summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it for every MIDI control change (a knob, a fader, the mod wheel, the sustain pedal), whether or not the controller is known.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每收到一個 MIDI 控制變化（旋鈕、推桿、調變輪、延音踏板），oav-p5 就呼叫它，不管控制器認不認得。

description.en: For one incoming message the order is: `midiMessage()`, then the specific one (`noteOn()`, `controlChange()`, `pitchBend()`), then the friendly one (`padPressed()`, `knobMoved()`, `notePressed()` and their partners).
description.zh: 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 `midiMessage()`，再來是對應的那一個（`noteOn()`、`controlChange()`、`pitchBend()`），最後才是比較親切的那一個（`padPressed()`、`knobMoved()`、`notePressed()` 和它們的另一半）。

params.name: cc
params.en: The controller number, 0 to 127 (1 is the mod wheel, 64 the sustain pedal, 74 the first knob on a MiniLab 3).
params.zh: 控制器號碼，0 到 127（1 是調變輪，64 是延音踏板，MiniLab 3 的第一顆旋鈕是 74）。

params.name: value
params.en: Where the control is now, 0 to 1 (MIDI's 0 to 127 divided by 127).
params.zh: 這個控制現在的位置，0 到 1（MIDI 的 0 到 127 除以 127）。

params.name: channel
params.en: The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.
params.zh: MIDI 通道，1 到 16。

needs.en: Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) and other programs reach it too. `OAVp5.on('controlChange', fn)` does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it.
needs.zh: 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，[`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、[`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。`OAVp5.on('controlChange', fn)` 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: Shows the controller number, its value and the channel of whatever you moved last. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 顯示你最後動的那個控制的號碼、值和通道。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: The background lights up while the sustain pedal is down. No pedal? Hold the mouse button: it sends the same message.
caption.zh: 延音踏板踩著的時候背景變亮。沒有踏板的話，按住滑鼠：它送出同樣的訊息。

claims.before: window.controlChange = (cc, v, c) => { window.__cc = [cc, Math.round(v * 127), c]; }; midi.input([0xB2, 74, 127], 'screen')

summary.en: Returns the position of fader number `n`, from 0 to 1: the same as `fader1` to `fader8`, for any `n`.
summary.zh: 回傳第 `n` 支推桿的位置，0 到 1：跟 `fader1` 到 `fader8` 一樣，但 `n` 可以是任何數字。

description.en: The function form of [`fader1`](#fader1), for when the fader's number is a variable.
description.zh: [`fader1`](#fader1) 的函式版本，推桿的編號是變數的時候用。

params.name: n
params.en: Which fader, counting from 1.
params.zh: 第幾支推桿，從 1 開始算。

returns.en: The fader's position, 0..1; 0 until it has moved.
returns.zh: 推桿的位置，0..1。還沒推過之前是 0。

caption.en: Four dots that rise with four faders.
caption.zh: 四個點，跟著四支推桿升高。

summary.en: The position of a controller fader (slider), from 0 to 1: `fader1` is the first fader, up to `fader8`.
summary.zh: 控制器上推桿（滑桿）的位置，從 0 到 1：`fader1` 是第一支推桿，一直到 `fader8`。

description.en: Works exactly like [`knob1`](#knob1), for the controller's faders, numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them (as printed on the device). A controller with only four faders, like the MiniLab 3, has `fader1` to `fader4`.
description.zh: 用法跟 [`knob1`](#knob1) 完全一樣，只是對應控制器上的推桿，編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序（也就是機器上印的順序）。只有四支推桿的控制器（像 MiniLab 3）就只有 `fader1` 到 `fader4`。

value.en: Changes when the fader moves; 0 until it has moved.
value.zh: 推桿移動的時候才會改變。還沒推過之前是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load, exactly as for a knob ([`knob1`](#knob1)); reading a fader also makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要，跟旋鈕一樣（見 [`knob1`](#knob1)）。讀推桿還會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成一張卡片。

caption.en: A bar that follows fader 1. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 一條跟著推桿 1 走的橫條。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever a fader moves.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。推桿一移動，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

description.en: The fader twin of [`knobMoved()`](#knobMoved): `function faderMoved(n, value) { … }`.
description.zh: [`knobMoved()`](#knobMoved) 的推桿版本：`function faderMoved(n, value) { … }`。

params.name: n
params.en: Which fader (1 is the first).
params.zh: 哪一支推桿（1 是第一支）。

params.name: value
params.en: Where it is now, 0..1.
params.zh: 現在的位置，0..1。

caption.en: A bar that follows fader 1, driven by the event instead of a read.
caption.zh: 一條跟著推桿 1 的橫條，用事件驅動，不是每個畫面去讀。

summary.en: Returns the position of knob number `n`, from 0 to 1: the same as `knob1` to `knob8`, for any `n`.
summary.zh: 回傳第 `n` 顆旋鈕的位置，0 到 1：跟 `knob1` 到 `knob8` 一樣，但 `n` 可以是任何數字。

description.en: Use it when the number of the knob is a variable: `for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));`. It also works in a sketch that has its own `knob1`, which oav-p5 then leaves alone.
description.zh: 旋鈕的編號是變數的時候用它：`for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));`。草圖自己已經有 `knob1` 的話也可以用，oav-p5 不會去動那個名稱。

params.name: n
params.en: Which knob, counting from 1 (as printed on the controller).
params.zh: 第幾顆旋鈕，從 1 開始算（照控制器上印的）。

returns.en: The knob's position, 0..1; 0 until it has been turned.
returns.zh: 旋鈕的位置，0..1。還沒轉過之前是 0。

caption.en: Eight bars, one per knob. Knobs you have not touched stay at the bottom.
caption.zh: 八根長條，一顆旋鈕一根。還沒碰過的旋鈕停在最低。

summary.en: The position of a controller knob, from 0 to 1: `knob1` is the first knob, `knob2` the second, up to `knob8`.
summary.zh: 控制器上旋鈕的位置，從 0 到 1：`knob1` 是第一顆旋鈕，`knob2` 是第二顆，一直到 `knob8`。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` the way you read `mouseX`: `background(knob1 * 255)`. Knobs are numbered the way they are printed on the controller, so knob 1 is knob 1 on any controller OAV has a [profile](/controllers/) for: the MiniLab 3's first knob is CC 74, the LPD8's is CC 70. The sketch never needs to know a CC number.
description.zh: 像讀 `mouseX` 一樣在 `draw()` 裡讀：`background(knob1 * 255)`。旋鈕的編號照控制器上印的順序，所以在 OAV 有[設定檔](/zh/controllers/)的任何控制器上，旋鈕 1 就是旋鈕 1：MiniLab 3 的第一顆是 CC 74，LPD8 的是 CC 70。草圖完全不用知道 CC 號碼。

description.en: On a controller OAV has no profile for, the first knob you turn becomes `knob1`, the next one `knob2`, and so on, in the order you turn them. Past eight, use [`knob(n)`](#knob).
description.zh: 遇到 OAV 沒有設定檔的控制器，你轉的第一顆旋鈕就變成 `knob1`，下一顆是 `knob2`，依你轉的順序往下排。超過八顆就用 [`knob(n)`](#knob)。

value.en: Changes when the knob moves, not once per frame; the sketch just reads the latest value. 0 until the knob has been turned.
value.zh: 旋鈕轉動的時候才會改變，不是每個畫面一次。草圖只要讀最新的值。旋鈕還沒轉過之前是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. With the default `hardware=auto`, oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI as soon as it loads, whatever the sketch reads (Chrome, Edge and Firefox have it; Safari and iPad do not: use 🎹 or a phone there). Reading a knob also tells oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI, so when Web MIDI is missing or refused a card beside the 🎹 says so; a sketch that uses none of this never sees that card. [`?oav_hardware=click`](#option-hardware) waits for the 🎹 panel instead.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。預設的 `hardware=auto` 下，oav-p5 一載入就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI，不管草圖有沒有讀東西（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 有。Safari 和 iPad 沒有，那裡改用 🎹 或手機）。讀旋鈕還會讓 oav-p5 知道這份草圖要用 MIDI 玩，所以 Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕的時候，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明。完全沒用到這些的草圖不會看到那張卡片。[`?oav_hardware=click`](#option-hardware) 則是等你按 🎹 面板裡的按鈕才去要。

notes.en: A sketch that already has its own `knob1` (a `let`, a function) keeps it, and a card beside the 🎹 says what to read instead (`knob(1)`).
notes.zh: 草圖如果本來就有自己的 `knob1`（`let`、函式都算），就由草圖保留，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明改讀什麼（`knob(1)`）。

notes.en: With OP Configurator, knobs also drive the OPC sliders in the order they are declared. A knob the sketch reads itself stays the sketch's: that slider no longer follows it.
notes.zh: 搭配 OP Configurator 時，旋鈕也會依宣告順序推動 OPC 的滑桿。草圖自己有讀的那顆旋鈕就歸草圖：對應的滑桿不再跟著動。

caption.en: Turn knob 1 and the whole canvas goes from black to white. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 轉旋鈕 1，整個畫布從黑變到白。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: Two knobs, two jobs: size and colour.
caption.zh: 兩顆旋鈕，兩件事：大小與顏色。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever a knob moves.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。旋鈕一轉動，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

params.name: n
params.en: Which knob (1 is the first, as printed on the controller).
params.zh: 哪一顆旋鈕（1 是第一顆，照控制器上印的）。

params.name: value
params.en: Where it is now, 0..1.
params.zh: 現在的位置，0..1。

caption.en: Shows which knob moved and where it is. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 顯示哪一顆旋鈕動了、現在在哪。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it for every MIDI message it receives, with the raw bytes and where they came from.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每收到一則 MIDI 訊息，oav-p5 就呼叫它，帶著原始的位元組和它從哪裡來。

description.en: It does not hear system messages: the MIDI clock, start, stop and song position go to [`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock), and system-exclusive messages are dropped. A note-on with velocity 0 arrives here as it was sent (a note-on with 0), while [`noteOff()`](#noteOff) is the one that treats it as a release.
description.zh: 系統訊息它聽不到：MIDI 時鐘、start、stop、song position 都交給 [`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock)，系統專用（sysex）訊息直接丟掉。力道是 0 的 note-on 在這裡照送出的樣子到達（note-on，力道 0），把它當成放開的是 [`noteOff()`](#noteOff)。

description.en: For one incoming message the order is: `midiMessage()`, then the specific one (`noteOn()`, `controlChange()`, `pitchBend()`), then the friendly one (`padPressed()`, `knobMoved()`, `notePressed()` and their partners).
description.zh: 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 `midiMessage()`，再來是對應的那一個（`noteOn()`、`controlChange()`、`pitchBend()`），最後才是比較親切的那一個（`padPressed()`、`knobMoved()`、`notePressed()` 和它們的另一半）。

params.name: bytes
params.en: The message as three numbers `[status, data1, data2]`. The status byte holds the kind in its top half and the channel in its bottom half (`0x90` is a note-on on channel 1, `0x93` on channel 4). The data bytes are 0 to 127, and a byte the message does not have is 0.
params.zh: 這則訊息，三個數字 `[status, data1, data2]`。status 位元組的上半是種類，下半是通道（`0x90` 是通道 1 的 note-on，`0x93` 是通道 4 的）。資料位元組是 0 到 127，訊息沒有的那個位元組是 0。

params.name: source
params.en: Where it came from: `'hardware'` (a real controller), `'screen'` (the 🎹), `'phone'`, `'virtual-out'` (a program playing into OAV Virtual MIDI), `'link'` (another page in the same room), or whatever label you gave [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input).
params.zh: 它從哪裡來：`'hardware'`（真的控制器）、`'screen'`（🎹）、`'phone'`、`'virtual-out'`（某個程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI）、`'link'`（同一個房間的另一頁），或你在 [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 給的標籤。

needs.en: Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) and other programs reach it too. `OAVp5.on('midiMessage', fn)` does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it.
needs.zh: 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，[`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、[`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。`OAVp5.on('midiMessage', fn)` 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: Prints the raw bytes of the last message and where it came from. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 印出最後一則訊息的原始位元組，和它從哪裡來。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: The circle follows aftertouch, which no friendlier function reports. No keyboard with aftertouch? Move the mouse across the canvas: it sends the same message.
caption.zh: 圓跟著觸後（aftertouch）走，這個沒有比較親切的函式會回報。沒有支援觸後的鍵盤的話，在畫布上移動滑鼠：它送出同樣的訊息。

summary.en: The MIDI number (0 to 127) of the last key pressed.
summary.zh: 最後被按下的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼（0 到 127）。

description.en: Middle C is 60, A4 is 69. [`noteName(note)`](#noteName) writes the number as a name (`60` → `'C4'`) and [`noteFreq(note)`](#noteFreq) as a frequency in Hz. [`velocity`](#velocity) says how hard it was pressed. For every key, not just the last, define [`notePressed()`](#notePressed).
description.zh: 中央 C 是 60，A4 是 69。[`noteName(note)`](#noteName) 把號碼寫成音名（`60` → `'C4'`），[`noteFreq(note)`](#noteFreq) 換成赫茲。[`velocity`](#velocity) 告訴你按得多用力。想要每個鍵都知道、不只最後一個，就定義 [`notePressed()`](#notePressed)。

value.en: Set when a key goes down and kept after it is released; 0 before any key has been pressed.
value.zh: 鍵按下的時候設定，放開之後也保留。還沒有按過任何鍵之前是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load (see [`knob1`](#knob1)). Unlike a knob, merely reading `note` does not tell oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI: defining [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) or reading a knob or pad does, which is what makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card. 🎹 and a phone always work.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要（見 [`knob1`](#knob1)）。跟旋鈕不一樣，單單讀 `note` 並不會讓 oav-p5 知道草圖要用 MIDI 玩：定義 [`notePressed()`](#notePressed)，或讀旋鈕、墊子才會，也才會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成卡片。🎹 和手機隨時都能用。

notes.en: A sketch with its own `note` (a `let note`, a function) keeps it; read `midi.last.note` instead. oav-p5 says so in a card the first time.
notes.zh: 草圖如果自己有 `note`（`let note`、函式都算），就由草圖保留。改讀 `midi.last.note`。oav-p5 第一次會用卡片告訴你。

caption.en: Shows the name of the last key you played. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 顯示你最後彈的那個鍵的名字。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: True while the key `n` (a MIDI number or a name like `'C4'`) is held down.
summary.zh: 鍵 `n`（MIDI 號碼，或像 `'C4'` 這樣的音名）按著的時候是 true。

description.en: The MIDI version of `keyIsDown()`. `noteIsDown('C4')` is the same as `noteIsDown(60)`: C4 is middle C. A name that is not a note (`'H4'`, `'C-2'`) stops the sketch with a one-line card saying how to write it.
description.zh: 就是 MIDI 版的 `keyIsDown()`。`noteIsDown('C4')` 跟 `noteIsDown(60)` 一樣：C4 是中央 C。不是音符的名稱（`'H4'`、`'C-2'`）會讓草圖停下來，並用一張卡片告訴你怎麼寫。

params.name: n
params.en: The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name (`'C4'`, `'c#4'`, `'Db3'`).

returns.en: True if that key is down right now.
returns.zh: 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。

caption.en: A circle that lights up only while C4 (middle C) is held. On the on-screen keyboard, middle C is the C labelled C4.
caption.zh: 只有按著 C4（中央 C）的時候才亮的圓。螢幕鍵盤上，標著 C4 的那個 C 就是中央 C。

summary.en: True while at least one key is held down.
summary.zh: 只要有任何一個鍵按著，就是 true。

description.en: To ask about one particular key, use [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown). `midi.held` lists every key held right now, lowest first.
description.zh: 想問某一個特定的鍵，用 [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown)。`midi.held` 列出現在按著的所有鍵，由低到高。

value.en: Like `keyIsPressed`, for MIDI keys. False when nothing is held.
value.zh: 像 `keyIsPressed`，但是對 MIDI 琴鍵。沒有任何鍵按著就是 false。

caption.en: The background lightens while any key is held.
caption.zh: 只要有鍵按著，背景就變亮。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it for every MIDI note-off, with the key and the channel.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每收到一個 MIDI 的 note-off，oav-p5 就呼叫它，帶著是哪個鍵、哪個通道。

description.en: For one incoming message the order is: `midiMessage()`, then the specific one (`noteOn()`, `controlChange()`, `pitchBend()`), then the friendly one (`padPressed()`, `knobMoved()`, `notePressed()` and their partners).
description.zh: 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 `midiMessage()`，再來是對應的那一個（`noteOn()`、`controlChange()`、`pitchBend()`），最後才是比較親切的那一個（`padPressed()`、`knobMoved()`、`notePressed()` 和它們的另一半）。

params.name: note
params.en: The MIDI number of the key that came up, 0 to 127.
params.zh: 放開的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127。

params.name: channel
params.en: The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.
params.zh: MIDI 通道，1 到 16。

needs.en: Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) and other programs reach it too. `OAVp5.on('noteOff', fn)` does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it.
needs.zh: 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，[`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、[`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。`OAVp5.on('noteOff', fn)` 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: Pairs each noteOn() with its noteOff() and says how long the key was held. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 把每個 noteOn() 和它的 noteOff() 配成一對，說出這個鍵按了多久。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it for every MIDI note-on, with the key, how hard and the channel.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每收到一個 MIDI 的 note-on，oav-p5 就呼叫它，帶著是哪個鍵、多用力、哪個通道。

description.en: For one incoming message the order is: `midiMessage()`, then the specific one (`noteOn()`, `controlChange()`, `pitchBend()`), then the friendly one (`padPressed()`, `knobMoved()`, `notePressed()` and their partners).
description.zh: 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 `midiMessage()`，再來是對應的那一個（`noteOn()`、`controlChange()`、`pitchBend()`），最後才是比較親切的那一個（`padPressed()`、`knobMoved()`、`notePressed()` 和它們的另一半）。

params.name: note
params.en: The MIDI number of the key, 0 to 127 (60 is middle C). [`noteName(note)`](#noteName) turns it into a name.
params.zh: 這個鍵的 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127（60 是中央 C）。[`noteName(note)`](#noteName) 可以把它轉成音名。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, above 0 and up to 1 (MIDI's 1 to 127 divided by 127).
params.zh: 多用力，大於 0、最大 1（MIDI 的 1 到 127 除以 127）。

params.name: channel
params.en: The MIDI channel, 1 to 16. Pads on the MiniLab 3 and the LPD8 send on channel 10.
params.zh: MIDI 通道，1 到 16。MiniLab 3 和 LPD8 的打擊墊都是從通道 10 送出。

needs.en: Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) and other programs reach it too. `OAVp5.on('noteOn', fn)` does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it.
needs.zh: 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，[`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、[`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。`OAVp5.on('noteOn', fn)` 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: Shows the key you played, how hard and on which channel. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 顯示你彈的那個鍵、多用力、哪個通道。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: Keys leave blue circles and pads leave orange squares, placed by pitch, bigger for harder hits, fading after a moment. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 鍵留下藍色圓，打擊墊留下橘色方塊，依音高排開，打得越用力越大，過一下就淡掉。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

claims.before: window.noteOn = (n, v, c) => { window.__noteOn = [n, Math.round(v * 127), c]; }; midi.input([0x93, 60, 100], 'screen')

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a key (or a pad) goes down.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每當有一個鍵（或打擊墊）按下，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

params.name: note
params.en: The MIDI number of the key (60 is middle C). [`noteName(note)`](#noteName) turns it into a name.
params.zh: 這個鍵的 MIDI 號碼（60 是中央 C）。[`noteName(note)`](#noteName) 可以把它轉成音名。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, 0..1.

needs.en: Defining it is enough: oav-p5 calls it from every source, and if Web MIDI is missing or refused it says so in a card beside the 🎹 (Web MIDI itself is asked for at load, see [`knob1`](#knob1)). Keys from 🎹 and from a phone call it too.
needs.zh: 只要定義了它就夠了：不管是哪一種來源，oav-p5 都會呼叫它。Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕的時候，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明（Web MIDI 本身在載入時就會去要，見 [`knob1`](#knob1)）。🎹 和手機上彈的鍵也會呼叫它。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next key still plays, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一個鍵還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: Every key leaves a circle: low keys on the left, high on the right, harder keys bigger.
caption.zh: 每個鍵留下一個圓：低音在左、高音在右，按得越用力圓越大。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a key (or a pad) is let go.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每當有一個鍵（或打擊墊）放開，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

params.name: note
params.en: The MIDI number of the key that was released.
params.zh: 被放開的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼。

caption.en: Lists the names of the keys that are down right now.
caption.zh: 列出現在按著的那些鍵的名字。

summary.en: Returns how hard pad number `n` is pressed, 0 to 1: the same as `pad1` to `pad16`, for any `n`.
summary.zh: 回傳第 `n` 個打擊墊被按得多用力，0 到 1：跟 `pad1` 到 `pad16` 一樣，但 `n` 可以是任何數字。

description.en: The function form of [`pad1`](#pad1).
description.zh: [`pad1`](#pad1) 的函式版本。

params.name: n
params.en: Which pad, counting from 1.
params.zh: 第幾個墊子，從 1 開始算。

returns.en: The velocity while the pad is held (0..1), 0 when it is released.
returns.zh: 墊子按著的時候是力道（0..1），放開是 0。

caption.en: A grid of eight squares that light up under the pads you hit.
caption.zh: 八個方塊排成格子，你打哪個墊子，哪個方塊就亮起來。

summary.en: How hard a drum pad is pressed, from 0 to 1: `pad1` is the first pad, up to `pad16`; 0 when it is let go.
summary.zh: 打擊墊被按得多用力，從 0 到 1：`pad1` 是第一個墊子，一直到 `pad16`。放開就是 0。

description.en: Read it like a held mouse button that also knows how hard: `if (pad1 > 0) fill(255, 90, 31)`. Pads are numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them. To react once per hit rather than ask every frame, define [`padPressed()`](#padPressed).
description.zh: 像一個知道力道的滑鼠按鍵那樣讀：`if (pad1 > 0) fill(255, 90, 31)`。墊子編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序。想「每打一下反應一次」而不是每個畫面都問，就定義 [`padPressed()`](#padPressed)。

value.en: The velocity of the hit while the pad is held (1 is as hard as the controller sends), and 0 as soon as it is released.
value.zh: 墊子按著的時候是這一下的力道（1 是控制器能送出的最大力道），一放開就變成 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. Web MIDI is asked for at load, exactly as for a knob ([`knob1`](#knob1)); reading a pad also makes a missing or refused Web MIDI show as a card.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。Web MIDI 在載入時就會去要，跟旋鈕一樣（見 [`knob1`](#knob1)）。讀墊子還會讓「Web MIDI 不存在或被拒絕」顯示成一張卡片。

caption.en: The circle swells while pad 1 is down, more for a harder hit. On the on-screen controller, click the first pad.
caption.zh: 按著墊子 1 的時候圓會脹大，打得越用力越大。用螢幕上的控制器就點第一個墊子。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a drum pad is hit.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每打一下打擊墊，oav-p5 就呼叫它一次。

params.name: n
params.en: Which pad (1 is the first).
params.zh: 哪個墊子（1 是第一個）。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, 0..1.

caption.en: Each hit pops a circle where its pad would sit on a 4×2 grid, and it fades away.
caption.zh: 每打一下，就在那個墊子在 4×2 格子裡的位置冒出一個圓，然後慢慢消失。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a drum pad is let go.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。每當打擊墊放開，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

description.en: The partner of [`padPressed()`](#padPressed): `function padReleased(n) { … }`. Without it, a pad calls [`noteReleased()`](#noteReleased).
description.zh: [`padPressed()`](#padPressed) 的另一半：`function padReleased(n) { … }`。沒有定義的話，打擊墊會呼叫 [`noteReleased()`](#noteReleased)。

params.name: n
params.en: Which pad (1 is the first).
params.zh: 哪個墊子（1 是第一個）。

caption.en: A square per pad, lit from press to release.
caption.zh: 一個墊子一個方塊，從按下到放開都亮著。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever the pitch wheel moves, with its position from −1 to 1.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。音高輪一動，oav-p5 就呼叫它，帶著它的位置，從 −1 到 1。

description.en: For one incoming message the order is: `midiMessage()`, then the specific one (`noteOn()`, `controlChange()`, `pitchBend()`), then the friendly one (`padPressed()`, `knobMoved()`, `notePressed()` and their partners).
description.zh: 同一則訊息進來時，呼叫的順序是：先 `midiMessage()`，再來是對應的那一個（`noteOn()`、`controlChange()`、`pitchBend()`），最後才是比較親切的那一個（`padPressed()`、`knobMoved()`、`notePressed()` 和它們的另一半）。

params.name: value
params.en: The wheel's position: −1 all the way down, 0 in the middle, 1 all the way up.
params.zh: 輪子的位置：−1 是推到底往下，0 是中間，1 是推到底往上。

params.name: channel
params.en: The MIDI channel, 1 to 16.
params.zh: MIDI 通道，1 到 16。

needs.en: Defining the function is enough. oav-p5 asks the browser for Web MIDI when it loads (the default, [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)), and a sketch that defines it also gets a card if Web MIDI is missing or blocked. Keys from 🎹, a phone, [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) and other programs reach it too. `OAVp5.on('pitchBend', fn)` does the same without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops it.
needs.zh: 只要定義這個函式就夠了。oav-p5 在載入的時候就會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（預設，[`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware)），而草圖有定義這個函式的話，Web MIDI 不存在或被擋下時還會多跳出一張卡片。🎹、手機、[`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 和其他程式送來的訊息也都會呼叫它。`OAVp5.on('pitchBend', fn)` 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

notes.en: Pitch bend is not mapped to anything else: there is no `bend` variable, only this function and `OAVp5.bend`.
notes.zh: 音高輪沒有對應到別的東西：沒有叫 `bend` 的變數，只有這個函式和 `OAVp5.bend`。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next message is still handled, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一則訊息還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: The circle slides left and right with the pitch wheel and returns to the middle when it springs back. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 圓隨音高輪往左右滑，輪子彈回中間時它也回到中間。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: The same wheel through spring(). No wheel? Drag the mouse across the canvas: it sends the same message.
caption.zh: 同一個輪子，再用 spring() 處理。沒有輪子的話，在畫布上拖動滑鼠：它送出同樣的訊息。

summary.en: How hard the last key was pressed, from 0 to 1.
summary.zh: 最後那個鍵被按得多用力，從 0 到 1。

description.en: MIDI sends velocity as 0 to 127; oav-p5 hands you it divided by 127, so 1 is the hardest hit the controller can send.
description.zh: MIDI 的力道是 0 到 127。oav-p5 給你的是除以 127 之後的值，所以 1 就是控制器能送出的最大力道。

value.en: Set together with [`note`](#note) when a key goes down; kept after release; 0 before any key.
value.zh: 跟 [`note`](#note) 一起在鍵按下的時候設定。放開之後保留。還沒按過任何鍵之前是 0。

notes.en: A sketch with its own `velocity` keeps it; read `midi.last.value`.
notes.zh: 草圖自己有 `velocity` 的話就由草圖保留。改讀 `midi.last.value`。

caption.en: The circle stays at the size of the last key's velocity.
caption.zh: 圓的大小停在最後那個鍵的力道上。

summary.en: Where the pitch wheel is, from −1 (all the way down) through 0 (middle) to 1 (all the way up).
summary.zh: 音高輪現在的位置，從 −1（推到底往下）、經過 0（中間）到 1（推到底往上）。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` like a knob that goes both ways: `x = width / 2 + OAVp5.bend * 150`. MIDI sends the position as 14 bits (0 to 16383, with 8192 in the middle). oav-p5 maps the two halves to −1..0 and 0..1, so full travel reaches exactly −1 and 1. To be told on every movement, define [`pitchBend()`](#pitchBend).
description.zh: 像一顆可以往兩邊轉的旋鈕那樣在 `draw()` 裡讀：`x = width / 2 + OAVp5.bend * 150`。MIDI 用 14 位元送出位置（0 到 16383，中間是 8192）。oav-p5 把兩半分別對應成 −1 到 0 和 0 到 1，所以推到底剛好是 −1 和 1。想每次移動都被通知，就定義 [`pitchBend()`](#pitchBend)。

value.en: Changes when the wheel moves. 0 before it has moved, and again when a spring-loaded wheel returns to the middle.
value.zh: 輪子動的時候才會變。還沒動過之前是 0，有彈簧的輪子彈回中間時也是 0。

notes.en: `midi.bend` is the same number. There is no plain `bend` variable.
notes.zh: `midi.bend` 是同一個數字。沒有叫 `bend` 的變數。

caption.en: The circle follows the pitch wheel. No wheel? Drag the mouse across the canvas: it sends the same message.
caption.zh: 圓跟著音高輪走。沒有輪子的話，在畫布上拖動滑鼠：它送出同樣的訊息。

summary.en: An array of 128 numbers, one per MIDI controller number: where each control last was, 0 to 1. `OAVp5.cc[1]` is the mod wheel, `OAVp5.cc[64]` the sustain pedal.
summary.zh: 128 個數字的陣列，每個 MIDI 控制器號碼一個：每個控制最後停在哪裡，0 到 1。`OAVp5.cc[1]` 是調變輪，`OAVp5.cc[64]` 是延音踏板。

description.en: The array version of [`controlChange()`](#controlChange): read any controller in `draw()` without defining a function. It holds every CC, including the ones that are not a knob or a fader, such as the mod wheel (1), the volume (7) and the sustain pedal (64, which counts as down at 0.5 and above). The MIDI channel is ignored: the latest value of that controller number wins, whichever channel it came on.
description.zh: [`controlChange()`](#controlChange) 的陣列版：不用定義函式，在 `draw()` 裡讀任何控制器。每個 CC 它都記著，包括不是旋鈕也不是推桿的那些，像調變輪（1）、音量（7）和延音踏板（64，0.5 以上算踩下去）。MIDI 通道被忽略：那個控制器號碼的最新值勝出，不管它是從哪個通道來的。

value.en: The index is the controller (CC) number, 0 to 127; the value is the last one received divided by 127. Changes when a message arrives. 0 before a control has moved, which is not the same as "at 0".
value.zh: 索引是控制器（CC）號碼，0 到 127，值是最後收到的那個除以 127。訊息進來的時候才會變。控制還沒動過之前是 0，這跟「剛好在 0」不是同一件事。

notes.en: `midi.cc` is the same array. The friendly names `knob1` and `fader1` are looked up through the controller's profile and read the same data.
notes.zh: `midi.cc` 是同一個陣列。比較親切的 `knob1` 和 `fader1` 是透過控制器的設定檔對應過去的，讀的是同樣的資料。

caption.en: The mod wheel (CC 1) sets the size of the circle and the sustain pedal (CC 64) lightens the background. No controller? Drag the mouse across the canvas: it sends CC 1.
caption.zh: 調變輪（CC 1）決定圓的大小，延音踏板（CC 64）讓背景變亮。沒有控制器的話，在畫布上拖動滑鼠：它會送出 CC 1。

summary.en: Asks the browser for Web MIDI now, and returns a promise that says whether a real controller can be heard.
summary.zh: 現在就向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你聽不聽得到真的控制器。

description.en: It does what [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware) does at load, at a moment you pick: from a button, after an intro, or when [`hardware`](#option-hardware) is `click` or `off`. It works whatever the option says. After a refusal you can call it again to retry, but browsers usually remember a refusal and answer at once, so the way out is the lock icon left of the address.
description.zh: 它做的就是 [`?oav_hardware=auto`](#option-hardware) 在載入時做的事，只是時間由你挑：從一個按鈕、片頭結束之後，或是 [`hardware`](#option-hardware) 設成 `click` 或 `off` 的時候。不管選項怎麼設它都能用。被拒絕之後可以再呼叫一次重試，但瀏覽器通常會記住拒絕、立刻回答，所以要解決得靠網址列左邊的鎖頭。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once the browser has allowed Web MIDI (with or without a device plugged in), and to `false` if it refused or there is no Web MIDI in this browser. Calling it again while it is asking, or after it said yes, gives the same answer.
returns.zh: 瀏覽器允許 Web MIDI 之後 resolve 成 `true`（不管有沒有插設備），被拒絕或這個瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI 就 resolve 成 `false`。還在詢問的時候、或是已經答應之後再呼叫，會得到同樣的答案。

needs.en: A browser with Web MIDI (Chrome, Edge, Firefox), on `https` or `localhost`. Some browsers want a click first: call it from `mousePressed()` or a button handler if `setup()` is too early. Safari and iPad have none: the promise resolves `false` and [`OAVp5.hardware`](#OAVp5.hardware) is `'unavailable'`.
needs.zh: 要有 Web MIDI 的瀏覽器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox），網頁在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下。有些瀏覽器要先有一次點擊：如果在 `setup()` 裡太早，就放在 `mousePressed()` 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。Safari 和 iPad 沒有：promise 會 resolve 成 `false`，[`OAVp5.hardware`](#OAVp5.hardware) 是 `'unavailable'`。

caption.en: Nothing is asked at load. Click the canvas: the browser asks, the state goes from "off" through "asking" to "connected", "waiting" or "denied", and the text follows.
caption.zh: 載入的時候什麼都沒有問。點一下畫布：瀏覽器才詢問，狀態從 "off" 經過 "asking" 變成 "connected"、"waiting" 或 "denied"，文字也跟著變。

summary.en: The names of the MIDI controllers plugged in, as the browser reports them: an array of text, empty when there is none.
summary.zh: 插著的 MIDI 控制器的名稱，照瀏覽器回報的樣子：一個文字陣列，沒有的時候是空的。

description.en: Use it for a line like "playing: Arturia MiniLab3", or to tell whether a real controller is there. The names are whatever the operating system calls the port, so match them loosely (`name.toLowerCase().includes('minilab')`). The 🎹 panel uses them to follow the controller that is plugged in.
description.zh: 用來顯示像「正在彈：Arturia MiniLab3」這樣的一行，或判斷有沒有真的控制器。名稱是作業系統給連接埠取的名字，所以比對時要寬鬆一點（`name.toLowerCase().includes('minilab')`）。🎹 面板就是用它們來跟著插上去的那一台控制器。

value.en: One entry per connected input port. Replaced whenever a device is plugged in or out. Empty until Web MIDI has been allowed ([`OAVp5.hardware`](#OAVp5.hardware)), and it never lists the on-screen controller or the phone.
value.zh: 每個連上的輸入埠一項。每次有設備插上或拔掉都會換成新的。在 Web MIDI 被允許之前是空的（[`OAVp5.hardware`](#OAVp5.hardware)），而且永遠不會列出螢幕上的控制器或手機。

notes.en: `midi.devices` is the same array, replaced as a whole, not changed in place: read it again after a change.
notes.zh: `midi.devices` 是同一個陣列，是整個換掉，不是就地修改：變動之後要重新讀一次。

caption.en: Names the controllers found, or says there are none. Plug a controller in while the page is open and the line changes.
caption.zh: 寫出找到的控制器，或說沒有。頁面開著的時候插上一台控制器，這一行就會改變。

summary.en: Where Web MIDI stands: `'off'`, `'asking'`, `'connected'`, `'waiting'`, `'denied'` or `'unavailable'`.
summary.zh: Web MIDI 目前的情形：`'off'`、`'asking'`、`'connected'`、`'waiting'`、`'denied'` 或 `'unavailable'`。

description.en: `'off'`: Web MIDI has not been asked for yet (see [`hardware`](#option-hardware)). `'asking'`: waiting for the browser's permission answer. `'connected'`: allowed, and at least one device is plugged in ([`OAVp5.devices`](#OAVp5.devices) lists them). `'waiting'`: allowed, but no device yet: plug one in and it becomes `'connected'` by itself. `'denied'`: the permission was refused. `'unavailable'`: the browser has no Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) or could not open it.
description.zh: `'off'`：還沒有去要過 Web MIDI（見 [`hardware`](#option-hardware)）。`'asking'`：等瀏覽器的權限回答。`'connected'`：允許了，而且至少插著一台設備（[`OAVp5.devices`](#OAVp5.devices) 列出它們）。`'waiting'`：允許了，但還沒有設備：插上一台就會自己變成 `'connected'`。`'denied'`：權限被拒絕。`'unavailable'`：這個瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad），或是打不開它。

description.en: It is only about real hardware. The on-screen controller and a phone work in every state.
description.zh: 它只管真的硬體。螢幕上的控制器和手機在每一種狀態下都能用。

value.en: Changes when the browser answers and whenever a MIDI device is plugged in or out.
value.zh: 瀏覽器回答的時候，以及每次有 MIDI 設備插上或拔掉的時候會變。

notes.en: In the 🩺 check-up, `waiting` is written as "no device found".
notes.zh: 在 🩺 體檢裡，`waiting` 寫成「沒偵測到裝置」。

caption.en: Shows the state of Web MIDI and the devices found. The background turns green once a controller is connected. Plug one in to see it change.
caption.zh: 顯示 Web MIDI 的狀態和找到的設備。控制器一連上，背景就變綠。插一台上去看它改變。

summary.en: A list of the MIDI numbers of the keys that are down right now, lowest first.
summary.zh: 現在按著的鍵的 MIDI 號碼清單，由低到高。

description.en: The short version of [`OAVp5.note`](#OAVp5.note): only the keys that are down, so `OAVp5.held.length` is how many, `OAVp5.held[0]` is the lowest and `OAVp5.held.map((n) => noteName(n))` spells the chord. [`noteIsPressed`](#noteIsPressed) is `OAVp5.held.length > 0`.
description.zh: [`OAVp5.note`](#OAVp5.note) 的精簡版：只列按著的鍵，所以 `OAVp5.held.length` 是幾個鍵，`OAVp5.held[0]` 是最低的那個，`OAVp5.held.map((n) => noteName(n))` 把和弦寫出來。[`noteIsPressed`](#noteIsPressed) 就是 `OAVp5.held.length > 0`。

value.en: Empty when nothing is held. A key is added when its note-on arrives and removed at its note-off, and the list is kept sorted from low to high.
value.zh: 沒有按著任何鍵的時候是空的。note-on 進來時加入，note-off 時移除，清單一直照由低到高排好。

notes.en: `midi.held` is the same array. Read it, do not change it. It is the same array object every time, so copy it (`[...OAVp5.held]`) if you want to keep a moment of it.
notes.zh: `midi.held` 是同一個陣列。只讀，不要改它。它每次都是同一個陣列物件，想把某一刻存下來的話要複製一份（`[...OAVp5.held]`）。

caption.en: Spells the keys held down, lowest first. Click the canvas to hold one more key. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 把按著的鍵由低到高寫出來。點一下畫布就多按著一個鍵。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: Sends one MIDI message into oav-p5 by hand, as bytes: the whole sketch reacts as if a controller had sent it.
summary.zh: 用位元組手動送一則 MIDI 訊息給 oav-p5：整個草圖的反應就像是控制器送出來的。

description.en: It is the door every input goes through, and you can knock on it yourself: a sketch can test itself without a controller, drive itself from a timer, or take messages from a WebSocket or another library. The sketch cannot tell the difference: [`knob1`](#knob1), [`notePressed()`](#notePressed), [`OAVp5.note`](#OAVp5.note), the sound if [`startSound()`](#startSound) is on and the drum cues all react. [`OAVp5.play()`](#OAVp5.play) is the friendlier way to send a note.
description.zh: 每一種輸入都從這扇門進來，你也可以自己來敲：草圖可以在沒有控制器的時候測試自己、用計時器自己推動自己，或接收來自 WebSocket 或其他函式庫的訊息。草圖分不出差別：[`knob1`](#knob1)、[`notePressed()`](#notePressed)、[`OAVp5.note`](#OAVp5.note)、開著 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 時的聲音，還有鼓機的 cue 都會有反應。要送音符的話，[`OAVp5.play()`](#OAVp5.play) 是比較親切的方式。

params.name: bytes
params.en: One message, `[status, data1, data2]`: `[0x90, 60, 100]` is a note-on for key 60 with velocity 100 on channel 1, `[0xB0, 74, 127]` a control change, `[0xE0, 0, 64]` a pitch bend in the middle. The status byte sets the kind (top half) and the channel (bottom half). Only the first three numbers are read, and the data bytes are held to 0 to 127. System messages are not for this: the clock bytes (`0xF8`, `0xFA`, `0xFB`, `0xFC`, `0xF2`) go to [`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock), and anything else from `0xF0` up is ignored.
params.zh: 一則訊息，`[status, data1, data2]`：`[0x90, 60, 100]` 是通道 1 上鍵 60、力道 100 的 note-on，`[0xB0, 74, 127]` 是控制變化，`[0xE0, 0, 64]` 是在中間的音高輪。status 位元組決定種類（上半）和通道（下半）。只讀前三個數字，資料位元組會被限制在 0 到 127。系統訊息不是給它用的：時鐘位元組（`0xF8`、`0xFA`、`0xFB`、`0xFC`、`0xF2`）會交給 [`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock)，從 `0xF0` 起的其他東西都忽略。

params.name: source
params.en: A label for where it came from, which shows up as `OAVp5.last.source` and as the second argument of [`midiMessage()`](#midiMessage). Any text. `'hardware'` and `'virtual-out'` are taken as those real sources and are not repeated to a sketch's own Web MIDI code.
params.zh: 一個說明來源的標籤，會出現在 `OAVp5.last.source`，也是 [`midiMessage()`](#midiMessage) 的第二個參數。任何文字都行。`'hardware'` 和 `'virtual-out'` 會被當作真的那兩種來源，不會再轉給草圖自己的 Web MIDI 程式。

params.name: device
params.en: A profile id such as `'akai-lpd8'`: the numbering of `knob1`, `pad1` … follows that controller for this message. Left out, it is the controller on the on-screen panel.
params.zh: 設定檔 id，像 `'akai-lpd8'`：這則訊息裡 `knob1`、`pad1` … 的編號照那一台控制器來對應。不寫的話，就是螢幕面板上的那一台控制器。

notes.en: `midi.input(…)` is the same function. It returns nothing. A message with a source other than `'screen'` also lights the keys of the on-screen controller if it is open.
notes.zh: `midi.input(…)` 是同一個函式。它沒有回傳值。來源不是 `'screen'` 的訊息，會在螢幕控制器打開的時候也讓它的琴鍵亮起來。

caption.en: Click the canvas: the sketch hears a note-on exactly as if you had played a key, and names it.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布：草圖聽到一個 note-on，就跟你彈了一個鍵一樣，並說出它的名字。

caption.en: Drag the mouse across the canvas: it sends CC 74, which is knob 1, and the circle follows.
caption.zh: 在畫布上拖動滑鼠：它送出 CC 74，也就是旋鈕 1，圓跟著動。

caption.en: The third argument says which controller the message comes from, so CC 70 is knob 1 here, whatever profile the panel shows.
caption.zh: 第三個參數說明這則訊息來自哪一台控制器，所以不管面板顯示哪個設定檔，這裡的 CC 70 都是旋鈕 1。

summary.en: True while the key `n` (a MIDI number or a name like `'C4'`) is held down: the same as `noteIsDown(n)`.
summary.zh: 鍵 `n`（MIDI 號碼，或像 `'C4'` 這樣的音名）按著的時候是 true：跟 `noteIsDown(n)` 一樣。

description.en: It is [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown) under the `OAVp5` name, for a sketch that cannot use the plain one: `OAVp5.isDown('C4')`. A name that is not a note stops the sketch with a card that says how to write one.
description.zh: 它是用 `OAVp5` 這個名字呼叫的 [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown)，給不能用一般名稱的草圖：`OAVp5.isDown('C4')`。不是音符的名稱會讓草圖停下來，並用卡片說明怎麼寫。

params.name: n
params.en: The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name (`'C4'`, `'c#4'`, `'Db3'`).

returns.en: True if that key is down right now.
returns.zh: 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。

notes.en: `midi.isDown(…)` is the same function.
notes.zh: `midi.isDown(…)` 是同一個函式。

caption.en: The background turns green while C, E and G are held together. Hold the mouse down to play the chord. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: C、E、G 同時按著的時候，背景變綠。按住滑鼠就會彈出這個和弦。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: The latest note, control change or pitch bend that arrived: its type, number, value, channel, where it came from and which control it is. `null` before any.
summary.zh: 最近收到的音符、控制變化或音高輪訊息：它的種類、號碼、值、通道、來自哪裡、是哪個控制。在任何訊息之前是 `null`。

description.en: A single object that is replaced on every message, so read it, do not keep it. It is how a sketch finds out where a message came from (`OAVp5.last.source`) or which knob moved (`OAVp5.last.control`), and what to read when the sketch has its own `note` or `velocity` that keeps the plain names: `OAVp5.last.note` and `OAVp5.last.value`.
description.zh: 它是每收到一則訊息就整個換掉的單一物件，所以只讀，不要留著。草圖用它知道訊息從哪裡來（`OAVp5.last.source`）或哪顆旋鈕動了（`OAVp5.last.control`），草圖自己有 `note` 或 `velocity` 而保留了一般名稱的時候，也是改讀它：`OAVp5.last.note` 和 `OAVp5.last.value`。

description.en: It keeps only notes, control changes and pitch bends. Aftertouch and program change reach [`midiMessage()`](#midiMessage) but are not stored here.
description.zh: 它只留音符、控制變化和音高輪。觸後和音色切換只會到 [`midiMessage()`](#midiMessage)，這裡不存。

value.en: `{ type, note | cc, value, channel, source, control }`. `type` is `'noteOn'`, `'noteOff'`, `'controlChange'` or `'pitchBend'` (a note-on with velocity 0 is a `'noteOff'`). `note` is there for notes, `cc` for control changes. `value` is the velocity 0..1 (0 for a note-off), the control's position 0..1, or the wheel −1..1. `channel` is 1 to 16. `source` is `'hardware'`, `'screen'`, `'phone'`, `'virtual-out'`, `'link'` or the label you gave [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input). `control` is `'knob1'`, `'fader2'`, `'pad3'` … when the controller's profile knows it, otherwise `null`.
value.zh: `{ type, note | cc, value, channel, source, control }`。`type` 是 `'noteOn'`、`'noteOff'`、`'controlChange'` 或 `'pitchBend'`（力道 0 的 note-on 算 `'noteOff'`）。音符有 `note`，控制變化有 `cc`。`value` 是力道 0 到 1（note-off 是 0）、控制的位置 0 到 1，或輪子的 −1 到 1。`channel` 是 1 到 16。`source` 是 `'hardware'`、`'screen'`、`'phone'`、`'virtual-out'`、`'link'`，或你在 [`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input) 給的標籤。`control` 在控制器的設定檔認得它的時候是 `'knob1'`、`'fader2'`、`'pad3'` …，否則是 `null`。

notes.en: `midi.last` is the same object. Clock messages (tick, start, stop) are not here: see [`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock).
notes.zh: `midi.last` 是同一個物件。時鐘訊息（tick、start、stop）不在這裡，請看 [`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock)。

caption.en: Prints the last message as an object. Click the canvas to send one from the mouse, and watch `source`. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 把最後一則訊息印成物件。點一下畫布就從滑鼠送一則，並看 `source`。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: An array of 128 numbers, one per MIDI key: how hard that key is held, 0 to 1, and 0 when it is up. `OAVp5.note[60]` is middle C.
summary.zh: 128 個數字的陣列，每個 MIDI 鍵一個：那個鍵被按得多用力，0 到 1，放開就是 0。`OAVp5.note[60]` 是中央 C。

description.en: Read every key at once, in `draw()`: `OAVp5.note[60]` for one key, or a loop over a range to draw a piano roll. It is the array version of [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown), with the velocity in it. It is not the variable [`note`](#note), which is just the number of the last key pressed. [`OAVp5.held`](#OAVp5.held) is the same information as a short list of the keys that are down.
description.zh: 在 `draw()` 裡一次讀每個鍵：`OAVp5.note[60]` 讀一個鍵，或用迴圈跑過一個範圍來畫鋼琴捲簾。它是 [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown) 的陣列版，而且裡面有力道。它不是變數 [`note`](#note)，那個只是最後按下的鍵的號碼。[`OAVp5.held`](#OAVp5.held) 是同樣的資訊，做成只列出按著的鍵的短清單。

value.en: The index is the MIDI note number, 0 to 127. A key that is down holds the velocity of its note-on divided by 127, a key that is up (or never pressed) holds 0. Changes when a message arrives, not once per frame.
value.zh: 索引是 MIDI 音符號碼，0 到 127。按著的鍵放的是它 note-on 的力道除以 127，放開（或從沒按過）的鍵是 0。訊息進來的時候才會變，不是每個畫面一次。

notes.en: `midi.note` is the same array. A note-on with velocity 0 sets the key to 0, like a note-off.
notes.zh: `midi.note` 是同一個陣列。力道是 0 的 note-on 會讓那個鍵變成 0，就像 note-off。

caption.en: A bar for each key: it rises while the key is down, higher for a harder press. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 每個鍵一根長條：按著的時候升起，按得越用力越高。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: Middle C (60) swells the circle by how hard it is held, and the circle shrinks back slowly.
caption.zh: 中央 C（60）按得多用力，圓就脹得多大，放開之後慢慢縮回去。

summary.en: Listens to a MIDI event by name without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops listening.
summary.zh: 用名字監聽一個 MIDI 事件，不必定義全域函式，並回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

description.en: The event functions ([`notePressed()`](#notePressed), [`knobMoved()`](#knobMoved), [`noteOn()`](#noteOn) …) are defined once, by name. `OAVp5.on('notePressed', fn)` is the other way: any number of listeners, added and removed while the sketch runs, with no global names taken. It is how a library, a class or a Hydra sketch listens, and the way to listen for a while and stop.
description.zh: 事件函式（[`notePressed()`](#notePressed)、[`knobMoved()`](#knobMoved)、[`noteOn()`](#noteOn) …）是用名字定義一次的。`OAVp5.on('notePressed', fn)` 是另一種方式：想要幾個監聽者都行，草圖在跑的時候可以加也可以拿掉，也不占用任何全域名稱。函式庫、類別或 Hydra 草圖就是這樣監聽的，要聽一陣子再停下來也用它。

description.en: A listener counts as a defined function for the pad rule: once anything listens to `'padPressed'`, a pad stops calling `notePressed()`. An error inside `fn` shows in the console and on a card, and the other listeners still run. For the microphone's events use [`OAVp5.mic.on()`](#OAVp5.mic.on).
description.zh: 對打擊墊的規則來說，監聽者就跟定義過的函式一樣：只要有東西在聽 `'padPressed'`，打擊墊就不再呼叫 `notePressed()`。`fn` 裡面出錯會顯示在 console 和卡片上，其他的監聽者照樣執行。麥克風的事件要用 [`OAVp5.mic.on()`](#OAVp5.mic.on)。

params.name: name
params.en: The event: `'notePressed'`, `'noteReleased'`, `'knobMoved'`, `'faderMoved'`, `'padPressed'`, `'padReleased'`, `'noteOn'`, `'noteOff'`, `'controlChange'`, `'pitchBend'` or `'midiMessage'`. `'noteon'` and `'noteoff'` work in any case. Anything else throws an error that lists the names.
params.zh: 事件名稱：`'notePressed'`、`'noteReleased'`、`'knobMoved'`、`'faderMoved'`、`'padPressed'`、`'padReleased'`、`'noteOn'`、`'noteOff'`、`'controlChange'`、`'pitchBend'` 或 `'midiMessage'`。`'noteon'` 和 `'noteoff'` 大小寫隨便。其他的名稱會丟出一個錯誤，並列出可用的名稱。

params.name: fn
params.en: Called with the same arguments the function of that name would get (`notePressed(note, velocity)`, `knobMoved(n, value)` …).
params.zh: 呼叫它的時候帶的參數跟同名函式會拿到的一樣（`notePressed(note, velocity)`、`knobMoved(n, value)` …）。

returns.en: A function that takes `fn` off again: `const off = OAVp5.on(…); off();`.
returns.zh: 一個把 `fn` 取消的函式：`const off = OAVp5.on(…); off();`。

notes.en: `midi.on(…)` is the same function.
notes.zh: `midi.on(…)` 是同一個函式。

caption.en: Counts the notes with a listener instead of a global function. Click the canvas to play one. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 用監聽者而不是全域函式來數音符。點一下畫布就彈一個。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: The number counts up to five and then stops, even though you keep playing: the listener took itself off.
caption.zh: 數字數到五就停了，就算你繼續彈也一樣：監聽者把自己取消掉了。

claims.before: window.__n = 0; window.__off = OAVp5.on('noteOn', () => window.__n++); midi.input([0x90, 60, 100], 'screen'); midi.input([0x90, 62, 100], 'screen'); window.__off(); midi.input([0x90, 64, 100], 'screen')

summary.en: The 🎹 panel as an object: `open()`, `close()` and `toggle()` show and hide it from code.
summary.zh: 把 🎹 面板當成物件：用 `open()`、`close()`、`toggle()` 從程式裡顯示和收起它。

description.en: The panel behind the 🎹 button holds the on-screen controller and the buttons for 🎤, 🔊, 🥁, ⏺, 📷, 📱 and 🩺. [`OAVp5.panel.open()`](#OAVp5.panel.open), `close()` and `toggle()` do what pressing 🎹 does, from your code: open it on a key, or open it at the start for a workshop ([`?oav_panel=open`](#option-panel) does the same at load).
description.zh: 🎹 按鈕後面的面板裝著螢幕上的控制器，和 🎤、🔊、🥁、⏺、📷、📱、🩺 的按鈕。[`OAVp5.panel.open()`](#OAVp5.panel.open)、`close()`、`toggle()` 做的是按 🎹 做的事，只是從你的程式裡：按一個鍵就打開它，或是工作坊一開始就打開（[`?oav_panel=open`](#option-panel) 在載入時做同樣的事）。

notes.en: With `?oav_panel=off` there is no 🎹 and these do nothing.
notes.zh: 設了 `?oav_panel=off` 就沒有 🎹，這幾個也什麼都不做。

caption.en: Press p: the 🎹 panel opens and, pressed again, closes.
caption.zh: 按 p：🎹 面板打開，再按一次就關起來。

summary.en: Opens the 🎹 panel (`open()`), closes it (`close()`) or flips it (`toggle()`).
summary.zh: 打開 🎹 面板（`open()`）、收起它（`close()`），或是切換（`toggle()`）。

description.en: Same as pressing the 🎹 button. The first time the panel opens, oav-p5 loads the on-screen controller (a few seconds on a slow connection, which the panel says while it loads), and if [`hardware`](#option-hardware) is `click` it asks for Web MIDI then. `OAVp5.panel.open()` when it is already open does nothing new.
description.zh: 就跟按 🎹 按鈕一樣。面板第一次打開的時候，oav-p5 才載入螢幕控制器（連線慢的話要幾秒，載入的時候面板會這麼說），而且 [`hardware`](#option-hardware) 是 `click` 的話，就在這時去要 Web MIDI。已經打開的時候再呼叫 `OAVp5.panel.open()` 不會有新的動作。

returns.en: A promise. `open()` (and `toggle()` when it opens) resolves to the panel's element once the on-screen controller inside it has loaded, and the panel is on screen at once, before that. `close()` (and `toggle()` when it closes) resolves to `null`, and so does everything when the panel option is `off`.
returns.zh: 一個 promise。`open()`（以及 `toggle()` 打開時）在面板裡的螢幕控制器載好之後 resolve 成面板的元素，面板本身一開始就會顯示，不用等。`close()`（以及 `toggle()` 關起來時）resolve 成 `null`，面板選項是 `off` 的時候全部都是 `null`。

notes.en: The three are listed together here: `OAVp5.panel.close` and `OAVp5.panel.toggle` take no arguments either. `midi.panel.open()` is the same function.
notes.zh: 這三個放在一起說明：`OAVp5.panel.close` 和 `OAVp5.panel.toggle` 也都不帶參數。`midi.panel.open()` 是同一個函式。

caption.en: Press o to open the 🎹 panel and c to close it.
caption.zh: 按 o 打開 🎹 面板，按 c 收起來。

caption.en: Click the canvas: the panel opens at once, and the console says when the controller inside it has loaded.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布：面板馬上打開，裡面的控制器載好的時候，console 會說一聲。

summary.en: Shows the 📱 card: a QR code that sends a phone to the remote page, whose MIDI tab then plays this sketch. Returns the room name.
summary.zh: 顯示 📱 卡片：一個 QR code，讓手機打開遙控頁面，手機上的 MIDI 分頁就能彈這個草圖。回傳房間名稱。

description.en: The same as the 📱 button in the panel. The card shows a QR code, the room and the link underneath; opening the link on a phone gives that phone an on-screen controller whose MIDI tab plays your sketch over the relay, as one more input (`OAVp5.last.source` is `'phone'`). Calling it again hides the card. The first call connects to the [`relay`](#option-relay) and loads a small QR-code library from jsDelivr.
description.zh: 跟面板裡的 📱 按鈕一樣。卡片上有 QR code、房間，和下面的連結。在手機上打開連結，那支手機就有一個螢幕控制器，它的 MIDI 分頁透過中繼來彈你的草圖，當作多一個輸入（`OAVp5.last.source` 是 `'phone'`）。再呼叫一次就把卡片收起來。第一次呼叫會連到 [`relay`](#option-relay)，並從 jsDelivr 載入一個很小的 QR code 函式庫。

returns.en: The name of the room the phone joins: the [`room`](#option-room) option, or the [`link`](#option-link) room, or a name made up for this browser (`p5-…`) and kept in it.
returns.zh: 手機要加入的房間名稱：[`room`](#option-room) 選項、[`link`](#option-link) 的房間，或是為這個瀏覽器隨機取、並存在裡面的名字（`p5-…`）。

needs.en: A network connection, to the relay (`wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay` unless you set another) and, for the picture of the QR code, to jsDelivr. Without the library the card shows the link as text.
needs.zh: 要有網路，連到中繼（沒另外設的話是 `wss://remote.cheyuwu.com/relay`），顯示 QR code 的圖還要連到 jsDelivr。沒有那個函式庫的話，卡片就把連結用文字顯示。

caption.en: Click the canvas and scan the QR code with a phone: the keys on its MIDI tab change the background of this sketch.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布，用手機掃 QR code：手機 MIDI 分頁上的鍵會改變這個草圖的背景顏色。

tbd.en: A phone playing a sketch through the relay was not tried for this page: the headless check cannot reach the relay, so the example is not run. The behaviour is as the code and the project's README describe it.
tbd.zh: 這一頁沒有試過用手機透過中繼彈草圖：無頭瀏覽器的檢查連不到中繼，所以範例沒有跑。行為依程式碼和專案的 README 所述。

summary.en: Plays a key as if a controller did: `midi.play(60, 0.8)` presses middle C, `midi.play(60, 0)` lets it go.
summary.zh: 像控制器那樣彈一個鍵：`midi.play(60, 0.8)` 按下中央 C，`midi.play(60, 0)` 放開。

description.en: It sends the same MIDI bytes a keyboard would, with `midi.last.source` set to `'screen'`, so everything reacts: [`notePressed()`](#notePressed), [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown), [`note`](#note), the sound if [`startSound()`](#startSound) is on. `midi` and `OAVp5` are the same object, so `OAVp5.play` and `midi.play` are one function.
description.zh: 它送出的 MIDI 位元組跟鍵盤送出的一樣，`midi.last.source` 會是 `'screen'`，所以所有東西都會有反應：[`notePressed()`](#notePressed)、[`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown)、[`note`](#note)，還有開著 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 時的聲音。`midi` 和 `OAVp5` 是同一個物件，所以 `OAVp5.play` 和 `midi.play` 是同一個函式。

params.name: note
params.en: The key: a MIDI number or a name (`'C#4'`).
params.zh: 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼或音名（`'C#4'`）。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, 0..1; 0 releases the key. Leave it out for full force.
params.zh: 多用力，0..1。0 表示放開。不給就是最大力道。

notes.en: The key stays down until you play it again with velocity 0.
notes.zh: 鍵會一直按著，直到你再用力道 0 彈一次。

caption.en: The mouse plays middle C: the sketch hears it the same as a key.
caption.zh: 用滑鼠彈中央 C：草圖聽到的跟按鍵一模一樣。

summary.en: Lists which controller knob, fader or pad drives which OpenProcessing OPC variable right now: `[{ control: 'knob1', name: 'radius' }, …]`.
summary.zh: 列出現在哪一顆旋鈕、推桿或墊子在推動哪一個 OpenProcessing OPC 變數：`[{ control: 'knob1', name: 'radius' }, …]`。

description.en: With OP Configurator, `OPC.slider('radius', 10)` declares a variable and oav-p5 wires the controller to the OPC variables in order: knob 1 to the first slider, knob 2 to the second, the faders after the knobs, pad 1 to the first toggle or button. This is the list of who drives what, the same one the panel prints under the controller and the console says once. Use it when a knob moves the wrong thing.
description.zh: 搭配 OP Configurator 時，`OPC.slider('radius', 10)` 宣告一個變數，oav-p5 會依序把控制器接到 OPC 的變數：旋鈕 1 接第一個滑桿，旋鈕 2 接第二個，推桿接在旋鈕後面，打擊墊 1 接第一個開關或按鈕。這份清單就是誰推動什麼，面板在控制器下面印的、console 說一次的也是同一份。旋鈕推動錯東西的時候就看它。

params.name: dev
params.en: Whose numbering to use: `'screen'` (the controller shown in the panel) or a profile id such as `'akai-lpd8'`. It matters for the faders, which are numbered after the knobs.
params.zh: 用誰的編號：`'screen'`（面板上顯示的那台控制器）或設定檔 id，像 `'akai-lpd8'`。它會影響推桿，因為推桿的編號接在旋鈕後面。

returns.en: One `{ control, name }` per wired variable: `control` is `'knob1'`, `'fader2'`, `'pad1'` …, `name` is the OPC variable. A control the sketch reads itself also has `sketch: true`, and its slider no longer follows it. An empty array when there is no OPC on the page or [`opc`](#option-opc) is `off`.
returns.zh: 每個接上線的變數一筆 `{ control, name }`：`control` 是 `'knob1'`、`'fader2'`、`'pad1'` …，`name` 是 OPC 的變數。草圖自己有讀的控制還會多一個 `sketch: true`，對應的滑桿就不再跟著它。頁面上沒有 OPC，或 [`opc`](#option-opc) 是 `off` 的時候是空陣列。

notes.en: `midi.wiring(…)` is the same function.
notes.zh: `midi.wiring(…)` 是同一個函式。

caption.en: Prints the controls and the OPC variables they drive, one per line. Outside OpenProcessing there is no OPC, so it says nothing is wired.
caption.zh: 一行印一組控制和它推動的 OPC 變數。在 OpenProcessing 以外沒有 OPC，所以會說沒有接上任何東西。

tbd.en: Not tried with OpenProcessing's real OPC library: it was checked against a stand-in object with the same `options` shape (`{ type: 'slider', name, min, max }`). Outside OpenProcessing the result is an empty array.
tbd.zh: 沒有用 OpenProcessing 真正的 OPC 函式庫試過：是拿一個有同樣 `options` 結構（`{ type: 'slider', name, min, max }`）的替身物件檢查的。在 OpenProcessing 以外，結果是空陣列。

claims.before: window.OPC = { options: { radius: { type: 'slider', name: 'radius', min: 0, max: 100, value: 10 }, go: { type: 'toggle', name: 'go', value: false } }, set() {} }

summary.en: Returns the frequency in Hz of a note: `noteFreq('A4')` is 440.
summary.zh: 回傳音符的頻率（赫茲）：`noteFreq('A4')` 是 440。

description.en: For a sketch that makes its own sound (p5.sound, Web Audio): `osc.freq(noteFreq(note))`. If you just want the sound, [`startSound()`](#startSound) plays every key for you.
description.zh: 給自己發聲的草圖用（p5.sound、Web Audio）：`osc.freq(noteFreq(note))`。如果只是想要有聲音，[`startSound()`](#startSound) 會幫你把每個鍵都彈出來。

params.name: v
params.en: A note name or a MIDI number. A number may be fractional (69.5 is a quarter tone above A4) and is not held to 0..127.
params.zh: 音名或 MIDI 號碼。數字可以有小數（69.5 是比 A4 高四分之一音），而且不會被限制在 0..127。

returns.en: Hz, equal temperament with A4 = 69 = 440 Hz.
returns.zh: 赫茲，十二平均律，A4 = 69 = 440 Hz。

caption.en: Prints 440 Hz and 261.63 Hz.
caption.zh: 印出 440 Hz 和 261.63 Hz。

summary.en: Turns a MIDI number into a note name: `noteName(61)` is `'C#4'`.
summary.zh: 把 MIDI 號碼轉成音名：`noteName(61)` 是 `'C#4'`。

description.en: [`notePressed(note, velocity)`](#notePressed) hands you the number; `noteName(note)` writes it back as a name for the screen or a lookup table. The same C4-is-60 convention as [`noteNumber()`](#noteNumber).
description.zh: [`notePressed(note, velocity)`](#notePressed) 給你的是號碼。`noteName(note)` 把它寫回音名，拿去顯示在畫面上或查表。跟 [`noteNumber()`](#noteNumber) 一樣，C4 就是 60。

params.name: v
params.en: A MIDI number (or a name, which is normalised).
params.zh: MIDI 號碼（給音名的話會被整理成標準寫法）。

params.name: o
params.en: Options: `{ flats: true }` writes `'Db4'` instead of `'C#4'`; `{ octave: false }` drops the octave number (`'C#'`).
params.zh: 選項：`{ flats: true }` 寫成 `'Db4'` 而不是 `'C#4'`。`{ octave: false }` 不寫八度數字（`'C#'`）。

returns.en: The name, sharps by default: `noteName(60)` is `'C4'`.
returns.zh: 音名，預設用升記號：`noteName(60)` 是 `'C4'`。

caption.en: Shows each key twice, with sharps and with flats (they differ on black keys). Open 🎹 and play.
caption.zh: 每個鍵用升記號和降記號各寫一次（黑鍵兩種寫法不同）。打開 🎹 彈彈看。

summary.en: Turns a note name like `'C4'` into its MIDI number, 0 to 127.
summary.zh: 把像 `'C4'` 這樣的音名轉成 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127。

description.en: A name is a letter A to G (either case), an optional `#` or `b` (`♯` and `♭` too), and the octave: `C4`, `c#4`, `Db3`, `C-1` (0) up to `G9` (127). **C4 is 60.** Anything else, such as `'H4'` or `'C-2'`, throws an error, and a card beside the 🎹 says how to write a note.
description.zh: 音名由一個 A 到 G 的字母（大小寫都可以）、可有可無的 `#` 或 `b`（`♯`、`♭` 也行），加上八度數字組成：`C4`、`c#4`、`Db3`，從 `C-1`（0）到 `G9`（127）。**C4 是 60。** 其他寫法（像 `'H4'`、`'C-2'`）會丟出錯誤，🎹 旁邊也會有一張卡片告訴你音名怎麼寫。

description.en: You rarely call it yourself: every place that takes a note number also takes a name, such as [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown) and [`midi.play()`](#OAVp5.play).
description.zh: 通常不用自己呼叫：凡是收音符號碼的地方也都收音名，像 [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown) 和 [`midi.play()`](#OAVp5.play)。

params.name: v
params.en: A note name (`'C4'`, `'c#4'`, `'Db3'`, `'F♯2'`) or a number. A number comes back rounded and held to 0..127.

returns.en: The MIDI number: `noteNumber('C4')` is 60, `noteNumber('A4')` is 69.
returns.zh: MIDI 號碼：`noteNumber('C4')` 是 60，`noteNumber('A4')` 是 69。

caption.en: Prints 60, 69 and 42.

summary.en: How much of the microphone's sound is low (`bass`), middle (`mid`) or high (`treble`), each from 0 to 1.
summary.zh: 麥克風聽到的聲音裡，低音（`bass`）、中音（`mid`）、高音（`treble`）各佔多少，各自從 0 到 1。

description.en: Use them like [`micLevel`](#micLevel), one number per band: `fill(200 + bass * 160, 70, 100)` pushes the colour with the low end. The three share one entry because they behave the same; only the frequency range differs.
description.zh: 用法跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣，每個頻段一個數字：`fill(200 + bass * 160, 70, 100)` 讓顏色跟著低音走。三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。

description.en: Unlike `micLevel` they are not measured in decibels: each is the average strength of the frequencies in its band, scaled by [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) and held to 1. A band that is faint in your room can stay close to 0; raise the sensitivity rather than multiplying by a large number.
description.zh: 跟 `micLevel` 不一樣，它們不是用分貝量的：每一個是該頻段所有頻率的平均強度，乘上 [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) 之後最多算到 1。如果某個頻段在你的房間裡很微弱，數字會一直貼近 0。這時調高靈敏度，比自己乘一個很大的數字好。

value.en: The energy in 20–250 Hz (`bass`), 250–2000 Hz (`mid`) and 2000–8000 Hz (`treble`). Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.
value.zh: `bass` 是 20–250 Hz 的能量，`mid` 是 250–2000 Hz，`treble` 是 2000–8000 Hz。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

needs.en: Reading any of them asks for the microphone the first time, exactly like [`micLevel`](#micLevel); until you allow it they are `0`.
needs.zh: 第一次讀其中任何一個，就會跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣去要麥克風。在你允許之前都是 `0`。

notes.en: A sketch that already has its own variable, function or library called `bass`, `mid` or `treble` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves that name alone and never starts the microphone for it. Assigning one later turns the name back into a plain variable.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就有自己的 `bass`、`mid` 或 `treble`（變數、函式、函式庫都算），oav-p5 就不動那個名稱，也不會為它去開麥克風。之後自己指定值的話，那個名稱就變回一般變數。

caption.en: A circle that swells and changes colour with the low end: tap the desk or play something with a kick.
caption.zh: 一個隨低音變大、變色的圓：敲桌子或放一段有大鼓的音樂。

caption.en: Three bars, one per band, from low to high. Whistle for the right one, hum for the left.
caption.zh: 三根長條，依序是低、中、高音。吹口哨看右邊那根，哼低音看左邊那根。

tbd.en: Typical values for speech and for music depend on the microphone and the room; no typical numbers are given here until they have been measured.
tbd.zh: 說話和音樂的典型數值要看麥克風和房間。在量過之前，這裡不給典型數字。

summary.en: True for one frame each time the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a beat.
summary.zh: 麥克風（或鼓機）每聽到一個拍子，就在那一個畫面是 true。

description.en: It behaves like `mouseIsPressed` while a button is down, except the "press" lasts one frame: `if (beat) flash = 1;` is all it takes to react to the music. A beat is a jump in loudness over what the room has been doing, with at least 100 ms between two beats; two beats between two frames count as one.
description.zh: 它的用法像按著滑鼠鍵時的 `mouseIsPressed`，只是「按下」只持續一個畫面：`if (beat) flash = 1;` 就能對音樂做出反應。一個拍子是音量比房間一直以來的聲音突然跳高，兩個拍子之間至少隔 100 毫秒。兩個畫面之間發生的兩個拍子只算一次。

description.en: When the drum machine is playing, `beat` is also true for a frame on every kick and snare, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over to the machine unchanged.
description.zh: 鼓機在播的時候，每一下大鼓和小鼓也會讓 `beat` 在那個畫面是 true，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。

value.en: True in the first `draw()` after a beat, and false until the next one. Reading it twice in the same frame gives the same answer.
value.zh: 拍子之後的第一個 `draw()` 是 true，到下一個拍子之前都是 false。同一個畫面裡讀兩次，答案一樣。

needs.en: Reading `beat` asks for the microphone the first time, like [`micLevel`](#micLevel). If you would rather be called, define [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected).
needs.zh: 第一次讀 `beat` 就會跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣去要麥克風。如果你比較想被呼叫，就定義 [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected)。

caption.en: The screen flashes on every beat and fades out. Clap or tap the desk.
caption.zh: 每個拍子畫面閃一下再慢慢暗下去。拍手或敲桌子試試。

caption.en: A counter that goes up by one per beat, never twice for the same one.
caption.zh: 每個拍子加一的計數器，同一個拍子不會算兩次。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a beat.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式。麥克風（或鼓機）每聽到一個拍子，oav-p5 就呼叫它一次。

params.name: level
params.en: How loud it was at that moment, 0..1 (the value of [`micLevel`](#micLevel)).
params.zh: 那一刻有多大聲，0..1（就是 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 的值）。

needs.en: A sketch that defines `beatDetected()` and reads no microphone value starts the microphone on the first click or key. When the drum machine is on, the same function is called for its kicks and snares and the microphone is not opened for it. `OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn)` hears the same beats without defining a global and returns a function that stops listening, but a listener alone never starts the microphone: read [`micLevel`](#micLevel) or call [`startMic()`](#startMic) as well.
needs.zh: 草圖只要定義了 `beatDetected()` 而沒有讀任何麥克風的值，第一次點擊或按鍵時就會啟動麥克風。鼓機開著的時候，鼓機的大鼓和小鼓也會呼叫同一個函式，而且不會為它去開麥克風。`OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn)` 聽到的是同樣的拍子，不用定義全域函式，也會回傳一個停止監聽的函式，但只有監聽並不會啟動麥克風：還要讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 或呼叫 [`startMic()`](#startMic)。

notes.en: If your function throws, the sketch keeps running: the error appears in the console and as a card beside the 🎹 with the file and line.
notes.zh: 你的函式如果出錯，草圖會繼續跑：錯誤會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案和行號。

caption.en: A flash per beat, brighter for a louder one.
caption.zh: 每個拍子閃一下，拍子越大聲閃得越亮。

summary.en: You define these; oav-p5 calls them when the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a kick, a snare or a hat.
summary.zh: 你來定義這幾個函式。麥克風（或鼓機）聽到大鼓、小鼓或鈸的時候，oav-p5 會呼叫 `kickDetected(level)`、`snareDetected(level)`、`hatDetected(level)`。

description.en: The microphone splits what it hears into three drum-like bands and calls the matching function when each band jumps: 20–120 Hz for the kick, 150–800 Hz for the snare, 6–14 kHz for the hat. There is no machine learning in it, just a transient in a frequency band, so a bass voice can trigger a kick.
description.zh: 麥克風把聽到的聲音分成三個像鼓的頻段，哪個頻段突然跳高，就呼叫對應的函式：大鼓是 20–120 Hz，小鼓是 150–800 Hz，鈸是 6–14 kHz。裡面沒有機器學習，只是某個頻段出現瞬間的衝擊，所以低沉的人聲也可能觸發大鼓。

description.en: When the drum machine plays, each of its hits calls the same functions: kick for the kick, snare for a snare, clap or rim, hat for a closed, open or pedal hat. A sketch written for the microphone therefore works with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) unchanged.
description.zh: 鼓機在播的時候，它的每一下也會呼叫同樣的函式：大鼓呼叫 kick，小鼓、拍手或 rim 呼叫 snare，閉合、開放或腳踏的鈸呼叫 hat。所以為麥克風寫的草圖，不用改就能搭配 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)。

description.en: While the drum machine plays, only its hits call these functions (from oav-p5 0.8.1). A microphone that is on at the same time mostly hears the drums coming out of the speakers, so its hits would call the same function twice and hear a kick as a snare. [`micLevel`](#micLevel), [`bass`](#bass), `mid` and `treble` still follow the microphone; the microphone's hits come back when the drums stop.
description.zh: 鼓機在打的時候，只有鼓機的每一下會呼叫這幾個函式（oav-p5 0.8.1 起）。這時候如果麥克風也開著，它聽到的多半是喇叭放出來的鼓聲，同一下會被叫兩次，大鼓也可能被聽成小鼓。[`micLevel`](#micLevel)、[`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 照樣跟著麥克風。鼓機停下來，麥克風的打擊就會回來。

params.name: level
params.en: How strong the hit was, 0..1 (for the drum machine, its velocity).
params.zh: 這一下有多強，0..1（鼓機的話就是力道）。

needs.en: Defining one of them is not enough to open the microphone once the drum machine has started; reading [`micLevel`](#micLevel) (or calling [`startMic()`](#startMic)) is. Without the drum machine, a sketch that defines any of them and reads nothing starts the microphone on the first click or key.
needs.zh: 鼓機啟動之後，只定義其中一個函式並不會去開麥克風。要讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel)（或呼叫 [`startMic()`](#startMic)）才會。沒有鼓機的時候，草圖只要定義了其中任何一個、又沒有讀任何值，第一次點擊或按鍵時會啟動麥克風。

caption.en: Two circles, orange for kicks and blue for snares, each swelling and shrinking back on its own hits.
caption.zh: 兩個圓，橘色對應大鼓、藍色對應小鼓，各自在自己的聲音出現時脹大再縮回去。

summary.en: Whether the microphone is running right now.
summary.zh: 麥克風現在有沒有在運作。

description.en: Use it to show a hint until sound arrives: `if (!micIsOn) text("Allow the microphone", 20, 30);`. Reading it never starts the microphone (unlike [`micLevel`](#micLevel)), so it is safe to check anywhere. The reason behind a `false` is in `OAVp5.mic.state` (`off`, `asking`, `on`, `denied` or `unavailable`) and, when something failed, `OAVp5.mic.error`.
description.zh: 可以用它在聲音進來之前顯示提示：`if (!micIsOn) text("請允許麥克風", 20, 30);`。讀它不會啟動麥克風（跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 不一樣），所以在哪裡檢查都安全。`false` 的原因看 `OAVp5.mic.state`（`off`、`asking`、`on`、`denied` 或 `unavailable`），失敗的時候還有 `OAVp5.mic.error`。

value.en: True once the browser has said yes and sound is coming in; false while the microphone is off, still asking, blocked or missing.
value.zh: 瀏覽器答應了、聲音進來之後是 true。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或不存在的時候是 false。

caption.en: Grey with a prompt until the microphone is on, then dark. (Nothing here reads micLevel, so nothing asks for the microphone: press 🎤 in the 🎹 panel.)
caption.zh: 麥克風開起來之前是灰色加提示，開了之後變暗。（這裡沒有讀 micLevel，所以不會自己去要麥克風：按 🎹 面板裡的 🎤。）

summary.en: How loud the microphone hears things, from 0 (a quiet room) to 1 (shouting).
summary.zh: 麥克風聽到的聲音有多大聲，從 0（安靜的房間）到 1（大喊）。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` the way you read `mouseX`: `circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel * 300)` grows when someone talks. It is a loudness in decibels, which is how an ear hears it, measured from the room itself: the bottom of the scale follows the room's own noise (it settles within a second or two and rises at most 1.5 dB a second, so a voice never becomes the new silence), and −10 dBFS, shouting into a laptop, is 1.
description.zh: 像讀 `mouseX` 一樣在 `draw()` 裡直接讀：`circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel * 300)`，有人說話圓就變大。它是以分貝量的音量，跟耳朵聽起來的感覺一致，而且是從房間本身量起：量表的底部跟著房間的底噪走（一兩秒內安頓下來，每秒最多往上爬 1.5 dB，所以人聲不會變成新的安靜），−10 dBFS（對著筆電大喊）就是 1。

description.en: In practice a quiet room reads 0, a quiet voice about 0.4 to 0.6, shouting close to 1. If the microphone is quiet or far away, raise it with [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity).
description.zh: 實際上，安靜的房間是 0，小聲說話約 0.4 到 0.6，大喊接近 1。麥克風很小聲或離得很遠的話，用 [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) 把它調大。

description.en: It follows the browser's animation frames rather than `draw()`, so a sketch running at `frameRate(10)` still reads the latest value, and the number stops changing while the tab is hidden (browsers pause animation frames there).
description.zh: 它跟著瀏覽器的動畫畫面更新，不是跟著 `draw()`，所以用 `frameRate(10)` 跑的草圖讀到的還是最新的值。分頁被藏起來時數字會停住（瀏覽器在那時會暫停動畫畫面）。

value.en: Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on. It is 0 while the microphone is off, still asking, blocked or missing.
value.zh: 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或根本沒有的時候，一直是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. The first time a sketch reads `micLevel` (or [`bass`](#bass), `mid`, `treble`, [`beat`](#beat)), oav-p5 asks the browser for the microphone, and every value stays `0` until you allow it. The page needs `https` or `localhost`. If the browser kept audio quiet until a click, the first click or key starts it. [`?oav_mic=click`](#option-mic) makes only the 🎤 button and [`startMic()`](#startMic) turn it on; `?oav_mic=off` means nothing can.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。草圖第一次讀 `micLevel`（或 [`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble`、[`beat`](#beat)）的時候，oav-p5 就會向瀏覽器要麥克風，在你按下允許之前所有的值都是 `0`。網頁要在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下。如果瀏覽器在你點一下之前不讓聲音出來，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把它啟動。[`?oav_mic=click`](#option-mic) 表示只有 🎤 按鈕和 [`startMic()`](#startMic) 能開。`?oav_mic=off` 表示什麼都開不了。

notes.en: In the 🎹 panel the 🎤 button turns the microphone on and off by hand and shows the level. When the browser blocked it, a card beside the 🎹 says why and what to press: click the lock left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then click the canvas.
notes.zh: 🎹 面板裡的 🎤 按鈕可以手動開關麥克風，並顯示音量。瀏覽器擋下麥克風的時候，🎹 旁邊會跳出一張卡片說明原因和怎麼處理：點網址列左邊的鎖頭，把麥克風設成允許，再點一下畫布。

notes.en: On openprocessing.org the sketch frame allows the microphone and MIDI (checked 2026-10-19: its `allow` list contains `microphone` and `midi`), and the first read of `micLevel` there asks for the microphone. An embed code copied from OpenProcessing does not carry that: add `allow="microphone"` to that `<iframe>`.
notes.zh: 在 openprocessing.org 上，草圖的框允許麥克風和 MIDI（2026-10-19 實際檢查過：它的 `allow` 清單有 `microphone` 和 `midi`），而且在那裡第一次讀 `micLevel` 就會去要麥克風。從 OpenProcessing 複製出來的嵌入碼沒有這個設定：要在那個 `<iframe>` 加上 `allow="microphone"`。

notes.en: The raw numbers behind it are [`OAVp5.mic.rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms) (0..1), `OAVp5.mic.db` and `OAVp5.mic.floor` (the room's own noise, in dBFS).
notes.zh: 它背後的原始數字是 [`OAVp5.mic.rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms)（0..1）、`OAVp5.mic.db` 和 `OAVp5.mic.floor`（房間本身的底噪，單位 dBFS）。

caption.en: Allow the microphone when the browser asks, then talk: the circle grows with your voice.
caption.zh: 瀏覽器詢問的時候按允許，然後說話：圓會跟著你的聲音變大。

caption.en: The same circle through lag(): it opens at once when someone speaks and closes slowly, like a VU meter.
caption.zh: 同一個圓，加上 lag()：有人開口就立刻張開，之後慢慢收回去，像音量表。

caption.en: A bar that fills with the level. micIsOn tells you whether the browser has said yes yet.
caption.zh: 一條隨音量變長的橫條。micIsOn 告訴你瀏覽器是不是已經答應了。

tbd.en: On openprocessing.org the pasted sketch runs, loads oav-p5 and asks for the microphone, but the sound itself was not tried there: the browser used for the check blocks the microphone, so the allow-and-listen step is still unconfirmed on that site.
tbd.zh: 貼進 openprocessing.org 的草圖會跑、會載入 oav-p5、也會去要麥克風，但那裡的聲音本身沒有試：檢查用的瀏覽器擋掉了麥克風，所以在那個網站上「按允許、然後聽到聲音」這一步還沒確認。

summary.en: Makes the microphone more or less sensitive: `micSensitivity(2)` is twice as sensitive, `micSensitivity()` says what it is now.
summary.zh: 調整麥克風的靈敏度：`micSensitivity(2)` 是兩倍靈敏，`micSensitivity()` 會告訴你現在是多少。

description.en: The number multiplies what the microphone hears. On [`micLevel`](#micLevel), 2 adds 6 dB; on [`bass`](#bass), `mid` and `treble` it multiplies by 2 (they stay held to 1). Use it for a quiet microphone or a far-away voice: `micSensitivity(3)` in `setup()` adds about 9.5 dB.
description.zh: 這個數字乘在麥克風聽到的東西上。對 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 來說，2 等於加 6 dB。對 [`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 是乘以 2（最多還是 1）。麥克風很小聲或人離得很遠的時候用它：在 `setup()` 寫 `micSensitivity(3)` 大約加 9.5 dB。

params.name: v
params.en: The new sensitivity, greater than 0 (kept between 0.05 and 20). Leave it out, or pass something that is not greater than 0, to change nothing.
params.zh: 新的靈敏度，要大於 0（會被限制在 0.05 到 20 之間）。不傳，或傳不大於 0 的值，就什麼都不改。

returns.en: The sensitivity now in effect (1 until you change it).
returns.zh: 現在生效的靈敏度（沒改過就是 1）。

notes.en: `OAVp5.mic.gain` is the same knob under the name oav-p5 0.3.0 used.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.mic.gain` 是同一個旋鈕，用的是 oav-p5 0.3.0 的舊名字。

caption.en: The same loudness circle on a microphone that needed a boost; the number shows the sensitivity in effect.
caption.zh: 同樣的音量圓，用在需要加強的麥克風上。數字顯示現在的靈敏度。

summary.en: Turns the microphone on and returns a promise that says whether it worked.
summary.zh: 開啟麥克風，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你有沒有成功。

description.en: You rarely need it: reading [`micLevel`](#micLevel) and its friends already starts the microphone. Call it when you want to choose the moment (a button, the end of an intro) or know the answer: `startMic().then((ok) => { … })`. Calling it again while it is on, or while the browser is still asking, returns the same result.
description.zh: 通常用不到：只要讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 之類的名稱，麥克風就會自己啟動。想自己決定時機（一個按鈕、片頭結束的時候）或想知道結果時才呼叫：`startMic().then((ok) => { … })`。已經開著、或瀏覽器還在詢問的時候再呼叫，會回傳同一個結果。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once the microphone is on, `false` if it was blocked, is missing, or the `mic` option is `off`.
returns.zh: 麥克風開起來之後 resolve 成 `true`。被擋下、不存在、或載入選項 `mic` 是 `off` 的時候 resolve 成 `false`。

needs.en: Browsers want a click before audio plays: call it from `mousePressed()` or a button handler if `setup()` is too early. It works whatever the `mic` option is, except `?oav_mic=off`, where nothing can start the microphone.
needs.zh: 瀏覽器要先有一次點擊才讓聲音出來：如果在 `setup()` 裡太早，就放在 `mousePressed()` 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。不管載入選項 `mic` 是什麼都能用，只有 `?oav_mic=off` 例外，那時什麼都開不了麥克風。

notes.en: After [`stopMic()`](#stopMic), only `startMic()` (or 🎤) turns it back on; reading `micLevel` does not.
notes.zh: 呼叫過 [`stopMic()`](#stopMic) 之後，只有 `startMic()`（或 🎤）能再把它打開。讀 `micLevel` 不會。

caption.en: Nothing happens until you click; then the browser asks, and the number starts moving.
caption.zh: 點下去之前什麼都不會發生。點了之後瀏覽器才詢問，數字就開始動。

summary.en: Turns the microphone off and sets every microphone value back to 0.
summary.zh: 關掉麥克風，所有麥克風的值都歸零。

description.en: It stops the microphone's tracks and closes its audio context, so the browser's "recording" indicator goes away. [`micLevel`](#micLevel), [`bass`](#bass), `mid`, `treble` and the rest read `0` again, and [`micIsOn`](#micIsOn) is `false`.
description.zh: 它會停掉麥克風的音軌並關掉它的音訊環境，所以瀏覽器上「正在錄音」的指示會消失。[`micLevel`](#micLevel)、[`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 等等都回到 `0`，[`micIsOn`](#micIsOn) 變成 `false`。

returns.en: Resolves to `false`, the new state of the microphone.
returns.zh: resolve 成 `false`，也就是麥克風的新狀態。

notes.en: After `stopMic()`, reading `micLevel` does not turn the microphone back on: that needs [`startMic()`](#startMic) or the 🎤 button.
notes.zh: `stopMic()` 之後，讀 `micLevel` 不會再把麥克風打開：要用 [`startMic()`](#startMic) 或 🎤 按鈕。

caption.en: Press m to switch the microphone on and off; the circle drops to its smallest size when it is off.
caption.zh: 按 m 開關麥克風。關掉的時候圓縮到最小。

summary.en: The microphone under the plain names: its state, the numbers of `micLevel` and `bass` that never turn it on when read, the raw loudness, start, stop and events.
summary.zh: 平常那些名稱底下的麥克風：它的狀態、跟 `micLevel` 和 `bass` 一樣的數字（讀它們不會把麥克風打開）、原始的音量，還有 start、stop 和事件。

description.en: Everything the microphone names ([`micLevel`](#micLevel), [`bass`](#bass), [`micIsOn`](#micIsOn), [`startMic()`](#startMic) …) read from here. The difference is that reading `OAVp5.mic.level` never asks for the microphone: the plain `micLevel` does, the first time. So `OAVp5.mic` is for code that must look without waking anything: a status line, a library, a sketch with `?oav_mic=click`.
description.zh: 所有麥克風的名稱（[`micLevel`](#micLevel)、[`bass`](#bass)、[`micIsOn`](#micIsOn)、[`startMic()`](#startMic) …）讀的都是這裡。差別是讀 `OAVp5.mic.level` 永遠不會去要麥克風，而一般的 `micLevel` 第一次讀就會。所以 `OAVp5.mic` 是給「只想看、不想吵醒任何東西」的程式用的：狀態列、函式庫、設了 `?oav_mic=click` 的草圖。

description.en: The members: [`state`](#OAVp5.mic.state), [`error`](#OAVp5.mic.error), [`sensitivity`](#OAVp5.mic.sensitivity) (also `gain`), [`level`](#OAVp5.mic.level), [`bass`](#OAVp5.mic.bass) (also `mid`, `treble`), [`rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms), [`db`](#OAVp5.mic.db), [`floor`](#OAVp5.mic.floor), [`analyzer`](#OAVp5.mic.analyzer), [`start()`](#OAVp5.mic.start), [`stop()`](#OAVp5.mic.stop) and [`on()`](#OAVp5.mic.on).
description.zh: 成員有：[`state`](#OAVp5.mic.state)、[`error`](#OAVp5.mic.error)、[`sensitivity`](#OAVp5.mic.sensitivity)（也叫 `gain`）、[`level`](#OAVp5.mic.level)、[`bass`](#OAVp5.mic.bass)（還有 `mid`、`treble`）、[`rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms)、[`db`](#OAVp5.mic.db)、[`floor`](#OAVp5.mic.floor)、[`analyzer`](#OAVp5.mic.analyzer)、[`start()`](#OAVp5.mic.start)、[`stop()`](#OAVp5.mic.stop) 和 [`on()`](#OAVp5.mic.on)。

notes.en: This is advanced. For most sketches the plain names are all you need.
notes.zh: 這是進階用法。大多數草圖只要用一般的名稱就夠了。

caption.en: A circle that follows the microphone, which only starts when you click: reading OAVp5.mic never turns it on by itself.
caption.zh: 一個跟著麥克風走的圓，要點一下畫布才會開始收音：讀 OAVp5.mic 不會自己把麥克風打開。

summary.en: The `AudioAnalyzer` from @openav/audio that listens to the microphone, while the microphone is on; `null` otherwise.
summary.zh: 麥克風開著的時候，負責聽麥克風的那個 @openav/audio 的 `AudioAnalyzer`，其他時候是 `null`。

description.en: A way into the audio itself when the 0 to 1 numbers are not enough: read the spectrum of the microphone with the browser's own `OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(array)`, or connect your own Web Audio nodes to it. oav-p5 updates the analyzer once per frame, so do not call its `update()` yourself.
description.zh: 0 到 1 的數字不夠用的時候，直接進到聲音本身的路：用瀏覽器自己的 `OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(array)` 讀麥克風的頻譜，或把你自己的 Web Audio 節點接上去。oav-p5 每個畫面會更新一次這個分析器，所以不要自己去呼叫它的 `update()`。

value.en: Made when the microphone starts and dropped when it stops. It has its own `AudioContext` (`OAVp5.mic.analyzer.ctx`) and the Web Audio `AnalyserNode` it reads from (`OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser`).
value.zh: 麥克風啟動時產生，停止時丟掉。它有自己的 `AudioContext`（`OAVp5.mic.analyzer.ctx`），也有它讀取的 Web Audio `AnalyserNode`（`OAVp5.mic.analyzer.analyser`）。

notes.en: This is advanced. Check it is not `null` first, and read it again after `stopMic()` and `startMic()`: it is a new object each time.
