notes.zh: 這是進階用法。先確認它不是 `null`，而且 `stopMic()` 再 `startMic()` 之後要重新讀：每次都是新的物件。

caption.en: The lowest 64 bins of the microphone's spectrum as bars, read straight from the analyser. Whistle and watch the bars move.
caption.zh: 麥克風頻譜最低的 64 個頻格畫成長條，直接從分析器讀。吹口哨，看長條動起來。

summary.en: The same 0 to 1 low, middle and high energy as `bass`, `mid` and `treble`, read without ever turning the microphone on.
summary.zh: 跟 `bass`、`mid`、`treble` 一樣的 0 到 1 低音、中音、高音能量，讀它們不會把麥克風打開。

description.en: The plain [`bass`](#bass), `mid` and `treble` ask for the microphone when first read, and a sketch that already has a variable of that name keeps it. `OAVp5.mic.bass`, `.mid` and `.treble` are the numbers themselves: always there, never starting anything. They are also the answer when the plain names are taken: on strudel.cc, where Strudel owns `bass`, this is what the card tells you to read.
description.zh: 一般的 [`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 第一次被讀的時候會去要麥克風，而且草圖本來就有同名變數的話就由草圖保留。`OAVp5.mic.bass`、`.mid`、`.treble` 就是數字本身：一直都在，也不會啟動任何東西。一般名稱被占用的時候也要讀它們：在 strudel.cc 上 `bass` 是 Strudel 的，卡片會告訴你改讀這個。

value.en: `bass` is 20–250 Hz, `mid` 250–2000 Hz and `treble` 2000–8000 Hz, scaled by the sensitivity and held to 1. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.
value.zh: `bass` 是 20–250 Hz，`mid` 是 250–2000 Hz，`treble` 是 2000–8000 Hz，乘上靈敏度、最多算到 1。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

notes.en: The three share this entry because they behave the same: only the frequency range differs.
notes.zh: 三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。

caption.en: Three bars for low, middle and high, written with the raw members. Whistle for the right one, hum for the left.
caption.zh: 低、中、高音三根長條，用原始的成員寫。吹口哨看右邊那根，哼低音看左邊那根。

summary.en: The loudness of the microphone in decibels relative to full scale (dBFS): 0 is as loud as it gets, −100 is silence or the microphone being off.
summary.zh: 麥克風的音量，單位是相對滿刻度的分貝（dBFS）：0 是最大聲，−100 是無聲或麥克風關著。

description.en: Decibels are what an ear hears: each 6 dB is twice the amplitude, so a number in dB moves the way loudness feels. [`micLevel`](#micLevel) maps it onto 0 to 1 between the room's noise floor (+6 dB) and −10 dBFS. Use `db` directly when you want your own scale, for example `map(OAVp5.mic.db, -60, -10, 0, 1)`.
description.zh: 分貝就是耳朵聽到的樣子：每增加 6 dB 就是振幅兩倍，所以用 dB 的數字，變化的方式就跟聽起來的大小聲一致。[`micLevel`](#micLevel) 把它對應到 0 到 1，範圍從房間底噪（再加 6 dB）到 −10 dBFS。想用自己的刻度的話，直接用 `db`，例如 `map(OAVp5.mic.db, -60, -10, 0, 1)`。

value.en: `20 * log10(rms)`, measured from [`OAVp5.mic.rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms). −100 when the level is below about −100 dB and while the microphone is off. Updated once per display frame.
value.zh: `20 * log10(rms)`，由 [`OAVp5.mic.rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms) 算出來。低於約 −100 dB 和麥克風關著的時候是 −100。每個畫面更新一次。

caption.en: The level in dBFS, and a circle on an own scale from −60 to −10 dB. Allow the microphone and talk.
caption.zh: 用 dBFS 表示的音量，加上一個用自己的刻度（−60 到 −10 dB）的圓。允許麥克風，然後說話。

summary.en: Why the microphone did not start, as the browser's error name such as `'NotAllowedError'`; `null` while there is no error.
summary.zh: 麥克風為什麼沒開起來，用瀏覽器的錯誤名稱表示，像 `'NotAllowedError'`，沒有錯誤的時候是 `null`。

description.en: For a sketch that wants to say more than a card does: `if (OAVp5.mic.error === 'NotAllowedError') …`. The card beside the 🎹 already tells the user what to press for each of these, in their language; this is the same fact for your code.
description.zh: 給想比卡片說得更多的草圖用：`if (OAVp5.mic.error === 'NotAllowedError') …`。🎹 旁邊的卡片已經用使用者的語言，針對每一種告訴他要按什麼了，這是同一件事給你的程式用。

value.en: `null` at the start and again once the microphone is on. After a failure: the browser's error name (`'NotAllowedError'` or `'SecurityError'` for a refusal, `'NotFoundError'` when there is no microphone, `'NotReadableError'` when another program holds it) or `'no getUserMedia'` on a page that cannot ask.
value.zh: 一開始是 `null`，麥克風開起來之後又回到 `null`。失敗之後是瀏覽器的錯誤名稱（被拒絕是 `'NotAllowedError'` 或 `'SecurityError'`，沒有麥克風是 `'NotFoundError'`，被別的程式占住是 `'NotReadableError'`），或是在不能詢問的頁面上的 `'no getUserMedia'`。

caption.en: Prints the state and the error. Refuse the microphone to see "NotAllowedError".
caption.zh: 印出狀態和錯誤。拒絕麥克風就會看到 "NotAllowedError"。

summary.en: The room's own noise as oav-p5 has measured it, in dBFS: the level that `micLevel` treats as silence (plus 6 dB).
summary.zh: oav-p5 量到的房間本身的底噪，單位是 dBFS：`micLevel` 把它（再加 6 dB）當成安靜的那個音量。

description.en: A humming classroom should not read as loud, so [`micLevel`](#micLevel) is measured from the room itself: this floor follows the quietest recent readings. It drops within a second when the room gets quieter and rises at most 1.5 dB a second when it gets noisier, so a voice never becomes the new silence. 6 dB above the floor reads 0 on `micLevel`.
description.zh: 嗡嗡響的教室不該被讀成很大聲，所以 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 是從房間本身量起的：這個底噪跟著最近最安靜的讀數走。房間變安靜時，一秒內就會降下去，變吵時每秒最多往上爬 1.5 dB，所以人聲不會變成新的安靜。比底噪高 6 dB 的音量，在 `micLevel` 上讀成 0。

value.en: Starts at −60 and is always held between −70 and −45. Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on.
value.zh: 一開始是 −60，永遠限制在 −70 到 −45 之間。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次。

notes.en: Stopping the microphone does not reset it: the next start continues from the last floor.
notes.zh: 停掉麥克風不會重設它：下次開始會從上一次的底噪接著走。

caption.en: Shows the level, the room's noise floor and the resulting micLevel. Keep quiet for a few seconds and watch the floor settle.
caption.zh: 顯示音量、房間的底噪，和算出來的 micLevel。安靜個幾秒，看底噪穩定下來。

summary.en: The same 0 to 1 loudness as `micLevel`, read without ever turning the microphone on.
summary.zh: 跟 `micLevel` 一樣的 0 到 1 音量，讀它不會把麥克風打開。

description.en: [`micLevel`](#micLevel) is a getter that returns this number and, the first time it is read, asks for the microphone. `OAVp5.mic.level` is the number itself, so reading it is safe anywhere: before the user has chosen, with `?oav_mic=click`, or in a library. Start the microphone with [`startMic()`](#startMic) or 🎤, then it moves. How it is measured (decibels, the room as zero, −10 dBFS as 1) is described under [`micLevel`](#micLevel).
description.zh: [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 是一個 getter，回傳這個數字，而且第一次被讀的時候會去要麥克風。`OAVp5.mic.level` 就是數字本身，所以在哪裡讀都安全：使用者還沒決定之前、設了 `?oav_mic=click`，或是在函式庫裡。用 [`startMic()`](#startMic) 或 🎤 啟動麥克風，它才會動。它怎麼量（分貝、以房間為 0、−10 dBFS 為 1）寫在 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 底下。

value.en: Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 while it is off, asking, blocked or missing.
value.zh: 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次。關著、詢問中、被擋下或不存在的時候是 0。

caption.en: The loudness circle, written with the raw number instead of micLevel. Allow the microphone and talk.
caption.zh: 音量圓，這次用原始的數字，不用 micLevel。允許麥克風，然後說話。

summary.en: Listens to a microphone event (`'beat'`, `'kick'`, `'snare'` or `'hat'`) without defining a global function, and returns a function that stops listening.
summary.zh: 監聽麥克風的事件（`'beat'`、`'kick'`、`'snare'` 或 `'hat'`），不必定義全域函式，並回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

description.en: The listener version of [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected), [`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected), `snareDetected()` and `hatDetected()`: any number of them, added and removed while the sketch runs, with no global names taken. An error inside `fn` shows in the console and on a card.
description.zh: [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected)、[`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected)、`snareDetected()`、`hatDetected()` 的監聽者版本：想要幾個都行，草圖在跑的時候可以加也可以拿掉，也不占用任何全域名稱。`fn` 裡面出錯會顯示在 console 和卡片上。

params.name: name
params.en: `'beat'`, `'kick'`, `'snare'` or `'hat'`. Anything else throws an error that lists them.
params.zh: `'beat'`、`'kick'`、`'snare'` 或 `'hat'`。其他的名稱會丟出一個錯誤，並列出這幾個。

params.name: fn
params.en: Called as `fn(level)` with how strong the hit was, 0 to 1: the same number [`beatDetected(level)`](#beatDetected) and [`kickDetected(level)`](#kickDetected) get.
params.zh: 用 `fn(level)` 的方式呼叫，帶著這一下有多強，0 到 1：跟 [`beatDetected(level)`](#beatDetected) 和 [`kickDetected(level)`](#kickDetected) 拿到的數字一樣。

returns.en: A function that takes `fn` off again: `const off = OAVp5.mic.on(…); off();`.
returns.zh: 一個把 `fn` 取消的函式：`const off = OAVp5.mic.on(…); off();`。

needs.en: Listening does not turn the microphone on: call [`startMic()`](#startMic), press 🎤, or read [`micLevel`](#micLevel) too, or nothing will ever fire. (Defining the global `beatDetected()` is different: oav-p5 sees that function and starts the microphone at the first click.) These events come from the microphone only, not from the drum machine.
needs.zh: 監聽並不會把麥克風打開：要呼叫 [`startMic()`](#startMic)、按 🎤，或是也讀一下 [`micLevel`](#micLevel)，不然什麼事件都不會發生。（定義全域的 `beatDetected()` 就不一樣：oav-p5 看到那個函式，會在第一次點擊時啟動麥克風。）這些事件只來自麥克風，不來自鼓機。

notes.en: When the drum machine plays, the global `beatDetected()`, `kickDetected()` and the others are also called for its hits. A listener added with `OAVp5.mic.on()` hears the microphone only.
notes.zh: 鼓機在播的時候，全域的 `beatDetected()`、`kickDetected()` 這些也會為鼓機的每一下被呼叫。用 `OAVp5.mic.on()` 加的監聽者只聽得到麥克風。

caption.en: A flash on every beat the microphone hears, brighter for a louder one. Clap or tap the desk.
caption.zh: 麥克風每聽到一個拍子就閃一下，拍子越大聲閃得越亮。拍手或敲桌子。

claims.expr: (() => { try { OAVp5.mic.on('nope', () => {}); return 'no error'; } catch (e) { return e.message.includes('unknown mic event'); } })()

summary.en: The raw loudness of the microphone: a smoothed RMS, 0 to 1, before oav-p5 turns it into the decibel scale of `micLevel`.
summary.zh: 麥克風原始的音量：平滑過的 RMS，0 到 1，是 oav-p5 把它換成 `micLevel` 的分貝刻度之前的值。

description.en: The root mean square of the samples in the latest frame, smoothed a little. It is linear, the way a waveform is drawn, so it suits a quick check or your own scale. [`micLevel`](#micLevel) is built from it: [`OAVp5.mic.db`](#OAVp5.mic.db) is the same number in dBFS, and [`OAVp5.mic.floor`](#OAVp5.mic.floor) is the room's own noise, in dBFS too.
description.zh: 最新一個畫面裡所有取樣的均方根，稍微平滑過。它是線性的，就像波形畫出來的樣子，所以適合快速檢查，或是用在你自己的刻度上。[`micLevel`](#micLevel) 就是用它算出來的：[`OAVp5.mic.db`](#OAVp5.mic.db) 是同一個數字換成 dBFS，[`OAVp5.mic.floor`](#OAVp5.mic.floor) 是房間本身的底噪，單位也是 dBFS。

value.en: Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 when it is off. A speaking voice into a laptop is a small number, in the range 0.01 to 0.05 according to the comment in the code, which is why `micLevel` works in decibels.
value.zh: 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次，關著是 0。對著筆電說話是個很小的數字，程式碼裡的註解說大約在 0.01 到 0.05，所以 `micLevel` 才改用分貝來算。

caption.en: The raw RMS as a number and a bar, magnified ten times because speech is a small number. Allow the microphone and talk.
caption.zh: 原始的 RMS，用數字和長條表示，放大十倍，因為說話的數值很小。允許麥克風，然後說話。

tbd.en: Typical values for speech and music depend on the microphone and the room. The 0.01 to 0.05 for a voice is the code comment's figure and was not measured here.
tbd.zh: 說話和音樂的典型數值要看麥克風和房間。人聲的 0.01 到 0.05 是程式碼註解裡的數字，這裡沒有量過。

summary.en: The microphone's sensitivity: 1 normally, 2 for twice as sensitive. [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) sets it; `OAVp5.mic.gain` is the old name.
summary.zh: 麥克風的靈敏度：平常是 1，2 是兩倍靈敏。用 [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) 來設定，`OAVp5.mic.gain` 是舊名字。

description.en: The number multiplies what the microphone hears: on [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 2 adds 6 dB, on [`bass`](#bass), `mid` and `treble` it multiplies by 2. Read it to show the current setting, and set it with [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity), which checks the number.
description.zh: 這個數字乘在麥克風聽到的東西上：對 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 來說 2 等於加 6 dB，對 [`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 是乘以 2。讀它來顯示目前的設定，要設定的話用 [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity)，它會檢查數字。

value.en: Starts at 1. [`micSensitivity(v)`](#micSensitivity) keeps what you give it between 0.05 and 20.
value.zh: 一開始是 1。[`micSensitivity(v)`](#micSensitivity) 會把你給的值限制在 0.05 到 20 之間。

notes.en: `OAVp5.mic.gain` is the same value under the name oav-p5 0.3.0 used. Assigning to either works (`OAVp5.mic.gain = 2`) but is not held between 0.05 and 20, and `gain` falls back to 1 for a number that is not above 0.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.mic.gain` 是同一個值，用的是 oav-p5 0.3.0 的名字。直接指定給任何一個都行（`OAVp5.mic.gain = 2`），但不會被限制在 0.05 到 20 之間，而且 `gain` 遇到不大於 0 的數字會退回 1。

caption.en: micSensitivity(3) sets the number, and OAVp5.mic.sensitivity reads it back.
caption.zh: micSensitivity(3) 設定這個數字，OAVp5.mic.sensitivity 把它讀回來。

summary.en: Turns the microphone on and returns a promise that says whether it worked: the same as `startMic()`.
summary.zh: 開啟麥克風，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你有沒有成功：跟 `startMic()` 一樣。

description.en: [`startMic()`](#startMic) is this function: see it for what must happen first (a click, `https` or `localhost`). `OAVp5.mic.start()` also lifts the "stopped by you" mark that [`stopMic()`](#stopMic) leaves, which is what lets a later read of [`micLevel`](#micLevel) switch the microphone on again.
description.zh: [`startMic()`](#startMic) 就是這個函式：要先發生什麼（一次點擊、`https` 或 `localhost`）請看那一條。`OAVp5.mic.start()` 也會解除 [`stopMic()`](#stopMic) 留下的「你停掉的」記號，這樣之後再讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 就又能把麥克風打開。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once the microphone is on, `false` if it was blocked, is missing, or the `mic` option is `off`.
returns.zh: 麥克風開起來之後 resolve 成 `true`，被擋下、不存在、或 `mic` 選項是 `off` 的時候 resolve 成 `false`。

caption.en: Nothing happens until you click: then the browser asks, and the text changes when the microphone is on.
caption.zh: 點下去之前什麼都不會發生：點了之後瀏覽器才詢問，麥克風開起來時文字就會改變。

summary.en: Where the microphone is: `'off'`, `'asking'`, `'on'`, `'denied'` or `'unavailable'`.
summary.zh: 麥克風現在的情形：`'off'`、`'asking'`、`'on'`、`'denied'` 或 `'unavailable'`。

description.en: `'off'`: not started, or stopped. `'asking'`: the browser is waiting for the user's answer. `'on'`: sound is coming in, and [`micIsOn`](#micIsOn) is true. `'denied'`: the permission was refused (by the user, by the computer's settings, or by an iframe without `allow="microphone"`). `'unavailable'`: there is no microphone, none the browser can open, or the page is not on `https` or `localhost`. When it is not `'on'`, [`OAVp5.mic.error`](#OAVp5.mic.error) has the browser's reason and a card beside the 🎹 says what to press.
description.zh: `'off'`：還沒啟動，或已經停了。`'asking'`：瀏覽器在等使用者回答。`'on'`：聲音進來了，[`micIsOn`](#micIsOn) 是 true。`'denied'`：權限被拒絕（被使用者、被電腦的設定，或被沒有 `allow="microphone"` 的 iframe）。`'unavailable'`：沒有麥克風、瀏覽器打不開，或網頁不在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下。不是 `'on'` 的時候，[`OAVp5.mic.error`](#OAVp5.mic.error) 有瀏覽器給的原因，🎹 旁邊也會有卡片說明要按什麼。

value.en: Changes when you start or stop the microphone and when the browser answers. `'off'` until something starts it. Reading it never starts it.
value.zh: 你開始或停止麥克風、瀏覽器回答的時候會變。在有東西啟動它之前是 `'off'`。讀它不會啟動它。

caption.en: The background is red until the microphone is on. The state goes "asking", then "on" when you allow it, or "denied" when you refuse.
caption.zh: 麥克風開起來之前背景是紅的。狀態先是 "asking"，你允許之後變成 "on"，拒絕的話變成 "denied"。

summary.en: Turns the microphone off and sets every microphone value back to 0: the same as `stopMic()`.
summary.zh: 關掉麥克風，所有麥克風的值都歸零：跟 `stopMic()` 一樣。

description.en: [`stopMic()`](#stopMic) is this function. It stops the microphone's tracks and closes its audio context, so the browser's "recording" indicator goes away, and [`OAVp5.mic.level`](#OAVp5.mic.level), `bass`, `mid`, `treble`, `rms` read 0 and `db` reads −100. After it, only [`OAVp5.mic.start()`](#OAVp5.mic.start) or 🎤 turns the microphone back on: reading `micLevel` does not.
description.zh: [`stopMic()`](#stopMic) 就是這個函式。它停掉麥克風的音軌並關掉它的音訊環境，所以瀏覽器上「正在錄音」的指示會消失，[`OAVp5.mic.level`](#OAVp5.mic.level)、`bass`、`mid`、`treble`、`rms` 都讀到 0，`db` 讀到 −100。之後只有 [`OAVp5.mic.start()`](#OAVp5.mic.start) 或 🎤 能再把麥克風打開：讀 `micLevel` 不行。

returns.en: Resolves to `false`, the new state of the microphone.
returns.zh: resolve 成 `false`，也就是麥克風的新狀態。

caption.en: Click the canvas: the microphone stops, the state says "off" and the circle drops to its smallest size.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布：麥克風停止，狀態變成 "off"，圓縮到最小。

entries.name: AudioAnalyzer
entries.signature: new AudioAnalyzer({ signals = null, fftSize = 2048, smooth = 0.7 } = {})

summary.en: Listens to the microphone, an audio element or any Web Audio node, and turns it into loudness, three bands, onsets and kick, snare and hat hits.
summary.zh: 聽麥克風、audio 元素或任何 Web Audio 節點，把它變成音量、三個頻段、起音，以及大鼓、小鼓、鈸的打點。

description.en: An `AudioAnalyzer` wraps one Web Audio `AnalyserNode`. You give it a sound (`enableMic()`, `enableElement(el)`, or connect your own node into `input()`), call `update()` once per frame, and it returns a plain object of numbers, which it also publishes as `audio/*` signals if you gave it a `signals` bus. This is the analysis under the microphone of a p5 sketch: [`micLevel`](#micLevel) is its `rms` turned into decibels, [`bass`](#bass), `mid` and `treble` are its `low`, `mid` and `high`, and [`beat`](#beat) and [`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected) come from its `onset` and `kick`.
description.zh: `AudioAnalyzer` 包著一個 Web Audio 的 `AnalyserNode`。你給它一個聲音來源（`enableMic()`、`enableElement(el)`，或把自己的節點接到 `input()`），每個畫面呼叫一次 `update()`，它就回傳一個只有數字的物件，如果你給了 `signals` 匯流排，也會同時發布成 `audio/*` 訊號。這就是 p5 草圖的麥克風底下的分析：[`micLevel`](#micLevel) 是它的 `rms` 換成分貝，[`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 是它的 `low`、`mid`、`high`，[`beat`](#beat) 和 [`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected) 來自它的 `onset` 和 `kick`。

description.en: `update()` returns `null` until a source is enabled. After that it returns `{ rms, peak, low, mid, high, centroid, onset, kick, snare, hat }`. `rms` is the smoothed loudness and `peak` the loudest sample of the moment, both 0..1 of full scale (from float samples where the browser has them, so a quiet room is measured, not rounded to one 8-bit step). A voice is a small `rms`: scale it, or map it through a window. `low`, `mid` and `high` are the average strength of the spectrum in 20–250 Hz, 250–2000 Hz and 2000–8000 Hz, 0..1, taken from the analyser's byte spectrum, so they are not decibels and a faint band stays near 0. `centroid` is the spectrum's centre of mass, 0..1 of the way from 0 Hz to half the sample rate (the brightness). `onset` is true for the one `update()` in which the loudness jumped over its adaptive floor, with at least 100 ms between two onsets.
description.zh: 來源開起來之前，`update()` 回傳 `null`。開起來之後，它回傳 `{ rms, peak, low, mid, high, centroid, onset, kick, snare, hat }`。`rms` 是平滑後的音量，`peak` 是這一刻最大的取樣，兩個都是滿刻度的 0..1（瀏覽器有浮點取樣的話就用浮點，所以安靜的房間也量得到，不會被四捨五入到 8 位元的一格）。人聲的 `rms` 很小，要乘上倍數，或用範圍視窗對應。`low`、`mid`、`high` 是頻譜在 20–250 Hz、250–2000 Hz、2000–8000 Hz 的平均強度，0..1，取自分析器的位元組頻譜，所以不是分貝，微弱的頻段會貼近 0。`centroid` 是頻譜的重心，從 0 Hz 到取樣率的一半，0..1（亮度）。`onset` 只在音量跳過它自己適應的底線的那一次 `update()` 是 true，兩個起音之間至少隔 100 毫秒。

description.en: `kick`, `snare` and `hat` are `{ hit, level, env }`, found by looking for a sudden rise in one band of the spectrum, with no machine learning: kick 20–120 Hz, snare 150–800 Hz, hat 6000–14000 Hz. `hit` is true on the update that found one (at least 90, 90 and 60 ms apart), `level` is the band's strength now, and `env` is 0..1: it jumps to `min(1, level × 2)` on a hit and then shrinks by 12% every `update()`, about 120 ms at 60 frames a second. Because it decays per update, it falls faster if you call `update()` less often.
description.zh: `kick`、`snare`、`hat` 是 `{ hit, level, env }`，做法是在頻譜的某一段找突然的上升，沒有用機器學習：大鼓 20–120 Hz、小鼓 150–800 Hz、鈸 6000–14000 Hz。`hit` 在找到一下的那次 `update()` 是 true（互相至少隔 90、90、60 毫秒），`level` 是那一段現在的強度，`env` 是 0..1：打到的時候跳到 `min(1, level × 2)`，之後每次 `update()` 縮小 12%，每秒 60 個畫面的話大約 120 毫秒。因為它是每次 `update()` 衰減，所以你呼叫 `update()` 的頻率越低，它掉得越快。

description.en: With a `signals` bus, these are published: `audio/rms`, `audio/peak`, `audio/band/low`, `audio/band/mid`, `audio/band/high`, `audio/centroid`, `audio/kick/env`, `audio/snare/env` and `audio/hat/env` (continuous, 0..1), and the pulses `audio/onset` `{ rms }`, `audio/kick` `{ level }`, `audio/snare` `{ level }` and `audio/hat` `{ level }`. Pulses fire only when something was found.
description.zh: 有 `signals` 匯流排的話，會發布這些：`audio/rms`、`audio/peak`、`audio/band/low`、`audio/band/mid`、`audio/band/high`、`audio/centroid`、`audio/kick/env`、`audio/snare/env`、`audio/hat/env`（連續值，0..1），以及脈衝 `audio/onset` `{ rms }`、`audio/kick` `{ level }`、`audio/snare` `{ level }`、`audio/hat` `{ level }`。脈衝只在找到東西的時候才觸發。

params.name: signals
params.en: A [`Signals`](#Signals) bus to publish into. With one, the `audio/*` signals are defined when you construct the analyzer and set on every `update()`. Without one, `update()` only returns the numbers.
params.zh: 要發布訊號的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 匯流排。有給的話，建構分析器時就會定義 `audio/*` 訊號，每次 `update()` 都會更新它們。沒給的話，`update()` 只回傳數字。

params.name: fftSize
params.en: The size of the analyser's FFT, a power of two from 32 to 32768. The spectrum has half as many bins.
params.zh: 分析器 FFT 的大小，32 到 32768 之間的 2 的次方。頻譜的格數是它的一半。

params.name: smooth
params.en: How much of the previous `rms` is kept each update, 0..1. Higher is smoother and slower: `rms = rms × smooth + now × (1 − smooth)`.
params.zh: 每次更新要留下多少上一次的 `rms`，0..1。越高越平滑也越慢：`rms = rms × smooth + 現在的值 × (1 − smooth)`。

needs.en: Browsers start audio only after a user gesture. `enableMic()` asks for the microphone, and the analyser's `AudioContext` stays suspended until the page has had a click or a key: `update()` calls `resume()` on every frame, so the numbers start by themselves after the first click. Until then they are all 0. The page needs `https` or `localhost` for the microphone.
needs.zh: 瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作之後才讓聲音開始。`enableMic()` 會去要麥克風，而分析器的 `AudioContext` 在頁面被點一下或按過鍵之前都是暫停的：`update()` 每個畫面都會呼叫 `resume()`，所以第一次點擊之後數字會自己開始動。在那之前全部都是 0。麥克風要求網頁在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下。

notes.en: It makes its own `AudioContext`, so p5.sound or Tone.js can run beside it. To analyse a sound that lives in another context, connect a node of `audio.ctx` into `input()`, or use `enableElement()`.
notes.zh: 它自己建一個 `AudioContext`，所以 p5.sound 或 Tone.js 可以在旁邊照常跑。要分析在別的 context 裡的聲音，就把 `audio.ctx` 的節點接到 `input()`，或用 `enableElement()`。

notes.en: `enableMic()` turns off echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic gain, because they change the loudness you want to measure. On a laptop that plays the sound it listens to, expect the speakers to leak into the microphone.
notes.zh: `enableMic()` 會關掉回音消除、噪音抑制和自動增益，因為它們會改變你想量的音量。筆電如果一邊播放一邊聽，喇叭的聲音會漏進麥克風。

caption.en: Allow the microphone, click the page once, and talk: a bar grows with the loudness.
caption.zh: 允許麥克風、在頁面上點一下，然後說話：一條橫條跟著音量變長。

caption.en: No microphone needed: a 100 Hz tone is fed into the analyser through `input()`. After 40 frames the log says the low band is louder than the high one.
caption.zh: 不需要麥克風：一個 100 Hz 的音從 `input()` 送進分析器。40 個畫面之後，log 會告訴你低頻段比高頻段大。

caption.en: With a signals bus the analyzer defines thirteen `audio/*` signals up front. Listen to a pulse with `signals.on`; the handlers run once a source is enabled and a hit is found.
caption.zh: 有匯流排的話，分析器一開始就定義好十三個 `audio/*` 訊號。用 `signals.on` 聽脈衝。來源開起來、找到打點的時候，處理函式就會被呼叫。

tbd.en: Typical `rms` values for speech differ between the notes of this project: the handbook (docs/inputs.md) says speech often sits around 0.05 to 0.2, a comment in oav-p5 says 0.01 to 0.05. They depend on the microphone and the room, and have not been measured here, so no typical number is given.
tbd.zh: 這個專案的各處對說話的 `rms` 典型值說法不一：手冊（docs/inputs.md）說說話常在 0.05 到 0.2 附近，oav-p5 裡的註解說是 0.01 到 0.05。它要看麥克風和房間，這裡沒有實際量過，所以不給典型數字。

members.name: enableElement
members.doc: Analyze an <audio>/<video> element (it keeps playing to speakers).

members.name: input
members.doc: Bring your own node (Tone.js etc.): node.connect(analyzer.input()).

members.name: update
members.doc: Call once per frame.

summary.en: Whether notes are being heard right now: true once `startSound()` has finished, false before and after.
summary.zh: 現在彈的音有沒有被聽到：`startSound()` 完成之後是 true，之前和之後都是 false。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` like `mouseIsPressed`: `if (!soundIsOn) text('click to hear', 20, 30);`. It changes only when the state of the sound changes, not every frame. Reading it never starts anything (unlike [`micLevel`](#micLevel)), so it is safe to check anywhere.
description.zh: 像 `mouseIsPressed` 一樣在 `draw()` 裡讀：`if (!soundIsOn) text('click to hear', 20, 30);`。它只有在聲音的狀態改變的時候才會變，不是每個畫面都更新。讀它不會啟動任何東西（跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 不一樣），所以在哪裡檢查都安全。

description.en: `false` does not mean `startSound()` was never called. To tell "loading" from "waiting for the click" from "failed", read [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state), and [`OAVp5.sound.error`](#OAVp5.sound.error) for the reason of a failure.
description.zh: `false` 不代表沒呼叫過 `startSound()`。要分辨「載入中」、「等點擊」和「失敗」，請讀 [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state)，失敗的原因在 [`OAVp5.sound.error`](#OAVp5.sound.error)。

value.en: True only while [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) is `'on'`. It is false at the start, while sound waits for a click, while it loads, after [`stopSound()`](#stopSound) and after an error.
value.zh: 只有 [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) 是 `'on'` 的時候才是 true。一開始、等待點擊、載入中、呼叫 [`stopSound()`](#stopSound) 之後、以及出錯的時候都是 false。

needs.en: It becomes true only after [`startSound()`](#startSound) (or 🔊 in the 🎹 panel, or `?oav_sound=piano`), and after the click the browser wants.
needs.zh: 要先呼叫 [`startSound()`](#startSound)（或按 🎹 面板的 🔊、或網址加 `?oav_sound=piano`），而且過了瀏覽器要求的那次點擊，它才會變成 true。

notes.en: A sketch that already declares its own variable called `soundIsOn` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.sound.state === 'on'` instead.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `soundIsOn` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.sound.state === 'on'`。

caption.en: An amber circle until you click, then a green one: that is the moment [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) turns true.
caption.zh: 點擊之前是琥珀色的圓，點了之後變綠色：那一刻就是 `soundIsOn` 變成 true 的時候。

summary.en: Makes the keys you play heard through an instrument you name, and returns a promise that says whether sound is on.
summary.zh: 讓你彈的鍵都聽得到，用你指定的樂器發聲，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你聲音有沒有開起來。

description.en: Call it once in `setup()`: `startSound('organ')`. From then on every note you play is heard: a MIDI keyboard, the 🎹 on screen, a phone, `midi.play(60, 0.8)`. Your own [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) still gets the note, and the sound is made before the sketch is told, so a slow callback never delays it. Pads on MIDI channel 10 (the General MIDI drum channel) play the drum kit instead of the instrument, and the sustain pedal holds notes.
description.zh: 在 `setup()` 裡呼叫一次：`startSound('organ')`。從這時候起，你彈的每個音都聽得到：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的 🎹、手機、`midi.play(60, 0.8)` 都算。你自己寫的 [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) 一樣會收到音符，而且是先發聲、再通知草圖，所以 callback 寫得慢也不會拖慢聲音。MIDI 第 10 軌（General MIDI 的鼓軌）的打擊墊打的是鼓組，不是樂器，延音踏板則會讓音延續。

description.en: The instrument ids are `piano`, `epiano`, `organ`, `strings`, `choir`, `harp`, `marimba`, `vibraphone`, `xylophone`, `glockenspiel`, `music-box` and the synth presets `synth/pad`, `synth/saw-lead`, `synth/square-lead`, `synth/pluck`, `synth/supersaw`, `synth/bass`, `synth/acid`, `synth/brass`, `synth/bell`, `synth/sub` and `synth/chip`. Calling `startSound(id)` while sound plays switches the instrument. An id that does not exist is listed in the console together with the real ones: an instrument that is already playing stays, and at the first call the warm pad `synth/pad` plays.
description.zh: 樂器代號有 `piano`、`epiano`、`organ`、`strings`、`choir`、`harp`、`marimba`、`vibraphone`、`xylophone`、`glockenspiel`、`music-box`，以及合成器音色 `synth/pad`、`synth/saw-lead`、`synth/square-lead`、`synth/pluck`、`synth/supersaw`、`synth/bass`、`synth/acid`、`synth/brass`、`synth/bell`、`synth/sub`、`synth/chip`。聲音在播的時候再呼叫 `startSound(id)`，就是換樂器。給了不存在的代號，主控台會連同真正的代號清單一起列出來：已經在播的樂器不變，第一次呼叫就給錯的話，會是溫暖的 `synth/pad`。

description.en: Nothing is loaded before the first call (or before 🔊 in the 🎹 panel): [@openav/sound](#Sound) comes from next to `oav-p5.js` and Tone.js 15 from jsDelivr (the `tone` option points it somewhere else). Only the `piano` plays recorded samples, about 2 MB the first time; the electric piano sounds meanwhile (or, when you switch from another instrument, that one keeps sounding), and [`OAVp5.sound.instrument`](#OAVp5.sound.instrument) changes to `piano` when the samples are in. Every other instrument is made by Tone.js and has no files to load.
description.zh: 在第一次呼叫之前（或按 🎹 面板裡的 🔊 之前）什麼都不會載入：[@openav/sound](#Sound) 從 `oav-p5.js` 旁邊載入，Tone.js 15 從 jsDelivr 載入（載入選項 `tone` 可以改成別的地方）。只有 `piano` 播的是錄好的取樣，第一次大約 2 MB，載好之前由電鋼琴先頂著（如果是從別的樂器切過來，就由原本那個繼續響），取樣到齊的時候 [`OAVp5.sound.instrument`](#OAVp5.sound.instrument) 會變成 `piano`。其他樂器都是 Tone.js 即時合成的，沒有檔案要載。

params.name: id
params.en: An instrument id, for example `'organ'` or `'synth/pluck'` (the list is in the description). Leave it out to keep the instrument chosen before; at the very first call that is the piano. A value that is not a non-empty string counts as left out.
params.zh: 樂器的代號，例如 `'organ'` 或 `'synth/pluck'`（完整清單在說明裡）。不傳就沿用之前選的樂器，第一次呼叫時就是鋼琴。不是非空字串的值，視同沒傳。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once sound is on. When the browser wants a click first, that is after the first click or key press on the page. Resolves to `false` when the loading option `sound` is `off`, when [`stopSound()`](#stopSound) came first, or when Tone.js could not be loaded.
returns.zh: 聲音開起來之後 resolve 成 `true`。瀏覽器要先有一次點擊的話，就是在頁面上第一次點擊或按鍵之後。載入選項 `sound` 是 `off`、[`stopSound()`](#stopSound) 先被呼叫、或 Tone.js 載入失敗的時候，resolve 成 `false`。

needs.en: A browser lets a page make sound only after a click or a key press on the page, and a key on a MIDI keyboard does not count. Calling `startSound()` in `setup()` is fine: [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) is `'waiting'` and a card beside the 🎹 says "Sound is ready but silent"; the first click or key press turns sound on. [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) tells when it has.
needs.zh: 瀏覽器要頁面上先有一次點擊或按鍵才讓頁面出聲，MIDI 鍵盤上的鍵不算。在 `setup()` 裡呼叫 `startSound()` 沒有問題：[`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) 會是 `'waiting'`，🎹 旁邊有一張卡片說「聲音準備好了，還沒響」，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把聲音打開。[`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) 會告訴你什麼時候開了。

notes.en: No code at all: `?oav_sound=piano` on the page address (any instrument id; on OpenProcessing `?sketch_oav_sound=piano`) makes any sketch heard from the first click, and [`?oav_sound=off`](#option-sound) keeps it silent: `startSound()` then does nothing and resolves to `false`. In the 🎹 panel, 🔊 turns sound on and off and shows a picker with every instrument.
notes.zh: 完全不寫程式也行：在網址後面加 `?oav_sound=piano`（任何樂器代號都可以，在 OpenProcessing 上是 `?sketch_oav_sound=piano`），任何草圖從第一次點擊起就聽得到，[`?oav_sound=off`](#option-sound) 則讓它保持安靜，這時 `startSound()` 什麼都不做，並 resolve 成 `false`。🎹 面板裡的 🔊 可以開關聲音，並列出所有樂器讓你挑。

notes.en: Sound is separate from the drum machine: [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) has its own kit and is heard from the first click without `startSound()`.
notes.zh: 聲音和鼓機是分開的：[`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 有自己的鼓組，不用 `startSound()`，第一次點擊之後就聽得到。

caption.en: The first click turns sound on and the background darkens; the clicks after that play a note, higher to the right.
caption.zh: 第一次點擊把聲音打開，背景變暗，之後每點一下就彈一個音，越右邊音越高。

caption.en: Press a, s, d, f, g, h, j, k: each key sounds and a dot floats up from the matching place.
caption.zh: 按 a、s、d、f、g、h、j、k：每個鍵都會發聲，並從對應的位置飄起一個圓點。

caption.en: Press 4 for the piano: "loading" shows its samples arriving while "playing" still names the instrument you hear, and flips to piano when it is ready.
caption.zh: 按 4 換鋼琴：「loading」會顯示取樣載入的進度，「playing」仍是你現在聽到的樂器，等準備好才換成 piano。

summary.en: Turns sound off and lets every ringing note go; the instrument stays loaded, so `startSound()` brings it back at once.
summary.zh: 關掉聲音，讓正在響的音全部放開，樂器還留在記憶體裡，所以再呼叫 `startSound()` 馬上就回來。

description.en: It releases every note that is ringing, sets [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) to `false` and [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) to `'off'`. Notes you play afterwards are not heard (the sketch's [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) is still called). Tone.js and the instrument stay loaded: [`startSound()`](#startSound) afterwards is on again at once, without a new download and without waiting for another click.
description.zh: 它會放開所有正在響的音，把 [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) 設成 `false`，[`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) 設成 `'off'`。之後彈的音聽不到（草圖的 [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) 照樣會被呼叫）。Tone.js 和樂器都還載著，所以之後再呼叫 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 會馬上開，不用重新下載，也不用再等一次點擊。

description.en: It also works while sound is still loading or waiting for the first click: the pending [`startSound()`](#startSound) then resolves to `false`.
description.zh: 聲音還在載入、或還在等第一次點擊的時候呼叫也可以：還沒結束的 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 會 resolve 成 `false`。

returns.en: A promise that is already resolved to `false`, the new state of the sound.
returns.zh: 一個已經 resolve 成 `false` 的 promise，`false` 就是聲音的新狀態。

notes.en: It does not touch the drum machine (use [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums)) or the microphone ([`stopMic()`](#stopMic)).
notes.zh: 它不會動到鼓機（要用 [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums)），也不會動到麥克風（[`stopMic()`](#stopMic)）。

caption.en: Press s to switch sound off and on; the background is dark while sound is on.
caption.zh: 按 s 把聲音關掉再打開，聲音開著的時候背景是暗的。

summary.en: The object behind the sound names: the state, the instrument, the error, the loading progress and the loaded parts of @openav/sound.
summary.zh: 聲音相關名稱背後的物件：狀態、樂器、錯誤、載入進度，以及載入進來的 @openav/sound 各部分。

description.en: `OAVp5.sound` (also reachable as `midi.sound`) is what [`startSound()`](#startSound), [`stopSound()`](#stopSound) and [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) are built on. Read [`state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) to know where sound is, [`instrument`](#OAVp5.sound.instrument) for what you hear, [`status`](#OAVp5.sound.status) for the loading progress and [`error`](#OAVp5.sound.error) for a failure. `start(id)` and `stop()` are the same as the two global functions. [`shell`](#OAVp5.sound.shell), `engine` and `module` hand you the loaded @openav/sound parts for the rare case that you need them.
description.zh: `OAVp5.sound`（也可以用 `midi.sound` 取得）是 [`startSound()`](#startSound)、[`stopSound()`](#stopSound) 和 [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) 的底層。讀 [`state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) 知道聲音在哪個階段，[`instrument`](#OAVp5.sound.instrument) 是你聽到的樂器，[`status`](#OAVp5.sound.status) 是載入進度，[`error`](#OAVp5.sound.error) 是失敗的原因。`start(id)` 和 `stop()` 跟那兩個全域函式一模一樣。[`shell`](#OAVp5.sound.shell)、`engine`、`module` 把載入進來的 @openav/sound 各部分交給你，給少數真的需要的情況。

notes.en: For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, the console and debugging: `OAVp5.sound.state` is the first thing to look at when nothing is heard.
notes.zh: 一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、主控台和除錯用的：聽不到聲音的時候，先看 `OAVp5.sound.state`。

caption.en: Three lines of the sound object: the state goes from "loading" or "waiting" to "on" after the first click.
caption.zh: 聲音物件的三個欄位：狀態會從 "loading" 或 "waiting"，在第一次點擊之後變成 "on"。

summary.en: The message of the last thing that went wrong while loading sound, or `null` when nothing has.
summary.zh: 載入聲音的時候，最近一次出錯的訊息，沒出過錯就是 `null`。

description.en: It is the error the browser reported when @openav/sound or Tone.js could not be loaded. A card beside the 🎹 already tells the person at the keyboard what to do (try another network, or point the `tone` option at another copy of Tone.js); read this value to log it or to show your own message. To know whether sound is failing right now, use [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state), not this.
description.zh: 這是 @openav/sound 或 Tone.js 載入失敗的時候，瀏覽器回報的錯誤。🎹 旁邊的卡片已經告訴現場的人該怎麼辦（換一個網路，或把 `tone` 選項指到另一份 Tone.js）。讀這個值是為了記錄下來，或顯示你自己的訊息。要知道聲音現在是不是在出錯，看 [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state)，不要看這個。

value.en: Set when the state becomes `'error'`. It stays until the page is reloaded: a later try that works does not clear it.
value.zh: 狀態變成 `'error'` 的時候設定。它會一直留到頁面重新載入：之後重試成功也不會清掉。

caption.en: Stays on "no error" when sound loads; if Tone.js cannot be reached the background turns red and the message is printed.
caption.zh: 聲音載入正常的時候一直是 "no error"，如果連不到 Tone.js，背景會變紅並印出訊息。

summary.en: The id of the instrument you hear right now, or `null` before sound has loaded.
summary.zh: 你現在聽到的樂器代號，聲音還沒載入的時候是 `null`。

description.en: After a first [`startSound('piano')`](#startSound) the piano's samples (about 2 MB) download first, and the electric piano plays meanwhile, so the first key is never silent: `instrument` says `'epiano'` until the piano is ready and `'piano'` after. When you switch to the piano from another instrument, that one keeps sounding and `instrument` names it until the samples are in. How far the loading is, and which instrument it is on, is in [`OAVp5.sound.status`](#OAVp5.sound.status).
description.zh: 第一次呼叫 [`startSound('piano')`](#startSound) 的時候，鋼琴的取樣（約 2 MB）要先下載，這段時間由電鋼琴頂著，所以第一個鍵不會沒聲音：鋼琴準備好之前 `instrument` 是 `'epiano'`，之後才是 `'piano'`。如果是從別的樂器切到鋼琴，取樣到齊之前原本那個樂器繼續響，`instrument` 也還是它的名字。載到哪裡、載的是哪個樂器，看 [`OAVp5.sound.status`](#OAVp5.sound.status)。

value.en: Changes when the instrument changes, which for a sampled instrument is when its samples are in.
value.zh: 樂器換了才會變，取樣型的樂器則是等取樣到齊的時候才換。

caption.en: Shows the instrument you hear: epiano while the piano samples arrive, then piano.
caption.zh: 顯示你聽到的樂器：鋼琴取樣下載的時候是 epiano，之後變成 piano。

summary.en: Where sound is: `'off'`, `'waiting'` (for a click), `'loading'`, `'on'` or `'error'`.
summary.zh: 聲音現在在哪個階段：`'off'`、`'waiting'`（等點擊）、`'loading'`、`'on'` 或 `'error'`。

description.en: `'off'` is where it starts and where [`stopSound()`](#stopSound) leaves it. [`startSound()`](#startSound) moves it to `'loading'` while @openav/sound and Tone.js arrive, to `'waiting'` when everything is ready but the browser has not yet had its click, and to `'on'` when notes are heard. `'error'` means the sound parts could not be loaded (a network, a school firewall or an ad blocker); the message is in [`OAVp5.sound.error`](#OAVp5.sound.error), and calling `startSound()` again tries once more.
description.zh: `'off'` 是起點，也是 [`stopSound()`](#stopSound) 之後的狀態。呼叫 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 之後，@openav/sound 和 Tone.js 還在下載的時候是 `'loading'`，東西都到齊但瀏覽器還沒等到那次點擊的時候是 `'waiting'`，聽得到音符的時候是 `'on'`。`'error'` 表示聲音的部分載入失敗（網路、學校的防火牆或廣告攔截器）。訊息在 [`OAVp5.sound.error`](#OAVp5.sound.error)，再呼叫一次 `startSound()` 會重試。

description.en: [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) is the same thing reduced to `state === 'on'`.
description.zh: [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn) 就是把它縮成 `state === 'on'` 的版本。

value.en: Starts as `'off'` and changes whenever the sound moves to another stage.
value.zh: 一開始是 `'off'`，聲音換到另一個階段的時候就跟著變。

caption.en: One word for each stage; "click to hear" is what the sketch shows between a ready sound and the first click.
caption.zh: 每個階段一句話，聲音準備好、但還沒點擊的那段時間，畫面會顯示 "click to hear"。

summary.en: How the instrument is loading: `{ id, state, progress, error }`, with `progress` from 0 to 1.
summary.zh: 樂器載入得怎麼樣了：`{ id, state, progress, error }`，其中 `progress` 從 0 到 1。

description.en: It is about the instrument, not about the whole sound: [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) is the whole sound. Only the `piano` has files to load, so for every other instrument `progress` is 1 almost at once. While a sampler loads, [`OAVp5.sound.instrument`](#OAVp5.sound.instrument) is still the one you hear and `status.id` is the one on its way (at the very first call it may name the electric piano that stands in, and then the piano).
description.zh: 它講的是樂器，不是整個聲音：整個聲音的狀態是 [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state)。只有 `piano` 有檔案要載，所以其他樂器的 `progress` 幾乎馬上就是 1。取樣型樂器載入的時候，[`OAVp5.sound.instrument`](#OAVp5.sound.instrument) 仍是你現在聽到的那個，`status.id` 才是正在路上的那個（第一次呼叫的時候，一開始可能先是頂替用的電鋼琴，之後才是鋼琴）。

value.range: { id, state: idle | loading | ready | error, progress: 0..1, error }
value.en: A new object on every read. `id` is the instrument the loader is working on, `state` is `'idle'` before anything loads, `'loading'`, `'ready'` or `'error'`, and `progress` is the fraction of the files loaded.
value.zh: 每次讀都是一個新的物件。`id` 是載入器現在處理的樂器，`state` 在還沒載任何東西時是 `'idle'`，之後是 `'loading'`、`'ready'` 或 `'error'`，`progress` 是檔案載入的比例。

caption.en: A progress bar for the piano samples; it fills within a few seconds and the label changes to "ready".
caption.zh: 鋼琴取樣的進度條，幾秒內會填滿，標籤變成 "ready"。

summary.en: The 22 instruments that come with the package, as definitions: a grand piano, mallets, strings, harp, organ, choir and 11 synth presets.
summary.zh: 套件內建的 22 個樂器的定義：平台鋼琴、敲擊琴、弦樂、豎琴、風琴、合唱和 11 個合成器預設。

description.en:
```text
id                 category  name
piano              keys      Grand piano (Salamander), 30 samples, CC-BY 3.0
epiano             keys      Electric piano (two FM pairs and a tremolo)
xylophone          mallets   Xylophone (sounds an octave up)
marimba            mallets   Marimba
vibraphone         mallets   Vibraphone (motor tremolo, key-up damps)
glockenspiel       mallets   Glockenspiel (two octaves up)
music-box          mallets   Music box (two octaves up)
strings            strings   String ensemble
harp               plucked   Harp (Karplus-Strong)
organ              organ     Drawbar organ (rotary tremolo)
choir              voice     Choir pad (aah)
synth/pad          synth     Warm pad (the default)
synth/saw-lead     synth     Saw lead
synth/square-lead  synth     Square lead
synth/pluck        synth     Pluck
synth/supersaw     synth     Supersaw
synth/bass         synth     Analog bass
synth/acid         synth     Acid
synth/brass        synth     Synth brass
synth/bell         synth     FM bell
synth/sub          synth     Sub bass
synth/chip         synth     Chip (8-bit)
```
description.zh:
```text
id                 類別      名稱
piano              keys      平台鋼琴（Salamander），30 個取樣，CC-BY 3.0
epiano             keys      電鋼琴（兩組 FM 加顫音）
xylophone          mallets   木琴（高一個八度）
marimba            mallets   馬林巴
vibraphone         mallets   顫音琴（馬達顫音，放開鍵會止音）
glockenspiel       mallets   鐵琴（高兩個八度）
music-box          mallets   音樂盒（高兩個八度）
strings            strings   弦樂合奏
harp               plucked   豎琴（Karplus-Strong）
organ              organ     音栓風琴（旋轉喇叭顫音）
choir              voice     合唱襯底（啊）
synth/pad          synth     溫暖襯底（預設）
synth/saw-lead     synth     鋸齒波主奏
synth/square-lead  synth     方波主奏
synth/pluck        synth     撥奏
synth/supersaw     synth     超級鋸齒波
synth/bass         synth     類比貝斯
synth/acid         synth     酸性 303
synth/brass        synth     合成銅管
synth/bell         synth     FM 鐘聲
synth/sub          synth     超低音
synth/chip         synth     晶片音（8-bit）
```

description.en: Loading the package registers all of them, except those whose id you registered first. Each one is a small file in the package's `instruments/` folder. The piano loads its samples only when it is picked, and falls back to the electric piano if they cannot be fetched. The organ, the strings, the choir, the electric piano and the vibraphone bring params of their own.
description.zh: 載入套件就會登記全部，除非你先登記了同樣 id 的樂器。每一個都是套件的 `instruments/` 資料夾裡的一個小檔案。鋼琴只有在被選到的時候才載入取樣，取樣抓不到就退回電鋼琴。風琴、弦樂、合唱、電鋼琴和顫音琴有自己的參數。

value.en: An array of 22 instrument definitions, in the order of the table.
value.zh: 一個有 22 個樂器定義的陣列，順序跟下面的表一樣。

examples.code:
import { BUILTIN_INSTRUMENTS, getInstrument } from '@openav/sound';

console.log(BUILTIN_INSTRUMENTS.length);                                       // 22
console.log(BUILTIN_INSTRUMENTS.slice(0, 3).map((d) => d.id).join(' '));      // piano epiano xylophone
console.log(getInstrument('piano') === BUILTIN_INSTRUMENTS[0]);                // true: they are the registered ones
console.log(getInstrument('organ').params.map((p) => p.key).join(' '));        // drawbars rotor

caption.en: How many built-in instruments there are, the first three, and that the registry holds these very objects. The organ lists the two params of its own.
caption.zh: 有幾個內建樂器、前三個，以及登記表裡放的就是這些物件。風琴列出它自己的兩個參數。

summary.en: The instrument categories in picker order: keys, mallets, strings, plucked, organ, voice, synth, drums and other.
summary.zh: 樂器的類別，照選單的順序：keys、mallets、strings、plucked、organ、voice、synth、drums、other。

description.en: The `category` of an instrument definition picks its group in the picker. A category that is not in this list is allowed: it sorts after these, and its label is its id. Every category also has a Chinese name, which the picker uses on a Chinese page.
description.zh: 樂器定義的 `category` 決定它在選單裡的組別。不在這份清單裡的類別也可以，它排在這些後面，標籤就是它的 id。中文名稱是 鍵盤、敲擊琴、弦樂、撥弦、風琴、人聲、合成器、鼓、其他。

value.en: Nine items `{ id, name: { en, zh } }`, such as `{ id: 'mallets', name: { en: 'Mallets', zh: … } }`.
value.zh: 九個項目 `{ id, name: { en, zh } }`，例如 `{ id: 'mallets', name: { en: 'Mallets', zh: '敲擊琴' } }`。

caption.en: Logs the nine ids in order and the English and Chinese name of the second.
caption.zh: 依序印出九個 id，以及第二個的英文和中文名稱。

summary.en: The instrument used when none is named: 'synth/pad', the warm three-saw pad that was the framework's first voice.
summary.zh: 沒指定樂器時用的那個：'synth/pad'，由三個鋸齒波組成的溫暖襯底，是這個框架最早的聲音。

description.en: [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) starts on it, and falls back to it when you name an instrument that is not registered. Its sound has not changed since the first version.
description.zh: [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) 一開始用它，你指定了沒登記的樂器時也退回它。它的聲音從第一版以來沒有變過。

value.en: `'synth/pad'`.
value.zh: 字串 `'synth/pad'`。

caption.en: Logs the default instrument and its name, and that an engine with no options starts on it.
caption.zh: 印出預設樂器和它的名字，以及沒給任何選項的引擎一開始用的就是它。

summary.en: Finds a registered instrument definition by its id, or null.
summary.zh: 用 id 找出一個登記過的樂器定義，找不到就是 null。

description.en: Use it to check that an id exists before you pass it to [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) or `setInstrument()`, or to read an instrument's `credit`, `defaults` or `params`.
description.zh: 在把 id 交給 [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) 或 `setInstrument()` 之前，用它確認 id 存在，或讀一個樂器的 `credit`、`defaults`、`params`。

params.name: id
params.en: The id, for example `'piano'` or `'synth/pluck'`.
params.zh: id，例如 `'piano'` 或 `'synth/pluck'`。

returns.en: The definition you registered (`{ id, name, category, create, … }`), or `null`.
returns.zh: 你登記的那個定義（`{ id, name, category, create, … }`），或 `null`。

caption.en: Reads the name, category and credit of the built-in piano, and shows that an id that is not registered gives `null`.
caption.zh: 讀內建鋼琴的名字、類別和出處說明，並顯示沒登記過的 id 會得到 `null`。

summary.en: Groups the instruments by category in picker order: [{ id, label, items }], with empty groups left out.
summary.zh: 把樂器依類別分組，照選單的順序：[{ id, label, items }]，沒有樂器的組會省略。

description.en: It is the data behind the picker, so you can build your own menu, a list or a grid of buttons. A category that is not in `CATEGORIES` is allowed; it sorts after the known ones and its `label` is its id.
description.zh: 這就是選單背後的資料，所以你可以自己做選單、清單或一排按鈕。不在 `CATEGORIES` 裡的類別也可以，它排在已知的類別後面，`label` 就是它的 id。

params.name: lang
params.en: The language of the group labels.
params.zh: 組別標籤的語言。

params.name: list
params.en: The instruments to group. Left out, all the registered ones.
params.zh: 要分組的樂器。沒給的話，就是所有登記過的。

returns.en: `[{ id, label, items: [definition…] }]`: the groups in the order of [`CATEGORIES`](#CATEGORIES), then any categories of your own, sorted by name.
returns.zh: `[{ id, label, items: [定義…] }]`：各組依 [`CATEGORIES`](#CATEGORIES) 的順序，接著是你自己的類別，依名稱排序。

caption.en: The seven groups the built-in instruments make, with how many each holds (no drums yet, so that group is left out), and a group label in Chinese.
caption.zh: 內建樂器組成的七個組，各有幾個樂器（還沒有鼓，所以那一組省略），以及一個中文的組別標籤。

summary.en: Gives an instrument's display name in a language, falling back to English.
summary.zh: 給一個樂器在某種語言下的顯示名稱，沒有就退回英文。

description.en: Instruments carry `name` as a string or as `{ en, zh }`. This hides which, so your own menu can just call `instrumentName(def, lang)`.
description.zh: 樂器的 `name` 可以是字串，也可以是 `{ en, zh }`。這個函式把差別藏起來，所以你自己的選單只要呼叫 `instrumentName(def, lang)`。

params.name: def
params.en: An instrument definition. `null` or `undefined` gives `''`.
params.zh: 樂器的定義。`null` 或 `undefined` 會得到 `''`。

params.name: lang
params.en: `'en'`, `'zh'`… A longer tag such as `'zh-TW'` is tried by its first two letters.
params.zh: `'en'`、`'zh'`…。比較長的標記，像 `'zh-TW'`，會用它前兩個字母去找。

returns.en: The name in that language, else the English one. A definition whose `name` is a plain string gives that string.
returns.zh: 該語言的名稱，沒有就是英文的。`name` 只是一個字串的定義就回傳那個字串。

caption.en: The name in English, in Chinese, in a language that has no entry (English again), and for nothing at all.
caption.zh: 英文的名字、中文的名字、沒有登記的語言（退回英文），以及什麼都沒有的情況。

summary.en: Lists every registered instrument, in the order they were registered, or only the ones of one category.
summary.zh: 列出所有登記過的樂器，照登記的順序，或只列某一個類別的。

description.en: The 22 built-in instruments are registered when `@openav/sound` loads, so a fresh page lists those. For a list shaped for a menu, with the groups in order, use [`instrumentGroups()`](#instrumentGroups).
description.zh: 22 個內建樂器在 `@openav/sound` 載入的時候就登記了，所以剛打開的頁面列出的就是這些。要一份適合做選單的清單，各組已排好序，用 [`instrumentGroups()`](#instrumentGroups)。

params.name: category
params.en: In the options `{ category }`: only the instruments of this category (`'mallets'`).
params.zh: 在選項 `{ category }` 裡：只列這個類別的樂器（`'mallets'`）。

returns.en: A new array of instrument definitions.
returns.zh: 一個新的樂器定義陣列。

caption.en: How many instruments there are, and which ones are mallets and keys.
caption.zh: 一共有幾個樂器，以及哪些是敲擊琴和鍵盤。

entries.name: modalInstrument
entries.signature: modalInstrument({ id, name, category = 'mallets', credit = null, params, defaults = { cutoff: 8000 }, partials, strike = null, damp = 0, pitchDecay = 0.6, transpose = 0, gain = 0, attack = 0.0015, tremolo = null, maxVoices = 40, set = null, })

summary.en: Makes a struck-bar or tine instrument from data: a list of partials that ring and die away, and a short noise for the mallet.
summary.zh: 用資料做出敲擊的音條或音叉類樂器：一串會響然後衰減的泛音，加上一小段代表槌子的雜訊。

description.en: A xylophone bar, a glockenspiel bar and a music-box tine are the same physics with different numbers: a strike excites a few modes, each rings at its own multiple of the pitch and dies at its own rate. So a mallet instrument here is data, not code. The built-in xylophone is this short:
description.zh: 木琴的音條、鐵琴的音條和音樂盒的音叉是同樣的物理，只是數字不同：敲一下激發出幾個振動模式，每個模式以自己的音高倍數響，用自己的速度消失。所以這裡的敲擊類樂器是資料，不是程式。內建的木琴就這麼短：

description.en: Harder strikes brighten: the upper partials grow faster with velocity, as a real mallet does. The voices are raw Web Audio nodes built for each strike and left to the garbage collector.
description.zh: 打得越用力越亮：高的泛音會隨力度長得比較快，真的槌子就是這樣。每個聲部都是每敲一下就建一組的原生 Web Audio 節點，用完交給垃圾回收。

params.name: id
params.en: The instrument id (see [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument)).
params.zh: 樂器的 id（見 [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument)）。

params.name: name
params.en: The name: a string, or `{ en, zh }`.
params.zh: 名稱：字串，或 `{ en, zh }`。

params.name: category
params.en: The picker group.
params.zh: 選單的組別。

params.name: credit
params.en: A credit line, a string or `{ text, url }`.
params.zh: 出處說明，字串或 `{ text, url }`。

params.name: params
params.en: Params of its own: `[{ key, label, min, max, def }]`. Handled by the `set` function.
params.zh: 它自己的參數：`[{ key, label, min, max, def }]`。由 `set` 函式處理。

params.name: defaults
params.en: Starting values for the shared params. The default opens the filter, because bars are bright.
params.zh: 共用參數的起始值。預設把濾波器打開，因為敲擊的音條聲音是亮的。

params.name: partials
params.en: The modes of the bar: `[{ ratio, gain, decay }]`. `ratio` is the frequency as a multiple of the note (1 is the note itself, 3 a twelfth above it), `gain` the level relative to the others and `decay` the seconds to near silence at middle C. High notes die faster than low ones. A partial above 45% of the sample rate is skipped. Required: without it this throws.
params.zh: 音條的各個振動模式：`[{ ratio, gain, decay }]`。`ratio` 是頻率相對於音符的倍數（1 是音符本身，3 是高一個十二度），`gain` 是相對於其他泛音的音量，`decay` 是在中央 C 衰減到幾乎無聲要幾秒。高音比低音消失得快。高於取樣率 45% 的泛音會被略過。必須給：沒給的話會丟出錯誤。

params.name: strike
params.en: The mallet, a few milliseconds of band-passed noise: `{ ratio, q, gain, decay }`, where `ratio` sets its pitch as a multiple of the note, `q` its width, `gain` its level and `decay` its length in seconds.
params.zh: 槌子，幾毫秒的帶通雜訊：`{ ratio, q, gain, decay }`，`ratio` 是它的音高相對於音符的倍數，`q` 是寬度，`gain` 是音量，`decay` 是長度，單位是秒。

params.name: damp
params.en: Seconds in which letting go of a key mutes the bar. 0 lets the bars ring free (xylophone, glockenspiel); a vibraphone has a damper.
params.zh: 放開鍵之後幾秒內把音條止音。0 是讓音條自由響完（木琴、鐵琴）。顫音琴有止音器。

params.name: pitchDecay
params.en: How much faster high notes die than low ones. The decay is scaled by `(261.63 / frequency) ^ pitchDecay`, held between 0.2 and 3. 0 makes every note last the same.
params.zh: 高音比低音消失得快多少。衰減時間會乘上 `(261.63 / 頻率) ^ pitchDecay`，限制在 0.2 到 3 之間。0 讓每個音一樣長。

params.name: transpose
params.en: Semitones to shift what is played (the xylophone sounds an octave up: 12).
params.zh: 把演奏的音移幾個半音（木琴高一個八度：12）。

params.name: gain
params.en: The instrument's level, in dB.
params.zh: 樂器的音量，單位是 dB。

params.name: attack
params.en: Seconds the partials take to reach full level.
params.zh: 泛音達到全音量要幾秒。

params.name: tremolo
params.en: A level wobble over all voices, the vibraphone's motor: `{ frequency, depth, spread }`.
params.zh: 所有聲部一起的音量起伏，也就是顫音琴的馬達：`{ frequency, depth, spread }`。

params.name: maxVoices
params.en: How many notes can ring at once. The oldest is faded out in 30 ms when it is exceeded.
params.zh: 最多能同時響幾個音。超過的時候，最舊的會在 30 毫秒內淡出。

params.name: set
params.en: `set({ key, value, tremolo, Tone })`, called when one of the instrument's own params changes, so it can change the tremolo or anything else.
params.zh: `set({ key, value, tremolo, Tone })`，樂器自己的參數改變時呼叫，好讓它改顫音或別的東西。

returns.en: An instrument definition, not yet registered: pass it to [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument). `tail` is set to `min(8, longest decay × 1.5 + 0.2)` seconds.
returns.zh: 一個還沒登記的樂器定義：交給 [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument)。`tail` 設成 `min(8, 最長的衰減 × 1.5 + 0.2)` 秒。

caption.en: Two partials and a mallet make a steel-bar instrument that validates and registers. It is only built, and heard, once the sound engine plays it.
caption.zh: 兩個泛音加一個槌子，就做出一個鋼片樂器，驗證通過也能登記。要等發聲引擎真的播它的時候，它才會被建出來、被聽見。

entries.name: mountSoundPicker
entries.signature: mountSoundPicker(container, sound, { lang = (globalThis.document?.documentElement?.lang || 'en').toLowerCase().startsWith('zh') ? 'zh' : 'en', className = 'oav-sound-pick', label = null, enableOnPick = true, } = {})

summary.en: Puts an instrument menu on the page: one group per category, a loading bar for samplers and the credit line an instrument asks for.
summary.zh: 在頁面上放一個樂器選單：每個類別一組，取樣樂器有載入進度條，也會顯示樂器要求的出處說明。

description.en: A native `<select>` with one `<optgroup>` per category ([`CATEGORIES`](#CATEGORIES)), so it works with a keyboard and on a phone and needs no styling to be usable. It lists whatever is registered, and it refreshes itself when an instrument is registered or removed ([`onInstrumentsChange()`](#onInstrumentsChange)). Choosing one calls `sound.setInstrument(id, { remember: true })`. While a sampler loads it shows a bar and a percentage; if the load fails it says so, and says which instrument plays instead. A credit line appears under the menu for an instrument that has one: the Salamander piano is CC-BY, and its credit is always shown.
description.zh: 這是原生的 `<select>`，每個類別（[`CATEGORIES`](#CATEGORIES)）一個 `<optgroup>`，所以用鍵盤、在手機上都能用，不用做任何樣式就能用。它列出所有已登記的樂器，而且在有樂器被登記或移除時自動更新（[`onInstrumentsChange()`](#onInstrumentsChange)）。選了一個就呼叫 `sound.setInstrument(id, { remember: true })`。取樣樂器載入的時候顯示進度條和百分比。載入失敗會說出來，並說明改播哪個樂器。有出處說明的樂器，選單底下會出現一行：Salamander 鋼琴是 CC-BY，它的出處說明一定會顯示。

params.name: container
params.en: The element to put the picker in.
params.zh: 要放選單的元素。

params.name: sound
params.en: The [`Sound`](#Sound) to control. The menu follows its instrument and its loading.
params.zh: 要控制的 [`Sound`](#Sound)。選單會跟著它的樂器和載入狀態走。

params.name: lang
params.en: The language of the labels and instrument names. The default is `'zh'` when the page's `<html lang>` starts with `zh`, else `'en'`.
params.zh: 標籤和樂器名稱的語言。預設是頁面的 `<html lang>` 以 `zh` 開頭就用 `'zh'`，否則用 `'en'`。

params.name: className
params.en: The class of the picker. The parts get `-row`, `-label`, `-status`, `-meter` and `-credit` added to it, for your own styling. The picker brings no CSS.
params.zh: 選單的 class。各個部分會在它後面加上 `-row`、`-label`、`-status`、`-meter`、`-credit`，讓你自己寫樣式。選單本身不帶 CSS。

params.name: label
params.en: The label in front of the menu. Left out, it is the word "instrument" (in Chinese when `lang` is `'zh'`).
params.zh: 選單前面的標籤。沒給的話，依語言是 "instrument" 或「樂器」。

params.name: enableOnPick
params.en: Choosing an instrument also calls `sound.enable()` if the sound is off. A choice is a click, which is the gesture a browser wants before it plays audio.
params.zh: 選了樂器之後，如果聲音還沒開，就順便呼叫 `sound.enable()`。選擇本身就是一次點擊，正是瀏覽器要的那個動作。

returns.en: `{ el, select, refresh(), dispose() }`: the element it made, its `<select>`, a function that rebuilds the list, and a function that takes it away.
returns.zh: `{ el, select, refresh(), dispose() }`：它做出來的元素、裡面的 `<select>`、重建清單的函式，和把它拆掉的函式。

caption.en: A menu of the 22 built-in instruments, in groups, appears on the page. Registering one more adds it to the menu at once.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現一個選單，22 個內建樂器分組列在裡面。再登記一個，它馬上就加進選單。

summary.en: Calls your function whenever an instrument is registered or removed, so a menu can refresh. Returns a function that stops listening.
summary.zh: 每當有樂器被登記或移除，就呼叫你的函式，讓選單可以更新。回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

description.en: [`mountSoundPicker()`](#mountSoundPicker) listens this way, which is why an instrument registered after the picker was built still shows up. A replacement with `{ replace: true }` also reports `register`. A call to `unregisterInstrument()` for an id that is not there reports nothing.
description.zh: [`mountSoundPicker()`](#mountSoundPicker) 就是這樣在聽，所以選單蓋好之後才登記的樂器也會出現。用 `{ replace: true }` 取代也會通報 `register`。對不存在的 id 呼叫 `unregisterInstrument()` 不會通報。

params.name: cb
params.en: `cb({ type, id })` with `type` `'register'` or `'unregister'`. An error inside it is logged and does not stop the others.
params.zh: `cb({ type, id })`，`type` 是 `'register'` 或 `'unregister'`。裡面出錯只會被記在 console，不會影響其他監聽者。

returns.en: Call it to stop listening.
returns.zh: 呼叫它就停止監聽。

caption.en: Records two changes while listening, then stops listening and shows that the next two are not reported.
caption.zh: 聽的時候記下兩次變化，然後停止監聽，顯示接下來的兩次不會被通報。

summary.en: Adds a sound to every picker on the page: an id, a name, a category and one create() function that builds the instrument.
summary.zh: 把一個聲音加到頁面上每個選單：一個 id、一個名字、一個類別，和一個建立樂器的 create() 函式。

description.en: A sound you can pick is plain data plus one factory. Registering it is all it takes: import the file before you start, and every [`mountSoundPicker()`](#mountSoundPicker) on the page lists it under its category, with no change to the package. The registry lives on `globalThis`, so two copies of this module on one page share one list. Built-in instruments only fill empty slots: register your own `'piano'` first and you keep it. The definition:
description.zh: 能選的聲音就是一份資料加一個工廠函式。登記它就夠了：在開始之前匯入那個檔案，頁面上每個 [`mountSoundPicker()`](#mountSoundPicker) 就會把它列在它的類別底下，不用改套件。登記表放在 `globalThis` 上，所以同一個頁面上有兩份這個模組也共用同一份清單。內建的樂器只會填空位：先登記你自己的 `'piano'`，就會保留你的。定義如下：

description.en:
```text
id          lowercase letters, digits and "-", at most one "/": 'kalimba', 'me/kalimba'
name        a string, or { en, zh }
category    keys · mallets · strings · plucked · organ · voice · synth · drums · other, or your own
create      create(Tone, ctx) → { noteOn(note, vel01, time), noteOff(note, time), set?(key, v),
                                  releaseAll?(time), ready?: Promise, dispose() }
params      your own knobs [{ key, label, min, max, def }], shown as sound/<key> while it plays
defaults    starting values for the shared params: { cutoff, space, volume }
credit      a string, or { text, url }, shown in the picker
gain        level in dB      transpose   semitones      tail   seconds the old one may ring after a switch
fallback    the id of an instrument to play if `ready` rejects
```
description.zh:
```text
id          小寫字母、數字和 "-"，最多一個 "/"：'kalimba'、'me/kalimba'
name        一個字串，或 { en, zh }
category    keys · mallets · strings · plucked · organ · voice · synth · drums · other，或你自己的
create      create(Tone, ctx) → { noteOn(note, vel01, time), noteOff(note, time), set?(key, v),
                                  releaseAll?(time), ready?: Promise, dispose() }
params      你自己的旋鈕 [{ key, label, min, max, def }]，播放時顯示成 sound/<key>
defaults    共用參數的起始值：{ cutoff, space, volume }
credit      一個字串，或 { text, url }，顯示在選單裡
gain        音量，單位 dB      transpose   半音數      tail   換樂器之後舊的可以再響幾秒
fallback    如果 `ready` 失敗，要改播的樂器 id
```

description.en: `create(Tone, ctx)` runs on enable and on every switch to the instrument, with Tone.js already loaded. `ctx` is `{ output, rawOutput, rawContext, baseUrl, options, onProgress }`: connect Tone nodes to `output` (raw Web Audio nodes to `rawOutput`), `baseUrl` is where sample folders live, `options` is what was passed in `toneEngine({ instruments: { <id>: … } })`, and `onProgress(0..1)` shows a loading bar. If `ready` is a promise, the picker shows progress and the old sound keeps playing until it resolves. An instrument that makes mallet sounds from data can use [`modalInstrument()`](#modalInstrument), and one that is a Tone synth with settings, [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset).
description.zh: `create(Tone, ctx)` 在啟用的時候、以及每次切換到這個樂器的時候執行，那時 Tone.js 已經載入。`ctx` 是 `{ output, rawOutput, rawContext, baseUrl, options, onProgress }`：把 Tone 的節點接到 `output`（原生 Web Audio 節點接到 `rawOutput`），`baseUrl` 是取樣資料夾的位置，`options` 是 `toneEngine({ instruments: { <id>: … } })` 傳進來的東西，`onProgress(0..1)` 用來顯示載入進度。如果 `ready` 是 promise，選單會顯示進度，而且在它 resolve 之前舊的聲音繼續播。從資料做敲擊聲的樂器可以用 [`modalInstrument()`](#modalInstrument)，是有設定的 Tone 合成器就用 [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset)。

params.name: def
params.en: The instrument definition, see the table below.
params.zh: 樂器的定義，見下面的表。

params.name: replace
params.en: In the options `{ replace }`: allow replacing an instrument that has the same id. Without it a duplicate id throws.
params.zh: 在選項 `{ replace }` 裡：允許取代同樣 id 的樂器。沒有它的話，重複的 id 會丟出錯誤。

returns.en: The definition you gave. It throws a `TypeError` listing everything wrong if the definition is not valid (see [`validateInstrument()`](#validateInstrument)), and an `Error` for a duplicate id.
returns.zh: 你給的那個定義。定義不合格的話會丟出 `TypeError`，列出所有的問題（見 [`validateInstrument()`](#validateInstrument))，id 重複則丟出 `Error`。

caption.en: Registers an instrument, finds it in its category, is refused when it registers the same id twice, and swaps it on purpose with `replace`.
caption.zh: 登記一個樂器、在它的類別裡找到它、重複登記同一個 id 會被拒絕，再用 `replace` 刻意換掉。

caption.en: A whole instrument in one file: an FM synth with a knob of its own. Import it before the sound starts, and "Kalimba" appears under Mallets in every picker.
caption.zh: 一個完整的樂器放在一個檔案裡：一個有自己旋鈕的 FM 合成器。在聲音開始之前匯入它，每個選單的「敲擊琴」底下就會出現 Kalimba。

summary.en: Adds a synth preset to every picker as synth/ plus its id: describe the voice, the envelope and the effects as data.
summary.zh: 把一個合成器預設加到每個選單，名稱是 synth/ 加上它的 id：把聲部、包絡和效果寫成資料就好。

description.en: A preset names a `voice`, its settings in Tone.js's vocabulary, and an optional effects chain, and nothing else. `id` is lowercase letters, digits and `-` (it becomes `synth/<id>`), `name` is a string or `{ en, zh }`. `voice` is `'synth'` (oscillator and envelope), `'mono'` (adds a resonant filter with its own envelope), `'fm'` or `'am'`. The Tone settings are `oscillator`, `envelope`, `filter`, `filterEnvelope`, `harmonicity`, `modulationIndex`, `modulation`, `modulationEnvelope`, `detune` and `portamento`. The rest: `octave` (a whole number of octaves, `-1` for a bass), `gain` (dB, to level it against the others), `polyphony`, `defaults` (starting `cutoff`, `space`, `volume`), `params`, `category` and `credit`, as in [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument).
description.zh: 一個預設只有這些：一個 `voice`、用 Tone.js 的詞彙寫的設定，和選用的效果鏈。`id` 是小寫字母、數字和 `-`（會變成 `synth/<id>`），`name` 是字串或 `{ en, zh }`。`voice` 是 `'synth'`（振盪器加包絡）、`'mono'`（多一個有自己包絡的共振濾波器）、`'fm'` 或 `'am'`。Tone 的設定有 `oscillator`、`envelope`、`filter`、`filterEnvelope`、`harmonicity`、`modulationIndex`、`modulation`、`modulationEnvelope`、`detune`、`portamento`。其他的：`octave`（整數個八度，貝斯用 `-1`）、`gain`（dB，用來跟別的樂器配音量）、`polyphony`、`defaults`（起始的 `cutoff`、`space`、`volume`）、`params`、`category`、`credit`，跟 [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument) 一樣。

description.en: `effects` is a list of `{ type, …settings }` that the sound passes through in order. The types are `chorus`, `delay`, `pingpong`, `distortion`, `vibrato`, `tremolo`, `phaser`, `autofilter`, `filter`, `eq`, `compressor`, `chebyshev` and `widener`; the other keys are the effect's own Tone settings, including `wet`. A preset that is wrong throws a `TypeError` with the reasons.
description.zh: `effects` 是一串 `{ type, …設定 }`，聲音依序通過它們。種類有 `chorus`、`delay`、`pingpong`、`distortion`、`vibrato`、`tremolo`、`phaser`、`autofilter`、`filter`、`eq`、`compressor`、`chebyshev`、`widener`。其他的鍵是那個效果自己的 Tone 設定，包括 `wet`。不合格的預設會丟出 `TypeError` 並說明原因。

params.name: preset
params.en: The preset: `{ id, name, voice, … }`, see below.
params.zh: 預設：`{ id, name, voice, … }`，見下面。

params.name: opts
params.en: The options of [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument): `{ replace: true }` swaps an existing one.
params.zh: [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument) 的選項：`{ replace: true }` 會換掉現有的。

returns.en: The instrument definition that was registered ([`synthInstrument()`](#synthInstrument) of the preset).
returns.zh: 被登記的那個樂器定義（這個預設的 [`synthInstrument()`](#synthInstrument)）。

caption.en: Registers an FM bell-like sound as plain data. It appears under Synth in the picker as "Glass".
caption.zh: 把一個像 FM 鐘的聲音當作單純的資料登記。它會以「Glass」出現在選單的 Synth 組裡。

summary.en: The 30 notes the Salamander piano has samples for: every minor third from A0 (MIDI 21) to C8 (108).
summary.zh: Salamander 鋼琴有取樣的 30 個音：從 A0（MIDI 21）到 C8（108），每隔一個小三度一個。

description.en: The sampler shifts the pitch of the notes in between by at most a semitone and a half, which is inaudible on a piano. There is only one velocity layer, so loud against soft is a gain curve, not a different hammer.
description.zh: 取樣器把中間的音升降最多一個半音半，在鋼琴上聽不出來。只有一個力度層，所以大聲和小聲是音量曲線，不是不同的琴槌。

value.en: `[21, 24, 27, …, 108]`: 30 MIDI note numbers, three semitones apart (the A, C, D♯ and F♯ of every octave).
value.zh: `[21, 24, 27, …, 108]`：30 個 MIDI 音符號碼，彼此相隔三個半音（每個八度的 A、C、D♯、F♯）。

caption.en: The count, the lowest and highest notes, and the first four.
caption.zh: 數量、最低和最高的音，以及最前面四個。

summary.en: Builds the sample map of the Salamander piano for Tone.Sampler: { 'A0': 'A0.mp3', 'D#1': 'Ds1.mp3', … }.
summary.zh: 做出 Salamander 鋼琴給 Tone.Sampler 用的取樣對照表：{ 'A0': 'A0.mp3', 'D#1': 'Ds1.mp3', … }。

description.en: The piano instrument uses it to fetch its files from `baseUrl + 'salamander/'`. Use it if you want to load the same files into a sampler of your own.
description.zh: 鋼琴樂器用它從 `baseUrl + 'salamander/'` 抓檔案。想把同樣的檔案載入你自己的取樣器時可以用它。

params.name: notes
params.en: Which MIDI notes to include. The default is [`SALAMANDER_NOTES`](#SALAMANDER_NOTES), all 30.
params.zh: 要包含哪些 MIDI 音符。預設是 [`SALAMANDER_NOTES`](#SALAMANDER_NOTES)，全部 30 個。

returns.en: An object from Tone note names to file names. The files spell a sharp as "s": `D#1` is `Ds1.mp3`.
returns.zh: 一個物件，從 Tone 的音名對應到檔名。檔名把升記號寫成 "s"：`D#1` 是 `Ds1.mp3`。

caption.en: The full map has 30 files; a map of two notes; and the full address of one sample.
caption.zh: 完整的對照表有 30 個檔案。只有兩個音的對照表。以及一個取樣的完整位址。

summary.en: The address of the folder with the built-in sample sets, when nobody says otherwise: openaudiovisual.com/packages/sound/samples/.
summary.zh: 沒有人指定時，內建取樣組所在資料夾的位址：openaudiovisual.com/packages/sound/samples/。

description.en: It is the default `baseUrl` of [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine). The piano reads its 30 mp3 files from the `salamander/` folder under it. The server sends CORS headers, so any page can load them. `createShow()` points the engine at the copy next to the page instead. To use your own copy, give `baseUrl`, or `instruments: { piano: { baseUrl } }` for the piano alone.
description.zh: 它是 [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) 的 `baseUrl` 預設值。鋼琴從它底下的 `salamander/` 資料夾讀 30 個 mp3 檔。伺服器有送 CORS 標頭，所以任何頁面都能載入。`createShow()` 會改指向頁面旁邊的那一份。要用自己的備份，就給 `baseUrl`，只想換鋼琴的話給 `instruments: { piano: { baseUrl } }`。

value.en: `'https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/sound/samples/'`, ending in a slash.
value.zh: `'https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/sound/samples/'`，以斜線結尾。

caption.en: Logs the default folder and shows how to point the engine at your own.
caption.zh: 印出預設資料夾，並示範怎麼讓引擎指向你自己的。

entries.name: Sound
entries.signature: new Sound({ signals, params = null, engine, instrument = null, remember = true, picker = true })

summary.en: Makes every midi/note/on and midi/note/off on a bus audible through a sound engine, and puts the engine's params on the bus as sound/*.
summary.zh: 讓匯流排上每個 midi/note/on 和 midi/note/off 都透過發聲引擎聽得見，並把引擎的參數放到匯流排上，名稱是 sound/*。

description.en: `Sound` is the shell that wires an engine into an app. Once `await sound.enable()` has run, every `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off` on the bus is played, whatever sent it: a MIDI keyboard, the on-screen piano ([`mountKeys()`](#mountKeys)), a [`SimPlayer`](#SimPlayer), a [`TakePlayer`](#TakePlayer) or a phone. Notes on a channel in the engine's `skipChannels` are left out (the Tone engine skips channel 10, which belongs to the drum machine).
description.zh: `Sound` 是把引擎接進應用程式的外殼。`await sound.enable()` 之後，匯流排上每個 `midi/note/on` 和 `midi/note/off` 都會被播出來，不管是誰送的：MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕鋼琴（[`mountKeys()`](#mountKeys)）、[`SimPlayer`](#SimPlayer)、[`TakePlayer`](#TakePlayer) 或手機。在引擎的 `skipChannels` 裡的頻道的音符不會播（Tone 引擎略過頻道 10，那是鼓機的）。

description.en: The engine's params become `sound/*` params, so a knob, the timeline or a hand can play the filter the same way it plays the visuals: sound is performable state, not a side effect. Every frame, call `sound.update(state)` with the resolved param values, and the `sound/*` ones are pushed into the engine. The instrument is a discrete choice (`setInstrument()` or the picker); what you perform continuously stays a param.
description.zh: 引擎的參數會變成 `sound/*` 參數，所以旋鈕、時間軸或一隻手可以像操作畫面那樣操作濾波器：聲音是可以演奏的狀態，不是附帶的效果。每個畫面用解析好的參數值呼叫 `sound.update(state)`，其中 `sound/*` 的就會被送進引擎。樂器是離散的選擇（`setInstrument()` 或選單），要連續演奏的東西則維持是參數。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) bus. `Sound` listens to `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch }`, `midi/note/off` `{ note, ch }` and `midi/cc/64` (the sustain pedal, down at 0.5 or more), and pulses `sound/instrument` `{ id, name }` when the instrument changes.
params.zh: [`Signals`](#Signals) 匯流排。`Sound` 聽 `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch }`、`midi/note/off` `{ note, ch }` 和 `midi/cc/64`（延音踏板，0.5 以上算踩下），並在樂器改變時發出 `sound/instrument` `{ id, name }` 脈衝。

params.name: params
params.en: A `Params` registry to add the engine's params to, named `sound/<key>` (`sound/cutoff`, `sound/space`, `sound/volume` and the instrument's own). Left out, no params are registered.
params.zh: 要把引擎的參數加進去的 `Params`，名稱是 `sound/<key>`（`sound/cutoff`、`sound/space`、`sound/volume`，和樂器自己的）。沒給的話，不註冊任何參數。

params.name: engine
params.en: The sound engine, such as [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) or [`drumEngine()`](#drumEngine). The contract is `{ params, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01), noteOff(note), set(key, value), dispose() }`, and optionally `setInstrument`, `instrument`, `status`, `subscribe`, `sustain(down)` and `skipChannels`.
params.zh: 發聲引擎，例如 [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) 或 [`drumEngine()`](#drumEngine)。約定是 `{ params, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01), noteOff(note), set(key, value), dispose() }`，選用的有 `setInstrument`、`instrument`、`status`、`subscribe`、`sustain(down)`、`skipChannels`。

params.name: instrument
params.en: The instrument to start with, for an engine that has instruments (`'piano'`, `'synth/pluck'`). An unknown id is warned about in the console and ignored.
params.zh: 一開始用哪個樂器，給有樂器的引擎用（`'piano'`、`'synth/pluck'`）。不認識的 id 會在 console 警告，並被忽略。

params.name: remember
params.en: Keep the instrument the picker last chose, per page, in `localStorage`, and let it win over `instrument` the next time. A string is your own storage key; the default key is `openav:sound:<page path>`. `false` turns it off. Choices made from code are not remembered unless you ask (`setInstrument(id, { remember: true })`).
params.zh: 把選單最後選的樂器依頁面記在 `localStorage`，下一次它會贏過 `instrument`。給字串就是你自己的儲存鍵。預設的鍵是 `openav:sound:<頁面路徑>`。`false` 是關掉。用程式做的選擇不會被記住，除非你要求（`setInstrument(id, { remember: true })`）。

params.name: picker
params.en: Whether a console should show the instrument picker. It is stored as `sound.picker` for whoever builds the interface; `Sound` itself draws nothing.
params.zh: 控台要不要顯示樂器選單。它被存成 `sound.picker`，給建介面的人讀。`Sound` 自己不畫任何東西。

needs.en: `sound.enable()` from a click: browsers start audio only after a user gesture. With [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) it also loads Tone.js from the network (jsDelivr) the first time. Before `enable()` nothing is heard, and the bus is not listened to.
needs.zh: 要在點擊裡呼叫 `sound.enable()`：瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作才讓聲音開始。用 [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) 的話，第一次還會從網路（jsDelivr）載入 Tone.js。`enable()` 之前什麼都聽不到，匯流排也沒有被聽。

notes.en: From a p5 sketch you do not build this: [`startSound()`](#startSound) does it, loading this package only when it is called.
notes.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己建這個：[`startSound()`](#startSound) 會做，而且只在被呼叫的時候才載入這個套件。

caption.en: A bus with a stand-in engine: notes on the bus reach the engine, and of the state only `sound/cutoff` does. The engine has no instruments, so `choosable` is false.
caption.zh: 一個匯流排加一個替身引擎：匯流排上的音符傳到引擎，state 裡只有 `sound/cutoff` 會傳到。這個引擎沒有樂器，所以 `choosable` 是 false。

caption.en: Click anywhere to start the sound, then click the piano keys: you hear the Salamander grand piano. Pick another instrument from the menu while you play.
caption.zh: 在任何地方點一下開始發聲，然後點鋼琴的琴鍵：你會聽到 Salamander 平台鋼琴。彈的時候可以從選單換別的樂器。

tbd.en: The Tone.js engine was not run for this page: there was no network and no speakers. What is written here comes from the code and from the package tests, which use a stand-in for Tone.js, and the examples that run use a stand-in engine.
tbd.zh: 這一頁沒有實際跑過 Tone.js 引擎：這裡沒有網路也沒有喇叭。寫在這裡的內容來自程式碼，和套件的測試（測試用一個替身代替 Tone.js），能跑的範例用的是替身引擎。

members.name: enable
members.doc: Start the engine (must be called from a user gesture — browser audio policy).

members.name: update
members.doc: Per frame: push resolved sound/* params into the engine.

members.name: instrument
members.doc: Current instrument id (null for engines without instruments, e.g.

members.name: status
members.doc: { id, state: 'idle'|'loading'|'ready'|'error', progress 0..1, error }

members.name: choosable
members.doc: Whether this engine has instruments to choose from.

members.name: setInstrument
members.doc: Switch instruments, live.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Listen to { type: 'instrument' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error' | 'enabled', id, progress, error }.

summary.en: The three params every instrument shares: cutoff (the filter), space (the reverb) and volume.
summary.zh: 每個樂器共用的三個參數：cutoff（濾波器）、space（殘響）和 volume（音量）。

description.en: `cutoff` is the low-pass filter's frequency in Hz, `space` is how much reverb is mixed in (the wet amount, 0..1), `volume` is the level in dB. They sit after the instrument on the output chain, so the timeline, a knob or a hand keep performing them across instrument switches. In a show they are the params `sound/cutoff`, `sound/space` and `sound/volume`. An instrument may suggest other starting values through its `defaults`, and automation and overrides always win over a suggestion. An instrument's own `params` cannot use these keys.
description.zh: `cutoff` 是低通濾波器的頻率，單位是 Hz，`space` 是混進去多少殘響（濕度，0..1），`volume` 是音量，單位是 dB。它們在輸出鏈上排在樂器之後，所以換樂器的時候，時間軸、旋鈕或一隻手可以繼續演奏它們。在演出裡它們是參數 `sound/cutoff`、`sound/space`、`sound/volume`。樂器可以用它的 `defaults` 建議不同的起始值，自動化和覆寫永遠贏過建議。樂器自己的 `params` 不能用這幾個鍵。

value.en: `[{ key: 'cutoff', min: 100, max: 8000, def: 2500 }, { key: 'space', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.3 }, { key: 'volume', min: -36, max: 0, def: -8 }]`, each also with a `label`.
value.zh: `[{ key: 'cutoff', min: 100, max: 8000, def: 2500 }, { key: 'space', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.3 }, { key: 'volume', min: -36, max: 0, def: -8 }]`，每個還有一個 `label`。

caption.en: Logs the range and the default of each shared param.
caption.zh: 印出每個共用參數的範圍和預設值。

summary.en: Reads the modules.sound option of createShow() (true, an instrument id, or an object) into one normalized object.
summary.zh: 把 createShow() 的 modules.sound 選項（true、樂器 id 或物件）讀成一個整理好的物件。

description.en: It is how `createShow({ modules: { sound: … } })` understands its option, so `sound: true`, `sound: 'piano'` and `sound: { instrument: 'organ', remember: false, picker: false }` all work. You only need it if you write something that takes the same option.
description.zh: `createShow({ modules: { sound: … } })` 就是靠它理解選項，所以 `sound: true`、`sound: 'piano'` 和 `sound: { instrument: 'organ', remember: false, picker: false }` 都行。只有你要寫收同樣選項的東西時才需要它。

params.name: value
params.en: `true` for the defaults, an instrument id (`'piano'`), or `{ instrument, remember, picker, engine, …toneEngine options }`. Anything falsy gives `null`.
params.zh: `true` 是預設，樂器 id（`'piano'`），或 `{ instrument, remember, picker, engine, …toneEngine 的選項 }`。任何假值會得到 `null`。

returns.en: `{ engine, instrument, remember, picker, engineOptions }` (`engine` and `instrument` are `null` when not given, `remember` and `picker` are `true`), or `null` for a falsy value. `engineOptions` holds the rest of an object: `baseUrl`, `cdn`, `instruments`…. An `instrument` that is not a string, or a value of another kind, throws a `TypeError`.
returns.zh: `{ engine, instrument, remember, picker, engineOptions }`（沒給的 `engine` 和 `instrument` 是 `null`，`remember` 和 `picker` 是 `true`），假值則是 `null`。`engineOptions` 放物件裡其餘的東西：`baseUrl`、`cdn`、`instruments`…。`instrument` 不是字串，或給了別種值，會丟出 `TypeError`。

caption.en: The three accepted shapes, a falsy value that turns the sound off, and the error for something that is none of them.
caption.zh: 三種接受的形式、關掉聲音的假值，以及什麼都不是的東西會得到的錯誤。

summary.en: The 11 synth presets as plain data: pad, saw lead, square lead, pluck, supersaw, bass, acid, brass, bell, sub and chip.
summary.zh: 11 個合成器預設，是單純的資料：pad、saw lead、square lead、pluck、supersaw、bass、acid、brass、bell、sub、chip。

description.en: Each preset is what [`synthInstrument()`](#synthInstrument) turns into an instrument `synth/<id>`. They are data in Tone.js's own vocabulary (`oscillator`, `envelope`, `filter`, `filterEnvelope`, `harmonicity`…), a good place to look when you write a preset of your own for [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset). The `pad` is the framework's original voice: three detuned sawtooth waves with a quick attack and a long release.
description.zh: 每個預設都會被 [`synthInstrument()`](#synthInstrument) 變成一個樂器 `synth/<id>`。它們是用 Tone.js 自己的詞彙寫的資料（`oscillator`、`envelope`、`filter`、`filterEnvelope`、`harmonicity`…），要為 [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset) 寫自己的預設時，是個好的參考。`pad` 是框架最早的聲音：三個失諧的鋸齒波，起音快、釋放長。

value.en: An array of 11 presets `{ id, name: { en, zh }, voice, … }`: `pad`, `saw-lead`, `square-lead`, `pluck`, `supersaw`, `bass`, `acid`, `brass`, `bell`, `sub`, `chip`.
value.zh: 一個有 11 個預設的陣列 `{ id, name: { en, zh }, voice, … }`：`pad`、`saw-lead`、`square-lead`、`pluck`、`supersaw`、`bass`、`acid`、`brass`、`bell`、`sub`、`chip`。

caption.en: Lists the preset ids and reads a few settings of the bass: a mono synth with a filter, an octave down.
caption.zh: 列出預設的 id，並讀貝斯的幾個設定：有濾波器的單音合成器，降一個八度。

summary.en: Turns a synth preset into an instrument definition whose id is synth/ followed by the preset id, without registering it.
summary.zh: 把一個合成器預設變成樂器定義，id 是 synth/ 加上預設的 id，但不登記它。

description.en: The definition's `create()` builds one `Tone.PolySynth` of the preset's `voice` (`synth`, `mono`, `fm` or `am`), with the Tone settings the preset carries, a chain of its `effects`, and its `polyphony` (16 voices if left out). Use it when you want the definition for yourself (to adjust it before registering); otherwise [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset) does both steps.
