description.zh: 這個定義的 `create()` 會建一個 `Tone.PolySynth`，聲部是預設的 `voice`（`synth`、`mono`、`fm` 或 `am`），帶著預設的 Tone 設定、一串 `effects` 效果，以及它的 `polyphony`（沒給就是 16 個聲部）。想自己拿到這個定義（登記前先調整）時才用它。否則 [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset) 兩步一起做完。

params.name: preset
params.en: The preset, see [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset). A preset that [`validateSynthPreset()`](#validateSynthPreset) refuses throws a `TypeError`.
params.zh: 預設，見 [`registerSynthPreset()`](#registerSynthPreset)。[`validateSynthPreset()`](#validateSynthPreset) 不接受的預設會丟出 `TypeError`。

returns.en: An instrument definition: `id` is `'synth/' + preset.id`, `name` the preset's (or its id), `category` the preset's or `'synth'`, `transpose` is `octave × 12`, `gain`, `defaults`, `params` and `credit` come from the preset, `tail` is `min(8, release × 1.5 + 0.5)` seconds and `preset` is the preset itself.
returns.zh: 一個樂器定義：`id` 是 `'synth/' + preset.id`，`name` 用預設的（沒有就用它的 id），`category` 用預設的或 `'synth'`，`transpose` 是 `octave × 12`，`gain`、`defaults`、`params`、`credit` 來自預設，`tail` 是 `min(8, release × 1.5 + 0.5)` 秒，`preset` 是預設本身。

caption.en: A preset becomes a valid instrument definition: an octave down is 12 semitones, and the tail follows the release. A bad id throws.
caption.zh: 一個預設變成合格的樂器定義：降一個八度是 12 個半音，尾巴長度跟著釋放時間走。壞的 id 會丟出錯誤。

summary.en: The address Tone.js is loaded from when the engine is enabled: Tone 15.0.4 on jsDelivr.
summary.zh: 引擎啟用時載入 Tone.js 的位址：jsDelivr 上的 Tone 15.0.4。

description.en: A module URL that `toneEngine()` imports on `enable()`. To host Tone.js yourself, pass your own as the `cdn` option of [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine).
description.zh: `toneEngine()` 在 `enable()` 時匯入的模組網址。想自己放 Tone.js 的話，把你的網址當作 [`toneEngine()`](#toneEngine) 的 `cdn` 選項。

value.en: `'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm'`.
value.zh: 字串 `'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm'`。

caption.en: Logs the default address and shows where an own copy would be given.
caption.zh: 印出預設位址，並示範自己的備份要寫在哪裡。

entries.name: toneEngine
entries.signature: toneEngine({ cdn = TONE_CDN, instrument = DEFAULT_INSTRUMENT, baseUrl = SAMPLES_URL, instruments: perInstrument = {}, drumChannel = 10, } = {})

summary.en: The sound engine that plays the registered instruments with Tone.js through a filter, a reverb and a limiter.
summary.zh: 發聲引擎，用 Tone.js 播放登記好的樂器，聲音依序經過濾波器、殘響和限幅器。

description.en: Tone.js stays a neighbour, not a dependency: it is loaded from the network the first time `enable()` runs, so an app that never turns the sound on pays nothing. After `enable()` the instrument's output goes through a low-pass filter (`cutoff`, starting at 2500 Hz), a reverb (`space`, the wet amount, starting at 0.3), a volume (`volume`, in dB, starting at -8) and a limiter at -1 dB, so a loud organ never clips the room. These three are the [`SOUND_PARAMS`](#SOUND_PARAMS) shared by every instrument. Their starting values can follow the instrument (a piano wants the filter open), and the instrument may add params of its own.
description.zh: Tone.js 只是鄰居，不是相依套件：第一次 `enable()` 的時候才從網路載入，所以從不開聲音的應用程式什麼代價都不用付。`enable()` 之後，樂器的輸出會經過低通濾波器（`cutoff`，起始 2500 Hz）、殘響（`space`，濕度，起始 0.3）、音量（`volume`，單位 dB，起始 -8）和 -1 dB 的限幅器，所以很大聲的風琴也不會把房間削波。這三個就是每個樂器共用的 [`SOUND_PARAMS`](#SOUND_PARAMS)。它們的起始值可以跟著樂器走（鋼琴想要濾波器全開），樂器也可以再加自己的參數。

description.en: `setInstrument(id)` switches live and returns a promise of whether it worked. Before `enable()` it only remembers the choice. Held notes are released on the old instrument and its tail is left to ring for a few seconds. A sampler (the piano) keeps the old sound until its files are in; if they cannot load, the engine plays the instrument's `fallback` (the piano falls back to the electric piano), so a performance never goes silent because of one failed download. `subscribe(cb)` tells you about `instrument`, `loading`, `ready` and `error` events. `sustain(down)` is the pedal: note-offs wait until it comes up. `releaseAll()` is a panic button.
description.zh: `setInstrument(id)` 現場換樂器，回傳換成功與否的 promise。在 `enable()` 之前它只是記住這個選擇。舊樂器按著的音會被放開，它的尾巴讓它再響幾秒。取樣樂器（鋼琴）在檔案進來之前會繼續用舊的聲音。如果載入失敗，引擎會播這個樂器的 `fallback`（鋼琴退回電鋼琴），所以演出不會因為一次下載失敗就沒聲音。`subscribe(cb)` 會告訴你 `instrument`、`loading`、`ready`、`error` 事件。`sustain(down)` 是踏板：放開音的動作要等到踏板抬起來才做。`releaseAll()` 是緊急停止鈕。

description.en: You usually pass the engine to a [`Sound`](#Sound), which is what listens to the bus. Used on its own, `noteOn(60, 0.8)` plays a note.
description.zh: 通常你會把引擎交給 [`Sound`](#Sound)，由它去聽匯流排。單獨使用的話，`noteOn(60, 0.8)` 就是彈一個音。

params.name: cdn
params.en: Where Tone.js is imported from when the engine is enabled. The default is [`TONE_CDN`](#TONE_CDN). A module URL, so you can host your own copy.
params.zh: 引擎啟用時從哪裡匯入 Tone.js。預設是 [`TONE_CDN`](#TONE_CDN)。是一個模組網址，所以你可以放自己的備份。

params.name: instrument
params.en: The instrument to start with. An unknown id is warned about and `synth/pad` is used.
params.zh: 一開始用的樂器。不認識的 id 會警告，改用 `synth/pad`。

params.name: baseUrl
params.en: The folder that holds the built-in sample sets (`salamander/…`). The default is [`SAMPLES_URL`](#SAMPLES_URL).
params.zh: 放內建取樣組（`salamander/…`）的資料夾。預設是 [`SAMPLES_URL`](#SAMPLES_URL)。

params.name: instruments
params.en: Options for single instruments, handed to their `create()` as `ctx.options`: `{ piano: { baseUrl: '/my/salamander/' } }`.
params.zh: 給單一樂器的選項，會當作 `ctx.options` 交給它的 `create()`：`{ piano: { baseUrl: '/my/salamander/' } }`。

params.name: drumChannel
params.en: Notes on this MIDI channel belong to a drum engine (the drum machine sends General MIDI channel 10) and are not played here. `null` plays everything.
params.zh: 這個 MIDI 頻道的音符屬於鼓的引擎（鼓機送的是 General MIDI 的頻道 10），這裡不播。`null` 是全部都播。

returns.en: An engine: `{ params, sharedParams, instrument, status, skipChannels, hasInstrument(id), subscribe(cb), setInstrument(id), enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), noteOff(note, time), sustain(down), releaseAll(), set(key, value), dispose() }`.
returns.zh: 一個引擎：`{ params, sharedParams, instrument, status, skipChannels, hasInstrument(id), subscribe(cb), setInstrument(id), enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), noteOff(note, time), sustain(down), releaseAll(), set(key, value), dispose() }`。

needs.en: `await engine.enable()` from a click: it loads Tone.js from the network, then starts its audio. Before that, `noteOn()` does nothing and `setInstrument()` only remembers the choice.
needs.zh: 要在點擊裡 `await engine.enable()`：它從網路載入 Tone.js，然後啟動音訊。在那之前 `noteOn()` 什麼都不做，`setInstrument()` 只是記住選擇。

caption.en: Looks at an engine before it is enabled: its instrument, the params it will offer (the strings suggest a different starting cutoff and space, and add two of their own), and that channel 10 is left to the drums.
caption.zh: 在引擎啟用之前看它：它的樂器、它會提供的參數（弦樂建議了不同的起始 cutoff 和 space，還多加了兩個自己的），以及頻道 10 是留給鼓的。

caption.en: Click the page: an electric piano plays a C major chord, with more reverb than usual, and lets go after a second and a half.
caption.zh: 在頁面上點一下：電鋼琴彈一個 C 大調和弦，殘響比平常多，一秒半之後放開。

tbd.en: The Tone.js engine was not run for this page: there was no network and no speakers. What is written here comes from the code and from the package tests, which use a stand-in for Tone.js, and the examples that run use a stand-in engine.
tbd.zh: 這一頁沒有實際跑過 Tone.js 引擎：這裡沒有網路也沒有喇叭。寫在這裡的內容來自程式碼，和套件的測試（測試用一個替身代替 Tone.js），能跑的範例用的是替身引擎。

summary.en: Removes a registered sound, for tests and hot reload. Returns whether it was there.
summary.zh: 移除一個登記過的聲音，給測試和熱重載用。回傳它原本在不在。

description.en: A picker refreshes itself. It does not stop an engine that is playing the instrument: switch away first.
description.zh: 選單會自己更新。它不會停掉正在播這個樂器的引擎：要先換掉。

params.name: id
params.en: The id of the instrument.
params.zh: 樂器的 id。

returns.en: True if it existed. The listeners of [`onInstrumentsChange()`](#onInstrumentsChange) hear `{ type: 'unregister', id }` only then.
returns.zh: 原本有就是 true。只有這時候，[`onInstrumentsChange()`](#onInstrumentsChange) 的監聽者才會收到 `{ type: 'unregister', id }`。

caption.en: Removes an instrument; the second time there is nothing to remove.
caption.zh: 移除一個樂器。第二次就沒有東西可以移除了。

summary.en: Checks an instrument definition and lists everything wrong with it as readable sentences. An empty list means it is valid.
summary.zh: 檢查一個樂器定義，把有問題的地方都列成看得懂的句子。空的清單表示沒問題。

description.en: It checks: `id` (lowercase letters, digits and `-`, at most one `/`), `name` (a string, or `{ en, zh }` with at least `en`), `category` (a string), `create` (a function), `params` (each with a word as `key`, numbers `min < max`, a `def` within them, and a key that is not one of the shared three), `defaults` (only `cutoff`, `space` or `volume`, each within its range), `credit` (a string, or `{ text, url }`), `gain`, `transpose` and `tail` (numbers) and `fallback` (another instrument's id). [`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument) runs it and throws with these sentences.
description.zh: 它檢查：`id`（小寫字母、數字和 `-`，最多一個 `/`）、`name`（字串，或至少有 `en` 的 `{ en, zh }`）、`category`（字串）、`create`（函式）、`params`（每個的 `key` 是一個單字，`min < max` 是數字，`def` 在兩者之間，而且 key 不是共用的那三個之一）、`defaults`（只能是 `cutoff`、`space`、`volume`，且各自在範圍內）、`credit`（字串，或 `{ text, url }`）、`gain`、`transpose`、`tail`（數字），以及 `fallback`（另一個樂器的 id）。[`registerInstrument()`](#registerInstrument) 會執行它，並用這些句子丟出錯誤。

params.name: def
params.en: The definition to check.
params.zh: 要檢查的定義。

returns.en: Sentences, one per problem. `[]` when valid. It never throws.
returns.zh: 句子，每個問題一句。沒問題就是 `[]`。它不會丟出錯誤。

caption.en: A good definition gives an empty list; a definition with a capital letter in the id and a param that is already shared gets two sentences.
caption.zh: 好的定義得到空清單。id 有大寫字母、又有一個已經是共用參數的定義，得到兩句話。

summary.en: Checks a synth preset and lists what is wrong with it. An empty list means it is valid.
summary.zh: 檢查一個合成器預設，列出有問題的地方。空的清單表示沒問題。

description.en: It checks the `id` (lowercase letters, digits and `-`), the `voice` (`synth`, `mono`, `fm` or `am`), that every effect has a `type` the package knows, and that `octave` is a whole number. It does not check the Tone settings, which are Tone.js's to judge.
description.zh: 它檢查 `id`（小寫字母、數字和 `-`）、`voice`（`synth`、`mono`、`fm` 或 `am`）、每個效果的 `type` 是不是套件認得的，以及 `octave` 是不是整數。Tone 的設定它不檢查，那是 Tone.js 的事。

params.name: p
params.en: The preset to check.
params.zh: 要檢查的預設。

returns.en: Sentences, one per problem. `[]` when valid.
returns.zh: 句子，每個問題一句。沒問題就是 `[]`。

caption.en: A good preset gives an empty list; a preset with four mistakes gets one sentence for each.
caption.zh: 好的預設得到空清單。有四個錯誤的預設，每個錯誤得到一句話。

summary.en: How far through the current beat the drum machine is, smoothly from 0 up to just below 1, four times per bar.
summary.zh: 鼓機走到這一拍的哪裡，從 0 平滑地增加到快要 1，一小節會跑四次。

description.en: A beat is a quarter note (four steps). `1 - beatPhase` is biggest right on the beat and shrinks until the next one, so `circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + (1 - beatPhase) * 80)` pulses with the tempo, with no callback needed. [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) is the same thing across a whole bar.
description.zh: 一拍是一個四分音符（四格）。`1 - beatPhase` 在正拍上最大，然後縮小到下一拍，所以 `circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + (1 - beatPhase) * 80)` 會跟著速度脈動，不用任何 callback。[`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) 是同樣的東西，範圍是整個小節。

value.en: Read fresh each time you look at it. 0 on the beat, close to 1 just before the next one, then 0 again. It is 0 before the machine has played and holds still while it is stopped.
value.zh: 每次讀都是當下的值。正拍上是 0，下一拍之前接近 1，然後回到 0。鼓機還沒播之前是 0，停下來的時候停在原地。

needs.en: Start the machine with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums); until it plays, `beatPhase` is 0.
needs.zh: 先用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 啟動鼓機，在它開始播之前，`beatPhase` 是 0。

caption.en: A circle that pulses four times per bar: biggest on each beat, then shrinking until the next one.
caption.zh: 一個圓，一小節脈動四次：每一拍最大，然後縮小到下一拍。

summary.en: Draws the rhythm on the canvas as a grid, a circle or a spiral, with a playhead and the hits lighting up, so a recording has it too.
summary.zh: 把節奏畫在畫布上，樣式可以是格子、圓或螺旋，有播放頭，打擊的時候會亮起來，所以錄影也錄得到。

description.en: Call it in `draw()` after `background()`: `drawRhythm(20, 100, 360, 100)`. Each row is one drum that plays in the pattern, a hit lights up the moment it is heard (the clock [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) reads), and a hit between two steps, such as a triplet, sits where it falls. The grid card is part of the page and a recording never shows it, but the canvas is what a recording takes, so this is how the rhythm gets into the video.
description.zh: 在 `draw()` 裡、`background()` 之後呼叫：`drawRhythm(20, 100, 360, 100)`。每一列是節奏裡有用到的一種鼓，打擊在你聽到的那一刻亮起來（用的就是 [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) 讀的那個時鐘），兩格之間的打擊（例如三連音）會畫在它實際落下的位置。鼓機的卡片是頁面的一部分，錄影錄不到，但錄影錄的是畫布，所以要讓節奏進影片，就用這個。

description.en: With no box it draws a strip along the bottom for `'grid'` and a square in the middle for the other two. It draws with p5's own shapes between `push()` and `pop()`, so it leaves your styles alone and works in 2D and in `WEBGL`, in p5 1.x and 2.x. In `WEBGL` the origin is the middle of the canvas: `drawRhythm(-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height, 'circle')` fills it.
description.zh: 不給方框的話，`'grid'` 畫在畫布下方的一條帶子，另外兩種畫在中間的正方形。它用 p5 自己的圖形，包在 `push()` 和 `pop()` 之間，所以不會弄亂你設定的樣式，2D 和 `WEBGL`、p5 1.x 和 2.x 都能用。在 `WEBGL` 裡原點是畫布中心：`drawRhythm(-width / 2, -height / 2, width, height, 'circle')` 會鋪滿整個畫布。

params.name: x
params.en: Left edge of the box to draw in. In `WEBGL` the middle of the canvas is (0, 0). If any of `x`, `y`, `w`, `h` is left out, the default box is used.
params.zh: 要畫的方框的左邊。在 `WEBGL` 裡，畫布中心是 (0, 0)。`x`、`y`、`w`、`h` 只要有一個沒傳，就用預設的方框。

params.name: y
params.en: Top edge of the box.
params.zh: 方框的上邊。

params.name: w
params.en: Width of the box.
params.zh: 方框的寬。

params.name: h
params.en: Height of the box.
params.zh: 方框的高。

params.name: style
params.en: `'grid'` (the 16 steps with a playhead), `'circle'` (a ring of 16 per drum with a hand turned by [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase)) or `'spiral'` (the last few bars wound outwards, now at the tip). An object here is taken as `o`, with `style` inside it.
params.zh: `'grid'`（16 格加一條播放頭）、`'circle'`（每種鼓一圈 16 格，指針照 [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) 轉）或 `'spiral'`（最近幾小節往外繞，現在在最外面的尖端）。這裡如果給的是物件，就當成 `o`，`style` 寫在物件裡面。

params.name: o
params.en: Options: `colors` (`{ kick: '#f66', … }`, any p5 colour per drum), `color` (one colour for all), `off` (the empty steps), `playhead` (a colour, or `false` for none), `bg` (a background for the box) and `bars` (spiral only, 1 to 16, 4 if left out).
params.zh: 選項：`colors`（`{ kick: '#f66', … }`，每種鼓一個 p5 看得懂的顏色）、`color`（全部同一個顏色）、`off`（空格子的顏色）、`playhead`（顏色，或 `false` 表示不畫）、`bg`（方框的底色）、`bars`（只用在螺旋，1 到 16，沒寫就是 4）。

returns.en: `true` if it drew something, `false` when the box is empty (`w` or `h` is not above 0) or there is no p5 global mode to draw with.
returns.zh: 有畫東西就是 `true`，方框是空的（`w` 或 `h` 不大於 0），或沒有 p5 全域模式可以畫的時候是 `false`。

needs.en: Start the machine with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) first. Before it plays you get an empty four-lane grid.
needs.zh: 要先用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 啟動鼓機。在它開始播之前，畫出來的是一個空的四軌格子。

notes.en: `OAVp5.drums.draw(x, y, w, h, style, o)` is the same function as a method.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.drums.draw(x, y, w, h, style, o)` 是同一個函式，寫成方法的樣子。

caption.en: The pattern as a grid on the canvas itself: a white playhead crosses it, and every hit lights up as it sounds.
caption.zh: 節奏以格子的樣子畫在畫布上：一條白色的播放頭掃過去，每一下打擊發聲的時候那一格亮起來。

caption.en: The same rhythm three ways: a ring per drum with a hand, the last four bars as a spiral, and the grid along the bottom.
caption.zh: 同一個節奏的三種畫法：每種鼓一圈、有指針的圓，最近四小節繞成的螺旋，以及下方的格子。

caption.en: In a WEBGL canvas the box starts at (-width / 2, -height / 2), because (0, 0) is the middle.
caption.zh: 在 WEBGL 畫布裡方框要從 (-width / 2, -height / 2) 開始，因為 (0, 0) 是畫布中心。

summary.en: The tempo of the drum machine in beats per minute.
summary.zh: 鼓機的速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍。

description.en: A beat is a quarter note, four steps, so one step lasts `60 / drumBpm / 4` seconds and one bar `240 / drumBpm`: at 120 a bar takes 2 seconds. To change the tempo call [`startDrums(bpm)`](#startDrums): `startDrums(drumBpm + 5)` speeds up by five. Writing to `drumBpm` yourself changes nothing.
description.zh: 一拍是一個四分音符，也就是四格，所以一格長 `60 / drumBpm / 4` 秒，一小節長 `240 / drumBpm` 秒：速度 120 的時候一小節是 2 秒。要改速度就呼叫 [`startDrums(bpm)`](#startDrums)：`startDrums(drumBpm + 5)` 就是加快 5。自己對 `drumBpm` 賦值不會有任何作用。

description.en: [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) keeps the tempo between 30 and 300; the slider on the grid goes from 60 to 180.
description.zh: [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 會把速度限制在 30 到 300 之間，格子上的滑桿則是從 60 到 180。

value.en: 112 until you set another one. It follows [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) and the tempo slider on the grid.
value.zh: 在你設定別的之前是 112。它會跟著 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 和格子上的速度滑桿走。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own variable called `drumBpm` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.drums.bpm` instead.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `drumBpm` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.drums.bpm`。

caption.en: Press the up and down arrow keys to change the tempo by 5; the number shows it.
caption.zh: 按上、下方向鍵，每次把速度加減 5，數字會顯示出來。

summary.en: An event you define: it is called for every hit of the drum machine, with the drum that sounded and how hard.
summary.zh: 一個由你定義的事件函式：鼓機每打一下就會呼叫它，告訴你是哪一種鼓、打得多用力。

description.en: Define `function drumHit(lane, velocity) { … }` and oav-p5 calls it for every hit of every drum, the way it calls [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) for a key. It is called in the frame in which the hit is heard, right before `draw()`.
description.zh: 定義 `function drumHit(lane, velocity) { … }`，鼓機每打一下、不論哪一種鼓，oav-p5 都會呼叫它，就像按一個鍵會呼叫 [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) 一樣。它是在你聽到那一下的那個畫面、`draw()` 之前被呼叫的。

description.en: The same hit also calls the microphone's functions, so you can pick the grain you want: [`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected) for the kick, `snareDetected()` for snare, clap and rim, `hatDetected()` for the three hats, and [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected) (with [`beat`](#beat) true for a frame) for kick, snare, clap and rim, once per step. Toms, crash, ride and cowbell reach only `drumHit()`. On one step the order is: [`cueFired()`](#cueFired), [`barStarted()`](#barStarted), [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted), then the hits.
description.zh: 同一下打擊也會呼叫麥克風用的那些函式，你可以挑想要的粒度：[`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected) 是大鼓，`snareDetected()` 是小鼓、拍手和鼓邊，`hatDetected()` 是三種鈸，[`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected)（同時 [`beat`](#beat) 在那個畫面是 true）是大鼓、小鼓、拍手和鼓邊，每一格最多一次。中鼓、碎音鈸、疊音鈸和牛鈴只會呼叫 `drumHit()`。同一格裡的順序是：[`cueFired()`](#cueFired)、[`barStarted()`](#barStarted)、[`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted)，最後才是各個打擊。

params.name: lane
params.en: The drum that sounded: `'kick'`, `'snare'`, `'hat'` or `'clap'` for the grid, and also `'openhat'`, `'pedalhat'`, `'rim'`, `'lowtom'`, `'tom'`, `'hightom'`, `'crash'`, `'ride'` or `'cowbell'` for a line of rhythm.
params.zh: 發聲的鼓：格子上是 `'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'`、`'clap'`，一行字寫的節奏還會有 `'openhat'`、`'pedalhat'`、`'rim'`、`'lowtom'`、`'tom'`、`'hightom'`、`'crash'`、`'ride'`、`'cowbell'`。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, from 0.15 to 1. It varies a little from hit to hit, because the machine plays slightly softer or louder on purpose.
params.zh: 打得多用力，從 0.15 到 1。每一下會有一點點不同，因為鼓機故意打得時輕時重。

notes.en: While the tab is hidden nobody sees a frame: the clock keeps counting, but no hit is told, and nothing is told twice when the tab comes back. An error thrown inside `drumHit()` is printed, with its file and line, and the next hit still comes.
notes.zh: 分頁被藏起來的時候沒有人看得到畫面：時鐘照樣在數，但不會通知任何一下打擊，分頁回來時也不會把漏掉的補通知一次。`drumHit()` 裡丟出的錯誤會連同檔案和行號印出來，下一下打擊照樣會來。

caption.en: Four circles, one per drum: each swells with the hit and shrinks back, and a harder hit swells more.
caption.zh: 四個圓，一種鼓一個：每打一下就鼓起來再縮回去，打得越用力鼓得越大。

caption.en: The name of the latest drum that sounded: a line of rhythm brings crash and low tom, which only drumHit() reports.
caption.zh: 顯示最近一下是哪種鼓：一行字寫的節奏會有碎音鈸和落地鼓，這些只有 drumHit() 會通知。

summary.en: How far through the current bar the drum machine is, smoothly from 0 up to just below 1, as it is heard.
summary.zh: 鼓機走到這一小節的哪裡，從 0 平滑地增加到快要 1，是你耳朵聽到的位置。

description.en: Use it for anything that should move continuously with the music: `rotate(drumPhase * TWO_PI)` turns once per bar. [`drumStep`](#drumStep) says the same thing in 16 jumps; `drumPhase` is the smooth version. The value is what the listener hears, which is the machine's position corrected for the latency of the speakers, so a drawing driven by it lands on the beat you hear.
description.zh: 任何要跟著音樂連續移動的東西都用它：`rotate(drumPhase * TWO_PI)` 一小節轉一圈。[`drumStep`](#drumStep) 講的是同一件事，只是分成 16 次跳動，`drumPhase` 是平滑的版本。它的值是聽的人聽到的位置，也就是鼓機的位置再扣掉喇叭的延遲，所以用它驅動的畫面會落在你聽到的拍子上。

description.en: A bar has four beats; [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) is the same idea for one beat.
description.zh: 一小節有四拍，[`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) 是同樣的概念，單位是一拍。

value.en: Read fresh each time you look at it, so it is never a frame old. 0 at the start of a bar, close to 1 at its end, then 0 again. It is 0 before the machine has played and holds still while it is stopped.
value.zh: 每次讀都是當下的值，不會慢一個畫面。小節開頭是 0，結尾接近 1，然後回到 0。鼓機還沒播之前是 0，停下來的時候停在原地。

needs.en: Start the machine with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums); until it plays, `drumPhase` is 0.
needs.zh: 先用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 啟動鼓機，在它開始播之前，`drumPhase` 是 0。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own `drumPhase` keeps it, and oav-p5 does not write that name. `OAVp5.drums.phase` is the same number under a name nothing else can take.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `drumPhase`，就用你的，oav-p5 不會去寫這個名稱。`OAVp5.drums.phase` 是同一個數字，用一個不會跟別人衝突的名字。

caption.en: A clock hand that turns exactly once every bar, smoothly.
caption.zh: 一根時鐘的指針，每一小節剛好轉一圈，轉得很平滑。

caption.en: Two dots on two circles: the orange one hops from step to step, the blue one runs smoothly.
caption.zh: 兩個圓上各有一個點：橘色的一格一格跳，藍色的連續不斷地跑。

summary.en: Whether the drum machine is playing right now.
summary.zh: 鼓機現在有沒有在播。

description.en: Use it to tell "the drums are not running" from "the drums are at step 0": [`drumStep`](#drumStep) is 0 in both cases. `if (drumsAreOn) { … }` is also the right guard before you read [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase). It changes only when the machine starts or stops, and reading it never starts anything.
description.zh: 用它來分辨「鼓機沒在跑」和「鼓機剛好在第 0 格」：這兩種情況下 [`drumStep`](#drumStep) 都是 0。在讀 [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) 之前用 `if (drumsAreOn) { … }` 把關也很合適。它只有在鼓機開始或停止的時候才會變，讀它不會啟動任何東西。

description.en: For the reason behind a `false` read `OAVp5.drums.state`: [`'loading'`](#OAVp5.drums.state) while the module arrives, `'stopped'` when the grid is up but not playing, `'error'` when it could not load.
description.zh: `false` 的原因看 `OAVp5.drums.state`：模組還在下載是 [`'loading'`](#OAVp5.drums.state)，格子在但沒在播是 `'stopped'`，載入失敗是 `'error'`。

value.en: True while the machine plays, false at the start, after [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums), after an error and while the grid's own checkbox is unticked.
value.zh: 鼓機在播的時候是 true，一開始、呼叫 [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) 之後、出錯的時候、以及格子上自己的勾選框取消勾選的時候是 false。

needs.en: It becomes true after [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) (or 🥁 in the 🎹 panel) has loaded the machine, usually within a fraction of a second.
needs.zh: 要先呼叫 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)（或按 🎹 面板的 🥁），等鼓機載入完才會變成 true，通常不到一秒。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own variable called `drumsAreOn` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.drums.state === 'on'` instead.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `drumsAreOn` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.drums.state === 'on'`。

caption.en: An amber circle for a moment while the machine loads, then green.
caption.zh: 鼓機載入的那一瞬間是琥珀色的圓，然後變成綠色。

tbd.en: After [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) and a second [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) it stayed `false` while the machine played again (Chromium, oav-p5 0.8.0). Not confirmed whether that is intended.
tbd.zh: 呼叫 [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) 之後再呼叫一次 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)，鼓機明明又在播，它卻仍是 `false`（Chromium，oav-p5 0.8.0）。這是不是預期的行為，還沒有確認。

summary.en: An event you define: it is called with the new line of rhythm every time the rhythm changes.
summary.zh: 一個由你定義的事件函式：節奏每次改變，就會帶著新的那一行節奏被呼叫。

description.en: The line over the grid and the cells edit each other, so the rhythm can change without your code: a click on a cell, a line typed into the card, ↶. `rhythmChanged(src, how)` tells the sketch, so it can show the line on the canvas (where a recording has it) or store it. It is also called once after [`startDrums()`](#startDrums), a moment after the rhythm module has loaded, with `how` equal to `'code'`.
description.zh: 格子上方的那一行字和格子本身會互相改寫，所以節奏可以在你的程式碼之外改變：點格子、在卡片上打字、按 ↶。`rhythmChanged(src, how)` 把這件事告訴草圖，讓它可以把那一行字畫在畫布上（錄影就錄得到），或是存起來。[`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 之後，節奏模組載入完的那一刻也會呼叫一次，這時 `how` 是 `'code'`。

params.name: src
params.en: The line of rhythm that plays now, for example `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`. A preset or a grid you drew comes as the line it is written as.
params.zh: 現在播的那一行節奏，例如 `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`。預設節奏或你自己畫的格子，會以它對應的那一行字給你。

params.name: how
params.en: What changed it: `'code'` ([`startDrums()`](#startDrums)), `'cell'` (a click on a cell of the grid), `'type'` (typed into the line on the card, or [`OAVp5.drums.edit()`](#OAVp5.drums.edit)), `'undo'` (↶ or [`OAVp5.drums.undo()`](#OAVp5.drums.undo)) or `'menu'` (a preset picked on the card).
params.zh: 是什麼改變了它：`'code'`（[`startDrums()`](#startDrums)）、`'cell'`（點了格子上的一格）、`'type'`（在卡片的那行字上打字，或用 [`OAVp5.drums.edit()`](#OAVp5.drums.edit)）、`'undo'`（↶ 或 [`OAVp5.drums.undo()`](#OAVp5.drums.undo)）、`'menu'`（在卡片上挑了一個預設節奏）。

caption.en: The line that plays and what changed it: "code" at the start, "type" after a click on the canvas, "cell" when you click a cell of the grid.
caption.zh: 顯示正在播的那一行節奏和是誰改的：一開始是 "code"，點畫布之後是 "type"，點格子上的一格就是 "cell"。

summary.en: Starts a drum machine: a 16-step grid on the page that plays a preset, your own grid or one line of rhythm, and counts the bars for your sketch.
summary.zh: 啟動鼓機：頁面上出現一個 16 格的鼓機，播放預設節奏、你自己畫的格子或一行字寫的節奏，並替草圖數小節。

description.en: Call it once in `setup()`: `startDrums('breakbeat', 120)`. A grid of 16 steps by 4 lanes (kick, snare, hat, clap) appears at the top of the page, with the tempo and the bar it is in, and plays a synthesized drum kit (no sample files). The grid is part of the page, not of the canvas: a recording never shows it, so use [`drawRhythm()`](#drawRhythm) to draw the rhythm on the canvas. A click on a cell changes the beat, and 🥁 in the 🎹 panel starts and stops the machine with no code at all.
description.zh: 在 `setup()` 裡呼叫一次：`startDrums('breakbeat', 120)`。頁面上方會出現 16 格 × 4 軌（大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手）的鼓機，旁邊有速度和目前的小節，用合成的鼓組發聲（沒有取樣檔）。這個鼓機是頁面的一部分，不在畫布上，所以錄影錄不到它，要把節奏畫進畫布請用 [`drawRhythm()`](#drawRhythm)。點格子可以改節奏，🎹 面板裡的 🥁 不用寫程式就能開關鼓機。

description.en: The machine is also a clock and a source of events. Every hit calls [`drumHit()`](#drumHit) and the microphone's own functions ([`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected), [`snareDetected()`](#kickDetected), [`hatDetected()`](#kickDetected), [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected)), so a sketch written for the microphone moves over unchanged. [`drumStep`](#drumStep), [`drumBar`](#drumBar), [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) and [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) say where the machine is, and [`cue()`](#cue) lets you plan what happens at which bar.
description.zh: 鼓機同時也是時鐘和事件的來源。每一下打擊都會呼叫 [`drumHit()`](#drumHit) 和麥克風用的那幾個函式（[`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected)、[`snareDetected()`](#kickDetected)、[`hatDetected()`](#kickDetected)、[`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected)），所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。[`drumStep`](#drumStep)、[`drumBar`](#drumBar)、[`drumPhase`](#drumPhase)、[`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) 告訴你鼓機走到哪，[`cue()`](#cue) 讓你事先安排哪一小節發生什麼。

description.en: Calling it again while it plays changes the pattern or the tempo without restarting: `startDrums(90)` only changes the tempo, `startDrums('latin')` only the pattern. A line of rhythm is any text that is not a preset name. A word is a drum (`bd` kick, `sd` snare, `hh` hat, `oh` open hat, `cp` clap, `rim`, `lt` `mt` `ht` toms, `cr` crash, `rd` ride, `cb` cowbell), `~` is a rest, words separated by spaces share the bar evenly, `[ ]` groups, `*4` repeats, `,` puts another line on top, `< >` takes one per bar and `bd(3,8)` spreads 3 hits over 8 steps. A mistake shows a card that points at the character and says how to fix it, and `'four on floor'` plays meanwhile.
description.zh: 機器播的時候再呼叫，是換節奏或換速度，不會重新開始：`startDrums(90)` 只改速度，`startDrums('latin')` 只換節奏。不是預設節奏名字的文字，都當成一行節奏來讀。一個字就是一種鼓（`bd` 大鼓、`sd` 小鼓、`hh` 鈸、`oh` 開鈸、`cp` 拍手、`rim` 鼓邊、`lt` `mt` `ht` 三種中鼓、`cr` 碎音鈸、`rd` 疊音鈸、`cb` 牛鈴），`~` 是休息，用空白隔開的字平分一小節，`[ ]` 是一組，`*4` 是重複四次，`,` 是疊上另一行，`< >` 是每小節輪流一個，`bd(3,8)` 是把 3 下打擊平均分在 8 格裡。寫錯的話會跳出一張卡片，指出是哪個字、怎麼改，這時先播 `'four on floor'`。

description.en: A line copied from strudel.cc works too: `startDrums('s("bd*4, [~ sd]*2").fast(2)')`. `s("…")` and `sound("…")` with `.fast(n)` and `.slow(n)` are read, `setcpm(110/4)` sets the tempo if you give none, `.bank(…)` is left out (oav-p5 plays its own kit), and any other call in the chain gets a card that says it is not supported yet. The rest plays.
description.zh: 從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式也可以：`startDrums('s("bd*4, [~ sd]*2").fast(2)')`。`s("…")` 和 `sound("…")` 加上 `.fast(n)`、`.slow(n)` 會被讀進來，沒給速度的話 `setcpm(110/4)` 會設定速度，`.bank(…)` 會略過（oav-p5 用自己的鼓組），鏈裡其他的呼叫會跳一張卡片說目前還不支援，其餘照播。

params.name: pattern
params.en: What to play. A preset name (`'four on floor'`, `'breakbeat'`, `'half time'`, `'latin'`, `'sparse'`). A line of rhythm such as `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`, or one copied from strudel.cc. Your own grid `{ kick: 'x...x...x...x...', snare, hat, clap }` (`x` or `1` is a hit, a lane you leave out is silent, `{}` is a silent clock). A number alone is the tempo. Leave it out to keep what plays now (`'four on floor'` at the start).
params.zh: 要播什麼。預設節奏的名字（`'four on floor'`、`'breakbeat'`、`'half time'`、`'latin'`、`'sparse'`）。一行字寫的節奏，例如 `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`，或從 strudel.cc 複製來的。你自己畫的格子 `{ kick: 'x...x...x...x...', snare, hat, clap }`（`x` 或 `1` 是打擊，沒寫的軌道是靜音，`{}` 是只走時間、不出聲的時鐘）。只給一個數字，那個數字就是速度。不傳就維持現在播的（一開始是 `'four on floor'`）。

params.name: bpm
params.en: The tempo in beats per minute (a beat is four steps). Kept between 30 and 300. Leave it out to keep the current tempo: 112 at the start, or the one a copied Strudel line sets with `setcpm(…)`.
params.zh: 速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍（一拍是四格）。會被限制在 30 到 300 之間。不傳就維持現在的速度：一開始是 112，或是複製來的 Strudel 程式用 `setcpm(…)` 設的那個。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once the machine plays (or when a later `startDrums()` took over). Resolves to `false` when [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) came first, when there is no page to put the grid on, or when @openav/drums could not be loaded.
returns.zh: 鼓機開始播之後 resolve 成 `true`（或者後面又有一次 `startDrums()` 接手的時候）。[`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) 先被呼叫、沒有頁面可以放鼓機、或 @openav/drums 載入失敗的時候，resolve 成 `false`。

needs.en: Nothing before the call. The counting, [`drumHit()`](#drumHit) and the other callbacks start at once, but a browser lets the page make sound only after a click or key press on it, so the drums are silent until the first one. A card at the top says so after a moment.
needs.zh: 呼叫之前不用準備什麼。計數、[`drumHit()`](#drumHit) 和其他 callback 馬上就開始，但瀏覽器要頁面上先有一次點擊或按鍵才讓頁面出聲，所以在那之前鼓是沒聲音的，過一會兒上方會出現卡片提醒你。

notes.en: Drum sound does not need [`startSound()`](#startSound): the machine has its own kit. Pads on MIDI channel 10 play the same kit once `startSound()` is on.
notes.zh: 鼓的聲音不需要 [`startSound()`](#startSound)：鼓機有自己的鼓組。MIDI 第 10 軌的打擊墊，在 `startSound()` 開著的時候打的就是同一組鼓。

notes.en: The card has – to fold the grid away and × to stop the machine. A tab in the background keeps counting and playing. The loading options [`drums`](#option-drums) (`lookahead` or `frame`) and [`drumlatency`](#option-drumlatency) tune the clock.
notes.zh: 卡片上的 – 可以把格子收起來，× 會停掉鼓機。分頁在背景的時候，鼓機照樣數、照樣播。載入選項 [`drums`](#option-drums)（`lookahead` 或 `frame`）和 [`drumlatency`](#option-drumlatency) 可以調整時鐘。

caption.en: A grid appears at the top of the page. Click the canvas once to hear it: the circle jumps on every kick.
caption.zh: 頁面上方出現鼓機。在畫布上點一下就聽得到鼓聲，每一下大鼓圓都會跳一下。

caption.en: Click the canvas to step through three rhythms: the line of text under the caption is the one that plays now, and the grid at the top follows it.
caption.zh: 在畫布上點一下就換下一個節奏：說明文字下面那一行就是現在播的節奏，上方的鼓機格子也跟著變。

caption.en: A silent clock: sixteen dots with the current step enlarged, running at 90 bpm with no sound at all.
caption.zh: 一個沒有聲音的時鐘：十六個點，現在這一格的點比較大，以每分鐘 90 拍的速度走，完全沒有聲音。

summary.en: Stops the drum machine and hides its card.
summary.zh: 停掉鼓機，並把它的卡片收起來。

description.en: The machine stops playing, the grid disappears and [`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) becomes `false`. The numbers keep the last value they had: [`drumStep`](#drumStep), [`drumBar`](#drumBar) and [`cueName`](#cueName) stay where they were, and [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) and [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) hold still. [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) afterwards begins again from bar 1.
description.zh: 鼓機停止播放，格子消失，[`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) 變成 `false`。各個數字停在最後的值：[`drumStep`](#drumStep)、[`drumBar`](#drumBar) 和 [`cueName`](#cueName) 留在原來的地方，[`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) 和 [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) 也停住不動。之後再呼叫 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 會從第 1 小節重新開始。

description.en: It also works while the machine is still loading: the pending [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) then resolves to `false`. The × on the card does the same thing.
description.zh: 機器還在載入的時候呼叫也可以：還沒結束的 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 會 resolve 成 `false`。卡片上的 × 做的是同一件事。

returns.en: A promise that is already resolved to `false`, the new state of the machine.
returns.zh: 一個已經 resolve 成 `false` 的 promise，`false` 就是鼓機的新狀態。

caption.en: Click the canvas: the grid disappears, the background turns light and the text shows the step it stopped on.
caption.zh: 在畫布上點一下：鼓機消失，背景變亮，文字顯示它停在第幾格。

tbd.en: After `stopDrums()` and a second `startDrums()` on the same page the machine plays and counts again, but [`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) and `OAVp5.drums.state` stayed `false` and `'off'` when this was tried (Chromium, oav-p5 0.8.0). Whether that is intended is not confirmed.
tbd.zh: 在同一個頁面呼叫 `stopDrums()` 之後再呼叫一次 `startDrums()`，鼓機會再度播放、計數，但實際試的時候（Chromium，oav-p5 0.8.0），[`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) 和 `OAVp5.drums.state` 仍然是 `false` 和 `'off'`。這是不是預期的行為，還沒有確認。

summary.en: The object behind the drum names: the state of the machine, its counters, the line of rhythm, its history and the loaded machine.
summary.zh: 鼓機相關名稱背後的物件：機器的狀態、各種計數、那一行節奏、它的歷史，以及載入進來的鼓機。

description.en: `OAVp5.drums` (also reachable as `midi.drums`) is what [`startDrums()`](#startDrums), [`drumStep`](#drumStep) and the rest are built on. It holds the numbers ([`state`](#OAVp5.drums.state), [`step`](#drumStep), [`bar`](#drumBar), [`count`](#OAVp5.drums.count), [`bpm`](#drumBpm), [`phase`](#drumPhase), `beatPhase`), the rhythm ([`pattern`](#OAVp5.drums.pattern), [`src`](#OAVp5.drums.src), [`copyText`](#OAVp5.drums.copyText), [`strudelUrl`](#OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl), [`history`](#OAVp5.drums.history), [`edit()`](#OAVp5.drums.edit), [`undo()`](#OAVp5.drums.undo)), the cues ([`cue()`](#OAVp5.drums.cue), [`cues`](#OAVp5.drums.cues), [`lastCue`](#cueName)), a way to listen ([`on()`](#OAVp5.drums.on)), what the machine hears right now ([`now`](#OAVp5.drums.now)) and handles for the curious ([`machine`](#OAVp5.drums.machine), [`clock`](#OAVp5.drums.clock)).
description.zh: `OAVp5.drums`（也可以用 `midi.drums` 取得）是 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)、[`drumStep`](#drumStep) 這些名稱的底層。它裡面有數字（[`state`](#OAVp5.drums.state)、[`step`](#drumStep)、[`bar`](#drumBar)、[`count`](#OAVp5.drums.count)、[`bpm`](#drumBpm)、[`phase`](#drumPhase)、`beatPhase`）、節奏（[`pattern`](#OAVp5.drums.pattern)、[`src`](#OAVp5.drums.src)、[`copyText`](#OAVp5.drums.copyText)、[`strudelUrl`](#OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl)、[`history`](#OAVp5.drums.history)、[`edit()`](#OAVp5.drums.edit)、[`undo()`](#OAVp5.drums.undo)）、cue（[`cue()`](#OAVp5.drums.cue)、[`cues`](#OAVp5.drums.cues)、[`lastCue`](#cueName)）、監聽的方法（[`on()`](#OAVp5.drums.on)）、鼓機此刻聽到的樣子（[`now`](#OAVp5.drums.now)），以及給好奇的人用的把手（[`machine`](#OAVp5.drums.machine)、[`clock`](#OAVp5.drums.clock)）。

description.en: `start`, `stop` and `draw` are the same as [`startDrums()`](#startDrums), [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) and [`drawRhythm()`](#drawRhythm). For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, libraries (Hydra, for one), the console and debugging.
description.zh: `start`、`stop`、`draw` 跟 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)、[`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums)、[`drawRhythm()`](#drawRhythm) 是同一回事。一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、函式庫（例如 Hydra）、主控台和除錯用的。

caption.en: Four lines read from the drums object while the machine plays.
caption.zh: 機器在播的時候，從鼓機物件讀出來的四行資料。

summary.en: The text the Copy button on the card puts on the clipboard: the rhythm that plays now as a ready `startDrums("…", bpm)` call.
summary.zh: 卡片上「複製」按鈕放進剪貼簿的文字：把現在播的節奏寫成可以直接貼上的 `startDrums("…", bpm)`。

description.en: Click cells, type a line, find a rhythm you like, and paste this into `setup()` to keep it. The tempo is the current one, rounded to two decimals.
description.zh: 點格子、打字，找到喜歡的節奏之後，把這一行貼進 `setup()` 就能留住它。速度是現在的速度，四捨五入到小數點後兩位。

value.en: For example `startDrums("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8", 110)`. Read fresh each time; `''` before the machine has loaded.
value.zh: 例如 `startDrums("bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8", 110)`。每次讀都是當下的值，鼓機載入之前是 `''`。

caption.en: The line to paste back into setup(); click cells on the grid and it follows.
caption.zh: 可以貼回 setup() 的那一行，在格子上點一點，它也會跟著變。

summary.en: Plays a line of rhythm as if it was typed on the card, and returns whether it worked and, if not, what is wrong with it.
summary.zh: 把一行節奏當成在卡片上打的字來播，並回傳有沒有成功，不成功的話告訴你哪裡有問題。

description.en: Unlike [`startDrums(text)`](#startDrums), which plays 'four on floor' when the line has a mistake, `edit()` keeps the line that was playing and tells you why the new one failed, so a live-coding sketch can show the message. The line goes into [`OAVp5.drums.history`](#OAVp5.drums.history) and [`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged) is called with `how` equal to `'type'`. A mistake also shows the card that points at the character.
description.zh: 跟 [`startDrums(text)`](#startDrums) 不同：那一行有錯的時候，`startDrums` 會改播 'four on floor'，而 `edit()` 會讓原本那一行繼續播，並告訴你新的為什麼失敗，所以即時編碼的草圖可以把訊息顯示出來。這一行會進到 [`OAVp5.drums.history`](#OAVp5.drums.history)，[`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged) 也會被呼叫，`how` 是 `'type'`。有錯的時候也會跳出卡片，指出是哪個字。

params.name: text
params.en: The line of rhythm, for example `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`, or a line copied from strudel.cc.
params.zh: 一行節奏，例如 `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`，或是從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式。

returns.en: `{ ok: true, error: null, text }` when the line plays. `{ ok: false, error, text }` when it has a mistake: `error` has `code`, `index` and `length` (where the bad word is in `text`), a `message` and a `hint`, and the last line that worked keeps playing. Before the machine has loaded: `{ ok: false, error: null }`.
returns.zh: 這行節奏播起來了就回傳 `{ ok: true, error: null, text }`。有錯的話回傳 `{ ok: false, error, text }`：`error` 裡有 `code`、`index` 和 `length`（錯的那個字在 `text` 的位置）、`message` 和 `hint`，這時上一行能播的節奏繼續播。鼓機還沒載入的時候回傳 `{ ok: false, error: null }`。

needs.en: The machine and the rhythm module must have loaded: call [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) first and give it a moment.
needs.zh: 鼓機和節奏模組必須已經載入完成：先呼叫 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)，再等一下。

caption.en: Click three times: the first two lines play; the third has a mistake, so the message is shown and the line before it keeps playing.
caption.zh: 連點三下：前兩行會播，第三行有錯，所以顯示錯誤訊息，並讓前一行繼續播。

summary.en: The earlier lines of rhythm, oldest first: every click on a cell, typed line or menu pick leaves the line before it here.
summary.zh: 之前播過的節奏，最舊的在最前面：每點一次格子、每改一次文字、每從選單挑一次，前一行就會存到這裡。

description.en: [`OAVp5.drums.undo()`](#OAVp5.drums.undo) takes the last line off this list and plays it. Changes made by [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) are not recorded here, only the ones made on the card or with [`OAVp5.drums.edit()`](#OAVp5.drums.edit). The array is the machine's own, so treat it as read-only.
description.zh: [`OAVp5.drums.undo()`](#OAVp5.drums.undo) 會把這份清單最後一行拿出來播。用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 做的改變不會記在這裡，只有在卡片上做的，或用 [`OAVp5.drums.edit()`](#OAVp5.drums.edit) 做的才會。這個陣列是鼓機自己的，請當成唯讀。

value.en: Empty at the start, and at most 50 lines long. The line that plays now is not in it: that is [`OAVp5.drums.src`](#OAVp5.drums.src).
value.zh: 一開始是空的，最多保留 50 行。現在在播的那一行不在裡面，那一行是 [`OAVp5.drums.src`](#OAVp5.drums.src)。

caption.en: Each click edits the line and adds the one before it to the history list.
caption.zh: 每點一下就改一次那一行，前一行會加進歷史清單。

summary.en: A snapshot of what the machine hears right now: the bar, the step, both phases and which words of the line are lit.
summary.zh: 鼓機此刻聽到的樣子，一次拿齊：小節、格、兩個相位，以及那一行字裡哪些字亮著。

description.en: It is what the card uses to light the word that sounds. Read it when you want the line and its lit words in one go, for example to draw the line on the canvas with the sounding word marked. Before the machine has loaded it answers with zeros and an empty `text`.
description.zh: 卡片就是用它讓正在響的字亮起來。想一次拿到那一行字和亮著的字的時候讀它，例如把那一行字畫在畫布上，並標出正在響的字。鼓機載入之前，它給的是零和空的 `text`。

value.range: { bar, step, phase, beatPhase, tokens, mode, text }
value.en: A new object on every read. `phase` and `beatPhase` are [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) and [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase). `tokens` is a list of `{ start, end }`: the places in `text` of the words that sound now. `mode` is `'string'` for a line of rhythm and `'grid'` for a preset or a grid you drew. `text` is the line.
value.zh: 每次讀都是一個新的物件。`phase` 和 `beatPhase` 就是 [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) 和 [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase)。`tokens` 是 `{ start, end }` 的清單，標出 `text` 裡現在正在響的那幾個字的位置。`mode` 在播一行節奏時是 `'string'`，預設節奏或你自己畫的格子是 `'grid'`。`text` 是那一行字。

caption.en: The line of rhythm with a yellow underline that follows the words as they sound.
caption.zh: 那一行節奏，下面有一條黃色底線，跟著正在響的字移動。

summary.en: Listens to the drum machine from anywhere: `OAVp5.drums.on('hit', fn)` calls `fn` like `drumHit` does, and returns a function that stops listening.
summary.zh: 在任何地方監聽鼓機：`OAVp5.drums.on('hit', fn)` 會像 `drumHit` 一樣呼叫 `fn`，並回傳一個可以取消監聽的函式。

description.en: The functions you define (`drumHit`, `barStarted` …) are one listener each. `on()` is for the cases where that does not fit: several listeners for one event, a library or a Hydra sketch that has no `drumHit()` of its own, a listener you want to remove again. It is the same idea as `midi.on()`. An error thrown inside `fn` is printed and the other listeners still run.
description.zh: 你定義的函式（`drumHit`、`barStarted` ……）每種事件只能有一個。`on()` 是給不適用的情況：同一個事件要有好幾個監聽者、函式庫或 Hydra 草圖沒有自己的 `drumHit()`、或是想把監聽者再拿掉。概念跟 `midi.on()` 一樣。`fn` 裡丟出的錯誤會被印出來，其他監聽者照樣執行。

params.name: name
params.en: What to listen to: `'hit'` (like [`drumHit()`](#drumHit)), `'step'` (like [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted)), `'bar'` (like [`barStarted()`](#barStarted)), `'cue'` (like [`cueFired()`](#cueFired)) or `'rhythm'` (like [`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged)). Any other name throws an error that lists them.
params.zh: 要監聽什麼：`'hit'`（像 [`drumHit()`](#drumHit)）、`'step'`（像 [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted)）、`'bar'`（像 [`barStarted()`](#barStarted)）、`'cue'`（像 [`cueFired()`](#cueFired)）、`'rhythm'`（像 [`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged)）。其他的名字會丟出錯誤，並列出這幾個。

params.name: fn
params.en: Called with the same arguments as the function it matches: `(lane, velocity)`, `(step, bar)`, `(bar)`, `(name, bar)` or `(src, how)`.
params.zh: 被呼叫的時候帶的參數跟對應的函式一樣：`(lane, velocity)`、`(step, bar)`、`(bar)`、`(name, bar)` 或 `(src, how)`。

returns.en: A function: call it to stop listening.
returns.zh: 一個函式，呼叫它就停止監聽。

caption.en: A counter that goes up once per bar; a click removes the listener and the number stops.
caption.zh: 一個每小節加一的計數器，點一下就拿掉監聽者，數字就停住。

summary.en: What the drum machine plays, as a name: the preset's name, `'custom'` for a grid, or the line of rhythm itself.
summary.zh: 鼓機正在播的東西，用名字表示：預設節奏的名字、自己畫的格子是 `'custom'`，一行節奏就是那一行字本身。

description.en: After `startDrums('breakbeat')` it is `'breakbeat'`, after `startDrums({ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' })` it is `'custom'`, and after `startDrums('bd*4, hh*8')` it is that line. A click on a cell of a preset makes it `'custom'`. To get the line of rhythm in every case, read [`OAVp5.drums.src`](#OAVp5.drums.src): a preset also has one.
description.zh: `startDrums('breakbeat')` 之後是 `'breakbeat'`，`startDrums({ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' })` 之後是 `'custom'`，`startDrums('bd*4, hh*8')` 之後就是那一行字。在預設節奏的格子上點一下，它就變成 `'custom'`。想在每一種情況下都拿到那一行節奏，請讀 [`OAVp5.drums.src`](#OAVp5.drums.src)：預設節奏也有對應的那一行。

value.en: `'four on floor'` until you choose another. It follows what plays, including clicks on the grid.
value.zh: 在你選別的之前是 `'four on floor'`。它跟著正在播的東西走，包括在格子上點的修改。

caption.en: Shows "breakbeat"; click a cell of the grid and it turns into "custom".
caption.zh: 顯示 "breakbeat"，在鼓機的格子上點一下，就變成 "custom"。

summary.en: The line of rhythm that plays now, such as `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`; an empty string until the machine has loaded.
summary.zh: 現在播的那一行節奏，例如 `'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'`。鼓機載入之前是空字串。

description.en: Show it on the canvas so a recording has it (`text(OAVp5.drums.src, 20, 30)`), or keep it to come back to the rhythm later with [`startDrums(src)`](#startDrums). [`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged) tells you when it changes, and [`OAVp5.drums.copyText`](#OAVp5.drums.copyText) is the same line wrapped in a `startDrums("…")` call.
description.zh: 把它畫在畫布上，錄影就錄得到（`text(OAVp5.drums.src, 20, 30)`），或是存起來，之後用 [`startDrums(src)`](#startDrums) 回到這個節奏。它改變的時候 [`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged) 會通知你，[`OAVp5.drums.copyText`](#OAVp5.drums.copyText) 則是同一行字外面包上 `startDrums("…")`。

value.en: Read fresh each time. A preset or a grid you drew shows as the line it is written as, and it changes with every click on a cell and every typed edit.
value.zh: 每次讀都是當下的值。預設節奏或你自己畫的格子，會顯示成它對應的那一行字，每點一次格子、每改一次文字，它就跟著變。

needs.en: It is `''` until [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) has loaded the machine and the rhythm module, a fraction of a second.
needs.zh: 在 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 載入鼓機和節奏模組之前都是 `''`，大約不到一秒。

caption.en: The preset "half time" written as the line of rhythm it is; click cells on the grid and the line is rewritten.
caption.zh: 預設節奏 "half time" 對應的那一行字，在格子上點一點，這一行就會被改寫。

summary.en: Where the drum machine is: `'off'`, `'loading'`, `'on'`, `'stopped'` or `'error'`.
summary.zh: 鼓機現在在哪個階段：`'off'`、`'loading'`、`'on'`、`'stopped'` 或 `'error'`。

description.en: `'loading'` is the moment after [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) while the module arrives, `'on'` is playing, `'stopped'` is a grid that is up but not playing (its checkbox is unticked), `'off'` is where it starts and where [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) leaves it, and `'error'` means @openav/drums could not be loaded. [`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) is `state === 'on'`.
description.zh: `'loading'` 是呼叫 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 之後，模組還在下載的那段時間，`'on'` 是正在播，`'stopped'` 是格子還在但沒在播（它的勾選框取消勾選了），`'off'` 是起點，也是 [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) 之後的狀態，`'error'` 表示 @openav/drums 載入失敗。[`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) 就是 `state === 'on'`。

value.en: Starts as `'off'` and changes when the machine loads, plays, is stopped or fails.
value.zh: 一開始是 `'off'`，鼓機載入、播放、停止或失敗的時候就跟著變。

caption.en: Shows "loading" for a moment, then "on". Untick the checkbox on the grid and it reads "stopped".
caption.zh: 先短暫顯示 "loading"，然後是 "on"。把鼓機上的勾選框取消勾選，就變成 "stopped"。

tbd.en: After [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) and a second [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) the state stayed `'off'` while the machine played again (Chromium, oav-p5 0.8.0). Not confirmed whether that is intended.
tbd.zh: 呼叫 [`stopDrums()`](#stopDrums) 之後再呼叫一次 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)，鼓機明明又在播，狀態卻仍是 `'off'`（Chromium，oav-p5 0.8.0）。這是不是預期的行為，還沒有確認。

summary.en: The rhythm that plays now as a link that opens it at strudel.cc, or an empty string when there is none.
summary.zh: 現在播的節奏做成的連結，打開就會在 strudel.cc 裡開啟同一個節奏，沒有的時候是空字串。

description.en: It holds the line as `s("…")` with `setcpm(bpm/4)` (one bar here is one Strudel cycle of four beats), the same thing the "Open in Strudel" link on the card opens. Open it in a new tab: `window.open(OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl)` from a click handler.
description.zh: 裡面是那一行節奏，寫成 `s("…")`，再加上 `setcpm(bpm/4)`（這裡的一小節就是 Strudel 的一個週期，四拍），跟卡片上「在 Strudel 打開」連結開啟的是同一個東西。用新分頁打開它：在點擊的處理函式裡寫 `window.open(OAVp5.drums.strudelUrl)`。

value.en: A `https://strudel.cc/#…` address, read fresh each time. `''` before the machine has loaded.
value.zh: 一個 `https://strudel.cc/#…` 的網址，每次讀都是當下的。鼓機載入之前是 `''`。

caption.en: Shows the start of the link; a click opens it at strudel.cc in a new tab.
caption.zh: 顯示連結的開頭，點一下就在新分頁的 strudel.cc 裡打開。

tbd.en: Not tried: whether the sketch frame of OpenProcessing lets `window.open` open the link.
tbd.zh: 還沒試過：OpenProcessing 的草圖框是否允許 `window.open` 開啟這個連結。

summary.en: Goes back one line of rhythm, like ↶ on the card; returns `true` if there was an earlier line.
summary.zh: 回到上一行節奏，跟卡片上的 ↶ 一樣，如果有上一行就回傳 `true`。

description.en: The line before the current one is played again and removed from the history. [`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged) is called with `how` equal to `'undo'`. On the card the same thing is ⌘Z or Ctrl+Z after touching it.
description.zh: 上一行會再播一次，並從歷史清單裡拿掉。[`rhythmChanged()`](#rhythmChanged) 會被呼叫，`how` 是 `'undo'`。在卡片上，點一下卡片之後按 ⌘Z 或 Ctrl+Z 也是同樣的事。

returns.en: `true` if it went back one line, `false` if [`OAVp5.drums.history`](#OAVp5.drums.history) was empty or the machine is not loaded.
returns.zh: 回到上一行就是 `true`，[`OAVp5.drums.history`](#OAVp5.drums.history) 是空的、或鼓機還沒載入就是 `false`。

caption.en: Click to change the line, press z to go back to the one before.
caption.zh: 點一下換一行節奏，按 z 回到前一行。

summary.en: A drum kit made of Web Audio synthesis, with no sample files: General MIDI drum notes go in, drum sounds come out.
summary.zh: 一組用 Web Audio 合成的鼓組，沒有取樣檔：送進 General MIDI 的鼓音符，就打出鼓聲。

description.en: It follows the small engine contract of [`@openav/sound`](#Sound), so the same shell and the same signals drive it: `enable()` makes the `AudioContext`, `noteOn(note, vel01, time)` plays a drum, `set(key, value)` sets a param. The kit has thirteen voices (see [`GM`](#GM)): kick, rim, snare, clap, low tom, hat, pedal hat, tom, open hat, high tom, crash, ride and cowbell. A note the kit does not know (any melodic note) plays nothing and returns `null`.
description.zh: 它遵守 [`@openav/sound`](#Sound) 的小小引擎約定，所以同一個外殼、同樣的訊號都能驅動它：`enable()` 建立 `AudioContext`，`noteOn(note, vel01, time)` 打一下鼓，`set(key, value)` 設定參數。鼓組有十三種鼓聲（見 [`GM`](#GM)）：大鼓、鼓邊、小鼓、拍手、落地鼓、鈸、踩鈸、中鼓、開鈸、高音中鼓、碎音鈸、疊音鈸、牛鈴。鼓組不認得的音符（任何旋律音符）不會發聲，並回傳 `null`。

description.en: `noteOn(note, vel01, time)` returns `{ time, cancel() }`, or `null` before `enable()` or for a note it does not play. `time` is on the kit's own clock (`engine.context.currentTime`); left out, or already past, the hit sounds now. `cancel()` silences a hit that has not started, which is how [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport) takes back what it scheduled when the tempo changes. `hit('crash', 0.9)` plays a voice by name (or a note number) for code that is not a MIDI pad. There is one param, `kitVolume`, from −30 to 0 dB (default −6).
description.zh: `noteOn(note, vel01, time)` 回傳 `{ time, cancel() }`，在 `enable()` 之前，或遇到它不打的音符時回傳 `null`。`time` 是鼓組自己的時鐘（`engine.context.currentTime`）上的時間。沒給，或已經過了，這一下就馬上響。`cancel()` 能讓還沒開始的鼓靜音，[`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport) 在速度改變時就是用它把排好的收回來。`hit('crash', 0.9)` 用名字（或音符號碼）打一種鼓，給不是 MIDI 墊子的程式用。它有一個參數 `kitVolume`，從 −30 到 0 dB（預設 −6）。

description.en: Once enabled, `engine.context` is its `AudioContext` and `engine.output` is the node that goes to the speakers, which a recorder can tap. Before that both are `null`. `noteOff()` does nothing (drums ring out) and `dispose()` closes the context.
description.zh: 啟用之後，`engine.context` 是它的 `AudioContext`，`engine.output` 是接到喇叭的節點，錄音器可以從這裡接。在那之前兩個都是 `null`。`noteOff()` 什麼都不做（鼓聲自己響完），`dispose()` 會關掉 context。

params.name: samples
params.en: Play audio files instead of the synthesis: `{ 36: 'kick.wav', 38: 'snare.wav' }`, MIDI note number to URL. They are fetched and decoded by `enable()`; a file that fails to load is skipped without an error, and a note of the kit then plays its synthesized sound instead.
params.zh: 用音檔取代合成：`{ 36: 'kick.wav', 38: 'snare.wav' }`，MIDI 音符號碼對應網址。`enable()` 會去下載並解碼。載入失敗的檔案會被略過、不報錯，屬於鼓組的音符就改用合成的聲音打。

returns.en: An engine: `{ params, context, output, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), hit(what, vel01, time), noteOff(), set(key, value), dispose() }`.
returns.zh: 一個引擎：`{ params, context, output, enable(), noteOn(note, vel01, time), hit(what, vel01, time), noteOff(), set(key, value), dispose() }`。

needs.en: `await kit.enable()` from a click: browsers start audio only after a user gesture. [`mountDrums()`](#mountDrums) and [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport) with `autoEnable` do that for you on the first hit.
needs.zh: 要在點擊裡 `await kit.enable()`：瀏覽器要使用者做過一個動作才讓聲音開始。[`mountDrums()`](#mountDrums) 和 `autoEnable` 的 [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport) 會在第一下鼓的時候替你做。

caption.en: Before `enable()` the kit has a param but no sound and no `AudioContext`: `noteOn()` returns `null`.
caption.zh: 在 `enable()` 之前，鼓組有參數但沒有聲音也沒有 `AudioContext`：`noteOn()` 回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Click the page: a kick, then a snare half a second later and a crash after a second. The times are on the kit's own audio clock.
caption.zh: 在頁面上點一下：先是大鼓，半秒後小鼓，一秒後碎音鈸。時間是鼓組自己的音訊時鐘上的時間。

summary.en: The name of a drum for the screen, in English or in Chinese: `drumName('lowtom')` is `'low tom'`.
summary.zh: 給人讀的鼓的名字，英文或中文：`drumName('lowtom', 'zh')` 是 `'落地鼓'`。

description.en: The drum names inside code stay English everywhere (`'kick'`, `'snare'`), and this is for the screen: the row labels of the drum machine card use it, and with `'zh'` they are written in Chinese.
description.zh: 程式裡的鼓的名字到處都保持英文（`'kick'`、`'snare'`），這個函式是給畫面顯示用的：鼓機卡的列標籤就是用它，中文的瀏覽器裡是 大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍手。

params.name: voice
params.en: The drum: `kick`, `snare`, `hat`, `clap`, `openhat`, `pedalhat`, `rim`, `lowtom`, `tom`, `hightom`, `crash`, `ride` or `cowbell`.
params.zh: 哪種鼓：`kick`、`snare`、`hat`、`clap`、`openhat`、`pedalhat`、`rim`、`lowtom`、`tom`、`hightom`、`crash`、`ride`、`cowbell`。

params.name: lang
params.en: `'zh'` for Chinese; anything else is English.
params.zh: `'zh'` 是中文。其他都是英文。

returns.en: The name, or `voice` itself if it is not a drum of the kit.
returns.zh: 名字。如果 `voice` 不是鼓組的鼓，就原樣回傳 `voice`。

examples.code:
import { drumName } from '@openav/drums';

console.log(drumName('kick'), drumName('kick', 'zh'));         // kick, then the Chinese name of the kick
console.log(drumName('openhat', 'zh'), drumName('lowtom', 'zh')); // Chinese names of the open hat and the low tom
console.log(drumName('banjo', 'zh'));                           // banjo, not a drum: returned as is

caption.en: Logs a few drums in English and in Chinese, and what a name that is not a drum gives back.
caption.zh: 印出幾種鼓的英文和中文名字，以及不是鼓的名字會得到什麼。

entries.name: DrumScheduler
entries.signature: new DrumScheduler({ bpm = 112, swing = 0, humanize = 0.35, lookahead = 0.1, pattern = 'four on floor', seed = 0, random = Math.random } = {})

summary.en: Pure drum logic with no timers and no audio: a grid or a line of rhythm goes in, timed events come out, ahead of time, on any clock you pass.
summary.zh: 純粹的鼓的邏輯，沒有計時器也沒有聲音：放進一張格子圖或一行節奏，就提前吐出有時間的事件，時鐘由你傳進來。

description.en: A `DrumScheduler` knows what plays in which bar, and when a bar happens, but it owns no clock: every time you give it is in seconds on one clock of your choosing, so it runs the same under a fake clock in a test as under the audio clock in a page. [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport) is the runtime that feeds it the real one. Use the scheduler on its own when you want drum events as data, for your own sound engine or a test.
description.zh: `DrumScheduler` 知道哪個小節要打什麼，也知道一個小節在什麼時候發生，但它沒有自己的時鐘：你給它的每個時間，都是你選的某一個時鐘上的秒數，所以它在測試裡用假時鐘跑、在頁面裡用音訊時鐘跑，結果一樣。[`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport) 是把真的時鐘餵給它的執行環境。想把鼓的事件當資料用，例如給自己的發聲引擎或測試，就單獨用排程器。

description.en: The loop is: `start(at)` puts the downbeat of bar 1 at time `at`. Then, again and again, `advance(now)` schedules everything up to `now + lookahead` and returns the new events, in order. `due(t)` hands out the events whose time has come (they stay in `queue` until then). Two kinds of event come out: a step `{ kind: 'step', i, n, bar, pos, time }` for every 16th, and a hit `{ kind: 'hit', voice, vel, pos, n, bar, token, word, layer, dur, time }`. `pos` counts bars from the start (0 is the downbeat of bar 1, 1.5 is half way through bar 2), `time` is in your seconds, `i` is the step 0..15 and `n` counts steps since the start. For a grid, the step comes before its hits. `token`, `word`, `layer` and `dur` come from a line of rhythm and are `null` or `undefined` for a grid.
description.zh: 流程是這樣：`start(at)` 讓第 1 小節的強拍落在時間 `at`。然後一再地呼叫 `advance(now)`，它排好直到 `now + lookahead` 的全部，並依序回傳新的事件。`due(t)` 把時間到了的事件交出來（在那之前它們留在 `queue` 裡）。事件有兩種：每個十六分音符一個步 `{ kind: 'step', i, n, bar, pos, time }`，和一下鼓 `{ kind: 'hit', voice, vel, pos, n, bar, token, word, layer, dur, time }`。`pos` 從開始算起以小節為單位（0 是第 1 小節的強拍，1.5 是第 2 小節的一半），`time` 是你的時鐘的秒數，`i` 是步 0..15，`n` 是從開始算起的步數。格子圖的話，步在它的鼓之前。`token`、`word`、`layer`、`dur` 來自一行節奏，格子圖的話是 `null` 或 `undefined`。

description.en: Positions turn into seconds by multiplication from the last tempo anchor, never by adding up frame times, so a thousand bars later nothing has drifted (the test measures under a microsecond). A tempo change adds an anchor, so the past keeps the tempo it had.
description.zh: 位置是從最近一個速度錨點用乘法換成秒的，不是把畫面時間加起來，所以一千個小節之後也沒有漂移（測試量到的誤差不到一微秒）。速度改變會多加一個錨點，所以過去保持它當時的速度。

params.name: bpm
params.en: The tempo, in beats per minute. A value that is not above 0 becomes 112.
params.zh: 速度，每分鐘幾拍。不大於 0 的值會變成 112。

params.name: swing
params.en: 0 to 0.5: every odd 16th is that share of a 16th late. 0 is straight.
params.zh: 0 到 0.5：每個奇數的十六分音符晚那麼多個十六分音符。0 是直的。

params.name: humanize
params.en: 0..1: a few milliseconds late and a little softer or louder, so it grooves instead of ticking. Use 0 for exact, repeatable times.
params.zh: 0..1：晚幾毫秒、力道有一點大小變化，讓它有律動而不是機械的滴答。要精準、可重複的時間就用 0。

params.name: lookahead
params.en: Seconds `advance()` schedules beyond `now`.
params.zh: `advance()` 在 `now` 之後多排幾秒。

params.name: pattern
params.en: A preset name from [`PATTERNS`](#PATTERNS), your own grid, or a compiled line of rhythm (see `setPattern()`).
params.zh: [`PATTERNS`](#PATTERNS) 裡的預設名稱、你自己的格子圖，或編譯過的一行節奏（見 `setPattern()`）。

params.name: seed
params.en: Passed to the rhythm line as `eventsInBar(bar, { seed })`, so each `?` decides the same way every time.
params.zh: 當作 `eventsInBar(bar, { seed })` 交給那一行節奏，讓每個 `?` 每次都做同樣的決定。

params.name: random
params.en: Where `humanize` gets its randomness: a function that returns a number from 0 up to 1. Pass your own for repeatable output.
params.zh: `humanize` 的隨機從哪裡來：回傳 0 到 1 之間數字的函式。傳自己的就能得到可重複的結果。

caption.en: No clock, no audio: the scheduler is asked for one bar of four on the floor at 120 bpm and logs the hits heard in the first half second, with their times in seconds.
caption.zh: 沒有時鐘、沒有聲音：向排程器要 120 bpm 四四拍的一個小節，印出前半秒聽到的鼓，連同以秒為單位的時間。

caption.en: A line of rhythm goes in: its first bar is read as hits, then as a 16-step grid, and a tempo change halves the speed at time 12 without moving what came before.
caption.zh: 放進一行節奏：先把它的第一小節讀成鼓點，再讀成 16 格的格子圖，然後在時間 12 把速度減半，在那之前的不受影響。

members.name: setPattern
members.doc: A preset name, your own grid { kick: 'x...x...', … }, or a compiled rhythm (anything with eventsInBar(bar, { seed }), i.e.

members.name: gridOf
members.doc: bar `bar` of what plays, on the 16 steps of the four lanes: { grid, offGrid (hits moved to the nearest step), dropped (voices the grid has no lane for) }

members.name: takeover
members.doc: the rhythm string becomes the grid it plays in `bar` (a click on a cell: the cells take over)

members.name: barEvents
members.doc: the hits of bar `bar` (1 = the first): [{ voice, pos 0..1, vel?, token?, word?, layer?

members.name: posAt
members.doc: where the music is at time t, in bars from the start (bar 1's downbeat = 0; negative before it)

members.name: timeAt
members.doc: when position p sounds (before swing and humanize)

members.name: phaseAt
members.doc: { pos, bar 0..1 through the bar, beat 0..1 through the beat } at time t (0 before the first downbeat)

members.name: stop
members.doc: stop: what was scheduled and not yet heard (to take back from the kit)

members.name: setBpm
members.doc: the tempo from time `at` on (left out: from the end of what is already scheduled, so nothing is taken back) → dropped

members.name: rewind
members.doc: take back everything scheduled at or after time `at` (the next advance makes it again, from the pattern and the tempo as they are then) → the events taken back.

members.name: advance
members.doc: schedule up to now + lookahead → the new events, in order (they are in `queue` too, until due() hands them out)

members.name: due
members.doc: the events heard by time t, in order (removed from the queue)

entries.name: DrumSequencer
entries.signature: new DrumSequencer({ onHit, onStep = null, bpm = 112, swing = 0.12, humanize = 0.35, pattern = 'four on floor' } = {})

summary.en: A 16-step, four-lane drum pattern clock that you move forward with `update(dt)` every frame and that calls your function for each hit.
summary.zh: 一個 16 步、四條軌道的鼓節奏時鐘，每個畫面用 `update(dt)` 往前推，每一下鼓就呼叫你的函式。

description.en: It is the simplest clock: no audio, no timers, no DOM. Make it with an `onHit` that does something, call `toggle(true)`, then call `update(dt)` once per frame with the seconds since the last frame. It walks through the 16 steps of a bar (a 16th lasts `60 / bpm / 4` seconds) and calls `onHit(lane, velocity)` for each hit in the four lanes `kick`, `snare`, `hat` and `clap`. A hit is told in the frame in which it is due, so it can be late by up to a frame, and nothing happens in a hidden tab. For a steady beat under a heavy frame, use [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport).
description.zh: 這是最簡單的時鐘：沒有聲音、沒有計時器、沒有 DOM。做一個會做事的 `onHit`，呼叫 `toggle(true)`，然後每個畫面用距離上一個畫面過了幾秒呼叫 `update(dt)`。它會走過一個小節的 16 步（一個十六分音符是 `60 / bpm / 4` 秒），每一下 `kick`、`snare`、`hat`、`clap` 四條軌道上的鼓就呼叫 `onHit(lane, velocity)`。鼓是在到時間的那個畫面才被告知，所以最多會晚一個畫面，分頁被藏起來的時候什麼都不會發生。要在畫面很重的時候也有穩的節拍，用 [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport)。

description.en: The grid is `seq.grid`: `{ kick: [0|1 × 16], snare, hat, clap }`. `seq.pattern` is the preset name, or `'custom'` once you changed a cell or gave your own grid. `seq.playing`, `seq.bpm`, `seq.swing` and `seq.humanize` are plain properties you can read and set.
description.zh: 格子圖是 `seq.grid`：`{ kick: [0|1 × 16], snare, hat, clap }`。`seq.pattern` 是預設的名稱，改過格子或給了自己的格子圖之後就是 `'custom'`。`seq.playing`、`seq.bpm`、`seq.swing`、`seq.humanize` 都是可以直接讀和設的普通屬性。

params.name: onHit
params.en: `onHit(lane, velocity)` for every hit: `lane` is `'kick'`, `'snare'`, `'hat'` or `'clap'`, `velocity` is 0.15 to 1. You decide what a hit does: play a sound, draw, publish a signal.
params.zh: 每一下鼓呼叫 `onHit(lane, velocity)`：`lane` 是 `'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'`、`'clap'`，`velocity` 是 0.15 到 1。一下鼓要做什麼由你決定：發聲、畫圖、發布訊號。

params.name: onStep
params.en: `onStep(i, n)` for every 16th step: `i` is 0..15, `n` counts steps since the start. It comes before that step's hits. A timeline counts bars on it.
params.zh: 每個十六分音符步呼叫 `onStep(i, n)`：`i` 是 0..15，`n` 是從開始算起的步數。它在那一步的鼓之前。時間軸靠它數小節。

params.name: bpm
params.en: The tempo, in beats per minute. It can be changed later: `seq.bpm = 90`.
params.zh: 速度，每分鐘幾拍。之後可以改：`seq.bpm = 90`。

params.name: swing
params.en: 0 to 0.5: every odd 16th is that share of a 16th late. 0 is straight.
params.zh: 0 到 0.5：每個奇數的十六分音符晚那麼多個十六分音符。0 是直的。

params.name: humanize
params.en: 0..1: some hits a few milliseconds late and a little softer or louder. Use 0 for exact, repeatable velocities (0.9 on the beat, 0.6 between).
params.zh: 0..1：有些鼓晚幾毫秒、力道有一點大小。要精準、可重複的力道就用 0（拍點上 0.9，其他 0.6）。

params.name: pattern
params.en: A preset name from [`PATTERNS`](#PATTERNS) or your own grid.
params.zh: [`PATTERNS`](#PATTERNS) 裡的預設名稱，或你自己的格子圖。

caption.en: Runs half a second of four on the floor with no sound and no screen, and logs the hits: a kick and a hat on the downbeat, the off-beat hat, then kick, snare and hat on beat 2.
caption.zh: 不用聲音也不用畫面，跑半秒的四四拍，印出鼓點：強拍上的大鼓和鈸、反拍的鈸，然後第二拍的大鼓、小鼓和鈸。

caption.en: Sixteen blocks on the canvas, and a bright one runs along them in time with the beat. There is no sound: `onHit` is where you would play one.
caption.zh: 畫布上有十六個方塊，亮的那一個跟著節拍跑。這裡沒有聲音：`onHit` 就是你放發聲程式的地方。

members.name: setPattern
members.doc: A preset name ('breakbeat'), or your own grid { kick: 'x...x...x...x...', snare: …, hat: …, clap: … } (= 'custom'; a lane left out is silent).

entries.name: DrumTransport
entries.signature: new DrumTransport({ scheduler = new DrumScheduler(), engine = null, onStep = null, onHit = null, onLate = null, autoEnable = false, now = perfNow, hidden = pageHidden, heartbeat = 'auto', tick = 0.025, latency = 'auto', stale = 0.25, startDelay = 0.05 } = {})

summary.en: The runtime around a DrumScheduler: it hands every hit to the kit ahead of time on its audio clock, and tells the page each step and hit when it is heard.
summary.zh: 包在 DrumScheduler 外面的執行環境：它用鼓組的音訊時鐘，把每一下鼓提前交給鼓組，並在聽到的時候才告訴頁面每一步和每一下。

description.en: A page that plays a hit in the frame it is due is late by up to a frame, and silent when its tab is hidden. `DrumTransport` fixes both. A timer (the heartbeat, from a Web Worker, 25 ms by default) looks 0.1 seconds ahead on the kit's own audio clock and hands the kit every hit with its exact start time. The page is told separately, in the frame in which each step and hit is **heard**: its time plus the output latency the browser reports. So the beat stays steady under a heavy `draw()` and in a hidden tab, and the callbacks still arrive in order: a step before its hits, hits in time order.
description.zh: 在到時間的那個畫面才打的鼓，最多會晚一個畫面，分頁被藏起來的時候還會停。`DrumTransport` 兩個都解決。一個計時器（心跳，預設用 Web Worker，每 25 毫秒一次）在鼓組自己的音訊時鐘上往前看 0.1 秒，把每一下鼓連同確切的開始時間交給鼓組。頁面則是另外被通知，在每一步、每一下**被聽到**的那個畫面：它的時間加上瀏覽器回報的輸出延遲。所以畫面很重或分頁被藏起來，節拍還是穩的，回呼也依然按順序到：一步在它的鼓之前，鼓依時間排序。

description.en: Call `start()`, then `frame()` once per animation frame. The heartbeat calls `pump()` for you. Tempo and pattern changes (`setBpm()`, `setPattern()`, `toggleCell()`) take back what was already handed over after now and make it again, so no hit is doubled or lost. Before the kit's `AudioContext` runs (no click yet) the clock runs on `now()` and the callbacks run but nothing sounds; once it runs, the hits from then on sound, and none from before.
description.zh: 呼叫 `start()`，然後每個動畫畫面呼叫一次 `frame()`。心跳會替你呼叫 `pump()`。速度和節奏的改變（`setBpm()`、`setPattern()`、`toggleCell()`）會把現在之後已經交出去的收回來重做，所以不會有鼓重複或漏掉。鼓組的 `AudioContext` 還沒跑（還沒點擊）的時候，時鐘用 `now()` 跑，回呼照常執行但沒有聲音。開始跑之後，從那之後的鼓才會響，之前的不補。

description.en: A hidden page, or a frame loop that catches up more than `stale` seconds late, tells its steps quietly: `ev.quiet` is true, the clock moves and cues fire, but `onHit` is not called, and of several bar starts at once only the last has `ev.announce`. Nothing floods the page when the tab comes back. If a `draw()` ever holds the thread longer than the lookahead, the lookahead grows to 0.3 seconds (`info().extended`).
description.zh: 頁面被藏起來，或畫面迴圈追趕時已經晚了超過 `stale` 秒的時候，步會被安靜地告知：`ev.quiet` 是 true，時鐘照走、cue 照發，但 `onHit` 不會被呼叫，而且同時到的好幾個小節開頭，只有最後一個有 `ev.announce`。分頁回來的時候不會一下子湧進一大堆。如果某個 `draw()` 佔住執行緒的時間比預讀還長，預讀會增加到 0.3 秒（`info().extended`）。

description.en: It has the getters `playing`, `pattern`, `grid`, `mode`, `text`, `bpm`, `swing`, `humanize` and `lookahead` of its scheduler; `bpm`, `swing` and `humanize` can also be set. You usually get one through [`mountDrums()`](#mountDrums) with `clock: 'lookahead'`; build your own when you want the clock without the card.
description.zh: 它有它的排程器的 getter：`playing`、`pattern`、`grid`、`mode`、`text`、`bpm`、`swing`、`humanize`、`lookahead`。`bpm`、`swing`、`humanize` 也可以設定。通常是透過 `clock: 'lookahead'` 的 [`mountDrums()`](#mountDrums) 拿到一個。想要時鐘而不要卡片的時候再自己建。

params.name: scheduler
params.en: The [`DrumScheduler`](#DrumScheduler) that decides what is played when.
params.zh: 決定什麼時候打什麼的 [`DrumScheduler`](#DrumScheduler)。

params.name: engine
params.en: The sound engine, usually a [`drumEngine()`](#drumEngine). If it has a `context` property (an `AudioContext`, or `null` before it is enabled), hits are scheduled ahead on that clock. If not, each hit is played by calling `engine.noteOn(note, vel)` at the moment it is heard.
params.zh: 發聲的引擎，通常是 [`drumEngine()`](#drumEngine)。它有 `context` 這個屬性（一個 `AudioContext`，啟用之前是 `null`）的話，鼓點就用那個時鐘提前排程。沒有的話，每一下鼓就在聽到的那一刻呼叫 `engine.noteOn(note, vel)` 來打。

params.name: onStep
params.en: `onStep(i, n, ev)` for every 16th step when it is heard. `ev.quiet` and `ev.announce` say whether it was told quietly (below).
params.zh: `onStep(i, n, ev)`，每個十六分音符步在聽到的時候呼叫。`ev.quiet` 和 `ev.announce` 說明它是不是被安靜地告知（見下面）。

params.name: onHit
params.en: `onHit(voice, vel, ev)` for every drum hit when it is heard.
params.zh: `onHit(voice, vel, ev)`，每一下鼓在聽到的時候呼叫。

params.name: onLate
params.en: `onLate(margin, transport)`: a hit was handed to the kit after its time, because the page held the main thread longer than the lookahead. `margin` is how many seconds early it was (negative or tiny).
params.zh: `onLate(margin, transport)`：因為頁面佔住主執行緒的時間比預讀還長，有一下鼓交給鼓組的時候已經過了它的時間。`margin` 是它早了幾秒（負的或很小）。

params.name: autoEnable
params.en: Call `engine.enable()` by `start()` when the engine has no `AudioContext` yet.
params.zh: 引擎還沒有 `AudioContext` 的話，在 `start()` 時呼叫 `engine.enable()`。

params.name: now
params.en: A function that returns the time in seconds. Pass your own to drive the transport from a fake clock in a test.
params.zh: 回傳目前時間（秒）的函式。測試時傳自己的，就能用假的時鐘帶動傳輸控制。

params.name: hidden
params.en: A function that returns true while nobody can see the page.
params.zh: 沒有人看得到頁面時回傳 true 的函式。

params.name: heartbeat
params.en: Who calls `pump()`: `'auto'` a Web Worker timer (a hidden tab does not slow a worker), falling back to `setInterval`; `'interval'` always `setInterval`; `false` (or `'none'`) nobody, and you call `pump()` or `frame()` yourself.
params.zh: 誰來呼叫 `pump()`：`'auto'` 是 Web Worker 的計時器（被藏起來的分頁不會讓 worker 變慢），不行就退回 `setInterval`。`'interval'` 一律用 `setInterval`。`false`（或 `'none'`）是沒人叫，你自己呼叫 `pump()` 或 `frame()`。

params.name: tick
params.en: Seconds between two heartbeats.
params.zh: 兩次心跳之間隔幾秒。

params.name: latency
params.en: Seconds between a hit being scheduled and being heard. `'auto'` asks the browser (`getOutputTimestamp()`, `outputLatency`); a number sets it by hand.
params.zh: 一下鼓從排程到聽到之間隔幾秒。`'auto'` 向瀏覽器問（`getOutputTimestamp()`、`outputLatency`）。給數字就是手動設定。

params.name: stale
params.en: A step that is told more than this many seconds late (a frame loop catching up) is told quietly.
params.zh: 一步如果被告知的時候已經晚了超過這麼多秒（畫面迴圈在追趕），就會被安靜地告知。

params.name: startDelay
params.en: When the audio clock is running, the first downbeat is put this many seconds after `start()`, so the first hit is not already late.
params.zh: 音訊時鐘在跑的時候，第一個強拍會放在 `start()` 之後這麼多秒，這樣第一下才不會已經晚了。

caption.en: Runs a whole bar of four on the floor on a clock we move by hand, and logs what the page is told: the downbeats of each beat, the kicks and the snares on 2 and 4.
caption.zh: 在我們手動撥動的時鐘上跑完一整個小節的四四拍，印出頁面被告知的事：每一拍的強拍、大鼓，和第 2、4 拍的小鼓。

caption.en: Click the page and a breakbeat starts on the kit's audio clock; the console logs each hit when it is heard. Switch to another tab: the beat keeps going.
caption.zh: 在頁面上點一下，breakbeat 就用鼓組的音訊時鐘開始打。console 在聽到每一下的時候印出來。切到別的分頁：節拍照樣繼續。

members.name: times
members.doc: { sched, heard, live }: `sched` is the earliest time a hit can still go to the kit, `heard` what the listener hears right now.

members.name: toggle
members.doc: on: start from bar 1 (again, if it was playing), as the grid's checkbox does; off: stop

members.name: setBpm
members.doc: a new tempo from now on: what was scheduled after now is taken back and made again, so no hit doubles or goes missing

members.name: rewind
members.doc: a change is heard at once: what was scheduled after now (10 ms of margin: never a hit already sounding) is made again

members.name: pump
members.doc: the heartbeat: schedule ahead; and while no frame runs (a hidden tab, a sketch stuck for a moment) tell the page too

members.name: frame
members.doc: once a frame (and right before p5 draws): schedule, then tell the page every step and hit heard by now → those events

members.name: phase
members.doc: where the listener is: { bar 0..1 through the bar, beat 0..1 through the beat, pos bars since the start }; it holds still while the machine is stopped

members.name: heardAt
members.doc: the scheduler's time line (what is heard) at a moment of the `now` clock (performance.now() / 1000 in a page)

members.name: follow
members.signature: { pos = 0, at, bpm } = {}, { catchUp = 0.5, jump = 0.125, pull = 0.08, still = 0.0005 } = {}
members.doc: play on an external clock: position `pos` (bars from its start; 0 = the downbeat of bar 1) is heard at `at` (the `now` clock: performance.now() / 1000, the MIDI timestamp / 1000), the tempo is `bpm`.

members.name: followInfo
members.doc: { bpm, err (s, the last correction), jumps, steers, at } while following; null when it never did

members.name: unfollow
members.doc: stop following (the machine keeps the tempo it has, on its own clock)

summary.en: The General MIDI drum note each drum of the kit plays: `GM.kick` is 36, `GM.snare` is 38.
summary.zh: 鼓組裡每種鼓對應的 General MIDI 鼓音符：`GM.kick` 是 36，`GM.snare` 是 38。

description.en: Drum pads and drum machines send these notes on MIDI channel 10. The drum machine sends them as `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 10 }` for every hit, so anything that listens to MIDI hears the drums. The reverse, from a note to a drum, is [`voiceForNote()`](#voiceForNote), which also knows the neighbouring General MIDI notes (35 is also a kick, 40 is also a snare).
description.zh: 打擊墊和鼓機在 MIDI 頻道 10 送這些音符。鼓機每打一下就送一個 `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 10 }`，所以任何聽 MIDI 的東西都聽得到鼓。從音符反查是哪種鼓用 [`voiceForNote()`](#voiceForNote)，它也認得 General MIDI 相鄰的音符（35 也是大鼓，40 也是小鼓）。

value.en: `{ kick: 36, rim: 37, snare: 38, clap: 39, lowtom: 41, hat: 42, pedalhat: 44, tom: 45, openhat: 46, hightom: 48, crash: 49, ride: 51, cowbell: 56 }`: drum name to MIDI note number.
value.zh: `{ kick: 36, rim: 37, snare: 38, clap: 39, lowtom: 41, hat: 42, pedalhat: 44, tom: 45, openhat: 46, hightom: 48, crash: 49, ride: 51, cowbell: 56 }`：鼓的名字對應 MIDI 音符號碼。

examples.code:
import { GM, voiceForNote } from '@openav/drums';

console.log(GM.kick, GM.snare, GM.hat);        // 36 38 42
console.log(Object.keys(GM).length);            // 13
console.log(voiceForNote(GM.crash));            // crash

caption.en: Logs the notes of three drums, how many drums the kit has, and that the note of a drum maps back to the drum.
caption.zh: 印出三種鼓的音符、鼓組有幾種鼓，以及鼓的音符可以反查回那種鼓。

summary.en: Turns a lane written as text, like 'x...x...x...x...', or as a list into 16 steps of 0 and 1.
summary.zh: 把寫成文字的軌道，像 'x...x...x...x...'，或寫成陣列的軌道，變成 16 格 0 和 1。

description.en: It is how every grid you write is read: `{ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }` in [`DrumSequencer`](#DrumSequencer), [`DrumScheduler`](#DrumScheduler) and [`startDrums()`](#startDrums). `'x... x... x... x...'` and `'1000100010001000'` are the same lane. Note that the dot is a rest here, and only here: in a line of rhythm (see [`compile()`](#compile)) a rest is `~`.
description.zh: 你寫的每一張格子圖都是這樣被讀的：[`DrumSequencer`](#DrumSequencer)、[`DrumScheduler`](#DrumScheduler) 和 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 裡的 `{ kick: 'x...x...x...x...' }`。`'x... x... x... x...'` 和 `'1000100010001000'` 是同一條軌道。注意點在這裡是休止，只有在這裡：一行節奏（見 [`compile()`](#compile)）裡的休止是 `~`。

params.name: v
params.en: The lane. In text, `x`, `X` and `1` are hits and everything else is a rest; spaces and `|` are ignored, so they can help the eye. In a list, `1` and `true` are hits.
params.zh: 軌道。文字的話，`x`、`X`、`1` 是鼓點，其他都是休止。空白和 `|` 會被忽略，可以用來幫助眼睛。陣列的話，`1` 和 `true` 是鼓點。

returns.en: An array of 16 numbers, 1 for a hit and 0 for a rest. A short lane is padded with rests, a long one is cut at 16.
returns.zh: 一個 16 個數字的陣列，1 是鼓點、0 是休止。太短的軌道用休止補滿，太長的在第 16 格截掉。

examples.code:
import { laneSteps } from '@openav/drums';

console.log(laneSteps('x... x... x... x...').join(''));   // 1000100010001000
console.log(laneSteps([1, 0, true]).join(''));            // 1010000000000000
console.log(laneSteps('x').length, laneSteps('x'.repeat(40)).length);   // 16 16

caption.en: Logs a lane written with spaces, a lane written as a list, and that any length comes out as 16 steps.
caption.zh: 印出用空白寫的軌道、用陣列寫的軌道，以及不管多長出來都是 16 格。

entries.name: mountDrums
entries.signature: mountDrums(container, { signals, engine = null, autoEnableEngine = true, onStep = null, onHit = null, onTakeover = null, bpm = 112, pattern = 'four on floor', clock = 'frame', lang = 'en', heartbeat = 'auto', latency = 'auto', now, hidden, rhythm = null, onRhythm = null, onLossy = null, onEditError = null, copyText = null, strudelComment = '' } = {})

summary.en: Puts a drum machine on the page: a step grid, a transport and a line of rhythm you can type into. It publishes every hit as `drum/*` signals.
summary.zh: 在頁面上放一台鼓機：步進格子、播放控制，和一行可以直接打字修改的節奏。它把每一下鼓發布成 `drum/*` 訊號。

description.en: `mountDrums(el, { signals })` builds a drum machine card inside `el`: a play checkbox, a preset menu, a tempo slider, the bar it is in, and a grid with a lane per drum (kick, snare, hat, clap, and a row of their own for the crash, ride, toms and open hat that a line of rhythm uses). A click on a cell toggles it. The returned object lets you do from code what the card does with the mouse: `play(true)`, `setPattern('breakbeat')`, `setBpm(96)`.
description.zh: `mountDrums(el, { signals })` 在 `el` 裡蓋一張鼓機卡：播放勾選框、預設選單、速度滑桿、現在在第幾小節，和一個每種鼓一條軌道的格子（大鼓、小鼓、鈸、拍手，一行節奏用到的碎音鈸、疊音鈸、中鼓、開鈸各有自己的一列）。點一個格子就切換它。回傳的物件讓你用程式做卡片上用滑鼠做的事：`play(true)`、`setPattern('breakbeat')`、`setBpm(96)`。

description.en: **You must call `drums.update(dt)` every frame**, with the seconds since the last one. It moves the machine (with the frame clock), tells your `onStep` and `onHit` what is heard, paints the grid and lets the `drum/*/env` signals decay. A machine that is never updated does not move.
description.zh: **每個畫面都要呼叫 `drums.update(dt)`**，參數是距離上一個畫面過了幾秒。它讓鼓機前進（用 frame 時鐘的時候）、把聽到的事告訴你的 `onStep` 和 `onHit`、畫格子，並讓 `drum/*/env` 訊號衰減。從來不更新的鼓機不會動。

description.en: Hits travel the same road as a drummer heard through the microphone, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over unchanged: `drum/kick`, `drum/snare`, `drum/hat`, `drum/clap` as pulses with `{ level }`, `drum/<voice>/env` as continuous 0..1 values, and `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 10 }` with the General MIDI drum note (see [`GM`](#GM)). A voice a line of rhythm adds, like `drum/crash`, is defined the first time it is hit.
description.zh: 鼓點走的路跟麥克風聽到的鼓手一樣，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成它：`drum/kick`、`drum/snare`、`drum/hat`、`drum/clap` 是帶 `{ level }` 的脈衝，`drum/<voice>/env` 是 0..1 的連續值，還有 `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 10 }`，音符是 General MIDI 的鼓音符（見 [`GM`](#GM)）。一行節奏多出來的鼓，像 `drum/crash`，會在第一次被打到的時候才定義。

description.en: Give it the pattern module (`rhythm`) and the line of rhythm is always shown over the grid: a preset shows the line its grid is (`'four on floor'` is `bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8`), and the word that sounds lights up. Then the two edit each other. A click on a cell rewrites the line (with [`fromGrid()`](#fromGrid)). Typing in the line changes the cells: Enter, or 400 ms without a key, plays what was typed. A mistake is marked red, `onEditError` is told, and the last line that worked keeps playing. Escape drops what was not played yet. Every change is kept in `history`; **↶** on the card, or `Cmd/Ctrl+Z` after touching the card, goes back one. **Copy** puts the line on the clipboard and **Open in Strudel** opens it at strudel.cc in a new tab ([`strudelUrl()`](#strudelUrl)).
