description.zh: 把鼓的模組（`rhythm`）交給它，格子上面就一直有那一行節奏：預設會顯示它的格子圖是哪一行（`'four on floor'` 就是 `bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8`），正在響的字會亮起來。接著兩邊互相修改。點一個格子會改寫那一行（用 [`fromGrid()`](#fromGrid)）。在那一行打字會改變格子：按 Enter，或停手 400 毫秒，就播放打進去的內容。有錯的地方標紅、通知 `onEditError`，上一行能用的繼續打。按 Escape 丟掉還沒播的。每次改動都存在 `history`。卡上的 **↶**，或碰過卡片之後按 `Cmd/Ctrl+Z`，退一步。**Copy** 把那一行放進剪貼簿，**Open in Strudel** 在新分頁的 strudel.cc 打開它（[`strudelUrl()`](#strudelUrl)）。

description.en: What the returned object offers:
description.zh: 回傳的物件提供這些：

description.en:
```text
play(on)               start (true) or stop (false) like the checkbox; no argument flips; returns whether it plays
setPattern(p, {text})  a preset name, your own grid, or a compiled line (text: the line it came from); the card follows
setBpm(bpm)            the tempo, like the slider; returns the tempo
update(dt)             call every frame
deliver()              tell onStep/onHit what is heard by now without painting (call it right before you draw)
phase()                { bar, beat, pos }: how far through the bar and the beat the listener is, 0..1
now()                  { bar, step, phase, beatPhase, tokens, mode, text } for the display
info()                 { clock, heartbeat, lookahead, late, extended, audio, latency, ... } the health of the clock
useRhythm(mod)         hand over @openav/pattern later (it can load on its own)
src()                  the line that plays now ('' with a grid and no rhythm module)
strudelUrl()           the line as a strudel.cc link, or ''
edit(text)             play a line as if typed: { ok, error }; a mistake keeps the last line playing
history, undo()        the lines before, oldest first; undo goes back one and returns whether it did
copy()                 put copyText() on the clipboard: Promise<{ ok, text }>
barEvents(bar)         the hits of a bar: [{ voice, pos, ... }]
voices()               the rows on the grid now
seq, engine, root      the DrumSequencer or DrumTransport, the sound engine, the card's element
dispose()              stop, release the kit and take the card out
```
description.zh:
```text
play(on)               像勾選框那樣開始（true）或停止（false）。不給參數就是反過來。回傳現在有沒有在打
setPattern(p, {text})  預設名稱、你自己的格子圖，或編譯好的一行（text：它原本的那行字）。卡片會跟著變
setBpm(bpm)            速度，像滑桿。回傳速度
update(dt)             每個畫面都要呼叫
deliver()              把現在聽到的告訴 onStep/onHit，但不畫圖（在你畫圖之前呼叫）
phase()                { bar, beat, pos }：聽的人在小節和拍子的哪裡，0..1
now()                  { bar, step, phase, beatPhase, tokens, mode, text }，給畫面顯示用
info()                 { clock, heartbeat, lookahead, late, extended, audio, latency, ... } 時鐘的健康狀況
useRhythm(mod)         之後再把 @openav/pattern 交給它（它可以自己載入）
src()                  現在在打的那一行（只有格子又沒有節奏模組的時候是 ''）
strudelUrl()           那一行變成 strudel.cc 連結，沒有就是 ''
edit(text)             像打字一樣播放一行：{ ok, error }。有錯就繼續打上一行
history, undo()        之前的幾行，舊的在前。undo 退一步，回傳有沒有退成
copy()                 把 copyText() 放進剪貼簿：Promise<{ ok, text }>
barEvents(bar)         某一小節的鼓點：[{ voice, pos, ... }]
voices()               現在格子上有哪幾列
seq, engine, root      DrumSequencer 或 DrumTransport、發聲引擎、卡片的元素
dispose()              停止、釋放鼓組並把卡片拆掉
```

params.name: container
params.en: The element to put the card in. `dispose()` takes it out again.
params.zh: 要放鼓機卡的元素。`dispose()` 會把它拆掉。

params.name: signals
params.en: A [`Signals`](#Signals) bus. Every hit is published as `drum/<voice>` (a pulse `{ level }`), `drum/<voice>/env` (0..1, decays) and `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 10 }`. Without one the machine plays and calls your functions, and publishes nothing.
params.zh: 一個 [`Signals`](#Signals) 匯流排。每一下鼓都會發布成 `drum/<voice>`（脈衝 `{ level }`）、`drum/<voice>/env`（0..1，會衰減）和 `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 10 }`。沒給的話鼓機照樣會打、會呼叫你的函式，但什麼都不發布。

params.name: engine
params.en: The sound engine. Left out, the machine makes its own [`drumEngine()`](#drumEngine). Anything with `enable()` and `noteOn(note, vel01, time)` works.
params.zh: 發聲的引擎。沒給的話，鼓機自己做一個 [`drumEngine()`](#drumEngine)。任何有 `enable()` 和 `noteOn(note, vel01, time)` 的東西都可以。

params.name: autoEnableEngine
params.en: Switch the engine on by the first hit (or by `play()` with the lookahead clock), so no extra click is needed beyond the one the browser wants.
params.zh: 讓第一下鼓（用 lookahead 時鐘的話是 `play()`）自己把引擎打開，所以除了瀏覽器要的那一次點擊，不用再多一次點擊。

params.name: onStep
params.en: `onStep(i, n, ev)`, once for every 16th step when it is heard. `i` is 0..15 in the bar, `n` counts steps since the start, before that step's hits. It is the clock a timeline counts bars on.
params.zh: `onStep(i, n, ev)`，每個十六分音符步在聽到的時候呼叫一次。`i` 是小節裡的 0..15，`n` 是從開始算起的步數，在那一步的鼓之前呼叫。時間軸就是靠它數小節。

params.name: onHit
params.en: `onHit(voice, vel, ev)`, once for every drum hit when it is heard. `voice` is a name like `'kick'`, `vel` is 0..1.
params.zh: `onHit(voice, vel, ev)`，每一下鼓在聽到的時候呼叫一次。`voice` 是像 `'kick'` 的名字，`vel` 是 0..1。

params.name: onTakeover
params.en: `onTakeover({ text, bar, offGrid, dropped, varied })`: without a `rhythm` module, a click on a cell turned a line of rhythm into the grid it was playing. `offGrid` hits moved to the nearest step and `dropped` drums had no row.
params.zh: `onTakeover({ text, bar, offGrid, dropped, varied })`：沒有 `rhythm` 模組的時候，點一個格子把一行節奏換成它正在打的格子圖。`offGrid` 個鼓點被移到最近的一格，`dropped` 是沒有對應列的鼓。

params.name: bpm
params.en: The starting tempo, in beats per minute. The slider on the card goes from 60 to 180.
params.zh: 一開始的速度，每分鐘幾拍。卡上的滑桿範圍是 60 到 180。

params.name: pattern
params.en: A preset name from [`PATTERNS`](#PATTERNS) or your own grid `{ kick: 'x...x...', … }`. Not a line of rhythm: to start with one, call `drums.edit(line)` or `drums.setPattern(compile(line), { text: line })`.
params.zh: [`PATTERNS`](#PATTERNS) 裡的預設名稱，或你自己的格子圖 `{ kick: 'x...x...', … }`。不是一行節奏：要用一行節奏開始，就呼叫 `drums.edit(line)` 或 `drums.setPattern(compile(line), { text: line })`。

params.name: clock
params.en: `'frame'`: the machine moves in `update(dt)` and each hit sounds in the frame it is due. `'lookahead'`: hits are handed to the kit ahead of time on its audio clock, so the beat is steady under a heavy frame and in a hidden tab (`'audio'` means the same). See [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport).
params.zh: `'frame'`：鼓機在 `update(dt)` 裡前進，每一下在到時間的那個畫面響。`'lookahead'`：鼓點提前交給鼓組，用它的音訊時鐘排程，所以畫面很重或分頁被藏起來時節拍還是穩的（`'audio'` 是同一個意思）。見 [`DrumTransport`](#DrumTransport)。

params.name: lang
params.en: `'zh'` names the lanes and the buttons in Chinese. Anything else is English.
params.zh: `'zh'` 會用中文為軌道和按鈕命名（大鼓 小鼓 鈸 拍手）。其他的值都是英文。

params.name: heartbeat
params.en: Only for `clock: 'lookahead'`. Who wakes the scheduler: `'auto'` a Web Worker timer (falls back to `setInterval` where a worker cannot start), `'interval'` always `setInterval`, `false` nobody (you call `drums.update()` often enough).
params.zh: 只在 `clock: 'lookahead'` 時有用。誰來叫醒排程器：`'auto'` 是 Web Worker 的計時器（worker 起不來的地方退回 `setInterval`），`'interval'` 一律用 `setInterval`，`false` 是沒人叫（你要自己夠頻繁地呼叫 `drums.update()`）。

params.name: latency
params.en: Only for `clock: 'lookahead'`. How long after a hit is scheduled it is heard, in seconds. `'auto'` asks the browser for its output latency; a number sets it by hand (a Bluetooth speaker is 0.15 to 0.25).
params.zh: 只在 `clock: 'lookahead'` 時有用。一下鼓排程之後多久才聽到，單位是秒。`'auto'` 向瀏覽器問輸出延遲。給數字就是手動設定（藍牙喇叭是 0.15 到 0.25）。

params.name: now
params.en: Only for `clock: 'lookahead'`. A function that returns the time in seconds. The default is `performance.now() / 1000`. Replace it to run the machine on a fake clock in a test.
params.zh: 只在 `clock: 'lookahead'` 時有用。回傳目前時間（秒）的函式。預設是 `performance.now() / 1000`。測試時換掉它，就能讓鼓機跑在假的時鐘上。

params.name: hidden
params.en: Only for `clock: 'lookahead'`. A function that returns true while nobody can see the page. The default looks at `document.visibilityState`.
params.zh: 只在 `clock: 'lookahead'` 時有用。沒有人看得到頁面時回傳 true 的函式。預設看的是 `document.visibilityState`。

params.name: rhythm
params.en: The [`@openav/pattern`](#compile) module (`import * as rhythm from '@openav/pattern'`, anything with `compile` and `fromGrid`). With it the line of rhythm over the grid is always there and editable, and the cells and the line rewrite each other. It can also be handed over later with `drums.useRhythm(mod)`.
params.zh: [`@openav/pattern`](#compile) 模組（`import * as rhythm from '@openav/pattern'`，只要有 `compile` 和 `fromGrid` 就行）。有了它，格子上面那一行節奏就一直在、可以編輯，格子和那一行會互相改寫。也可以之後再用 `drums.useRhythm(mod)` 交給它。

params.name: onRhythm
params.en: `onRhythm(line, { how, prev })`, once for every new line. `how` is `'code'`, `'cell'`, `'type'`, `'undo'` or `'menu'`.
params.zh: `onRhythm(line, { how, prev })`，每一行新的節奏呼叫一次。`how` 是 `'code'`、`'cell'`、`'type'`、`'undo'`、`'menu'` 其中之一。

params.name: onLossy
params.en: `onLossy({ text, bar, lost })`: a click on a cell would lose something the 16 steps cannot hold (triplets, `< >`, `?`, `bd:2`). `lost` is the same as in [`toGrid()`](#toGrid). Left out, a note appears on the card. The next click rewrites the line anyway.
params.zh: `onLossy({ text, bar, lost })`：點一個格子會損失 16 格放不下的東西（三連音、`< >`、`?`、`bd:2`）。`lost` 跟 [`toGrid()`](#toGrid) 的一樣。沒給的話，卡上會出現一行提示。再點一次就會照樣改寫那一行。

params.name: onEditError
params.en: `onEditError(error, text)` when what was typed is not a line of rhythm (the mistake is marked in red and the last line that worked keeps playing), and `onEditError(null)` once it is fixed.
params.zh: 打進去的不是一行節奏的時候呼叫 `onEditError(error, text)`（錯的地方標紅，上一行能用的繼續打），修好之後呼叫 `onEditError(null)`。

params.name: copyText
params.en: `copyText(line, bpm)` returns what the Copy button puts on the clipboard. The default is the line itself.
params.zh: `copyText(line, bpm)` 回傳「複製」按鈕要放進剪貼簿的文字。預設就是那一行本身。

params.name: strudelComment
params.en: A comment to put at the head of the code that **Open in Strudel** sends.
params.zh: 要放在「在 Strudel 打開」送出去的程式碼最前面的註解。

returns.en: `{ seq, engine, root, clock, play(on), setPattern(p, { text }), setBpm(bpm), update(dt), deliver(), phase(), now(), info(), dispose(), useRhythm(mod), src(), strudelUrl(), history, undo(), edit(text), copy(), copyText(), barEvents(bar), voices() }` (and the getters `rhythm` and `copied`).
returns.zh: `{ seq, engine, root, clock, play(on), setPattern(p, { text }), setBpm(bpm), update(dt), deliver(), phase(), now(), info(), dispose(), useRhythm(mod), src(), strudelUrl(), history, undo(), edit(text), copy(), copyText(), barEvents(bar), voices() }`（還有 getter `rhythm` 和 `copied`）。

needs.en: A page with a DOM, and `update(dt)` called every frame. Sound waits for the browser: the kit's `AudioContext` is made by the first hit (or by `play()` with the lookahead clock), and until the page has had a click it stays suspended. Callbacks and signals run from the start; the sound comes in on the first click, and nothing from before it is played late.
needs.zh: 需要有 DOM 的頁面，而且每個畫面都要呼叫 `update(dt)`。聲音要等瀏覽器：鼓組的 `AudioContext` 在第一下鼓（用 lookahead 時鐘的話是 `play()`）的時候才建立，頁面被點一下之前它都是暫停的。回呼和訊號從一開始就會跑。聲音在第一次點擊之後才進來，點擊之前的鼓不會補打。

notes.en: With `clock: 'frame'` the first bar of a compiled line is played on the 16-step grid of four lanes: hits between steps move to the nearest step, and drums with no lane (crash, ride, toms, open hat) are left out. The console says so. `clock: 'lookahead'` plays a line exactly as written.
notes.zh: 用 `clock: 'frame'` 的時候，編譯過的一行只有第一小節會在四條軌道、十六格的格子上打：落在格子之間的鼓點會移到最近的一格，沒有軌道的鼓（碎音鈸、疊音鈸、中鼓、開鈸）會被略過，console 會說一聲。`clock: 'lookahead'` 則照寫的樣子打。

notes.en: In a p5 sketch you do not call it: [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) builds this card for you, with the lookahead clock, and calls `update()` every frame.
notes.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己呼叫：[`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 會替你蓋這張卡，用 lookahead 時鐘，並且每個畫面幫你呼叫 `update()`。

caption.en: A drum machine card appears and plays a breakbeat; the yellow column runs along the grid. Click the page once to hear the kit; click the cells to change the beat.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現一張鼓機卡，打著 breakbeat，黃色的那一欄沿著格子跑。在頁面上點一下才聽得到鼓組。點格子就能改節奏。

caption.en: With the pattern module the line is shown over the grid. The code types two lines for you, one of them wrong, then goes back; type into the line yourself and the cells follow.
caption.zh: 有了節奏模組，格子上面就會顯示那一行。程式替你打了兩行，其中一行是錯的，然後退回去。你自己在那一行打字，格子會跟著變。

caption.en: A circle on the canvas swells with every kick: the drum machine publishes `drum/kick/env`, and the sketch only reads the signal.
caption.zh: 畫布上的圓隨著每一下大鼓脹大：鼓機發布 `drum/kick/env`，草圖只要讀這個訊號。

tbd.en: The figure of 0.15 to 0.25 seconds for a Bluetooth speaker (the `latency` option) is from the handbook (docs/p5.md); it was not measured here.
tbd.zh: 藍牙喇叭的 0.15 到 0.25 秒（`latency` 選項）這個數字來自手冊（docs/p5.md），這裡沒有實際量過。

summary.en: The five preset grids of the drum machine: 'four on floor', breakbeat, 'half time', latin and sparse.
summary.zh: 鼓機內建的五個預設格子圖：'four on floor'、breakbeat、'half time'、latin、sparse。

description.en: The preset names are what [`startDrums()`](#startDrums), [`DrumSequencer`](#DrumSequencer) and [`mountDrums()`](#mountDrums) accept as a `pattern`. A preset is just data, so you can start from one: `{ ...PATTERNS.latin, clap: 'x...x...x...x...' }` is `latin` with a clap on every beat.
description.zh: 預設的名稱就是 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)、[`DrumSequencer`](#DrumSequencer)、[`mountDrums()`](#mountDrums) 的 `pattern` 收的值。預設就只是資料，所以你可以從其中一個開始改：`{ ...PATTERNS.latin, clap: 'x...x...x...x...' }` 就是在 `latin` 上每一拍加一下拍手。

value.en: Five presets, each `{ kick, snare, hat, clap }` as 16-character strings of `1` and `0`.
value.zh: 五個預設，每個都是 `{ kick, snare, hat, clap }`，各是 16 個字的 `1` 和 `0`。

caption.en: Lists the presets, reads one lane, and builds a variation of `latin` by spreading it into a new grid.
caption.zh: 列出預設、讀其中一條軌道，並把 `latin` 展開成新的格子圖，做出一個變化版。

summary.en: Tells which drum of the kit a General MIDI drum note plays, or `null` for a note it does not play.
summary.zh: 告訴你一個 General MIDI 鼓音符會打鼓組裡的哪一種鼓，不打的音符回傳 `null`。

description.en: Pads and drum machines send notes on channel 10, and several notes map to the same drum: 35 and 36 are kicks, 38 and 40 snares, 41 and 43 low toms, 45 and 47 toms, 48 and 50 high toms, 49, 52, 55 and 57 crashes, 51, 53 and 59 rides. A note that is not in the table, such as a melodic 60, gives `null`: the kit stays silent instead of guessing, because a wrong cymbal on a kick pad is worse than nothing.
description.zh: 打擊墊和鼓機在頻道 10 送音符，好幾個音符會對到同一種鼓：35 和 36 是大鼓，38 和 40 是小鼓，41 和 43 是落地鼓，45 和 47 是中鼓，48 和 50 是高音中鼓，49、52、55、57 是碎音鈸，51、53、59 是疊音鈸。不在表裡的音符，像旋律用的 60，會回傳 `null`：鼓組寧可不出聲也不亂猜，因為大鼓的打擊墊打出錯的鈸，比沒聲音還糟。

params.name: note
params.en: A MIDI note number.
params.zh: MIDI 音符號碼。

returns.en: The drum name (`'kick'`, `'crash'`…), or `null`.
returns.zh: 鼓的名字（`'kick'`、`'crash'`…），或 `null`。

examples.code:
import { voiceForNote } from '@openav/drums';

console.log(voiceForNote(36), voiceForNote(35));   // kick kick
console.log(voiceForNote(49), voiceForNote(57));   // crash crash
console.log(voiceForNote(60));                      // null, a melodic note

caption.en: Logs which drum a few notes play: two notes for one drum, and a melodic note that plays none.
caption.zh: 印出幾個音符打哪一種鼓：兩個音符對同一種鼓，以及一個不打任何鼓的旋律音符。

summary.en: Reads one line of rhythm text, like 'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8', and gives back the drum hits of any bar you ask for. It never throws.
summary.zh: 把一行節奏文字，像 'bd*4, [~ sd]*2, hh*8'，讀成任何一個小節要打哪些鼓。它不會丟出錯誤。

description.en: `compile()` is the one function you need to turn a line of rhythm into hits. `compile('bd sd hh').eventsInBar(1)` answers "what happens in bar 1?" with a list of hits, sorted by `pos`. Bars count from 1, and one bar is one cycle of the line: the words share the bar equally, so `bd sd hh` puts a kick at 0, a snare at 1/3 and a hat at 2/3.
description.zh: 要把一行節奏變成鼓點，用 `compile()` 就夠了。`compile('bd sd hh').eventsInBar(1)` 回答「第 1 小節發生什麼事」，給你一串按 `pos` 排好的鼓點。小節從 1 開始數，一個小節就是這一行的一個循環：字平分這個小節，所以 `bd sd hh` 是大鼓在 0、小鼓在 1/3、鈸在 2/3。

description.en: Each hit from `eventsInBar(bar, { seed })` is `{ word, voice, n, pos, dur, vel, layer, token }`. `word` is what was written, `voice` the drum it plays (`'kick'`), `pos` where in the bar, 0 up to (not including) 1. `dur` is how long it lasts, in bars, and may run past the bar (`bd/2` lasts two). `vel` is always 1. `layer` is the index of the comma part it came from. `token` is `{ start, end }`, the character range of the word in `src`, so you can light the word while it sounds. `n` is the sample number from `bd:2`, or `null`. `n` is kept for you but does not change the sound.
description.zh: `eventsInBar(bar, { seed })` 給的每個鼓點是 `{ word, voice, n, pos, dur, vel, layer, token }`。`word` 是寫的字，`voice` 是它打的鼓（`'kick'`），`pos` 是在小節的哪裡，從 0 到（不含）1。`dur` 是持續多久，單位是小節，可以超過這個小節（`bd/2` 長兩個小節）。`vel` 永遠是 1。`layer` 是它來自第幾個逗號層。`token` 是 `{ start, end }`，這個字在 `src` 裡的字元範圍，字在響的時候可以拿來點亮它。`n` 是 `bd:2` 的取樣編號，沒寫就是 `null`。`n` 會保留給你，但不會改變聲音。

description.en: It never throws. A line it cannot read comes back as `{ ok: false, error }`, and `eventsInBar()` returns `[]` for every bar, so check `ok` before you trust the hits. `error.index` and `error.length` mark the characters that are wrong, `error.message` and `error.hint` are English sentences, and `error.code` is one of `empty`, `unclosed`, `unexpected`, `bad-number`, `bad-euclid`, `unknown-word` or `unsupported`. An `unknown-word` error also carries `suggestion`, the closest word or `null`. The words and the symbols you can write are listed below.
description.zh: 它不會丟出錯誤。讀不懂的一行會回傳 `{ ok: false, error }`，而且每個小節的 `eventsInBar()` 都回傳 `[]`，所以相信鼓點之前先檢查 `ok`。`error.index` 和 `error.length` 標出錯的字元，`error.message` 和 `error.hint` 是英文句子，`error.code` 是 `empty`、`unclosed`、`unexpected`、`bad-number`、`bad-euclid`、`unknown-word`、`unsupported` 其中之一。`unknown-word` 錯誤還會帶 `suggestion`，也就是最接近的字，沒有就是 `null`。可以寫的字和符號列在下面。

description.en:
```text
bd sd hh      steps share the bar equally
~  or  -       a rest
[bd sd]        a group takes one step and splits it again
bd*4           faster: 4 times in its step (decimals work: bd*1.5)
bd/2           slower: once every 2 bars
<bd sd>        one per bar, in turn
bd, hh*8       a comma stacks layers
bd(3,8)        Euclidean: 3 hits spread over 8 steps
bd(3,8,2)      the same, starting 2 steps later
bd!2  bd !     repeat the step (each copy takes a step)
bd@3  bd _ _   make the step 3 times as long
hh*8?  hh*8?0.3   drop each hit by chance (1/2, or 0.3)
bd:2           sample number, kept in n
```
description.zh:
```text
bd sd hh      字平分一個小節
~  或  -       休止
[bd sd]        一組佔一格，再平分那一格
bd*4           加快：在它那一格裡打 4 次（小數也行：bd*1.5）
bd/2           放慢：每 2 個小節打一次
<bd sd>        每小節輪一個
bd, hh*8       逗號把幾層疊在一起
bd(3,8)        歐幾里得節奏：3 下平均分在 8 格
bd(3,8,2)      一樣，但晚 2 格開始
bd!2  bd !     重複這一格（每個複本各佔一格）
bd@3  bd _ _   這一格拉長成 3 倍
hh*8?  hh*8?0.3   每一下用機率省略（1/2 或 0.3）
bd:2           取樣編號，存在 n
```

description.en: Modifiers chain in the order written (`bd(3,8)*2`, `hh*8?`). Word case does not matter (`BD` is `bd`). `?` is decided by `seed` and the time of the hit, so the same seed and bar always give the same hits, while other bars and other seeds differ. Not supported, and refused with an `unsupported` error and a hint: `.` (Strudel's grouping), `|`, `{ }`, `%`, `..` and `^`. A dot matters most: lane strings like `'x...x...'` are not a line of rhythm, and a rest is `~`.
description.zh: 修飾符號照寫的順序一個接一個（`bd(3,8)*2`、`hh*8?`）。字的大小寫不影響（`BD` 就是 `bd`）。`?` 由 `seed` 和鼓點的時間決定，所以同一個 seed、同一個小節永遠打出一樣的鼓點，換一個小節或換一個 seed 就不同。不支援，並會用 `unsupported` 錯誤和提示拒絕的有：`.`（Strudel 的分組）、`|`、`{ }`、`%`、`..`、`^`。其中最重要的是點：像 `'x...x...'` 這種軌道字串不是一行節奏，休止要寫 `~`。

params.name: src
params.en: The line of rhythm, for example `'bd sd hh'`. Anything that is not a string is turned into one (`null` and `undefined` become an empty line, which is an error).
params.zh: 一行節奏，例如 `'bd sd hh'`。不是字串的東西會被轉成字串（`null` 和 `undefined` 變成空的一行，那是錯誤）。

params.name: words
params.en: Which words mean which drum: `{ word: voice }`. The default is [`WORDS`](#WORDS). To add a word, spread the default: `{ ...WORDS, boom: 'kick' }`. The voice should be one the drum kit plays, see [`GM`](#GM).
params.zh: 哪個字代表哪一種鼓：`{ 字: 鼓聲 }`。預設是 [`WORDS`](#WORDS)。要多加一個字，就把預設展開：`{ ...WORDS, boom: 'kick' }`。鼓聲要是鼓組會打的，見 [`GM`](#GM)。

returns.en: `{ ok, error, src, voices, layers, period, eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) }`. `ok` is true when the line was read. `error` is `null`, or `{ code, index, length, message, hint }`. `voices` lists the drums the line uses, in the order they first appear. `layers` counts the comma parts. `period` is the number of bars until the written rhythm repeats.
returns.zh: `{ ok, error, src, voices, layers, period, eventsInBar(bar, { seed }) }`。`ok` 是 true 表示這一行讀懂了。`error` 是 `null`，或 `{ code, index, length, message, hint }`。`voices` 列出這一行用到的鼓，依第一次出現的順序。`layers` 是逗號分出來的層數。`period` 是寫出來的節奏要幾個小節才會重複。

notes.en: Time inside is exact fractions, and each bar is computed on its own. Bar 1 000 000 of `[bd sd sn]*3` lands on the same ninths as bar 1, and asking for bar 500 is as cheap as asking for bar 2.
notes.zh: 內部的時間用精確的分數，每個小節各自計算。`[bd sd sn]*3` 的第 1 000 000 小節跟第 1 小節落在一模一樣的九分之幾，問第 500 小節跟問第 2 小節一樣便宜。

notes.en: From a p5 sketch you do not call it: [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) takes the line and compiles it for you. Use `compile()` yourself when you want the hits as data, for a score, a drawing or a test.
notes.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡不用自己呼叫：[`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 收下這一行，會替你編譯。想把鼓點當資料用，例如畫譜、畫圖或寫測試的時候，才自己呼叫 `compile()`。

notes.en: The way of writing comes from TidalCycles and Strudel. This is an independent implementation written from their public documentation. Where it differs from strudel.cc on purpose (a rotation of `n` steps or more wraps around, `*0` and `(9,8)` are errors, unknown names are errors), the package README says so.
notes.zh: 這種寫法來自 TidalCycles 和 Strudel，這個套件是依他們的公開文件獨立實作的。刻意跟 strudel.cc 不同的地方（旋轉 `n` 格以上會繞回來、`*0` 和 `(9,8)` 是錯誤、不認識的字是錯誤），套件的 README 都有寫。

caption.en: Logs the three hits of bar 1: the word, the drum it plays, and where in the bar. Open the console to see them.
caption.zh: 印出第 1 小節的三個鼓點：字、它打的鼓、在小節的哪裡。打開 console 就看得到。

caption.en: A line that changes every bar: `<bd sd>` alternates, so `period` is 2. A line with a mistake comes back with `ok: false`, the error code and the character it starts at.
caption.zh: 每個小節都不一樣的一行：`<bd sd>` 輪流出現，所以 `period` 是 2。有錯的一行會回傳 `ok: false`、錯誤代碼，和錯誤從哪個字元開始。

caption.en: Draws bar 1 on the canvas, one row per comma part: each hit is a block at its position, as long as it lasts.
caption.zh: 把第 1 小節畫在畫布上，每個逗號層一排：每個鼓點是在它位置上的一塊，長度就是它持續的時間。

summary.en: Spreads a number of hits as evenly as possible over a number of steps, the Euclidean rhythm. `euclid(3, 8)` is the tresillo.
summary.zh: 把一些鼓點盡量平均地分在一些格子上，也就是歐幾里得節奏。`euclid(3, 8)` 就是 tresillo。

description.en: It is the function behind `bd(3,8)` in a line of rhythm: [`compile()`](#compile) calls it for every `(k,n)`. Use it on its own when you want the pattern as data, for a drawing or your own sequencer. `euclid(3, 8)` is `x..x..x.`, and `euclid(5, 8)` is `x.xx.xx.`.
description.zh: 一行節奏裡的 `bd(3,8)` 就是靠它：[`compile()`](#compile) 每遇到一個 `(k,n)` 就會呼叫它。想把這個節奏當資料用，例如畫圖或接到自己的音序器，就單獨呼叫它。`euclid(3, 8)` 是 `x..x..x.`，`euclid(5, 8)` 是 `x.xx.xx.`。

description.en: It follows Bjorklund's procedure as Toussaint (2005) describes it. `rotate` moves the pattern later, the direction strudel.cc plays: `euclid(3, 8, 2)` is `x.x..x..`, the hits of `euclid(3, 8)` moved two steps to the right.
description.zh: 它照 Toussaint（2005）說明的 Bjorklund 方法做。`rotate` 把節奏往後移，方向跟 strudel.cc 一樣：`euclid(3, 8, 2)` 是 `x.x..x..`，也就是 `euclid(3, 8)` 的鼓點往右移兩格。

params.name: pulses
params.en: How many hits. A negative number plays the gaps instead: `euclid(-3, 8)` is the five steps `euclid(3, 8)` leaves out. More hits than steps fills every step. The number is cut to a whole number.
params.zh: 有幾下。負數會打空隙：`euclid(-3, 8)` 是 `euclid(3, 8)` 沒打的那五格。比格數多的話，每一格都會打。小數會被去掉。

params.name: steps
params.en: How many steps. Fewer than 1 gives an empty array.
params.zh: 有幾格。小於 1 會得到空陣列。

params.name: rotate
params.en: Start the pattern this many steps later. Negative starts earlier, and a number of `steps` or more wraps around.
params.zh: 讓節奏晚這麼多格開始。負數是提早，`steps` 以上的數字會繞回來。

returns.en: An array of `steps` booleans, true where there is a hit.
returns.zh: 一個長度 `steps` 的布林陣列，有鼓點的地方是 true。

caption.en: Logs three rhythms as text: `x` is a hit and `.` is a rest. The third is the first one moved two steps later.
caption.zh: 把三個節奏印成文字：`x` 是鼓點、`.` 是休止。第三個是第一個往後移兩格。

caption.en: Draws sixteen blocks and lights five of them, spread as evenly as sixteen steps allow.
caption.zh: 畫十六個方塊，點亮其中五個，分得跟十六格能做到的一樣平均。

entries.name: fromGrid
entries.signature: fromGrid(grid, { steps = 16, words = null, order = null } = {})

summary.en: Turns a grid of steps, like the drum machine card, into the one line of rhythm a person would write for it.
summary.zh: 把一張格子圖，像鼓機卡上的那種，轉成一個人會為它寫的那一行節奏。

description.en: It is what happens when you click a cell of the drum machine card: the grid has to come back as text. Each lane becomes one layer, joined with `, `, and it picks the shortest honest spelling. Steady hits become `bd*4` or `hh*8`, one hit per group `[~ sd]*2`, a Euclidean rhythm `bd(3,8)`, and anything else is written beat by beat, like `bd [~ ~ ~ bd] bd*2 ~`. It never throws.
description.zh: 按下鼓機卡上的一個格子，就是在做這件事：格子圖要變回文字。每條軌道變成一層，用 `, ` 接起來，並選最短又準確的寫法。平穩的鼓點寫成 `bd*4` 或 `hh*8`，每組一下寫成 `[~ sd]*2`，歐幾里得節奏寫成 `bd(3,8)`，其他的一拍一拍寫，像 `bd [~ ~ ~ bd] bd*2 ~`。它不會丟出錯誤。

description.en: The line is exact: [`compile()`](#compile) of the result lands on the same steps, in every bar. The rules are in the package README, and the tests check a thousand random grids.
description.zh: 這一行是精確的：把結果交給 [`compile()`](#compile)，每個小節都會落在同樣的格子上。規則寫在套件的 README，測試用一千張隨機的格子圖驗證過。

params.name: grid
params.en: The steps: `{ lane: 'x...x...' }` or `{ lane: [1, 0, 0, 0, …] }`. A lane is named by its drum (`kick`) or its word (`bd`). `x`, `X`, `1` and `true` are hits, `|` and spaces are ignored. A lane with no name the kit knows is left out.
params.zh: 格子：`{ 軌道: 'x...x...' }` 或 `{ 軌道: [1, 0, 0, 0, …] }`。軌道可以用鼓的名字（`kick`）或字（`bd`）命名。`x`、`X`、`1`、`true` 是鼓點，`|` 和空白會被忽略。名字不是鼓組認得的軌道會被丟掉。

params.name: steps
params.en: How many steps each lane has.
params.zh: 每條軌道有幾格。

params.name: words
params.en: Keep your own spelling: `{ kick: 'kick' }` writes `kick*4` instead of `bd*4`.
params.zh: 保留你自己的寫法：`{ kick: 'kick' }` 會寫成 `kick*4` 而不是 `bd*4`。

params.name: order
params.en: Drums to put first, in this order, for example `['kick', 'snare']`. The rest follow in the order of the grid's keys.
params.zh: 要放在最前面的鼓，照這個順序，例如 `['kick', 'snare']`。其他的接在後面，照格子圖的鍵的順序。

returns.en: One line of rhythm that plays exactly the grid. A grid with no hit anywhere gives `'~'`.
returns.zh: 一行剛好打出這張格子圖的節奏。完全沒有鼓點的格子圖會得到 `'~'`。

caption.en: Logs the line for a classic four-on-the-floor grid: a kick on every beat, a snare on 2 and 4, eight hats.
caption.zh: 印出經典四四拍格子圖的那一行：每一拍大鼓、第 2 和第 4 拍小鼓、八下鈸。

caption.en: A lane can be an array of 0 and 1. The hits at steps 0, 6 and 12 are recognised as a Euclidean rhythm. `words` keeps your own spelling, and an empty grid is one rest.
caption.zh: 一條軌道也可以是 0 和 1 的陣列。第 0、6、12 格的鼓點被認成歐幾里得節奏。`words` 保留你自己的寫法，空的格子圖就是一個休止。

summary.en: Reads code copied from strudel.cc, like `s("bd*4").fast(2)`, into the line of rhythm OAV plays, plus the tempo it found.
summary.zh: 把從 strudel.cc 複製來的程式碼，像 `s("bd*4").fast(2)`，讀成 OAV 會打的那一行節奏，並附上找到的速度。

description.en: It lets someone paste what they made in Strudel. It reads `s("…")` and `sound("…")` with `"`, `'` or backtick quotes. Several of them (also with a label like `$:` or `name:` in front) become layers. A `.fast(n)` or `.slow(n)` is folded into the line as `[…]*n` or `[…]/n`. `setcpm(x)` gives `bpm` as x times 4, `setcps(x)` as x times 240. `.bank(…)` goes to `ignored`, because OAV plays its own kit. Any other call or statement goes to `unsupported`, and the rest still plays. It never throws.
description.zh: 它讓人可以貼上自己在 Strudel 做的東西。它讀 `s("…")` 和 `sound("…")`，引號可以是 `"`、`'` 或反引號。好幾個（前面也可以有 `$:` 或 `name:` 這種標籤）會變成好幾層。`.fast(n)` 或 `.slow(n)` 會折進那一行，變成 `[…]*n` 或 `[…]/n`。`setcpm(x)` 的 `bpm` 是 x 乘 4，`setcps(x)` 是 x 乘 240。`.bank(…)` 進 `ignored`，因為 OAV 打的是自己的鼓組。其他的呼叫或敘述都進 `unsupported`，剩下的照樣會打。它不會丟出錯誤。

description.en: It only reshapes text: it does not check the words. `fromStrudel('s("bd kik")')` gives `ok: true` with `src: 'bd kik'`, so pass `src` to [`compile()`](#compile) and look at its `ok`. [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) accepts Strudel code directly and does all of this for you.
description.zh: 它只是把文字重新整理，不會檢查字。`fromStrudel('s("bd kik")')` 會回 `ok: true` 和 `src: 'bd kik'`，所以要把 `src` 交給 [`compile()`](#compile)，看它的 `ok`。[`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 可以直接收 Strudel 程式碼，這些事都替你做了。

params.name: code
params.en: The Strudel code, as copied from the strudel.cc editor.
params.zh: 從 strudel.cc 編輯器複製來的 Strudel 程式碼。

returns.en: `{ strudel, ok, src, bpm, ignored, unsupported }`. `strudel` is false when the text has no `s(…)` or `sound(…)` in it. `ok` is true when there is a line of rhythm in `src`. `bpm` is the tempo from `setcpm()` or `setcps()`, else `null`. `ignored` lists what was left out on purpose (`.bank(…)`), `unsupported` what OAV does not do (`.jux(rev)`, `.gain(…)`).
returns.zh: `{ strudel, ok, src, bpm, ignored, unsupported }`。文字裡沒有 `s(…)` 或 `sound(…)` 的話，`strudel` 是 false。`src` 裡有一行節奏的話，`ok` 是 true。`bpm` 是 `setcpm()` 或 `setcps()` 給的速度，沒有就是 `null`。`ignored` 列出刻意略過的（`.bank(…)`），`unsupported` 列出 OAV 不做的（`.jux(rev)`、`.gain(…)`）。

examples.code:
import { fromStrudel, compile } from '@openav/pattern';

const r = fromStrudel('setcpm(110/4)\ns("bd*4, [~ sd]*2").bank("RolandTR909").fast(2).jux(rev)');
console.log(r.src);            // [bd*4, [~ sd]*2]*2
console.log(r.bpm);            // 110
console.log(r.ignored);        // ['.bank("RolandTR909")']
console.log(r.unsupported);    // ['.jux(rev)']
console.log(compile(r.src).ok); // true

caption.en: Reads a typical Strudel snippet: `.fast(2)` is folded into the line, the tempo is found, `.bank()` is ignored and `.jux()` is reported as unsupported.
caption.zh: 讀一段常見的 Strudel 程式：`.fast(2)` 折進那一行，找到速度，`.bank()` 被略過，`.jux()` 被回報為不支援。

examples.code:
import { fromStrudel } from '@openav/pattern';

console.log(fromStrudel('note("c e g")').strudel);   // false, no s("…") in it
console.log(fromStrudel('s("bd kik")').ok);          // true: the words are not checked
console.log(fromStrudel('setcps(0.5)\ns("bd")').bpm); // 120

caption.en: The edges: text with no `s(…)` is not Strudel for OAV, a misspelled word still passes, and `setcps(0.5)` is 120 bpm.
caption.zh: 邊界情況：沒有 `s(…)` 的文字對 OAV 來說不是 Strudel，拼錯的字還是會通過，`setcps(0.5)` 是 120 bpm。

summary.en: Reads a line of rhythm into a tree of nodes, each with its character range. It does not look words up in the drum kit.
summary.zh: 把一行節奏讀成一棵節點樹，每個節點都帶著它的字元範圍。它不會去查鼓組有沒有這個字。

description.en: `parse()` is the first half of [`compile()`](#compile): it checks the grammar and builds the tree, and stops there. Use it when you want to look at the structure of a line, for example to colour its words or find a mistake. For the hits, call `compile()`.
description.zh: `parse()` 是 [`compile()`](#compile) 的前半段：只檢查文法、建出樹，到此為止。想看一行的結構，例如幫字上色或找錯誤的時候用它。要鼓點的話，呼叫 `compile()`。

description.en: The root is always a `layer` whose `layers` are the top-level comma parts, and each of those is a `seq`. The node types are `step` `{ word, n }`, `rest`, `seq` `{ steps: [{ node, weight }] }`, `layer` `{ layers }`, `alt` `{ steps }` (one per bar), `fast` and `slow` `{ factor, node }`, `euclid` `{ pulses, slots, rotate, node }` and `maybe` `{ chance, id, node }`. Every node has `start` and `end`, its character range in `src`. Weights and factors are fractions `[numerator, denominator]`, so `bd*1.5` has the factor `[3, 2]`.
description.zh: 樹根永遠是 `layer`，它的 `layers` 是最上層用逗號分開的幾部分，每一部分是一個 `seq`。節點的種類有 `step` `{ word, n }`、`rest`、`seq` `{ steps: [{ node, weight }] }`、`layer` `{ layers }`、`alt` `{ steps }`（每小節一個）、`fast` 和 `slow` `{ factor, node }`、`euclid` `{ pulses, slots, rotate, node }`、`maybe` `{ chance, id, node }`。每個節點都有 `start` 和 `end`，也就是它在 `src` 裡的字元範圍。權重和倍數是分數 `[分子, 分母]`，所以 `bd*1.5` 的倍數是 `[3, 2]`。

params.name: src
params.en: The line of rhythm, for example `'bd [sd sd]'`.
params.zh: 一行節奏，例如 `'bd [sd sd]'`。

returns.en: `{ ok: true, tree, error: null }`, or `{ ok: false, tree: null, error }` with the same `{ code, index, length, message, hint }` error as [`compile()`](#compile).
returns.zh: `{ ok: true, tree, error: null }`，或 `{ ok: false, tree: null, error }`，`error` 跟 [`compile()`](#compile) 的一樣，是 `{ code, index, length, message, hint }`。

notes.en: Because `parse()` never looks at the drum kit, `parse('kik')` succeeds while `compile('kik')` fails with `unknown-word`. Everything else (an unclosed bracket, `*0`, `(9,8)`) fails in both.
notes.zh: 因為 `parse()` 不看鼓組，`parse('kik')` 會成功，`compile('kik')` 卻會失敗，錯誤是 `unknown-word`。其他的錯（括號沒關、`*0`、`(9,8)`）兩個都會失敗。

caption.en: Logs the type of each step of the first layer (a plain step, then a group made faster), and the error code of a line with an unclosed bracket.
caption.zh: 印出第一層每一格的種類（一個普通的字，接著一組被加快的），以及括號沒關的那一行的錯誤代碼。

caption.en: Walks the tree and logs each word with the character it starts at, the data you need to colour words in an editor.
caption.zh: 走過整棵樹，印出每個字和它開始的字元位置，在編輯器裡幫字上色就需要這份資料。

summary.en: The short word Tidal and Strudel write for each drum: `kick` is `bd`, `snare` is `sd`. The other direction from `WORDS`.
summary.zh: Tidal 和 Strudel 為每種鼓寫的短字：`kick` 是 `bd`，`snare` 是 `sd`。跟 `WORDS` 方向相反。

description.en: [`fromGrid()`](#fromGrid) writes with these words when you do not give it your own spelling, and [`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel) uses them (with `hh` for `pedalhat`) to speak Strudel.
description.zh: [`fromGrid()`](#fromGrid) 沒給你自己的寫法時，就是用這些字寫。[`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel) 也用它們（`pedalhat` 用 `hh`）來說 Strudel 的話。

value.en: A frozen object of 13 `{ voice: word }` pairs, one per drum of the kit. `pedalhat` has no short word, so it maps to `'pedalhat'`, OAV's own.
value.zh: 一個凍結的物件，有 13 組 `{ 鼓聲: 字 }`，鼓組每種鼓一組。`pedalhat` 沒有短字，所以對到 OAV 自己的 `'pedalhat'`。

caption.en: Logs the short word for a few drums, and the one drum that has none.
caption.zh: 印出幾種鼓的短字，以及唯一沒有短字的那一種。

summary.en: Makes a strudel.cc link that opens the line of rhythm in the Strudel editor.
summary.zh: 做出一個 strudel.cc 的連結，打開後 Strudel 編輯器裡就是這一行節奏。

description.en: The format is the one strudel.cc shows in its own address bar. It is what the drum machine card's **Open in Strudel** link uses. Open it in a **new tab**: a strudel.cc tab that is already open does not read a changed `#`.
description.zh: 格式就是 strudel.cc 自己的網址列顯示的那種，鼓機卡上的 **在 Strudel 打開** 連結用的就是它。要在**新分頁**打開：已經開著的 strudel.cc 分頁不會重讀改變過的 `#`。

params.name: src
params.en: The line of rhythm.
params.zh: 一行節奏。

params.name: opts
params.en: The options of [`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel): `{ bpm, comment, words }`.
params.zh: [`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel) 的選項：`{ bpm, comment, words }`。

returns.en: A URL: `'https://strudel.cc/#'` and the code from [`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel), as UTF-8 base64, URL-encoded.
returns.zh: 一個網址：`'https://strudel.cc/#'` 加上 [`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel) 的程式碼，轉成 UTF-8 的 base64，再做網址編碼。

notes.en: OAV only builds the link. No Strudel code runs in, or ships with, OAV.
notes.zh: OAV 只是做出連結，沒有任何 Strudel 的程式碼在 OAV 裡執行，也沒有隨 OAV 一起發佈。

caption.en: Builds the link, decodes it again to show the code inside, and puts it on the page as a link that opens in a new tab.
caption.zh: 做出連結，再解碼一次讓你看到裡面的程式碼，並放在頁面上，做成會在新分頁打開的連結。

tbd.en: Not opened in strudel.cc from this build: the link format was read off strudel.cc's address bar on 2026-10-15 (README), and a strudel.cc change could break it.
tbd.zh: 這個版本沒有實際在 strudel.cc 打開過：連結格式是 2026-10-15 從 strudel.cc 的網址列讀出來的（見 README），strudel.cc 改版的話可能會失效。

entries.name: toGrid
entries.signature: toGrid(p, { bar = 1, steps = 16, seed = 0, bars = 16, words = WORDS } = {})

summary.en: Shows one bar of a line of rhythm on a grid of steps, and tells you what the grid cannot hold.
summary.zh: 把一行節奏的某一個小節畫成格子圖，並告訴你格子放不下哪些東西。

description.en: It is the way back from [`fromGrid()`](#fromGrid), and what the drum machine card uses to draw the cells of a line. Each hit goes to the step it is nearest to. The `lost` fields say what that cost: `offGrid` is the number of hits that sit between steps (triplets) and were moved to the nearest one. `stacked` counts two hits of one drum on one step. `varies` is true when other bars differ (`< >`, `/2`). `random` is true when the line has a `?`. `samples` is true when it has a sample number like `bd:2`. `exact` is true only when none of these happened.
description.zh: 它是 [`fromGrid()`](#fromGrid) 的反方向，鼓機卡就是用它畫出一行節奏的格子。每個鼓點會放到離它最近的那一格。`lost` 的欄位告訴你這樣損失了什麼：`offGrid` 是落在格子之間（三連音）而被移到最近一格的鼓點數量。`stacked` 是同一種鼓在同一格有兩下。`varies` 為 true 表示其他小節不一樣（`< >`、`/2`）。`random` 為 true 表示這一行有 `?`。`samples` 為 true 表示有像 `bd:2` 的取樣編號。只有這些都沒發生，`exact` 才是 true。

description.en: A line that fails to compile does not throw: you get `ok: false`.
description.zh: 編譯失敗的一行不會丟出錯誤，你會得到 `ok: false`。

params.name: p
params.en: A line of rhythm, or the result of [`compile()`](#compile).
params.zh: 一行節奏，或 [`compile()`](#compile) 的結果。

params.name: bar
params.en: Which bar to show, counting from 1.
params.zh: 要看哪個小節，從 1 開始數。

params.name: steps
params.en: How many steps the grid has.
params.zh: 格子有幾格。

params.name: seed
params.en: Decides each `?`, the same way as in `eventsInBar()`.
params.zh: 決定每一個 `?`，跟 `eventsInBar()` 裡的用法一樣。

params.name: bars
params.en: How many bars to look through to find out whether the other bars differ (`lost.varies`). At most the line's `period`, and never more than 64.
params.zh: 要看幾個小節，用來判斷其他小節有沒有不同（`lost.varies`）。最多看到這一行的 `period`，而且不會超過 64。

params.name: words
params.en: Which words mean which drum, the same as in [`compile()`](#compile).
params.zh: 哪個字代表哪一種鼓，跟 [`compile()`](#compile) 一樣。

returns.en: `{ ok, grid, words, voices, exact, lost }`. `grid` is `{ voice: [0 or 1 × steps] }`. `words` is the word the line used for each drum. `voices` lists the drums. `exact` is true when the grid holds the bar completely. `lost` counts what it cannot: `{ offGrid, stacked, varies, random, samples }`. If the line cannot be read, `ok` is false and the rest is empty.
returns.zh: `{ ok, grid, words, voices, exact, lost }`。`grid` 是 `{ 鼓聲: [0 或 1，共 steps 個] }`。`words` 是這一行為每種鼓用的字。`voices` 列出鼓。`exact` 是 true 表示格子完整放得下這個小節。`lost` 數出放不下的東西：`{ offGrid, stacked, varies, random, samples }`。這一行讀不懂的話，`ok` 是 false，其他都是空的。

caption.en: A line that fits the sixteen steps: `exact` is true, and each drum has its row of 0 and 1.
caption.zh: 一行放得進十六格：`exact` 是 true，每種鼓有它那一排 0 和 1。

examples.code:
import { toGrid } from '@openav/pattern';

console.log(toGrid('bd [sd sd sd]').lost.offGrid);      // 2, the triplet sits between steps
console.log(toGrid('<bd sd>', { bar: 2 }).lost.varies); // true
console.log(toGrid('hh*8?').lost.random);               // true
console.log(toGrid('bd:2').exact);                      // false, the sample number is lost
console.log(toGrid('bd . sd').ok);                      // false, not a line of rhythm

caption.en: Five lines and what each costs on a grid: triplets move, alternating bars and chance cannot be shown, and a line that does not compile has no grid at all.
caption.zh: 五行節奏，以及各自放進格子要付出的代價：三連音會移位，輪流的小節和機率顯示不出來，編譯失敗的一行根本沒有格子。

entries.name: toStrudel
entries.signature: toStrudel(src, { bpm = null, comment = '', words = WORDS } = {})

summary.en: Turns a line of rhythm into Strudel code: OAV's drum words become Strudel's, with a tempo line and a comment if you give them.
summary.zh: 把一行節奏轉成 Strudel 程式碼：OAV 的鼓的字換成 Strudel 的字，有給的話還會加上速度那行和註解。

description.en: The words become the names Strudel's drum sounds use: `kick` becomes `bd`, `pedalhat` becomes `hh`. A rotation of `n` steps or more in a Euclidean part, like `bd(3,8,10)`, is written as the rotation OAV plays (`bd(3,8,2)`), because strudel.cc would play it unrotated. A line that does not read is passed through unchanged, so the result may not play in Strudel: check it with [`compile()`](#compile) first. It never throws.
description.zh: 字會換成 Strudel 的鼓的名字：`kick` 變 `bd`，`pedalhat` 變 `hh`。歐幾里得的旋轉在 `n` 格以上的，像 `bd(3,8,10)`，會寫成 OAV 實際打的旋轉（`bd(3,8,2)`），因為 strudel.cc 會把它當作沒旋轉。讀不懂的一行會原樣放過去，所以結果在 Strudel 裡可能打不出來，先用 [`compile()`](#compile) 檢查。它不會丟出錯誤。

description.en: To open the result in the Strudel editor, use [`strudelUrl()`](#strudelUrl).
description.zh: 要在 Strudel 編輯器裡打開結果，用 [`strudelUrl()`](#strudelUrl)。

params.name: src
params.en: The line of rhythm.
params.zh: 一行節奏。

params.name: bpm
params.en: The tempo. When it is above 0 a `setcpm(bpm/4)` line is written, because one OAV bar is one Strudel cycle of four beats.
params.zh: 速度。大於 0 的話會寫一行 `setcpm(bpm/4)`，因為 OAV 的一個小節就是 Strudel 的一個四拍的循環。

params.name: comment
params.en: A line to put first as a `//` comment.
params.zh: 要放在最前面的一行 `//` 註解。

params.name: words
params.en: Which words mean which drum, the same as in [`compile()`](#compile).
params.zh: 哪個字代表哪一種鼓，跟 [`compile()`](#compile) 一樣。

returns.en: The Strudel code, one to three lines, ending in `s("…")`.
returns.zh: Strudel 程式碼，一到三行，最後一行是 `s("…")`。

caption.en: Logs three lines of Strudel code: the comment, the tempo, and the pattern with Strudel's names for the drums.
caption.zh: 印出三行 Strudel 程式碼：註解、速度，和用 Strudel 的鼓名寫的節奏。

caption.en: A rotation past the number of steps is written the way OAV plays it, and a line with a mistake is not touched.
caption.zh: 超過格數的旋轉，會寫成 OAV 實際打的樣子，有錯的一行則不會被動到。

summary.en: The drum words a line of rhythm may use and the drum each one plays: `bd` is `kick`, `sd` is `snare`, `hh` is `hat`.
summary.zh: 一行節奏可以用的鼓的字，以及每個字打哪一種鼓：`bd` 是 `kick`，`sd` 是 `snare`，`hh` 是 `hat`。

description.en: The short words are the ones TidalCycles and Strudel use: `bd` kick, `sd` and `sn` snare, `hh` hat, `oh` open hat, `cp` clap, `rim` and `rs` rim, `lt` low tom, `mt` tom, `ht` high tom, `cr` crash, `rd` ride, `cb` cowbell. Each drum's own name works too: `kick`, `snare`, `hat`, `openhat`, `pedalhat`, `clap`, `lowtom`, `tom`, `hightom`, `crash`, `ride`, `cowbell`. The values are the drum names of [`GM`](#GM).
description.zh: 短的字是 TidalCycles 和 Strudel 用的：`bd` 大鼓、`sd` 和 `sn` 小鼓、`hh` 鈸、`oh` 開鈸、`cp` 拍手、`rim` 和 `rs` 鼓邊、`lt` 落地鼓、`mt` 中鼓、`ht` 高音中鼓、`cr` 碎音鈸、`rd` 疊音鈸、`cb` 牛鈴。每種鼓自己的名字也能用：`kick`、`snare`、`hat`、`openhat`、`pedalhat`、`clap`、`lowtom`、`tom`、`hightom`、`crash`、`ride`、`cowbell`。值就是 [`GM`](#GM) 裡的鼓的名字。

description.en: It is the default of the `words` option of [`compile()`](#compile), [`toGrid()`](#toGrid) and [`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel). To teach a line a new word, pass a copy with your word added.
description.zh: 它是 [`compile()`](#compile)、[`toGrid()`](#toGrid)、[`toStrudel()`](#toStrudel) 的 `words` 選項的預設值。要讓一行節奏認得新的字，就傳一份加了你的字的複本。

value.en: A frozen object of 26 `{ word: voice }` pairs. Keys are lowercase, and [`compile()`](#compile) ignores the case of what you write.
value.zh: 一個凍結的物件，有 26 組 `{ 字: 鼓聲 }`。鍵是小寫，[`compile()`](#compile) 不管你寫的大小寫。

caption.en: Looks up a few words, counts them, and teaches a line two words of your own by spreading `WORDS` into a new object.
caption.zh: 查幾個字、數有幾個，再把 `WORDS` 展開到新物件裡，讓一行節奏認得兩個你自己的字。

summary.en: An event you define: it is called at the first step of every bar of the drum machine, with the bar number.
summary.zh: 一個由你定義的事件函式：鼓機每一小節的第一格就會呼叫它，帶著小節的號碼。

description.en: Define `function barStarted(bar) { … }` to do something once per bar: `function barStarted(bar) { drift += 9; }`. It is called in the frame where the first step of the bar is heard, right before `draw()`, and the first call is `barStarted(1)` when the machine starts. Within a step, [`cueFired()`](#cueFired) comes before it and [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) after.
description.zh: 定義 `function barStarted(bar) { … }`，就可以每小節做一次事：`function barStarted(bar) { drift += 9; }`。它是在你聽到那一小節第一格的那個畫面、`draw()` 之前被呼叫的，鼓機啟動時的第一次呼叫是 `barStarted(1)`。在同一格裡，[`cueFired()`](#cueFired) 在它之前，[`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) 在它之後。

params.name: bar
params.en: The bar that starts, counted from 1.
params.zh: 剛開始的小節，從 1 算起。

notes.en: While the tab is hidden it is still called once per bar, but nothing is told twice when the tab comes back. [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) and the hits are not told in that time.
notes.zh: 分頁被藏起來的時候，每一小節仍然會呼叫一次，分頁回來的時候也不會補呼叫漏掉的。這段時間不會呼叫 [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted)，也不會通知打擊。

caption.en: The background changes colour at the start of every bar, while the number counts the bars.
caption.zh: 每一小節的開頭背景換一個顏色，數字數著現在是第幾小節。

summary.en: Plans something for a bar: at bar `bar` the function `cueFired(name, bar)` is called and `cueName` becomes `name`; with `every`, again every that many bars.
summary.zh: 替某一小節安排事情：到了第 `bar` 小節，就呼叫 `cueFired(name, bar)`，`cueName` 變成 `name`，給了 `every`，之後每隔那麼多小節再來一次。

description.en: The drum machine counts the bars, so it can run a plan: `cue(1, 'calm', 12); cue(5, 'bloom', 12); cue(9, 'storm', 12);` in `setup()` makes three scenes that come round every 12 bars. When a cue is due, [`cueFired(name, bar)`](#cueFired) is called and [`cueName`](#cueName) holds the name; read it in `draw()` if you prefer that to a callback. Several cues on one step fire in the order you declared them, before [`barStarted()`](#barStarted), [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) and the hits of that step.
description.zh: 鼓機會數小節，所以可以照著計畫走：在 `setup()` 裡寫 `cue(1, 'calm', 12); cue(5, 'bloom', 12); cue(9, 'storm', 12);`，就是三個場景，每 12 小節輪一圈。cue 到的時候會呼叫 [`cueFired(name, bar)`](#cueFired)，[`cueName`](#cueName) 裡也會是它的名字，不想用 callback 的話，在 `draw()` 裡讀它就好。同一格有好幾個 cue 的時候，會依你宣告的順序發動，並且在 [`barStarted()`](#barStarted)、[`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) 和那一格的打擊之前。

description.en: Calling `cue()` twice with the same values adds nothing, so it is safe in `draw()` too. Counting starts with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums), and a cue only fires when the machine passes its place: declare the cues right after `startDrums()` in `setup()` so that a cue at bar 1 is not missed. After the machine is stopped and started again, the cues fire again from bar 1.
description.zh: 用同樣的值呼叫兩次 `cue()` 不會重複加，所以放在 `draw()` 裡也安全。計數從 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 開始，cue 只在鼓機走過它的位置時才發動：請在 `setup()` 裡緊接著 `startDrums()` 宣告，第 1 小節的 cue 才不會漏掉。鼓機停止再啟動之後，cue 會從第 1 小節重新發動。

params.name: bar
params.en: The bar, counted from 1 (the first bar). A fraction is a place inside a bar: 4.5 is halfway through bar 4 (the nearest of the 16 steps is used). A value below 1, or one that is not a number, prints a warning in the console and adds nothing.
params.zh: 第幾小節，第一小節是 1。小數表示小節裡的位置：4.5 是第 4 小節的一半（會取最接近的那一格，共 16 格）。小於 1 或不是數字的值，會在主控台印一個警告，什麼都不會加。

params.name: name
params.en: What to call it, usually a string. It is passed to [`cueFired()`](#cueFired) and becomes [`cueName`](#cueName).
params.zh: 給它取的名字，通常是字串。會傳給 [`cueFired()`](#cueFired)，並成為 [`cueName`](#cueName)。

params.name: every
params.en: Repeat every this many bars after the first time (fractions work, at least one step). 0 or left out: only once.
params.zh: 第一次之後，每隔這麼多小節再來一次（小數可以，至少一格）。0 或不傳：只發動一次。

returns.en: Nothing. [`OAVp5.drums.cue()`](#OAVp5.drums.cue) is the same function and returns the cue it made.
returns.zh: 沒有回傳值。[`OAVp5.drums.cue()`](#OAVp5.drums.cue) 是同一個函式，它會回傳建立出來的 cue。

notes.en: A cue declared after its bar has passed fires at its next repeat if it has an `every`, otherwise never until the machine is started again. Without a running machine no cue fires at all.
notes.zh: 如果 cue 是在它的那一小節已經過了之後才宣告的，有 `every` 就會在下一次重複時發動，沒有的話，要等到鼓機重新啟動才會發動。鼓機沒在跑的時候，任何 cue 都不會發動。

caption.en: The picture swaps between "calm" (blue) and "storm" (red) every two bars, and the text names the scene and the bar.
caption.zh: 畫面每兩小節在 "calm"（藍色）和 "storm"（紅色）之間切換，文字說明現在的場景和小節。

caption.en: The screen flashes in the middle of bar 2 and again in the middle of every second bar after it.
caption.zh: 畫面在第 2 小節的中間閃一下，之後每隔一小節的中間又閃一次。

caption.en: cue() inside draw() is safe: the text changes to "last cue: drop" at bar 2 and stays that way.
caption.zh: 在 draw() 裡呼叫 cue() 也沒問題：到了第 2 小節，文字變成 "last cue: drop" 就一直是這樣。

summary.en: An event you define: it is called when the bar of a cue declared with `cue()` has come, with the cue's name and the bar.
summary.zh: 一個由你定義的事件函式：用 `cue()` 宣告的 cue，到了它的那一小節就會呼叫它，帶著 cue 的名字和小節。

description.en: Define `function cueFired(name, bar) { … }` and it is called at the step where a cue is due, before [`barStarted()`](#barStarted), [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) and the hits of that step. A good place to change a scene: `function cueFired(name) { look = SCENES[name]; }`. If you only need the latest name, read [`cueName`](#cueName) in `draw()` instead.
description.zh: 定義 `function cueFired(name, bar) { … }`，cue 該發動的那一格就會呼叫它，順序在 [`barStarted()`](#barStarted)、[`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted) 和那一格的打擊之前。很適合用來換場景：`function cueFired(name) { look = SCENES[name]; }`。如果你只需要最近的名字，在 `draw()` 裡讀 [`cueName`](#cueName) 就好。

params.name: name
params.en: The name you gave to [`cue()`](#cue).
params.zh: 你給 [`cue()`](#cue) 的名字。

params.name: bar
params.en: The bar the cue fired in, counted from 1. For a cue in the middle of a bar (4.5) it is the whole bar it falls in (4).
params.zh: cue 發動時所在的小節，從 1 算起。小節中間的 cue（4.5）給的是它落在的那一整小節（4）。

notes.en: Cues keep firing while the tab is hidden, so the scene is right when you come back. Several cues on one step call it once each, in the order they were declared.
notes.zh: 分頁被藏起來的時候，cue 照樣會發動，所以回來的時候場景是對的。同一格有好幾個 cue，會依宣告的順序各呼叫一次。

caption.en: The screen flashes and names the scene each time a cue fires: intro once, then verse and chorus take turns.
caption.zh: 每次 cue 發動，畫面閃一下並顯示場景名稱：intro 只有一次，之後 verse 和 chorus 輪流。

summary.en: The name of the last cue that fired, or an empty string before the first one.
summary.zh: 最近一個發動的 cue 的名字，第一個發動之前是空字串。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` instead of waiting for [`cueFired()`](#cueFired): `look = SCENES[cueName];`. It is the name of the last cue only, so it is the right thing for "which scene am I in", and `cueFired()` is the right thing for "something just began". Cues are declared with [`cue()`](#cue).
description.zh: 可以在 `draw()` 裡直接讀，不用等 [`cueFired()`](#cueFired)：`look = SCENES[cueName];`。它只是最近一個 cue 的名字，所以回答「我現在在哪個場景」用它最適合，「某件事剛剛開始」則適合用 `cueFired()`。cue 用 [`cue()`](#cue) 宣告。

value.en: Changes when a cue fires, and keeps the name until the next one. It is `''` at the start.
value.zh: cue 發動的時候改變，之後一直是那個名字，直到下一個。一開始是 `''`。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own variable called `cueName` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.drums.lastCue` instead.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `cueName` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.drums.lastCue`。

caption.en: The background and the word follow the last cue: blue "calm", pink "bloom", grey "storm", every six bars.
caption.zh: 背景和文字跟著最近一個 cue 走：藍色 "calm"、粉紅色 "bloom"、灰色 "storm"，每六小節輪一圈。

summary.en: Which bar the drum machine is in, counted from 1 when it started.
summary.zh: 鼓機現在在第幾小節，從啟動的時候起算，第一小節是 1。

description.en: A bar is 16 steps, four beats. Use it to give a piece a shape: `floor((drumBar - 1) / 4) % 3` is the section number when you change every four bars. To make something happen at an exact bar, [`cue()`](#cue) is neater than testing `drumBar` in `draw()`. [`barStarted()`](#barStarted) is the function that is called at the start of each bar.
description.zh: 一小節是 16 格、四拍。用它替作品安排結構：每四小節換一段的話，`floor((drumBar - 1) / 4) % 3` 就是現在是第幾段。要讓某件事剛好發生在某一小節，[`cue()`](#cue) 比在 `draw()` 裡判斷 `drumBar` 更簡潔。[`barStarted()`](#barStarted) 則是每小節開頭會被呼叫的函式。

value.en: 0 before the machine has played its first step, then 1, 2, 3 … with no upper limit. It keeps its last value when the machine stops.
value.zh: 鼓機播第一格之前是 0，之後是 1、2、3 ……，沒有上限。鼓機停止之後停在最後的值。

needs.en: Start the machine with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums). Stopping and starting again counts from bar 1 again.
needs.zh: 先用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 啟動鼓機。停止之後再啟動，會從第 1 小節重新算起。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own variable called `drumBar` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.drums.bar` instead.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `drumBar` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.drums.bar`。

caption.en: A big number that goes up by one at the start of every bar.
caption.zh: 一個大數字，每一小節開頭加一。

caption.en: The background changes colour every two bars and the text names the bar and the section.
caption.zh: 背景每兩小節換一個顏色，文字說明現在是第幾小節、第幾段。

summary.en: Which of the 16 steps of the bar the drum machine just played, from 0 to 15.
summary.zh: 鼓機剛剛播到這一小節 16 格裡的第幾格，從 0 到 15。

description.en: A bar has 16 steps (sixteenth notes) and a beat has 4, so `drumStep % 4 === 0` is a beat and `drumStep === 0` the start of a bar. At 120 bpm a step lasts 125 ms. Use it to light a cell or pick a frame: `fill(i === drumStep ? 255 : 80)`. If you would rather be called on each step, define [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted). For something that moves smoothly instead of in 16 jumps, use [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase).
description.zh: 一小節有 16 格（十六分音符），一拍有 4 格，所以 `drumStep % 4 === 0` 就是正拍，`drumStep === 0` 是小節的開頭。速度 120 的時候一格是 125 毫秒。可以用它讓某一格亮起來或挑選畫面：`fill(i === drumStep ? 255 : 80)`。如果你比較想在每一格被呼叫，就定義 [`stepStarted()`](#stepStarted)。想要平滑移動，不要 16 次跳動的話，用 [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase)。

value.en: Changes in the frame in which a step is heard, right before `draw()`. 0 at the start, and it keeps its last value when the machine stops.
value.zh: 在你聽到那一格的那個畫面、`draw()` 之前改變。一開始是 0，鼓機停止之後停在最後的值。

needs.en: Start the machine with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums). Before that, and when the machine is stopped, the value is 0 or the last one, so check [`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn) if the difference matters.
needs.zh: 先用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 啟動鼓機。在那之前、以及鼓機停止之後，值是 0 或最後的值，這個差別重要的話，要檢查 [`drumsAreOn`](#drumsAreOn)。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own variable called `drumStep` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.drums.step` instead. While the tab is hidden the clock keeps counting but nothing else is told.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `drumStep` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.drums.step`。分頁被藏起來的時候，時鐘照樣在數，但不會通知任何事件。

caption.en: Sixteen cells in a row with the current step lit, one cell at a time, from left to right.
caption.zh: 一排十六個格子，現在的那一格亮著，從左到右一格一格走。

caption.en: The background lights up on every beat (steps 0, 4, 8, 12) and the text counts the steps.
caption.zh: 每一拍（第 0、4、8、12 格）背景亮一下，文字數著現在是第幾格。

summary.en: An event you define: it is called at every one of the 16 steps of the drum machine, with the step and the bar.
summary.zh: 一個由你定義的事件函式：鼓機 16 格裡的每一格都會呼叫它，帶著這一格和小節。

description.en: Define `function stepStarted(step, bar) { … }` for something on every step: `if (step % 4 === 0) ping = 1;` is a pulse on the beat. It is called in the frame where the step is heard, right before `draw()`, after [`barStarted()`](#barStarted) and before the hits of that step. [`drumStep`](#drumStep) holds the same number if you would rather read than be called.
description.zh: 定義 `function stepStarted(step, bar) { … }`，每一格都能做事：`if (step % 4 === 0) ping = 1;` 就是每一拍脈動一下。它是在你聽到那一格的那個畫面、`draw()` 之前被呼叫的，在 [`barStarted()`](#barStarted) 之後、那一格的打擊之前。如果你比較想讀值而不是被呼叫，[`drumStep`](#drumStep) 裡是同一個數字。

params.name: step
params.en: The step that starts, 0 to 15. Every 4 steps is a beat.
params.zh: 剛開始的那一格，0 到 15。每 4 格是一拍。

params.name: bar
params.en: The bar it is in, counted from 1.
params.zh: 它所在的小節，從 1 算起。

notes.en: It is not called while the tab is hidden, so a sketch that adds a particle per step does not burst when you come back.
notes.zh: 分頁被藏起來的時候不會呼叫它，所以每一格就加一個粒子的草圖，在你回來的時候不會一口氣冒出一大堆。

caption.en: A circle that pulses on every beat (every fourth step) and shrinks back in between.
caption.zh: 一個圓，每一拍（每四格）脹一下，中間縮回去。

summary.en: How many steps the drum machine has played since it started, from 0; -1 before the first one.
summary.zh: 鼓機從啟動到現在一共播了幾格，從 0 開始算，第一格之前是 -1。

description.en: It is the single clock the others are cut from: `drumBar` is `floor(count / 16) + 1`, `drumStep` is `count % 16`, and [`cue()`](#cue) fires when `count` reaches the step of its bar. It is handy when you want one number that only grows: a position on a very long timeline, or an index into a list.
description.zh: 其他的數字都是從它切出來的：`drumBar` 是 `floor(count / 16) + 1`，`drumStep` 是 `count % 16`，[`cue()`](#cue) 是在 `count` 走到它那一小節的位置時發動。想要一個只會一直變大的數字的時候很好用，例如很長的時間軸上的位置，或是清單的索引。

value.en: Goes up by one at every step and never goes back to 0 at a new bar. It starts again from 0 when the machine is started again.
value.zh: 每一格加一，到了新的小節也不會歸零。機器重新啟動的時候，才會從 0 重新算。

needs.en: Start the machine with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums); it is -1 until the first step has played.
needs.zh: 先用 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 啟動鼓機，第一格播出來之前都是 -1。

caption.en: The running step count and the bar and step it is made of.
caption.zh: 一路累加的格數，以及它換算成的小節和格。

summary.en: The same as `cue(bar, name, every)`, but it returns the cue it made (or the one that was already there), and `null` when `bar` is not valid.
summary.zh: 跟 `cue(bar, name, every)` 一樣，但會回傳建立出來的 cue（或原本就有的那個），`bar` 無效的時候回傳 `null`。

description.en: Use it when you want to hold on to the cue, for example to find out which step it fires at. For a plain plan, [`cue()`](#cue) is shorter. The list of every cue is [`OAVp5.drums.cues`](#OAVp5.drums.cues).
description.zh: 想拿著這個 cue 的時候用它，例如想知道它在第幾格發動。只是安排計畫的話，[`cue()`](#cue) 比較短。所有 cue 的清單在 [`OAVp5.drums.cues`](#OAVp5.drums.cues)。

params.name: bar
params.en: The bar, counted from 1; 4.5 is halfway through bar 4. See [`cue()`](#cue).
params.zh: 第幾小節，從 1 算起，4.5 是第 4 小節的一半。見 [`cue()`](#cue)。

params.name: name
params.en: What to call the cue.
params.zh: 這個 cue 的名字。

params.name: every
params.en: Repeat every this many bars; 0 or left out: once.
params.zh: 每隔幾小節再來一次，0 或不傳：只一次。

returns.en: The cue: `{ bar, name, every, at, period, key }` with `at` and `period` counted in steps. `null` if `bar` is below 1 or not a number. A repeat of an earlier call gives back the cue that exists.
returns.zh: 這個 cue：`{ bar, name, every, at, period, key }`，其中 `at` 和 `period` 以格為單位。`bar` 小於 1 或不是數字就是 `null`。重複前面呼叫過的，會回傳已經存在的那個 cue。

caption.en: Bar 3.5 is step 40 of the count, and "every 4 bars" is 64 steps.
caption.zh: 第 3.5 小節是累計的第 40 格，「每 4 小節」是 64 格。

summary.en: The list of every cue declared so far, in the order they were declared.
summary.zh: 到目前為止宣告過的所有 cue，照宣告的順序排。

description.en: Read it to show a plan on screen or to check what is declared. It is the machine's own list, so treat it as read-only; declare cues with [`cue()`](#cue).
description.zh: 想把計畫顯示在畫面上，或檢查宣告了哪些 cue 的時候讀它。它是鼓機自己的清單，請當成唯讀，要宣告 cue 請用 [`cue()`](#cue)。

value.en: Each item is `{ bar, name, every, at, period, key }`: the values you passed, and `at` and `period` counted in steps. An empty list at the start.
value.zh: 每一項是 `{ bar, name, every, at, period, key }`：你傳進去的值，以及以格為單位的 `at` 和 `period`。一開始是空的。

caption.en: The plan as a list: one line per cue.
caption.zh: 把計畫列成清單：每個 cue 一行。

entries.name: Director
entries.signature: new Director({ score, modules = [], api = {}, onStatus = null, onCue = null, maxStep = 2 } = {})

summary.en: Runs a score's segment modules: enters each once, updates it every frame, exits it once, fires cues, and switches off a module that crashes without stopping the show.
summary.zh: 執行總譜的段落模組：每個模組進場一次、每個畫面更新、退場一次，觸發 cue，而且某個模組當掉時只關掉它，不會讓演出停下來。

description.en:
A **segment module** is the code that performs one segment (the dawn, the storm, the finale). The director calls its hooks as the show moves through the score:

```js
{
  id: 'dusk',                                  // the id of the segment it performs
  enter(api, ctx)  {},                         // the segment began, or a seek landed inside it
  update(api, ctx) {},                         // every frame while the segment (and its linger) is current
  exit(api, ctx)   {},                         // it ended, or a seek left it: give back what you took
  param(key, value, ctx) { return value; },    // optional: rewrite a timeline param meanwhile
  cue(name, ctx)   {},                         // optional: one of its cues was just passed
  reset(api)       {},                         // optional: R was pressed, forget everything
}
```
description.zh:
**段落模組**就是負責表演一個段落（黎明、暴風雨、終曲）的程式碼。演出走過總譜的時候，導演會呼叫它的掛鉤：

```js
{
  id: 'dusk',                                  // the id of the segment it performs
  enter(api, ctx)  {},                         // the segment began, or a seek landed inside it
  update(api, ctx) {},                         // every frame while the segment (and its linger) is current
  exit(api, ctx)   {},                         // it ended, or a seek left it: give back what you took
  param(key, value, ctx) { return value; },    // optional: rewrite a timeline param meanwhile
  cue(name, ctx)   {},                         // optional: one of its cues was just passed
  reset(api)       {},                         // optional: R was pressed, forget everything
}
```

description.en: Every hook gets a `ctx`: `p` (progress through the segment, 0 to 1; above 1 during `linger`; exactly 1 while holding), `t` (seconds into the segment), `dt`, `dur`, `T` (show time), `segment`, `cue(name)` and `cueT(name)` (where a cue sits, as a progress and in show seconds), `phase` (`'active'`, `'linger'`, or `'failed'` inside `exit()` after a crash), `holding`, `held` (seconds waited at a hold: a clock for ambient motion while `T` is frozen), `playing` and `api`.
description.zh: 每個掛鉤都會收到一個 `ctx`：`p`（這一段走了多少，0 到 1，餘韻期間大於 1，hold 的時候剛好是 1）、`t`（段內第幾秒）、`dt`、`dur`、`T`（演出時間）、`segment`、`cue(name)` 和 `cueT(name)`（cue 的位置，一個是進度、一個是演出秒數）、`phase`（`'active'`、`'linger'`，崩潰後的 `exit()` 裡是 `'failed'`）、`holding`、`held`（在 hold 上等了幾秒，演出時間 `T` 凍結時可以拿它當環境動態的時鐘）、`playing` 和 `api`。

description.en: A module is entered once and exited once, however the show got there: a seek into the middle of a segment calls `enter` with the right `p`, so a module must be able to start from the middle. A module that throws is switched off alone: the director calls its `exit()` once with `phase: 'failed'`, logs one `console.error`, and never calls it again; the other modules and the show carry on. Reset brings it back.
description.zh: 一個模組只進場一次、只退場一次，不管演出是怎麼走到那裡的：seek 到段落中間，會用正確的 `p` 呼叫 `enter`，所以模組必須能從中間開始。丟出錯誤的模組只有它自己會被關掉：導演用 `phase: 'failed'` 呼叫一次它的 `exit()`，印出一行 `console.error`，之後不再呼叫它，其他模組和演出照常進行。reset 可以把它請回來。

description.en: In a show, [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds the director from its `score` option and calls `update()` every frame after the timeline has advanced; the director's `param()` plugs into `timeline.layer`. Without `createShow()` you do that wiring yourself: `director.update(timeline.t, dt, { holding: timeline.holding, playing: timeline.playing })`.
description.zh: 在演出裡，[`createShow()`](#createShow) 依 `score` 選項建好導演，每個畫面在時間軸前進之後呼叫 `update()`，導演的 `param()` 接到 `timeline.layer` 上。不用 `createShow()` 的話，這些接線要自己做：`director.update(timeline.t, dt, { holding: timeline.holding, playing: timeline.playing })`。

params.name: score
params.en: The [`Score`](#Score) to perform. Required: without it the constructor throws "Director needs a score".
params.zh: 要表演的 [`Score`](#Score)。必填，沒有的話建構函式會丟出 "Director needs a score"。

params.name: modules
params.en: The segment modules: an array (matched to segments by each module's `id`) or an object keyed by segment id. A segment with no module is simply not performed.
params.zh: 段落模組：一個陣列（依每個模組的 `id` 對應到段落），或以段落 id 為 key 的物件。沒有模組的段落就單純不被表演。

params.name: api
params.en: What every module hook receives as its first argument (also `ctx.api`). A function is called once, the first time it is needed, and its result is used.
params.zh: 每個模組的掛鉤收到的第一個參數（也是 `ctx.api`）。如果是函式，會在第一次需要時呼叫一次，然後使用它回傳的結果。

params.name: onStatus
params.en: Called with `status()` when the segment, the holding state or the list of switched-off modules changes, not every frame.
params.zh: 當段落、hold 的狀態或被關掉的模組清單改變的時候，以 `status()` 呼叫，不是每個畫面都呼叫。

params.name: onCue
params.en: Called for each cue the playhead passes: `{ name, cue, T, n, segment }`.
params.zh: 播放頭每經過一個 cue 就呼叫一次：`{ name, cue, T, n, segment }`。

params.name: maxStep
params.en: A jump bigger than this many seconds between two `update()` calls counts as a seek, so the cues in between are not fired. Raise it if you rehearse at a very high `timeline.rate`.
params.zh: 兩次 `update()` 之間跳超過這麼多秒，就算是 seek，中間的 cue 不會觸發。如果你用很高的 `timeline.rate` 排練，把它調大。

notes.en: The last segment is never exited by time: while the show sits at its end (or past it), the last module stays entered. It exits on a seek that leaves it, or on `reset()`.
notes.zh: 最後一個段落不會因為時間而退場：演出停在尾端（或超過尾端）時，最後一個模組仍維持進場狀態。它只在 seek 離開或 `reset()` 時退場。

notes.en: A new segment's module is entered before the old one exits, and during `linger` both run at the same time.
notes.zh: 新段落的模組會先進場、舊的才退場，在 `linger` 期間兩個會同時在跑。

notes.en: A module whose `module` or `id` matches no segment, or a segment that names a module nobody registered (listed in `status().missing`), is simply not performed. The show keeps going.
notes.zh: `module` 或 `id` 對不到任何段落的模組，或段落指定了沒人登記的模組（會列在 `status().missing`），都只是不被表演，演出照常進行。

caption.en: The console prints `dawn enter, p = 0`, `dawn cue birds` (second 2), then `noon enter, p = 0` and `dawn exit` at second 4. The last segment stays entered to the end.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `dawn enter, p = 0`、`dawn cue birds`（第 2 秒），然後第 4 秒是 `noon enter, p = 0` 和 `dawn exit`。最後一個段落會一直維持進場到結束。

caption.en: While `dawn` is current its module bends only the `sun` param, following its own progress: the console prints `0.25 0.9`, then `0.5`.
caption.zh: `dawn` 在進行的時候，它的模組只改動 `sun` 這個參數，跟著自己的進度走：主控台印出 `0.25 0.9`，然後是 `0.5`。

caption.en: A crash is contained: the console prints `logged: [score] segment module "dawn" crashed in update: boom and was` (normally a red error line), then `noon is still performed`, `[ 'dawn' ] { dawn: 'update: boom' }`, and after the reset `[]`.
caption.zh: 崩潰被關在原地：主控台印出 `logged: [score] segment module "dawn" crashed in update: boom and was`（平常那是一行紅色的錯誤訊息），接著是 `noon is still performed`、`[ 'dawn' ] { dawn: 'update: boom' }`，reset 之後是 `[]`。

members.name: register
members.doc: Add a segment module (replaces one with the same id).

members.name: moduleFor
members.doc: The module that performs a segment: its `module` name if the cut gives one, else its own id.

members.name: update
members.doc: Call once per frame.

members.name: param
members.doc: The timeline's param layer: let the modules of the current segments rewrite a param.

members.name: seek
members.doc: The playhead jumped to T: modules whose segment no longer covers T exit now; the next update() enters the new ones with the right p.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Back to the start: every active module exits, every module hears reset(), disabled modules come back.

members.name: status
members.doc: For the desk and the backstage: the current segment, the next one and how long until it, who is off.

summary.en: A show written as segments with lengths, never as absolute seconds: it works out every start, end, cue and countdown, for every version (cut) of the show.
summary.zh: 把一場演出寫成「每一段有多長」，而不是絕對秒數：每個起點、終點、cue 和倒數，以及每一個版本（cut）的時間，都由它算出來。

description.en: A timeline written as a table of absolute seconds cannot grow: make one scene longer and every later cue, curve and `if (t > 466)` is wrong. In a score you write only how **long** each segment is, and `Score` computes every start, end, cue time, countdown and scene from those lengths. Change one `dur` and everything after it moves; a second version of the show is a few lines of data.
description.zh: 把時間軸寫成一張絕對秒數的表，它就長不大：某個場景拉長一點，後面每個 cue、曲線和 `if (t > 466)` 全都錯了。在總譜裡你只寫每一段「多**長**」，`Score` 從這些長度算出每個起點、終點、cue 的時間、倒數和場景。改一個 `dur`，它後面的一切都跟著挪。第二個版本只是幾行資料。

description.en:
A cut is one version of the show; a segment is one stretch of it:

```js
{ id: 'full', title: 'A day', segments: [
  { id: 'standby', dur: 6, hold: true, acts: ['Press Space when the room is ready'] },
  { id: 'dawn',    dur: 24, cues: { birds: 0.3 } },          // a ratio of the segment
  { id: 'noon',    dur: 30, cues: { flare: { s: 8 } } },     // or seconds into it
  { id: 'dusk',    dur: 24, linger: 8 },
] }
{ id: 'short', from: 'full', scale: 0.5 }                     // the same show at half the length
```

`dur` is the only time a segment has. `cues` are named moments (a ratio `0 <= r < 1`, or `{ s: seconds }`), `acts` is what the human operator does (strings shown on the desk), `linger` keeps a segment's module running for some seconds after it ends, `hold` stops playback at the end of the segment until the operator releases it, and `module` names the module that performs it when that is not the segment's own id. A derived cut scales `dur`, `linger` and `{ s }` cues, so a cue keeps its place in the music.
description.zh:
一個 cut 是演出的一個版本，一個 segment（段落）是其中的一段：

```js
{ id: 'full', title: 'A day', segments: [
  { id: 'standby', dur: 6, hold: true, acts: ['Press Space when the room is ready'] },
  { id: 'dawn',    dur: 24, cues: { birds: 0.3 } },          // a ratio of the segment
  { id: 'noon',    dur: 30, cues: { flare: { s: 8 } } },     // or seconds into it
  { id: 'dusk',    dur: 24, linger: 8 },
] }
{ id: 'short', from: 'full', scale: 0.5 }                     // the same show at half the length
```

`dur` 是一個段落唯一擁有的時間。`cues` 是有名字的時刻（比例 `0 <= r < 1`，或 `{ s: 秒數 }`），`acts` 是操作者要做的事（顯示在控台上的字串），`linger` 讓段落的模組在段落結束後再多跑幾秒，`hold` 讓播放停在段落尾端，等操作者放行，`module` 在負責表演的模組不是段落自己的 id 時，指定模組名稱。衍生的 cut 會縮放 `dur`、`linger` 和 `{ s }` 形式的 cue，所以 cue 在音樂裡的位置不變。

description.en: Everything is checked when the score is built. Duplicate ids, a `dur` of 0 or below, a `from` that is not a cut, a cut derived from itself, a cue outside its segment: each throws a [`ScoreError`](#ScoreError) that lists every problem at once. In a show, [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds the score from its `score` option and hands it to a [`Timeline`](#Timeline) and a [`Director`](#Director); `?cut=<id>` in the page address picks the cut.
description.zh: 總譜在建立的時候就會全部檢查一遍。id 重複、`dur` 等於或小於 0、`from` 指到不存在的 cut、cut 衍生自己、cue 落在段落外面，每一種都會丟出 [`ScoreError`](#ScoreError)，一次把所有問題列出來。在演出裡，[`createShow()`](#createShow) 依 `score` 選項建好總譜，交給 [`Timeline`](#Timeline) 和 [`Director`](#Director)，網址上的 `?cut=<id>` 可以選 cut。

params.name: cuts
params.en: The cuts this show can be performed as: an array of cuts, or an object keyed by cut id. A cut is `{ id, title?, start?, segments: [...] }`, or a derived one, `{ id, title?, from, scale }`. Required: without a cut it throws.
params.zh: 這場演出可以表演成哪些 cut：一個 cut 的陣列，或以 cut id 為 key 的物件。一個 cut 是 `{ id, title?, start?, segments: [...] }`，或衍生的 `{ id, title?, from, scale }`。必填，沒有 cut 就會丟出錯誤。

params.name: cut
params.en: The id of the cut to perform. Defaults to the first one; an id that is not in `cuts` is an error.
params.zh: 要表演的 cut 的 id。預設是第一個，不在 `cuts` 裡的 id 是錯誤。

notes.en: Plain fields: `cut` (the id being performed), `title`, `segments` (each with `start`, `end`, `dur`, `index`, `cues` …), `total` (the length of the show), `startT` (where `reset` goes), `scale` and `base`.
notes.zh: 普通欄位：`cut`（正在表演的 id）、`title`、`segments`（每一段都有 `start`、`end`、`dur`、`index`、`cues` ……）、`total`（演出總長）、`startT`（`reset` 回到哪裡）、`scale` 和 `base`。

notes.en: Segment and cue ids must not contain a dot: the dot is how `cueTime('dusk.glow')` separates a segment from its cue. A cue cannot be called `end`.
notes.zh: 段落和 cue 的 id 不能含有句點：`cueTime('dusk.glow')` 就是靠句點把段落和它的 cue 分開。cue 也不能叫 `end`。

notes.en: If two cuts differ in structure and not only in length, do not share automation between them. Drive the params from the segment modules instead, where `ctx.p` already scales for free.
notes.zh: 如果兩個 cut 不只是長度不同、連結構都不同，就不要讓它們共用自動化曲線，改由段落模組來驅動參數，那裡的 `ctx.p` 本來就會跟著縮放。

caption.en: The console shows a table of the three segments (`dawn` 0 to 24, `noon` 24 to 54, `dusk` 54 to 80), then `80 noon 32`: the show is 80 seconds long, second 40 is in `noon`, and the flare cue sits at 32.
caption.zh: 主控台會顯示三個段落的表格（`dawn` 0 到 24、`noon` 24 到 54、`dusk` 54 到 80），然後印出 `80 noon 32`：演出長 80 秒，第 40 秒在 `noon`，flare 這個 cue 在第 32 秒。

caption.en: The same show at two lengths: `full 54 6 32`, then `short 27 3 16`. Every time is halved and the cues stay in the same place in the music.
caption.zh: 同一場演出的兩種長度：`full 54 6 32`，然後 `short 27 3 16`。所有時間都減半，cue 在音樂裡的位置不變。

caption.en: The timeline takes its scenes and total from the score, and reads the haze curve (written once for the full cut) stretched: `full 80 a@0 b@20 c@60 0.25`, then `short 40 a@0 b@10 c@30 0.5`.
caption.zh: 時間軸的場景和總長都從總譜來，而且讀的是被拉伸的 haze 曲線（只對完整版寫過一次）：`full 80 a@0 b@20 c@60 0.25`，然後 `short 40 a@0 b@10 c@30 0.5`。

members.name: cuts
members.doc: Every cut, for a version picker: [{ id, title, total, from?, scale }]

members.name: validate
members.doc: Re-check everything and throw a ScoreError listing every problem.

members.name: table
members.doc: One row per segment, for console.table and docs.

members.name: segment
members.doc: The segment with this id (undefined when there is none).

members.name: indexAt
members.doc: Index of the segment playing at show time T.

members.name: cueTime
members.doc: A named moment in show seconds.

members.name: cues
members.doc: Every cue of the cut in time order: [{ name, cue, T, p, n, segment }] (n = its place in that order).

members.name: cuesBetween
members.doc: The cues a playhead passed going from T0 to T1: those with T0 < time ≤ T1, in order.

members.name: baseTime
members.doc: Time on the cut this one was derived from.

members.name: scenes
members.doc: The segments as a

summary.en: The error a Score throws when it cannot be built: its `problems` array lists every reason at once, and its message lists them too.
summary.zh: 總譜建不起來的時候丟出的錯誤：它的 `problems` 陣列一次列出所有原因，錯誤訊息裡也會一起列出來。

description.en: You rarely build one yourself: [`new Score()`](#Score) throws it. `error.problems` is an array of strings and `error.message` is the same list as one text, headed "Score is invalid (3 problems)". `error.name` is `'ScoreError'`, and it is a normal `Error`, so `instanceof ScoreError` and `instanceof Error` both work.
description.zh: 通常不用自己建：[`new Score()`](#Score) 會丟出它。`error.problems` 是字串陣列，`error.message` 是同一份清單串成的文字，開頭是「Score is invalid (3 problems)」。`error.name` 是 `'ScoreError'`，它是一般的 `Error`，所以 `instanceof ScoreError` 和 `instanceof Error` 都成立。

description.en: It lists every problem it found, not only the first, so one run of the show shows you everything to fix. Nothing half-valid can reach the stage.
description.zh: 它會列出找到的所有問題，不是只列第一個，所以跑一次就能看到所有要修的地方。有問題的總譜上不了台。

params.name: problems
params.en: The reasons, one string each. Each one names the cut, the segment and what is wrong.
params.zh: 所有原因，每個一個字串。每一個都會指出是哪個 cut、哪個段落、哪裡不對。

caption.en: Three mistakes, all reported at once: the console prints `true 3` and then one line for each (a `dur` of 0, a repeated id, a `from` that is not a cut).
caption.zh: 三個錯誤一次全部報出來：主控台印出 `true 3`，然後每個錯誤一行（`dur` 是 0、id 重複、`from` 指到不存在的 cut）。

summary.en: The curve names a keyframe can use to say how its segment gets there: `linear`, `ease`, `in`, `out`, `step`, each a function from 0..1 to 0..1.
summary.zh: 關鍵影格可以用來說明「這一段怎麼抵達」的曲線名稱：`linear`、`ease`、`in`、`out`、`step`，每個都是 0..1 對應到 0..1 的函式。

description.en: In a [`Timeline`](#Timeline), the third item of a keyframe names the curve of the segment that **ends** at that keyframe: `[30, 320, 'ease']` means "arrive at 320 at second 30 the `ease` way". `linear` is the default, and an unknown name or a typo also falls back to `linear`, so a mistake never stops a show. You can pass your own function instead of a name.
description.zh: 在 [`Timeline`](#Timeline) 裡，關鍵影格的第三項是「**抵達**這個影格的那一段」的曲線名稱：`[30, 320, 'ease']` 的意思是「用 `ease` 的方式，在第 30 秒抵達 320」。預設是 `linear`，名稱不認得或打錯也會退回 `linear`，所以打錯字不會讓演出停下來。你也可以傳自己的函式，不用名稱。

description.en: `linear` goes straight. `ease` is a smoothstep: slow, fast, slow. `in` starts slowly (f²). `out` starts fast and lands softly (1 − (1 − f)²). `step` is special: the segment holds the **old** value until the keyframe, then jumps. The `step` function stored here returns 0 and is never called to interpolate; it is listed so that the object is the whole vocabulary.
description.zh: `linear` 走直線。`ease` 是 smoothstep：慢、快、慢。`in` 起頭慢（f²）。`out` 起頭快、輕輕落地（1 − (1 − f)²）。`step` 比較特別：這一段會一直守著**舊**值，到了關鍵影格才跳過去。放在這裡的 `step` 函式永遠回傳 0，內插的時候不會用它來算，列在這裡只是為了讓這個物件涵蓋整套名稱。

description.en: A param declared with `step` in its [`Params`](#Params) schema holds each keyframe whatever curve you name.
description.zh: 在 [`Params`](#Params) 的 schema 裡宣告了 `step` 的參數，不管你寫哪種曲線，都會停在每個關鍵影格。

caption.en: The console prints how far each curve has got at the halfway point: `linear 0.5`, `ease 0.5`, `in 0.25`, `out 0.75`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出每條曲線在一半的時間點走到了哪裡：`linear 0.5`、`ease 0.5`、`in 0.25`、`out 0.75`。

caption.en: One lane, three curves: the console prints a slow start (`8 0.63`), the arrival at `16 1.60`, a long hold (`19 1.60`) until the step jumps at 20 (`20 3.40`), then an `out` curve down to `30 0.80`.
caption.zh: 一條軌道，三種曲線：主控台印出緩慢的起頭（`8 0.63`）、第 16 秒抵達 `16 1.60`、一路守著（`19 1.60`）到第 20 秒 step 才跳（`20 3.40`），最後用 `out` 曲線降到 `30 0.80`。

caption.en: A function works wherever a name does. Halfway through, a cubic curve is only an eighth of the way: the console prints `0.5` (4 × 0.125).
caption.zh: 函式可以用在任何可以寫名稱的地方。走到一半的時候，三次方曲線只走了八分之一：主控台印出 `0.5`（4 × 0.125）。

summary.en: How far before the boundary the playhead parks when a hold stops the show: one microsecond, so it still belongs to the scene that is waiting.
summary.zh: hold 讓演出停住的時候，播放頭停在邊界前多遠的地方：一微秒，這樣它仍然屬於正在等候的那個場景。

description.en: A scene with `hold: true` stops playback at its end. The [`Timeline`](#Timeline) parks `HOLD_EPS` (0.000001 seconds) **before** the boundary rather than on it, so `sceneIndexAt(t)` and the director still say "the held scene", `timeline.t` reads 5.999999 for a hold at 6, and the next scene has not started. `release()` then moves the playhead onto the boundary itself.
description.zh: `hold: true` 的場景會在尾端讓播放停住。[`Timeline`](#Timeline) 把播放頭停在邊界**前面** `HOLD_EPS`（0.000001 秒）的地方，而不是正好停在邊界上，所以 `sceneIndexAt(t)` 和導演仍然說「現在是被 hold 的那個場景」，在 6 秒的 hold 上 `timeline.t` 讀到的是 5.999999，下一個場景還沒開始。之後 `release()` 才把播放頭移到邊界本身。

description.en: You only need it when you compare the playhead with a boundary yourself: while holding, `timeline.t` is `boundary - HOLD_EPS`, not exactly `boundary`.
description.zh: 只有在你自己拿播放頭跟邊界做比較的時候才會用到：hold 的時候，`timeline.t` 是 `邊界 - HOLD_EPS`，不是剛好等於邊界。

caption.en: The show parks just before second 6, still inside the held scene: the console prints `true wait true` (`6 - timeline.t` is `HOLD_EPS`, apart from rounding).
caption.zh: 演出停在第 6 秒的稍前方，仍然在被 hold 的場景裡：主控台印出 `true wait true`（`6 - timeline.t` 在捨入誤差內等於 `HOLD_EPS`）。

entries.name: Timeline
entries.signature: new Timeline({ params, automation = {}, scenes = [], total = 600, score = null, start = null, loop = false, onCue = null })

summary.en: Answers "what is every param at time t?" from keyframes, and runs the transport around it: play, seek, scenes, holds, loops, cues and recording.
summary.zh: 用關鍵影格回答「時間 t 的時候，每個參數是多少？」，並在外面包一層播放控制：播放、跳轉、場景、hold、循環、cue 和錄製。

description.en: `timeline.state(t)` returns `{ key: value }` for every param at time `t`, interpolated from `automation`. That is the whole job: the timeline owns time, and a world never reads the clock. In a show, [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds the timeline from its `timeline` option, [`Loop`](#Loop) calls `advance(dt)` every frame, and what `state()` returns goes into [`params.resolve()`](#Params), where a hand or a knob that has overridden a param still wins.
description.zh: `timeline.state(t)` 回傳時間 `t` 的時候每個參數的 `{ key: value }`，由 `automation` 內插得來。它的工作就這一件：時間歸時間軸管，世界從來不讀時鐘。在演出裡，[`createShow()`](#createShow) 依 `timeline` 選項建好時間軸，[`Loop`](#Loop) 每個畫面呼叫 `advance(dt)`，`state()` 的結果再交給 [`params.resolve()`](#Params)，被手或旋鈕覆寫的參數仍然以覆寫為準。

description.en: Between two keyframes the value moves in a straight line. The optional third item of a keyframe says how the segment that **ends** at that keyframe gets there: `'linear'`, `'ease'`, `'in'`, `'out'`, `'step'`, or your own function of 0..1 (see [`CURVES`](#CURVES)).
