Before the first keyframe the value is the first one, after the last it is the last one, and a param with no keyframes stays at its `def`. A param declared with `step` holds each keyframe instead of interpolating.
description.zh: 兩個關鍵影格之間，值走直線。關鍵影格選填的第三項，說的是「**抵達**這個影格的那一段」怎麼走：`'linear'`、`'ease'`、`'in'`、`'out'`、`'step'`，或你自己寫的 0..1 函式（見 [`CURVES`](#CURVES)）。第一個影格之前，值就是第一個影格的值。最後一個影格之後，就是最後一個的值。沒有任何關鍵影格的參數維持在 `def`。宣告了 `step` 的參數會停在每個關鍵影格，不做內插。

description.en: Scenes give the show its shape: `{ id: 'storm', t: 90, title: 'Storm', note: 'clusters welcome' }`. `onSceneChange` is the hook to fire sound, lights or prompts, and the console shows the title and note to the performer. A scene with `hold: true` stops playback at its end until someone calls `release()`. Scene `cues` are `{ name, t }` with `t` in show seconds (not seconds into the scene), and they fire only when **playback** passes them: a seek, a jump or a reset never does.
description.zh: 場景給了演出一個結構：`{ id: 'storm', t: 90, title: 'Storm', note: 'clusters welcome' }`。`onSceneChange` 是用來觸發聲音、燈光或提詞的掛鉤，主控台會把標題和備註顯示給表演者。`hold: true` 的場景，播放到它的尾端就停住，直到有人呼叫 `release()`。場景的 `cues` 是 `{ name, t }`，`t` 是演出秒數（不是場景內的第幾秒），而且只有**播放**經過它們的時候才會觸發：seek、跳轉或 reset 都不會。

params.name: params
params.en: The [`Params`](#Params) of the show, or a plain schema array. The timeline reads the schema to know which params to resolve. Required.
params.zh: 演出的 [`Params`](#Params)，或一個單純的 schema 陣列。時間軸讀 schema 來知道要解析哪些參數。必填。

params.name: automation
params.en: The keyframes of each param: `{ hue: [[0, 200], [30, 320, 'ease'], [60, 40]] }`. A keyframe is `[seconds, value, curve?]`, sorted by time.
params.zh: 每個參數的關鍵影格：`{ hue: [[0, 200], [30, 320, 'ease'], [60, 40]] }`。一個關鍵影格是 `[秒數, 值, 曲線?]`，依時間排序。

params.name: scenes
params.en: The scenes: `{ id, t, title?, note?, acts?, hold?, cues? }`, sorted by `t`. A negative `t` is a pre-show standby. Ignored when a `score` is given.
params.zh: 場景：`{ id, t, title?, note?, acts?, hold?, cues? }`，依 `t` 排序。`t` 是負的就是開演前的待機。有給 `score` 的時候會被忽略。

params.name: total
params.en: The length of the show in seconds. Playback stops by itself there. (`createShow()` passes 120 unless you say otherwise.) Ignored when a `score` is given.
params.zh: 演出的長度，單位是秒。播放到這裡會自己停下來。（`createShow()` 沒特別指定的時候傳 120。）有給 `score` 的時候會被忽略。

params.name: score
params.en: A [`Score`](#Score): the scenes, the total and the start then come from it, and automation is read at `score.baseTime(t)`, so a derived cut stretches the curves with it.
params.zh: 一份 [`Score`](#Score)：場景、總長和起點都改從它來，自動化曲線讀的是 `score.baseTime(t)`，所以衍生的 cut 會把曲線一起拉伸。

params.name: start
params.en: Where `reset()` goes and where the playhead starts: a number of seconds, or `'first'` for the start of the first scene (a standby at −30, say). `null` means 0, or the score's start.
params.zh: `reset()` 要回到哪裡，播放頭一開始也在這裡：一個秒數，或 `'first'` 代表第一個場景的起點（例如 −30 的待機）。`null` 表示 0，或總譜的起點。

params.name: loop
params.en: `true` wraps the show at its end and plays on; `'scene'` repeats the scene the playhead is in; a scene id repeats that scene; `{ from, to }` repeats a range (seconds or scene ids). It is a plain property: set `timeline.loop` any time.
params.zh: `true` 是演出到尾端就繞回去繼續播，`'scene'` 是反覆播目前所在的場景，給場景 id 就反覆播那個場景，`{ from, to }` 反覆播一段範圍（秒數或場景 id）。它是個普通屬性，隨時可以設定 `timeline.loop`。

params.name: onCue
params.en: The same as calling `timeline.onCue(cb)` once: `cb(cue, { cause })`.
params.zh: 等於呼叫一次 `timeline.onCue(cb)`：`cb(cue, { cause })`。

needs.en: Time only moves when you call `play()` and then `advance(dt)` every frame (a show does this for you). `state(t)` and `valueAt(key, t)` work at any moment, playing or not. The callbacks do not fire for the starting scene until the first `advance()` or `seek()`.
needs.zh: 時間只在你呼叫 `play()`、並且每個畫面呼叫 `advance(dt)` 的時候才會往前走（演出會替你做）。`state(t)` 和 `valueAt(key, t)` 隨時都能用，不論有沒有在播放。起始場景的回呼，要等到第一次 `advance()` 或 `seek()` 才會觸發。

notes.en: These are plain fields you can read and set: `t`, `playing`, `holding`, `rate` (1 is real time; 4 rehearses at four times the speed), `total`, `start`, `scenes`, `automation`, `score`, `loop`, `loops` (laps since the last reset), and `layer`.
notes.zh: 這些是可以直接讀、也可以直接設定的普通欄位：`t`、`playing`、`holding`、`rate`（1 是真實速度，4 是四倍速排練）、`total`、`start`、`scenes`、`automation`、`score`、`loop`、`loops`（上次 reset 以來繞了幾圈）和 `layer`。

notes.en: `layer` is `(key, value, t) => value`. A [`Director`](#Director) plugs in here so segment modules can bend a param; the performer's override is still applied afterwards and wins.
notes.zh: `layer` 是 `(key, value, t) => value`。[`Director`](#Director) 會接在這裡，讓段落模組可以改動參數，表演者的覆寫之後才套用，所以仍然以覆寫為準。

notes.en: With a `score`, anything you pass as `scenes` or `total` is ignored, and `reset()` goes to the score's start.
notes.zh: 有 `score` 的時候，你傳的 `scenes` 和 `total` 都會被忽略，`reset()` 回到的是總譜的起點。

caption.en: The console prints the hue at four moments: `0 200`, `15 260`, `30 320`, `45 180`. Nothing plays; `state(t)` just looks the answer up.
caption.zh: 主控台印出四個時刻的色相：`0 200`、`15 260`、`30 320`、`45 180`。什麼都沒有在播放，`state(t)` 只是把答案查出來。

caption.en: The console prints `scene standby play`, then `holding: true at 6.000` (the show waits at the end of the standby), then `scene go release`, then `cue flash at 10`.
caption.zh: 主控台依序印出 `scene standby play`、`holding: true at 6.000`（演出停在待機場景的尾端等候），然後是 `scene go release`，最後是 `cue flash at 10`。

caption.en: The knob turns for seven seconds; the console prints `take 6 to 12 release`, then the new keyframes: the take replaced the middle of the curve and the old ends stayed.
caption.zh: 旋鈕轉了七秒，主控台印出 `take 6 to 12 release`，接著是新的關鍵影格：這段錄製取代了曲線的中段，原本的兩端保留下來。

members.name: state
members.doc: Base state for all params at time t (no overrides — Params.resolve applies those).

members.name: onSceneChange
members.doc: cb(index, scene, { cause }) — cause: 'play' | 'release' | 'seek' | 'jump' | 'reset' | 'loop'

members.name: onSeek
members.doc: cb(t, kind) when the playhead is moved by hand — kind: 'seek' | 'jump' | 'reset'.

members.name: play
members.doc: Play.

members.name: seek
members.doc: Move the playhead to t (clamped).

members.name: next
members.doc: → : release a hold (and keep playing), otherwise jump to the next scene.

members.name: prev
members.doc: ← : the previous scene.

members.name: release
members.doc: Let a hold go: the next scene starts now and playback continues.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Back to the start (default 0, or `start`): stopped, not holding.

members.name: advance
members.doc: Call per frame with clamped dt.

members.name: loopRange
members.doc: The range being looped right now, { a, b } in seconds, or null.

members.name: onLoop
members.doc: cb({ t, from, to, count }) each time the playhead wraps round the loop.

members.name: cues
members.doc: Every cue of every scene, in time order: { …cue, scene: sceneId, sceneIndex }.

members.name: onCue
members.doc: cb(cue, { cause }) when PLAYBACK passes a scene cue (cause 'play') or fireCue() sets it off by hand ('manual').

members.name: fireCue
members.doc: Set a cue off by hand (the scrubber's ◆ click).

members.name: record
members.doc: Arm a lane: while the timeline PLAYS, whatever `source()` returns is written into automation[key] as keyframes.

members.name: stopRecording
members.doc: Close every armed recorder (committing what each holds).

members.name: onRecord
members.doc: cb({ key, from, to, count, cause, keyframes }) when a take closes.

members.name: mergeTake
members.doc: Write a take (an array of [t, value], t in automation time) into automation[key]: · thinned: the first and last points stay; a point in between stays when its value moved more than `epsilon` (default 0.6 % of the…

summary.en: Counts how often `on` has turned on, or how many `'kick'` (or any other event) have happened; with a limit it loops 0, 1, … limit − 1.
summary.zh: 數 `on` 打開過幾次，或某個事件（像 `'kick'`）發生過幾次。給了上限就會循環：0、1、…、上限 − 1（TouchDesigner 的 Count CHOP）。

description.en: A counter you do not have to keep yourself: `count(mouseIsPressed)` is the number of clicks so far, `count(beat, 4)` walks 0 1 2 3 0 1 … on the beat, and `count('kick')` counts the kicks of the drum machine. A switch has to go off and on again to be counted twice.
description.zh: 不用自己維護的計數器：`count(mouseIsPressed)` 是到現在的點擊次數，`count(beat, 4)` 跟著拍子數 0 1 2 3 0 1 …，`count('kick')` 數鼓機的大鼓。開關要關掉再打開，才會算第二次。

description.en: Event counts start when `count('kick')` is first called, so earlier kicks are not counted. An event of your own fired with `trigger()` is counted from its first firing, whenever `count()` is first called.
description.zh: 事件的計數從第一次呼叫 `count('kick')` 才開始，之前的大鼓不算。你自己用 `trigger()` 發出的事件，從它第一次發出就開始算，不管 `count()` 什麼時候第一次被呼叫。

params.name: on
params.en: A switch: a boolean, or a number above 0.5, and each time it goes from off to on counts one. Or an event name (`'kick'`, `'beat'`, `'note'`, or one of your own fired with [`trigger()`](#trigger)): how many of those events have happened.
params.zh: 可以是開關：布林值，或大於 0.5 的數字，每次從關變成開就算一次。也可以是事件名字（`'kick'`、`'beat'`、`'note'`，或你自己用 [`trigger()`](#trigger) 發出的）：那種事件到現在發生了幾次。

params.name: limit
params.en: Loop at this number: 4 gives 0 1 2 3 0 1 … Left out, or 0 or less, it keeps counting up.
params.zh: 數到這個數字就繞回去：4 會得到 0 1 2 3 0 1 …。不寫、或是 0 以下，就一直往上數。

params.name: name
params.en: Only for the switch form (`count(beat, 4, 'a')`): a name for its memory, as the last argument. The event-name form needs none.
params.zh: 只用在開關的寫法（`count(beat, 4, 'a')`）：給它的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。事件名字的寫法不需要。

returns.en: The count, a whole number from 0. It is 0 until @openav/chop has loaded (a few frames), and for an unnamed switch outside `draw()`.
returns.zh: 計數，從 0 開始的整數。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 `draw()` 外面沒有名字的開關，都回傳 0。

needs.en: The event names work like [`env()`](#env): `'kick'`, `'snare'`, `'hat'` and `'beat'` come from the microphone, or from the drum machine once [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) has been called, and the first `count('kick')` asks for the microphone if the drum machine is not on. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 事件名字的規則跟 [`env()`](#env) 一樣：`'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'`、`'beat'` 來自麥克風，或是呼叫過 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 之後來自鼓機，而鼓機沒開的時候，第一次 `count('kick')` 會去要麥克風。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: A sketch with its own variable or function called `count` keeps it. `OAVp5.chop.count(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: 草圖如果自己有叫 `count` 的變數或函式，就由草圖保留。`OAVp5.chop.count(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: A counter that goes up by one on every click. Holding the button down counts once.
caption.zh: 每點一下加一的計數器。按住不放只算一次。

caption.en: Four dots light up one after another, one step per kick of the drum machine. Click the canvas once if you hear nothing.
caption.zh: 四個圓點依序亮起，鼓機每一下大鼓前進一格。如果沒聽到聲音，點一下畫布。

caption.en: Each click cycles the background through three colours, and the text counts the clicks without end.
caption.zh: 每點一下，背景就在三種顏色之間輪流換，文字則不停地數點擊次數。

claims.before: trigger('claim-cycle'); trigger('claim-cycle'); trigger('claim-cycle'); trigger('claim-cycle'); trigger('claim-cycle'); count('claim-cycle')

summary.en: Draws a line through `values` on the canvas, so it is in the work and in a recording: the oldest at `x`, `lo` at the bottom of the box, `hi` at the top.
summary.zh: 在畫布上畫一條穿過 `values` 的線，所以它會在作品裡、也會被錄進影片：最舊的在 `x`，`lo` 在方框底，`hi` 在方框頂。

description.en: The picture [`scope()`](#scope) shows in the corner, but drawn on the canvas: `stroke(255); drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 0, height - 100, width, 100)`. The line is one shape in the sketch's own `stroke()` colour and weight (white while `noStroke()` is in effect), with no fill, and the style you had before is put back afterwards.
description.zh: 就是 [`scope()`](#scope) 顯示在角落的那張圖，只是畫在畫布上：`stroke(255); drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 0, height - 100, width, 100)`。這條線是草圖自己的 `stroke()` 顏色和粗細畫出的一個形狀（`noStroke()` 生效時是白色），不填色，畫完之後會把你原本的樣式還原。

description.en: The oldest value is at the left edge `x`, the newest at `x + w`. A number instead of an array is the shortcut: `drawTrail(micLevel, 0, 0, width, 100)` draws the last 2 seconds without a separate [`trail()`](#trail) call.
description.zh: 最舊的值在左邊的 `x`，最新的在 `x + w`。傳數字而不傳陣列是捷徑：`drawTrail(micLevel, 0, 0, width, 100)` 不用另外呼叫 [`trail()`](#trail) 就能畫出最近 2 秒。

params.name: values
params.en: An array such as the one [`trail()`](#trail) returns. Or a single number: then drawTrail keeps its own trail of the last 2 seconds.
params.zh: 像 [`trail()`](#trail) 回傳的那種陣列。或是單一個數字：這時 drawTrail 會自己保留最近 2 秒的軌跡。

params.name: x
params.en: Left edge of the box.
params.zh: 方框左邊的位置。

params.name: y
params.en: Top edge of the box.
params.zh: 方框上緣的位置。

params.name: w
params.en: Width of the box. Left out, it is the canvas width.
params.zh: 方框的寬度。不寫就是畫布的寬度。

params.name: h
params.en: Height of the box. Left out, it is the canvas height.
params.zh: 方框的高度。不寫就是畫布的高度。

params.name: lo
params.en: The value drawn at the bottom of the box.
params.zh: 畫在方框底部的那個值。

params.name: hi
params.en: The value drawn at the top of the box. Values outside `lo`..`hi` sit on the edge of the box. If `hi` equals `lo`, the line runs through the middle.
params.zh: 畫在方框頂部的那個值。超出 `lo` 到 `hi` 的值會貼在方框的邊上。`hi` 等於 `lo` 的話，線會從中間穿過。

params.name: name
params.en: Only when `values` is a single number: a name for its own trail, as the 8th argument (after `hi`).
params.zh: 只有 `values` 是單一個數字的時候才用：給它自己的軌跡取的名字，寫在第 8 個參數（`hi` 後面）。

returns.en: The array that was drawn: the one you passed, or the number's own trail. Nothing is drawn when it has fewer than 2 values.
returns.zh: 畫出來的那個陣列：你傳進來的，或是那個數字自己的軌跡。少於 2 個值的時候不會畫。

needs.en: Call it in `draw()` after `createCanvas()`. With a number, the first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames, and nothing is drawn until then.
needs.zh: 在 `createCanvas()` 之後的 `draw()` 裡呼叫。傳數字的話，第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面，那之前不會畫任何東西。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.drawTrail(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.drawTrail(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: A moving sine line drawn on the canvas itself, so it would appear in a recording.
caption.zh: 一條移動的正弦線，直接畫在畫布上，所以錄影也會錄到。

caption.en: The raw square wave in green and its lagged version in yellow, in the same box so you can see the delay.
caption.zh: 綠色是原始的方波，黃色是加了 lag 的版本，畫在同一個方框裡，看得出延遲。

caption.en: A wave that goes below 0: lo = -1 and hi = 1 put the bottom of the box at -1 and the top at 1, so the whole wave fits.
caption.zh: 一條會掉到 0 以下的波：`lo` = -1、`hi` = 1 讓方框底是 -1、頂是 1，整條波就放得下。

summary.en: A 0..1 pulse that jumps up after each event (a kick, a beat, a key, a press) and then fades out: TouchDesigner's Trigger CHOP.
summary.zh: 一個 0 到 1 的脈衝：每次事件（大鼓、拍子、琴鍵、按下）之後就跳起來，然後慢慢退下去（TouchDesigner 的 Trigger CHOP）。

description.en: Call it every frame and use the number like a size or a brightness: `circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + env('kick', 0.01, 0.3) * 200)` swells on every kick. The number rises to 1 in `attack` seconds after an event and falls back to 0 in `decay` seconds, quick at first and landing softly, the way a bass drum's swell looks right.
description.zh: 每個畫面都呼叫它，把這個數字當成大小或亮度來用：`circle(width / 2, height / 2, 60 + env('kick', 0.01, 0.3) * 200)` 讓圓在每一下大鼓都脹大。事件之後，數字在 `attack` 秒內升到 1，再用 `decay` 秒落回 0，一開始退得快，最後輕輕落地，就像大鼓的那一下看起來該有的樣子。

description.en: An event that arrives while the last pulse is still sounding restarts from where the pulse is, never from zero, so fast hits pile up into a plateau instead of flickering. The attack is measured from 0: a retrigger from halfway up takes half the attack.
description.zh: 上一個脈衝還沒退完時又來一個事件，會從脈衝現在的位置重新開始，不會回到 0，所以很快的連打會堆成一個平台，不會閃爍。attack 是從 0 算起的：從一半的地方再觸發，只花一半的 attack。

description.en: The events: `'kick'`, `'snare'` and `'hat'` are the hits [`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected) hears (from the microphone, or from the drum machine when it plays), `'beat'` is [`beat`](#beat), `'note'` is any key going down, `'bar'` and `'step'` come from the drum machine, a cue's name fires when [`cue()`](#cue) does, and any other name is yours to fire with [`trigger()`](#trigger). The switch form, `env(mouseIsPressed, 0.02, 0.5)`, fires on every press.
description.zh: 事件有這些：`'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'` 就是 [`kickDetected()`](#kickDetected) 聽到的那些打擊（來自麥克風，或鼓機在播的時候來自鼓機），`'beat'` 是 [`beat`](#beat)，`'note'` 是任何一個琴鍵按下，`'bar'` 和 `'step'` 來自鼓機，cue 的名字在 [`cue()`](#cue) 觸發時發出，其他的名字由你用 [`trigger()`](#trigger) 發出。開關的寫法 `env(mouseIsPressed, 0.02, 0.5)` 在每次按下時發出事件。

params.name: event
params.en: What to react to. A name: `'kick'`, `'snare'`, `'hat'`, `'beat'` (from the microphone or the drum machine), `'note'` (any key), `'bar'`, `'step'` (the drum machine), a cue's name, or an event of your own fired with [`trigger()`](#trigger). Or a switch: a boolean, or a number above 0.5, and each time it turns on counts as an event. Left out: `'beat'`.
params.zh: 要對什麼起反應。可以是名字：`'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'`、`'beat'`（來自麥克風或鼓機）、`'note'`（任何琴鍵）、`'bar'`、`'step'`（鼓機）、某個 cue 的名字，或你自己用 [`trigger()`](#trigger) 發出的事件。也可以是開關：布林值，或大於 0.5 的數字，每次從關變成開就算一次事件。不寫就是 `'beat'`。

params.name: attack
params.en: Seconds the rise from 0 to 1 takes.
params.zh: 從 0 升到 1 要花的秒數。

params.name: decay
params.en: Seconds the fall from 1 back to 0 takes.
params.zh: 從 1 落回 0 要花的秒數。

params.name: name
params.en: Only for the switch form (`env(mouseIsPressed, …, 'a')`): a name for its memory, as the last argument. A named event such as `'kick'` needs none.
params.zh: 只用在開關的寫法（`env(mouseIsPressed, …, 'a')`）：給它的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。像 `'kick'` 這種有名字的事件不需要。

returns.en: 0..1: 0 when nothing has happened, 1 at the top of the pulse. Until @openav/chop has loaded (a few frames) it returns 0.
returns.zh: 0 到 1：什麼都沒發生是 0，脈衝的頂點是 1。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面）回傳 0。

needs.en: `'kick'`, `'snare'`, `'hat'` and `'beat'` need something that makes them. If the sketch has not started the drum machine ([`startDrums()`](#startDrums)), the first `env('kick')` asks for the microphone, like reading [`micLevel`](#micLevel), and `?oav_mic=off` means nothing ever fires. Once the drum machine is started, the microphone is not opened for it. `'note'` needs a key: play one, press 🎹, or call [`OAVp5.play()`](#OAVp5.play). A name of your own needs [`trigger()`](#trigger): if nothing fires it within 4 seconds, a card says so.
needs.zh: `'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'`、`'beat'` 要有東西去產生它們。草圖還沒啟動鼓機（[`startDrums()`](#startDrums)）的話，第一次 `env('kick')` 就會像讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣去要麥克風，而 `?oav_mic=off` 表示永遠不會有事件。鼓機一啟動，就不會為它去開麥克風。`'note'` 要有琴鍵：彈一個、按 🎹，或呼叫 [`OAVp5.play()`](#OAVp5.play)。你自己取的名字要靠 [`trigger()`](#trigger)：4 秒內沒有任何東西觸發它，會跳出一張卡片告訴你。

notes.en: A named event needs no place in `draw()`: `env('kick')` works in `setup()` or `mousePressed()` too. Only the switch form remembers anything between frames, and an unnamed switch outside `draw()` returns 0. Calls in `draw()` are matched by order, like [`lag()`](#lag).
notes.zh: 有名字的事件不需要待在 `draw()` 裡：`env('kick')` 在 `setup()` 或 `mousePressed()` 裡也能用。只有開關的寫法會在畫面之間記東西，沒有名字的開關在 `draw()` 外面回傳 0。在 `draw()` 裡的呼叫跟 [`lag()`](#lag) 一樣，靠順序來對應。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.env(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.env(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: Click the canvas: the circle jumps open and fades back each time.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布：圓每次都彈開，再慢慢退回去。

caption.en: Two circles swell on the drum machine's kick and snare. Click the canvas once if you hear nothing: browsers wait for a click before they play sound.
caption.zh: 兩個圓分別在鼓機的大鼓和小鼓時脹大。如果沒聽到聲音，點一下畫布：瀏覽器要先有一次點擊才會播聲音。

caption.en: Click the canvas, or play a key on a controller or the 🎹: every key pulses the circle.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布，或在控制器或 🎹 上彈一個鍵：每個鍵都讓圓跳一下。

summary.en: Follows `value` smoothly instead of jumping: up in `up` seconds, down in `down` seconds (TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP).
summary.zh: 讓數值平順地跟上 `value`，不要跳：上升花 `up` 秒，下降花 `down` 秒（TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP）。

description.en: Wrap any number that jumps: `circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) * 300)` is a VU meter. It opens within 0.03 seconds when someone speaks and takes 0.4 seconds to close. `up` is the time to follow a rise, `down` the time to follow a fall. Leave `down` out and both are `up`. Leave both out and they are 0.1.
description.zh: 包住任何會跳的數字：`circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4) * 300)` 就是一個音量表。有人說話時 0.03 秒內張開，要 0.4 秒才收回去。`up` 是跟上升的時間，`down` 是跟下降的時間。不寫 `down`，兩個都是 `up`。兩個都不寫，就都是 0.1。

description.en: The seconds are TouchDesigner's: `lag(x, 0.1)` moves like a Lag CHOP set to 0.1, so the numbers you learn here carry over. That is about the time the output takes to cover 90% of a jump (underneath, a one-pole lag whose time constant is the seconds divided by 2.3). The curve is the same at 30 and at 144 frames per second.
description.zh: 這裡的秒數跟 TouchDesigner 一樣：`lag(x, 0.1)` 的動法就像把 Lag CHOP 設成 0.1，所以在這裡學的數字可以直接帶到 TouchDesigner。意思大約是輸出走完一次跳動的 90% 所花的時間（底層是一階的 lag，時間常數是秒數除以 2.3）。每秒 30 格和每秒 144 格畫出來的曲線一樣。

description.en: The first value it sees is taken as it is, so nothing glides in from 0. A boolean counts as 0 or 1: `lag(mouseIsPressed, 0.2)` is a soft switch.
description.zh: 它看到的第一個值照單全收，所以不會從 0 慢慢滑進來。布林值算成 0 或 1：`lag(mouseIsPressed, 0.2)` 就是一個柔軟的開關。

params.name: value
params.en: The number to follow. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number (a string, `NaN`) goes straight through and the lag keeps what it had.
params.zh: 要跟隨的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西（字串、`NaN`）會直接穿過去，lag 保留原來的狀態。

params.name: up
params.en: Seconds to follow a rise: about how long the output takes to cover 90% of a jump upward. Negative numbers count as 0.
params.zh: 跟上升的秒數：輸出大約花這麼久走完往上跳的 90%。負數算 0。

params.name: down
params.en: Seconds to follow a fall. Left out, it is the same as `up`.
params.zh: 跟下降的秒數。不寫的話跟 `up` 一樣。

params.name: name
params.en: A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in `draw()`; with one, the call is the same wherever it is made.
params.zh: 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 `draw()` 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。

returns.en: The smoothed value. It returns `value` as it is until @openav/chop has loaded (a few frames), and for an unnamed call outside `draw()`.
returns.zh: 平順過的數值。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 `draw()` 外面沒有名字的呼叫，原樣回傳 `value`。

needs.en: Nothing to call or declare: write it in `draw()`. The first call loads @openav/chop from next to oav-p5.js, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 `draw()` 裡。第一次呼叫時會從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: A sketch with its own variable or function called `lag` keeps it. `OAVp5.chop.lag(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: 草圖如果自己有叫 `lag` 的變數或函式，就由草圖保留。`OAVp5.chop.lag(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: A circle that chases the mouse: it never jumps, it glides, and takes about half a second to catch up.
caption.zh: 一個追著滑鼠跑的圓：它不會跳，而是滑過去，大約半秒追上。

caption.en: Hold the mouse down: the circle swells quickly and, when you let go, shrinks back slowly.
caption.zh: 按住滑鼠：圓很快脹大，放開之後慢慢縮回去。

caption.en: Six dots follow the mouse, each a little slower than the one above. The names keep each dot's memory its own even if you later add or remove dots.
caption.zh: 六個圓點跟著滑鼠，每一個都比上面那個慢一點。有了名字，之後就算增減圓點，每一個記得的還是自己的位置。

summary.en: Shows `value` in a small oscilloscope in the corner of the page and gives it back, so you can wrap any expression to watch it.
summary.zh: 把 `value` 顯示在網頁角落的小示波器上，並原樣還給你，所以可以包住任何運算式來觀察它。

description.en: It is a CHOP's viewer: each label is one line in a small plot across the page from the 🎹, with the last 4 seconds of the value and its number now. Call it twice in a frame with two labels and you get two lines to compare, raw against smoothed. The scale is at least 0 to 1 and grows to hold whatever the values reach.
description.zh: 它就是 CHOP 的檢視器：每個標籤是一條線，畫在跟 🎹 對角的網頁角落一個小圖上，顯示這個值最近 4 秒的樣子和現在的數字。在一個畫面裡用兩個標籤呼叫兩次，就有兩條線可以比較，例如原始的和平滑過的。刻度至少是 0 到 1，值跑出去就跟著放大。

description.en: It lives on the page, not on the canvas: never in a recording or in 📷, and it never takes a click from the sketch. To draw the same line inside the work, use [`drawTrail()`](#drawTrail).
description.zh: 它在網頁上，不在畫布上：不會錄進影片，也不會進 📷，而且不會搶走草圖的點擊。要把同樣的線畫進作品裡，用 [`drawTrail()`](#drawTrail)。

params.name: value
params.en: The number to watch. A boolean is drawn as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number is returned as it is and not drawn.
params.zh: 要觀察的數字。布林值畫成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西原樣回傳，也不會畫。

params.name: label
params.en: The name of this line in the legend. Each label is one line, and a label longer than 9 characters is cut short there. Without one the line is numbered.
params.zh: 這條線在圖例上的名字。每個標籤是一條線，超過 9 個字元的標籤在圖例上會被截短。不寫的話，這條線用編號。

returns.en: Exactly `value`, so `circle(x, y, scope(lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4), 'lag') * 300)` works.
returns.zh: 原封不動的 `value`，所以 `circle(x, y, scope(lag(micLevel, 0.03, 0.4), 'lag') * 300)` 這樣寫就行。

needs.en: Only inside `draw()`: anywhere else it just returns `value`. `?oav_scope=off` hides it, and so does `?oav_hints=off`, which is the one thing to know if it does not appear. See [`scope`](#option-scope). The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 只在 `draw()` 裡有作用：其他地方它只會原樣回傳 `value`。`?oav_scope=off` 會把它藏起來，`?oav_hints=off` 也會，這是它沒出現時唯一要知道的事。見 [`scope`](#option-scope)。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.scope(…)` is this function under another name. The lines keep coming from the last second: stop calling it for a second and its line leaves the plot.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.scope(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。線條只保留最近一秒內還有呼叫的：停止呼叫一秒之後，那條線就會從圖上消失。

caption.en: The circle breathes, and a small plot in the corner of the page draws the same number as a moving line.
caption.zh: 圓一漲一縮，網頁角落的小圖把同一個數字畫成一條移動的線。

caption.en: The corner plot shows two lines: the square wave and what lag() makes of it, rising in 0.3 seconds and falling in 0.6.
caption.zh: 角落的圖有兩條線：方波，以及 lag() 把它變成的樣子，上升 0.3 秒、下降 0.6 秒。

summary.en: How fast `value` is changing, per second: positive while it rises, negative while it falls, 0 while it holds still (TouchDesigner's Slope CHOP).
summary.zh: `value` 每秒變化多快：上升時是正的，下降時是負的，靜止時是 0（TouchDesigner 的 Slope CHOP）。

description.en: Ask how hard something is moving rather than where it is: `abs(slope(mouseX))` is the mouse speed in pixels per second, and `slope(micLevel)` jumps up at the start of a word. It is as noisy as its input, so smooth it when it flickers: `lag(abs(slope(x)), 0.05, 0.3)`.
description.zh: 問的是東西動得多用力，而不是在哪裡：`abs(slope(mouseX))` 是滑鼠每秒移動幾像素，`slope(micLevel)` 在一個字開頭的時候會往上衝。它的雜訊跟輸入一樣多，閃爍的時候先平滑一下：`lag(abs(slope(x)), 0.05, 0.3)`。

params.name: value
params.en: The number to watch. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number keeps the last slope.
params.zh: 要觀察的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西，就保留上一個斜率。

params.name: name
params.en: A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in `draw()`; with one, the call is the same wherever it is made.
params.zh: 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 `draw()` 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。

returns.en: The change per second, in the units of `value` (pixels per second for a pixel position). 0 on the first call, and 0 until @openav/chop has loaded or for an unnamed call outside `draw()`.
returns.zh: 每秒的變化量，單位跟 `value` 一樣（像素位置就是每秒幾像素）。第一次呼叫是 0。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前，以及在 `draw()` 外面沒有名字的呼叫，也是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call or declare: write it in `draw()`. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 `draw()` 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.slope(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.slope(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: Move the mouse sideways: the bar and the number show how fast you are going, and drop to 0 when you stop.
caption.zh: 左右移動滑鼠：長條和數字顯示你動得多快，停下來就回到 0。

caption.en: Hold the mouse: the ring grows and bounces, and its outline is thickest while it is changing fastest.
caption.zh: 按住滑鼠：圓環長大、彈跳，變化最快的時候外框最粗。

summary.en: Adds `rate` to a running total every second, so `rotate(speed(TWO_PI))` turns once a second and the rate can change without the total ever jumping.
summary.zh: 每秒把 `rate` 加進一個累計值，所以 `rotate(speed(TWO_PI))` 每秒轉一圈，而且速率隨時可以變，累計值不會跳（TouchDesigner 的 Speed CHOP）。

description.en: Use the total to turn or move something: `rotate(speed(TWO_PI))` is one turn a second, `x = speed(60) % width` slides 60 pixels a second and wraps around. You pass the rate, not the position, so the rate can follow a knob or the microphone (`speed(micLevel * TWO_PI)` spins faster the louder it gets) and the angle never jumps, which `frameCount * rate` would do.
description.zh: 用累計值來轉或移動東西：`rotate(speed(TWO_PI))` 是每秒轉一圈，`x = speed(60) % width` 是每秒滑 60 像素，到邊界再繞回來。你傳的是速率，不是位置，所以速率可以跟著旋鈕或麥克風走（`speed(micLevel * TWO_PI)` 越大聲轉越快），角度也不會跳，換成 `frameCount * rate` 就會跳。

description.en: Time is in seconds, the same at any frame rate. One frame counts for at most a quarter of a second, so coming back to a hidden tab does not make the shape leap.
description.zh: 時間是以秒計，任何畫面更新率都一樣。一個畫面最多只算四分之一秒，所以從被藏起來的分頁回來時，圖形不會一下子衝出去。

params.name: rate
params.en: How much to add per second, in the unit you use the result in (radians for `rotate()`, pixels for a position). It may change every frame. A boolean counts as 0 or 1.
params.zh: 每秒要加多少，單位看你怎麼用結果（給 `rotate()` 就是弧度，給位置就是像素）。每個畫面都可以不一樣。布林值算成 0 或 1。

params.name: name
params.en: A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in `draw()`; with one, the call is the same wherever it is made.
params.zh: 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 `draw()` 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。

returns.en: The running total, 0 at the start. It is 0 until @openav/chop has loaded (a few frames), and for an unnamed call outside `draw()`.
returns.zh: 累計值，一開始是 0。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 `draw()` 外面沒有名字的呼叫，都回傳 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call or declare: write it in `draw()`. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 `draw()` 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: Plenty of sketches have a variable called `speed`. If yours does, it keeps the name, and `OAVp5.chop.speed(…)` is this function under another name (third example).
notes.zh: 很多草圖都有一個叫 `speed` 的變數。你的草圖有的話，名稱就歸你的草圖，而 `OAVp5.chop.speed(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字（第三個範例）。

caption.en: A square that turns once a second, steadily.
caption.zh: 一個方塊，每秒平穩地轉一圈。

caption.en: Move the mouse: the left side spins the square one way, the middle stops it, the right side spins it the other way, and it never jumps.
caption.zh: 移動滑鼠：左邊讓方塊往一個方向轉，中間讓它停下，右邊往另一個方向轉，而且不會跳。

caption.en: The sketch keeps its own `speed` (2 radians a second) and reaches the function as OAVp5.chop.speed.
caption.zh: 草圖保留自己的 `speed`（每秒 2 弧度），並用 OAVp5.chop.speed 呼叫這個函式。

summary.en: Follows `value` like a mass on a spring: it overshoots, bounces and settles (TouchDesigner's Spring CHOP).
summary.zh: 像彈簧上的重物那樣跟上 `value`：會衝過頭、彈幾下、然後穩住（TouchDesigner 的 Spring CHOP）。

description.en: Wrap a target that jumps: `circle(width / 2, height / 2, spring(mouseIsPressed ? 300 : 100, 100, 6))`. The size does not just glide to the new target (that is [`lag()`](#lag)): it swings past it, comes back and settles.
description.zh: 包住一個會跳的目標：`circle(width / 2, height / 2, spring(mouseIsPressed ? 300 : 100, 100, 6))`。大小會衝過頭、回來、再穩住，跟單純滑向新目標的 [`lag()`](#lag) 不一樣。

description.en: Stiffness and damping are the two knobs. A stiff, lightly damped spring rings like a ruler on a table. A soft, heavily damped one just eases. A big jump or a low frame rate does not break it: the motion is the same at any frame rate.
description.zh: 剛性（stiffness）和阻尼（damping）是兩個旋鈕。很硬、阻尼很小的彈簧像桌邊的尺一樣一直顫。很軟、阻尼很大的就只是緩緩靠近。目標跳很大，或畫面更新率很低，都不會弄壞它：任何更新率的動作都一樣。

params.name: value
params.en: The target the spring is pulled toward. A boolean counts as 0 or 1.
params.zh: 彈簧被拉向的目標。布林值算成 0 或 1。

params.name: stiffness
params.en: How fast it swings: 100 swings about 1.6 times a second. Higher is snappier. Negative numbers count as 0.
params.zh: 擺動得多快：100 大約每秒擺 1.6 次。越大越俐落。負數算 0。

params.name: damping
params.en: How soon it settles: 6 gives two or three bounces, 20 and up none. The edge where it stops bouncing is `2 * sqrt(stiffness)`.
params.zh: 多快穩下來：6 會彈兩三下，20 以上就不彈了。剛好不再彈的界線是 `2 * sqrt(stiffness)`。

params.name: name
params.en: A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in `draw()`; with one, the call is the same wherever it is made.
params.zh: 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 `draw()` 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。

returns.en: The spring's position now. The first value it sees is taken as it is. It returns `value` as it is until @openav/chop has loaded (a few frames), and for an unnamed call outside `draw()`.
returns.zh: 彈簧現在的位置。看到的第一個值照單全收。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前（幾個畫面），以及在 `draw()` 外面沒有名字的呼叫，原樣回傳 `value`。

needs.en: Nothing to call or declare: write it in `draw()`. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 `draw()` 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.spring(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.spring(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: Hold the mouse: the circle springs open, overshoots and settles. Let go and it bounces back down.
caption.zh: 按住滑鼠：圓彈開、衝過頭、再穩住。放開就彈回去。

caption.en: A circle hung on the mouse by a soft spring: it swings around the pointer instead of sticking to it.
caption.zh: 一個用軟彈簧掛在滑鼠上的圓：它繞著滑鼠擺動，不會黏在上面。

caption.en: Hold the mouse: three circles are pulled right by the same spring with different damping. The top one bounces many times, the middle one a few, the bottom one not at all.
caption.zh: 按住滑鼠：三個圓被同一個彈簧、不同的阻尼往右拉。最上面的彈很多下，中間的彈幾下，最下面的完全不彈。

summary.en: The last few seconds of `value` as an array, 60 values a second, oldest first and newest last (TouchDesigner's Trail CHOP).
summary.zh: `value` 最近幾秒的歷史，做成一個陣列，每秒 60 個值，最舊的在前、最新的在最後（TouchDesigner 的 Trail CHOP）。

description.en: A history to draw or measure: `drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 20, 20, width - 40, 100)` plots the last three seconds of the microphone level, and `Math.max(...trail(x, 2))` is a two-second peak. The values are sampled 60 times a second whatever the frame rate, and the gaps between two frames are interpolated, so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same shape.
description.zh: 要畫出來或量一量的歷史：`drawTrail(trail(micLevel, 3), 20, 20, width - 40, 100)` 畫出麥克風音量最近三秒的樣子，`Math.max(...trail(x, 2))` 是兩秒內的最高值。不管畫面更新率是多少，都是每秒取 60 個值，兩個畫面之間的空隙用內插補起來，所以每秒 30 格和 144 格得到同樣的形狀。

description.en: Change `seconds` between frames and the history is resized, keeping the newest values. The array you got last frame is never changed afterwards.
description.zh: 在畫面之間改 `seconds`，歷史會跟著調整大小，保留最新的值。上一個畫面拿到的陣列之後不會再被改動。

params.name: value
params.en: The number to record. A boolean counts as 0 or 1. Anything that is not a finite number is skipped.
params.zh: 要記錄的數字。布林值算成 0 或 1。不是有限數字的東西會被略過。

params.name: seconds
params.en: How many seconds of history to keep, from 0.05 to 600.
params.zh: 要保留幾秒的歷史，範圍是 0.05 到 600。

params.name: name
params.en: A name for this call's memory, written as the last argument. Optional. Without one, oav-p5 tells calls apart by their order in `draw()`; with one, the call is the same wherever it is made.
params.zh: 給這次呼叫的記憶取的名字，寫在最後一個參數。可以不寫。不寫的話，oav-p5 用 `draw()` 裡呼叫的先後順序來區分。有名字的呼叫，在哪裡呼叫都是同一個。

returns.en: About `seconds * 60 + 1` numbers (121 for 2 seconds), a new array every call. The length is fixed from the first call and filled with the first value, so you can draw it from frame one. It is an empty array until @openav/chop has loaded, and for an unnamed call outside `draw()`.
returns.zh: 大約 `seconds * 60 + 1` 個數字（2 秒是 121 個），每次呼叫都是一個新的陣列。長度從第一次呼叫就固定，並且用第一個值填滿，所以從第一個畫面就能畫。@openav/chop 還沒載好之前，以及在 `draw()` 外面沒有名字的呼叫，是空陣列。

needs.en: Nothing to call or declare: write it in `draw()`. The first call loads @openav/chop, which takes a few frames.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫別的東西，也不用宣告：直接寫在 `draw()` 裡。第一次呼叫會載入 @openav/chop，要幾個畫面。

notes.en: Unnamed calls find their memory by their order in `draw()`: the first `lag()` is the first lag, the second is the second. Put one inside an `if`, or in a loop whose length changes, and the order slips: a card says so, and from then on oav-p5 matches each call by the line it is written on. A name at the end is the sure way. Outside `draw()` an unnamed call has nothing to remember by: it returns what Returns says and a card says so.
notes.zh: 沒有名字的呼叫靠它在 `draw()` 裡的順序找回自己的記憶：第一個 `lag()` 是第一個 lag，第二個是第二個。放進 `if`，或放進長度會變的迴圈，順序就會對不上。這時會跳出一張卡片，從那之後 oav-p5 改成照「寫在哪一行」來對應。最穩的做法是在最後加一個名字。在 `draw()` 外面，沒有名字的呼叫沒有東西可以記，會回傳「回傳」欄寫的值，也會跳出卡片。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.trail(…)` is this function under another name. To see the line on the canvas use [`drawTrail()`](#drawTrail), to see it in the corner of the page use [`scope()`](#scope).
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.trail(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。要在畫布上看這條線用 [`drawTrail()`](#drawTrail)，要在網頁角落看就用 [`scope()`](#scope)。

caption.en: A sine wave drawn from its own history: it scrolls to the left as new values arrive at the right.
caption.zh: 用自己的歷史畫出一條正弦波：新的值從右邊進來，波形往左捲動。

caption.en: A ghost trail behind the pointer: the older the copy, the fainter it is.
caption.zh: 滑鼠後面拖著一串殘影：越舊的越淡。

caption.en: A band shows how far left and right the mouse went in the last three seconds, with the trail itself drawn across the top.
caption.zh: 一條色帶顯示滑鼠最近三秒往左往右走了多遠，上方畫出軌跡本身。

summary.en: Fires an event of your own, by name, for [`env()`](#env) and [`count()`](#count) to react to.
summary.zh: 用名字發出一個你自己的事件，讓 [`env()`](#env) 和 [`count()`](#count) 去對它起反應。

description.en: Call it where the thing happens: `function mousePressed() { trigger('boom'); }`. Then read it anywhere in `draw()` with `env('boom', 0.01, 0.6)` (a pulse that fades) or `count('boom')` (how many times so far). It returns nothing.
description.zh: 在事情發生的地方呼叫它：`function mousePressed() { trigger('boom'); }`。然後在 `draw()` 的任何地方，用 `env('boom', 0.01, 0.6)`（會退下去的脈衝）或 `count('boom')`（到現在發生幾次）去讀它。它沒有回傳值。

description.en: It works anywhere, not only in `draw()`, and each call is one event, remembered with the time it happened. You can fire the built-in names by hand as well: `trigger('kick')` pulses `env('kick')` as a real kick would.
description.zh: 它在哪裡都能用，不只是 `draw()`，每呼叫一次就是一個事件，連同發生的時間一起被記下來。內建的名字也可以用手發出：`trigger('kick')` 會讓 `env('kick')` 跳一下，就像真的大鼓一樣。

params.name: name
params.en: The name of the event. Anything is fine except the built-in meanings: `'kick'`, `'snare'`, `'hat'`, `'beat'`, `'note'`, `'bar'` and `'step'` are also fired by the microphone, the keys and the drum machine. Left out: `'trigger'`.
params.zh: 事件的名字。隨便取，只是要留意內建的意思：`'kick'`、`'snare'`、`'hat'`、`'beat'`、`'note'`、`'bar'`、`'step'` 也會被麥克風、琴鍵和鼓機發出。不寫就是 `'trigger'`。

notes.en: `OAVp5.chop.trigger(…)` is this function under another name.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.chop.trigger(…)` 是同一個函式的另一個名字。

caption.en: Click the canvas: each click fires "boom" and the circle pulses once.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布：每點一下就發出一次 "boom"，圓跳一下。

caption.en: Click for the orange circle, press any key for the blue one: each reacts only to its own event.
caption.zh: 點一下讓橘色的圓跳，按任何一個鍵讓藍色的圓跳：各自只對自己的事件起反應。

summary.en: The CHOP functions under one roof, plus the state of the module behind them: `OAVp5.chop.lag(…)`, `.state`, `.slots()`, `.reset()`.
summary.zh: CHOP 函式放在同一個地方，加上它們背後模組的狀態：`OAVp5.chop.lag(…)`、`.state`、`.slots()`、`.reset()`。

description.en: Every function of this group is also here: `OAVp5.chop.lag`, `.env`, `.trigger`, `.speed`, `.spring`, `.trail`, `.slope`, `.count`, `.scope` and `.drawTrail` are the same functions as the plain names, for a sketch whose own `speed` or `count` keeps the plain name.
description.zh: 這一組的每個函式這裡都有：`OAVp5.chop.lag`、`.env`、`.trigger`、`.speed`、`.spring`、`.trail`、`.slope`、`.count`、`.scope`、`.drawTrail` 跟一般的名稱是同一批函式，給那些自己的 `speed` 或 `count` 保留了一般名稱的草圖用。

description.en: The rest is for looking inside: [`state`](#OAVp5.chop.state) says whether the module is loaded, [`module`](#OAVp5.chop.module) is the module itself, [`slots()`](#OAVp5.chop.slots) lists every memory in use and [`reset()`](#OAVp5.chop.reset) forgets them.
description.zh: 其餘的是用來看裡面的：[`state`](#OAVp5.chop.state) 說模組載好了沒，[`module`](#OAVp5.chop.module) 就是模組本身，[`slots()`](#OAVp5.chop.slots) 列出正在用的每一個記憶，[`reset()`](#OAVp5.chop.reset) 把它們忘掉。

notes.en: This is advanced: a sketch that only calls `lag()` and friends never needs it.
notes.zh: 這是進階用法：只呼叫 `lag()` 這些函式的草圖用不到它。

caption.en: A circle chasing the mouse through OAVp5.chop.lag, with the module's state and the number of memories in use printed above it.
caption.zh: 一個透過 OAVp5.chop.lag 追著滑鼠的圓，上方印出模組的狀態和正在用的記憶數量。

summary.en: The @openav/chop module itself once it has loaded, otherwise `null`: the classes and functions the CHOP functions are built on.
summary.zh: @openav/chop 模組本身，載好之後才有，之前是 `null`：CHOP 函式底下用的那些類別和函式。

description.en: For reaching below the p5-style calls: `OAVp5.chop.module.DEFAULTS` lists the defaults the functions use, and `new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 0.1 })` makes a lag you keep yourself. Check it is not `null` first.
description.zh: 要用到比 p5 風格呼叫更底層的東西時才需要：`OAVp5.chop.module.DEFAULTS` 列出這些函式用的預設值，`new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 0.1 })` 做出一個你自己保管的 lag。先確認它不是 `null`。

value.en: `null` until the first CHOP function has been called and the module has arrived, then the module (`Lag`, `Spring`, `Trail`, `envelope()`, `DEFAULTS` and the rest).
value.zh: 第一次呼叫 CHOP 函式、而且模組載好之前是 `null`，之後就是那個模組（`Lag`、`Spring`、`Trail`、`envelope()`、`DEFAULTS` 等等）。

notes.en: This is advanced. The module is also published as `@openav/chop` for sketches and shows that do not go through oav-p5.
notes.zh: 這是進階用法。這個模組也以 `@openav/chop` 發布，給不經過 oav-p5 的草圖和演出使用。

caption.en: Prints the spring defaults from the module as soon as it has loaded.
caption.zh: 模組一載好，就印出它裡面 spring 的預設值。

summary.en: Forgets the memory named `name` (a lag, a speed total, a count …), or every memory when you give no name: the next call starts fresh.
summary.zh: 忘掉叫 `name` 的那個記憶（lag、speed 的累計、計數…），不給名字就全部忘掉：下一次呼叫會重新開始。

description.en: The call that follows starts from nothing, as if it were the first one: a `speed()` total is 0 again, a `lag()` takes its input as it is, a `count()` is back at 0. Use it to restart a named effect, for example on a key press.
description.zh: 接下來的那次呼叫會從零開始，就像是第一次：`speed()` 的累計值回到 0，`lag()` 照單全收輸入，`count()` 回到 0。想讓某個有名字的效果重新開始時用，例如按一個鍵的時候。

description.en: Calling it with no name also drops the unnamed memories. They are made again by order on the next frame, so nothing breaks, but every unnamed value starts over too. Event counts from `trigger()` are not memories of a call and are not touched.
description.zh: 不給名字的時候，沒有名字的記憶也一起丟掉。下一個畫面會重新照順序建立，所以不會壞掉，但每一個沒有名字的值也都重新開始。`trigger()` 的事件次數不是某個呼叫的記憶，不受影響。

params.name: name
params.en: The name you gave a call as its last argument (`'spin'` in `speed(1, 'spin')`). The memory of that name is forgotten in every function that has one. Left out, every memory is forgotten, named or not.
params.zh: 你在呼叫的最後一個參數給的名字（`speed(1, 'spin')` 裡的 `'spin'`）。每個函式裡那個名字的記憶都會被忘掉。不寫的話，不管有沒有名字，全部忘掉。

caption.en: The square turns steadily. Click: it jumps back to its starting angle and carries on from there.
caption.zh: 方塊平穩地轉。點一下：它跳回起始的角度，再從那裡繼續轉。

summary.en: Lists every memory the CHOP functions are using right now: its kind, how it is found, and its latest value.
summary.zh: 列出 CHOP 函式現在用的每一個記憶：是哪一種、怎麼找到它、最新的值是多少。

description.en: For finding out why two calls seem to share a memory, or whether a loop made hundreds: `OAVp5.chop.slots().length` is how many there are. It reads the state and changes nothing.
description.zh: 用來查為什麼兩個呼叫好像共用同一個記憶，或迴圈是不是做出了好幾百個：`OAVp5.chop.slots().length` 就是現在有幾個。它只讀取狀態，不會改任何東西。

returns.en: One `{ kind, key, mode, value }` per memory. `kind` is the function (`'lag'`, `'spring'`, …). `key` is `'#1'`, `'#2'` for calls found by order, a name for named ones, or the line of code for calls matched by line. `mode` says which: `'order'`, `'name'` or `'site'`. `value` is its latest output (missing for a trail).
returns.zh: 每一個記憶一筆 `{ kind, key, mode, value }`。`kind` 是哪個函式（`'lag'`、`'spring'` …）。`key` 是靠順序找到的呼叫的 `'#1'`、`'#2'`，有名字的就是名字，靠行號對應的就是那一行程式。`mode` 說明是哪一種：`'order'`、`'name'` 或 `'site'`。`value` 是它最近一次的輸出（trail 沒有）。

notes.en: This is advanced. 🩺 and tests use it; a sketch rarely needs to.
notes.zh: 這是進階用法。🩺 和測試會用到，草圖很少需要。

caption.en: Lists the memories the three calls are using: two lags found by order and one spring found by its name.
caption.zh: 列出這三個呼叫在用的記憶：兩個靠順序找到的 lag，和一個靠名字找到的 spring。

summary.en: Where the @openav/chop module is: `'off'`, `'loading'`, `'on'` or `'error'`.
summary.zh: @openav/chop 模組目前的狀態：`'off'`、`'loading'`、`'on'` 或 `'error'`。

description.en: `off` until one of these functions is first called, `loading` while @openav/chop arrives (a few frames), `on` once it is in, `error` if it could not be loaded: a card says so and every function then passes its input through. [`trigger()`](#trigger) on its own never loads it, because it only records that something happened.
description.zh: 在任何一個函式第一次被呼叫之前是 `off`，@openav/chop 在載入的時候（幾個畫面）是 `loading`，載好之後是 `on`，載不到是 `error`：這時會跳出卡片，所有函式也都改成把輸入直接穿過去。單獨呼叫 [`trigger()`](#trigger) 不會載入它，因為它只記錄「發生了一件事」。

value.en: Changes the first time a CHOP function is called and once more when the module has arrived. `off` before any call.
value.zh: 第一次呼叫 CHOP 函式的時候會變，模組載好時再變一次。在任何呼叫之前是 `off`。

caption.en: For half a second it says off. The first lag() call then loads the module: loading, then on.
caption.zh: 前半秒它顯示 off。接著第一次呼叫 lag() 就載入模組：loading，然後 on。

summary.en: One step of a one-pole lag: moves `current` toward `target`, closing 63% of the gap after `seconds`.
summary.zh: 一階低通跟隨的一步：把 `current` 往 `target` 推近，經過 `seconds` 秒走完 63% 的差距。

description.en: The smallest piece of smoothing. Call it once per frame, `value = approach(value, target, 0.2, dt)`, and `value` chases `target`: 63% of the way after `seconds`, 90% after 2.3 × `seconds`, 99% after 4.6 × `seconds`. It is exact for any `dt`, so a sketch at 30 fps and one at 144 fps draw the same curve.
description.zh: 平滑裡最小的一塊。每個畫面呼叫一次，`value = approach(value, target, 0.2, dt)`，`value` 就會追著 `target` 跑：經過 `seconds` 走完 63%，2.3 × `seconds` 走完 90%，4.6 × `seconds` 走完 99%。不管 `dt` 多大都是精確解，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 畫出同一條曲線。

description.en: `seconds` here is a time constant, which is shorter than the "seconds" of TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP. [`Lag`](#Lag) takes the TouchDesigner kind and divides it by [`TD_LAG_RATIO`](#TD_LAG_RATIO) before calling this function. `@openav/mapping`'s `smooth` steps with `approach` and means the time constant too.
description.zh: 這裡的 `seconds` 是時間常數，比 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 的「秒數」短。[`Lag`](#Lag) 收的是 TouchDesigner 那種秒數，會先除以 [`TD_LAG_RATIO`](#TD_LAG_RATIO) 再呼叫這個函式。`@openav/mapping` 的 `smooth` 也是用 `approach` 一步一步走，意思同樣是時間常數。

params.name: current
params.en: Where the value is now.
params.zh: 數值現在的位置。

params.name: target
params.en: Where it is heading.
params.zh: 它要去的地方。

params.name: seconds
params.en: The time constant: after this many seconds the gap to `target` has closed by 63% (1 − 1/e). 0, a negative number or NaN jumps straight to `target`, whatever `dt` is.
params.zh: 時間常數：經過這麼多秒，與 `target` 的差距縮小 63%（1 − 1/e）。0、負數或 NaN 會直接跳到 `target`，不管 `dt` 是多少。

params.name: dt
params.en: Seconds since the last step. 0, a negative number or NaN leaves `current` where it is.
params.zh: 距離上一步過了幾秒。0、負數或 NaN 時 `current` 原地不動。

returns.en: The new value, between `current` and `target`.
returns.zh: 新的數值，落在 `current` 與 `target` 之間。

needs.en: Nothing. It is pure arithmetic with no memory: you keep `current` yourself and pass in the seconds since the last call. For a value with its own memory use [`Lag`](#Lag).
needs.zh: 不需要先做什麼。它只是算術，沒有記憶：`current` 由你自己保管，並把距離上次呼叫的秒數傳進來。想要自帶記憶的版本，用 [`Lag`](#Lag)。

caption.en: Six frames of a value chasing 1: it covers about 15% of the remaining gap each frame (0.154, 0.283, 0.393 …).
caption.zh: 一個數值追著 1 跑的六個畫面：每個畫面大約走完剩下差距的 15%（0.154、0.283、0.393 …）。

caption.en: Prints 0.632, 0.900 and 0.990: the three numbers worth remembering.

claims.before: (lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))
(lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))

summary.en: Counts how many times its input turned on (true, or a number above `threshold`); with a limit it loops 0 … limit − 1. The Count CHOP.
summary.zh: 數輸入打開了幾次（true，或超過 `threshold` 的數字），給上限就會在 0 … 上限 − 1 之間循環。就是 Count CHOP。

description.en: `count.step(input, limit)` counts a rising edge, the moment the input goes from off to on, not the time it stays on. Hold a button for ten seconds and that is one. With `limit` 4 the result walks 0 1 2 3 0 1 …, which is how a beat becomes "beat 1 of 4".
description.zh: `count.step(input, limit)` 數的是上升的那一下，也就是輸入從關變成開的瞬間，不是開著的時間。按住按鈕十秒也只算一次。給 `limit` 4，結果會是 0 1 2 3 0 1 …，一個拍子就這樣變成「四拍裡的第幾拍」。

description.en: The counter keeps counting underneath even when you pass a limit, so you can change the limit later without losing your place. A value that is not a number counts as off.
description.zh: 就算給了上限，底下的計數器還是一直累加，所以之後改上限也不會失去進度。不是數字的值算成關。

description.en: In a p5 sketch use [`count()`](#count): `count(beat, 4)`, or `count('kick')` to count the drum machine's kicks.
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡請用 [`count()`](#count)：`count(beat, 4)`，或用 `count('kick')` 數鼓機的大鼓。

params.name: threshold
params.en: A number counts as "on" when it is above this. A boolean true is 1, false is 0.
params.zh: 數字超過這個值才算「打開」。布林值 true 是 1，false 是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to load. Call `step` every frame, even while the input is off: it has to see the "off" to notice the next "on". It has no `dt`, because a count does not depend on time.
needs.zh: 不用載入任何東西。每個畫面都呼叫 `step`，連輸入關著的時候也要：它得看到「關」，才認得出下一次的「開」。它沒有 `dt`，因為計數跟時間無關。

notes.en: Public fields: `threshold`, `on` (is the input on right now) and `total` (the count before looping).
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `threshold`、`on`（輸入現在是不是開著）和 `total`（循環之前的計數）。

caption.en: Prints 0  1  1  1  2  2  2  3: it counts each time the input goes from off to on, and holding it on adds nothing.
caption.zh: 印出 0  1  1  1  2  2  2  3：輸入每次從關變開就加一，一直開著不會再加。

caption.en: With a limit of 4 the count loops: 0  1  1  2  2  3  3  0  0  1  1  2.

summary.en: The default settings of every CHOP in the package, as one frozen object: lag, envelope, spring, trail and count.
summary.zh: 這個套件裡每個 CHOP 的預設設定，收在一個凍結的物件裡：lag、envelope、spring、trail 和 count。

description.en: For documentation and for interfaces that show the defaults, such as the placeholder text of a field. The classes and [`envelope()`](#envelope) have these same numbers written in their own signatures; changing this object changes nothing about how they behave.
description.zh: 給文件和要顯示預設值的介面用，例如輸入欄的提示文字。這些類別和 [`envelope()`](#envelope) 在自己的簽名裡已經寫了同樣的數字。改這個物件不會改變它們的行為。

value.en: `{ lag: { up: 0.1, down: 0.1 }, envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.3 }, spring: { stiffness: 100, damping: 6 }, trail: { seconds: 2, rate: 60 }, count: { threshold: 0.5 } }`. Frozen: assigning to it does nothing.
value.zh: `{ lag: { up: 0.1, down: 0.1 }, envelope: { attack: 0.01, decay: 0.3 }, spring: { stiffness: 100, damping: 6 }, trail: { seconds: 2, rate: 60 }, count: { threshold: 0.5 } }`。已凍結：指定新值不會有作用。

examples.code:
import { DEFAULTS } from '@openav/chop';

document.getElementById('app').textContent = JSON.stringify(DEFAULTS.spring);

caption.en: Prints {"stiffness":100,"damping":6}: what a Spring does when you give it no settings.
caption.zh: 印出 {"stiffness":100,"damping":6}：沒給設定時 Spring 用的值。

summary.en: The level, 0 to `peak`, of an attack-and-decay envelope at time `t`, for events that happened at the given `times`; the Trigger CHOP.
summary.zh: 給定事件發生的時間 `times`，算出起音加衰減的包絡在時間 `t` 的高度（0 到 `peak`），就是 Trigger CHOP。

description.en: Keep a list of the times something happened (a kick, a key press, a cue) and ask for the level at the time you are drawing: `scale(1 + envelope(kicks, now, 0.01, 0.3))`. It rises in a straight line to 1 in `attack` seconds, then falls to 0 in `decay` seconds, quick at first and landing softly.
description.zh: 把某件事發生的時間（大鼓、按鍵、cue）存成一個清單，畫的時候問它「現在多高」：`scale(1 + envelope(kicks, now, 0.01, 0.3))`。它在 `attack` 秒內直線升到 1，再用 `decay` 秒落回 0，一開始快、收尾柔。

description.en: It is a pure function of the times and of `t`: ask twice, or at 30 fps and at 144 fps, and the same moment gives the same level; `attack` and `decay` may change every frame (a knob on the decay). A new event while the last one still sounds restarts from where the envelope is, never from 0, so fast hits pile up into a plateau instead of flickering. The attack counts from 0 to the peak, so a retrigger from halfway up takes half the attack.
description.zh: 它是 `times` 和 `t` 的純函式：問兩次、或在 30 fps 與 144 fps 問同一個時間點，答案一樣。`attack` 和 `decay` 每個畫面都可以改（例如用旋鈕調 decay）。上一個事件還沒消散時又來一個，包絡從目前的高度重新出發，不會先掉到 0，所以快速的連擊會堆成一個高原，不會閃爍。起音以 0 到峰值計算，所以從一半高度重新觸發只要一半的起音時間。

description.en: In a p5 sketch you do not import it: [`env()`](#env) and `trigger()` keep the event list for you and read the drum machine and the microphone.
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡不用 import：[`env()`](#env) 和 `trigger()` 會替你保管事件清單，也會讀鼓機和麥克風。

params.name: times
params.en: When the events happened, in seconds on any clock you like, oldest first. An empty array (or none) gives 0. Events later than `t` have not happened yet and are ignored. Only the last few matter, so you can trim the list.
params.zh: 事件發生的時間，單位是秒，用哪個時鐘都行，最舊的排前面。空陣列（或沒給）回傳 0。比 `t` 晚的事件還沒發生，會被忽略。只有最後幾筆有影響，所以可以把舊的剪掉。

params.name: t
params.en: The moment to read, on the same clock as `times`.
params.zh: 要讀取的時間點，跟 `times` 用同一個時鐘。

params.name: attack
params.en: Seconds to rise from 0 to the peak. 0 starts at the peak at once.
params.zh: 從 0 升到峰值要幾秒。0 就一開始直接在峰值。

params.name: decay
params.en: Seconds to fall back to 0 after the peak: it is exactly 0 from `attack + decay` seconds after an event.
params.zh: 到達峰值後落回 0 要幾秒：事件之後 `attack + decay` 秒起正好是 0。

params.name: peak
params.en: The top of the envelope.
params.zh: 包絡的最高點。

returns.en: 0 to `peak`: `peak` just after an event, 0 once it has died away.
returns.zh: 0 到 `peak`：事件剛發生時是 `peak`，消散之後是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to load. You record the event times yourself (for example `kicks.push(performance.now() / 1000)` when a kick arrives) and pass the same clock as `t`.
needs.zh: 不用載入任何東西。事件的時間由你自己記（例如大鼓來的時候 `kicks.push(performance.now() / 1000)`），`t` 要用同一個時鐘。

caption.en: Before the kick 0.00, half way up the attack 0.50 at 1.005 s, the peak 1.00 at 1.01 s, then 0.49, 0.13 and 0.00 at 1.31 s.
A disc that swells on every kick (twice a second) and shrinks back within 0.3 s.
caption.zh: 一個圓盤，每次大鼓（每秒兩次）都脹大，0.3 秒內縮回去。

caption.en: Prints "pile-up: 0.95   lone hit: 0.44": each new hit restarts from where the envelope is, so quick hits hold it high.
caption.zh: 印出「pile-up: 0.95   lone hit: 0.44」：每一擊都從目前高度重新出發，所以密集的擊打會把它撐在高處。

claims.before: (lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))
(lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))
(lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))

summary.en: The level of one envelope `elapsed` seconds after its trigger: a straight rise to `peak`, then a fall to 0 in `decay` seconds.
summary.zh: 一個包絡在被觸發 `elapsed` 秒之後的高度：先直線升到 `peak`，再用 `decay` 秒落回 0。

description.en: The building block of [`envelope()`](#envelope), which strings several of these together for a list of events. On its own it answers: "how high is a kick that happened `elapsed` seconds ago?" With the defaults of `envelope()` (attack 0.01, decay 0.3) it is 0.5 at 5 ms, 1 at 10 ms, 0.49 at 100 ms and 0 from 310 ms on.
description.zh: [`envelope()`](#envelope) 的基本零件，它把好幾個這樣的片段串起來處理一串事件。單獨使用時，它回答的是：「`elapsed` 秒前發生的一次大鼓，現在有多高？」用 `envelope()` 的預設值（attack 0.01、decay 0.3），5 毫秒時是 0.5，10 毫秒是 1，100 毫秒是 0.49，310 毫秒起是 0。

description.en: The fall is quick at first and lands softly: that is the shape a kick drum swell looks right with. It reaches 0 in exactly `decay` seconds, not asymptotically.
description.zh: 下降一開始很快、收尾很柔：大鼓的律動配這個形狀看起來最對。它剛好在 `decay` 秒落到 0，不是無限接近。

params.name: elapsed
params.en: Seconds since the trigger. Below 0 (or NaN) gives `from`.
params.zh: 觸發之後過了幾秒。小於 0（或 NaN）時回傳 `from`。

params.name: attack
params.en: Seconds to rise from 0 to `peak`. 0 or less starts at the peak at once.
params.zh: 從 0 升到 `peak` 要幾秒。0 或更小就一開始直接在峰值。

params.name: decay
params.en: Seconds to fall from `peak` to 0, along (1 − u)² where u runs 0 to 1. 0 or less drops to 0 right after the attack.
params.zh: 從 `peak` 落到 0 要幾秒，走 (1 − u)² 的曲線（u 從 0 跑到 1）。0 或更小就在起音結束後立刻變 0。

params.name: from
params.en: The level at the moment of the trigger. The attack still counts from 0 to the peak, so starting from halfway up takes half the attack.
params.zh: 觸發當下的高度。起音仍然以 0 到峰值計算，所以從一半高度開始只要一半的起音時間。

params.name: peak
params.en: The top of the envelope.
params.zh: 包絡的最高點。

returns.en: The level, from 0 to `peak`.
returns.zh: 高度，從 0 到 `peak`。

notes.en: Advanced. Most sketches never call it: use [`envelope()`](#envelope), or `env()` in p5.
notes.zh: 進階用法。大部分草圖不會直接呼叫它：請用 [`envelope()`](#envelope)，p5 裡用 `env()`。

caption.en: Prints the level at six moments after a trigger: 0.00, 0.50, 1.00, 0.49, 0.25, 0.00.

entries.name: Lag
entries.signature: new Lag({ up = 0.1, down = up, value = null } = {})

summary.en: Follows its input with one speed while the input is above the output and another while it is below; the TouchDesigner Lag CHOP.
summary.zh: 輸入比輸出高的時候用一種速度跟上去，比輸出低的時候用另一種速度，就是 TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP。

description.en: Make one `Lag` per value you want to smooth, then call `step(input, dt)` once per frame. `new Lag({ up: 0.03, down: 0.4 })` is a VU meter: it opens almost at once and closes slowly. `up` and `down` are in TouchDesigner's seconds: with `up: 1`, a jump from 0 to 1 is at 0.9 one second later, at 30, 60 or 144 fps alike.
description.zh: 每一個要平滑的數值做一個 `Lag`，每個畫面呼叫一次 `step(input, dt)`。`new Lag({ up: 0.03, down: 0.4 })` 就是音量表：幾乎立刻張開，慢慢收回。`up` 和 `down` 用 TouchDesigner 的秒數：`up: 1` 的話，從 0 跳到 1 之後一秒是 0.9，30、60 或 144 fps 都一樣。

description.en: Each step is the exact answer for an input held at its new value over `dt` seconds, so the frame rate does not change the curve. A boolean counts as 0 or 1 (`lag.step(mouseIsPressed, dt)` is a soft switch). A value that is not a number, such as `NaN`, comes back untouched and leaves the memory as it was.
description.zh: 每一步都是「輸入在這 `dt` 秒內維持新值」的精確解，所以影格率不會改變曲線。布林值算成 0 或 1（`lag.step(mouseIsPressed, dt)` 是柔和的開關）。不是數字的值（像 `NaN`）原樣傳回，記憶不受影響。

description.en: In a p5 sketch you do not import this: [`lag()`](#lag) keeps one `Lag` per call for you.
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡不用 import 它：[`lag()`](#lag) 會替每一個呼叫保管一個 `Lag`。

params.name: up
params.en: Seconds to follow a rise, while the input is above the output. TouchDesigner's seconds: about the time to cover 90% of a jump. 0 follows at once.
params.zh: 追上升高的輸入要幾秒（輸入比輸出高的時候）。用 TouchDesigner 的秒數：大約是走完 90% 跳躍的時間。0 表示立刻跟上。

params.name: down
params.en: Seconds to follow a fall, while the input is below the output. Leave it out and it is the same as `up`.
params.zh: 追上降低的輸入要幾秒（輸入比輸出低的時候）。不給就跟 `up` 一樣。

params.name: value
params.en: A starting value. Leave it out and the first input is taken as it is, so nothing glides in from 0.
params.zh: 起始值。不給的話，第一個輸入原樣當作輸出，所以不會從 0 慢慢滑進來。

needs.en: Nothing to load or start. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as `dt` (in a browser: the difference of two `performance.now() / 1000`). The first `step` only stores the input, so the output equals the input on frame one.
needs.zh: 不用載入或啟動任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 `dt` 傳進來（瀏覽器裡：兩次 `performance.now() / 1000` 的差）。第一次 `step` 只是把輸入記下來，所以第一個畫面輸出等於輸入。

notes.en: Public fields: `up`, `down` and `value`, the last output (`null` until the first step). You can change `up` and `down` any time.
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `up`、`down` 和 `value`（最後一次的輸出，第一次 `step` 之前是 `null`）。`up`、`down` 隨時可以改。

notes.en: The time constant underneath is `seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO` (see [`TD_LAG_RATIO`](#TD_LAG_RATIO)), not `seconds`. If you want the plain 63% kind, call [`approach()`](#approach).
notes.zh: 底層的時間常數是 `seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO`（見 [`TD_LAG_RATIO`](#TD_LAG_RATIO)），不是 `seconds`。想要單純 63% 那一種，直接呼叫 [`approach()`](#approach)。

caption.en: The output shoots up within two frames when the input turns on, then sags back slowly after it turns off (0.00 0.00 0.72 0.92 0.98 0.99 0.90 0.82 …).
caption.zh: 輸入打開時，輸出兩個畫面內就衝上去，輸入關掉之後才慢慢掉下來（0.00 0.00 0.72 0.92 0.98 0.99 0.90 0.82 …）。

caption.en: A one-second pulse (grey) through a Lag at 30 fps (orange) and at 144 fps (blue): it rises in about 0.1 s, falls over about 0.4 s, and the two curves lie on top of each other.
caption.zh: 一個一秒長的脈衝（灰）分別用 30 fps（橘）和 144 fps（藍）走過 Lag：大約 0.1 秒升上去、0.4 秒左右落下來，兩條曲線疊在一起。

examples.code:
import { Lag } from '@openav/chop';

const lag = new Lag();                       // up and down are both 0.1
lag.step(0.5, 0);                            // the first input is taken as it is
const nan = lag.step(NaN, 1 / 60);           // not a number: passed through, memory kept
const kept = lag.value;                      // still 0.5
const toward = lag.step(true, 1 / 60);       // a boolean counts as 1, so it moves up from 0.5
document.getElementById('app').textContent =
  `NaN in: ${nan}, memory still ${kept}, true in: ${toward.toFixed(2)}`;

caption.en: Prints "NaN in: NaN, memory still 0.5, true in: 0.66": a non-number leaves the memory alone, and a boolean counts as 0 or 1.
caption.zh: 印出「NaN in: NaN, memory still 0.5, true in: 0.66」：不是數字就不動記憶，布林值算成 0 或 1。

claims.before: (lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))
claims.expr: (() => { const l = new OAVp5.chop.module.Lag({ up: 1 }); l.step(0, 0); let v; for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) v = l.step(1, 0.01); return v; })()

members.name: step
members.signature: input, dt, up = this.up, down = this.down

summary.en: How fast the input is changing, in units per second; 0 on the first step. The Slope CHOP.
summary.zh: 輸入變化得多快，單位是每秒多少，第一步是 0。就是 Slope CHOP。

description.en: `slope.step(value, dt)` returns `(value − previous value) / dt`. A value rising by 3 every second gives 3 at any frame rate; a value that stands still gives 0; a falling one gives a negative number. Use it for "how hard did the knob just move": `scale(1 + abs(slope.step(knob, dt)))`.
description.zh: `slope.step(value, dt)` 回傳 `(value − 上一個值) / dt`。每秒升 3 的數值，在任何影格率下都回傳 3，沒動的數值是 0，往下掉的是負數。用來表達「旋鈕剛剛轉得多用力」：`scale(1 + abs(slope.step(knob, dt)))`。

description.en: It has no smoothing: a single jump of the input is one big spike for one step. Put the result through a [`Lag`](#Lag) if you want it to fade. A `dt` of 0 or less changes nothing and returns the last slope, and a value that is not a number returns the last slope too.
description.zh: 它不做任何平滑：輸入跳一下，就是一步裡的一根大尖峰。想讓它淡出，把結果交給 [`Lag`](#Lag)。`dt` 是 0 或更小，什麼都不改，回傳上一次的斜率。值不是數字時也回傳上一次的斜率。

description.en: In a p5 sketch use [`slope()`](#slope).
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡請用 [`slope()`](#slope)。

needs.en: Nothing to load. The first `step` only stores the value and returns 0, because there is no earlier value to compare with.
needs.zh: 不用載入任何東西。第一次 `step` 只是把值記下來並回傳 0，因為沒有更早的值可以比。

notes.en: The last slope is the public field `value`.
notes.zh: 最近一次的斜率是公開欄位 `value`。

caption.en: Prints 0.0  3.0  3.0  0.0: nothing on the first step, then 3 units a second while it rises, then 0 when it stops.
caption.zh: 印出 0.0  3.0  3.0  0.0：第一步沒有東西，上升時每秒 3 單位，停下來就是 0。

summary.en: Adds `rate` every second to a running total: a rate in units per second becomes a position; the Speed CHOP.
summary.zh: 每秒把 `rate` 加進一個累計值：每秒多少單位的速率變成位置，就是 Speed CHOP。

description.en: `speed.step(rate, dt)` adds `rate * dt` to the total and returns it. With `rate` 1 the total grows by 1 every second; `rotate(speed.step(TWO_PI, dt))` is one turn a second. Feed it a rate that changes (a knob, `micLevel`) and the motion speeds up and slows down smoothly, without the jump you get from multiplying `frameCount` by it.
description.zh: `speed.step(rate, dt)` 把 `rate * dt` 加到累計值裡並回傳。`rate` 是 1 的話，累計值每秒增加 1。`rotate(speed.step(TWO_PI, dt))` 就是每秒轉一圈。餵給它會變動的速率（旋鈕、`micLevel`），動作會平順地變快變慢，不會像把 `frameCount` 乘上速率那樣一跳一跳。

description.en: It is the integral of the rate, so it is the same at any frame rate. A boolean rate counts as 1 per second while true. A rate that is not a number, or a `dt` of 0 or less, adds nothing.
description.zh: 它是速率的積分，所以不論影格率都一樣。布林值的速率在 true 的時候算每秒 1。速率不是數字、或 `dt` 是 0 或更小，就什麼都不加。

description.en: In a p5 sketch use [`speed()`](#speed), which keeps one for each call.
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡請用 [`speed()`](#speed)，它會替每個呼叫保管一個。

params.name: value
params.en: The starting total. Anything that is not a finite number starts at 0.
params.zh: 累計值的起點。不是有限數字的話就從 0 開始。

needs.en: Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as `dt`.
needs.zh: 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 `dt` 傳進來。

notes.en: The total is the public field `value`.
notes.zh: 累計值就是公開欄位 `value`。

caption.en: Prints 1.0  2.0  3.0  4.0: two units a second, half a second per step.
caption.zh: 印出 1.0  2.0  3.0  4.0：每秒 2 單位，每一步半秒。

caption.en: A hand that turns once a second, at any frame rate. Change the rate to a changing number (a level, a knob) and it speeds up and slows down smoothly.
caption.zh: 一根每秒轉一圈的指針，不論影格率。把速率換成會變動的數字（音量、旋鈕），它就會平順地加速減速。

entries.name: Spring
entries.signature: new Spring({ stiffness = 100, damping = 6, value = null } = {})

summary.en: Follows its input like a mass on a spring: it overshoots, swings back and settles; the Spring CHOP with the input as position.
summary.zh: 像吊在彈簧上的重物一樣追著輸入：會衝過頭、彈回來、再安定下來，就是輸入當作位置的 Spring CHOP。

description.en: Make one `Spring` per value, call `step(target, dt)` once per frame and draw what it returns. With the defaults (stiffness 100, damping 6), a jump of the input from 0 to 1 sends the output to 1.37 after a third of a second, and it is within 1% of 1 from about 1.4 s on. Raise the damping to 20 and it glides to the target without overshooting.
description.zh: 每個數值做一個 `Spring`，每個畫面呼叫一次 `step(target, dt)`，畫它回傳的值。用預設值（stiffness 100、damping 6）的話，輸入從 0 跳到 1，輸出在約三分之一秒時衝到 1.37，大約 1.4 秒之後就落在 1 的 1% 以內。把 damping 調到 20，它就會滑到目標上，不衝過頭。

description.en: Each step is the exact answer from [`springStep()`](#springStep), so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same motion and a long frame cannot blow it up. The input is the position it is pulled toward; a boolean counts as 0 or 1; a value that is not a number is returned as it is and changes nothing.
description.zh: 每一步都是 [`springStep()`](#springStep) 的精確解，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 動得一樣，一個很長的畫面也不會讓它發散。輸入是它被拉向的位置，布林值算成 0 或 1，不是數字的值原樣傳回，什麼都不改。

description.en: In a p5 sketch use [`spring()`](#spring).
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡請用 [`spring()`](#spring)。

params.name: stiffness
params.en: How hard the spring pulls, so how fast it swings. With nothing damping it, it swings about `√stiffness / 2π` times a second (100 is about 1.6).
params.zh: 彈簧拉得多用力，也就是擺動多快。沒有阻尼的時候，每秒大約擺 `√stiffness / 2π` 次（100 大約是 1.6 次）。

params.name: damping
params.en: How soon it settles. 6 with a stiffness of 100 bounces a few times; `2 * √stiffness` (20 for 100) and above never bounces.
params.zh: 多快安定下來。stiffness 100 配 damping 6 會彈幾下。`2 * √stiffness`（100 的話是 20）以上就完全不彈。

params.name: value
params.en: A starting position. Leave it out and the first input is taken as it is, so it does not swing in from 0.
params.zh: 起始位置。不給的話，第一個輸入原樣當作位置，所以不會從 0 擺進來。

needs.en: Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as `dt`. The first `step` only stores the input (the spring starts at rest on it).
needs.zh: 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 `dt` 傳進來。第一次 `step` 只是把輸入記下來（彈簧就靜止在那裡開始）。

notes.en: Public fields: `stiffness`, `damping`, `value` (the position; `null` before the first step) and `velocity`.
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `stiffness`、`damping`、`value`（位置，第一次 `step` 之前是 `null`）和 `velocity`。

caption.en: Every third frame after the input jumps to 1: the value overshoots past 1 (to about 1.37), comes back and settles.
caption.zh: 輸入跳到 1 之後每隔三個畫面看一次：數值衝過 1（約 1.37）、彈回來、再安定。

caption.en: Two springs follow the same jump (grey): damping 6 (orange) overshoots and wobbles, damping 20 (blue) glides straight to the target.
caption.zh: 兩個彈簧追同一個跳躍（灰）：damping 6（橘）衝過頭再晃幾下，damping 20（藍）直接滑到目標。

claims.before: (lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))
claims.expr: (() => { const s = new OAVp5.chop.module.Spring(); s.step(0, 0); let peak = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 180; i++) peak = Math.max(peak, s.step(1, 1 / 60)); return peak; })()

members.name: step
members.signature: target, dt, stiffness = this.stiffness, damping = this.damping

entries.name: springStep
entries.signature: springStep(x, v, target, stiffness, damping, dt)

summary.en: One exact step of a damped spring of mass 1 pulled toward `target`; returns `[position, velocity]`.
summary.zh: 質量為 1 的阻尼彈簧朝 `target` 被拉的一個精確步驟，回傳 `[位置, 速度]`。

description.en: Solves x'' = −stiffness·(x − target) − damping·x' exactly over `dt` for a `target` that stays still during the step. It handles all three cases (under-damped: it bounces; critically damped; over-damped: it creeps) and a huge `dt` never blows up, which is why a sketch can fall behind for a whole second and the spring just lands on the target.
description.zh: 對 `dt` 這段時間內 `target` 不動的情況，精確解 x'' = −stiffness·(x − target) − damping·x'。欠阻尼（會彈）、臨界阻尼、過阻尼（慢慢爬）三種情況都處理，而且 `dt` 再大也不會發散，所以草圖卡了一整秒，彈簧也只是落在目標上。

description.en: `damping = 2 * Math.sqrt(stiffness)` is the edge where it stops bouncing: with `stiffness` 100 that is a damping of 20. With no spring (`stiffness` 0) only the damping acts and the velocity just fades.
description.zh: `damping = 2 * Math.sqrt(stiffness)` 是剛好不再彈的臨界點：`stiffness` 是 100 的話，就是 damping 20。沒有彈簧（`stiffness` 為 0）的時候只剩阻尼作用，速度慢慢消失。

params.name: x
params.en: The position now.
params.zh: 現在的位置。

params.name: v
params.en: The velocity now, in units per second.
params.zh: 現在的速度，單位是每秒多少單位。

params.name: target
params.en: Where the other end of the spring is held.
params.zh: 彈簧另一端固定的位置。

params.name: stiffness
params.en: How hard it pulls. Negative counts as 0.
params.zh: 拉得多用力。負數當作 0。

params.name: damping
params.en: How much friction slows it. Negative counts as 0.
params.zh: 摩擦力多大。負數當作 0。

params.name: dt
params.en: Seconds to advance. 0 or less (or NaN) returns `[x, v]` unchanged.
params.zh: 要前進幾秒。0 或更小（或 NaN）原樣回傳 `[x, v]`。

returns.en: The new position and velocity.
returns.zh: 新的位置與速度。

notes.en: Advanced. The [`Spring`](#Spring) class holds the position and the velocity for you and calls this.
notes.zh: 進階用法。[`Spring`](#Spring) 類別會替你保管位置與速度，並呼叫這個函式。

caption.en: Eight frames of a spring released at 0 and pulled toward 1: it accelerates (0.01, 0.05, 0.11 …).
caption.zh: 從 0 放開、朝 1 拉的彈簧的八個畫面：愈來愈快（0.01、0.05、0.11 …）。

caption.en: A ten-second step lands on the target (position 1.000, velocity 0.000) instead of exploding.
caption.zh: 一次走十秒也只是落在目標上（位置 1.000、速度 0.000），不會發散。

summary.en: `Math.LN10`, about 2.303: how many time constants a lag needs to cover 90% of a jump, which is what TouchDesigner's Lag seconds mean.
summary.zh: `Math.LN10`，約 2.303：一個 lag 走完 90% 要幾個時間常數，也就是 TouchDesigner 的 Lag 秒數的意思。

description.en: TouchDesigner's Lag CHOP quotes its seconds as roughly the time the output takes to follow 90% of a change. A one-pole lag reaches 90% after ln 10 time constants, so `seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO` is the time constant to hand to [`approach()`](#approach). [`Lag`](#Lag) does exactly that, which is why `lag(x, 0.1)` in a p5 sketch moves like a Lag CHOP set to 0.1.
description.zh: TouchDesigner 的 Lag CHOP 把秒數定義成大約是輸出追上 90% 變化所花的時間。一階低通要走 ln 10 個時間常數才到 90%，所以 `seconds / TD_LAG_RATIO` 就是該交給 [`approach()`](#approach) 的時間常數。[`Lag`](#Lag) 做的正是這件事，所以 p5 草圖裡的 `lag(x, 0.1)` 動起來就像把 Lag CHOP 設成 0.1。

description.en: You only need it when you mix the two kinds of seconds: a time constant `tau` is `tdSeconds / TD_LAG_RATIO`, and `tdSeconds` is `tau * TD_LAG_RATIO`. Attack and decay of an [`envelope()`](#envelope) are plain lengths and are not converted.
description.zh: 只有在兩種秒數混著用的時候才會用到它：時間常數 `tau` 等於 `tdSeconds / TD_LAG_RATIO`，`tdSeconds` 等於 `tau * TD_LAG_RATIO`。[`envelope()`](#envelope) 的 attack 和 decay 是單純的長度，不用換算。

value.en: Exactly `Math.LN10`, 2.302585092994046. A fixed number: it never changes.

caption.en: Prints "tau = 0.217 s, after 0.5 s the value is 0.90": half a second of Lag CHOP seconds is 90% of the way.
caption.zh: 印出「tau = 0.217 s, after 0.5 s the value is 0.90」：Lag CHOP 的 0.5 秒就是走完 90%。

claims.before: (lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))

summary.en: Remembers the input over the last few seconds as a list of values, oldest first, at a fixed 60 values a second; the Trail CHOP.
summary.zh: 把輸入最近幾秒的變化記成一串數值，最舊的在前，固定每秒 60 個，就是 Trail CHOP。

description.en: `trail.step(value, dt)` returns an array of `seconds * rate` past values followed by this step's input at the end, so the array is `seconds * rate + 1` long (121 for the defaults). Draw it across the canvas as a line: that is a scope of the value.
description.zh: `trail.step(value, dt)` 回傳一個陣列：`seconds * rate` 個過去的值，最後接上這一步的輸入，所以長度是 `seconds * rate + 1`（預設是 121）。把它橫跨畫布畫成一條線，就是這個數值的示波器。

description.en: The length is fixed from the first step, filled with the first value, so a sketch can draw the whole line from frame one. The values are interpolated between steps, so 30 fps and 144 fps give the same line. A gap longer than the whole window (a tab that was hidden) restarts it filled with the new value.
description.zh: 長度從第一步就固定，用第一個值填滿，所以草圖從第一個畫面就能畫出整條線。步與步之間會內插，所以 30 fps 和 144 fps 得到同一條線。如果有一段空檔比整個視窗還長（例如分頁被藏起來），就用新的值填滿重新開始。

description.en: In a p5 sketch use [`trail()`](#trail) and [`drawTrail()`](#drawTrail).
description.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡請用 [`trail()`](#trail) 和 [`drawTrail()`](#drawTrail)。

params.name: seconds
params.en: How many seconds of history to keep. 0 or less falls back to 2.
params.zh: 要保留幾秒的歷史。0 或更小的話改用 2。

params.name: rate
params.en: Values per second in the list. 0 or less falls back to 60.
params.zh: 清單裡每秒幾個值。0 或更小的話改用 60。

needs.en: Nothing to load. Pass the seconds since the previous frame as `dt`. A value that is not a number leaves the history as it is and returns the current list.
needs.zh: 不用載入任何東西。把距離上一個畫面的秒數當作 `dt` 傳進來。不是數字的值不會改動歷史，只是回傳目前的清單。

caption.en: Prints "7 values: 4 5 6 7 8 9 9": the last six steps of the input, then the newest input once more at the end.
caption.zh: 印出「7 values: 4 5 6 7 8 9 9」：輸入最近的六步，最後再接一次最新的輸入。

caption.en: A scope of a sine wave that scrolls across the canvas: the newest value is at the right edge, with three seconds of history behind it (flat on the left until that much has passed).
caption.zh: 一個正弦波的示波器，從畫布上捲過去：最新的值在右邊緣，後面是三秒的歷史（過滿三秒之前，左邊是平的）。
