claims.before: (lag(0), new Promise((done) => { const t = setInterval(() => { if (OAVp5.chop.state === 'on') { clearInterval(t); done(); } }, 20); setTimeout(done, 5000); }))

members.name: values
members.doc: oldest → newest, the newest being the last input

summary.en: Loops a count to 0 … limit − 1: `wrapCount(5, 4)` is 1. A limit of 0 or less leaves the count as it is.
summary.zh: 把計數循環到 0 … 上限 − 1：`wrapCount(5, 4)` 是 1。上限是 0 或更小就維持原樣。

description.en: The modulo that [`Count`](#Count) uses, made safe for negative numbers: `wrapCount(-1, 4)` is 3, where `-1 % 4` is -1. It is useful on its own for anything that loops, such as a step number: `wrapCount(frameCount, 16)`.
description.zh: [`Count`](#Count) 使用的取餘數，並且對負數也安全：`wrapCount(-1, 4)` 是 3，而 `-1 % 4` 是 -1。拿來處理任何要循環的東西也很方便，例如步序編號：`wrapCount(frameCount, 16)`。

params.name: total
params.en: The count so far.
params.zh: 目前累計的次數。

params.name: limit
params.en: How many values to loop through. A fraction is rounded down. 0, a negative number, or no value at all returns `total` unchanged.
params.zh: 要循環幾個值。小數會無條件捨去。0、負數或沒給，就原樣回傳 `total`。

returns.en: `total` looped into 0 … `limit` − 1 (never negative, even for a negative `total`).
returns.zh: 循環到 0 … `limit` − 1 的 `total`（就算 `total` 是負的，結果也不會是負的）。

caption.en: Prints 0 3 0 1 1 3, then 5 when there is no limit.
caption.zh: 印出 0 3 0 1 1 3。沒有上限的話則是 5。

summary.en: Whether a recording is running right now.
summary.zh: 現在有沒有在錄影。

description.en: Use it to keep things out of the video: `if (!recordingIsOn) text('press r to record', 20, 30);`, because everything on the canvas is recorded. Use it for a key that toggles: `recordingIsOn ? stopRecording() : startRecording()`. It changes when a take starts and when it ends, and reading it never starts anything. For the other stages (`starting`, `saving`) read [`OAVp5.record.state`](#OAVp5.record.state).
description.zh: 用它把東西留在影片之外：`if (!recordingIsOn) text('press r to record', 20, 30);`，因為畫布上的所有東西都會被錄進去。也可以用在開關鍵上：`recordingIsOn ? stopRecording() : startRecording()`。它只在錄影開始和結束的時候改變，讀它不會啟動任何東西。想知道其他階段（`starting`、`saving`），請讀 [`OAVp5.record.state`](#OAVp5.record.state)。

value.en: True while a take runs. It is false at the start, while the recorder is still loading, from the moment [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) is called (the file is then being made) and after the take.
value.zh: 錄影進行中是 true。一開始、錄影程式還在載入、從呼叫 [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) 的那一刻起（檔案這時還在製作）、以及錄完之後，都是 false。

notes.en: A sketch that declares its own variable called `recordingIsOn` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves the name alone and a card says to read `OAVp5.record.state === 'on'` instead.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就宣告了自己的 `recordingIsOn` 變數，就用你的：oav-p5 不動這個名稱，並用一張卡片提醒你改讀 `OAVp5.record.state === 'on'`。

caption.en: The guide text is on the canvas until you press r, and gone while recording, so the video has only the circle.
caption.zh: 按 r 之前畫布上有說明文字，錄影的時候消失，所以影片裡只有那個圓。

summary.en: An event you define: it is called when a recording has been saved and checked, with an `info` object about the file.
summary.zh: 一個由你定義的事件函式：錄影存好、檢查完之後呼叫它，帶著一個說明這支檔案的 `info` 物件。

description.en: Define `function recordingSaved(info) { … }` to know when the file is done: [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) or the end of `seconds` leads to it. By then the file has already been handed to the browser to download. The same `info` is given to the promise of `stopRecording()` and to `OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn)`, and stays in [`OAVp5.record.last`](#OAVp5.record.last).
description.zh: 定義 `function recordingSaved(info) { … }`，就知道檔案什麼時候好了：[`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) 或 `seconds` 時間到之後會走到這裡。那時檔案已經交給瀏覽器下載了。同一份 `info` 也會交給 `stopRecording()` 回傳的 promise 和 `OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn)`，並且留在 [`OAVp5.record.last`](#OAVp5.record.last)。

description.en: `info.url` works as a link to the file (`createA(info.url, 'play')` or a `<video>`) until a minute after the next take is saved. `warnings` is what the card after the take says in words; an empty list means nothing looked wrong.
description.zh: `info.url` 可以當成檔案的連結用（`createA(info.url, 'play')` 或 `<video>`），直到下一支錄好之後一分鐘為止。`warnings` 是錄完之後卡片用文字說的那些事，空的清單表示沒有哪裡不對。

params.name: info
params.en: `name` (the file name), `format` (`'mp4'` or `'webm'`), `type` (the exact MIME type), `seconds` (length, to a tenth), `bytes`, `width` and `height` (even numbers for MP4), `fps`, `audio` (the video has a sound track), `heard` (something sounded), `sources` (which sounds were in it: `'sound'`, `'drums'`, `'mic'`, `'p5sound'`), `warnings` (what looked wrong: `'recEmpty'`, `'recWebm'`, `'recNoAudio'`, `'recSilent'`, `'recBlack'`, usually an empty list), `blob` (the file) and `url` (an address for the blob).
params.zh: `name`（檔名）、`format`（`'mp4'` 或 `'webm'`）、`type`（精確的 MIME 類型）、`seconds`（長度，精確到 0.1 秒）、`bytes`、`width` 和 `height`（MP4 會是偶數）、`fps`、`audio`（影片有沒有音軌）、`heard`（有沒有真的出過聲）、`sources`（錄進去的聲音來源：`'sound'`、`'drums'`、`'mic'`、`'p5sound'`）、`warnings`（看起來哪裡不對：`'recEmpty'`、`'recWebm'`、`'recNoAudio'`、`'recSilent'`、`'recBlack'`，通常是空的）、`blob`（檔案本身）、`url`（blob 的位址）。

caption.en: Press r: three seconds later the file is downloaded and its name, format, length and size appear on the canvas.
caption.zh: 按 r：三秒後檔案下載完成，檔名、格式、長度和大小會顯示在畫布上。

caption.en: Press r (after one click on the page): the text says whether the video has sound, from which sources, and lists anything that looked wrong.
caption.zh: （先在頁面上點一下）再按 r：文字會說影片有沒有聲音、來自哪些來源，以及有沒有哪裡不對。

summary.en: Records the canvas and the sound your sketch makes into one video file, and returns a promise that says whether the recording began.
summary.zh: 把畫布和草圖發出的聲音錄成一支影片檔，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你錄影有沒有開始。

description.en: Start it from a key or a click: `if (key === 'r') startRecording();`. What goes into the video is the canvas alone, at its own pixel size (a retina screen doubles it), and everything your sketch sounds like: the instrument of [`startSound()`](#startSound), the drum machine, the pads, the microphone while it is on, and p5.sound 1.x, mixed into one track while the speakers play as before. The 🎹, the drum grid and the cards are part of the page, not of the canvas, so they are never in the video. A sound that comes on during the take joins it.
description.zh: 從按鍵或點擊啟動：`if (key === 'r') startRecording();`。進影片的只有畫布本身（用畫布自己的像素大小，視網膜螢幕會是兩倍），加上你的草圖發出的所有聲音：[`startSound()`](#startSound) 的樂器、鼓機、打擊墊、開著的麥克風、p5.sound 1.x，混成一條音軌，喇叭照常播放。🎹、鼓機格子和提示卡片是頁面的一部分，不在畫布上，所以不會出現在影片裡。錄到一半才開起來的聲音也會加入。

description.en: The file is MP4 (H.264 + AAC, which Instagram, YouTube and every editor take) where the browser can write it, and WebM where not; a card says Instagram will not take a WebM. It is named `oav-20261015-183005.mp4`, with `name` in the middle when you give one. When the take is done it is downloaded, and on a phone that can share files a Share button appears on the card. After [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording), or when `seconds` has run out, [`recordingSaved(info)`](#recordingSaved) is called with the details. Without `seconds` a take stops by itself at the longest length (300 seconds unless the `reclimit` option says otherwise).
description.zh: 瀏覽器寫得出 MP4 的話，檔案就是 MP4（H.264 + AAC，Instagram、YouTube 和所有剪輯軟體都吃），不然就是 WebM，這時會有卡片說 Instagram 不收 WebM。檔名像 `oav-20261015-183005.mp4`，有給 `name` 的話會放在中間。錄完會自動下載，在能分享檔案的手機上，卡片會出現「分享」按鈕。呼叫 [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) 之後，或 `seconds` 時間到了，會呼叫 [`recordingSaved(info)`](#recordingSaved) 並把細節交給它。沒給 `seconds` 的話，錄到最長長度就會自己停（預設 300 秒，載入選項 `reclimit` 可以改）。

description.en: Without `bitrate` the quality follows the canvas: 0.16 bits per pixel per frame, kept between 4 and 16 megabits a second (24 above 30 frames a second). Calling `startRecording()` while a take is running starts nothing new. After every take a card says what was recorded and, when something looks wrong, what and why: nothing reached the sound track although a sound was on, WebM, a file that is almost empty, a black video of a canvas that was not black.
description.zh: 沒給 `bitrate` 的話，畫質跟著畫布大小走：每個像素、每一格 0.16 位元，限制在每秒 4 到 16 百萬位元之間（每秒超過 30 格時是 24）。已經在錄的時候再呼叫 `startRecording()`，不會開新的一支。每支錄完之後，卡片會說錄了什麼，有地方不對的話還會說是什麼、為什麼：有聲音開著、卻沒有任何東西進到音軌、WebM、幾乎是空的檔案、畫布明明不是黑的、影片卻是黑的。

params.name: o
params.en: A number is the length in seconds: `startRecording(10)` stops by itself after ten. An object can hold `seconds` (the same, never more than the longest take, 300 by default), `fps` (frames a second, at most 60, 30 by default), `mic` (`false` keeps the microphone out of the video), `name` (a word for the file name), `canvas` (the canvas to record: a `<canvas>`, a p5 canvas or a `createGraphics()` buffer; the biggest p5 canvas on the page by default) and `bitrate` (bits a second). Leave it out to record until [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording).
params.zh: 給數字就是秒數：`startRecording(10)` 錄十秒後自己停。給物件的話，可以放 `seconds`（同樣是秒數，不會超過一支影片的長度上限，預設 300）、`fps`（每秒幾格，最多 60，預設 30）、`mic`（`false` 就不把麥克風錄進影片）、`name`（檔名裡的一個詞）、`canvas`（要錄的畫布：`<canvas>`、p5 畫布或 `createGraphics()` 的緩衝區，預設是頁面上最大的那張 p5 畫布）和 `bitrate`（每秒幾位元）。不傳就一直錄到呼叫 [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording)。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once the recording is running (or when one already is). Resolves to `false` when the loading option `record` is `off`, when there is no canvas to record, when this browser has no `MediaRecorder`, or when it could not start; a card says why.
returns.zh: 錄影開始之後 resolve 成 `true`（已經在錄的話也是 `true`）。載入選項 `record` 是 `off`、找不到要錄的畫布、這個瀏覽器沒有 `MediaRecorder`、或是啟動失敗的時候，resolve 成 `false`，並且會有一張卡片說明原因。

needs.en: A browser that has `MediaRecorder`: where it is missing, a card says so and the promise resolves to `false`. The picture is recorded at once, but the page can only make sound after a click or key press on it, so a take that begins before the first one has nothing to hear at first. A canvas that shows an image from another site (no CORS) cannot be recorded, and a card says so.
needs.zh: 瀏覽器要有 `MediaRecorder`，沒有的話會跳出卡片說明，promise 也會 resolve 成 `false`。畫面馬上就錄，但頁面要有一次點擊或按鍵之後才能發聲，所以在第一次點擊之前開始的錄影，一開始是沒有聲音可錄的。畫布上如果有別的網站來的圖片（沒有 CORS），就錄不了，卡片會告訴你。

notes.en: In the 🎹 panel, ⏺ starts and stops a take with no code, and 📷 saves the canvas as a PNG (see [`OAVp5.record.shot()`](#OAVp5.record.shot)). While a take runs the 🎹 button shows a red dot and the time. The loading options [`record`](#option-record) (`on`, `nomic` or `off`), `recfps`, `reclimit` and `title` set the defaults.
notes.zh: 在 🎹 面板裡，⏺ 不用寫程式就能開始和停止錄影，📷 把畫布存成 PNG（見 [`OAVp5.record.shot()`](#OAVp5.record.shot)）。錄影的時候，🎹 按鈕上會有紅點和時間。載入選項 [`record`](#option-record)（`on`、`nomic` 或 `off`）、`recfps`、`reclimit`、`title` 可以設定預設值。

notes.en: The microphone is in the take while it is on: wear headphones, or the speakers are recorded twice. p5.sound for p5 2.x connects each sound straight to the speakers, so it cannot be recorded (a card says so); use p5 1.11, or [`startSound()`](#startSound) and [`startDrums()`](#startDrums). Sound that your sketch makes with its own Tone.js or Web Audio code is not recorded either.
notes.zh: 麥克風開著的時候會錄進影片：請戴耳機，不然喇叭的聲音會被錄兩次。p5 2.x 用的 p5.sound 把每個聲音直接接到喇叭，沒辦法錄（卡片會說明），請改用 p5 1.11，或用 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 和 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)。草圖自己用 Tone.js 或 Web Audio 程式發出的聲音，同樣不會被錄進去。

notes.en: Whatever you draw on the canvas is in the video, so show hints only while [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) is false.
notes.zh: 畫在畫布上的東西都會進影片，所以提示文字只在 [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) 是 false 的時候畫。

caption.en: Press r: after five seconds an MP4 of the moving circle is downloaded, without the hint text.
caption.zh: 按 r：五秒後會下載一支圓在移動的 MP4，影片裡沒有那行提示文字。

caption.en: Click once so the browser allows sound, then press r to start and r again to stop: the file holds the picture, the drums and the notes you played.
caption.zh: 先點一下讓瀏覽器允許出聲，再按 r 開始、再按 r 停止：檔案裡有畫面、鼓聲和你彈的音。

caption.en: Press g: the video is 200 by 200, the buffer alone, not the 400 by 300 canvas.
caption.zh: 按 g：影片是 200 × 200，只有那個緩衝區，不是 400 × 300 的整張畫布。

summary.en: Stops the recording; the video is finished, downloaded, and handed to `recordingSaved(info)` and to the returned promise.
summary.zh: 停止錄影，影片完成後會下載，並交給 `recordingSaved(info)` 和回傳的 promise。

description.en: It ends a take that has no `seconds`, or ends one early. [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) turns `false` at once, while the file is made (`OAVp5.record.state` is `'saving'` until then), so the promise or [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) is how you know the file is ready. Both come after a fraction of a second, a little more for a long take.
description.zh: 用來結束沒有給 `seconds` 的錄影，或是提早結束。[`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) 馬上變成 `false`，檔案這時還在製作（`OAVp5.record.state` 在那之前是 `'saving'`），所以要用 promise 或 [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) 才知道檔案好了。兩者都在不到一秒之後，很長的一支會再久一點。

returns.en: Resolves, once the file is saved and checked, to the same `info` that [`recordingSaved(info)`](#recordingSaved) gets. Resolves to `null` at once when nothing is recording, or when the recording was still starting (nothing was recorded then).
returns.zh: 檔案存好、檢查完之後，resolve 成跟 [`recordingSaved(info)`](#recordingSaved) 拿到的同一份 `info`。沒有在錄、或錄影還在啟動中（那時還沒錄到東西）的時候，馬上 resolve 成 `null`。

caption.en: Press r to start and r to stop: once the file is ready the text names it.
caption.zh: 按 r 開始、再按 r 停止：檔案好了之後，文字會顯示它的檔名。

summary.en: The object behind the recording names: the state, the time, the last file, the formats this browser can write and the screenshot function.
summary.zh: 錄影相關名稱背後的物件：狀態、時間、最後一支檔案、這個瀏覽器能寫的格式，以及存圖的函式。

description.en: `OAVp5.record` (also reachable as `midi.record`) is what [`startRecording()`](#startRecording), [`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) and [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) are built on. It holds the [`state`](#OAVp5.record.state) of the recording, how many [`seconds`](#OAVp5.record.seconds) it has run, the [`last`](#OAVp5.record.last) file's `info`, the [`sources`](#OAVp5.record.sources) in the take, and the [`fps`](#OAVp5.record.fps) and [`limit`](#OAVp5.record.fps) in force. [`formats()`](#OAVp5.record.formats) says what the browser can write, [`shot()`](#OAVp5.record.shot) saves a PNG of the canvas and [`on()`](#OAVp5.record.on) listens to `'start'` and `'saved'`. `start` and `stop` are the same as the two global functions.
description.zh: `OAVp5.record`（也可以用 `midi.record` 取得）是 [`startRecording()`](#startRecording)、[`stopRecording()`](#stopRecording) 和 [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) 的底層。裡面有錄影的 [`state`](#OAVp5.record.state)、已經錄了多少 [`seconds`](#OAVp5.record.seconds)、[`last`](#OAVp5.record.last) 最後一支檔案的 `info`、這一支裡有哪些聲音來源 [`sources`](#OAVp5.record.sources)，以及生效的 [`fps`](#OAVp5.record.fps) 和 [`limit`](#OAVp5.record.fps)。[`formats()`](#OAVp5.record.formats) 說明瀏覽器能寫什麼格式，[`shot()`](#OAVp5.record.shot) 把畫布存成 PNG，[`on()`](#OAVp5.record.on) 監聽 `'start'` 和 `'saved'`。`start` 和 `stop` 跟那兩個全域函式一模一樣。

notes.en: For a sketch the global names are enough. This object is for tools, the console and debugging.
notes.zh: 一般草圖用全域名稱就夠了。這個物件是給工具、主控台和除錯用的。

caption.en: Three fields of the recording object; the state stays "off" until a take starts (press ⏺ in the 🎹 panel).
caption.zh: 錄影物件的三個欄位，開始錄影之前狀態一直是 "off"（可以按 🎹 面板裡的 ⏺ 試試）。

summary.en: Says what this browser can record: `{ recorder, mp4, webm, mime }`.
summary.zh: 告訴你這個瀏覽器能錄什麼：`{ recorder, mp4, webm, mime }`。

description.en: Use it before you offer a recording button, or to tell the person which file they will get: MP4 goes to Instagram and every editor, WebM does not. It asks the browser each time you call it.
description.zh: 在你要提供錄影按鈕之前用它，或是告訴使用的人會拿到哪種檔案：MP4 可以直接上傳 Instagram，也能放進所有剪輯軟體，WebM 不行。每次呼叫都會重新問一次瀏覽器。

returns.en: `recorder` is true when the browser has `MediaRecorder` at all, `mp4` and `webm` are true when it can write that format, and `mime` is the MIME type a recording asks for first (MP4 where possible), or `''` when none works.
returns.zh: `recorder` 表示瀏覽器到底有沒有 `MediaRecorder`，`mp4` 和 `webm` 表示能不能寫那種格式，`mime` 是錄影最先要求的 MIME 類型（可以的話是 MP4），都不行的話是 `''`。

caption.en: Shows what this browser can write: Chrome 126 and later and Safari say mp4 true.
caption.zh: 顯示這個瀏覽器能寫的格式：Chrome 126 之後的版本和 Safari 會顯示 mp4 為 true。

summary.en: The frame rate (`fps`) and the longest take in seconds (`limit`) that the loading options `recfps` and `reclimit` set.
summary.zh: 載入選項 `recfps` 和 `reclimit` 設定的錄影格率（`fps`）和一支影片最長的秒數（`limit`）。

description.en: They are there to read: `OAVp5.record.limit` tells a sketch how long a take can be. Writing to them changes nothing, because a take reads the options, not these two. To record at another frame rate once, pass `startRecording({ fps: 60 })`; to change the limit, set the `reclimit` option before oav-p5 loads (`window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: 600 }`).
description.zh: 它們是拿來讀的：`OAVp5.record.limit` 讓草圖知道一支影片最長能錄多久。對它們賦值沒有作用，因為錄影讀的是載入選項，不是這兩個值。想用別的格率錄一次，就傳 `startRecording({ fps: 60 })`，要改長度上限，在 oav-p5 載入之前設定 `reclimit` 選項（`window.OAV_P5 = { reclimit: 600 }`）。

value.en: `fps` is 30 and `limit` is 300 unless the options say otherwise (`fps` is kept between 1 and 60).
value.zh: `fps` 預設是 30，`limit` 預設是 300，除非載入選項另外設定（`fps` 會被限制在 1 到 60 之間）。

caption.en: Prints the two defaults: 30 frames a second and 300 seconds.
caption.zh: 印出兩個預設值：每秒 30 格、最長 300 秒。

summary.en: The `info` of the last recording that was saved (the same object `recordingSaved` got), or `null` before the first one.
summary.zh: 最近一支存好的錄影的 `info`（跟 `recordingSaved` 拿到的是同一個物件），第一支之前是 `null`。

description.en: Handy when you did not keep `info` in `recordingSaved()`: show the last file name, or put `OAVp5.record.last.url` in a link. The address stays valid until a minute after the next take is saved.
description.zh: 當你沒有在 `recordingSaved()` 裡把 `info` 存下來的時候很方便：顯示最後一支的檔名，或把 `OAVp5.record.last.url` 放進連結。這個位址會一直有效，直到下一支存好之後一分鐘。

value.en: Replaced each time a take is saved. See [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) for its fields.
value.zh: 每存好一支就換成新的。欄位見 [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved)。

caption.en: Press r: two seconds later the last file name appears; press again and it changes.
caption.zh: 按 r：兩秒後會顯示最近一支的檔名，再錄一次它就會換掉。

summary.en: Listens to the recording from anywhere: `OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn)` or `on('start', fn)`, and it returns a function that stops listening.
summary.zh: 在任何地方監聽錄影：`OAVp5.record.on('saved', fn)` 或 `on('start', fn)`，並回傳一個可以取消監聽的函式。

description.en: [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) is a single function that you define. `on()` is for the cases where that does not fit: several listeners, a library, a listener you want to remove again. It is the same idea as `OAVp5.drums.on()` and `midi.on()`. An error thrown inside `fn` is printed and the other listeners still run.
description.zh: [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) 是你定義的單一函式。`on()` 是給不適用的情況：好幾個監聽者、函式庫、或是想把監聽者再拿掉。概念跟 `OAVp5.drums.on()` 和 `midi.on()` 一樣。`fn` 裡丟出的錯誤會被印出來，其他監聽者照樣執行。

params.name: name
params.en: `'start'` (a take began) or `'saved'` (a file is saved, like [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved)). Any other name throws an error that lists the two.
params.zh: `'start'`（一支錄影開始了）或 `'saved'`（檔案存好了，跟 [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) 一樣）。其他的名字會丟出錯誤，並列出這兩個。

params.name: fn
params.en: For `'start'` it gets `{ width, height, fps, type, seconds }` (`seconds` is 0 when no length was asked for). For `'saved'` it gets the same `info` as [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved).
params.zh: `'start'` 拿到的是 `{ width, height, fps, type, seconds }`（沒指定長度的話 `seconds` 是 0）。`'saved'` 拿到的是跟 [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) 一樣的 `info`。

returns.en: A function: call it to stop listening.
returns.zh: 一個函式，呼叫它就停止監聽。

caption.en: Press r: the text reports the start (size and frame rate) and then the saved file name, from two listeners.
caption.zh: 按 r：文字先回報開始錄影（大小和格率），再回報存好的檔名，這是由兩個監聽者做的。

summary.en: How long the running take has been going, in seconds, and the length of the last take after it.
summary.zh: 正在錄的這一支已經錄了幾秒，錄完之後是那一支的長度。

description.en: Use it as a clock that starts with the take: `const t = recordingIsOn ? OAVp5.record.seconds : 0;` makes an animation that always begins at 0 in the video. It is the time since the recording began, not the time of the sketch, so it does not count the moment before `startRecording()`.
description.zh: 當成跟著這一支錄影一起開始的時鐘：`const t = recordingIsOn ? OAVp5.record.seconds : 0;` 做出來的動畫，在影片裡一定從 0 開始。它是錄影開始之後的時間，不是草圖的時間，所以不包含 `startRecording()` 之前的那段。

value.en: 0 at the start, then refreshed four times a second while recording. When the take is saved it is that take's length, and the next take sets it back to 0.
value.zh: 一開始是 0，錄影中每秒更新四次。檔案存好之後是那一支的長度，下一支開始的時候又歸零。

caption.en: Press r: the circle jumps to the left edge and slides right for four seconds, so the video always begins the same way.
caption.zh: 按 r：圓跳到最左邊，往右滑四秒，所以影片每次的開頭都一樣。

summary.en: Saves the canvas alone as a PNG picture (not the 🎹, not the cards) and downloads it.
summary.zh: 把畫布本身存成 PNG 圖片（不包含 🎹 和提示卡片）並下載。

description.en: It is the button 📷 in the 🎹 panel as a function. The file is named `oav-20261015-183005.png` (with `name` in the middle when you give one) and is downloaded at once; on a phone that can share files a Share button appears on a card instead. The picture has the size of the canvas in pixels, so a retina screen gives twice the width and height. p5's own `saveCanvas('name', 'png')` does the same thing without the card.
description.zh: 就是 🎹 面板裡 📷 按鈕的函式版。檔名像 `oav-20261015-183005.png`（有給 `name` 的話會放在中間），馬上下載，在能分享檔案的手機上，會改成在卡片上出現「分享」按鈕。圖片的大小就是畫布的像素大小，所以視網膜螢幕的寬和高會是兩倍。p5 自己的 `saveCanvas('name', 'png')` 做的是同一件事，只是沒有卡片。

params.name: o
params.en: Options: `canvas` (the canvas to save: a `<canvas>`, a p5 canvas or a `createGraphics()` buffer; the biggest p5 canvas on the page by default) and `name` (a word for the file name).
params.zh: 選項：`canvas`（要存的畫布：`<canvas>`、p5 畫布或 `createGraphics()` 的緩衝區，預設是頁面上最大的 p5 畫布）和 `name`（檔名裡的一個詞）。

returns.en: Resolves to `{ name, blob, url, width, height, bytes }`, or to `null` when there is no canvas or it cannot be read (an image from another site on it, no CORS).
returns.zh: resolve 成 `{ name, blob, url, width, height, bytes }`，找不到畫布、或畫布讀不出來（上面有別的網站來的圖片，沒有 CORS）的時候是 `null`。

notes.en: With the loading option `record=off` the 📷 button is gone and [`startRecording()`](#startRecording) does nothing, but this function still saves the PNG (tried).
notes.zh: 載入選項 `record=off` 的時候，📷 按鈕會消失，[`startRecording()`](#startRecording) 也什麼都不做，但這個函式仍然可以存 PNG（實際試過）。

caption.en: Move the circle with the mouse and press p: a PNG of the canvas is downloaded.
caption.zh: 用滑鼠移動圓，按 p：會下載一張畫布的 PNG。

summary.en: Which sounds the running take is hearing right now: a list of `'sound'`, `'drums'`, `'mic'` and `'p5sound'`; empty when no take runs.
summary.zh: 正在錄的這一支現在錄進了哪些聲音：由 `'sound'`、`'drums'`、`'mic'`、`'p5sound'` 組成的清單，沒在錄的時候是空的。

description.en: It is what the take has connected, not whether something is audible at this moment. A source that is switched on halfway joins the list within a quarter of a second. After the take, [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) gives the final list in `info.sources`.
description.zh: 它是這一支已經接上的來源，不是此刻有沒有聲音聽得到。錄到一半才打開的來源，會在四分之一秒內加進清單。錄完之後，最終的清單在 [`recordingSaved()`](#recordingSaved) 的 `info.sources` 裡。

value.en: A new list on every read. `'sound'` is the instrument of [`startSound()`](#startSound), `'drums'` the drum machine and the pads, `'mic'` the microphone, `'p5sound'` p5.sound 1.x.
value.zh: 每次讀都是一份新的清單。`'sound'` 是 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 的樂器，`'drums'` 是鼓機和打擊墊，`'mic'` 是麥克風，`'p5sound'` 是 p5.sound 1.x。

caption.en: Press r: the text lists what the take has connected, here the drum machine and the instrument.
caption.zh: 按 r：文字列出這一支接上了什麼，這裡是鼓機和樂器。

summary.en: Where the recording is: `'off'`, `'starting'`, `'on'` or `'saving'`.
summary.zh: 錄影現在在哪個階段：`'off'`、`'starting'`、`'on'` 或 `'saving'`。

description.en: [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) is `state === 'on'`. Read the state when the other stages matter: a button can show "starting…" and "saving…" and refuse a new take while one is being saved.
description.zh: [`recordingIsOn`](#recordingIsOn) 就是 `state === 'on'`。其他階段有影響的時候才需要讀它：按鈕可以顯示「啟動中……」和「儲存中……」，在檔案還在存的時候不接受新的一支。

value.en: Starts as `'off'`. A take goes `'starting'` (the recorder is loading, the first time), `'on'` (recording), `'saving'` (the file is being made) and back to `'off'`.
value.zh: 一開始是 `'off'`。一支錄影會依序是 `'starting'`（錄影程式載入中，第一次才會有）、`'on'`（錄影中）、`'saving'`（檔案製作中），然後回到 `'off'`。

caption.en: Press r: the word goes through starting, on and saving and comes back to the prompt; the key does nothing in between.
caption.zh: 按 r：文字依序經過 starting、on、saving，然後回到提示，中間再按 r 沒有作用。

summary.en: The audio MIME types the recorder tries for a sound-only file, best first: AAC in .m4a, then Opus.
summary.zh: 只錄聲音的檔案時，錄影器會依序嘗試的音訊 MIME 型別，最好的在前：先是 .m4a 的 AAC，再來是 Opus。

description.en: AAC in an `.m4a` file comes first because it imports into every DAW and editor. This is the list a [`Recorder`](#Recorder) with `audioOnly: true` uses, through [`pickMime()`](#pickMime).
description.zh: AAC 的 `.m4a` 檔排第一，因為它每個 DAW 和剪輯軟體都能匯入。`audioOnly: true` 的 [`Recorder`](#Recorder) 用的就是這份清單，透過 [`pickMime()`](#pickMime)。

value.en: A frozen list of 5 strings: `audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2`, `audio/webm;codecs=opus`, `audio/ogg;codecs=opus`, `audio/mp4`, `audio/webm`.
value.zh: 一份凍結的清單，有 5 個字串：`audio/mp4;codecs=mp4a.40.2`、`audio/webm;codecs=opus`、`audio/ogg;codecs=opus`、`audio/mp4`、`audio/webm`。

caption.en: Logs the best candidate for a sound file, and the one this browser would pick with its extension.
caption.zh: 印出聲音檔最好的候選，以及這個瀏覽器實際會挑的那一個和它的副檔名。

entries.name: AudioTap
entries.signature: new AudioTap({ context = null, sources = [], captureDestination = false } = {})

summary.en: Collects the sound of your work (and, if you add it, a microphone) into one recordable track, without sending anything to the speakers.
summary.zh: 把你的作品的聲音（以及你加進來的麥克風）收集成一條可以錄的音軌，不會把任何東西送到喇叭。

description.en: Recording the speakers with a microphone gives you the room. Tapping the Web Audio graph gives you the instrument exactly as it was synthesized, on the same clock as the canvas. An `AudioTap` has two buses and two outputs. The **work** bus is the sound of the piece; the **extra** bus is for things that belong in the video but not in the sound file, such as a microphone. `tap.stream` and `tap.tracks` are work and extras together (give them to the video [`Recorder`](#Recorder)); `tap.workStream` and `tap.workTracks` are the work alone (for the separate audio file). Both are a single track, on purpose: Chrome records only the first audio track of a stream.
description.zh: 用麥克風錄喇叭，錄到的是房間。接上 Web Audio 的節點圖，錄到的是樂器合成出來的原樣，而且跟畫布用同一個時鐘。`AudioTap` 有兩條匯流排和兩個輸出。**work** 匯流排是作品的聲音，**extra** 匯流排放的是該在影片裡、卻不該在聲音檔裡的東西，例如麥克風。`tap.stream` 和 `tap.tracks` 是 work 加 extra（交給影片的 [`Recorder`](#Recorder)），`tap.workStream` 和 `tap.workTracks` 只有 work（給另外存的聲音檔）。兩個都只有一條音軌，這是故意的：Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。

description.en: The tap never routes anything to the speakers, so adding a microphone cannot feed back. To record a sketch you did not write (p5.sound, Tone.js, [`Sound`](#Sound)), call `captureDestination()` **before** the work starts its sound: from then on every node that connects to a speaker destination is tapped too.
description.zh: 這個 tap 絕不會把東西送到喇叭，所以加麥克風不會產生回授。要錄不是你寫的草圖（p5.sound、Tone.js、[`Sound`](#Sound)），就在作品開始出聲**之前**呼叫 `captureDestination()`：從那時起，每個接到喇叭的節點也會被接進來。

params.name: context
params.en: The `AudioContext` to mix in, usually the work's own. One is made if you leave it out; it needs Web Audio to exist.
params.zh: 要在哪個 `AudioContext` 裡混音，通常是作品自己的。沒給的話會新建一個，需要瀏覽器有 Web Audio。

params.name: sources
params.en: Things to add to the work bus at once: `AudioNode`s, `MediaStream`s or `MediaStreamTrack`s (see `add()`).
params.zh: 要馬上加進作品匯流排的東西：`AudioNode`、`MediaStream` 或 `MediaStreamTrack`（見 `add()`）。

params.name: captureDestination
params.en: Also call `captureDestination()` right away.
params.zh: 同時馬上呼叫 `captureDestination()`。

needs.en: An `AudioContext` that is running. Browsers start audio only after a click, so call `tap.resume()` from a click handler. Without the click the tracks exist but carry silence.
needs.zh: 要有正在跑的 `AudioContext`。瀏覽器要點擊過才讓聲音開始，所以在點擊的處理函式裡呼叫 `tap.resume()`。沒有點擊的話，音軌雖然存在，裡面是靜音。

caption.en: A 440 Hz tone is tapped and the meter confirms that sound reaches the recording. The tracks are ready to hand to a Recorder.
caption.zh: 接上一個 440 Hz 的音，指示確認聲音有進到錄影裡。音軌已經可以交給 Recorder。

caption.en: A sound made in another AudioContext, connected to the speakers the usual way, is picked up by the tap too: this is how you record a sketch you did not write.
caption.zh: 另一個 AudioContext 裡的聲音，照平常接到喇叭，tap 也收得到：錄不是你寫的草圖就是這樣做。

members.name: stream
members.doc: Work + extras, one track: give it to the video Recorder.

members.name: workStream
members.doc: The work alone, one track: the separate audio file.

members.name: tracks
members.doc: `stream`'s audio tracks (one).

members.name: workTracks
members.doc: `workStream`'s audio tracks (one).

members.name: add
members.doc: Tap a source.

members.name: captureDestination
members.doc: From now on, every node that connects to an AudioDestinationNode (any context) is tapped too.

members.name: addMicrophone
members.signature: { deviceId = '', gain = 1, echoCancellation = false, noiseSuppression = false, autoGainControl = false } = {}
members.doc: Add a microphone (or any audio input) to the video's mix — not to the audio file.

members.name: removeMicrophone
members.doc: Take the microphone out of the mix (and stop it unless `stop: false`).

members.name: level
members.doc: Peak level of the mix right now, 0..1 — for a "sound is reaching the recording" meter.

members.name: resume
members.doc: Resume a suspended context (call from a click).

members.name: dispose
members.doc: Let go of everything the tap made (the context itself is left alone).

entries.name: cameraConstraints
entries.signature: cameraConstraints({ deviceId = '', width = 1920, height = 1080, fps = 30, facingMode = '' } = {})

summary.en: Builds the getUserMedia options for a camera: it asks for 1920 by 1080 at 30 fps, but only as an ideal, never as a demand.
summary.zh: 做出開鏡頭用的 getUserMedia 選項：它要求 1920 乘 1080、30 fps，但只是理想值，不是硬性要求。

description.en: Size and rate are `ideal`, never `exact`: a camera that cannot do 1920 by 1080 should open at what it can, not throw in front of an audience. It is pure, so you can look at what [`openCamera()`](#openCamera) will ask for. The stream has no audio: a microphone is added through [`AudioTap`](#AudioTap).
description.zh: 尺寸和畫格率是 `ideal`，不是 `exact`：做不到 1920 乘 1080 的鏡頭應該用它做得到的規格開起來，而不是在觀眾面前丟出錯誤。它是純函式，所以你可以看 [`openCamera()`](#openCamera) 會要求什麼。串流裡沒有聲音：麥克風要透過 [`AudioTap`](#AudioTap) 加。

params.name: deviceId
params.en: A specific camera, from [`listCameras()`](#listCameras). It is asked for as `exact`: if it is gone, opening fails.
params.zh: 指定哪一個鏡頭，來自 [`listCameras()`](#listCameras)。用 `exact` 要求：如果它不見了，就會開啟失敗。

params.name: width
params.en: The width to ask for, as `ideal`.
params.zh: 想要的寬，用 `ideal` 要求。

params.name: height
params.en: The height to ask for, as `ideal`.
params.zh: 想要的高，用 `ideal` 要求。

params.name: fps
params.en: The frame rate to ask for, as `ideal`.
params.zh: 想要的畫格率，用 `ideal` 要求。

params.name: facingMode
params.en: `'user'` or `'environment'` on a phone. Ignored when a `deviceId` is given.
params.zh: 手機上的 `'user'`（前鏡頭）或 `'environment'`（後鏡頭）。有給 `deviceId` 時會被忽略。

returns.en: A `MediaStreamConstraints`: `{ video: { width: { ideal }, height: { ideal }, frameRate: { ideal }, deviceId?, facingMode? }, audio: false }`.
returns.zh: 一個 `MediaStreamConstraints`：`{ video: { width: { ideal }, height: { ideal }, frameRate: { ideal }, deviceId?, facingMode? }, audio: false }`。

caption.en: The default request, and a request for one specific camera at 720p60.
caption.zh: 預設的要求，以及指定某一個鏡頭、要 720p60 的要求。

summary.en: Makes a copy of a signal value that is safe to write as JSON: rounded numbers, plain arrays, no functions, nothing too deep.
summary.zh: 做出一份訊號值的複本，可以安全地寫成 JSON：數字捨入、陣列變普通陣列、沒有函式、也不會太深。

description.en: The rules: numbers are rounded to 6 decimals, and `NaN` and infinities become `null`. Typed arrays become plain arrays. A `bigint` becomes a number. Objects and arrays are copied down to depth 4 and anything deeper becomes `null`. A function, symbol or `undefined` becomes `null` in an array and the key is dropped from an object. [`EventLog`](#EventLog) runs every value through it.
description.zh: 規則：數字捨入到小數第 6 位，`NaN` 和無限大變成 `null`。型別陣列變成普通陣列。`bigint` 變成數字。物件和陣列往下複製到第 4 層，再深的變成 `null`。函式、symbol 和 `undefined` 在陣列裡變成 `null`，在物件裡這個鍵會被丟掉。[`EventLog`](#EventLog) 把每個值都經過它。

params.name: v
params.en: The value to clean.
params.zh: 要整理的值。

params.name: depth
params.en: How deep we already are. Leave it out; it is used by the function calling itself.
params.zh: 目前已經到第幾層。不用給，是函式呼叫自己的時候用的。

returns.en: The cleaned copy.
returns.zh: 整理過的複本。

caption.en: A messy object goes in and plain data comes out: the number is rounded, the function key is gone, the typed array became a list.
caption.zh: 一個亂七八糟的物件進去，出來的是單純的資料：數字被捨入、函式的鍵不見了、型別陣列變成陣列。

entries.name: Compositor
entries.signature: new Compositor({ size = 'vertical-1080p', layout = 'stack', layoutOptions = {}, getWorkCanvas = null, background = '#000', mirrorCam = true, maxFps = 60, onDraw = null, canvas = null } = {})

summary.en: Draws your work and the performer's camera into one canvas of an exact size, every frame: the canvas that a Recorder records.
summary.zh: 每個畫面把你的作品和表演者的鏡頭畫進一張尺寸精確的畫布：這張畫布就是 Recorder 要錄的那張。

description.en: A performance video is two things in one picture: your work and the performer. The `Compositor` makes that picture. It owns a canvas (`comp.canvas`) of exactly the size of the file you want, whatever your window is, so a vertical 4K video from a laptop really is 4K. It is the canvas you hand to a [`Recorder`](#Recorder). To show it on the page as a preview, put `comp.canvas` in the DOM and shrink it with CSS.
description.zh: 表演影片是同一個畫面裡的兩件事：你的作品和表演者。`Compositor` 就是做這個畫面的。它擁有一張畫布（`comp.canvas`），大小就是你要的檔案大小，跟你的視窗多大無關，所以在筆電上錄的直式 4K 影片真的是 4K。把這張畫布交給 [`Recorder`](#Recorder)。要在頁面上預覽，就把 `comp.canvas` 放進 DOM，再用 CSS 縮小。

description.en: `comp.start()` redraws every animation frame (and, because a hidden tab freezes animation frames, from a Web Worker timer too, so a recording does not freeze with the tab). `comp.draw()` draws one frame now: call it yourself right after your work renders if you have your own loop. `comp.rects` is the last layout, `{ work, cam }` in output pixels, and `comp.fps` is the rate it has been drawing at.
description.zh: `comp.start()` 每個動畫畫面重畫一次（而且因為被藏起來的分頁會凍結動畫畫面，所以也用 Web Worker 的計時器畫，這樣錄影不會跟著分頁一起凍住）。`comp.draw()` 馬上畫一個畫面：如果你有自己的迴圈，就在作品畫完之後自己呼叫它。`comp.rects` 是最近一次的版面，`{ work, cam }`，單位是輸出的像素，`comp.fps` 是它實際畫的頻率。

description.en: The camera is optional and never owned: `setCamera(stream)` shows it and `setCamera(null)` lets go, and you stop the tracks yourself. The camera's area can show a **panel** instead, anything with `draw(ctx, rect, now)`, for example a drawing of the controller being played. The area for the camera is reserved before the camera arrives, so the picture does not jump.
description.zh: 鏡頭是選用的，而且合成器不擁有它：`setCamera(stream)` 顯示它，`setCamera(null)` 放手，音軌由你自己停。鏡頭的區域也可以改放一個**面板**，也就是任何有 `draw(ctx, rect, now)` 的東西，例如一張正在彈的控制器的圖。鏡頭的區域會在鏡頭來之前就先留好，所以畫面不會跳動。

params.name: size
params.en: The size of the output, which is the size of the file. A preset id from [`PRESETS`](#PRESETS) (`'vertical-4k'`), `'1080x1920'`, `[w, h]` or `{ w, h }`. Each side is rounded up to an even number. See [`resolveSize()`](#resolveSize).
params.zh: 輸出的尺寸，也就是檔案的尺寸。可以是 [`PRESETS`](#PRESETS) 的 id（`'vertical-4k'`）、`'1080x1920'`、`[w, h]` 或 `{ w, h }`。每一邊都會進位成偶數。見 [`resolveSize()`](#resolveSize)。

params.name: layout
params.en: Where the work and the camera go: `stack`, `pip`, `side` or `work` (see [`LAYOUTS`](#LAYOUTS)).
params.zh: 作品和鏡頭放在哪裡：`stack`、`pip`、`side`、`work`（見 [`LAYOUTS`](#LAYOUTS)）。

params.name: layoutOptions
params.en: Passed on to [`layoutRects()`](#layoutRects): `fit`, `camFit`, `camAnchor`, `minCam`, `split`, `pip`.
params.zh: 原封不動交給 [`layoutRects()`](#layoutRects)：`fit`、`camFit`、`camAnchor`、`minCam`、`split`、`pip`。

params.name: getWorkCanvas
params.en: Returns the canvas of your work, or `null`. It is asked every frame, because a p5 sketch may replace its canvas and a WebGL work may resize it. The compositor never owns the work.
params.zh: 回傳你的作品的畫布，或 `null`。每個畫面都會問一次，因為 p5 草圖可能換掉畫布，WebGL 作品可能改變大小。合成器從來不擁有作品。

params.name: background
params.en: The colour behind everything, any canvas colour string.
params.zh: 所有東西後面的顏色，任何畫布能用的顏色字串。

params.name: mirrorCam
params.en: Show the camera as a mirror, as performers expect. Keep it equal to the `mirror` of a hand tracker drawn on top.
params.zh: 把鏡頭顯示成鏡子，這是表演者習慣的樣子。要跟畫在上面的手部追蹤的 `mirror` 保持一樣。

params.name: maxFps
params.en: Draw at most this often when running. A 120 Hz display does not need 120 composites a second.
params.zh: 跑起來的時候最多這麼頻繁地畫。120 Hz 的螢幕不需要每秒合成 120 次。

params.name: onDraw
params.en: `onDraw(ctx, rects, comp)`, called after the work and the camera are drawn, to put an overlay on top. A context state is saved and restored around it. An error in it is warned about once and does not stop the recording.
params.zh: `onDraw(ctx, rects, comp)`，作品和鏡頭畫好之後呼叫，用來在最上面再蓋一層。呼叫前後會保存和還原繪圖狀態。裡面出錯只會警告一次，不會中斷錄影。

params.name: canvas
params.en: Draw into this canvas instead of making a new one. Its width and height are set to the output size.
params.zh: 畫進這張畫布，不另外做新的。它的寬高會被設成輸出的尺寸。

notes.en: A WebGL work: the compositor copies its canvas in the same animation frame it was drawn in, which works in Chrome. If you see black, create the WebGL context with `preserveDrawingBuffer: true`, or call `comp.draw()` right after your render and do not call `start()`.
notes.zh: WebGL 的作品：合成器會在作品畫完的同一個動畫畫面裡複製它的畫布，在 Chrome 上這樣就行。如果看到黑的，就用 `preserveDrawingBuffer: true` 建立 WebGL context，或在你渲染完之後馬上呼叫 `comp.draw()`，並且不要呼叫 `start()`。

notes.en: Webcams usually stop at 1080p30, so a 4K `stack` layout enlarges the camera about 1.6 times. The work above it stays sharp because it is drawn at the output size, as long as the work's own canvas is at least as large as its area.
notes.zh: 網路攝影機通常只到 1080p30，所以 4K 的 `stack` 版面會把鏡頭放大約 1.6 倍。上面的作品是照輸出尺寸畫的，只要作品自己的畫布至少跟它的區域一樣大，就會保持清楚。

notes.en: In a p5 sketch you do not need this: [`startRecording()`](#startRecording) records the canvas and its sound for you. The `Compositor` is for a page that records the work together with a camera.
notes.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡用不到這個：[`startRecording()`](#startRecording) 會替你錄畫布和它的聲音。`Compositor` 是給要把作品和鏡頭一起錄的頁面用的。

caption.en: A square work is drawn into a 540 by 960 frame: the work takes the top 540 pixels and 420 are kept for the camera. The result appears on the page as a small preview.
caption.zh: 把一個正方形的作品畫進 540 乘 960 的畫面：作品佔上面 540 像素，下面 420 像素留給鏡頭。結果以小預覽的樣子出現在頁面上。

caption.en: The animated canvas fills a 1080p frame with the camera in a corner. Allow the camera when the browser asks; the composite appears below the work.
caption.zh: 會動的畫布鋪滿 1080p 的畫面，鏡頭在一個角落。瀏覽器問的時候允許鏡頭。合成的結果會出現在作品下面。

caption.en: The work alone in a square frame, with a caption written over it by `onDraw`. The caption is part of the picture, so it is in the recording.
caption.zh: 作品單獨放在正方形畫面裡，上面由 `onDraw` 寫了一行字。這行字是畫面的一部分，所以會被錄進影片。

members.doc: The <video> the camera plays in (null without one) — e.g.

members.name: cameraSize

members.doc: Draw over the camera in the camera's own coordinates: `fn(ctx, w, h)` gets a context translated to where the WHOLE camera frame lands and clipped to the visible camera rect — the shape HandTracker / PoseTracker…

entries.name: EventLog
entries.signature: new EventLog({ now = defaultNow, filter = null, throttleMs = 0 } = {})

summary.en: Keeps a timestamped list of what happened during a take, such as notes and parameter changes, on the same clock as the recording.
summary.zh: 把一次錄影過程中發生的事，例如音符和參數變化，連同時間記成一份清單，用的是跟錄影同一個時鐘。

description.en: A video keeps the picture and the sound. The log keeps the **score** of the take: every note, pad hit and (throttled) hand position, in milliseconds from the moment recording started. With it a take can be re-rendered at another size, re-synced to a better audio take, or turned into MIDI later. Start it with the recorder's start time so event times line up with the video's first frame: `log.start(recorder.t0)`.
description.zh: 影片留下的是畫面和聲音。事件記錄留下的是這次錄影的**樂譜**：每個音符、每一下墊子、以及（有節流的）手的位置，從開始錄的那一刻算起的毫秒數。有了它，一段錄影之後可以用別的尺寸重新渲染、跟更好的聲音檔重新對齊，或轉成 MIDI。用錄影器的開始時間來開始它，事件時間才會跟影片的第一個畫面對齊：`log.start(recorder.t0)`。

description.en: `log.attach(signals)` logs every signal a [`Signals`](#Signals) bus publishes; pulses are always kept and continuous signals obey `throttleMs`. Or add events yourself with `log.add(name, value)`. Values are cleaned into plain JSON data by [`cleanValue()`](#cleanValue). `toJSON()` gives `{ format: 'openav-eventlog', version: 1, startedAt, durationMs, count, events }`, and `EventLog.fromJSON(json)` reads it back. `toTake()` turns the log into a MIDI take; [`TakeRecorder`](#TakeRecorder) is a log that does exactly that on `midi/*`.
description.zh: `log.attach(signals)` 會記下 [`Signals`](#Signals) 匯流排發布的每個訊號。脈衝一定會留，連續的訊號則受 `throttleMs` 限制。也可以自己用 `log.add(name, value)` 加事件。值會被 [`cleanValue()`](#cleanValue) 整理成單純的 JSON 資料。`toJSON()` 給 `{ format: 'openav-eventlog', version: 1, startedAt, durationMs, count, events }`，`EventLog.fromJSON(json)` 能讀回來。`toTake()` 把記錄轉成 MIDI 的 take，[`TakeRecorder`](#TakeRecorder) 就是在 `midi/*` 上剛好做這件事的記錄。

description.en: Properties: `events` is the list `[{ t, name, value }]` (`t` in ms, to a tenth), `t0` the clock time of t = 0, `startedAt` the wall-clock time (ISO text) and `durationMs` is `null` until `stop()`.
description.zh: 屬性：`events` 是 `[{ t, name, value }]` 的清單（`t` 是毫秒，精確到十分之一），`t0` 是 t = 0 的時鐘時間，`startedAt` 是真實時間（ISO 文字），`durationMs` 在 `stop()` 之前是 `null`。

params.name: now
params.en: The clock, in milliseconds. The default is the same clock as `Recorder.t0`. Pass your own in a test.
params.zh: 時鐘，單位是毫秒。預設跟 `Recorder.t0` 是同一個時鐘。測試時傳自己的。

params.name: filter
params.en: `filter(name, value, meta)`, returns whether to keep an event. It applies to `add()` too.
params.zh: `filter(name, value, meta)`，回傳要不要留下這個事件。`add()` 也適用。

params.name: throttleMs
params.en: For continuous signals: keep at most one event per name in this many milliseconds. Pulses (note on, note off…) are never throttled.
params.zh: 對連續的訊號：每個名字在這麼多毫秒內最多留一個事件。脈衝（音符開、音符關…）永遠不會被節流。

caption.en: A take of half a second on a clock moved by hand: a note at 100 ms, a marker at 200 ms. After `stop()` nothing more is accepted.
caption.zh: 用手動撥動的時鐘錄半秒：100 毫秒一個音符，200 毫秒一個標記。`stop()` 之後就不再收任何事件。

caption.en: A bus is attached: the note pulse is kept, and ten changes of a continuous signal in a few milliseconds become one event. The log survives a round trip through JSON.
caption.zh: 接上一個匯流排：音符脈衝被留下，連續訊號在幾毫秒內的十次變化只剩一個事件。記錄經過 JSON 來回之後依然完整。

members.name: start
members.doc: Start a take: clears the log.

members.name: stop
members.doc: End the take; later events are ignored.

members.name: add
members.signature: name, value = null, { at = this.now(), pulse = true, meta } = {}
members.doc: Log one event.

members.name: mark
members.doc: A labelled marker ("chorus", "take 2 starts here") — shows up as name 'mark'.

members.name: attach
members.doc: Log every signal a `Signals` registry publishes (`signals.onAny`).

members.name: detach
members.doc: Detach from every registry.

members.name: between
members.doc: Events with start ≤ t < end (ms).

members.name: toTake
members.doc: A take is an EventLog filtered to midi/* — TakeRecorder is exactly that.

members.name: fromJSON
members.doc: Rebuild a (stopped) log from toJSON() output or its string.

summary.en: Gives the file extension for a recorded MIME type: video/mp4 is 'mp4', audio/mp4 is 'm4a', anything unknown is 'bin'.
summary.zh: 給一個錄好的 MIME 型別該用的副檔名：video/mp4 是 'mp4'，audio/mp4 是 'm4a'，不認識的是 'bin'。

description.en: A [`Recorder`](#Recorder) puts this in the `ext` of its result. Use it for a download name: `'take.' + extFor(blob.type)`.
description.zh: [`Recorder`](#Recorder) 把它放進結果的 `ext`。拿來取下載檔名：`'take.' + extFor(blob.type)`。

params.name: mime
params.en: A MIME type, with or without codecs, in any letter case. Anything that is not text counts as empty.
params.zh: MIME 型別，有沒有 codecs 都行，大小寫不拘。不是文字的東西當作空字串。

returns.en: `mp4`, `m4a` (audio/mp4), `webm`, `ogg`, `mkv` (video/x-matroska) or `bin`.
returns.zh: `mp4`、`m4a`（audio/mp4）、`webm`、`ogg`、`mkv`（video/x-matroska）或 `bin`。

examples.code:
import { extFor } from '@openav/record';

console.log(extFor('video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2'));   // mp4
console.log(extFor('audio/mp4'), extFor('audio/webm'));           // m4a webm
console.log(extFor('video/x-matroska'), extFor('text/plain'));    // mkv bin

caption.en: Five MIME types and the extension each one gets.
caption.zh: 五個 MIME 型別，和各自拿到的副檔名。

summary.en: Turns a point in the camera's own 0..1 coordinates, like a hand landmark, into a pixel in the output frame.
summary.zh: 把鏡頭自己的 0..1 座標裡的一個點，像手的關節點，換成輸出畫面裡的像素。

description.en: Landmarks from a hand or pose tracker come as fractions of the camera picture. To draw something on the output at the place a landmark is, you need pixels of the output, where the camera may be enlarged and cropped. `framePoint()` does that. It gives the same point whether or not part of the camera is cropped away, because it uses `frame`, the whole camera picture placed in the output. Use the same `mirror` in the tracker and in the compositor.
description.zh: 手部或姿態追蹤給的關節點是鏡頭畫面的比例。要在輸出上、關節點所在的位置畫東西，需要的是輸出畫面的像素，而鏡頭可能被放大和裁切。`framePoint()` 就是做這件事。不管鏡頭有沒有被裁掉一部分，它給的點都是對的，因為它用的是 `frame`，也就是整個鏡頭畫面放進輸出之後的位置。追蹤器和合成器要用同樣的 `mirror`。

params.name: camRect
params.en: The `cam` of [`layoutRects()`](#layoutRects), or of `compositor.rects`.
params.zh: [`layoutRects()`](#layoutRects) 的 `cam`，或 `compositor.rects` 的 `cam`。

params.name: u
params.en: Across the camera picture, 0 left to 1 right, in the displayed (mirrored if `mirrorCam`) orientation.
params.zh: 橫跨鏡頭畫面，0 是左、1 是右，用顯示出來的方向（有 `mirrorCam` 就是鏡像後的）。

params.name: v
params.en: Down the camera picture, 0 top to 1 bottom.
params.zh: 沿著鏡頭畫面往下，0 是上、1 是下。

returns.en: `{ x, y }` in output pixels, or `null` when there is no camera (or its size is not known yet).
returns.zh: 輸出像素的 `{ x, y }`，沒有鏡頭（或還不知道它的尺寸）就是 `null`。

caption.en: The centre of the camera lands in the middle of its area. The camera's left edge is outside the frame because the 16:9 picture is cropped to fit.
caption.zh: 鏡頭的中心落在它的區域中間。鏡頭的左邊緣在畫面外面，因為 16:9 的畫面為了塞進去被裁掉了。

summary.en: Reads a Standard MIDI File into a take whose events are the signals a keyboard playing that file would publish.
summary.zh: 把標準 MIDI 檔讀成 take，裡面的事件就是鍵盤彈這個檔案時會發布的訊號。

description.en: It reads type 0 and type 1 files (the tracks are merged), running status, tempo changes and SMPTE time division; system exclusive messages are skipped. A file that is not a MIDI file throws a `TypeError` (`fromMidiFile: not a MIDI file (no MThd)`), and one that ends early a `RangeError`. Play the result into a show with [`TakePlayer`](#TakePlayer): it drives a work like someone playing the file on a keyboard.
description.zh: 它讀 type 0 和 type 1 的檔案（音軌會合併）、running status、速度變化，和 SMPTE 時間單位。系統專用訊息會被略過。不是 MIDI 的檔案會丟出 `TypeError`（`fromMidiFile: not a MIDI file (no MThd)`），中途結束的檔案會丟出 `RangeError`。用 [`TakePlayer`](#TakePlayer) 把結果播進演出：它驅動作品的方式，就像有人在鍵盤上彈這個檔案。

params.name: bytes
params.en: The bytes of the `.mid` file, for example `await file.arrayBuffer()`.
params.zh: `.mid` 檔的位元組，例如 `await file.arrayBuffer()`。

params.name: name
params.en: The name of the take. Left out, it is the track name in the file, then `'take'`.
params.zh: take 的名字。沒給的話用檔案裡的音軌名稱，再沒有就是 `'take'`。

params.name: families
params.en: Which signal spellings to produce, as in [`signalsOfMidi()`](#signalsOfMidi). The default is both, like hardware.
params.zh: 要產生哪幾種訊號寫法，跟 [`signalsOfMidi()`](#signalsOfMidi) 一樣。預設兩種都有，就像硬體。

returns.en: A take. `meta.bpm` is the first tempo in the file (not set for SMPTE time).
returns.zh: 一個 take。`meta.bpm` 是檔案裡第一個速度（SMPTE 時間的檔案不設）。

caption.en: A round trip: the two notes come back as four events (both spellings), or two with `families: 'legacy'`. Bytes that are not a MIDI file are refused.
caption.zh: 來回一趟：兩個音符變回四個事件（兩種寫法），用 `families: 'legacy'` 則是兩個。不是 MIDI 檔的位元組會被拒絕。

summary.en: Works out where the work and the camera go in an output frame, in whole pixels, for one of the four layouts.
summary.zh: 算出作品和鏡頭在輸出畫面的哪裡，單位是整數像素，支援四種版面。

description.en: It is pure arithmetic: no DOM, no clock. The [`Compositor`](#Compositor) calls it whenever a size changes. A 1080 by 1920 frame with a square work and `stack` splits into exactly 1080 by 1080 and 1080 by 840, with no seam row. The crop of a camera is in the **displayed** orientation, so with the mirror on, an anchor of `x: 0.2` still means "keep the left of what you see".
description.zh: 這是純算術：沒有 DOM、沒有時鐘。[`Compositor`](#Compositor) 在尺寸改變時就呼叫它。1080 乘 1920 的畫面放一個正方形的作品、用 `stack`，會剛好切成 1080 乘 1080 和 1080 乘 840，中間沒有縫。鏡頭的裁切是用**顯示出來的**方向表示的，所以開了鏡像之後，`x: 0.2` 的錨點仍然是「保留你看到的畫面的左邊」。

description.en: `stack` puts the work across the full width at the top and the camera below. If that would leave the camera under `minCam` of the height (a square or landscape frame), the work gets `split` of the height and is letterboxed in it. `side` is the same turned sideways. `pip` fills the frame with the work and puts the camera in a corner as a rounded inset. `work` is the work alone.
description.zh: `stack` 把作品橫跨整個寬度放在上面，鏡頭在下面。如果這樣留給鏡頭的高度不到 `minCam`（正方形或橫式畫面），作品就只佔高度的 `split`，並且在裡面留黑邊。`side` 是同樣的做法轉九十度。`pip` 讓作品鋪滿畫面，把鏡頭放在角落當圓角小視窗。`work` 只有作品。

params.name: layout
params.en: One of [`LAYOUTS`](#LAYOUTS). Any other name throws a `TypeError`.
params.zh: [`LAYOUTS`](#LAYOUTS) 其中之一。其他名字會丟出 `TypeError`。

params.name: out
params.en: The output size `{ w, h }` in pixels. It must be positive, or this throws.
params.zh: 輸出尺寸 `{ w, h }`，單位是像素。必須是正數，否則會丟出錯誤。

params.name: src
params.en: The sizes of the sources: `{ workW, workH, camW, camH }`. A missing or zero value means unknown. An unknown work counts as square. With an unknown camera the camera's area is still reserved, with `crop: null` and `frame: null`, so the frame does not jump when the camera arrives.
params.zh: 來源的尺寸：`{ workW, workH, camW, camH }`。沒給或是 0 就表示不知道。不知道尺寸的作品當作正方形。鏡頭尺寸不知道時，鏡頭的區域還是會先留好，`crop: null`、`frame: null`，所以鏡頭來的時候畫面不會跳動。

params.name: opts
params.en: Options: `fit` (`'contain'` default, or `'cover'`, for the work), `camFit` (`'cover'` default, or `'contain'`), `camAnchor` (`{ x, y }`, 0..1, default the middle: which part a cover-crop keeps, in what you see), `minCam` (0.2: the share of the height in `stack`, or of the width in `side`, that the camera must keep), `split` (0.6: the work's share when it would leave the camera less than `minCam`) and `pip` (`{ corner: 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl', size: 0.3, margin: 0.03, radius: 0.08, aspect: 0 }`: the inset's width as a share of the frame, its distance from the corner as a share of the short side, its corner radius as a share of the inset's short side, and its shape, 0 being the camera's own).
params.zh: 選項：`fit`（作品，預設 `'contain'`，或 `'cover'`）、`camFit`（預設 `'cover'`，或 `'contain'`）、`camAnchor`（`{ x, y }`，0..1，預設在中間：滿版裁切時保留哪一部分，是你看到的畫面裡的位置）、`minCam`（0.2：`stack` 裡鏡頭至少要留的高度比例，`side` 裡是寬度比例）、`split`（0.6：留給鏡頭的比 `minCam` 還少時，作品佔的比例）、`pip`（`{ corner: 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl', size: 0.3, margin: 0.03, radius: 0.08, aspect: 0 }`：小視窗寬度佔畫面的比例、離角落的距離佔短邊的比例、圓角半徑佔小視窗短邊的比例，以及形狀，0 表示用鏡頭自己的比例）。

returns.en: `{ layout, out, work, cam }`. `work` and `cam` are `{ x, y, w, h, crop, frame, box }` in output pixels (all whole numbers), and `cam` also has `radius`. `crop` is the part of the source that is drawn (source pixels, may be fractional) or `null` for the whole source. `frame` is where the whole source frame would land, cropped parts falling outside the rect, which is what overlays need. `box` is the area it was placed in. `cam` is `null` for the `work` layout.
returns.zh: `{ layout, out, work, cam }`。`work` 和 `cam` 是輸出像素的 `{ x, y, w, h, crop, frame, box }`（全是整數），`cam` 還多一個 `radius`。`crop` 是來源被畫出來的那一塊（來源像素，可以有小數），整張都畫就是 `null`。`frame` 是整個來源畫面會落在哪裡，被裁掉的部分在矩形外面，疊圖需要它。`box` 是它被放進的區域。`work` 版面的 `cam` 是 `null`。

caption.en: A square work and a 16:9 camera in a vertical frame: the work is the top 1080 pixels, the camera fills the 840 below it with a middle crop.
caption.zh: 直式畫面裡放正方形的作品和 16:9 的鏡頭：作品是上面 1080 像素，鏡頭用中間的裁切填滿它下面的 840。

caption.en: A picture-in-picture in the top-left corner, the reserved camera area before a camera exists, and the error for a layout that does not exist.
caption.zh: 左上角的子母畫面、鏡頭還不存在時先留好的鏡頭區域，以及不存在的版面會得到的錯誤。

summary.en: The four layout names, in picker order: `'stack'`, `'pip'`, `'side'`, `'work'`.
summary.zh: 四種版面的名字，照選單的順序：`'stack'`、`'pip'`、`'side'`、`'work'`。

description.en: `stack`: the work across the full width at the top, the camera fills the rest below (for vertical video: Reels, Shorts, TikTok). `pip`: the work fills the frame and the camera is a rounded inset in a corner (for square frames, or a work that needs all of the frame). `side`: the work at full height on the left, the camera fills the right (landscape). `work`: the work alone. [`layoutRects()`](#layoutRects) says exactly where everything lands, and the `layout` option of the [`Compositor`](#Compositor) takes one of these names; any other name throws.
description.zh: `stack`：作品橫跨整個寬度放在上面，鏡頭填滿下面剩下的（給直式影片：Reels、Shorts、TikTok）。`pip`：作品鋪滿畫面，鏡頭是角落的圓角小視窗（給正方形畫面，或需要整個畫面的作品）。`side`：作品佔滿左邊的整個高度，鏡頭填滿右邊（橫式）。`work`：只有作品。確切的位置由 [`layoutRects()`](#layoutRects) 算出，[`Compositor`](#Compositor) 的 `layout` 選項收的就是這幾個名字，其他名字會丟出錯誤。

value.en: `['stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work']`, a frozen-by-convention list (do not change it).
value.zh: `['stack', 'pip', 'side', 'work']`，一份約定不要修改的清單。

caption.en: Runs the four layouts on one vertical frame with a square work and a 16:9 camera, and logs the size of each area.
caption.zh: 在同一個直式畫面上，用正方形的作品和 16:9 的鏡頭跑過四種版面，印出每個區域的大小。

summary.en: Lists the video inputs of this computer as { deviceId, groupId, label }.
summary.zh: 列出這台電腦的影像輸入，格式是 { deviceId, groupId, label }。

description.en: Browsers hide the labels (and sometimes the ids) until the page has had camera permission once, so call it again after [`openCamera()`](#openCamera) to get the real names. Needs `https` or `localhost`: elsewhere there is no `navigator.mediaDevices` and the promise rejects.
description.zh: 瀏覽器在頁面拿到過一次鏡頭權限之前，會隱藏名字（有時連 id 也是），所以在 [`openCamera()`](#openCamera) 之後再呼叫一次，才會拿到真正的名字。需要 `https` 或 `localhost`：其他地方沒有 `navigator.mediaDevices`，promise 會被 reject。

returns.en: A promise of a list of `{ deviceId, groupId, label }`. A device without a label is called `Camera 1`, `Camera 2`… by its position.
returns.zh: 一個 promise，內容是 `{ deviceId, groupId, label }` 的清單。沒有名字的裝置會依位置叫作 `Camera 1`、`Camera 2`…。

caption.en: Lists the cameras before and after permission is given; the second list has the real names. Stop the tracks when you are done.
caption.zh: 在拿到權限之前和之後各列一次鏡頭。第二次的清單有真正的名字。用完之後要把音軌停掉。

summary.en: Lists the audio inputs of this computer as { deviceId, groupId, label }.
summary.zh: 列出這台電腦的音訊輸入，格式是 { deviceId, groupId, label }。

description.en: The same as [`listCameras()`](#listCameras) for audio, with the same rule about labels: they are generic until the page has had microphone permission once. Pass a `deviceId` to [`AudioTap.addMicrophone()`](#AudioTap) to use one.
description.zh: 跟 [`listCameras()`](#listCameras) 一樣，只是列的是音訊，名字的規則也一樣：頁面拿到過一次麥克風權限之前，名字都是通用的。把 `deviceId` 交給 [`AudioTap.addMicrophone()`](#AudioTap) 就能使用其中一個。

returns.en: A promise of a list of `{ deviceId, groupId, label }`. A device without a label is called `Microphone 1`, `Microphone 2`… by its position.
returns.zh: 一個 promise，內容是 `{ deviceId, groupId, label }` 的清單。沒有名字的裝置會依位置叫作 `Microphone 1`、`Microphone 2`…。

caption.en: Lists the audio inputs and shows the shape of one item.
caption.zh: 列出音訊輸入，並顯示其中一項的形狀。

summary.en: Reads a take as plain MIDI events (note on and off, controllers, pitch bend), picking one naming family so nothing is counted twice.
summary.zh: 把一個 take 讀成單純的 MIDI 事件（音符開關、控制器、彎音），只選一種名稱寫法，所以不會重複算。

description.en: A take made on hardware holds the same note several times, under several names. This picks one family for the notes: `midi/note/*` if present, else `midi/ch/*`, else one device's `midi/<device>/note/*`, else raw `midi/virtual` bytes. Controllers and pitch bend come from `midi/ch/*` if present, else the classic names (as channel 1), else one device's. [`toMidiFile()`](#toMidiFile) and [`takeStats()`](#takeStats) are built on it.
description.zh: 在硬體上錄的 take，同一個音會用好幾個名字記好幾次。這裡替音符選一種寫法：有 `midi/note/*` 就用它，沒有就用 `midi/ch/*`，再沒有就用某一個裝置的 `midi/<device>/note/*`，最後是 `midi/virtual` 的原始位元組。控制器和彎音：有 `midi/ch/*` 就用，沒有就用傳統名稱（當作頻道 1），再沒有就用某一個裝置的。[`toMidiFile()`](#toMidiFile) 和 [`takeStats()`](#takeStats) 都是建立在它上面。

params.name: take
params.en: The take.
params.zh: 這個 take。

returns.en: A list in the shape of `@openav/midi`: `{ t, type: 'noteon', ch, note, vel }`, `noteoff`, `{ t, type: 'cc', ch, cc, value }`, `{ t, type: 'pitchbend', ch, value }` (0..16383), `chanat` and `polyat`. `vel` and `value` are 0..127.
returns.zh: `@openav/midi` 的格式：`{ t, type: 'noteon', ch, note, vel }`、`noteoff`、`{ t, type: 'cc', ch, cc, value }`、`{ t, type: 'pitchbend', ch, value }`（0..16383）、`chanat`、`polyat`。`vel` 和 `value` 是 0..127。

caption.en: Four recorded events are one key pressed and released, spelled twice; the result has just the two MIDI events.
caption.zh: 四個錄下來的事件其實是一個鍵按下又放開，寫了兩次。結果只有兩個 MIDI 事件。

summary.en: Mixes several audio tracks into one, because Chrome records only the first audio track of a stream.
summary.zh: 把好幾條音軌混成一條，因為 Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。

description.en: A [`Recorder`](#Recorder) calls this itself when you give it more than one live audio track, and closes the mix on `stop()`. Call it yourself when you want the one track for something else. It makes an `AudioContext`, so the page needs to have had a click. For several sounds that come from Web Audio nodes, [`AudioTap`](#AudioTap) is the better tool: it mixes them without a detour through streams.
description.zh: 你給 [`Recorder`](#Recorder) 超過一條活著的音軌時，它會自己呼叫這個，並在 `stop()` 時關掉混音。想把那一條音軌拿去做別的事時，才自己呼叫。它會建一個 `AudioContext`，所以頁面需要先被點過一次。如果聲音是來自 Web Audio 節點，用 [`AudioTap`](#AudioTap) 比較好：它直接混，不用繞一圈串流。

params.name: tracks
params.en: The audio tracks to mix.
params.zh: 要混的音軌。

returns.en: `{ track, close() }`: the one mixed `MediaStreamTrack`, and a function that closes the `AudioContext` that mixes it.
returns.zh: `{ track, close() }`：混好的那一條 `MediaStreamTrack`，以及關掉混音用的 `AudioContext` 的函式。

caption.en: Two audio tracks go in and one live audio track comes out; `close()` shuts the mixer down.
caption.zh: 兩條音軌進去，出來一條活的音軌。`close()` 把混音器關掉。

summary.en: Turns anything take-shaped, or its JSON text, into a valid take: events sorted by time, bad events dropped, nothing negative.
summary.zh: 把任何長得像 take 的東西，或它的 JSON 文字，整理成合格的 take：事件依時間排序、壞事件丟掉、沒有負數。

description.en: A take is what an [`EventLog`](#EventLog) filtered to `midi/*` records, as plain data: `t` is milliseconds from the start, `name` is a signal name such as `midi/note/on`, `value` is its payload, and `meta` holds free fields like `{ bpm, device, notes }`. `normalizeTake()` makes any input safe: events that are not objects, have no name or have a `t` that is not a number are dropped; `t` is rounded to a tenth of a millisecond and held at 0 or more; the events are sorted by `t` (events with equal times keep their order); `name` defaults to `'take'`; `durationMs` is at least the time of the last event. A new object is returned.
description.zh: take 就是過濾成 `midi/*` 的 [`EventLog`](#EventLog) 記下的東西，是單純的資料：`t` 是從開始算起的毫秒數，`name` 是訊號名稱，像 `midi/note/on`，`value` 是它的內容，`meta` 放自由欄位，像 `{ bpm, device, notes }`。`normalizeTake()` 讓任何輸入都變安全：不是物件、沒有名字、`t` 不是數字的事件會被丟掉，`t` 捨入到十分之一毫秒並限制在 0 以上，事件依 `t` 排序（時間一樣的保持原來的順序），`name` 預設是 `'take'`，`durationMs` 至少是最後一個事件的時間。回傳的是新物件。

description.en: Every function in this package that takes a take runs it through here first, so you can pass raw data.
description.zh: 這個套件裡每個收 take 的函式，都會先把它送進這裡處理，所以你可以直接傳原始資料。

params.name: input
params.en: A take, or its JSON text. A string is parsed with `JSON.parse`. Anything that is not an object throws a `TypeError`.
params.zh: 一個 take，或它的 JSON 文字。字串會用 `JSON.parse` 解析。不是物件的東西會丟出 `TypeError`。

returns.en: A new take: `{ v: 1, name, createdAt, durationMs, events: [{ t, name, value }], meta }`.
returns.zh: 一個新的 take：`{ v: 1, name, createdAt, durationMs, events: [{ t, name, value }], meta }`。

caption.en: Three of the five events are junk and go; the rest are sorted, and the length grows to cover the last event.
caption.zh: 五個事件裡三個是垃圾，會被丟掉。剩下的排好序，長度也被拉長到涵蓋最後一個事件。

summary.en: Tells whether a recorded event is a key going down or up, whatever its spelling, and which note on which channel.
summary.zh: 告訴你一個錄下來的事件是不是鍵按下去或放開，不管它用哪一種寫法，以及是哪個頻道的哪個音。

description.en: A hardware keyboard publishes the same note under several names, and this function knows them all: `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off` (family `legacy`, with `value: { note, vel, ch }`), `midi/ch/<ch>/note/<note>` (family `channel`, a number, 0 for off), `midi/<device>/note/on|off` (family `slug:<device>`) and raw bytes on `midi/virtual` (family `virtual`, `{ data: [status, note, vel] }`). A key-down with velocity 0 in raw bytes counts as off. A channel of 0, as the on-screen piano says, counts as channel 1.
description.zh: 硬體鍵盤會把同一個音符用好幾種名字發布，這個函式全部認得：`midi/note/on` 和 `midi/note/off`（寫法 `legacy`，內容是 `{ note, vel, ch }`）、`midi/ch/<ch>/note/<note>`（寫法 `channel`，是數字，0 表示放開）、`midi/<device>/note/on|off`（寫法 `slug:<device>`），以及 `midi/virtual` 上的原始位元組（寫法 `virtual`，`{ data: [status, note, vel] }`）。原始位元組裡力度是 0 的按下算放開。頻道是 0 的（螢幕鋼琴會這樣）當作頻道 1。

params.name: ev
params.en: An event `{ name, value }` of a take.
params.zh: take 的一個事件 `{ name, value }`。

returns.en: `{ key, on, note, ch, family, vel }`, or `null` if it is not a note event. `key` is `'<ch>:<note>'`, `on` is true for a key-down, `family` says which spelling it came in, `vel` is 0..127.
returns.zh: `{ key, on, note, ch, family, vel }`，不是音符事件就是 `null`。`key` 是 `'<ch>:<note>'`，`on` 是 true 表示按下，`family` 說明它用哪一種寫法，`vel` 是 0..127。

caption.en: The same key in three spellings, and a controller that is not a note.
caption.zh: 同一個鍵的三種寫法，和一個不是音符的控制器。

summary.en: Gives the events that release a sounding note, in the same spelling it was played in.
summary.zh: 給出能放開一個正在響的音的事件，用的是它當初被彈出來的那種寫法。

description.en: This is how a [`TakePlayer`](#TakePlayer) and a [`TakeRecorder`](#TakeRecorder) make sure no note is left sounding: for `legacy` it is `midi/note/off`, for `channel` it is `midi/ch/<ch>/note/<note>` with 0, for `virtual` it is a raw note-off byte triple, for a device family `midi/<device>/note/off`.
description.zh: [`TakePlayer`](#TakePlayer) 和 [`TakeRecorder`](#TakeRecorder) 就是這樣確保沒有音一直響著：`legacy` 是 `midi/note/off`，`channel` 是值為 0 的 `midi/ch/<ch>/note/<note>`，`virtual` 是原始的放開位元組，裝置寫法則是 `midi/<device>/note/off`。

params.name: n
params.en: The result of [`noteOf()`](#noteOf): `{ note, ch, family }`.
params.zh: [`noteOf()`](#noteOf) 的結果：`{ note, ch, family }`。

returns.en: A list of `{ name, value }` events (one, or none for an unknown family).
returns.zh: `{ name, value }` 事件的清單（一個，不認得的寫法則是空的）。

caption.en: The release of the same key depends on how it was played: the per-channel spelling releases with a zero, the classic one with a note-off.
caption.zh: 同一個鍵怎麼放開要看它當初怎麼彈：每頻道的寫法用 0 放開，傳統的用 note-off。

summary.en: Opens a camera and returns its MediaStream: ideally 1920 by 1080 at 30 fps, or whatever the camera can do.
summary.zh: 開啟鏡頭並回傳它的 MediaStream：理想是 1920 乘 1080、30 fps，不行就用鏡頭做得到的。

description.en: Give the stream to [`Compositor.setCamera()`](#Compositor). The caller owns the stream: stop its tracks when you are done, the compositor never does. Webcams usually top out at 1080p30, so a 4K frame enlarges the camera; the work above it stays sharp. It needs `https` or `localhost`, and the user's permission.
description.zh: 把串流交給 [`Compositor.setCamera()`](#Compositor)。串流由呼叫的人擁有：用完要自己把音軌停掉，合成器不會做。網路攝影機通常最多到 1080p30，所以 4K 的畫面會把鏡頭放大，上面的作品仍然清楚。需要 `https` 或 `localhost`，以及使用者許可。

params.name: opts
params.en: The options of [`cameraConstraints()`](#cameraConstraints): `{ deviceId, width, height, fps, facingMode }`.
params.zh: [`cameraConstraints()`](#cameraConstraints) 的選項：`{ deviceId, width, height, fps, facingMode }`。

returns.en: A promise of the stream, with one video track and no audio. It rejects with the browser's error when permission is refused or the camera is missing.
returns.zh: 串流的 promise，有一條影像軌，沒有聲音。權限被拒或沒有鏡頭時會用瀏覽器的錯誤 reject。

caption.en: Allow the camera and a small live picture of it appears on the page.
caption.zh: 允許鏡頭之後，頁面上會出現一個小小的即時畫面。

entries.name: pickMime
entries.signature: pickMime(isTypeSupported, { audioOnly = false, prefer = null, candidates = null } = {})

summary.en: Picks the first MIME type from a list that the browser can record, using the browser's own check.
summary.zh: 用瀏覽器自己的檢查，從清單裡挑出第一個瀏覽器錄得了的 MIME 型別。

description.en: A [`Recorder`](#Recorder) calls this for you. It takes the browser's check as an argument so that it is pure and can be tried with a fake one, like the examples below.
description.zh: [`Recorder`](#Recorder) 會替你呼叫它。它把瀏覽器的檢查當成參數傳進來，所以是純函式，可以像下面的範例那樣用假的檢查來試。

params.name: isTypeSupported
params.en: The browser's check, for example `(m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m)`. Not a function gives `''`. A check that throws counts as "no" for that type.
params.zh: 瀏覽器的檢查函式，例如 `(m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m)`。給的不是函式就回傳 `''`。丟出錯誤的檢查，對那個型別算「不行」。

params.name: audioOnly
params.en: Use [`AUDIO_MIMES`](#AUDIO_MIMES) instead of [`VIDEO_MIMES`](#VIDEO_MIMES).
params.zh: 用 [`AUDIO_MIMES`](#AUDIO_MIMES) 而不是 [`VIDEO_MIMES`](#VIDEO_MIMES)。

params.name: prefer
params.en: Move this container to the front, keeping the order inside each group.
params.zh: 把這種容器移到最前面，兩組各自的內部順序不變。

params.name: candidates
params.en: Your own list instead of the built-in one.
params.zh: 用你自己的清單，取代內建的。

returns.en: The first supported type, or `''` when none matches (then let `MediaRecorder` choose its default).
returns.zh: 第一個支援的型別，都不符合就回傳 `''`（這時就讓 `MediaRecorder` 用它的預設）。

examples.code:
import { pickMime } from '@openav/record';

const pretend = (...ok) => (mime) => ok.includes(mime);      // a fake browser that supports only these
const both = pretend('video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus', 'video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2');
console.log(pickMime(both));                                  // video/mp4;codecs=avc1.640033,mp4a.40.2
console.log(pickMime(both, { prefer: 'webm' }));              // video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus
console.log(pickMime(pretend('audio/webm;codecs=opus'), { audioOnly: true }));   // audio/webm;codecs=opus
console.log(JSON.stringify(pickMime(() => false)));           // ""

caption.en: Four fake browsers: one that has both, the same asked to prefer WebM, one that only records Opus, and one that records nothing.
caption.zh: 四個假的瀏覽器：兩種都支援的、同一個但要求優先 WebM、只錄得了 Opus 的，和什麼都錄不了的。

summary.en: Finds one size preset by its id: `presetById('vertical-4k')`.
summary.zh: 用 id 找出一個尺寸預設：`presetById('vertical-4k')`。

description.en: Use it to fill a size picker with [`PRESETS`](#PRESETS), or to read the suggested frame rate and layout of a size before you build a [`Compositor`](#Compositor).
description.zh: 拿來為尺寸選單填上 [`PRESETS`](#PRESETS) 的內容，或在建 [`Compositor`](#Compositor) 之前讀一個尺寸建議的畫格率和版面。

params.name: id
params.en: The preset id, for example `'square-1080'`.
params.zh: 預設的 id，例如 `'square-1080'`。

returns.en: The preset `{ id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }`, or `null` if there is no such id.
returns.zh: 那個預設 `{ id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }`，沒有這個 id 就是 `null`。

caption.en: Logs the numbers of one preset and shows that an unknown id gives `null`.
caption.zh: 印出一個預設的各個數字，並顯示不認識的 id 會得到 `null`。

summary.en: The output sizes the compositor knows by name, from `vertical-1080p` (1080 by 1920) to `landscape-4k`, each with its suggested layout and frame rate.
summary.zh: 合成器認得名字的輸出尺寸，從 `vertical-1080p`（1080 乘 1920）到 `landscape-4k`，每個都附建議的版面和畫格率。

description.en:
```text
id                 size        fps   layout
vertical-1080p     1080x1920   60    stack
vertical-4x5       1440x1800   60    stack
vertical-2.7k      1520x2704   30    stack
vertical-4k        2160x3840   30    stack
landscape-1080p    1920x1080   60    side
landscape-16x10    1920x1200   60    side
landscape-2.7k     2704x1520   30    side
landscape-4k       3840x2160   30    side
square-1080        1080x1080   60    pip
square-2048        2048x2048   30    pip
square-2160        2160x2160   30    pip
```
description.zh:
```text
id                 尺寸        fps   版面
vertical-1080p     1080x1920   60    stack
vertical-4x5       1440x1800   60    stack
vertical-2.7k      1520x2704   30    stack
vertical-4k        2160x3840   30    stack
landscape-1080p    1920x1080   60    side
landscape-16x10    1920x1200   60    side
landscape-2.7k     2704x1520   30    side
landscape-4k       3840x2160   30    side
square-1080        1080x1080   60    pip
square-2048        2048x2048   30    pip
square-2160        2160x2160   30    pip
```

description.en: Every side is even, because H.264 and VP9 encode 4:2:0 colour, which needs even sizes. Use an id as the `size` of a [`Compositor`](#Compositor); [`presetById()`](#presetById) looks one up.
description.zh: 每一邊都是偶數，因為 H.264 和 VP9 用 4:2:0 的色彩編碼，需要偶數的尺寸。可以把 id 當作 [`Compositor`](#Compositor) 的 `size`。用 [`presetById()`](#presetById) 查某一個。

value.en: A frozen list of 11 presets. Each is `{ id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }`: `group` is `'vertical'`, `'landscape'` or `'square'`, `label` and `labelZh` are names for a picker, `layout` is the layout suggested for the shape and `fps` is [`recommendedFps()`](#recommendedFps).
value.zh: 一份凍結的清單，有 11 個預設。每個是 `{ id, group, w, h, label, labelZh, layout, fps }`：`group` 是 `'vertical'`、`'landscape'` 或 `'square'`，`label` 和 `labelZh` 是給選單用的名字，`layout` 是這種形狀建議的版面，`fps` 是 [`recommendedFps()`](#recommendedFps)。

caption.en: Lists the presets that are bigger than about 2.6 megapixels: all of them are recorded at 30 frames a second.
caption.zh: 列出大於約 260 萬像素的預設：它們全都用每秒 30 個畫面來錄。

summary.en: Snaps the key presses of a take to a rhythmic grid, so a loose performance lands on the beat.
summary.zh: 把一個 take 的按鍵對齊到節奏格子上，讓不太準的演奏落在拍點上。

description.en: Each key-down moves to the nearest grid line (`60000 / bpm / grid` milliseconds apart). The key-up of a note moves with it, so the length of every note is kept. Everything that is not a note (controllers, pitch bend) stays where it was. A note written in two spellings at the same time (`midi/note/on` and `midi/ch/1/note/60`) moves by the same amount in both.
description.zh: 每次按下的鍵會移到最近的格線上（格線之間隔 `60000 / bpm / grid` 毫秒）。音符放開的時間跟著一起移，所以每個音的長度不變。不是音符的東西（控制器、彎音）留在原處。同一個音符用兩種寫法同時記錄的（`midi/note/on` 和 `midi/ch/1/note/60`），兩邊移動的量一樣。

params.name: take
params.en: The take.
params.zh: 這個 take。

params.name: bpm
params.en: The tempo. Left out, it is `take.meta.bpm`, and then 120.
params.zh: 速度。沒給的話用 `take.meta.bpm`，再沒有就是 120。

params.name: grid
params.en: Grid steps per beat: 4 is sixteenths, 2 is eighths, 1 is quarters.
params.zh: 每一拍幾格：4 是十六分音符，2 是八分音符，1 是四分音符。

params.name: strength
params.en: How far to move, 0..1. 1 is all the way, 0.5 is half way to the grid, 0 changes nothing.
params.zh: 移動多少，0..1。1 是移到定位，0.5 是移一半，0 是什麼都不變。

params.name: offsetMs
params.en: Shift the grid later by this many milliseconds, for a take that does not start on a beat.
params.zh: 把格子往後移這麼多毫秒，給不是從拍點開始的 take 用。

returns.en: A new take.
returns.zh: 一個新的 take。

caption.en: Two notes a little off the beat snap to 500 and 1000 ms, and each note-off moves with its note. With a strength of one half they only go halfway.
caption.zh: 兩個稍微偏離拍點的音對齊到 500 和 1000 毫秒，每個放開的時間跟著它的音一起移。強度一半的話，它們只移一半。

summary.en: A video bitrate that keeps fast generative detail clean: 0.12 bits per pixel per frame, held between 4 and 80 Mb/s.
summary.zh: 能讓快速的生成式細節保持乾淨的影像位元率：每個像素每個畫面 0.12 位元，限制在 4 到 80 Mb/s。

description.en: Particles and thin lines are the first things a low bitrate smears, so this is higher than a streaming bitrate on purpose: the file is a master that will be edited and encoded again. It is the default `videoBitsPerSecond` of a [`Recorder`](#Recorder) that records a canvas.
description.zh: 粒子和細線是位元率太低時最先被糊掉的東西，所以這個數字刻意比串流的位元率高：這個檔案是要再剪輯、再編碼的母帶。它是錄畫布的 [`Recorder`](#Recorder) 的 `videoBitsPerSecond` 預設值。

params.name: w
params.en: Width in pixels.
params.zh: 寬，單位是像素。

params.name: h
params.en: Height in pixels.
params.zh: 高，單位是像素。

params.name: fps
params.en: The frame rate. Left out, it is [`recommendedFps()`](#recommendedFps) for the size.
params.zh: 畫格率。沒給的話，用這個尺寸的 [`recommendedFps()`](#recommendedFps)。

returns.en: Bits per second, rounded to 100 000. 1080 by 1920 at 60 fps is 14 900 000, 4K at 30 fps is 29 900 000.

caption.en: The bitrate for a few sizes, in megabits per second: the floor of 4 holds for a tiny frame, and asking for 60 fps at 4K doubles the number.
caption.zh: 幾種尺寸的位元率，單位是每秒百萬位元：很小的畫面會停在下限 4，4K 要 60 fps 的話數字會加倍。

summary.en: The frame rate to record a frame size at: 60 up to about 2.6 megapixels, 30 above that.
summary.zh: 一個畫面尺寸該用什麼畫格率來錄：到約 260 萬像素是 60，再大就是 30。

description.en: 60 fps holds up to about 1080 by 1920 (and 1440 by 1800, 1920 by 1200). A 4K canvas at 60 means 500 million pixels a second through the compositor and the encoder, which drops frames on a laptop in the middle of a performance, and 30 is what cameras shoot 4K at anyway. Pass the result as `fps` to a [`Recorder`](#Recorder).
description.zh: 60 fps 可以撐到約 1080 乘 1920（以及 1440 乘 1800、1920 乘 1200）。4K 的畫布用 60 的話，合成器和編碼器每秒要處理 5 億個像素，在筆電上表演到一半會掉格，而且相機拍 4K 本來也是 30。把結果當作 `fps` 交給 [`Recorder`](#Recorder)。

params.name: w
params.en: Width in pixels.
params.zh: 寬，單位是像素。

params.name: h
params.en: Height in pixels.
params.zh: 高，單位是像素。

returns.en: 60 when `w × h` is at most 2 600 000 pixels, otherwise 30.
returns.zh: `w × h` 不超過 2 600 000 像素是 60，否則是 30。

examples.code:
import { recommendedFps } from '@openav/record';

console.log(recommendedFps(1080, 1920));   // 60
console.log(recommendedFps(2160, 3840));   // 30
console.log(recommendedFps(1920, 1200));   // 60

caption.en: Logs the rate for a 1080p vertical frame, a 4K vertical frame and a 16:10 landscape frame.
caption.zh: 印出 1080p 直式、4K 直式和 16:10 橫式畫面的畫格率。

entries.name: Recorder
entries.signature: new Recorder({ canvas = null, stream = null, fps = 60, audioTracks = [], audioOnly = false, videoBitsPerSecond, audioBitsPerSecond = 192000, mimeType, prefer = null } = {})

summary.en: Records a canvas, together with the sound you give it, into one video file with one MediaRecorder, so picture and sound stay in sync.
summary.zh: 用一個 MediaRecorder 把一張畫布連同你給它的聲音錄成一個影片檔，所以畫面和聲音保持同步。

description.en: `new Recorder({ canvas, audioTracks })` then `start()` and, later, `await stop()`. The canvas track and the audio track go into the same `MediaRecorder`, which stamps both from one clock: nothing has to be lined up afterwards. `stop()` resolves, after the last chunk, with `{ mimeType, ext, bytes, chunks, durationMs, width, height, fps, audio, blob, error }`: the `blob` is the file, `ext` the extension to give it (`mp4`, `webm`, `m4a`…), `audio` whether it has sound. Give the blob to `URL.createObjectURL()` for a download link.
description.zh: `new Recorder({ canvas, audioTracks })`，然後 `start()`，之後 `await stop()`。畫布的影像軌和聲音軌進的是同一個 `MediaRecorder`，它用同一個時鐘替兩者打時間戳記，所以事後不用對齊。`stop()` 在最後一塊資料到了之後 resolve，內容是 `{ mimeType, ext, bytes, chunks, durationMs, width, height, fps, audio, blob, error }`：`blob` 就是檔案，`ext` 是該用的副檔名（`mp4`、`webm`、`m4a`…），`audio` 是有沒有聲音。把 blob 交給 `URL.createObjectURL()` 就能做下載連結。

description.en: Which file you get depends on the browser: it records MP4 (H.264 and AAC) when it can, WebM otherwise. A WebM from Chrome has no duration in its header; players cope, editors may want `ffmpeg -i in.webm -c copy out.webm`. The file is a master to edit, so the default bitrate is high.
description.zh: 拿到什麼檔案看瀏覽器：能錄 MP4（H.264 和 AAC）就錄 MP4，不行就錄 WebM。Chrome 錄出來的 WebM 檔頭沒有長度，播放器沒問題，剪輯軟體可能需要 `ffmpeg -i in.webm -c copy out.webm`。這個檔案是拿來剪輯的母帶，所以預設的位元率偏高。

description.en: To keep a long take out of the tab's memory, pass `ondata(blob, seq)` to `start()`: each chunk (every `timeslice` ms) is handed over in order, and a promise you return is awaited before the next chunk and before `stop()` resolves, so uploads stay ordered. With `ondata` the chunks are not kept and `blob` is `null`, unless you pass `keep: true`. To line a take up with an [`EventLog`](#EventLog), start the log with `recorder.t0`, the `performance.now()` of the moment recording started.
description.zh: 要讓很長的一段錄影不佔著分頁的記憶體，就在 `start()` 傳 `ondata(blob, seq)`：每一塊資料（每隔 `timeslice` 毫秒）會依序交給你，你回傳的 promise 會在下一塊、以及 `stop()` resolve 之前被等待，所以上傳的順序不會亂。有給 `ondata` 的話資料塊不會保留，`blob` 是 `null`，除非你傳 `keep: true`。要讓一段錄影跟 [`EventLog`](#EventLog) 對齊，就用 `recorder.t0` 來開始事件記錄，它是開始錄影那一刻的 `performance.now()`。

params.name: canvas
params.en: What to record, usually `compositor.canvas`.
params.zh: 要錄什麼，通常是 `compositor.canvas`。

params.name: stream
params.en: A ready video stream to record instead of a canvas.
params.zh: 要錄的現成影像串流，用來取代畫布。

params.name: fps
params.en: The capture rate of the canvas. Use [`recommendedFps(w, h)`](#recommendedFps): 30 for 2.7K and 4K.
params.zh: 畫布的擷取頻率。用 [`recommendedFps(w, h)`](#recommendedFps)：2.7K 和 4K 是 30。

params.name: audioTracks
params.en: The sound, for example `tap.tracks` of an [`AudioTap`](#AudioTap). Several tracks are mixed into one, because Chrome records only the first audio track of a stream.
params.zh: 聲音，例如 [`AudioTap`](#AudioTap) 的 `tap.tracks`。給好幾條會混成一條，因為 Chrome 只會錄一個串流的第一條音軌。

params.name: audioOnly
params.en: Record only the audio tracks: the sound as a file of its own. Then `canvas` and `stream` are not needed.
params.zh: 只錄音軌：把聲音另外存成一個檔。這時不需要 `canvas` 和 `stream`。

params.name: videoBitsPerSecond
params.en: The video bitrate. The default is [`recommendedBitrate()`](#recommendedBitrate) of the canvas size and `fps` (12 Mb/s when there is no canvas).
params.zh: 影像位元率。預設是依畫布尺寸和 `fps` 算出的 [`recommendedBitrate()`](#recommendedBitrate)（沒有畫布的話是 12 Mb/s）。

params.name: audioBitsPerSecond
params.en: The audio bitrate.
params.zh: 聲音位元率。

params.name: mimeType
params.en: Force one MIME type. The default is the first one the browser supports from [`VIDEO_MIMES`](#VIDEO_MIMES) or [`AUDIO_MIMES`](#AUDIO_MIMES), see [`pickMime()`](#pickMime).
params.zh: 強制用某一個 MIME 型別。預設是瀏覽器支援的第一個 [`VIDEO_MIMES`](#VIDEO_MIMES) 或 [`AUDIO_MIMES`](#AUDIO_MIMES)，見 [`pickMime()`](#pickMime)。

params.name: prefer
params.en: Try this container first when picking the MIME type.
params.zh: 挑 MIME 型別的時候先試這種容器。

needs.en: A browser with `MediaRecorder` (`Recorder.supported` tells), and a canvas or a stream, or `audioOnly: true`: otherwise the constructor throws a `TypeError`. Mixing several audio tracks makes an `AudioContext`, which needs the page to have had a click. A camera or microphone in the stream needs the user's permission, as always.
needs.zh: 需要有 `MediaRecorder` 的瀏覽器（`Recorder.supported` 會告訴你），也要有畫布或串流，或 `audioOnly: true`：否則建構時會丟出 `TypeError`。混好幾條音軌會建一個 `AudioContext`，頁面需要先被點過一次。串流裡有鏡頭或麥克風的話，一樣需要使用者許可。

caption.en: Records one second of the moving square and logs what the file is. A Download link appears on the page.
caption.zh: 錄一秒鐘會動的方塊，印出這個檔案是什麼。頁面上出現一個下載連結。

caption.en: One second of video with a 220 Hz tone in it, and the same tone as a separate audio file. The picture and the sound of the video enter the same recorder.
caption.zh: 一秒鐘的影片，裡面有一個 220 Hz 的音，同一個音另外存成一個聲音檔。影片的畫面和聲音進的是同一個錄影器。

caption.en: With `ondata` the chunks are handed to you one by one, in order, and the result carries no `blob`: this is how a long take stays out of the tab's memory.
