value.zh: Tone.js 第 15 版的 ES module 位址。留空的話用 `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/tone@15.0.4/+esm`，`OAVp5.options.tone` 讀回來是 `''`。

notes.en: Set it before oav-p5 loads. `window.OAV_P5 = { tone: … };` above the loader line wins, then `?oav_tone=…` on the page address, then `?tone=…` on the script's own URL. Values in `window.OAV_P5` are turned into text, so write `'off'`, not `false`. On OpenProcessing the page address takes `?sketch_oav_tone=…` (the project's README says OpenProcessing forwards it to the sketch).
notes.zh: 要在 oav-p5 載入之前設好。寫在載入那一行上面的 `window.OAV_P5 = { tone: … };` 優先，其次是網頁網址上的 `?oav_tone=…`，最後是 script 自己網址上的 `?tone=…`。寫在 `window.OAV_P5` 裡的值會被轉成文字，所以要寫 `'off'`，不要寫 `false`。在 OpenProcessing 上，網頁網址要寫成 `?sketch_oav_tone=…`（專案的 README 說 OpenProcessing 會把它轉給草圖）。

caption.en: Prints where Tone.js would come from. The address here is the built-in one, so nothing changes. Swap in your own copy to host it yourself.
caption.zh: 印出 Tone.js 會從哪裡來。這裡的位址就是內建的那個，所以不會有任何改變。換成你自己的那一份，就能自己架。

summary.en: The object oav-p5 hangs everything on: MIDI state, the panel, the microphone, the clock, the check-up. `midi` and `oavMidi` are the same object.
summary.zh: oav-p5 把所有東西掛在上面的那個物件：MIDI 狀態、面板、麥克風、時鐘、體檢。`midi` 和 `oavMidi` 是同一個物件。

description.en: It is there as soon as oav-p5 has loaded, in setup() and draw() alike. The plain names of the p5 style (`knob1`, `note`, `micLevel`) are the easy way in. `OAVp5` is the way in when you want more: the raw MIDI state ([`OAVp5.note`](#OAVp5.note), [`OAVp5.cc`](#OAVp5.cc), [`OAVp5.bend`](#OAVp5.bend), [`OAVp5.held`](#OAVp5.held), [`OAVp5.last`](#OAVp5.last)), subscriptions ([`OAVp5.on()`](#OAVp5.on)), a way to send bytes ([`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input)), the microphone's numbers ([`OAVp5.mic`](#OAVp5.mic)), the external clock ([`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock)), the link ([`OAVp5.link`](#OAVp5.link)), the values over time ([`OAVp5.chop`](#OAVp5.chop)) and the check-up ([`OAVp5.check()`](#OAVp5.check)).
description.zh: 只要 oav-p5 載入了，它就在那裡，setup() 和 draw() 裡都一樣。p5 風格的簡單名稱（`knob1`、`note`、`micLevel`）是輕鬆的入口。想要更多的時候就用 `OAVp5`：原始的 MIDI 狀態（[`OAVp5.note`](#OAVp5.note)、[`OAVp5.cc`](#OAVp5.cc)、[`OAVp5.bend`](#OAVp5.bend)、[`OAVp5.held`](#OAVp5.held)、[`OAVp5.last`](#OAVp5.last)）、訂閱（[`OAVp5.on()`](#OAVp5.on)）、自己送位元組進去的方法（[`OAVp5.input()`](#OAVp5.input)）、麥克風的數字（[`OAVp5.mic`](#OAVp5.mic)）、外部時鐘（[`OAVp5.clock`](#OAVp5.clock)）、連結（[`OAVp5.link`](#OAVp5.link)）、數值隨時間變化（[`OAVp5.chop`](#OAVp5.chop)），還有體檢（[`OAVp5.check()`](#OAVp5.check)）。

description.en: Three names, one object. `OAVp5` is always there. `oavMidi` is always there too. `midi` is there unless the page already had a `midi` of its own, in which case it is left alone and the console says to read `OAVp5` instead. `OAVp5.options` holds the loading options as oav-p5 read them: `OAVp5.options.mic`, and so on for each of the loading options (for example [`mic`](#option-mic)).
description.zh: 三個名字，同一個物件。`OAVp5` 一定在，`oavMidi` 也一定在。`midi` 則是頁面本來沒有自己的 `midi` 時才有，如果頁面已經有了，就不去動它，console 會說要改讀 `OAVp5`。`OAVp5.options` 放的是 oav-p5 讀到的載入選項：`OAVp5.options.mic`，其他每個載入選項（例如 [`mic`](#option-mic)）也一樣。

needs.en: Only the loader line. If it has not loaded, `OAVp5` is not defined, and a sketch that reads it stops with "OAVp5 is not defined".
needs.zh: 只需要載入那一行。如果它沒載入，`OAVp5` 就沒有定義，讀它的草圖會停在「OAVp5 is not defined」。

notes.en: `midi` and `oavMidi` are the same object under other names.
notes.zh: `midi` 和 `oavMidi` 是同一個物件的其他名字。

caption.en: A small status board: the three names are one object, then the version and the state of MIDI, the microphone and the clock.
caption.zh: 一塊小小的狀態板：三個名字是同一個物件，然後是版本，以及 MIDI、麥克風和時鐘的狀態。

summary.en: Runs the 🩺 check-up: the version, page, browser, microphone, MIDI, sound, drums, recording, wiring and hints, as a card to screenshot and as an object.
summary.zh: 執行 🩺 體檢：版本、頁面、瀏覽器、麥克風、MIDI、聲音、鼓機、錄影、接線和提示，做成一張可以截圖的卡片，也回傳成物件。

description.en: The same thing the 🩺 button in the panel does. When something does not work for a student, `OAVp5.check()` in the console (or 🩺) gives a card that says what this browser did: whether the page is in an iframe, whether the microphone is on or blocked, whether Web MIDI exists and which devices it found, the last message, the sound and drum state, whether MP4 recording works, what the controller is wired to, which of the sketch's own names stepped in the way, and which cards have appeared. It has a copy button and a link to the site's full device check.
description.zh: 跟面板裡的 🩺 按鈕做的事一樣。學生那邊有東西不能用的時候，在 console 打 `OAVp5.check()`（或按 🩺）就會得到一張卡片，說這個瀏覽器做了什麼：頁面是不是在 iframe 裡、麥克風開著還是被擋、有沒有 Web MIDI、找到哪些設備、最後一則訊息、聲音和鼓機的狀態、能不能錄 MP4、控制器接到哪些變數、草圖自己的哪些名稱擋住了路，還有出現過哪些卡片。卡片上有複製按鈕，也有連到網站完整裝置檢查的連結。

params.name: opts
params.en: `{ show: false }` skips the card on the page and only returns the report (the text still goes to the console). Left out, the card is shown.
params.zh: `{ show: false }` 不顯示頁面上的卡片，只回傳報告（文字還是會印到 console）。不寫的話就顯示卡片。

returns.en: The report: `{ version, time, page, browser, microphone, midi, sound, drums, wiring, own, hints, external, recording, text }`. `text` is the whole card as plain lines, the other fields are the same facts as data (`microphone.state`, `midi.hardware`, `midi.devices` …).
returns.zh: 報告：`{ version, time, page, browser, microphone, midi, sound, drums, wiring, own, hints, external, recording, text }`。`text` 是整張卡片的純文字，其他欄位是同樣的資訊做成的資料（`microphone.state`、`midi.hardware`、`midi.devices` …）。

notes.en: It is a snapshot taken when you call it, not a live view. Calling it again replaces the card.
notes.zh: 它是呼叫那一刻的快照，不是即時的畫面。再呼叫一次會取代那張卡片。

caption.en: Prints the check-up text on the canvas: version, browser, microphone, MIDI and the rest, one line each.
caption.zh: 把體檢的文字印在畫布上：版本、瀏覽器、麥克風、MIDI 等等，一項一行。

caption.en: Click the canvas: the check-up card opens over the page, with a copy button, ready to screenshot.
caption.zh: 點一下畫布：體檢卡片會蓋在頁面上，附有複製按鈕，可以直接截圖。

summary.en: What oav-p5 hears of an external MIDI clock: its state, tempo and where it is in the bar. Nothing until another program or device starts sending one.
summary.zh: oav-p5 聽到的外部 MIDI 時鐘：它的狀態、速度、現在在小節的哪裡。在別的程式或設備開始送時鐘之前什麼都沒有。

description.en: Some programs keep the time and everyone else follows: Strudel (`midicmd("clock*96, <start stop>/8")`), a DAW over a virtual cable, a drum machine on a MIDI cable. They send 24 clock messages per beat, plus start, continue, stop and song position. oav-p5 counts them: [`OAVp5.clock.info`](#OAVp5.clock.info) says whether a clock is running, [`OAVp5.clock.bpm`](#OAVp5.clock.bpm) its tempo and [`OAVp5.clock.phase`](#OAVp5.clock.phase) how far through the bar and the beat it is now.
description.zh: 有些程式負責打拍子，其他人跟著走：Strudel（`midicmd("clock*96, <start stop>/8")`）、透過虛擬線連過來的 DAW、用 MIDI 線接的鼓機。它們每拍送 24 個時鐘訊息，加上 start、continue、stop 和 song position。oav-p5 把它們數起來：[`OAVp5.clock.info`](#OAVp5.clock.info) 說有沒有時鐘在跑，[`OAVp5.clock.bpm`](#OAVp5.clock.bpm) 是它的速度，[`OAVp5.clock.phase`](#OAVp5.clock.phase) 是現在走到小節和拍子的哪裡。

description.en: When a clock is moving, [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase), [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase), [`drumBar`](#drumBar), [`drumStep`](#drumStep) and [`drumBpm`](#drumBpm) read it, and a drum machine that is up follows it. [`?oav_clock=off`](#option-clock) turns all of that off. Clock messages are not delivered to [`midiMessage()`](#midiMessage): they belong to the clock.
description.zh: 時鐘在動的時候，[`drumPhase`](#drumPhase)、[`beatPhase`](#beatPhase)、[`drumBar`](#drumBar)、[`drumStep`](#drumStep)、[`drumBpm`](#drumBpm) 讀的就是它，已經在跑的鼓機也會跟著它。[`?oav_clock=off`](#option-clock) 會把這些全部關掉。時鐘訊息不會交給 [`midiMessage()`](#midiMessage)：它們屬於時鐘。

notes.en: The first clock message loads the counting code (@openav/midi's `MidiClock`) from next to oav-p5.js, which takes a few frames. Until then the members read `none`, `null` and `null`.
notes.zh: 第一個時鐘訊息會從 oav-p5.js 旁邊載入負責計算的程式（@openav/midi 的 `MidiClock`），要幾個畫面。在那之前，這些成員讀到的是 `none`、`null`、`null`。

notes.en: This is advanced: most sketches only read `drumPhase` and let it follow a clock.
notes.zh: 這是進階用法：大多數草圖只讀 `drumPhase`，讓它自己去跟著時鐘。

caption.en: The sketch sends itself a made-up MIDI clock at about 125 BPM. A circle sweeps across once per beat, and the state and tempo are printed.
caption.zh: 草圖自己送出一個假的 MIDI 時鐘，大約 125 BPM。一個圓每拍從左掃到右一次，狀態和速度也印出來。

summary.en: The tempo of the external MIDI clock in beats a minute, or `null` while there is none.
summary.zh: 外部 MIDI 時鐘的速度，單位是每分鐘幾拍，沒有的時候是 `null`。

description.en: The raw number, not rounded. Use it for anything that should run at the clock's tempo: `OAVp5.clock.bpm / 60` is beats a second. If the drum machine follows the clock, [`drumBpm`](#drumBpm) shows it rounded to a tenth.
description.zh: 原始的數字，沒有四捨五入。任何要跟著時鐘速度走的東西都可以用它：`OAVp5.clock.bpm / 60` 就是每秒幾拍。鼓機如果跟著時鐘，[`drumBpm`](#drumBpm) 會顯示四捨五入到小數一位的值。

value.en: Fitted over the last 24 clock ticks, so it settles within a moment and does not jump with one late tick. `null` before two ticks have arrived or when `clock=off`.
value.zh: 用最近 24 個時鐘 tick 擬合出來的，所以一下子就會穩定，不會因為一個晚到的 tick 就跳動。兩個 tick 到齊之前，或設了 `clock=off`，都是 `null`。

caption.en: Prints the tempo of the made-up clock the sketch sends itself: about 125 BPM once a few ticks have arrived.
caption.zh: 印出草圖自己送的假時鐘的速度：幾個 tick 到齊之後大約是 125 BPM。

summary.en: A snapshot of the external clock: `state` (`none`, `running`, `stopped` or `lost`), `bpm`, whether the drums follow it, where it came from, and counts.
summary.zh: 外部時鐘的快照：`state`（`none`、`running`、`stopped` 或 `lost`）、`bpm`、鼓機有沒有跟著它、它從哪裡來，還有各種計數。

description.en: `state` is `'none'` until a clock message has come, `'running'` while the clock is going, `'stopped'` after a MIDI stop (the position holds and clocks may still arrive), and `'lost'` when no clock message has arrived for 0.6 seconds. `bpm` is the tempo fitted over the last 24 ticks, rounded to two decimals, or `null` before two ticks. `running` is true while the transport runs, which a stream of clocks with no start message counts as too (`implicit` is true then).
description.zh: `state` 在收到任何時鐘訊息之前是 `'none'`，時鐘在走的時候是 `'running'`，MIDI stop 之後是 `'stopped'`（位置停住，時鐘訊息可能還在來），超過 0.6 秒沒收到時鐘訊息就是 `'lost'`。`bpm` 是用最近 24 個 tick 擬合出來的速度，四捨五入到小數兩位，兩個 tick 之前是 `null`。`running` 在播放中是 true，只有時鐘、沒有 start 訊息的串流也算（那時 `implicit` 是 true）。

description.en: `following` is true when the drums read this clock: it is running, has a tempo and `clock=off` is not set. `source` says where the messages came from: `'hardware'`, `'screen'`, `'phone'`, `'virtual-out'` (a program playing into OAV Virtual MIDI) or `'link'`. `clocks`, `dupes`, `starts`, `stops` and `continues` count what arrived; a start sent three times with one timestamp counts once and adds to `dupes`.
description.zh: `following` 在鼓機讀這個時鐘的時候是 true：它在跑、有速度、而且沒有設 `clock=off`。`source` 說訊息從哪裡來：`'hardware'`、`'screen'`、`'phone'`、`'virtual-out'`（某個程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI）或 `'link'`。`clocks`、`dupes`、`starts`、`stops`、`continues` 數的是收到了什麼：用同一個時間戳送三次的 start 只算一次，其餘加進 `dupes`。

value.en: A new object each time you read it: `{ state, bpm, running, following, source, implicit, clocks, dupes, starts, stops, continues }`. Before any clock message it is `{ state: 'none', bpm: null, running: false, following: false, source: null, clocks: 0 }`.
value.zh: 每次讀都是一個新的物件：`{ state, bpm, running, following, source, implicit, clocks, dupes, starts, stops, continues }`。在任何時鐘訊息之前是 `{ state: 'none', bpm: null, running: false, following: false, source: null, clocks: 0 }`。

caption.en: Prints the clock's snapshot while the sketch sends itself a made-up clock: the state goes from "none" to "running" within a moment.
caption.zh: 草圖自己送一個假的時鐘，同時印出時鐘的快照：狀態很快就從 "none" 變成 "running"。

summary.en: Where the external clock is right now: `{ pos, bar, beat, bpm, running }`, or `null` while there is no tempo.
summary.zh: 外部時鐘現在走到哪裡：`{ pos, bar, beat, bpm, running }`，沒有速度的時候是 `null`。

description.en: A bar is four beats. `bar` and `beat` count up from 0 and fall back to 0 at the next downbeat, the same way [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase) and [`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) do. After a stop the position holds. A clock with no start message gets its downbeat from the first tick after a silence of half a second, so a phase is there anyway.
description.zh: 一個小節是四拍。`bar` 和 `beat` 從 0 往上數，到下一個第一拍就回到 0，跟 [`drumPhase`](#drumPhase)、[`beatPhase`](#beatPhase) 一樣。stop 之後位置會停住。沒有 start 訊息的時鐘，以沉默半秒之後的第一個 tick 當第一拍，所以還是有相位可以用。

value.en: A new object each time you read it: `pos` is the number of bars since the start (0 is the downbeat of bar 1), `bar` and `beat` are 0..1 through the current bar and beat, `bpm` the tempo and `running` whether the transport is moving. `null` until a tempo is known.
value.zh: 每次讀都是一個新的物件：`pos` 是從 start 起算經過幾個小節（0 是第 1 小節的第一拍），`bar` 和 `beat` 是目前小節和拍子走了 0 到 1 的多少，`bpm` 是速度，`running` 是播放有沒有在動。知道速度之前是 `null`。

caption.en: Two circles sweep from left to right on the made-up clock: the blue one once per beat, the yellow one once per bar of four beats.
caption.zh: 兩個圓依著假的時鐘從左掃到右：藍色的每拍一次，黃色的每小節（四拍）一次。

summary.en: How the drum machine keeps time: which clock moves it, how far ahead it schedules and how long the callbacks wait for the speakers.
summary.zh: 鼓機怎麼計時：用哪一種時鐘推動、提前排程多久，以及 callback 為了等喇叭而延後多久。

description.en: This is the diagnostic behind the 🩺 check-up. When drum hits feel late or early, look here first: the handbook puts a Bluetooth speaker at 0.15 to 0.25 seconds of `latency`, and [`?oav_drumlatency=200`](#option-drumlatency) sets it by hand. `late`, `skipped`, `warning` and `why` are further notes the check-up reads.
description.zh: 這是 🩺 檢查報告背後的診斷資料。打擊感覺太晚或太早的時候，先看這裡：說明文件寫藍牙喇叭的 `latency` 大約是 0.15 到 0.25 秒，[`?oav_drumlatency=200`](#option-drumlatency) 可以手動設定。`late`、`skipped`、`warning`、`why` 是檢查報告會讀的其他備註。

value.range: { clock, heartbeat, lookahead, latency, audio, extended, preDraw, … }
value.en: A new object on every read. `clock` is `'lookahead'` (hits are handed to the audio clock ahead of time, the default) or `'frame'` (moved by the frames, the [`drums`](#option-drums) option). `heartbeat` is `'worker'` (a Web Worker wakes it every 25 ms), `'interval'` (the fallback), `'frame'` with the frame clock, or `'none'` before the machine exists. `lookahead` is the seconds scheduled ahead and `extended` is true when a slow `draw()` made it look further ahead. `latency` is the seconds the callbacks wait for the output of the speakers, `audio` whether the kit's audio clock is running, and `preDraw` the p5 hook that delivers the callbacks right before `draw()`.
value.zh: 每次讀都是一個新的物件。`clock` 是 `'lookahead'`（打擊事先交給音訊時鐘排好，預設）或 `'frame'`（跟著畫面走，載入選項 [`drums`](#option-drums)）。`heartbeat` 是 `'worker'`（Web Worker 每 25 毫秒叫醒它）、`'interval'`（備用的做法）、用畫面時鐘的時候是 `'frame'`，鼓機還沒有的時候是 `'none'`。`lookahead` 是提前排程的秒數，`extended` 為 true 表示 `draw()` 太慢，讓它看得更遠。`latency` 是 callback 為了等喇叭輸出而延後的秒數，`audio` 是鼓組的音訊時鐘有沒有在跑，`preDraw` 是在 `draw()` 前面送 callback 的 p5 掛鉤。

caption.en: The clock settings of the machine while it plays.
caption.zh: 鼓機播放時的時鐘設定。

tbd.en: What exactly `late`, `skipped`, `warning` and `why` count was not checked.
tbd.zh: `late`、`skipped`、`warning`、`why` 各自精確計的是什麼，還沒有查證。

summary.en: The drum machine from @openav/drums that the grid on the page belongs to, or `null` before it has loaded.
summary.zh: 頁面上那個鼓機格子背後的 @openav/drums 鼓機，還沒載入的時候是 `null`。

description.en: It is what `mountDrums()` of [@openav/drums](#mountDrums) returns, with `seq` (the sequencer), `engine` (the kit), `play(on)`, `setPattern(p)`, `setBpm(bpm)`, `phase()`, `now()`, `info()` and the rhythm functions. `OAVp5.drums.machine.play(false)` stops the sound and the counting but leaves the grid up: [`OAVp5.drums.state`](#OAVp5.drums.state) then says `'stopped'`. It is an advanced handle; the names on this page cover what a sketch normally needs.
description.zh: 就是 [@openav/drums](#mountDrums) 的 `mountDrums()` 回傳的東西，有 `seq`（序列器）、`engine`（鼓組）、`play(on)`、`setPattern(p)`、`setBpm(bpm)`、`phase()`、`now()`、`info()` 和節奏相關的函式。`OAVp5.drums.machine.play(false)` 會讓鼓機停止發聲和計數，但格子還留在畫面上：[`OAVp5.drums.state`](#OAVp5.drums.state) 這時是 `'stopped'`。它是進階的把手，這一頁的名稱已經涵蓋草圖平常需要的一切。

value.en: Set once, when [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) has loaded the machine. `null` before that and after a failed load.
value.zh: [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) 把鼓機載入之後設定一次。在那之前，或載入失敗之後，都是 `null`。

needs.en: It is `null` until [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) (or 🥁) has loaded the machine. Check for `null` before you use it.
needs.zh: 在 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)（或 🥁）把鼓機載入之前都是 `null`，使用之前先檢查。

caption.en: A click pauses the machine and the grid stays on the page; the state reads "stopped" until the next click.
caption.zh: 點一下讓鼓機暫停，格子還留在頁面上，狀態會顯示 "stopped"，再點一下就繼續。

summary.en: The list of cards oav-p5 has shown or would have shown so far (a blocked microphone, no Web MIDI, an error in your callback), each with what, why and what to press.
summary.zh: oav-p5 到現在顯示過（或本來會顯示）的卡片清單（麥克風被擋、沒有 Web MIDI、你的回呼出錯），每張都寫著發生什麼、為什麼、要按什麼。

description.en: Each situation is said once per page. The list holds them all, including the ones the page did not show because [`hints=off`](#option-hints) is set, so it is the place to look when a sketch does something odd and nothing is on screen: `console.log(OAVp5.hints)`.
description.zh: 每種狀況在一個頁面只說一次。這個清單把它們全都記著，包括因為設了 [`hints=off`](#option-hints) 而沒有顯示在頁面上的，所以草圖行為怪怪的、螢幕上又什麼都沒有的時候，就看這裡：`console.log(OAVp5.hints)`。

value.en: Starts empty and only grows. Each item is `{ id, kind, what, why, next }`: `id` names the situation (`'micDenied'`, `'chopOut:lag'`), `kind` is `'error'`, `'warn'` or `'info'`, and `what`, `why`, `next` are the three lines of the card in the browser's language.
value.zh: 一開始是空的，只會變長。每一項是 `{ id, kind, what, why, next }`：`id` 是這個狀況的名字（`'micDenied'`、`'chopOut:lag'`），`kind` 是 `'error'`、`'warn'` 或 `'info'`，`what`、`why`、`next` 是卡片上的三行字，用瀏覽器的語言寫。

notes.en: A card that went away because the situation ended (the microphone came on) stays in the list.
notes.zh: 因為狀況結束（麥克風開起來了）而收掉的卡片，還是會留在清單裡。

caption.en: Lists what oav-p5 has said so far: here, that lag() was called outside draw(). The same sentence is in the console.
caption.zh: 列出 oav-p5 到現在說過的話：這裡是 lag() 在 draw() 外面被呼叫。同樣的句子也在 console 裡。

summary.en: What the link to other oav-p5 pages in the same room is doing: only `OAVp5.link.info`, and `null` unless a room is set.
summary.zh: 和同一個房間裡其他 oav-p5 頁面之間的連結現在的情形：只有 `OAVp5.link.info`，沒有設房間的時候是 `null`。

description.en: A link joins oav-p5 pages that share a room: what one page's programs play into OAV Virtual MIDI (notes, controllers and the clock) is heard by every other page in the room, at the moment it sounds there. You switch it on with [`?oav_link=my-room`](#option-link), and [`OAVp5.link.info`](#OAVp5.link.info) is where you look at how it is going. There is nothing else to call: the link is made and closed by the option.
description.zh: 連結把共用同一個房間的 oav-p5 頁面連在一起：一個頁面的程式送進 OAV Virtual MIDI 的東西（音符、控制器和時鐘），房間裡其他每個頁面都會在它在那邊響起的那一刻聽到。用 [`?oav_link=my-room`](#option-link) 打開它，[`OAVp5.link.info`](#OAVp5.link.info) 是看它進行得如何的地方。沒有別的東西要呼叫：連結的建立和結束都由那個選項決定。

notes.en: This is advanced. It needs a network connection to the relay ([`relay`](#option-relay)).
notes.zh: 這是進階用法。它需要連得上中繼（[`relay`](#option-relay)）。

caption.en: Says whether this page is linked. Without a `link` room it is not, and the sketch says so.
caption.zh: 說這個頁面有沒有連結。沒有 `link` 房間的話就沒有，草圖會這麼說。

summary.en: The state of the link: its room, `state` (`connecting`, `open`, `closed`), how many other pages are there, and the trip time. `null` when no room is set.
summary.zh: 連結的狀態：它的房間、`state`（`connecting`、`open`、`closed`）、有幾個其他頁面在、還有來回的時間。沒有設房間時是 `null`。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` for a status line, or look at the 🔗 on the 🎹, which turns green when another page is there, yellow while connecting or alone, and red when the relay is gone. The 🩺 check-up prints the same facts. A new object is made on every read.
description.zh: 在 `draw()` 裡讀它來做狀態列，或是看 🎹 上的 🔗：另一個頁面在的時候是綠色，連線中或只有自己是黃色，中繼不見是紅色。🩺 體檢也印出同樣的資訊。每次讀都會產生一個新的物件。

value.en: `null` without a `link` room. With one: `{ room, state, peers, rtt, trip, late, sent, received, … }`. `state` is `'connecting'`, `'open'` or `'closed'` (the relay is gone and it retries). `peers` is how many other pages were heard in the last 6 seconds. `rtt` is the shortest round trip to the relay in the last 30 seconds and `trip` the one-way trip estimated from it, both in milliseconds. `late` counts notes that arrived after the moment they should have sounded and were played at once. `sent` and `received` count messages. The object also has `diff`, `lead`, `msgs`, `dupes` and `id`, which explain the clock alignment (packages/relay/link.js).
value.zh: 沒有 `link` 房間的時候是 `null`。有的話是 `{ room, state, peers, rtt, trip, late, sent, received, … }`。`state` 是 `'connecting'`、`'open'` 或 `'closed'`（中繼不見了，正在重試）。`peers` 是最近 6 秒內聽到幾個其他頁面。`rtt` 是最近 30 秒到中繼最短的一趟來回，`trip` 是由它估出來的單程時間，單位都是毫秒。`late` 數的是比該響的時間晚到、被立刻播出的音符。`sent` 和 `received` 數訊息。物件裡還有 `diff`、`lead`、`msgs`、`dupes` 和 `id`，它們說明時鐘怎麼對齊（packages/relay/link.js）。

caption.en: Open the same address in two tabs: both say "open" and one other page, and show the trip time.
caption.zh: 在兩個分頁打開同一個網址：兩邊都顯示 "open" 和一個其他頁面，並顯示來回的時間。

caption.en: Without a `link` room it prints null.
caption.zh: 沒有 `link` 房間的話，印出 null。

tbd.en: The values between two real pages were not observed here: the headless check cannot reach a relay. The fields and their meanings are from the code (packages/relay/link.js) and the project's README.
tbd.zh: 兩個真的頁面之間的數值沒有親眼看過：無頭瀏覽器的檢查連不到中繼。欄位和它們的意思出自程式碼（packages/relay/link.js）和專案的 README。

summary.en: The loaded parts of @openav/sound: the `Sound` shell, its Tone.js engine and the module itself. All three are `null` until sound has loaded.
summary.zh: 載入進來的 @openav/sound 各部分：`Sound` 外殼、它的 Tone.js 引擎，以及模組本身。聲音載入之前三個都是 `null`。

description.en: `OAVp5.sound.shell` is the `Sound` instance of [@openav/sound](#Sound), `OAVp5.sound.engine` is the Tone.js engine it plays through (`noteOn`, `noteOff`, `sustain`, `releaseAll`, `setInstrument`) and `OAVp5.sound.module` is the whole module, for example `OAVp5.sound.module.listInstruments()`, which lists every instrument id. They are advanced handles: the sketch-level names ([`startSound()`](#startSound), [`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn)) cover everything a sketch normally needs.
description.zh: `OAVp5.sound.shell` 是 [@openav/sound](#Sound) 的 `Sound` 實例，`OAVp5.sound.engine` 是它用來發聲的 Tone.js 引擎（`noteOn`、`noteOff`、`sustain`、`releaseAll`、`setInstrument`），`OAVp5.sound.module` 是整個模組，例如 `OAVp5.sound.module.listInstruments()` 會列出所有樂器代號。它們是進階的把手：草圖層級的名稱（[`startSound()`](#startSound)、[`soundIsOn`](#soundIsOn)）已經涵蓋草圖平常需要的一切。

value.en: Set once, when [`startSound()`](#startSound) has loaded @openav/sound (the engine and the shell at the same moment, the module a little before). `null` before that, and after a failed load.
value.zh: [`startSound()`](#startSound) 載入 @openav/sound 之後設定一次（引擎和外殼同時，模組稍微早一點）。在那之前，或載入失敗之後，都是 `null`。

needs.en: Call [`startSound()`](#startSound) first and wait until [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) is no longer `'loading'`, or check for `null` before you use them.
needs.zh: 先呼叫 [`startSound()`](#startSound)，等 [`OAVp5.sound.state`](#OAVp5.sound.state) 離開 `'loading'` 之後再用，也可以在使用之前先檢查它是不是 `null`。

caption.en: Lists every instrument id that [`startSound()`](#startSound) accepts, as soon as the module has loaded.
caption.zh: 模組一載入，就列出 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 接受的所有樂器代號。

summary.en: The version of oav-p5 that loaded, as text such as `'0.8.0'`.
summary.zh: 載入的 oav-p5 的版本，是像 `'0.8.0'` 這樣的文字。

description.en: Useful in a bug report or to check which build a page got: `openaudiovisual.com/p5/oav-p5.js` is always the latest, while a jsDelivr address with a tag is frozen. The same number is on the first line of the 🩺 check-up.
description.zh: 回報問題或確認頁面拿到哪個版本時有用：`openaudiovisual.com/p5/oav-p5.js` 永遠是最新版，帶版本標籤的 jsDelivr 網址則是固定的。同一個數字也在 🩺 體檢的第一行。

value.en: Set when oav-p5 loads and never changes.
value.zh: oav-p5 載入時設定，之後不會變。

notes.en: If the file loads twice (the loader line and the OpenProcessing library list), the first one wins and the second does nothing.
notes.zh: 如果這個檔案載入了兩次（載入那一行和 OpenProcessing 的函式庫清單各一次），先載入的那一個生效，第二個什麼都不做。

caption.en: Shows the version of oav-p5 this page loaded.
caption.zh: 顯示這個頁面載入的 oav-p5 版本。

summary.en: The resting value of a pitch-bend wheel: 8192, the middle of the 14-bit range 0..16383.
summary.zh: 彎音輪休息時的數值：8192，也就是 14 位元範圍 0..16383 的中間。

description.en: Use it when you build a pitch-bend message by hand: `{ type: 'pitchbend', ch: 1, value: BEND_CENTER }` is a wheel at rest. Spring-loaded wheels in a profile (`spring`) go back to this value when released.
description.zh: 手動組彎音訊息時用得到：`{ type: 'pitchbend', ch: 1, value: BEND_CENTER }` 就是休息中的彎音輪。設定檔裡帶彈簧的彎音輪（`spring`）放開後會回到這個值。

value.en: A constant. A pitch-bend `value` equal to it means "not bent" and becomes 0 in [`bendToUnit()`](#bendToUnit).
value.zh: 常數。彎音輪的 `value` 等於它就表示「沒有彎」，在 [`bendToUnit()`](#bendToUnit) 裡會變成 0。

caption.en: Prints 8192, then the bytes of a pitch bend at rest.
caption.zh: 印出 8192，再印出休息位置彎音訊息的位元組。

summary.en: Turns a 14-bit pitch-bend value (0..16383) into −1..1, with the centre (8192) exactly 0.

description.en: MIDI centres pitch bend at 8192, so there are 8192 steps below the centre and 8191 above. Below the centre it divides by 8192 and above by 8191, so the bottom reaches exactly −1, the top exactly +1 and the rest position exactly 0. This is the number published as `midi/bend` and `midi/ch/<ch>/bend`.
description.zh: MIDI 把彎音輪的中心定在 8192，所以中心以下有 8192 級，以上有 8191 級。它在中心以下除以 8192，以上除以 8191，因此最低剛好是 −1，最高剛好是 +1，休息位置剛好是 0。發佈成 `midi/bend` 和 `midi/ch/<ch>/bend` 的就是這個數字。

params.name: v
params.en: A pitch-bend value, 0..16383 (what `parseMessage()` puts in `value`).
params.zh: 彎音輪的數值，0..16383（`parseMessage()` 放在 `value` 裡的那個）。

examples.code:
import { bendToUnit, unitToBend } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(bendToUnit(0), bendToUnit(8192), bendToUnit(16383));   // -1 0 1
console.log(bendToUnit(12288));                                    // about 0.5
console.log(unitToBend(bendToUnit(5000)));                         // 5000

caption.en: Prints −1, 0, 1, then about 0.5, then 5000: the round trip is exact.
caption.zh: 印出 −1、0、1，接著約 0.5，最後 5000：來回轉換不會失真。

summary.en: The kinds of control a profile may contain: `knob`, `encoder`, `fader`, `pad`, `button`, `keys`, `wheel`, `strip`.
summary.zh: 設定檔裡可以出現的控制項種類：`knob`、`encoder`、`fader`、`pad`、`button`、`keys`、`wheel`、`strip`。

description.en: What each sends: `knob` and `fader` a CC (0..1); `encoder` a CC that is either relative (position plus a `/delta` signal) or absolute; `pad` a note (velocity while held, with a `/hit` pulse) or a CC; `button` a note or CC, momentary or toggle; `keys` a range of notes; `wheel` and `strip` a CC or pitch bend, optionally bipolar and spring-loaded.
description.zh: 各自送什麼：`knob` 和 `fader` 送 CC（0..1）。`encoder` 送 CC，可以是相對（位置加上 `/delta` 訊號）或絕對。`pad` 送音符（按著時是力度，並有 `/hit` 脈衝）或 CC。`button` 送音符或 CC，可以是瞬間或切換。`keys` 是一段音域的音符。`wheel` 和 `strip` 送 CC 或彎音，可以是雙向，也可以帶彈簧。

value.en: A plain array. A control's `type` must be one of these or [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile) reports it.
value.zh: 一個普通陣列。控制項的 `type` 必須是其中之一，否則 [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile) 會回報。

caption.en: Prints how many controls of each type the shipped profiles hold, in the order of the list.
caption.zh: 依清單順序，印出內建設定檔裡每種控制項各有幾個。

summary.en: Builds mapper routes for "this control drives that param": `controllerRoutes(profile, { knob1: 'hue' })` routes the knob's signal to the param `hue`.
summary.zh: 建立「這個控制項推動那個參數」的 Mapper 路由：`controllerRoutes(profile, { knob1: 'hue' })` 會把旋鈕的訊號接到參數 `hue`。

description.en: This is rule 1 of the project (continuous control goes through params): a world does not read `midi/lpd8/k1` in `update()`, it declares a param and lets a route drive it. An id the profile does not have throws `profile akai-lpd8 has no control "x"`, so a typo is loud.
description.zh: 這是專案的第一條規則（連續控制要經過參數）：世界不在 `update()` 裡讀 `midi/lpd8/k1`，而是宣告一個參數，由路由來推動它。設定檔沒有的 id 會丟出 `profile akai-lpd8 has no control "x"`，打錯字一定看得見。

params.name: profile
params.en: The device's profile (raw or normalized): used to check the ids and to know which controls are bipolar.
params.zh: 那台機器的設定檔（原始或整理過的都行）：用來檢查 id，並判斷哪些控制項是雙向的。

params.name: bindings
params.en: `{ controlId: target }`, where `target` is a param name or a route object (`{ target, inMin, inMax, … }`). A pad written as `{ target: 'burst', on: 'hit' }` listens to the `/hit` pulse instead of its velocity.
params.zh: `{ 控制項 id: target }`，`target` 是參數名稱，或路由物件（`{ target, inMin, inMax, … }`）。打擊墊寫成 `{ target: 'burst', on: 'hit' }` 時，聽的是 `/hit` 脈衝而不是力度。

params.name: short
params.en: The signal namespace. The default is the profile's `short`; give another when you run the device under a different one.
params.zh: 訊號的命名空間，預設是設定檔的 `short`。同一台機器用了別的命名空間時才需要改。

params.name: extra
params.en: Every other key of the third argument (`{ inMin: 0, inMax: 0.5 }`) is copied onto each route as a default; a key in the route object itself wins.
params.zh: 第三個參數裡其他的鍵（例如 `{ inMin: 0, inMax: 0.5 }`）會當成預設值複製到每一條路由上，路由物件自己有的鍵優先。

returns.en: `[{ source, target, … }]`, ready for `mapper.addRoute(route)`. A bipolar control (a pitch wheel) gets `inMin: -1, inMax: 1`. Any other key in the third argument is copied onto every route.
returns.zh: `[{ source, target, … }]`，可以直接用 `mapper.addRoute(route)`。雙向的控制項（彎音輪）會自動加上 `inMin: -1, inMax: 1`。第三個參數裡的其他鍵，會複製到每一條路由上。

caption.en: Prints `midi/lpd8/k1 -> hue`, `midi/lpd8/k2 -> size` and `midi/lpd8/pad1/hit -> burst`: the signal each control drives its param from.
caption.zh: 印出 `midi/lpd8/k1 -> hue`、`midi/lpd8/k2 -> size` 和 `midi/lpd8/pad1/hit -> burst`：每個控制項用哪個訊號去推動它的參數。

entries.name: createVirtualMIDIAccess
entries.signature: createVirtualMIDIAccess({ name = 'OAV Virtual MIDI', manufacturer = 'open-audiovisual', id = 'oav-virtual', sysex = false, onOutput = null, onClear = null } = {})

summary.en: Builds a Web MIDI `MIDIAccess` that always has one more input and output of its own, so a sketch written for a MIDI keyboard works with none plugged in.
summary.zh: 建立一個 Web MIDI 的 `MIDIAccess`，它永遠多出一組自己的輸入和輸出，讓寫給 MIDI 鍵盤的草圖在沒有接任何機器時也能動。

description.en: A 2018 sketch that calls `navigator.requestMIDIAccess()` (or WebMidi.js) and waits for a keyboard shows nothing on a laptop without one, and on an iPad has no Web MIDI at all. Hand it this access instead and the on-screen controller becomes a real-looking MIDI input: the sketch's own unmodified code receives `midimessage` events with the same bytes a keyboard sends.
description.zh: 2018 年寫的草圖呼叫 `navigator.requestMIDIAccess()`（或 WebMidi.js）然後等鍵盤，在沒有鍵盤的筆電上什麼都不會出現，在 iPad 上更是完全沒有 Web MIDI。改成交給它這個 access，螢幕上的控制器就變成一個看起來像真的 MIDI 輸入：草圖原封不動的程式碼，會收到跟鍵盤送出的位元組一模一樣的 `midimessage` 事件。

description.en: The virtual OUTPUT is a real-looking port too: a program that plays out to it (Strudel's `.midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')`, a WebMidi.js sketch) calls `send(bytes, timestamp)`, and `onOutput` hears both. Real ports can be merged in with `addReal(realAccess)`: they come FIRST in `inputs`, the virtual one last, so a sketch that only listens to `inputs[0]` takes the hardware when it is there and the virtual controller when it is not. Real ports pass through untouched, so nothing is delivered twice.
description.zh: 虛擬「輸出」也長得像真的埠：對它輸出的程式（Strudel 的 `.midi('OAV Virtual MIDI')`、WebMidi.js 草圖）會呼叫 `send(bytes, timestamp)`，`onOutput` 會同時收到位元組和時間戳。可以用 `addReal(realAccess)` 併入真實的埠：它們排在 `inputs` 的「前面」，虛擬的排最後，所以只聽 `inputs[0]` 的草圖，有硬體時用硬體，沒有時用虛擬控制器。真實的埠原封不動地穿過，所以不會重複送達。

params.name: name
params.en: The name of the virtual port, as the sketch sees it.
params.zh: 虛擬埠的名稱，也就是草圖看到的名字。

params.name: manufacturer
params.en: The `manufacturer` the virtual ports report.
params.zh: 虛擬埠回報的 `manufacturer`。

params.name: id
params.en: The port id prefix: the ports are `<id>-in` and `<id>-out`.
params.zh: 埠 id 的前綴：埠的 id 是 `<id>-in` 和 `<id>-out`。

params.name: sysex
params.en: What `access.sysexEnabled` reports.
params.zh: `access.sysexEnabled` 回報的值。

params.name: onOutput
params.en: `(bytes, timestamp) => …` called when a program sends to the virtual OUTPUT. `timestamp` is when the bytes should sound (`performance.now()` milliseconds), or `undefined` for "now".
params.zh: 程式送到虛擬「輸出」時呼叫的 `(bytes, timestamp) => …`。`timestamp` 是這些位元組該發聲的時間（`performance.now()` 毫秒），`undefined` 表示「現在」。

params.name: onClear
params.en: Called when the program calls `output.clear()` (Web MIDI: drop what is still waiting).
params.zh: 程式呼叫 `output.clear()` 時被呼叫（Web MIDI 的意思是：丟掉還在排隊的）。

returns.en: `{ access, input, output, emit(bytes), addReal(realAccess), real, requests, dispose() }`. Give `access` to the program. `emit()` plays bytes into the virtual input.
returns.zh: `{ access, input, output, emit(bytes), addReal(realAccess), real, requests, dispose() }`。把 `access` 交給程式。`emit()` 把位元組彈進虛擬輸入。

notes.en: `access.inputs` and `access.outputs` are `Map`s, as in Web MIDI. `input.listening` counts the listeners a program put on the port, and `requests` counts how often [`virtualRequestMIDIAccess()`](#virtualRequestMIDIAccess) handed the access out.
notes.zh: 跟 Web MIDI 一樣，`access.inputs` 和 `access.outputs` 都是 `Map`。`input.listening` 是程式在這個埠上掛了幾個監聽，`requests` 是 [`virtualRequestMIDIAccess()`](#virtualRequestMIDIAccess) 把這個 access 交出去幾次。

caption.en: Prints the port name with 0 listeners, then `program heard [144, 60, 100]`, then `program played [144, 62, 80] undefined` (no timestamp means "now").
caption.zh: 印出埠名與 0 個監聽，接著是 `program heard [144, 60, 100]`，再來是 `program played [144, 62, 80] undefined`（沒有時間戳就是「現在」）。

tbd.en: Not tried for this page: a real WebMidi.js or Strudel sketch talking to the virtual ports, and how the `onOutput` timestamps line up with a hardware port. The example calls the ports directly.
tbd.zh: 這一頁沒有實測：真正的 WebMidi.js 或 Strudel 草圖跟虛擬埠對話，以及 `onOutput` 的時間戳跟硬體埠比起來對不對得上。範例是直接呼叫那些埠。

summary.en: The profile id used when none is given: `'arturia-minilab3'`.
summary.zh: 沒有指定時使用的設定檔 id：`'arturia-minilab3'`。

description.en: [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) fills `profile` with it. [`createController()`](#createController) and [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) have the same id as their own default.
description.zh: [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) 會用它填入 `profile`。[`createController()`](#createController) 和 [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) 自己的預設值也是同一個 id。

value.en: A constant. `<oav-controller>` without a `profile` attribute and the iframe embed without `?profile=` show this device.
value.zh: 常數。沒有 `profile` 屬性的 `<oav-controller>`，和沒有 `?profile=` 的 iframe 嵌入，都會顯示這台機器。

caption.en: Prints `arturia-minilab3`, then `true`.
caption.zh: 印出 `arturia-minilab3`，再印出 `true`。

summary.en: Returns a short readable line for a parsed MIDI event, for logs and learn screens: `CC ch1 #74=64`, `Bend ch1 0.50`.
summary.zh: 把解析過的 MIDI 事件變成一行好讀的文字，給記錄和學習畫面用：`CC ch1 #74=64`、`Bend ch1 0.50`。

description.en: The formats are `Note On  ch1 n60 v100` (two spaces after "On"), `Note Off ch1 n60`, `CC ch1 #74=64`, `Bend ch1 0.50` (the bend as −1..1 with two decimals), `Pressure ch1 50`, `Poly AT ch1 n60 33` and `Program ch1 5`. The [`Midi`](#Midi) engine writes one of these to its log for each message it parses (clock is left out).
description.zh: 格式是 `Note On  ch1 n60 v100`（On 後面兩個空格）、`Note Off ch1 n60`、`CC ch1 #74=64`、`Bend ch1 0.50`（彎音換成 −1..1，兩位小數）、`Pressure ch1 50`、`Poly AT ch1 n60 33`、`Program ch1 5`。[`Midi`](#Midi) 引擎解析的每則訊息（時鐘除外），都會把這樣的一行寫進它的記錄。

params.name: ev
params.en: An event from [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage).
params.zh: [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) 回傳的事件。

returns.en: The line. `null` gives `?`, and a type without a format (`clock`, `sysex`) gives its type name.
returns.zh: 那一行文字。給 `null` 回傳 `?`，沒有格式的類型（`clock`、`sysex`）則回傳類型名稱。

notes.en: Easily confused with `describeMessage()` and `describeDetail()`, which write the shorter lines the `<oav-controller>` readout shows (`CC 70 = 53`). This one takes an event and is meant for logs.
notes.zh: 容易跟 `describeMessage()`、`describeDetail()` 搞混：那兩個寫的是 `<oav-controller>` 讀數列用的較短文字（`CC 70 = 53`）。這一個吃事件物件，是給記錄用的。

caption.en: Prints `Note On  ch1 n60 v100`, `CC ch1 #74=64` and `Bend ch1 0.50`.
caption.zh: 印出 `Note On  ch1 n60 v100`、`CC ch1 #74=64` 和 `Bend ch1 0.50`。

summary.en: Recognises our own MIDI messages coming back: remember what was sent, and an identical message arriving within a short window is an echo, not a performer.
summary.zh: 認出「自己送出的 MIDI 又回來了」：記住送出過什麼，短時間內抵達的相同訊息就是回音，不是演奏者彈的。

description.en: A virtual cable or a DAW can send your message straight back on an input, and the engine would treat it as a performer. `sent(bytes)` records a message and `isEcho(bytes)` asks whether an arriving one is that message returning. Each sent message cancels at most ONE echo, so two real identical messages are not both eaten.
description.zh: 虛擬線路或 DAW 可能把你送出的訊息原樣從輸入送回來，引擎會把它當成演奏者。`sent(bytes)` 記下一則訊息，`isEcho(bytes)` 問「剛到的這則是不是那一則回來了」。每則送出的訊息最多只抵銷「一個」回音，所以兩則真正相同的訊息不會被一起吃掉。

description.en: A note-on with velocity 0 counts as a note-off, in both directions, because a DAW may rewrite one as the other. System messages (clock and the like) are never recorded. [`Midi`](#Midi) has one (`midi.echo`, with the `echoWindow` option) and drops the echoes it finds, counted in `midi.echoDropped`.
description.zh: 力度 0 的 note-on 當成 note-off，雙向都算，因為 DAW 可能把其中一種改寫成另一種。系統訊息（時鐘之類）不會被記錄。[`Midi`](#Midi) 內建一個（`midi.echo`，由 `echoWindow` 選項設定），並把找到的回音丟掉，數量記在 `midi.echoDropped`。

params.name: window
params.en: Milliseconds an echo may take to come back. `0` turns the guard off.
params.zh: 回音可以晚多久回來（毫秒）。`0` 表示關閉。

params.name: max
params.en: How many sent messages to remember. Only the newest `max` are kept.
params.zh: 要記住幾則送出的訊息，只留最新的 `max` 則。

caption.en: Prints `true`, `false`, `false`: an echo is used up once, and a message that arrives too late is a real note.
caption.zh: 印出 `true`、`false`、`false`：回音只抵銷一次，太晚到的訊息是真的音符。

members.name: sent
members.doc: Record a message we just sent.

members.name: isEcho
members.doc: Is this arriving message our own coming back?

summary.en: Turns an event object back into MIDI bytes, the inverse of `parseMessage()`: `{ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 74, value: 64 }` becomes `[0xb0, 74, 64]`.
summary.zh: 把事件物件轉回 MIDI 位元組，是 `parseMessage()` 的反向：`{ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 74, value: 64 }` 會變成 `[0xb0, 74, 64]`。

description.en: `encodeMessage({ type: 'noteon', ch: 10, note: 36, vel: 127 })` is `[0x99, 36, 127]`. The channel is held to 1..16 and every data byte is rounded and held to 0..127, so a bad value cannot produce an invalid message. A missing `vel` is 100 for `noteon` and 0 for `noteoff`.
description.zh: `encodeMessage({ type: 'noteon', ch: 10, note: 36, vel: 127 })` 得到 `[0x99, 36, 127]`。頻道會限制在 1..16，每個資料位元組都會四捨五入並限制在 0..127，所以錯誤的數值做不出不合法的訊息。沒給 `vel` 的話，`noteon` 是 100，`noteoff` 是 0。

description.en: A `pitchbend` `value` (0..16383) is split into two 7-bit bytes, low byte first, as MIDI requires. The package uses this for the on-screen controller and for LED feedback.
description.zh: `pitchbend` 的 `value`（0..16383）會照 MIDI 規定拆成兩個 7 位元的位元組，低位在前。套件用它來做螢幕上的控制器和 LED 回饋。

params.name: ev
params.en: An event: `type` is `noteon`, `noteoff`, `polyat`, `cc`, `program`, `chanat` or `pitchbend`, with the fields [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) uses for that type. `ch` defaults to 1.
params.zh: 事件物件：`type` 是 `noteon`、`noteoff`、`polyat`、`cc`、`program`、`chanat` 或 `pitchbend`，欄位跟 [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) 對該類型用的一樣。`ch` 預設是 1。

returns.en: The bytes, ready for `output.send()`. `null` for a type it cannot make (`clock`, `sysex`, anything unknown).
returns.zh: 位元組陣列，可以直接給 `output.send()`。做不出來的類型（`clock`、`sysex`、不認得的）回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `[153, 36, 127]` (0x99, 0x24, 0x7f), then the event it came from.

examples.code:
import { encodeMessage } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(encodeMessage({ type: 'pitchbend', ch: 1, value: 8192 }));  // centre: [224, 0, 64]
console.log(encodeMessage({ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 74, value: 300 }));  // value held to 127
console.log(encodeMessage({ type: 'clock' }));                          // null

caption.en: Three results: the pitch-bend centre, a value held to 127, and `null` for a message type it cannot make.
caption.zh: 三個結果：彎音輪的中心、被限制在 127 的數值，以及做不出來的訊息類型回傳 `null`。

summary.en: The inverse of `genericSignals()`: turns one generic MIDI signal (`midi/ch/10/note/36`, `midi/cc/74`) back into the MIDI event it came from.
summary.zh: `genericSignals()` 的反向：把一個通用的 MIDI 訊號（`midi/ch/10/note/36`、`midi/cc/74`）轉回它原本的 MIDI 事件。

description.en: It lets anything that only hears a [`Signals`](/docs/#signals-openav-midi) bus (a recorded take playing back, the on-screen piano, a phone) drive a controller model as if the bytes had arrived. Values come back on the 0..127 scale they were published from (value × 127, rounded), so the round trip through `genericSignals()` is exact.
description.zh: 有了它，只聽得到 [`Signals`](/zh/docs/#signals-openav-midi) 匯流排的東西（正在回放的錄音、螢幕上的鋼琴、手機），也能像收到原始位元組一樣去推動控制器模型。數值會還原成當初發佈時的 0..127 尺度（值 × 127 再四捨五入），所以跟 `genericSignals()` 來回轉換不會失真。

description.en: A note signal with a value above 0 is a `noteon` (velocity at least 1), and 0 is a `noteoff`. The on-screen piano publishes channel 0, which is read as `channel`. A hardware message is published under both families, so a listener that wants each message once should use [`followMidiSignals()`](#followMidiSignals) instead of calling this on every name.
description.zh: 音符訊號的值大於 0 是 `noteon`（力度至少 1），等於 0 是 `noteoff`。螢幕上的鋼琴發佈的頻道是 0，會被當成 `channel` 參數。硬體的一則訊息會用兩組名稱各發佈一次，所以想「每則訊息只處理一次」的話，請用 [`followMidiSignals()`](#followMidiSignals)，不要對每個名稱都呼叫這個函式。

params.name: name
params.en: A signal name. Only the generic names starting with `midi/` are understood.
params.zh: 訊號名稱。只認得 `midi/` 開頭的通用名稱。

params.name: value
params.en: The signal's value: a number 0..1 (−1..1 for bend), or the `{ note, vel, velocity, ch }` payload of `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off`.
params.zh: 訊號的值：0..1 的數字（彎音是 −1..1），或 `midi/note/on`、`midi/note/off` 那個 `{ note, vel, velocity, ch }` 內容。

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel to use for the legacy names that carry none (`midi/cc/<n>`, `midi/bend`).
params.zh: 沒有頻道資訊的短名稱（`midi/cc/<n>`、`midi/bend`）要用哪個頻道。

returns.en: `family` is `'channel'` or `'legacy'`, and `ev` is the event. `null` for a device name (`midi/minilab3/…`), `midi/virtual` and anything else.
returns.zh: `family` 是 `'channel'` 或 `'legacy'`，`ev` 是事件。裝置名稱（`midi/minilab3/…`）、`midi/virtual` 和其他名稱都回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints a `noteon` on channel 10 with velocity 64, a CC 74 on channel 4 with value 127, then `null`.
caption.zh: 印出頻道 10、力度 64 的 `noteon`，頻道 4、值 127 的 CC 74，最後是 `null`。

summary.en: Finds a MIDI port by name: a `/regex/flags`, then the exact name, then a case-insensitive substring; `null` when nothing matches.
summary.zh: 用名稱找 MIDI 埠：先試 `/regex/flags`，再試完整名稱，最後試不分大小寫的子字串，都找不到就回傳 `null`。

description.en: This is how the `midi-out` attribute, the `hardware` attribute's port name and [`createController()`](#createController)'s `setOutput(query)` read what you typed.
description.zh: `midi-out` 屬性、`hardware` 屬性裡的埠名，以及 [`createController()`](#createController) 的 `setOutput(query)`，都是用它來理解你打的字。

params.name: ports
params.en: Ports with a `name` (an array, such as `midi.outputs`).
params.zh: 有 `name` 的埠（陣列，例如 `midi.outputs`）。

params.name: query
params.en: A name, a part of a name (`'IAC'`, `'loopMIDI'`), or `'/^mini/'`. Flags after the closing slash are used; without flags the regex is case-insensitive.
params.zh: 名稱、名稱的一部分（`'IAC'`、`'loopMIDI'`），或 `'/^mini/'`。結尾斜線後面的旗標會被採用，沒寫旗標的話正規表示式不分大小寫。

returns.en: The first matching port. A broken regex finds nothing instead of throwing.
returns.zh: 第一個符合的埠。壞掉的正規表示式只會找不到，不會丟出錯誤。

caption.en: Prints `IAC Driver Bus 1`, `Minilab3 MIDI`, `null`, `null`.
caption.zh: 印出 `IAC Driver Bus 1`、`Minilab3 MIDI`、`null`、`null`。

summary.en: Finds a profile in a list by id or short name, or returns `null`; no validation, no loading.
summary.zh: 在清單裡用 id 或短名稱找設定檔，找不到回傳 `null`，不驗證也不載入。

description.en: Use it when you hold your own list, for example the profiles a picker offers (`controller.controllers.profiles`), and want the same id-or-short lookup the element uses.
description.zh: 手上有自己的清單時用，例如選單提供的設定檔（`controller.controllers.profiles`），而你想用跟元素相同的「id 或短名稱」查法。

params.name: ref
params.en: A profile `id` or `short` name.
params.zh: 設定檔的 `id` 或 `short` 短名稱。

params.name: profiles
params.en: The list to search (required here, unlike [`profileById()`](#profileById), which uses the shipped ones).
params.zh: 要搜尋的清單（這裡一定要給，不像 [`profileById()`](#profileById) 固定用內建的）。

returns.en: The profile in the list.
returns.zh: 清單裡的那份設定檔。

caption.en: Prints `akai-lpd8`, `lpd8` and `null`.
caption.zh: 印出 `akai-lpd8`、`lpd8` 和 `null`。

entries.name: genericSignals
entries.signature: genericSignals(ev, { device = null, legacy = true, channel = true } = {})

summary.en: Lists the device-independent signals one MIDI event becomes: `midi/cc/74`, `midi/note/on`, `midi/bend`, and their per-channel twins such as `midi/ch/2/cc/74`.
summary.zh: 列出一則 MIDI 事件會變成哪些跟裝置無關的訊號：`midi/cc/74`、`midi/note/on`、`midi/bend`，以及各頻道版本，例如 `midi/ch/2/cc/74`。

description.en: Two families, both published for every hardware port and every virtual controller. The short ones are what most worlds read: a `noteon` becomes the pulse `midi/note/on` with `{ note, vel (0..1), velocity (1..127), ch, device }`, a `noteoff` becomes `midi/note/off` with `{ note, ch, device }`, a `cc` becomes `midi/cc/<n>` (0..1), and a `pitchbend` becomes `midi/bend` (−1..1).
description.zh: 兩組名稱，每個硬體連接埠和每個虛擬控制器都會發佈。短名稱是大多數世界讀的：`noteon` 變成脈衝 `midi/note/on`，內容是 `{ note, vel（0..1）, velocity（1..127）, ch, device }`。`noteoff` 變成 `midi/note/off`，內容是 `{ note, ch, device }`。`cc` 變成 `midi/cc/<n>`（0..1），`pitchbend` 變成 `midi/bend`（−1..1）。

description.en: The per-channel ones are for two devices that share a CC number, or a work that cares about the channel: `midi/ch/<ch>/note/<n>` (velocity 0..1 while held, 0 on release), `midi/ch/<ch>/cc/<n>`, `midi/ch/<ch>/bend`, `midi/ch/<ch>/pressure` (channel aftertouch) and `midi/ch/<ch>/poly/<n>` (polyphonic aftertouch). Pressure and poly exist only in this family. `program`, `clock` and the other system messages produce nothing.
description.zh: 分頻道的那組給「兩台機器共用同一個 CC 編號」或「作品在意頻道」的時候用：`midi/ch/<ch>/note/<n>`（按著時是力度 0..1，放開是 0）、`midi/ch/<ch>/cc/<n>`、`midi/ch/<ch>/bend`、`midi/ch/<ch>/pressure`（頻道觸後）、`midi/ch/<ch>/poly/<n>`（複音觸後）。壓力和 poly 只存在於這一組。`program`、`clock` 和其他系統訊息不會產生訊號。

description.en: There is deliberately no `midi/cc/<ch>/<n>`: under prefix subscriptions it would collide with "CC 1 on any channel".
description.zh: 刻意沒有 `midi/cc/<ch>/<n>` 這種名稱：用前綴訂閱時，它會跟「任何頻道的 CC 1」搞混。

params.name: ev
params.en: An event from [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage). `null` gives an empty list.
params.zh: [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) 回傳的事件。給 `null` 會得到空陣列。

params.name: device
params.en: Written into the `device` field of the `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off` pulses (the port slug).
params.zh: 寫進 `midi/note/on`、`midi/note/off` 脈衝的 `device` 欄位（連接埠的 slug）。

params.name: legacy
params.en: Include the short names that ignore the channel (`midi/note/on`, `midi/cc/<n>`, `midi/bend`).
params.zh: 是否包含不分頻道的短名稱（`midi/note/on`、`midi/cc/<n>`、`midi/bend`）。

params.name: channel
params.en: Include the per-channel names (`midi/ch/<ch>/…`).
params.zh: 是否包含分頻道的名稱（`midi/ch/<ch>/…`）。

returns.en: One item per signal. Hand the list to [`publish()`](#publish).
returns.zh: 每個訊號一項。把整個陣列交給 [`publish()`](#publish) 即可。

caption.en: Prints `['midi/cc/74', 'midi/ch/2/cc/74']`, then the two note-on names, then the single per-channel pressure name.
caption.zh: 印出 `['midi/cc/74', 'midi/ch/2/cc/74']`，接著是 note-on 的兩個名稱，最後是只有分頻道版本的壓力名稱。

caption.en: The first prints the pulse payload `{ note: 60, vel: 0.787…, velocity: 100, ch: 1, device: 'my-keys' }`, the second only the per-channel name.
caption.zh: 第一行印出脈衝內容 `{ note: 60, vel: 0.787…, velocity: 100, ch: 1, device: 'my-keys' }`，第二行只剩分頻道的名稱。

summary.en: Groups a profile's controls by their `group` (`knob`, `pad`, `fader` …), returning `{ group: [control ids] }`.
summary.zh: 依 `group`（`knob`、`pad`、`fader` …）把設定檔的控制項分組，回傳 `{ group: [控制項 id] }`。

description.en: The groups follow the TouchDesigner tool's out CHOPs (`out_knob`, `out_slider`, `out_pad` …). A control gets its type as group unless the profile gives another. [`MidiController`](#MidiController) has a method of the same name that returns the current values instead of the ids.
description.zh: 分組方式跟 TouchDesigner 工具的輸出 CHOP（`out_knob`、`out_slider`、`out_pad` …）一致。控制項沒特別指定的話，就用它的類型當分組。[`MidiController`](#MidiController) 有個同名的方法，回傳的是目前的數值，不是 id。

params.name: p
params.en: A normalized profile, so every control has its `group` filled in.
params.zh: 整理過的設定檔，這樣每個控制項才有 `group`。

returns.en: An object of arrays of control ids.
returns.zh: 由控制項 id 陣列組成的物件。

caption.en: Prints the group names and then the eight knob ids.
caption.zh: 印出分組名稱，再印出八個旋鈕的 id。

summary.en: Builds the lookup from a MIDI message to the control it moves: `"cc:1:74"` maps to the knob listening for CC 74 on channel 1.
summary.zh: 建立「MIDI 訊息 → 它會推動的控制項」的查詢表：`"cc:1:74"` 對應到聽頻道 1 的 CC 74 的那顆旋鈕。

description.en: This is how [`MidiController`](#MidiController) decides which control a message belongs to. Use it to build your own router. Each value is a list because a message can move more than one control.
description.zh: [`MidiController`](#MidiController) 就是用它判斷一則訊息屬於哪個控制項。要自己做路由時可以拿來用。每個值都是清單，因為一則訊息可能推動不只一個控制項。

params.name: p
params.en: A normalized profile (each control needs its `ch`).
params.zh: 整理過的設定檔（每個控制項都要有 `ch`）。

returns.en: The keys are `cc:<ch>:<cc>`, `note:<ch>:<note>`, `polyat:<ch>:<note>`, `pitchbend:<ch>`, `chanat:<ch>`, `program:<ch>`. A keys control gets one entry per note of its range.
returns.zh: 鍵的格式是 `cc:<ch>:<cc>`、`note:<ch>:<note>`、`polyat:<ch>:<note>`、`pitchbend:<ch>`、`chanat:<ch>`、`program:<ch>`。琴鍵控制項的音域裡每個音都有一筆。

caption.en: Prints `['k1']` for CC 70, `['pad1']` for note 36 on channel 10, and `undefined` for a message the device does not send.
caption.zh: 印出 CC 70 對應的 `['k1']`、頻道 10 音符 36 對應的 `['pad1']`，以及這台機器不會送的訊息所對應的 `undefined`。

summary.en: Says whether a MIDI port can still be sent to: it exists and its `state` is not `'disconnected'`.
summary.zh: 判斷一個 MIDI 埠還能不能送資料：它存在，而且 `state` 不是 `'disconnected'`。

description.en: A port that was unplugged can still be an object in your hands. Sending to it gets nowhere, and the engine's try/catch swallows the error, so nothing on screen says why. The output rules ([`pickOutput()`](#pickOutput), [`reselectOutput()`](#reselectOutput)) therefore skip every port that is not live.
description.zh: 被拔掉的埠，在你手上仍然是個物件。對它送資料到不了任何地方，引擎的 try/catch 又會把錯誤吞掉，畫面上看不出原因。所以輸出的挑選規則（[`pickOutput()`](#pickOutput)、[`reselectOutput()`](#reselectOutput)）會跳過所有不存活的埠。

params.name: p
params.en: A port shaped like a `MIDIOutput`: it only needs a `state`.
params.zh: 長得像 `MIDIOutput` 的埠，只需要有 `state`。

returns.en: `false` for `null` and for a disconnected port.
returns.zh: 給 `null` 或已斷線的埠回傳 `false`。

examples.code:
import { isLive } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(isLive({ name: 'A', state: 'connected' }));      // true
console.log(isLive({ name: 'B', state: 'disconnected' }));   // false
console.log(isLive(null));                                   // false

caption.en: Prints `true`, `false`, `false`.
caption.zh: 印出 `true`、`false`、`false`。

summary.en: Tells a URL to a profile file apart from a profile id: `true` for `./pads.json`, `https://…`, `/p/x`, `false` for `'akai-lpd8'`.
summary.zh: 分辨「指向設定檔的網址」和「設定檔 id」：`./pads.json`、`https://…`、`/p/x` 回傳 `true`，`'akai-lpd8'` 回傳 `false`。

description.en: It is the test [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile) uses to decide between looking an id up and fetching a file. A bare name that happens to end in `.json` also counts as a URL.
description.zh: [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile) 就是用它決定要「查 id」還是「抓檔案」。剛好以 `.json` 結尾的單純名稱也會被當成網址。

params.name: ref
params.en: What the page or attribute gave. Anything that is not a string is `false`.
params.zh: 頁面或屬性給的內容。不是字串一律是 `false`。

returns.en: `true` when the string starts with `http:`, `https:`, `blob:` or `data:`, starts with `/`, `./` or `../`, or ends in `.json` (optionally followed by `?…` or `#…`).
returns.zh: 字串以 `http:`、`https:`、`blob:`、`data:` 開頭，或以 `/`、`./`、`../` 開頭，或以 `.json` 結尾（後面可接 `?…` 或 `#…`）時為 `true`。

caption.en: Prints `false` for the id and `true` for the other four.
caption.zh: id 印出 `false`，其他四個印出 `true`。

summary.en: Links the on-screen controllers to phones over the room relay: tells phones which device is on screen, echoes this machine's moves to them, and mirrors theirs here.
summary.zh: 透過房間中繼把螢幕上的控制器和手機連起來：告訴手機現在螢幕上是哪台機器，把這台電腦上的動作回傳給手機，也把手機的動作鏡射到這裡。

description.en: A phone's MIDI tab publishes the device's signals itself (the controller lives there), so this side only does three things. When you `select` another device it tells the phones with `relay.config('midi', { profile })`. When a knob, fader, encoder, wheel, strip or toggle button on THIS machine moves from hardware or the screen, it queues `relay.feedback('midi/<short>/<id>', value)` so the phone's knobs follow. When a phone plays (`midi/virtual`) it mirrors that on this screen, state and view only, because the phone already published the signals.
description.zh: 手機的 MIDI 分頁自己會發佈機器的訊號（控制器就住在那裡），所以這一端只做三件事。你用 `select` 換了機器，就用 `relay.config('midi', { profile })` 告訴手機。這台電腦上的旋鈕、推桿、編碼器、彎音輪、觸控條或切換按鈕被硬體或螢幕動了，就把 `relay.feedback('midi/<short>/<id>', value)` 排進佇列，讓手機上的旋鈕跟著動。手機彈了（`midi/virtual`），就鏡射在這個螢幕上，只更新狀態和畫面，因為手機已經發佈過訊號了。

description.en: This is what `@openav/remote`'s show-side host and the lab's midi module call. You need it only when you wire phones into a page yourself.
description.zh: `@openav/remote` 在演出端的主機，和實驗室的 midi 模組，用的就是它。只有在你自己把手機接進頁面時才需要。

params.name: relay
params.en: A relay client with `config(name, value)` and `feedback(signalName, value)` (the show runner's `RelayClient`).
params.zh: 中繼客戶端，要有 `config(name, value)` 和 `feedback(signalName, value)`（演出執行器的 `RelayClient`）。

params.name: signals
params.en: The bus the phones' `midi/virtual` messages arrive on.
params.zh: 手機的 `midi/virtual` 訊息抵達的匯流排。

params.name: controllers
params.en: The manager whose controllers are linked.
params.zh: 要連起來的控制器所屬的管理器。

returns.en: `flush()` sends the queued feedback to the relay (call it at a steady pace, for example once per frame). `dispose()` stops listening.
returns.zh: `flush()` 把佇列中的回饋送給中繼（以穩定的節奏呼叫，例如每個畫面一次）。`dispose()` 停止監聽。

caption.en: Prints `feedback midi/lpd8/k1 0.50` after the flush, then `config midi { profile: 'korg-nanokontrol2' }` when the device on screen changes.
caption.zh: flush 之後印出 `feedback midi/lpd8/k1 0.50`，螢幕上的裝置換掉時再印出 `config midi { profile: 'korg-nanokontrol2' }`。

summary.en: Loads a controller profile by id, short name or URL (a JSON file anywhere CORS allows), checking any file or object you give it; returns a promise.
summary.zh: 用 id、短名稱或網址（任何 CORS 允許的 JSON 檔）載入控制器設定檔，你給的檔案或物件會先檢查，回傳 promise。

description.en: It is [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile) with the shipped profiles and the page's base URL filled in. `<oav-controller profile="./my-device.json">` calls it to read your file. A bad file says why instead of drawing nothing.
description.zh: 它就是 [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile)，只是已經幫你帶入內建設定檔和頁面的基底網址。`<oav-controller profile="./my-device.json">` 就是呼叫它來讀你的檔案。檔案有問題時會說明原因，而不是什麼都不畫。

params.name: ref
params.en: An id (`'akai-lpd8'`), a short name (`'lpd8'`), a URL or path to a profile JSON, or a profile object.
params.zh: id（`'akai-lpd8'`）、短名稱（`'lpd8'`）、設定檔 JSON 的網址或路徑，或是設定檔物件。

params.name: o
params.en: Options passed on to [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile): `fetch`, `base`, and `profiles` (default: every shipped profile). `base` defaults to the page's `document.baseURI`, so a relative path is read from the page.
params.zh: 轉交給 [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile) 的選項：`fetch`、`base`，以及 `profiles`（預設是所有內建設定檔）。`base` 預設是頁面的 `document.baseURI`，所以相對路徑會以頁面為準。

returns.en: The raw profile. Rejects with every problem listed when a file or object is invalid, or with `unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)` when an id does not exist.
returns.zh: 原始的設定檔。檔案或物件不合法時 reject，並列出所有問題。id 不存在則 reject 為 `unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)`。

caption.en: Prints `akai-lpd8 16`, then the beginning of the error for an id that does not exist (it goes on to list every known id).
caption.zh: 印出 `akai-lpd8 16`，再印出不存在的 id 所產生的錯誤訊息開頭（後面還會列出所有認得的 id）。

caption.en: Prints the full URL it fetched (`https://example.com/show/profiles/my-lpd8.json`), then `My LPD8`.
caption.zh: 印出它抓取的完整網址（`https://example.com/show/profiles/my-lpd8.json`），再印出 `My LPD8`。

summary.en: Finds the device profile that owns a MIDI port name, such as `'Minilab3 MIDI'`, by testing each profile's `match` patterns.
summary.zh: 用各個設定檔的 `match` 規則，找出「這個 MIDI 埠名」屬於哪一台機器，例如 `'Minilab3 MIDI'`。

description.en: Only `device` profiles are considered (a generic layout never matches by name). A profile matches when one of its `match.ports` regular expressions (case-insensitive) hits the name. The score starts at 1, gains 1 when a `match.prefer` pattern also hits, and loses 2 when a `match.avoid` pattern hits. The highest positive score wins, so a port a device only exposes for something else (`Minilab3 DIN THRU`, `Minilab3 MCU/HUI`) does not match.
description.zh: 只考慮 `device` 設定檔（通用版面永遠不會靠名稱配對）。設定檔的某個 `match.ports` 正規表示式（不分大小寫）對得上名稱，就算符合。分數從 1 開始，`match.prefer` 也對上就加 1，`match.avoid` 對上就扣 2。取最高的正分，所以機器為了別的用途開出來的埠（`Minilab3 DIN THRU`、`Minilab3 MCU/HUI`）不會被配對。

description.en: This is how [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers) turns a plugged-in device into the right on-screen controller. When a device exposes several ports, [`pickPort()`](#pickPort) chooses which one to listen to.
description.zh: [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers) 就是靠它把接上的機器變成正確的螢幕控制器。一台機器開出好幾個埠時，由 [`pickPort()`](#pickPort) 決定聽哪一個。

params.name: portName
params.en: The name of a MIDI input port.
params.zh: MIDI 輸入埠的名稱。

params.name: profiles
params.en: The profiles to search, usually [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES).
params.zh: 要搜尋的設定檔，通常是 [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES)。

returns.en: The best match, or `null` when no `device` profile fits.
returns.zh: 最佳的符合者。沒有任何 `device` 設定檔符合時回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `akai-lpd8 (score 1)`, `arturia-minilab3 (score 2)`, then `null` for the DIN THRU port and for an unknown synth.
caption.zh: 印出 `akai-lpd8 (score 1)`、`arturia-minilab3 (score 2)`，DIN THRU 埠和不認識的合成器則是 `null`。

entries.name: Midi
entries.signature: new Midi({ signals = null, filterOut = 'IAC', requestAccess = null, echoWindow = 40, prefer = [] } = {})

summary.en: The Web MIDI engine: asks the browser for access, listens to every input, publishes what arrives as signals, and sends to one output port.
summary.zh: Web MIDI 引擎：向瀏覽器要存取權，聽每一個輸入埠，把收到的訊息發佈成訊號，並送到一個輸出埠。

description.en: Create it, then `await midi.enable()`. It resolves `true` once the browser has given access and `false` when there is no Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) or the permission was refused; the reason is written to the log (`onMessage`). Nothing is listened to or sent before that.
description.zh: 建立之後，`await midi.enable()`。瀏覽器給了存取權就回傳 `true`，沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad）或權限被拒絕就回傳 `false`，原因會寫進記錄（`onMessage`）。在那之前不會聽也不會送任何東西。

description.en: In: every message from every listened input goes to the callbacks you added with `listen(fn)` (raw bytes, including clock), then is parsed and published as [`genericSignals()`](#genericSignals) names. With two or more inputs it also publishes `midi/<slug>/note/on`, `midi/<slug>/note/off`, `midi/<slug>/cc/<n>` and `midi/<slug>/bend`, so devices do not collide. The slug comes from the port name (`Minilab3 MIDI` becomes `minilab3-midi`), so a device that drops and reconnects keeps its identity. Clock messages are not logged and publish nothing.
description.zh: 輸入：每個被聆聽的輸入埠送來的每一則訊息，會先交給你用 `listen(fn)` 加的函式（原始位元組，包含時鐘），再被解析並發佈成 [`genericSignals()`](#genericSignals) 的名稱。有兩個以上輸入埠時，另外會發佈 `midi/<slug>/note/on`、`midi/<slug>/note/off`、`midi/<slug>/cc/<n>` 和 `midi/<slug>/bend`，讓不同機器不會互相打架。slug 由埠名產生（`Minilab3 MIDI` 變成 `minilab3-midi`），所以機器斷線再接回來，身分不變。時鐘訊息不寫記錄，也不發佈訊號。

description.en: Out: `send(bytes)`, `noteOn()`, `noteOff()` and `cc()` go to `midi.out`, the chosen output port, and are remembered for echo filtering. If that port is unplugged the engine moves to the next best live port (your choice by name, then `prefer`, then the first), moves back when your choice returns, and never lets an unrelated device steal the output. Every switch writes one line to the log and one `console.warn`, and calls the `onOutput` subscribers.
description.zh: 輸出：`send(bytes)`、`noteOn()`、`noteOff()`、`cc()` 都會送到 `midi.out`（選定的輸出埠），並記下來做回音過濾。那個埠被拔掉時，引擎會換到下一個最好的存活埠（先你用名稱指定的，再 `prefer`，最後第一個），你指定的埠回來就換回去，而且不相干的新裝置不會搶走輸出。每次切換都會寫一行記錄、一個 `console.warn`，並通知 `onOutput` 的訂閱者。

description.en: Hooks you can assign: `onCC(cc, value01, ch)`, `onNote(note, velocity01, on, ch)`, `onMessage({ dir, text })` (the log), `onSend(bytes)` (sees everything sent, for a meter) and `onDeviceChange(devices)`. Fields: `enabled`, `inputs`, `outputs`, `out`, `access`, `echoDropped`.
description.zh: 可以指定的掛鉤：`onCC(cc, value01, ch)`、`onNote(note, velocity01, on, ch)`、`onMessage({ dir, text })`（記錄）、`onSend(bytes)`（看得到所有送出的訊息，做音量表用）、`onDeviceChange(devices)`。欄位有：`enabled`、`inputs`、`outputs`、`out`、`access`、`echoDropped`。

params.name: signals
params.en: Publish every input message here as `midi/…` signals (see [`genericSignals()`](#genericSignals)). Without it the engine still calls `listen()` callbacks and the `on…` hooks.
params.zh: 把每則輸入訊息發佈成 `midi/…` 訊號（見 [`genericSignals()`](#genericSignals)）。不給的話，引擎仍然會呼叫 `listen()` 的函式和 `on…` 掛鉤。

params.name: filterOut
params.en: Input port NAMES never to listen to, as a regular expression (a string is read as its source, case-insensitive). The default `'IAC'` is the macOS bus you send into Ableton or TouchDesigner, so what you send never comes back as input. `null` listens to everything.
params.zh: 永遠不聽的輸入埠「名稱」，寫成正規表示式（字串會當成它的內容，不分大小寫）。預設 `'IAC'` 是 macOS 上你用來送進 Ableton 或 TouchDesigner 的匯流排，這樣你送出去的東西不會又從輸入回來。給 `null` 就是全部都聽。

params.name: requestAccess
params.en: Where the `MIDIAccess` comes from, called as `requestAccess({ sysex: false })` and returning a promise. The default is `navigator.requestMIDIAccess`. Pass your own for a test, a shim, or a host that wraps Web MIDI for old sketches and hands the REAL one here.
params.zh: `MIDIAccess` 從哪裡來，會以 `requestAccess({ sysex: false })` 呼叫，要回傳 promise。預設是 `navigator.requestMIDIAccess`。測試、轉接層，或是替舊草圖包裝了 Web MIDI 的環境，可以傳自己的函式，並把「真的」那個交到這裡。

params.name: echoWindow
params.en: Milliseconds. An input message identical to one just SENT within this window is our own echo and is dropped (counted in `echoDropped`). `0` turns it off.
params.zh: 毫秒。輸入的訊息如果跟這個時間內剛「送出」的某一則完全相同，就視為自己的回音而丟掉（計入 `echoDropped`）。`0` 表示關閉。

params.name: prefer
params.en: Output priority after the port you chose by name: the first entry that matches a live port wins (a string matches as a substring), else the first port. Example: `['IAC']`.
params.zh: 你用名稱指定的埠之後的輸出優先順序：第一個對得上存活埠的項目勝出（字串以子字串比對），都沒有就用第一個埠。例如 `['IAC']`。

needs.en: Call `await midi.enable()` first. Browsers with Web MIDI (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) ask the visitor for permission at that moment, so call it from a click when you can. Safari and iPad have no Web MIDI: `enable()` gives `false`.
needs.zh: 要先呼叫 `await midi.enable()`。有 Web MIDI 的瀏覽器（Chrome、Edge、Firefox）會在這個時候向訪客要權限，所以可以的話請在點擊裡呼叫。Safari 和 iPad 沒有 Web MIDI，`enable()` 會回傳 `false`。

notes.en: `createShow()` creates one and enables it for you. `createController()` and `<oav-controller>` share one engine per page, so a page with five controllers asks for MIDI once.
notes.zh: `createShow()` 會替你建立一個並啟用它。`createController()` 和 `<oav-controller>` 在同一個頁面上共用一個引擎，所以一頁放五個控制器也只會要一次 MIDI。

notes.en: The engine sends MIDI data only and plays no audio. To hear the notes you need a synth on the other end (a DAW on the IAC bus, a hardware synth), or `@openav/sound`.
notes.zh: 引擎只送 MIDI 資料，自己不發聲。想聽到音符，另一端要有合成器（接在 IAC 匯流排上的 DAW、硬體合成器），或是用 `@openav/sound`。

caption.en: Prints `true`, then the two messages that reach the output port: note-on and note-off for middle C.
caption.zh: 印出 `true`，再印出送到輸出埠的兩則訊息：中央 C 的 note-on 和 note-off。

caption.en: Prints `knob 1.00`: a message arriving on the input port became the signal `midi/cc/74`.
caption.zh: 印出 `knob 1.00`：輸入埠收到的訊息變成了訊號 `midi/cc/74`。

caption.en: Prints the chosen port, then a `fallback` line saying the output moved to "Synth" (the engine also writes it with `console.warn`), then `Synth`.
caption.zh: 印出選定的埠，接著一行 `fallback`，說明輸出換到了「Synth」（引擎也會用 `console.warn` 印一次），最後印出 `Synth`。

caption.en: The real thing: the browser asks for MIDI permission, then the console lists your input devices (or says there is no Web MIDI).
caption.zh: 真正的用法：瀏覽器會詢問 MIDI 權限，接著主控台列出你的輸入裝置（或告訴你沒有 Web MIDI）。

tbd.en: Not tried for this page: the real permission prompt and real MIDI hardware in each browser. The examples run against a stand-in for `MIDIAccess`, and the browser behaviour (Chrome, Edge and Firefox ask for permission, Safari and iPad have no Web MIDI) is as the package README describes it.
tbd.zh: 這一頁沒有實測：各個瀏覽器真實的權限詢問，以及真實的 MIDI 硬體。範例是用假的 `MIDIAccess` 跑的，瀏覽器的行為（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 會詢問權限，Safari 和 iPad 沒有 Web MIDI）是照套件 README 的說法寫的。

entries.name: MidiController
entries.signature: new MidiController(profile, { signals = null, sink = null, short = null, onLed = null } = {})

summary.en: One MIDI controller (a profile) as a live model: MIDI bytes go in, control values and signals come out, and a hand on screen sends the bytes the device would.
summary.zh: 把一台 MIDI 控制器（一份設定檔）做成活的模型：MIDI 位元組進去，控制項的值和訊號出來，而螢幕上的手會送出跟實體機器一樣的位元組。

description.en: The one idea: the on-screen controller and the hardware speak the SAME language, MIDI bytes. `setValue()`, `press()` and the other virtual hands encode the exact message the real control would send and feed it through `ingest()`, the same door the hardware uses. So a virtual knob and a real one can never drift apart, and what your work receives is identical whichever hand moved it. Pass the bytes of a real device to `ingest(bytes, { source: 'hw' })`.
description.zh: 核心想法：螢幕上的控制器和硬體說的是「同一種語言」，MIDI 位元組。`setValue()`、`press()` 等虛擬的手，會編出真實控制項會送的那則訊息，再從 `ingest()` 送進去，也就是硬體走的同一個入口。所以虛擬旋鈕和真的旋鈕不會漂開，作品收到的東西也一樣，不論是哪隻手動的。真實機器的位元組請用 `ingest(bytes, { source: 'hw' })` 餵進去。

description.en: The `source` of a message decides what is published, so every event is published exactly once. `'hw'`: the device lives here, and [`Midi`](#Midi) already published the generic `midi/…` names, so only `midi/<short>/…` is added. `'ui'`: a virtual hand, so it publishes `midi/<short>/…`, the generic names, and `midi/virtual` (the raw bytes, for Web MIDI shims). `'mirror'`: someone else published it (a phone, feedback), so only the state and the views move.
description.zh: 訊息的 `source` 決定發佈什麼，讓每個事件只發佈一次。`'hw'`：機器就在這裡，[`Midi`](#Midi) 已經發佈過通用的 `midi/…` 名稱，所以只多發佈 `midi/<short>/…`。`'ui'`：虛擬的手，所以會發佈 `midi/<short>/…`、通用名稱，以及 `midi/virtual`（原始位元組，給 Web MIDI 轉接用）。`'mirror'`：別人已經發佈過了（手機、回饋），所以只更新狀態和畫面。

description.en: Signals per control (values are normalised, `raw` keeps the MIDI number): `midi/<short>/<id>` (0..1, −1..1 for a bipolar wheel) and `/raw`; an encoder's `/delta`; a pad's `/hit` pulse `{ vel, velocity, note, ch }` and `/pressure`; a keys control's `/on` and `/off` pulses and `midi/<short>/n<note>` while a key is held; and `midi/<short>/last`, a pulse saying what was touched last. [`profileSignals()`](#profileSignals) lists them for a profile.
description.zh: 每個控制項的訊號（數值已正規化，`raw` 保留 MIDI 的號碼）：`midi/<short>/<id>`（0..1，雙向彎音輪是 −1..1）和 `/raw`。旋鈕有 `/delta`，打擊墊有 `/hit` 脈衝 `{ vel, velocity, note, ch }` 和 `/pressure`，琴鍵控制項有 `/on`、`/off` 脈衝，按著某個鍵時有 `midi/<short>/n<note>`，另外還有 `midi/<short>/last`，這個脈衝說明最後碰了哪個控制項。[`profileSignals()`](#profileSignals) 能列出某份設定檔的全部名稱。

description.en: Each control keeps a state `{ value, raw, held, pressure, pos }` in `controller.state` (read it with `get(id)`). `controller.keys` maps each held key's note to its velocity. `controller.profile` is the working copy (learning changes it), `controller.base` the normalized profile before any learning, `controller.lastEvent` the last message with its text, and `controller.learning` and `controller.learned` track learn mode.
description.zh: 每個控制項的狀態是 `{ value, raw, held, pressure, pos }`，存在 `controller.state`（用 `get(id)` 讀）。`controller.keys` 把每個按著的琴鍵音符對應到力度。`controller.profile` 是正在使用的副本（學習會改動它），`controller.base` 是還沒學習之前整理過的設定檔，`controller.lastEvent` 是最後一則訊息和它的文字，`controller.learning` 與 `controller.learned` 記錄學習模式。

params.name: profile
params.en: A raw or normalized profile (see [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES)). It is copied, so changing the object later does nothing.
params.zh: 原始或整理過的設定檔（見 [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES)）。會被複製一份，之後改動原物件不會有影響。

params.name: signals
params.en: Publish the controller's signals here.
params.zh: 把控制器的訊號發佈到這裡。

params.name: sink
params.en: `(name, value, { pulse, min, max }) => …` called for each signal instead of `signals` (a relay, a phone). When both are given, `sink` wins.
params.zh: 每個訊號改成呼叫 `(name, value, { pulse, min, max }) => …`，不走 `signals`（例如中繼、手機）。兩個都給的話以 `sink` 為準。

params.name: short
params.en: Overrides the signal namespace, so two controllers of the same device publish under different names.
params.zh: 覆寫訊號的命名空間，這樣兩台同型號的控制器就能用不同名稱發佈。

params.name: onLed
params.en: `(bytes) => …` called with the MIDI that lights or dims a control's LED on the hardware, whenever its state changes.
params.zh: 控制項狀態改變時，用「讓硬體上 LED 亮起或變暗的 MIDI」呼叫 `(bytes) => …`。

notes.en: Inside a show, do not read `midi/lpd8/k1` in `update()`: route it to a param with [`controllerRoutes()`](#controllerRoutes). You rarely create a `MidiController` yourself: [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers) makes one per profile, and [`createController()`](#createController) wraps all of it.
notes.zh: 在演出裡不要在 `update()` 讀 `midi/lpd8/k1`，要用 [`controllerRoutes()`](#controllerRoutes) 把它接到參數上。你很少需要自己建立 `MidiController`：[`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers) 會替每份設定檔建立一個，[`createController()`](#createController) 則把這一切包起來。

caption.en: Prints three lines: `hw k1 1.00 127`, `ui k2 0.50 64`, `ui pad1 0.80 102`. The same model, three hands.
Prints the `/hit` pulse `{ vel: 0.50…, velocity: 64, note: 38, ch: 10 }`, then the pad's value while held and after release.
caption.zh: 印出 `/hit` 脈衝 `{ vel: 0.50…, velocity: 64, note: 38, ch: 10 }`，再印出打擊墊按著時與放開後的值。

caption.en: Prints the learned binding of k3, then `10`: a second controller with the saved mapping reacts to the same CC.
caption.zh: 印出 k3 學到的綁定，再印出 `10`：套用了存起來的對應的第二個控制器，對同一個 CC 會有反應。

members.name: groups
members.doc: {group: [values…]} — the TouchDesigner tool's out CHOPs (out_knob, out_slider, out_pad…), as arrays.

members.name: onMessage
members.doc: Every message that passes through, once, after state has moved: ({bytes, ev, source, ids}) → void.

members.name: ingest
members.doc: Feed MIDI bytes.

members.name: setValue
members.doc: Absolute controls (knob, fader, wheel/strip, absolute encoder): v in 0..1 (−1..1 bipolar).

members.name: turn
members.doc: Endless encoder: signed steps.

members.name: press
members.doc: Pads, buttons, keys: press with velocity 0..1 (keys/pads: which note).

members.name: pressure
members.doc: Pad/key pressure (poly aftertouch, or channel pressure when the profile says so).

members.name: rest
members.doc: Spring-loaded wheels go home (pitch bend → centre).

members.name: releaseAll
members.doc: Let go of everything the virtual hands hold (blur, page hide, octave change).

members.name: mirror
members.doc: Apply a value that arrived from elsewhere (relay feedback) without publishing.

members.name: ledBytes
members.doc: Bytes that light (or dim) one control's LED on the hardware, from its state.

members.name: ledSnapshot
members.doc: Every LED at its current state — send once when the hardware connects (idle colours).

members.name: learn
members.doc: Arm learn for one control: the next hardware message of a compatible kind is bound to it.

members.name: bindMessage
members.doc: Rebind a control to the message `ev` (swapping with whoever had it).

members.name: exportMapping
members.doc: Learned bindings as JSON (persist per device: localStorage, a file, the work's meta).

entries.name: MidiControllers
entries.signature: new MidiControllers({ profiles, signals = null, sink = null, midi = null, initial = null, storage = safeStorage() } = {})

summary.en: Ties hardware ports to controller profiles: plug in a MiniLab 3 and the on-screen one appears and moves with your hands; unplug it and it stays playable.
summary.zh: 把硬體埠跟控制器設定檔接起來：接上 MiniLab 3，螢幕上的 MiniLab 3 就出現並跟著你的手動，拔掉它，虛擬的那台仍然可以玩。

description.en: There is one [`MidiController`](#MidiController) per profile, created the first time it is asked for (`get(id)`), so a virtual MiniLab and a real MiniLab are the SAME object: whichever hand moves it, the work receives the same `midi/minilab3/…` signals. `current` is the controller the panel shows.
description.zh: 每份設定檔只有一個 [`MidiController`](#MidiController)，第一次被要求時才建立（`get(id)`），所以虛擬的 MiniLab 和真的 MiniLab 是「同一個物件」：不論哪隻手在動，作品收到的都是同樣的 `midi/minilab3/…` 訊號。`current` 是面板正在顯示的那個控制器。

description.en: With a `midi` attached it matches every input port to a profile by name ([`matchProfile()`](#matchProfile), one port per device through [`pickPort()`](#pickPort)), switches `current` to the first device it recognises, sends the LED colours to its output port, and routes each port's messages to that profile's controller. A port nobody recognises can be given to a profile by hand with `assign(slug, profileId)`; that choice is remembered per port name.
description.zh: 接上 `midi` 之後，它會用名稱把每個輸入埠對到設定檔（[`matchProfile()`](#matchProfile)，一台機器只取一個埠，由 [`pickPort()`](#pickPort) 決定），把 `current` 切到第一台認得的機器，把 LED 顏色送到它的輸出埠，並把每個埠的訊息導向該設定檔的控制器。沒有人認得的埠，可以用 `assign(slug, profileId)` 手動指定給某份設定檔，這個選擇會依埠名記起來。

description.en: It remembers in `storage` under `openav.midi.map.<profile id>` (learned mappings, restored when the controller is created) and `openav.midi.assign` (manual port assignments).
description.zh: 它會把資料記在 `storage` 的 `openav.midi.map.<設定檔 id>`（學到的對應，建立控制器時還原）和 `openav.midi.assign`（手動指定的埠）。

params.name: profiles
params.en: The profiles to manage, usually [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES). Required: the first one is shown when `initial` is not given.
params.zh: 要管理的設定檔，通常是 [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES)。必填，沒給 `initial` 時會先顯示第一個。

params.name: signals
params.en: Passed to every [`MidiController`](#MidiController) it creates.
params.zh: 交給它建立的每個 [`MidiController`](#MidiController)。

params.name: sink
params.en: Passed on to every controller, as in `MidiController`.
params.zh: 交給每個控制器，用法同 `MidiController`。

params.name: midi
params.en: An enabled (or about-to-be-enabled) [`Midi`](#Midi) to follow. Leave it out for no hardware, and call `attach(midi)` later.
params.zh: 要跟隨的 [`Midi`](#Midi)（已啟用或即將啟用）。不給就是沒有硬體，之後再呼叫 `attach(midi)`。

params.name: initial
params.en: The profile id shown before any hardware arrives.
params.zh: 硬體出現之前先顯示的設定檔 id。

params.name: storage
params.en: Where learned mappings and manual port assignments are remembered: anything with `getItem` and `setItem`. The default is `localStorage` when the page has it, otherwise nothing is remembered.
params.zh: 用來記住學到的對應和手動指定的埠：任何有 `getItem`、`setItem` 的東西。預設是頁面有的話就用 `localStorage`，沒有的話就不記。

caption.en: Prints `1` (a finger on the on-screen LPD8 knob became a signal), then `korg-nanokontrol2` after switching the device on screen.
caption.zh: 印出 `1`（螢幕上 LPD8 旋鈕被手指推動，變成了訊號），切換螢幕裝置之後再印出 `korg-nanokontrol2`。

caption.en: Prints `arturia-minilab3 <- Minilab3 MIDI` (the port was recognised by name), then `1`: a message from the port moved knob 1 of the on-screen MiniLab 3.
caption.zh: 印出 `arturia-minilab3 <- Minilab3 MIDI`（埠名被認出來了），再印出 `1`：埠送來的訊息推動了螢幕上 MiniLab 3 的旋鈕 1。

tbd.en: LED feedback (the colours sent back to a device when it is recognised) was not tried on real hardware. Some controls in the shipped profiles are marked `verified: false`: their messages come from the manual but nobody has confirmed them on a real unit yet, and Learn rebinds them.
tbd.zh: LED 回饋（機器被認出時送回去的顏色）沒有在真實的硬體上實測。內建設定檔裡有些控制項標著 `verified: false`：它們的訊息來自說明書，但還沒有人在真實的機器上確認過，可以用學習重新綁定。

members.name: attach
members.doc: Start following a hardware engine (now, or later: an embed connects only when asked).

members.name: detach
members.doc: Stop following hardware; the on-screen controllers stay, still playable.

members.name: register
members.doc: Add (or replace) a profile at runtime — one loaded from a URL, one moved to another channel.

members.name: get
members.doc: The controller for a profile (created on first use, with any learned mapping restored).

members.name: devices
members.doc: Hardware ports and who they drive: [{slug, name, profileId, auto, listening}]

members.name: hardwareFor
members.doc: Is a hardware port feeding this controller right now?

members.name: assign
members.doc: Route a port to a profile by hand (unknown device → generic layout), or null to un-route.

summary.en: Validates a profile and returns a filled-in copy with defaults for channel, labels, groups, encoder mode and portrait layout; the input is not changed.
summary.zh: 驗證設定檔，回傳一份補好預設值的副本，包含頻道、標籤、分組、旋鈕模式和直立版面，傳進去的物件不會被改動。

description.en: It throws `invalid MIDI profile "<id>":` followed by every problem when the profile is not valid. Otherwise it fills in: `channel` (1), `learn` (true for a generic layout), `stack` (true), `sources` and `match` (empty lists), and per control `label` (its id), `group` (its type), `ch` (the profile's channel), an encoder's `relative` (`offset64`), a button's `mode` (`momentary`) and a pitch-bend wheel's `bipolar` and `spring` (both true). Sections get `label`, `flow` (`row`) and `spans`, and `portrait` is built from the sections, top to bottom, with each section's height as its weight when you did not write one.
description.zh: 設定檔不合法時，它會丟出 `invalid MIDI profile "<id>":`，後面接上每一個問題。合法的話會補上：`channel`（1）、`learn`（通用版面為 true）、`stack`（true）、`sources` 和 `match`（空清單），每個控制項的 `label`（用它的 id）、`group`（用它的類型）、`ch`（設定檔的頻道）、旋鈕的 `relative`（`offset64`）、按鈕的 `mode`（`momentary`）、彎音輪的 `bipolar` 和 `spring`（都是 true）。區塊會補上 `label`、`flow`（`row`）和 `spans`，沒寫 `portrait` 的話，會由各區塊從上到下排出來，高度當作權重。

description.en: [`MidiController`](#MidiController), [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) and the view all work on the normalized form, which is what `controller.profile` gives you.
description.zh: [`MidiController`](#MidiController)、[`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) 和畫面元件用的都是整理後的版本，也就是 `controller.profile` 給你的那份。

params.name: raw
params.en: A raw profile. It must pass [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile).
params.zh: 原始設定檔，必須通過 [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile)。

returns.en: A new profile object.
returns.zh: 一個新的設定檔物件。

caption.en: Prints the defaults it filled in, then the error message listing what is wrong with `{ id: 'X' }`.
caption.zh: 印出它補上的預設值，再印出 `{ id: 'X' }` 有哪些問題的錯誤訊息。

summary.en: Turns the bytes of one MIDI message into an event object such as `{ type: 'noteon', ch: 1, note: 60, vel: 100 }`, or `null` for bytes it does not know.
summary.zh: 把一則 MIDI 訊息的位元組轉成事件物件，例如 `{ type: 'noteon', ch: 1, note: 60, vel: 100 }`，不認得的位元組就回傳 `null`。

description.en: `parseMessage([0x90, 60, 100])` is `{ type: 'noteon', ch: 1, note: 60, vel: 100 }`. Channels are numbered 1 to 16, the way they are printed on a device (the status byte stores 0 to 15), and data bytes are cut to 0..127. Every other function in this package that handles MIDI speaks these event objects.
description.zh: `parseMessage([0x90, 60, 100])` 會得到 `{ type: 'noteon', ch: 1, note: 60, vel: 100 }`。頻道編號是 1 到 16，跟機器上印的一樣（狀態位元組裡存的是 0 到 15），資料位元組會被限制在 0..127。這個套件裡其他處理 MIDI 的函式，講的都是這種事件物件。
