description.en: The `type` is `noteon` and `noteoff` (`note`, `vel`), `polyat` (polyphonic aftertouch: `note`, `value`), `cc` (`cc`, `value`), `program` (`value`), `chanat` (channel pressure: `value`) or `pitchbend` (`value` 0..16383, centre 8192). System messages come back as `clock`, `start`, `continue`, `stop`, `sysex` (with `data`, the whole message) or `system` (with the `status` byte).
description.zh: `type` 可能是 `noteon`、`noteoff`（有 `note`、`vel`）、`polyat`（複音觸後：`note`、`value`）、`cc`（`cc`、`value`）、`program`（`value`）、`chanat`（頻道壓力：`value`）、`pitchbend`（`value` 為 0..16383，中心是 8192）。系統訊息則是 `clock`、`start`、`continue`、`stop`、`sysex`（附 `data`，整則訊息）或 `system`（附 `status` 位元組）。

description.en: A note-on with velocity 0 comes back as `noteoff`, because that is how many devices say "released". Bytes that start with a data byte give `null`: the browser has already resolved running status before it hands you the message.
description.zh: 力度為 0 的 note-on 會回傳成 `noteoff`，因為很多機器就是這樣表示「放開」。位元組開頭是資料位元組時回傳 `null`：瀏覽器在把訊息交給你之前，已經處理過 running status。

params.name: data
params.en: The bytes of ONE message, the way Web MIDI hands them over (`event.data`): a status byte first, then up to two data bytes.
params.zh: 「一則」訊息的位元組，格式跟 Web MIDI 給你的一樣（`event.data`）：先是狀態位元組，後面最多兩個資料位元組。

returns.en: The event, or `null` when the input is empty, starts with a data byte (below 0x80) or is a channel status it has no case for.
returns.zh: 事件物件。輸入是空的、以資料位元組（小於 0x80）開頭，或是它沒處理的頻道狀態時，回傳 `null`。

notes.en: It is pure: no DOM, no Web MIDI, no state. [`encodeMessage()`](#encodeMessage) is its inverse, and [`describe()`](#describe) turns the result into a line of text.
notes.zh: 它是純函式：沒有 DOM、沒有 Web MIDI、沒有狀態。[`encodeMessage()`](#encodeMessage) 是它的反向，[`describe()`](#describe) 則把結果變成一行文字。

examples.code:
import { parseMessage } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(parseMessage([0x90, 60, 100]));   // note on, middle C
console.log(parseMessage([0x90, 60, 0]));     // velocity 0 reads as note off
console.log(parseMessage([0xe0, 0, 64]));     // pitch bend, centre

caption.en: Open the console: three event objects, a `noteon`, a `noteoff` and a `pitchbend` with `value: 8192`.
caption.zh: 打開主控台：印出三個事件物件，分別是 `noteon`、`noteoff`，以及 `value: 8192` 的 `pitchbend`。

caption.en: Prints `CC 74 on channel 1 = 0.79`: a control-change value turned into the 0 to 1 range a sketch wants.
caption.zh: 印出 `CC 74 on channel 1 = 0.79`：把控制變更的值換成草圖想要的 0 到 1。

summary.en: Chooses which MIDI output to send to from a list: the port you named, else the first match of a preference list, else the first live port.
summary.zh: 從清單裡挑要送到哪個 MIDI 輸出埠：先是你指定的名稱，其次是偏好清單的第一個符合者，最後才是第一個存活的埠。

description.en: The order is: 1) the port named `preferred`, 2) the first port that matches each entry of `prefer`, in order, 3) the first port. Only live ports (see [`isLive()`](#isLive)) are considered, so a disconnected port is never picked.
description.zh: 順序是：1）名稱符合 `preferred` 的埠，2）依序比對 `prefer` 每一項，取第一個符合的埠，3）第一個埠。只考慮存活的埠（見 [`isLive()`](#isLive)），所以斷線的埠不會被選到。

description.en: It is a pure function over plain objects, so you can test the rules without any hardware. The [`Midi`](#Midi) engine applies them through [`reselectOutput()`](#reselectOutput).
description.zh: 它是處理普通物件的純函式，所以不用任何硬體就能測這些規則。[`Midi`](#Midi) 引擎是透過 [`reselectOutput()`](#reselectOutput) 來套用它們。

params.name: outputs
params.en: The candidate ports (objects with a `name` and a `state`).
params.zh: 候選的埠（有 `name` 和 `state` 的物件）。

params.name: preferred
params.en: The port you asked for: tried by exact name, then as a substring.
params.zh: 你指定的埠：先比對完整名稱，再比對子字串。

params.name: prefer
params.en: Fallback order. The first entry that matches a live port wins (a string is a substring).
params.zh: 備用順序。第一個對得上存活埠的項目勝出（字串以子字串比對）。

returns.en: The chosen port, or `null` when no port is live.
returns.zh: 選到的埠。沒有任何存活的埠時回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `Synth A`, `IAC Driver Bus 1`, `Synth B` and `null`: the first port, your choice, the preference list, and nothing live.
caption.zh: 印出 `Synth A`、`IAC Driver Bus 1`、`Synth B` 和 `null`：分別是第一個埠、你指定的埠、偏好清單，以及沒有任何存活埠。

summary.en: Of several ports one device exposes ("Minilab3 MIDI", "Minilab3 DIN THRU", "Minilab3 MCU/HUI"), picks the one to listen to.
summary.zh: 一台機器開出好幾個埠（「Minilab3 MIDI」、「Minilab3 DIN THRU」、「Minilab3 MCU/HUI」）時，挑出要聽的那一個。

description.en: A port scores 1 when its name matches one of the profile's `match.ports` (otherwise it is out), plus 1 for a `prefer` match and minus 2 for an `avoid` match. Only positive scores count and the highest wins. It is the second half of device detection after [`matchProfile()`](#matchProfile).
description.zh: 埠名符合設定檔的某個 `match.ports` 得 1 分（不符合就出局），符合 `prefer` 加 1 分，符合 `avoid` 扣 2 分。只算正分，最高分勝出。它是 [`matchProfile()`](#matchProfile) 之後裝置偵測的第二步。

params.name: ports
params.en: Candidate ports: objects with a `name`.
params.zh: 候選的埠：有 `name` 的物件。

params.name: profile
params.en: The device's profile (its `match.ports`, `prefer` and `avoid`).
params.zh: 那台機器的設定檔（用它的 `match.ports`、`prefer`、`avoid`）。

returns.en: The best port, or `null` when none of them fits the profile.
returns.zh: 最合適的埠。沒有任何一個符合設定檔時回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `Minilab3 MIDI`, then `null` when no port belongs to the device.
caption.zh: 印出 `Minilab3 MIDI`，埠都不屬於那台機器時印出 `null`。

summary.en: Looks up a shipped controller profile by its id (`'akai-lpd8'`) or its short signal name (`'lpd8'`), or returns `null`.
summary.zh: 用 id（`'akai-lpd8'`）或訊號用的短名稱（`'lpd8'`）找一個內建的控制器設定檔，找不到回傳 `null`。

description.en: Only profiles from `PROFILES` are searched. A profile you loaded from a URL is not in there: use [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile), which also accepts ids. It does not normalize or validate: pass the result to [`normalizeProfile()`](#normalizeProfile) when you need the filled-in form.
description.zh: 只會在 `PROFILES` 裡找。從網址載入的設定檔不在裡面，請用 [`resolveProfile()`](#resolveProfile)，它也收 id。它不會整理也不會驗證，需要填好預設值的版本時，請把結果交給 [`normalizeProfile()`](#normalizeProfile)。

params.name: id
params.en: A profile `id` or its `short` name (the part in `midi/<short>/…`).
params.zh: 設定檔的 `id` 或 `short` 短名稱（`midi/<short>/…` 裡的那一段）。

returns.en: The raw profile from [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES), the same object each time, or `null`.
returns.zh: [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES) 裡的原始設定檔，每次回傳同一個物件，找不到則是 `null`。

caption.en: Prints the LPD8's id, name and 16 controls, then `true`, then `null`.
caption.zh: 印出 LPD8 的 id、名稱和 16 個控制項，接著 `true`，最後 `null`。

summary.en: Every controller profile that ships with the package, as an array of plain JSON objects: real devices first, then the generic layouts.
summary.zh: 套件內建的所有控制器設定檔，是一個由普通 JSON 物件組成的陣列：先是真實的機器，再來是通用版面。

description.en: A profile describes one controller as data: what it looks like (the faceplate sections), every control on it (type and the exact MIDI message it sends), LED feedback where the device accepts it, how to recognise its port name, and the document each number came from. Each one is a JSON file in `packages/midi/profiles/`; the full field list is in the package README and the [controllers page](/controllers/) shows them all.
description.zh: 設定檔把一台控制器寫成資料：長什麼樣子（面板的各個區塊）、上面每個控制項（類型，以及它送出的確切 MIDI 訊息）、機器有支援的 LED 回饋、怎麼認出它的埠名，以及每個數字的出處文件。每個設定檔是 `packages/midi/profiles/` 裡的一個 JSON 檔，完整欄位在套件的 README 裡，[控制器頁面](/zh/controllers/)則列出全部。

description.en: A `device` profile cites its sources and is matched to ports by name, so plugging the device in picks it automatically. A `generic` layout (`generic-8k8p`, `generic-keys49` …) never auto-matches: you assign a device to it and it learns the controls in the order you move them.
description.zh: `device` 設定檔要註明資料來源，並且用名稱跟埠配對，所以接上機器就會自動選到它。`generic`（通用）版面（`generic-8k8p`、`generic-keys49` …）永遠不會自動配對：你把某台機器指定給它，它會照你轉動的順序學習控制項。

description.en: Pick one with [`profileById()`](#profileById) (by `id` or by the short name), and hand it to [`createController()`](#createController), [`MidiController`](#MidiController) or [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers). Do not edit these objects in place: copy first (`structuredClone`), as [`withChannel()`](#withChannel) does.
description.zh: 用 [`profileById()`](#profileById) 挑一個（用 `id` 或短名稱），再交給 [`createController()`](#createController)、[`MidiController`](#MidiController) 或 [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers)。不要直接修改這些物件，要先複製（`structuredClone`），[`withChannel()`](#withChannel) 就是這樣做的。

value.en: The order is the order a device picker shows. Each item is a raw profile (see [`normalizeProfile()`](#normalizeProfile) for the filled-in form): `id`, `short`, `name`, `kind` (`'device'` or `'generic'`), `face`, `sections`, `controls` and, for a device, `match` and `sources`.
value.zh: 順序就是裝置選單顯示的順序。每一項是原始設定檔（填好預設值的版本見 [`normalizeProfile()`](#normalizeProfile)）：有 `id`、`short`、`name`、`kind`（`'device'` 或 `'generic'`）、`face`、`sections`、`controls`，真實機器還有 `match` 和 `sources`。

notes.en: A control marked `verified: false` (with a `note` saying why) has a message that comes from the manual or a guess and has not been confirmed on a real unit. The faceplate shows a small orange `?` on its label, and Learn rebinds it in one move.
notes.zh: 標著 `verified: false` 的控制項（並附上 `note` 說明原因），它的訊息來自說明書或推測，還沒有在真實的機器上確認過。面板上它的標籤旁會有一個橘色的 `?`，用學習一下就能重新綁定。

caption.en: Prints the first four devices (id, short name, kind, control count), then the ids of the generic layouts.
caption.zh: 印出前四台機器（id、短名稱、類型、控制項數量），再印出通用版面的 id。

summary.en: Lists every signal name a profile can publish under its own namespace (`midi/lpd8/…` for the LPD8), for docs, tests and mapping screens.
summary.zh: 列出一份設定檔會發佈在它自己命名空間底下的所有訊號名稱（LPD8 是 `midi/lpd8/…`），給文件、測試和映射畫面用。

description.en: For each control: `midi/<short>/<id>` and `/raw`; an encoder adds `/delta`; a pad adds `/hit` (and `/pressure` when it has aftertouch). A keys control has only `/on`, `/off` and one `midi/<short>/n<note>` per key. These are the names a [`MidiController`](#MidiController) publishes, so a route from `controllerRoutes()` or a `signals.on()` can use them.
description.zh: 每個控制項有 `midi/<short>/<id>` 和 `/raw`。旋鈕多一個 `/delta`，打擊墊多一個 `/hit`（有觸後的話再加 `/pressure`）。琴鍵控制項只有 `/on`、`/off`，以及每個琴鍵一個 `midi/<short>/n<note>`。這些就是 [`MidiController`](#MidiController) 發佈的名稱，所以 `controllerRoutes()` 的路由或 `signals.on()` 都能用。

params.name: p
params.en: A profile (its `short` and `controls` are read).
params.zh: 設定檔（會讀它的 `short` 和 `controls`）。

returns.en: Signal names, starting with `midi/<short>/last`.
returns.zh: 訊號名稱，第一個是 `midi/<short>/last`。

caption.en: Prints how many signals the LPD8 can publish and the first five: `midi/lpd8/last`, then pad 1's value, raw value and hit, then pad 2.
caption.zh: 印出 LPD8 能發佈幾個訊號和前五個：`midi/lpd8/last`，然後是 pad 1 的值、原始值、hit，接著是 pad 2。

summary.en: Publishes a list of `{ name, value, pulse?, min?, max? }` into a `Signals` registry, declaring each signal the first time it is seen.
summary.zh: 把一串 `{ name, value, pulse?, min?, max? }` 發佈到 `Signals` 登錄表，每個訊號第一次出現時會先宣告。

description.en: For a new continuous signal it defines the range from `min` and `max` (0 and 1 when missing) and `source: 'midi'`. A pulse is defined as `kind: 'pulse'`. Then it calls `signals.pulse(name, value)` or `signals.set(name, value)`.
description.zh: 遇到新的連續訊號，會用 `min`、`max`（沒寫就是 0 和 1）和 `source: 'midi'` 來宣告範圍。脈衝則宣告成 `kind: 'pulse'`。接著呼叫 `signals.pulse(name, value)` 或 `signals.set(name, value)`。

description.en: The [`Midi`](#Midi) engine and [`MidiController`](#MidiController) already do this for you. Call it yourself when you read MIDI some other way, for example from a WebSocket, and want the same names in your show.
description.zh: [`Midi`](#Midi) 引擎和 [`MidiController`](#MidiController) 已經替你做了這件事。只有在你用別的方式讀 MIDI（例如從 WebSocket）、又想在作品裡得到同樣名稱的時候，才需要自己呼叫。

params.name: signals
params.en: The registry from `@openav/core`. `null` makes the call do nothing.
params.zh: `@openav/core` 的登錄表。給 `null` 就什麼都不做。

params.name: list
params.en: Usually the result of [`genericSignals()`](#genericSignals). `pulse: true` fires a pulse, anything else sets a value.
params.zh: 通常是 [`genericSignals()`](#genericSignals) 的結果。`pulse: true` 會觸發脈衝，其他的會設定數值。

caption.en: Prints `cc 74 is now 0.79`, then the same value read from the per-channel name.
caption.zh: 印出 `cc 74 is now 0.79`，再印出從分頻道名稱讀到的同一個值。

summary.en: The four ways an endless encoder can write a turn as a CC value: `offset64`, `offset16`, `twos` and `signbit`.
summary.zh: 無限旋鈕把一次轉動寫成 CC 值的四種方式：`offset64`、`offset16`、`twos`、`signbit`。

description.en: Use it to check or list the encodings, for example when you build a profile editor. `validateProfile()` reports an encoder whose `relative` is not in this list.
description.zh: 用來檢查或列出編碼方式，例如做設定檔編輯器的時候。`validateProfile()` 會回報 `relative` 不在這個清單裡的旋鈕。

value.en: A plain array. [`relativeDelta()`](#relativeDelta) and [`relativeValue()`](#relativeValue) take one of these as `mode`, and a profile's `relative` field must be one of them (or `false` for an absolute encoder).
value.zh: 一個普通陣列。[`relativeDelta()`](#relativeDelta) 和 [`relativeValue()`](#relativeValue) 的 `mode` 要從裡面挑一個，設定檔的 `relative` 欄位也必須是其中之一（絕對值旋鈕寫 `false`）。

examples.code:
import { RELATIVE_MODES } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(RELATIVE_MODES);

caption.en: Prints the four mode names.
caption.zh: 印出四個模式名稱。

summary.en: Turns the CC value an endless encoder sends into signed steps: with `offset64`, 65 is +1, 63 is −1 and 64 is no move.
summary.zh: 把無限旋鈕送來的 CC 值轉成有正負號的步數：用 `offset64` 時，65 是 +1，63 是 −1，64 是沒動。

description.en: An endless encoder has no position, so it sends how far it moved, and devices disagree on how to write it. `offset64`: 64 is no move, 65 is +1, 63 is −1. `offset16`: 16 is no move, 17 is +1, 15 is −1. `twos`: 1..63 are +1..+63 and 127..65 are −1..−63 (two's complement). `signbit`: 1..63 are positive, 65..127 are −1..−63 (sign and magnitude).
description.zh: 無限旋鈕沒有位置，它送出的是「轉了多少」，而各家機器的寫法不一樣。`offset64`：64 是沒動，65 是 +1，63 是 −1。`offset16`：16 是沒動，17 是 +1，15 是 −1。`twos`：1..63 是 +1..+63，127..65 是 −1..−63（二的補數）。`signbit`：1..63 是正的，65..127 是 −1..−63（符號加大小）。

description.en: An unknown `mode` throws `unknown relative mode "x"`. [`MidiController`](#MidiController) uses this for every `encoder` control whose profile says `relative`, and publishes the result as `midi/<short>/<id>/delta`.
description.zh: 不認得的 `mode` 會丟出 `unknown relative mode "x"`。[`MidiController`](#MidiController) 對每個設定檔有寫 `relative` 的 `encoder` 控制項都用它，並把結果發佈成 `midi/<short>/<id>/delta`。

params.name: value
params.en: The CC value, 0..127 (only the low 7 bits are read).
params.zh: CC 的值，0..127（只讀低 7 位元）。

params.name: mode
params.en: How the device writes a turn: one of [`RELATIVE_MODES`](#RELATIVE_MODES). A profile names it in the control's `relative` field.
params.zh: 機器怎麼表示一次轉動：[`RELATIVE_MODES`](#RELATIVE_MODES) 其中之一。設定檔在控制項的 `relative` 欄位裡寫明。

returns.en: The signed step count, positive for clockwise.
returns.zh: 有正負號的步數，順時針為正。

examples.code:
import { relativeDelta } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(relativeDelta(65));            // 1  (offset64, the default)
console.log(relativeDelta(63));            // -1
console.log(relativeDelta(127, 'twos'));   // -1
console.log(relativeDelta(67, 'signbit')); // -3

caption.en: Prints 1, −1, −1 and −3: the same kind of turn written four ways.
caption.zh: 印出 1、−1、−1、−3：同一種轉動的四種寫法。

summary.en: The inverse of `relativeDelta()`: the CC value that says "turned by this many steps" in a given encoder encoding.
summary.zh: `relativeDelta()` 的反向：在指定的旋鈕編碼下，代表「轉了這麼多步」的 CC 值。

description.en: A virtual encoder sends the same encoding a hardware one does, so the on-screen controller and the real device look identical to everything downstream. `relativeValue(-1)` is 63 and `relativeValue(3, 'twos')` is 3. With `offset16` the result is held at 0, so it can only go down to −16.
description.zh: 虛擬的旋鈕送出跟實體旋鈕一樣的編碼，所以螢幕上的控制器和真實機器，在下游看起來完全一樣。`relativeValue(-1)` 是 63，`relativeValue(3, 'twos')` 是 3。`offset16` 的結果會停在 0，所以最多只能往下到 −16。

description.en: An unknown `mode` throws `unknown relative mode "x"`.
description.zh: 不認得的 `mode` 會丟出 `unknown relative mode "x"`。

params.name: delta
params.en: Signed steps. Rounded and held to −63..63.
params.zh: 有正負號的步數，會四捨五入並限制在 −63..63。

params.name: mode
params.en: One of [`RELATIVE_MODES`](#RELATIVE_MODES).
params.zh: [`RELATIVE_MODES`](#RELATIVE_MODES) 其中之一。

returns.en: The CC value, 0..127.

caption.en: Four lines: turning −3 steps is sent as 61, 13, 125 and 67, and each reads back as −3.
caption.zh: 四行輸出：轉 −3 步在四種編碼下分別送出 61、13、125、67，讀回來都是 −3。

summary.en: Decides what to send to after the port list changed or the current port died, and returns the one line to print about it.
summary.zh: 埠清單改變、或目前的埠斷線之後，決定現在該送到哪裡，並回傳一行要印出來的說明。

description.en: It switches only when the current port is gone or disconnected (to the best live one, or to none), or when the port you named is back while a stand-in is in use (back to it). In every other case it stays: plugging in an unrelated device never steals the output. The text is plain ASCII, such as `MIDI out: switched to "Synth" ("IAC Driver Bus 1" was unplugged)`.
description.zh: 只有兩種情況會換：目前的埠不見了或斷線（換到最好的存活埠，或是變成沒有），或是你指定的埠回來了而現在用的是替代品（換回去）。其他情況一律不動：插上不相干的新裝置，不會搶走輸出。說明文字是純 ASCII，例如 `MIDI out: switched to "Synth" ("IAC Driver Bus 1" was unplugged)`。

description.en: This is the rule behind the [`Midi`](#Midi) engine's output hot-plug. It never touches Web MIDI, so a test can call it with plain objects.
description.zh: [`Midi`](#Midi) 引擎處理輸出熱插拔，靠的就是這條規則。它完全不碰 Web MIDI，所以測試時用普通物件呼叫就行。

params.name: current
params.en: The port in use now.
params.zh: 現在正在用的埠。

params.name: outputs
params.en: The ports there are now.
params.zh: 現在有的埠。

params.name: preferred
params.en: The port you chose by name (the one to go back to).
params.zh: 你用名稱選的埠（要回去的那一個）。

params.name: prefer
params.en: Fallback order, as in [`pickOutput()`](#pickOutput).
params.zh: 備用順序，跟 [`pickOutput()`](#pickOutput) 一樣。

returns.en: `next` is the port to use. `changed` says whether it differs from `current`. `reason` is `same`, `found`, `fallback`, `back` or `none`. `text` is the line to log (an empty string when nothing changed).
returns.zh: `next` 是該用的埠，`changed` 表示是否跟 `current` 不同，`reason` 是 `same`、`found`、`fallback`、`back` 或 `none`，`text` 是要記錄的一行（沒變時是空字串）。

caption.en: Prints `fallback true Synth` and its sentence, then `back IAC Driver Bus 1`.
caption.zh: 印出 `fallback true Synth` 和它的說明句，再印出 `back IAC Driver Bus 1`。

summary.en: Control ids a profile may not use, because they are signal suffixes: `last`, `raw`, `delta`, `hit`, `on`, `off`, `pressure`.
summary.zh: 設定檔裡不能拿來當控制項 id 的名字，因為它們是訊號的後綴：`last`、`raw`、`delta`、`hit`、`on`、`off`、`pressure`。

description.en: A profile's `short` has a separate reserved list (`cc`, `note`, `bend`, `ch`, `virtual`, `raw`, `clock`) because those are the generic `midi/…` families. Both are checked by `validateProfile()`.
description.zh: 設定檔的 `short` 另有一份保留字清單（`cc`、`note`、`bend`、`ch`、`virtual`、`raw`、`clock`），因為它們是通用的 `midi/…` 家族名稱。兩份都由 `validateProfile()` 檢查。

value.en: A plain array. `last` is the signal `midi/<short>/last`, and the others are the suffixes a control's signals use (`/raw`, `/delta`, `/hit`, `/on`, `/off`, `/pressure`), so [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile) rejects them as control ids.
value.zh: 一個普通陣列。`last` 是訊號 `midi/<short>/last` 的名字，其他的是控制項訊號會用的後綴（`/raw`、`/delta`、`/hit`、`/on`、`/off`、`/pressure`），所以 [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile) 不接受它們當控制項 id。

caption.en: Prints the list, then the problem raised when a control is renamed to `hit`.
caption.zh: 印出清單，再印出把某個控制項改名為 `hit` 時回報的問題。

entries.name: resolveProfile
entries.signature: async resolveProfile(ref, { profiles = [], fetch = globalThis.fetch, base = undefined } = {})

summary.en: Turns a profile object, an id or short name, or a URL to a profile JSON into a profile; an object or a file that is not valid is rejected with every problem listed.
summary.zh: 把設定檔物件、id 或短名稱，或指向設定檔 JSON 的網址，變成一份設定檔，物件或檔案不合法就 reject，並列出所有問題。

description.en: Errors are written for a person: `no MIDI profile given`, `unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)`, `could not load MIDI profile <url> (404)` and `invalid MIDI profile (<where>):` followed by the list from [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile).
description.zh: 錯誤訊息是寫給人看的：`no MIDI profile given`、`unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)`、`could not load MIDI profile <url> (404)`，以及 `invalid MIDI profile (<where>):` 後面接上 [`validateProfile()`](#validateProfile) 的清單。

params.name: ref
params.en: A profile object (checked and returned), an id or short name (looked up in `profiles`), or a URL (fetched). A URL is a string starting with `http:`, `https:`, `blob:`, `data:`, `/`, `./` or `../`, or ending in `.json`.
params.zh: 設定檔物件（檢查後直接回傳）、id 或短名稱（在 `profiles` 裡查），或網址（會去抓）。網址指的是以 `http:`、`https:`、`blob:`、`data:`、`/`、`./`、`../` 開頭，或以 `.json` 結尾的字串。

params.name: profiles
params.en: Where ids are looked up. The default is an empty list, so pass [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES) (or use [`loadProfile()`](#loadProfile), which does).
params.zh: 用來查 id 的清單。預設是空的，所以要傳入 [`PROFILES`](#PROFILES)（或改用已經幫你傳好的 [`loadProfile()`](#loadProfile)）。

params.name: fetch
params.en: Replaces `fetch`, for tests or special loading. It must return `{ ok, status?, json() }`.
params.zh: 取代 `fetch`，給測試或特殊的載入方式用。必須回傳 `{ ok, status?, json() }`。

params.name: base
params.en: A base URL that a relative path is resolved against.
params.zh: 解析相對路徑用的基底網址。

returns.en: The raw profile (not normalized).
returns.zh: 原始的設定檔（沒有整理過）。

caption.en: Prints `korg-nanokontrol2`, `akai-lpd8`, then the error header and the first two problems of an invalid object.
caption.zh: 印出 `korg-nanokontrol2`、`akai-lpd8`，再印出一個不合法物件的錯誤標題和前兩個問題。

entries.name: ScoreMidi
entries.signature: new ScoreMidi({ midi, channel = 15, segment = { note: 36 }, cue = { note: 84 }, length = 0.15, scrub = false, enabled = true, timer = (fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms) } = {})

summary.en: Turns a show's segment changes and cues into MIDI notes and CCs on one channel, so a DAW or lighting desk can follow the show.
summary.zh: 把演出的段落切換和 cue 變成某個頻道上的 MIDI 音符與 CC，讓 DAW 或燈光台能跟著演出走。

description.en: The score knows when a segment starts and when a cue passes. An outside program cannot read the score, but it can read MIDI: launch a clip on a note, jump a scene on a CC. Create a `ScoreMidi`, then call `out.segment({ index, cause })` and `out.cue({ name, n })` (`createShow({ score: { …, midi: { channel: 15 } } })` does this for you).
description.zh: 樂譜知道每個段落什麼時候開始、cue 什麼時候經過。外部程式讀不到樂譜，但讀得到 MIDI：用某個音符啟動片段，用某個 CC 切換場景。建立一個 `ScoreMidi`，然後呼叫 `out.segment({ index, cause })` 和 `out.cue({ name, n })`（`createShow({ score: { …, midi: { channel: 15 } } })` 會替你做這件事）。

description.en: Markers go out only while the show plays (`cause` is `play` or `release`). A `reset` never sends, and `seek` and `jump` send only with `scrub: true`. Everything goes through the engine's own `noteOn`, `noteOff` and `cc`, so the MIDI OUT meter shows it and `panic()` can silence it. Off unless you create it.
description.zh: 只有演出在播放時才送標記（`cause` 是 `play` 或 `release`）。`reset` 永遠不送，`seek` 和 `jump` 只有在 `scrub: true` 時才送。所有訊息都走引擎自己的 `noteOn`、`noteOff`、`cc`，所以 MIDI OUT 音量表看得到，`panic()` 也關得掉。你不建立它就不會送。

params.name: midi
params.en: What to send through: a [`Midi`](#Midi) (anything with `noteOn`, `noteOff` and `cc`). Required: without it the constructor throws.
params.zh: 要透過誰送出：一個 [`Midi`](#Midi)（任何有 `noteOn`、`noteOff`、`cc` 的東西都行）。必填，沒給建構時會丟出錯誤。

params.name: channel
params.en: The MIDI channel, 1..16 (anything else throws).
params.zh: MIDI 頻道，1..16（其他值會丟出錯誤）。

params.name: segment
params.en: `{ note, cc, velocity }`: segment number i sends note `note + i` and/or CC `cc` with value i. `velocity` defaults to 100, `note` to 36 (give `note: null` to send only the CC). `false` sends no segment markers.
params.zh: `{ note, cc, velocity }`：第 i 段會送出音符 `note + i` 和（或）CC `cc`（值為 i）。`velocity` 預設 100，`note` 預設 36（只想送 CC 的話，給 `note: null`）。`false` 表示不送段落標記。

params.name: cue
params.en: `{ note, notes, cc, velocity }`: every cue sends `note` (or its own note from the map `notes`, by cue name) and/or CC `cc` with the cue's number as value. `note` defaults to 84 (give `note: null` to send only the CC). `false` sends no cue markers.
params.zh: `{ note, notes, cc, velocity }`：每個 cue 會送出 `note`（或在 `notes` 對照表裡依 cue 名稱查到的專屬音符）和（或）CC `cc`，值是 cue 的編號。`note` 預設 84（只想送 CC 的話，給 `note: null`）。`false` 表示不送 cue 標記。

params.name: length
params.en: Seconds before a marker note's note-off. A marker note is a trigger, not a held note.
params.zh: 標記音符送出後，隔幾秒才送 note-off。標記音符是觸發用的，不是按著的音。

params.name: scrub
params.en: Also mark jumps the playhead made by hand (`seek`, `jump`). Off by default, so dragging the scrubber does not launch clips in the DAW.
params.zh: 手動拖動播放頭造成的跳轉（`seek`、`jump`）也要送標記。預設關閉，這樣拖動時間軸不會在 DAW 裡誤觸發片段。

params.name: enabled
params.en: Set to `false` (or later, `out.enabled = false`) to send nothing.
params.zh: 設成 `false`（或之後改 `out.enabled = false`）就什麼都不送。

params.name: timer
params.en: `(fn, ms) => …` used to schedule the note-offs. It is `setTimeout`; pass your own in a test.
params.zh: 排程 note-off 用的 `(fn, ms) => …`，預設是 `setTimeout`，測試時可以傳自己的。

caption.en: Prints note 38 and CC 20 = 2 for segment 2, note 90 and CC 21 = 4 for the cue, nothing for the seek, and the note-offs 0.15 s later.
caption.zh: 印出第 2 段的音符 38 和 CC 20 = 2，cue 的音符 90 和 CC 21 = 4，跳轉不會有任何輸出，0.15 秒後再印出 note-off。

members.name: segmentMessages
members.doc: What a segment change sends: [{ type:'note'|'cc', number, value }] (also the unit-test surface).

members.name: cueMessages
members.doc: What a cue sends.

members.name: segment
members.doc: A segment began.

members.name: cue
members.doc: A cue was passed.

summary.en: Turns a −1..1 number into a 14-bit pitch-bend value (0..16383), the inverse of `bendToUnit()`.
summary.zh: 把 −1..1 的數字轉成 14 位元的彎音輪數值（0..16383），是 `bendToUnit()` 的反向。

description.en: It does not hold `u` to −1..1, so clamp it first if it can overshoot. [`encodeMessage()`](#encodeMessage) clamps the final value into 0..16383 anyway, so a pitch-bend message built from an overshoot stays valid.
description.zh: 它不會把 `u` 限制在 −1..1，可能超出範圍的話請先自己限制。不過 [`encodeMessage()`](#encodeMessage) 最後會把數值限制在 0..16383，所以用超出範圍的數字組成的彎音訊息仍然是合法的。

params.name: u
params.en: A position from −1 (fully down) to 1 (fully up). 0 is the centre.
params.zh: 位置，從 −1（最下）到 1（最上），0 是中心。

returns.en: The rounded 14-bit value: `unitToBend(0)` is 8192, `unitToBend(1)` is 16383.
returns.zh: 四捨五入後的 14 位元數值：`unitToBend(0)` 是 8192，`unitToBend(1)` 是 16383。

caption.en: Prints `0 8192 16383`, then the three bytes of a half-up pitch bend.
caption.zh: 印出 `0 8192 16383`，再印出「推到一半」的彎音訊息的三個位元組。

summary.en: Checks a controller profile and returns every problem as a sentence; an empty array means it is valid.
summary.zh: 檢查一個控制器設定檔，把每個問題都寫成一句話回傳。空陣列表示沒問題。

description.en: It reports all problems at once, not just the first. It checks: `id` and `short` are lower-case `[a-z0-9_-]` and `short` is not a reserved family name (`cc`, `note`, `bend`, `ch`, `virtual`, `raw`, `clock`), `name` and `kind` exist, a `device` cites at least one source, `match` regexes compile, `face` has a size, every control has a unique non-reserved `id` (see [`RESERVED_IDS`](#RESERVED_IDS)), a known `type` and `msg`, numbers in range and no two controls listening to the same message, encoders name their `relative` mode, and the `sections` (and `portrait`, if given) show every control exactly once, inside the faceplate and within their grid.
description.zh: 它會一次回報所有問題，不是只講第一個。檢查的項目有：`id` 和 `short` 是小寫的 `[a-z0-9_-]`，而且 `short` 不是保留的家族名稱（`cc`、`note`、`bend`、`ch`、`virtual`、`raw`、`clock`）。有 `name` 和 `kind`。`device` 至少註明一個來源。`match` 的正規表示式能編譯。`face` 有尺寸。每個控制項的 `id` 不重複也不是保留字（見 [`RESERVED_IDS`](#RESERVED_IDS)），有認得的 `type` 和 `msg`，數字在範圍內，且沒有兩個控制項聽同一則訊息。旋鈕要寫明 `relative` 模式。`sections`（和有給的話 `portrait`）要讓每個控制項剛好出現一次，位在面板內，並且塞得進它的格子。

description.en: This is the check behind `normalizeProfile()` (it throws with this list), `resolveProfile()` and the test that validates every shipped profile. Run it on your own file before you try it in a page.
description.zh: `normalizeProfile()`（用這份清單丟出錯誤）、`resolveProfile()`，以及驗證所有內建設定檔的測試，背後都是這個檢查。把自己的檔案放進網頁之前，先跑一次。

params.name: p
params.en: A raw profile object (for example parsed from your JSON file).
params.zh: 原始的設定檔物件（例如從你的 JSON 檔解析出來的）。

returns.en: The problems, in plain words. `[]` is valid.
returns.zh: 用白話寫的問題清單。`[]` 表示合法。

caption.en: Prints `[]` for a shipped profile, then a list of what is wrong with the made-up one (bad id, reserved short name, no source, CC out of range, control not shown).
caption.zh: 內建設定檔印出 `[]`，接著列出自己亂寫的那個有什麼問題（id 不合法、短名稱是保留字、沒有來源、CC 超出範圍、控制項沒有被顯示）。

summary.en: Wraps `navigator.requestMIDIAccess` so every caller gets the virtual access: real ports join if they answer in time, and the virtual input stays without Web MIDI.
summary.zh: 包裝 `navigator.requestMIDIAccess`，讓每個呼叫者都拿到虛擬的 access：真實的埠有及時回應就併進來，就算沒有 Web MIDI 或被拒絕，虛擬輸入也還在。

description.en: If the real request answers within `waitMs` (1200 ms by default), its ports are there from the start. If it answers later they hot-plug in as `statechange` events. If it is refused or missing (Safari, iPad), the virtual input is still there. A permission prompt nobody answers cannot hang the sketch: it gets the access after `waitMs` anyway.
description.zh: 真實請求在 `waitMs`（預設 1200 毫秒）內回應的話，它的埠一開始就在。晚一點回應，就以 `statechange` 事件熱插拔進來。被拒絕或不存在（Safari、iPad）時，虛擬輸入還是在。沒有人回答的權限詢問不會卡死草圖：`waitMs` 一到它就會拿到 access。

params.name: real
params.en: The original `requestMIDIAccess`, already bound (`navigator.requestMIDIAccess.bind(navigator)`), or `null` when there is none. The real request still happens, permission prompt and all.
params.zh: 原本的 `requestMIDIAccess`，要先綁好 `this`（`navigator.requestMIDIAccess.bind(navigator)`），沒有的話給 `null`。真實的請求仍然會進行，權限詢問也一樣。

params.name: make
params.en: `(opts) => …` returning the object of [`createVirtualMIDIAccess()`](#createVirtualMIDIAccess). Required. Return the same one each time to share it.
params.zh: `(opts) => …`，回傳 [`createVirtualMIDIAccess()`](#createVirtualMIDIAccess) 的物件。必填。每次回傳同一個就能共用。

params.name: waitMs
params.en: How long to wait for the real request before answering anyway.
params.zh: 最多等真實請求多久，時間到就先回覆。

returns.en: A function `(opts?) => Promise<MIDIAccess>` to put where `navigator.requestMIDIAccess` was.
returns.zh: 一個函式 `(opts?) => Promise<MIDIAccess>`，放到原本 `navigator.requestMIDIAccess` 的位置。

caption.en: Prints `['Demo MIDI']`, then `true 1`: the caller got the virtual access, and it was asked for once.
caption.zh: 印出 `['Demo MIDI']`，再印出 `true 1`：呼叫者拿到的是虛擬的 access，而且只被要求過一次。

caption.en: The real wiring: put it before the sketch runs and its old MIDI code needs no change.
caption.zh: 真正的接法：放在草圖執行之前，它舊的 MIDI 程式碼就不用改。

summary.en: Returns a copy of a profile with every control moved to another MIDI channel, for a unit that is set to a channel other than the profile's.
summary.zh: 回傳一份設定檔的副本，所有控制項都改到另一個 MIDI 頻道，給「機器設定的頻道跟設定檔不同」的情況用。

description.en: Explicit LED channels (`led.ch`) stay as they are, since LED feedback may use a different channel from the control. This is what the `channel` option of [`createController()`](#createController) and the `channel` attribute of `<oav-controller>` call.
description.zh: 明確寫出的 LED 頻道（`led.ch`）會維持原樣，因為 LED 回饋用的頻道可能跟控制項不同。[`createController()`](#createController) 的 `channel` 選項和 `<oav-controller>` 的 `channel` 屬性，呼叫的就是它。

params.name: profile
params.en: A profile.
params.zh: 設定檔。

params.name: ch
params.en: The channel, 1..16. A falsy value (`0`, `null`) returns the same profile object untouched.
params.zh: 頻道，1..16。給假值（`0`、`null`）就原封不動回傳同一個設定檔物件。

returns.en: A deep copy, validated, with `channel` and every control's `ch` set. The original is not changed.
returns.zh: 深層複製的副本，已通過驗證，`channel` 和每個控制項的 `ch` 都改好了。原本的不會被改動。

caption.en: Prints `10 -> 3`: the shipped profile keeps its channel, the copy has every control on channel 3.
caption.zh: 印出 `10 -> 3`：內建的設定檔頻道不變，副本的每個控制項都在頻道 3。

summary.en: The default look of `ControllerCanvas`: background, body, text, idle colours, `accent`, `glow` and fonts. Pass any subset as the `theme` option.
summary.zh: `ControllerCanvas` 的預設外觀：背景、機身、文字、待機顏色、`accent`、`glow` 和字型。把任何子集當作 `theme` 選項傳入即可。

description.en: Colours are CSS colour strings. `bg: null` lets the video or page underneath show through, and `accent: '#7ea6ff'` makes the panel monochrome-with-one-colour, which suits a branded video.
description.zh: 顏色都是 CSS 顏色字串。`bg: null` 讓底下的影片或頁面透出來，`accent: '#7ea6ff'` 則讓整個面板只用一個顏色，很適合有品牌色的影片。

value.en: A frozen object (you cannot change it; pass `theme` instead). Keys: `bg` (the area around the device; `null` leaves what is underneath), `body` (the faceplate; `null` uses the profile's `face.body`), `ink` (big text), `label` (control labels), `dim` (faceplate and section lettering), `idle` (a pad at rest), `button`, `cap` (knob caps), `well` (fader slots and strip wells), `screen`, `screenInk`, `screenDim`, `accent` (one colour for everything that moves; `null` keeps each control's own), `glow` (0 flat to 1 like the on-screen controller) and the fonts `font` and `mono`.
value.zh: 凍結的物件（不能修改，要用 `theme` 選項覆寫）。鍵有：`bg`（機器周圍的區域，`null` 表示保留底下原本的畫面）、`body`（面板，`null` 用設定檔的 `face.body`）、`ink`（大字）、`label`（控制項標籤）、`dim`（面板與區塊的文字）、`idle`（待機的打擊墊）、`button`、`cap`（旋鈕蓋）、`well`（推桿溝槽和觸控條底）、`screen`、`screenInk`、`screenDim`、`accent`（所有會動的東西用同一個顏色，`null` 保留各控制項自己的顏色）、`glow`（0 是平面，1 是跟螢幕控制器一樣的光暈），以及字型 `font` 和 `mono`。

caption.en: Prints the defaults (`#060709 null 1`), then the panel's theme with your three keys replaced and everything else (such as `ink`) kept.
caption.zh: 印出預設值（`#060709 null 1`），再印出面板的外觀：你指定的三個鍵被取代，其他（例如 `ink`）維持原樣。

summary.en: Builds the `control` event payload for one control change: `id`, `value`, `raw`, `signal`, the parsed `message`, its `bytes` and where it came from.
summary.zh: 為一次控制項變化組出 `control` 事件的內容：`id`、`value`、`raw`、`signal`、解析後的 `message`、`bytes`，以及它從哪裡來。

description.en: Always there: `profile` (the profile id), `id`, `type`, `label`, `value`, `raw`, `signal`, `message`, `bytes`, `source` and `time` (`performance.now()`, rounded). `value` is 0..1 (−1..1 for a bipolar wheel); a pad is its velocity while held and 0 on release; a button is 0 or 1; for keys it is that note's velocity. `raw` is the MIDI number (0..127, pitch bend 0..16383). `signal` is the name the rest of open-audiovisual uses (`midi/lpd8/k1`; for a key `midi/minilab3/n60`). `message` is the parsed MIDI (`{ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 70, value: 53 }`) and `bytes` the raw bytes. `source` is `'ui'` (a finger, a mouse, `set()`), `'hardware'` (a real port, or bytes you `ingest()`) or `'mirror'`.
description.zh: 一定會有的欄位：`profile`（設定檔 id）、`id`、`type`、`label`、`value`、`raw`、`signal`、`message`、`bytes`、`source`、`time`（`performance.now()`，取整數）。`value` 是 0..1（雙向彎音輪是 −1..1），打擊墊在按著時是力度、放開是 0，按鈕是 0 或 1，琴鍵則是那個音的力度。`raw` 是 MIDI 的號碼（0..127，彎音是 0..16383）。`signal` 是 open-audiovisual 其他部分用的名稱（`midi/lpd8/k1`，琴鍵是 `midi/minilab3/n60`）。`message` 是解析後的 MIDI（`{ type: 'cc', ch: 1, cc: 70, value: 53 }`），`bytes` 是原始位元組。`source` 是 `'ui'`（手指、滑鼠、`set()`）、`'hardware'`（真實的埠，或你 `ingest()` 的位元組）或 `'mirror'`。

description.en: Sometimes there: `note` and `velocity` (note messages, `velocity` 0 for a release), `delta` (a relative encoder: the signed steps), `held` (a pad or button), and `pressure` (a pad, when it is above 0). The `control`, `noteon` and `noteoff` events carry it as their `detail`.
description.zh: 有時才有的欄位：`note` 和 `velocity`（音符訊息，放開時 `velocity` 為 0）、`delta`（相對旋鈕：有正負號的步數）、`held`（打擊墊或按鈕）、`pressure`（打擊墊，大於 0 時才有）。`control`、`noteon`、`noteoff` 事件把它當作 `detail`。

params.name: mc
params.en: The controller the change happened on.
params.zh: 發生變化的控制器。

params.name: id
params.en: The control id.
params.zh: 控制項 id。

params.name: st
params.en: Its state after the change (`mc.get(id)`).
params.zh: 變化之後的狀態（`mc.get(id)`）。

params.name: info
params.en: What `onChange` gave: `{ source, ev, note, bytes }`.
params.zh: `onChange` 給的內容：`{ source, ev, note, bytes }`。

returns.en: The payload, plain JSON that is safe to `postMessage`.
returns.zh: 事件內容，是可以安全 `postMessage` 的純 JSON。

caption.en: Prints the readout line `midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1`, then the bytes `[176, 74, 53]`, `ui` and the signal name.
caption.zh: 印出讀數列的文字 `midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1`，再印出位元組 `[176, 74, 53]`、`ui` 和訊號名稱。

entries.name: ControllerCanvas
entries.signature: new ControllerCanvas({ profile = 'arturia-minilab3', signals = null, controller = null, mapping = null, theme = {}, notes = 'auto', screen = true, padding = 0.05, now = defaultNow } = {})

summary.en: Draws a controller's faceplate into any 2D canvas context, every frame, at any size: the bottom of a performance video, an overlay, a thumbnail.
summary.zh: 把控制器的面板畫進任何 2D 畫布，每個畫面都畫，任何大小都行：演出影片的下半部、疊圖、縮圖。

description.en: The on-screen controller is DOM: perfect to play, impossible to record, because a page cannot capture its own DOM into a video. This draws the same faceplate, every section where it sits on the device and in the same colours, straight into a 2D context. It is vector and drawn at the output size, so a 4K frame is as sharp as a 1080 one, and it costs a few hundred path calls a frame. `@openav/record`'s `Compositor#setPanel` takes one.
description.zh: 螢幕上的控制器是 DOM：很適合彈，卻沒辦法錄，因為網頁不能把自己的 DOM 錄進影片。這個類別把同一個面板直接畫進 2D 畫布，每個區塊都在機器上原本的位置，用同樣的顏色。它是向量，直接以輸出的大小繪製，所以 4K 畫面跟 1080 一樣清楚，每個畫面約花幾百次路徑呼叫。`@openav/record` 的 `Compositor#setPanel` 就是接收它。

description.en: Call `panel.draw(ctx, { x, y, w, h })` every frame, or `panel.renderTo(canvas)` to fill a canvas of its own. What a video needs that a screen does not: a touch has to stay visible for a few frames (30 fps is 33 ms; a staccato note can be shorter), so released keys and pads fade out instead of switching off, the control a hand just moved glows, and the keyboard follows the device's octave buttons. `panel.aspect` is the faceplate's width ÷ height, for reserving an area of that shape. With neither `signals` nor `controller` the panel just stays at rest.
description.zh: 每個畫面呼叫 `panel.draw(ctx, { x, y, w, h })`，或用 `panel.renderTo(canvas)` 畫滿一張自己的畫布。影片需要而螢幕不需要的東西：一次觸碰要在畫面上留幾格（30 fps 是 33 毫秒，很短的斷音可能比這還短），所以放開的琴鍵和打擊墊會淡出而不是直接熄掉，剛被手動過的控制項會發光，鍵盤也會跟著機器的八度按鈕移動。`panel.aspect` 是面板的寬除以高，可用來預留相同形狀的區域。`signals` 和 `controller` 都沒給時，面板就只是靜止不動。

params.name: profile
params.en: Profile id, short name or object. An unknown id throws `ControllerCanvas: unknown profile "x"`.
params.zh: 設定檔 id、短名稱或物件。不認得的 id 會丟出 `ControllerCanvas: unknown profile "x"`。

params.name: signals
params.en: Follow the generic MIDI names on this bus (`midi/ch/<ch>/…`, `midi/note/on|off`, `midi/cc/<n>`, `midi/bend`): live hardware, the on-screen controller, the QWERTY piano, phones and a recorded take playing back all move the panel. Each message counts once, though hardware publishes it under two names.
params.zh: 跟隨這條匯流排上的通用 MIDI 名稱（`midi/ch/<ch>/…`、`midi/note/on|off`、`midi/cc/<n>`、`midi/bend`）：實際的硬體、螢幕控制器、電腦鍵盤鋼琴、手機，以及正在回放的錄音，都會讓面板動起來。硬體的一則訊息雖然用兩個名稱發佈，也只會算一次。

params.name: controller
params.en: Follow this existing controller instead of the bus: exactly that device, with its learned mapping. A recorded take does not reach it. When given, `signals` is ignored.
params.zh: 改為跟隨這個現有的控制器，不聽匯流排：正好就是那一台，連同它學到的對應。錄音回放不會傳到它。有給的話會忽略 `signals`。

params.name: mapping
params.en: Learned bindings to apply to the panel's own controller: the `exportMapping()` of the live device.
params.zh: 要套用到面板自己的控制器上的學習結果：就是實機控制器的 `exportMapping()`。

params.name: theme
params.en: Any subset of [`CANVAS_THEME`](#CANVAS_THEME): colours, `glow`, fonts.
params.zh: [`CANVAS_THEME`](#CANVAS_THEME) 的任何子集：顏色、`glow`、字型。

params.name: notes
params.en: Write the held notes large under the faceplate. `'auto'` does it when the area has room, `true` makes room, `false` never.
params.zh: 把按著的音大大地寫在面板下面。`'auto'` 是區域有空間時才寫，`true` 會擠出空間，`false` 永遠不寫。

params.name: screen
params.en: The device's own screen (MiniLab 3, KeyStep) shows the last touch, as the hardware's does: `Knob 3 · 87`, `C4 · 100`.
params.zh: 機器自己的螢幕（MiniLab 3、KeyStep）顯示最後一次碰了什麼，跟實機一樣：`Knob 3 · 87`、`C4 · 100`。

params.name: padding
params.en: Space around the faceplate, as a share of the area's short side.
params.zh: 面板周圍的留白，以區域短邊的比例表示。

params.name: now
params.en: The clock in milliseconds that the fades use; default `performance.now()`. The `now` you pass to `draw()` must be on the same clock.
params.zh: 淡出效果用的時鐘（毫秒），預設是 `performance.now()`。傳給 `draw()` 的 `now` 要用同一個時鐘。

notes.en: It is a silent model: it publishes nothing back to the bus. `panel.dispose()` stops listening to the bus or controller (a controller you passed in is left as it was).
notes.zh: 它是個安靜的模型：不會往匯流排發佈任何東西。`panel.dispose()` 會停止聽匯流排或控制器（你傳進來的控制器不會被動到）。

caption.en: The Arturia MiniLab 3 is drawn into the canvas with C4 and E4 lit, pad 1 lit, and knob 1 turned up. The device screen reads `Knob 1 · 100`.
caption.zh: Arturia MiniLab 3 被畫進畫布，C4 和 E4 亮著，pad 1 亮著，旋鈕 1 轉大了。機器的螢幕寫著 `Knob 1 · 100`。

caption.en: A different pad of the LPD8 lights every third of a second and then fades, all in one accent colour, as it would in a recorded video.
caption.zh: LPD8 的打擊墊每三分之一秒換一個亮起，然後淡出，全部是同一個強調色，就像錄進影片時的樣子。

members.name: profile
members.doc: The profile being drawn (normalized).

members.name: aspect
members.doc: Width ÷ height of the faceplate — layouts reserve an area of this shape (a picture-in-picture corner).

members.name: geometry
members.doc: Geometry for a rect (cached while the rect stays the same).

members.name: reset
members.doc: Release everything (stuck-key insurance between takes).

members.name: draw
members.doc: Draw into `rect` of a 2D context.

members.name: renderTo
members.doc: Draw into a canvas of its own (an overlay, a thumbnail): fills the whole canvas.

members.name: dispose
members.doc: Stop listening.

summary.en: Computes where everything goes when a profile's faceplate is drawn into a pixel rectangle: the face, every section, every control cell, and the notes strip.
summary.zh: 算出設定檔的面板畫進某個像素矩形時，每樣東西的位置：面板、每個區塊、每個控制項的格子，以及音名條。

description.en: The faceplate keeps its own proportions, centred in the rect. The sections are laid out the way the on-screen controller's CSS grid does (row or column flow, spans), so the canvas drawing and the DOM agree. It is pure, so it is the part to test, and the part to use when you want to draw something of your own on top of a control.
description.zh: 面板維持自己的比例，置中在矩形裡。區塊的排法跟螢幕控制器的 CSS grid 一致（橫向或直向排列、跨格），所以畫布上的繪製和 DOM 版本一致。它是純函式，適合拿來測試，也適合在你想在某個控制項上疊自己畫的東西時使用。

params.name: profile
params.en: A normalized profile (`MidiController#profile`).
params.zh: 整理過的設定檔（`MidiController#profile`）。

params.name: rect
params.en: The area, in pixels.
params.zh: 區域，單位是像素。

params.name: padding
params.en: Space around the faceplate, as a share of the rect's short side (0..1).
params.zh: 面板周圍的留白，以矩形短邊的比例表示（0..1）。

params.name: notes
params.en: Reserve a strip under the faceplate for the held notes: `true` always, `false` never, `'auto'` when the rect has room.
params.zh: 在面板下面預留一條放按著的音的位置：`true` 一定有，`false` 一定沒有，`'auto'` 是矩形有空間時才有。

returns.type: { u, face, notes, sections, controls, deco }
returns.en: `u` is the pixel size of one face unit. `face` is `{ x, y, w, h }`. `notes` is the strip or `null`. `sections` is a list with `id`, `label`, the box and its `grid`. `controls` is a `Map` from control id to `{ id, type, section, x, y, w, h }`. `deco` lists the decorations (screen, logo, lettering) in pixels.
returns.zh: `u` 是一個面板單位的像素大小。`face` 是 `{ x, y, w, h }`。`notes` 是那一條或 `null`。`sections` 是帶有 `id`、`label`、外框和 `grid` 的清單。`controls` 是從控制項 id 對到 `{ id, type, section, x, y, w, h }` 的 `Map`。`deco` 列出以像素表示的裝飾（螢幕、標誌、文字）。

caption.en: Prints the faceplate rectangle (370 wide, centred), pad 1's cell in pixels, then `16 controls with a notes strip`.
caption.zh: 印出面板的矩形（寬 370，置中）、pad 1 的格子位置（像素），再印出 `16 controls with a notes strip`。

entries.name: ControllerHost
entries.signature: new ControllerHost(profile = 'arturia-minilab3', { profiles = PROFILES, signals = null, sink = null, channel = null, follow = false, midi = null, requestAccess = null, filterOut = 'IAC', storage = undefined, telemetry = true, embedKind = 'headless' } = {})

summary.en: The object `createController()` returns: one controller with its events, its playable faceplate, its hardware connection and its MIDI output.
summary.zh: `createController()` 回傳的物件：一台控制器，包含事件、可以彈的面板、硬體連線和 MIDI 輸出。

description.en: Events, with `ctl.on(name, fn)` (returns an unsubscribe function): `control` (every knob, pad, key or button change), `noteon` and `noteoff` (the same payload, for pads, keys and note buttons), `connect` and `disconnect` (`{ port, profile }`: a hardware port started or stopped driving it), `status`, `profilechange` (`{ profile, name }`) and `'*'`, which gets `(name, detail)` for all of them. The `control` payload is the one described under [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail). `ready` and `error` exist only on the `<oav-controller>` element.
description.zh: 事件用 `ctl.on(name, fn)` 訂閱（回傳取消訂閱的函式）：`control`（任何旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵、按鈕的變化）、`noteon` 和 `noteoff`（內容相同，給打擊墊、琴鍵和音符按鈕）、`connect` 和 `disconnect`（`{ port, profile }`：某個硬體埠開始或停止驅動它）、`status`、`profilechange`（`{ profile, name }`），以及 `'*'`，所有事件都會以 `(name, detail)` 通知它。`control` 的內容見 [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail)。`ready` 和 `error` 只有 `<oav-controller>` 元素才有。

description.en: `ctl.status` is `{ hardware, input, output, outputState }`. `hardware` is `off`, `asking`, `waiting` (listening, but the device is not plugged in), `connected`, `unavailable` (the browser has no Web MIDI) or `denied` (permission refused). `outputState` is `off`, `asking`, `open`, `missing` (no port matches), `unavailable` or `denied`. `ctl.profileId`, `ctl.controller` and `ctl.profile` say which device is on screen; `ctl.controllers`, `ctl.view`, `ctl.midi` and `ctl.output` are the objects underneath.
description.zh: `ctl.status` 是 `{ hardware, input, output, outputState }`。`hardware` 可能是 `off`、`asking`、`waiting`（在聽，但機器沒接上）、`connected`、`unavailable`（瀏覽器沒有 Web MIDI）或 `denied`（權限被拒絕）。`outputState` 可能是 `off`、`asking`、`open`、`missing`（沒有符合的埠）、`unavailable` 或 `denied`。`ctl.profileId`、`ctl.controller`、`ctl.profile` 告訴你螢幕上是哪台機器，`ctl.controllers`、`ctl.view`、`ctl.midi`、`ctl.output` 則是底下的物件。

description.en: What a hand plays on the screen leaves through the output port as real MIDI; moves of your real hardware are not forwarded (your software already hears the device), and input with the same name as the chosen output (the loopMIDI echo) is muted.
description.zh: 螢幕上的手彈出來的，會從輸出埠以真正的 MIDI 送出。真實硬體的動作不會被轉送（你的軟體本來就聽得到那台機器），名稱跟所選輸出埠相同的輸入（loopMIDI 的回音）會被靜音。

params.name: profile
params.en: Profile id, short name or object.
params.zh: 設定檔 id、短名稱或物件。

params.name: profiles
params.en: The profiles a picker or `follow` may switch to. Default: every shipped one.
params.zh: 選單或 `follow` 可以切換到的設定檔。預設是所有內建的。

params.name: signals
params.en: Also publish `midi/<short>/…` into a show.
params.zh: 同時把 `midi/<short>/…` 發佈進演出。

params.name: sink
params.en: Publish through this function instead (a relay), as in [`MidiController`](#MidiController).
params.zh: 改由這個函式發佈（中繼），用法同 [`MidiController`](#MidiController)。

params.name: channel
params.en: Move every control to this MIDI channel (your unit is set to another one). See [`withChannel()`](#withChannel).
params.zh: 把所有控制項移到這個 MIDI 頻道（你的機器設定在別的頻道時）。見 [`withChannel()`](#withChannel)。

params.name: follow
params.en: When a different known device is plugged in, show that one.
params.zh: 接上另一台認得的機器時，就改顯示那一台。

params.name: midi
params.en: Use this engine (a show's) instead of the page-shared one.
params.zh: 改用這個引擎（演出的），不用頁面共用的。

params.name: requestAccess
params.en: Where the `MIDIAccess` comes from, as in [`Midi`](#Midi). Giving it makes the controller use its own engine.
params.zh: `MIDIAccess` 從哪裡來，用法同 [`Midi`](#Midi)。給了它，控制器就會用自己的引擎。

params.name: filterOut
params.en: The input-port filter of [`Midi`](#Midi). Anything but the default `'IAC'` also gives the controller its own engine.
params.zh: [`Midi`](#Midi) 的輸入埠過濾。任何不是預設 `'IAC'` 的值，也會讓控制器用自己的引擎。

params.name: storage
params.en: Where learned mappings are kept, as in [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers). Default: `localStorage` when available.
params.zh: 學到的對應存在哪裡，用法同 [`MidiControllers`](#MidiControllers)。預設是有 `localStorage` 就用它。

params.name: telemetry
params.en: `false` sends no anonymous page-load hit.
params.zh: `false` 就不送匿名的頁面載入資料。

params.name: embedKind
params.en: Which kind of embed this is for the hit: `'headless'` (default), `'element'` or `'iframe'`.
params.zh: 這次嵌入屬於哪一種，供那筆資料用：`'headless'`（預設）、`'element'` 或 `'iframe'`。

needs.en: `connectHardware()`, `setOutput()` and `requestMidi()` are the only calls that ask the browser for MIDI. Chrome, Edge and Firefox show a permission prompt, so call them from a click when you can. Without Web MIDI (Safari, iPad) the controller still plays and fires events, and `status` says `unavailable`.
needs.zh: 只有 `connectHardware()`、`setOutput()`、`requestMidi()` 會向瀏覽器要 MIDI。Chrome、Edge、Firefox 會跳出權限詢問，所以可以的話請在點擊裡呼叫。沒有 Web MIDI（Safari、iPad）時，控制器仍然能彈、能觸發事件，`status` 會顯示 `unavailable`。

caption.en: Prints `true akai-lpd8 off`, then the bytes of knob 1 on channel 3, then the new device with the channel override kept.
caption.zh: 印出 `true akai-lpd8 off`，再印出旋鈕 1 在頻道 3 的位元組，最後是換過的新機器，頻道覆寫仍然有效。

members.name: controller
members.doc: The live model (MidiController) of the device on screen.

members.name: profile
members.doc: Its normalized profile (controls, faceplate, sources).

members.name: on
members.doc: Subscribe: 'control' | 'noteon' | 'noteoff' | 'connect' | 'disconnect' | 'status' | 'profilechange' | '*' (name, detail).

members.name: set
members.signature: id, value, { note = null, quiet = false } = {}
members.doc: Move a control like a hand would (see embed.js setControl).

members.name: get
members.doc: Current value of one control (0..1, −1..1 bipolar), or null.

members.name: values
members.doc: { id: value } for every control.

members.name: reset
members.doc: Let go of everything and bring every control home (sends what a hand would, unless quiet).

members.name: releaseAll
members.doc: Let go of every held pad and key (blur, page hide): the DAW gets its note-offs.

members.name: ingest
members.doc: MIDI arriving from anywhere (a WebSocket, another page, a port you manage): the faceplate follows.

members.name: send
members.doc: Raw bytes out of the MIDI output port (if one is open).

members.name: mount
members.doc: Draw the playable faceplate into `el` (it fills el and follows its size).

members.name: learn
members.doc: Learn mode: tap a control on screen, then move the one on your hardware (or ingest() it).

members.name: setProfile
members.doc: Show another device: id, short name, URL, or profile object.

members.name: connectHardware
members.doc: Follow the real device: its port drives the on-screen one (asks for Web MIDI).

members.name: requestMidi
members.doc: Ask for Web MIDI without connecting anything (an output picker needs the port list).

members.name: outputs
members.doc: Output port names, once Web MIDI is on.

members.name: setOutput
members.doc: Send what is played here to a MIDI output: a name, a substring ('IAC', 'loopMIDI') or '/regex/'.

members.name: dispose
members.doc: Remove everything this controller added: listeners, the view, its share of the MIDI engine.

summary.en: The playable on-screen faceplate of a controller: knobs, faders, pads and keys you drive with a mouse, a finger or the keyboard, repainted from the controller's state.
summary.zh: 控制器在螢幕上可以彈的面板：旋鈕、推桿、打擊墊、琴鍵，可以用滑鼠、手指或鍵盤操作，畫面隨著控制器的狀態重畫。

description.en: Two shapes, chosen from the box it lives in. `face`: the device as it looks, sections where they sit on the real faceplate, scaled to fit (desktop, iPad, a phone held sideways). `stack`: the same controls re-gridded top to bottom for a tall box (a phone held upright), as the profile's `portrait` says. Nothing scrolls and nothing shrinks below a thumb. Square grid devices (Launchpad) stay `face`. `mode` fixes one; `'auto'` follows the box.
description.zh: 兩種形狀，依它所在的盒子大小決定。`face`：機器原本的樣子，各區塊在真實面板上的位置，縮放到剛好放進去（桌機、iPad、橫拿的手機）。`stack`：同樣的控制項，照設定檔的 `portrait` 重新由上到下排列，給高的盒子用（直拿的手機）。不會捲動，也不會縮到比手指小。方形格子的機器（Launchpad）一律維持 `face`。`mode` 可以固定其中一種，`'auto'` 則跟著盒子走。

description.en: Every control repaints from the controller's state, so a finger here and a knob on the desk look the same, and a move from hardware gets a brief glow ring so you can see your hand arrive. Touch: drag a knob (right or up raises it), drag or click a fader or strip, strike a pad (higher on the pad is softer, lower is harder), hold a button, play the keys (multi-touch works). The mouse wheel turns knobs and faders.
description.zh: 每個控制項都從控制器的狀態重畫，所以螢幕上的手指和桌上的旋鈕看起來一樣，硬體動作則會有一圈短暫的光環，讓你看見自己的手「抵達」螢幕。操作：拖曳旋鈕（往右或往上是增加）、拖曳或點推桿與觸控條、敲打擊墊（敲在上半部較輕，下半部較重）、按住按鈕、彈琴鍵（支援多點觸控）。滑鼠滾輪可以轉旋鈕和推桿。

description.en: Keyboard: Tab reaches every control except the piano keys; the arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End move knobs, faders and strips (Shift for fine steps); Space or Enter strikes pads and buttons, held while the key is held. Learn mode (`setLearning(true)`) turns every tap into "bind this control", and `view.onLearnTap = (id) => …` tells you which.
description.zh: 鍵盤：Tab 可以走到每個控制項（琴鍵除外），方向鍵、Page Up/Down、Home、End 移動旋鈕、推桿和觸控條（加 Shift 是微調），空白鍵或 Enter 敲打擊墊和按鈕，按著鍵就一直按著。學習模式（`setLearning(true)`）會讓每一次點擊都變成「綁定這個控制項」，`view.onLearnTap = (id) => …` 會告訴你是哪一個。

params.name: container
params.en: The element to fill. It needs a size: the view is 100% wide and tall, so give it a height. It can be inside a shadow root: the view's CSS goes into that root, not the page.
params.zh: 要填滿的元素。它要有大小：畫面是 100% 寬、100% 高，所以要給高度。可以放在 shadow root 裡，畫面的 CSS 會放進那個 root，不會碰到頁面。

params.name: controller
params.en: The model to show and drive.
params.zh: 要顯示並驅動的模型。

params.name: mode
params.en: `'auto'`, `'face'` or `'stack'` (below).
params.zh: `'auto'`、`'face'` 或 `'stack'`（見下）。

params.name: minTouch
params.en: Pixels a control needs before `face` gives way to `stack`.
params.zh: 控制項至少要有幾個像素大，`face` 才不會被換成 `stack`。

needs.en: A browser DOM and a container with a height. `createController(…).mount(el)` is the usual way to get one.
needs.zh: 要有瀏覽器的 DOM，而且容器要有高度。平常用 `createController(…).mount(el)` 取得它。

caption.en: The AKAI LPD8 appears in the page and pad 1 lights for a moment. Try dragging a knob or tapping the pads.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現 AKAI LPD8，pad 1 亮了一下。可以試著拖曳旋鈕或敲打擊墊。

caption.en: Prints `stack`, then `face` after forcing the layout: the same controls in the two shapes.
caption.zh: 印出 `stack`，強制指定版面之後印出 `face`：同樣的控制項，兩種形狀。

members.name: setMode
members.doc: 'auto' (choose from the box) | 'face' | 'stack'.

summary.en: Makes one MIDI controller you can play, listen to, and point at hardware or a DAW, with no element and no framework: `createController('akai-lpd8')`.
summary.zh: 做出一台可以彈、可以聽、可以接硬體或 DAW 的 MIDI 控制器，不需要元素也不需要框架：`createController('akai-lpd8')`。

description.en: Four lines are enough: `const ctl = createController('akai-lpd8')`, `ctl.mount(el)` for the playable faceplate (optional, it works headless too), `ctl.on('control', fn)` to hear every knob, pad and key whether it came from the screen or the hardware, and `ctl.connectHardware()` to follow the real device. `ctl.set(id, value)` moves a control the way a hand would.
description.zh: 四行就夠：`const ctl = createController('akai-lpd8')`，`ctl.mount(el)` 畫出可以彈的面板（可有可無，沒有畫面也能用），`ctl.on('control', fn)` 聽每一個旋鈕、打擊墊、琴鍵，不論來自螢幕還是硬體，`ctl.connectHardware()` 跟隨真實的機器。`ctl.set(id, value)` 則像一隻手一樣去動某個控制項。

description.en: Controllers on one page share one [`Midi`](#Midi) engine, so the browser asks for MIDI permission once. Nothing asks until you call `connectHardware()`, `setOutput()` or `requestMidi()`. Pass `signals` to publish `midi/<short>/…` into a show.
description.zh: 同一個頁面上的控制器共用一個 [`Midi`](#Midi) 引擎，所以瀏覽器只會詢問一次 MIDI 權限。在你呼叫 `connectHardware()`、`setOutput()` 或 `requestMidi()` 之前，什麼都不會詢問。傳入 `signals` 就能把 `midi/<short>/…` 發佈進演出。

params.name: profile
params.en: A profile id (`'akai-lpd8'`), a short name (`'lpd8'`) or a profile object. For a URL, load it first with [`loadProfile()`](#loadProfile). An unknown id throws `unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)`.
params.zh: 設定檔 id（`'akai-lpd8'`）、短名稱（`'lpd8'`）或設定檔物件。要用網址的話，先用 [`loadProfile()`](#loadProfile) 載入。不認得的 id 會丟出 `unknown MIDI profile "x" (known: …)`。

params.name: o
params.en: Options, the same as the second argument of [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost): `profiles`, `signals`, `sink`, `channel`, `follow`, `midi`, `requestAccess`, `filterOut`, `storage`, `telemetry`, `embedKind`.
params.zh: 選項，跟 [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) 的第二個參數一樣：`profiles`、`signals`、`sink`、`channel`、`follow`、`midi`、`requestAccess`、`filterOut`、`storage`、`telemetry`、`embedKind`。

returns.en: The controller. Its methods are listed under [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost).
returns.zh: 控制器本身。它的方法列在 [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) 底下。

notes.en: Like `<oav-controller>`, it sends one anonymous hit per page load (which kind of embed and which device; nothing anyone plays) to the project's analytics, and nothing from localhost or the LAN. Turn it off with `createController(profile, { telemetry: false })`. The README's Telemetry section has the details.
notes.zh: 跟 `<oav-controller>` 一樣，每次載入頁面會對專案的分析送出一筆匿名資料（哪一種嵌入、哪一台機器，不含任何人彈的內容），從 localhost 或區域網路則不送。用 `createController(profile, { telemetry: false })` 可以關掉。細節在 README 的 Telemetry 一節。

caption.en: Prints three `control` events (knob 0.50, pad 1.00, pad 0.00, each from 'ui'), then the knob's value and `null` for an id that does not exist.
caption.zh: 印出三個 `control` 事件（旋鈕 0.50、打擊墊 1.00、打擊墊 0.00，來源都是 'ui'），再印出旋鈕的值，以及不存在的 id 回傳的 `null`。

caption.en: Prints the port name, then the two messages a hand on the screen sends. The last line prints nothing: what arrives from hardware is not forwarded.
caption.zh: 印出埠名，再印出螢幕上的手送出的兩則訊息。最後一行不會有輸出：從硬體進來的東西不會被轉送。

caption.en: The MiniLab 3 appears in the page with knob 1 turned up, and the console prints its signal value (0.80…). Play it with the mouse.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現 MiniLab 3，旋鈕 1 被轉大了，主控台印出它的訊號值（0.80…）。可以用滑鼠玩。

summary.en: Registers the controller element under another tag name (importing `@openav/midi/element` already registers it as `oav-controller`).
summary.zh: 把 `<oav-controller>` 元素註冊成另一個標籤名稱（匯入 `@openav/midi/element` 時已經註冊好 `<oav-controller>` 了）。

description.en: A tag name can be registered only once per page, so use this when `oav-controller` clashes with another library, or when you want two differently-named copies. The default tag registers the exported [`OavController`](#OavController) class itself; any other name registers a subclass of it.
description.zh: 一個標籤名稱在同一個頁面只能註冊一次，所以當 `oav-controller` 跟別的函式庫衝突，或你想要兩個不同名字的副本時，就用它。預設標籤註冊的是匯出的 [`OavController`](#OavController) 類別本身，其他名稱註冊的是它的子類別。

params.name: tag
params.en: The new tag name. It must contain a hyphen, as every custom element does.
params.zh: 新的標籤名稱，必須包含連字號，所有自訂元素都是如此。

returns.en: The element class registered for that tag (an already-registered tag returns what is there). `null` when the page has no `customElements`.
returns.zh: 註冊在該標籤上的元素類別（標籤已經註冊過就回傳現有的）。頁面沒有 `customElements` 時回傳 `null`。

caption.en: A 16-pad generic controller appears from a tag you named yourself; the console prints `MY-PADS generic-16p`.
caption.zh: 一台 16 個打擊墊的通用控制器，從你自己取名的標籤出現，主控台印出 `MY-PADS generic-16p`。

summary.en: Writes the readout line for a `control` event payload: `midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1`.
summary.zh: 為 `control` 事件的內容寫出讀數列的文字：`midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1`。

description.en: This is the text `<oav-controller readout>` shows under the faceplate. Use it for your own log or caption. A payload without a `message` shows only the signal and the value.
description.zh: `<oav-controller readout>` 在面板下面顯示的就是這段文字。拿去做你自己的記錄或字幕也很方便。沒有 `message` 的內容只會顯示訊號和數值。

params.name: d
params.en: A payload from [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail) (or a `control` event's `detail`). `null` gives an empty string.
params.zh: [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail) 的內容（或 `control` 事件的 `detail`）。給 `null` 回傳空字串。

returns.en: The signal name, the value (two decimals, or a whole number from 100 up), then `←`, the message as [`describeMessage()`](#describeMessage) writes it and the channel.
returns.zh: 訊號名稱、數值（兩位小數，100 以上則是整數），接著是 `←`、用 [`describeMessage()`](#describeMessage) 寫的訊息，和頻道。

caption.en: Prints `midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1`, then the same kind of line for the pitch bend and pad 1.
caption.zh: 印出 `midi/minilab3/knob1 = 0.42 ← CC 74 = 53 · ch 1`，接著是彎音輪和 pad 1 的同類文字。

summary.en: Writes one parsed MIDI message the way a person reads it: `CC 70 = 53`, `Note 36 · vel 90`, `Bend 12288`.
summary.zh: 把一則解析過的 MIDI 訊息寫成人讀得懂的樣子：`CC 70 = 53`、`Note 36 · vel 90`、`Bend 12288`。

description.en: These are the shorter lines of the `<oav-controller>` readout. [`describe()`](#describe) writes the longer log lines (`CC ch1 #70=53`).
description.zh: 這是 `<oav-controller>` 讀數列用的較短文字。[`describe()`](#describe) 寫的是較長的記錄文字（`CC ch1 #70=53`）。

params.name: m
params.en: An event from [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage). `null` gives an empty string.
params.zh: [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) 的事件。給 `null` 回傳空字串。

returns.en: `CC 70 = 53`, `Note 36 · vel 90`, `Note 36 off`, `Bend 12288` (the raw 14-bit value), `Pressure 50`, `Poly AT 36 = 12`, `Program 5`; any other type gives its name.
returns.zh: `CC 70 = 53`、`Note 36 · vel 90`、`Note 36 off`、`Bend 12288`（原始的 14 位元數值）、`Pressure 50`、`Poly AT 36 = 12`、`Program 5`，其他類型則回傳類型名稱。

caption.en: Prints `CC 70 = 53`, `Note 36 · vel 90`, `Note 36 off` and `Bend 12288`.
caption.zh: 印出 `CC 70 = 53`、`Note 36 · vel 90`、`Note 36 off` 和 `Bend 12288`。

summary.en: The attributes the `oav-controller` element reads, which are also the query parameters of the iframe page: `profile`, `layout`, `hardware`, `midi-out` and more.
summary.zh: `<oav-controller>` 讀取的屬性，也同時是 iframe 頁面的查詢參數：`profile`、`layout`、`hardware`、`midi-out`、`channel` 等等。

description.en: The iframe page copies every one of these from its URL onto the element. The extra parameters `bg`, `pad`, `frame`, `origin` and `lang` belong to the iframe page and are read by [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions). What each attribute means is under [`OavController`](#OavController).
description.zh: iframe 頁面會把網址裡的這些參數逐一複製到元素上。另外的 `bg`、`pad`、`frame`、`origin`、`lang` 是 iframe 頁面專用的，由 [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) 讀取。每個屬性的意思寫在 [`OavController`](#OavController) 底下。

value.en: A plain array, in this order. The element watches these (and `lang`) for changes.
value.zh: 一個普通陣列，順序如上。元素會監看這些屬性（加上 `lang`）有沒有改變。

examples.code:
import { EMBED_ATTRS } from '@openav/midi/embed';

console.log(EMBED_ATTRS.join(' '));

caption.en: Prints the eleven attribute names.
caption.zh: 印出十一個屬性名稱。

summary.en: The nine events the `oav-controller` element dispatches and the iframe posts to its page, from `ready` and `control` to `profilechange` and `error`.
summary.zh: `<oav-controller>` 會觸發、iframe 也會送給外層頁面的事件：`ready`、`control`、`noteon`、`noteoff`、`connect`、`disconnect`、`status`、`profilechange`、`error`。

description.en: The iframe also posts a tenth type, `values`, as the answer to the `get` command; it is not an element event, so it is not in this list. The payloads are described under [`OavController`](#OavController) and [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail).
description.zh: iframe 還會送出第十種類型 `values`，那是對 `get` 指令的回答，不是元素事件，所以不在這份清單裡。各事件的內容寫在 [`OavController`](#OavController) 和 [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail) 底下。

value.en: A plain array, in this order. The element dispatches each as a `CustomEvent` that bubbles and is composed; the iframe page forwards each to `window.parent` with [`toParent()`](#toParent).
value.zh: 一個普通陣列，順序如上。元素把每一個都當成會冒泡、可穿過 shadow root 的 `CustomEvent` 觸發，iframe 頁面則用 [`toParent()`](#toParent) 把每一個轉送給 `window.parent`。

examples.code:
import { EMBED_EVENTS } from '@openav/midi/embed';

console.log(EMBED_EVENTS.join(' '));

caption.en: Prints the nine event names.
caption.zh: 印出九個事件名稱。

summary.en: The three layouts a controller can have: `auto`, `face` (the device as it looks) and `stack` (re-gridded for a tall box).
summary.zh: 控制器的三種版面：`auto`、`face`（機器原本的樣子）和 `stack`（為高的盒子重新排列）。

description.en: A profile can opt out of `stack` (`stack: false`); square grid devices such as the Launchpad always stay `face`. See [`preferredAspect()`](#preferredAspect).
description.zh: 設定檔可以不要 `stack`（`stack: false`），像 Launchpad 這種方形的格子機器永遠維持 `face`。見 [`preferredAspect()`](#preferredAspect)。

value.en: A plain array. [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) turns any other `layout` value into `'auto'`, and the `layout` command of the iframe accepts only these.
value.zh: 一個普通陣列。[`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) 會把其他的 `layout` 值變成 `'auto'`，iframe 的 `layout` 指令也只接受這三個。

caption.en: Prints the three names, then `stack`, then `auto`.
caption.zh: 印出三個名稱，再印出 `stack`，最後印出 `auto`。

summary.en: Reads the `channel` attribute: a whole number from 1 to 16, or `null` for anything else.
summary.zh: 讀取 `channel` 屬性：1 到 16 的整數，其他任何值都是 `null`。

description.en: A `null` means "keep the profile's own channels". A number makes [`withChannel()`](#withChannel) move every control there.
description.zh: `null` 代表「維持設定檔本來的頻道」。有數字的話，[`withChannel()`](#withChannel) 會把所有控制項移到那個頻道。

params.name: v
params.en: The attribute value, a number or a string.
params.zh: 屬性的值，數字或字串。

returns.en: The channel, or `null` when it is missing, empty, not a whole number or outside 1..16.
returns.zh: 頻道，沒寫、空字串、不是整數或不在 1..16 時是 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `10 3`, then four `null`s.
caption.zh: 印出 `10 3`，再印出四個 `null`。

summary.en: Checks the `bg` colour of the iframe page and returns a safe value: `transparent`, a hex colour, or a plain colour name; anything else is `null`.
summary.zh: 檢查 iframe 頁面的 `bg` 顏色，回傳安全的值：`transparent`、十六進位顏色或單純的顏色名稱，其他一律是 `null`。

description.en: The iframe page puts the result into a CSS variable, so a value that could break out of CSS (`red;}body{`) is refused. It does not check that a name is a real colour: any 3 to 20 letters pass, and CSS ignores the ones it does not know.
description.zh: iframe 頁面會把結果放進一個 CSS 變數，所以可能跳出 CSS 的值（`red;}body{`）會被拒絕。它不檢查名稱是不是真的顏色：任何 3 到 20 個字母都會通過，CSS 不認得的就會被忽略。

params.name: v
params.en: The value from the query string.
params.zh: 來自查詢字串的值。

returns.en: `'transparent'`; `'#'` plus 3, 4, 6 or 8 hex digits (the `#` is optional in the input, so `abc` becomes `#abc`); or 3 to 20 letters, lower-cased (`'RED'` becomes `'red'`); otherwise `null`.
returns.zh: `'transparent'`，或 `'#'` 加上 3、4、6 或 8 個十六進位數字（輸入裡的 `#` 可有可無，所以 `abc` 會變成 `#abc`），或 3 到 20 個英文字母（轉成小寫，`'RED'` 變成 `'red'`），其他是 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `transparent #0b0b0c #000 red`, then three `null`s.
caption.zh: 印出 `transparent #0b0b0c #000 red`，再印出三個 `null`。

summary.en: Reads a boolean attribute: present means on, unless it says `false`, `0`, `off` or `no`.
summary.zh: 讀取布林屬性：有寫就是開，除非內容是 `false`、`0`、`off` 或 `no`。

description.en: This is why `<oav-controller readout>` and `readout="true"` both turn the readout on and `readout="off"` turns it off. Any other word counts as on, so `readout="ask"` is `true`.
description.zh: 所以 `<oav-controller readout>` 和 `readout="true"` 都會開啟讀數列，`readout="off"` 則會關掉。其他任何字都算開，所以 `readout="ask"` 也是 `true`。

params.name: v
params.en: The attribute value: `null`/`undefined`/`false` (absent) or a string. A bare attribute is the empty string.
params.zh: 屬性的值：`null`、`undefined`、`false`（沒寫）或字串。只寫屬性名稱時是空字串。

returns.en: Absent is `false`; `true` is `true`; a string is `true` unless it is (case-insensitively, trimmed) `false`, `0`, `off` or `no`.
returns.zh: 沒寫是 `false`，`true` 是 `true`，字串除了（不分大小寫、去掉空白後）`false`、`0`、`off`、`no` 之外都是 `true`。

caption.en: Prints three `true`s, then three `false`s.
caption.zh: 印出三個 `true`，再印出三個 `false`。

summary.en: Reads `hardware` and `midi-out`: off, `ask` (a button, so the permission prompt waits for a click) or on, plus which port.
summary.zh: 讀取 `hardware` 和 `midi-out`：關閉、`ask`（顯示按鈕，讓權限詢問等到點擊）或開啟，以及指定哪個埠。

description.en: Absent or `false`/`0`/`off`/`no` is off. `ask` is ask. `on`, `true`, `yes`, `auto` is on without a port. Any other text is on, and the text is the port name or `/regex/` to look for (see [`findPort()`](#findPort)): `embedMode('IAC')` is `{ mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }`.
description.zh: 沒寫或是 `false`/`0`/`off`/`no` 就是關閉。`ask` 就是 ask。`on`、`true`、`yes`、`auto` 是開啟但不指定埠。其他任何文字都是開啟，而那段文字就是要找的埠名或 `/regex/`（見 [`findPort()`](#findPort)）：`embedMode('IAC')` 是 `{ mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }`。

params.name: v
params.en: The attribute value.
params.zh: 屬性的值。

params.name: bare
params.en: What a bare attribute (no value) means: `'on'` for `hardware` (the default), `'ask'` for `midi-out`, because there is no sensible default port to send to.
params.zh: 只寫屬性、沒有值時的意思：`hardware` 是 `'on'`（預設），`midi-out` 是 `'ask'`，因為送出去沒有合理的預設埠。

returns.en: `mode` is `'off'`, `'ask'` or `'on'`. `port` is a string only when the value names one.
returns.zh: `mode` 是 `'off'`、`'ask'` 或 `'on'`。只有值裡有指定埠時，`port` 才是字串。

caption.en: Prints four `{ mode, port }` objects: off, on, ask, and on with a named port.
caption.zh: 印出四個 `{ mode, port }` 物件：關閉、開啟、ask，以及指定了埠名的開啟。

summary.en: The brightness of a fading touch: 1 at the moment it happened, 0 after `ms`, eased so it still reads on a 30 fps frame.
summary.zh: 一次淡出中的觸碰目前有多亮：發生的那一刻是 1，經過 `ms` 之後是 0，並做了緩和，所以在 30 fps 的畫面上仍然看得出來。

description.en: [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) fades released keys (180 ms), pads (450 ms), the glow of a touched control (650 ms), the last-touch text under the faceplate (1600 ms) and on the device screen (3200 ms) with it. A video frame is 33 ms at 30 fps, so a staccato note that was 20 ms long would be gone before the next frame without a fade.
description.zh: [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) 用它讓放開的琴鍵（180 毫秒）、打擊墊（450 毫秒）、被碰到的控制項光暈（650 毫秒）、面板下方的最後觸碰文字（1600 毫秒）和機器螢幕上的文字（3200 毫秒）淡出。30 fps 的影片一格是 33 毫秒，沒有淡出的話，20 毫秒長的斷音在下一格之前就消失了。

params.name: now
params.en: The current time in milliseconds.
params.zh: 目前的時間（毫秒）。

params.name: at
params.en: When the touch happened, on the same clock. `null` or `undefined` gives 0.
params.zh: 觸碰發生的時間，用同一個時鐘。`null` 或 `undefined` 會得到 0。

params.name: ms
params.en: How long the fade lasts. Not above 0 gives 0.
params.zh: 淡出持續多久。不大於 0 會得到 0。

returns.en: From 1 down to 0. The curve is the square of the remaining time, so it falls quickly at first.
returns.zh: 從 1 降到 0。曲線是剩餘時間的平方，所以一開始掉得比較快。

examples.code:
import { fadeLevel } from '@openav/midi';

for (const now of [100, 200, 300, 400, 500]) console.log(now, fadeLevel(now, 100, 400));

caption.en: Prints 1 at the moment of the touch, then 0.5625, 0.25, 0.0625 and 0 at the end of the fade.

summary.en: Listens to a `Signals` bus and hands you each MIDI message back exactly once, as an event, although hardware publishes it under two names.
summary.zh: 監聽 `Signals` 匯流排，並把每則 MIDI 訊息「剛好一次」以事件的形式還給你，雖然硬體會用兩個名稱發佈同一則訊息。

description.en: Hardware and the on-screen controllers publish every message twice: the legacy name (`midi/note/on`) and then the per-channel one (`midi/ch/1/note/60`) in one call. The QWERTY piano and some takes publish only the legacy name. A per-channel name counts at once; a legacy name waits for a microtask and is dropped if its per-channel twin shows up first. So a relative encoder never turns twice, a legacy CC (which has no channel) never lands on the wrong channel, and order is kept.
description.zh: 硬體和螢幕控制器對每則訊息都會發佈兩次：先是短名稱（`midi/note/on`），緊接著在同一次呼叫裡是分頻道的名稱（`midi/ch/1/note/60`）。電腦鍵盤鋼琴和某些錄音只發佈短名稱。分頻道的名稱會立刻算數，短名稱則等一個 microtask，如果它分頻道的孿生兄弟先到了就丟掉。所以相對旋鈕不會轉兩次，沒有頻道的短名稱 CC 也不會落到錯誤的頻道，順序也會保持。

description.en: [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) uses it. Use it yourself to turn a bus back into MIDI events, for example to drive your own visual from a recorded take.
description.zh: [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) 用的就是它。想把匯流排變回 MIDI 事件時可以自己用，例如用錄下的演奏去驅動你自己的畫面。

params.name: signals
params.en: The bus. It needs `onAny(cb)`.
params.zh: 匯流排，需要有 `onAny(cb)`。

params.name: onEvent
params.en: `(ev) => …` called with an event of [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) for each message.
params.zh: 每則訊息都以 [`parseMessage()`](#parseMessage) 的事件格式呼叫 `(ev) => …`。

params.name: channel
params.en: The channel given to legacy CC and bend names, which carry none.
params.zh: 指定給短名稱 CC 和彎音用的頻道，因為它們本身沒有頻道資訊。

params.name: defer
params.en: `(fn) => …` that schedules the flush of legacy-only names. Default `queueMicrotask`; replaceable in tests.
params.zh: 排程「只有短名稱」那批訊息的 flush 用的 `(fn) => …`。預設是 `queueMicrotask`，測試時可以換掉。

returns.en: `flush()` delivers legacy-only messages that are still waiting. `dispose()` stops listening and drops them.
returns.zh: `flush()` 送出還在等待的「只有短名稱」訊息。`dispose()` 停止監聽並丟掉它們。

caption.en: Prints three lines: `noteon 60 2`, `cc 74 2`, then `noteon 64 1` for the piano (channel 0 becomes the default channel 1).
caption.zh: 印出三行：`noteon 60 2`、`cc 74 2`，然後是鍵盤鋼琴的 `noteon 64 1`（頻道 0 變成預設的頻道 1）。

summary.en: The commands a page may send into an embed iframe: `set`, `ingest`, `reset`, `profile`, `layout`, `get`, `press`, `release`.
summary.zh: 外層頁面可以送進嵌入 iframe 的指令：`set`、`ingest`、`reset`、`profile`、`layout`、`get`、`press`、`release`。

description.en: What each does: `set` `{ id, value, note?, quiet? }` moves a control, `press` `{ id, velocity?, note? }` and `release` `{ id, note? }` hold and let go, `ingest` `{ bytes }` feeds MIDI (one message or a list), `reset` brings everything home, `profile` `{ profile }` switches the device, `layout` `{ layout }` changes the layout, and `get` asks for every value (the iframe answers with a `values` message).
description.zh: 各指令的作用：`set` `{ id, value, note?, quiet? }` 移動控制項，`press` `{ id, velocity?, note? }` 與 `release` `{ id, note? }` 按住與放開，`ingest` `{ bytes }` 餵入 MIDI（一則或一串），`reset` 讓所有東西回到原位，`profile` `{ profile }` 切換機器，`layout` `{ layout }` 改變版面，`get` 要求所有數值（iframe 會用一則 `values` 訊息回答）。

value.en: A plain array. [`fromParent()`](#fromParent) ignores a message whose `type` is not one of these.
value.zh: 一個普通陣列。[`fromParent()`](#fromParent) 會忽略 `type` 不在這份清單裡的訊息。

caption.en: Prints the eight commands, then the message `{ target: 'openav', v: 1, type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5 }`.
caption.zh: 印出八個指令，再印出訊息 `{ target: 'openav', v: 1, type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5 }`。

summary.en: Page side: reads a message that came from an embed iframe, returns `{ type, frame, detail, v }`, or `null` when it is not one of ours.
summary.zh: 外層頁面這一側：讀取從嵌入 iframe 來的訊息，回傳 `{ type, frame, detail, v }`，不是我們的訊息就回傳 `null`。

description.en: Other scripts and extensions post to a page all the time, so always filter. Check `event.origin` too when the page cares who sent it: this function checks the shape, not the sender.
description.zh: 別的腳本和瀏覽器擴充功能隨時都在對頁面送訊息，所以一定要過濾。頁面在意是誰送的話，也要檢查 `event.origin`：這個函式檢查的是格式，不是寄件者。

params.name: data
params.en: The `event.data` of a `message` event.
params.zh: `message` 事件的 `event.data`。

returns.en: `null` unless `data` is an object with `source: 'openav'` and a string `type`.
returns.zh: 除非 `data` 是帶有 `source: 'openav'` 和字串 `type` 的物件，否則回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints `pads midi/lpd8/k1 1`, then `null null` for messages that are not ours.
caption.zh: 印出 `pads midi/lpd8/k1 1`，再對不是我們的訊息印出 `null null`。

caption.en: The listener to put on the page that holds the iframe.
caption.zh: 放在包著 iframe 的那個頁面上的監聽程式。

summary.en: Frame side: validates a command from the page and returns a clean command, or `null` (the message is ignored).
summary.zh: iframe 這一側：驗證外層頁面送來的指令，回傳整理乾淨的指令，不合格就回傳 `null`（訊息被忽略）。

description.en: It is strict, because anything on the web can post to an iframe. The message needs `target: 'openav'` and a `type` from [`FRAME_COMMANDS`](#FRAME_COMMANDS). Control ids must be lower-case `[a-z0-9_-]`. `value` must be a finite number. `note` must be an integer 0..127 (else `null`). A `press` velocity is held to 0..1. `ingest` takes one message of 1 to 3 bytes whose first byte is a status byte (128 or more), or up to 256 such messages. `profile` takes an id or an `https://` URL (not `http://`). `layout` must be in [`EMBED_LAYOUTS`](#EMBED_LAYOUTS).
description.zh: 它很嚴格，因為網路上任何東西都能對 iframe 送訊息。訊息必須有 `target: 'openav'`，`type` 要在 [`FRAME_COMMANDS`](#FRAME_COMMANDS) 裡。控制項 id 必須是小寫的 `[a-z0-9_-]`。`value` 必須是有限的數字。`note` 必須是 0..127 的整數（否則是 `null`）。`press` 的力度會限制在 0..1。`ingest` 接受一則 1 到 3 個位元組、第一個位元組是狀態位元組（128 以上）的訊息，或最多 256 則這樣的訊息。`profile` 接受 id 或 `https://` 網址（不接受 `http://`）。`layout` 必須在 [`EMBED_LAYOUTS`](#EMBED_LAYOUTS) 裡。

params.name: data
params.en: The `event.data` of a `message` event.
params.zh: `message` 事件的 `event.data`。

returns.en: A command such as `{ type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5, note: null, quiet: false }`, or `null`.
returns.zh: 像 `{ type: 'set', id: 'k1', value: 0.5, note: null, quiet: false }` 這樣的指令，或 `null`。

caption.en: Prints three clean commands, then four `null`s for messages the frame would ignore.
caption.zh: 印出三個整理乾淨的指令，再對 frame 會忽略的四則訊息印出四個 `null`。

summary.en: Computes the rectangles of piano keys from one note to another inside a rect: white keys side by side, black keys over the seams at 60% of the height.
summary.zh: 算出從某個音到另一個音的琴鍵在矩形裡的位置：白鍵並排，黑鍵蓋在縫上，高度是 60%。

description.en: A range never starts on a black key: a black key with no white key before it is left out, the way the on-screen keyboard does. White keys share the width equally, so 48 to 72 is 15 white keys and 10 black ones.
description.zh: 音域不會從黑鍵開始：前面沒有白鍵的黑鍵會被省略，螢幕上的鍵盤也是這樣。白鍵平分寬度，所以 48 到 72 是 15 個白鍵加 10 個黑鍵。

params.name: from
params.en: The first MIDI note.
params.zh: 第一個 MIDI 音符。

params.name: to
params.en: The last MIDI note.
params.zh: 最後一個 MIDI 音符。

params.name: rect
params.en: The area the keys fill.
params.zh: 琴鍵要填滿的區域。

returns.type: { note, white, x, y, w, h }[]
returns.en: One item per key, the white keys first and then the black ones (the draw order, so the black keys end up on top).
returns.zh: 每個琴鍵一項，先是白鍵再是黑鍵（也就是繪製順序，這樣黑鍵會疊在上面）。

caption.en: Prints `8 white, 5 black` (one octave and the next C), then the first key's note and its position.
caption.zh: 印出 `8 white, 5 black`（一個八度加上下一個 C），再印出第一個鍵的音符和位置。

summary.en: Tells which note a drawn keyboard should start at after a note outside its printed range arrives, so it follows the device's octave buttons.
summary.zh: 一個超出印刷音域的音符到來之後，算出畫出來的鍵盤該從哪個音開始，這樣它就能跟著機器的八度按鈕走。

description.en: A keyboard control catches notes outside its printed range, because the device's Oct+/Oct− buttons shift what the keys send. When one arrives, the drawing moves and stays there, as the device does. A 48 to 72 MiniLab with Oct+ pressed (a note of 76) shows 60 to 84. A range narrower than an octave just moves to reach the note.
description.zh: 琴鍵控制項會接住超出印刷音域的音，因為機器的 Oct+/Oct− 按鈕會改變琴鍵送出的音。這種音到來時，畫面會移動並停在那裡，就像實機一樣。48 到 72 的 MiniLab 按下 Oct+（音符 76）後，畫面會顯示 60 到 84。窄於一個八度的音域，則是直接移動到夠到那個音為止。

params.name: from
params.en: The first note of the printed range.
params.zh: 印刷音域的第一個音。

params.name: to
params.en: The last note of the printed range.
params.zh: 印刷音域的最後一個音。

params.name: base
params.en: The first note shown now.
params.zh: 目前顯示的第一個音。

params.name: note
params.en: A note that just went down.
params.zh: 剛剛按下的音。

returns.en: The new first note: `base` when the note fits, otherwise `base` moved by the fewest octaves that reach it, held to the MIDI range.
returns.zh: 新的第一個音：音符放得進去就回傳 `base`，否則是把 `base` 移動剛好夠的最少八度，並限制在 MIDI 範圍內。

examples.code:
import { keyWindow } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(keyWindow(48, 72, 48, 60));    // 48: inside the window, unchanged
console.log(keyWindow(48, 72, 48, 76));    // 60: Oct+ on the MiniLab
console.log(keyWindow(48, 72, 48, 40));    // 36: Oct-
console.log(keyWindow(48, 72, 48, 127));   // 103: held to the MIDI range

caption.en: Prints 48, 60, 36 and 103.

summary.en: Turns a MIDI note number into its name with the octave, middle C being C4: `midiNoteName(60)` is `'C4'`, `midiNoteName(61)` is `'C#4'`.
