summary.zh: 把 MIDI 音符號碼轉成帶八度的音名，中央 C 是 C4：`midiNoteName(60)` 是 `'C4'`，`midiNoteName(61)` 是 `'C#4'`。

description.en: This is the on-screen keyboard's convention. Some software (Ableton Live, Yamaha) calls 60 "C3": the number is the same, only the octave label differs. In a p5 sketch, [`noteName()`](#noteName) does the same and also writes flats when you ask.
description.zh: 這是螢幕鍵盤採用的寫法。有些軟體（Ableton Live、Yamaha）把 60 叫做「C3」：號碼是一樣的，只有八度的標示不同。在 p5 草圖裡，[`noteName()`](#noteName) 做同樣的事，而且需要時可以寫成降記號。

params.name: n
params.en: A MIDI note number, 0..127.
params.zh: MIDI 音符號碼，0..127。

returns.en: Sharps only (`'C#4'`, never `'Db4'`). 0 is `'C-1'` and 127 is `'G9'`.

examples.code:
import { midiNoteName } from '@openav/midi';

console.log([60, 61, 69, 0, 127].map(midiNoteName));   // [ 'C4', 'C#4', 'A4', 'C-1', 'G9' ]

caption.en: Prints the five note names.
caption.zh: 印出五個音名。

entries.name: mountMidiPanel
entries.signature: mountMidiPanel(parent, mcs, { mode = 'full', open = true, id = null, onToggle = null, closeButton = mode === 'dock', profiles = null, contained = false } = {})

summary.en: Mounts a controller panel: a toolbar (device picker, hardware status, port picker, Learn, last message) above a playable faceplate, docked at the bottom or full size.
summary.zh: 掛上一個控制器面板：上面一條工具列，有機器選單、硬體狀態、埠選單、學習按鈕和最後一則訊息的監看，下面是可以彈的面板，可以停靠在底部或填滿。

description.en: The bar shows which device is on screen (the picker switches it), a chip saying whether a hardware port drives it, a port picker when hardware is attached, a Learn button (click a control, then move the one on the hardware; a second button resets the mapping), and a tiny monitor that prints the last message, so you see the hardware talking before you see what it moves. Plugging in a known device switches the picker and the faceplate.
description.zh: 工具列顯示螢幕上是哪台機器（可以用選單切換）、一個說明有沒有硬體埠在驅動它的標籤、接了硬體時的埠選單、學習按鈕（點一個控制項，再動硬體上對應的那一個，另一個按鈕可以還原對應），以及一個小監看視窗印出最後一則訊息，讓你在看到它推動什麼之前，先看到硬體在說話。接上認得的機器時，選單和面板都會跟著切換。

params.name: parent
params.en: The element to add the panel to. In `full` mode the panel is `position: absolute; inset: 0`, so give `parent` a position (`relative`) and a size.
params.zh: 要加進面板的元素。`full` 模式的面板是 `position: absolute; inset: 0`，所以 `parent` 要設 position（`relative`）並有大小。

params.name: mcs
params.en: The manager that holds the devices and the hardware.
params.zh: 管理裝置與硬體的管理器。

params.name: mode
params.en: `'full'` fills `parent`. `'dock'` is a drawer fixed to the bottom of the window, 40% of the window height by default, with a grip to drag its height (remembered in `localStorage`).
params.zh: `'full'` 填滿 `parent`。`'dock'` 是固定在視窗底部的抽屜，預設佔視窗高度的 40%，有把手可以拖曳調整高度（記在 `localStorage`）。

params.name: open
params.en: Whether it starts open. A closed dock builds its view only when opened.
params.zh: 一開始是否打開。關著的停靠面板要到打開時才建立畫面。

params.name: id
params.en: An element id for the panel.
params.zh: 面板的元素 id。

params.name: onToggle
params.en: `(open) => …` called when the panel opens or closes.
params.zh: 面板打開或關閉時呼叫 `(open) => …`。

params.name: closeButton
params.en: Show a ✕ button. The default is on in `dock` mode only.
params.zh: 是否顯示 ✕ 按鈕。預設只有 `dock` 模式會顯示。

params.name: profiles
params.en: Limit the device picker to these profile ids.
params.zh: 把機器選單限制在這些設定檔 id。

params.name: contained
params.en: Dock inside `parent` (absolute) instead of the window (fixed).
params.zh: 停靠在 `parent` 裡面（absolute），不是停靠在視窗（fixed）。

returns.type: { el, view, isOpen, open(), close(), toggle(), dispose() }
returns.en: `el` is the panel element, `view` the [`ControllerView`](#ControllerView) (once it exists), `isOpen` a boolean. `open()`, `close()` and `toggle()` return the same object; `close()` also releases held notes.
returns.zh: `el` 是面板元素，`view` 是 [`ControllerView`](#ControllerView)（建立之後才有），`isOpen` 是布林值。`open()`、`close()`、`toggle()` 回傳同一個物件，`close()` 還會放開按著的音。

notes.en: The labels on the toolbar (Learn, Reset, the hardware chip) are written in Chinese only, whatever the page language is. `<oav-controller>` has an English and a Chinese toolbar; this panel is the one the lab and the phone tab use.
notes.zh: 工具列上的文字是中文（學習、還原、硬體 …），不隨頁面語言改變。`<oav-controller>` 的工具列有英文和中文版，這個面板則是實驗室和手機分頁在用的那個。

caption.en: A panel with the toolbar and the AKAI LPD8 appears in the page; pad 2 lights for half a second. Switch the device in the picker.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現帶工具列的面板和 AKAI LPD8，pad 2 亮了半秒。可以在選單裡切換機器。

summary.en: The `oav-controller` custom element: a playable MIDI controller you paste into any page with one line, with no import map and no build.
summary.zh: `<oav-controller>` 自訂元素：用一行就能貼進任何頁面的、可以彈的 MIDI 控制器，不需要 import map，也不需要建置。

description.en: Load `@openav/midi/element` (`https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js`) once and write `<oav-controller profile="akai-lpd8" readout></oav-controller>`. Importing the file registers the tag by itself. It is a shadow-DOM element, so the page's CSS cannot bend it and it cannot bend the page. It plays with a mouse, a finger, a pen and the keyboard, with or without Web MIDI: on Safari and iPad it still plays and fires events, and only the hardware and MIDI-out parts say they are unavailable.
description.zh: 載入一次 `@openav/midi/element`（`https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js`），然後寫 `<oav-controller profile="akai-lpd8" readout></oav-controller>`。匯入這個檔案時會自動註冊標籤。它是 shadow DOM 元素，所以頁面的 CSS 影響不到它，它也不會影響頁面。滑鼠、手指、觸控筆和鍵盤都能彈，有沒有 Web MIDI 都行：在 Safari 和 iPad 上仍然能彈、能觸發事件，只有硬體和 MIDI 輸出的部分會說「不能用」。

description.en: Attributes, each also a property of the same name (`midi-out` is `el.midiOut`): `profile` (an id, a short name or a URL to a profile JSON; default `arturia-minilab3`), `layout` (`auto`, `face` as it looks, `stack` re-gridded for a tall box), `hardware` (off by default; bare or `on` follows the real device, `ask` shows a button so the permission prompt waits for a click, or a port name or `/regex/`), `midi-out` (off by default; bare or `ask` lets the visitor pick, or a port name, substring or `/regex/` such as `IAC` or `loopMIDI`), `channel` (1 to 16: move every control to that channel), `picker`, `readout` (the last message under the faceplate), `learn` (a Learn button), `follow` (show whatever known device is plugged in), `theme` (`dark` or `light`: the toolbar only, the device stays the device), `telemetry` (`off` sends no anonymous hit) and `lang` (the toolbar language: `zh…` is Chinese, anything else English; it reads the nearest `lang` on the page).
description.zh: 屬性，每一個也是同名的屬性（property）（`midi-out` 對應 `el.midiOut`）：`profile`（id、短名稱，或指向設定檔 JSON 的網址，預設 `arturia-minilab3`）、`layout`（`auto`，`face` 是原本的樣子，`stack` 是為高的盒子重新排列）、`hardware`（預設關閉，只寫屬性或 `on` 是跟隨真實機器，`ask` 會顯示按鈕，讓權限詢問等到點擊才跳出，也可以寫埠名或 `/regex/`）、`midi-out`（預設關閉，只寫屬性或 `ask` 讓訪客自己挑，也可以寫埠名、子字串或 `/regex/`，例如 `IAC`、`loopMIDI`）、`channel`（1 到 16：把所有控制項移到那個頻道）、`picker`、`readout`（面板下面顯示最後一則訊息）、`learn`（學習按鈕）、`follow`（接上哪台認得的機器就顯示哪一台）、`theme`（`dark` 或 `light`：只影響工具列，機器還是機器的樣子）、`telemetry`（`off` 就不送匿名資料）和 `lang`（工具列語言：`zh…` 是中文，其他是英文，會讀頁面上最近的 `lang`）。

description.en: Events are `CustomEvent`s that bubble and cross the shadow root, so `el.addEventListener('control', e => e.detail)` works anywhere above it: `ready` `{ profile, name, controls }`, `control` (see [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail)), `noteon`, `noteoff`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `status`, `profilechange` and `error` `{ message }`. [`EMBED_EVENTS`](#EMBED_EVENTS) lists them. Methods: `set()`, `get()`, `values()`, `reset()`, `press()`, `release()`, `ingest()`, `send()`, `on()`, `connectHardware()`, `disconnectHardware()`, `setOutput()` and `toggleLearn()`.
description.zh: 事件是會冒泡、也會穿過 shadow root 的 `CustomEvent`，所以在它上面任何一層用 `el.addEventListener('control', e => e.detail)` 都收得到：`ready` `{ profile, name, controls }`、`control`（見 [`controlDetail()`](#controlDetail)）、`noteon`、`noteoff`、`connect`、`disconnect`、`status`、`profilechange` 和 `error` `{ message }`。[`EMBED_EVENTS`](#EMBED_EVENTS) 列出了它們。方法有：`set()`、`get()`、`values()`、`reset()`、`press()`、`release()`、`ingest()`、`send()`、`on()`、`connectHardware()`、`disconnectHardware()`、`setOutput()`、`toggleLearn()`。

description.en: It fills its width, and its height follows the faceplate (a taller stack on a phone) unless you set one. CSS variables: `--oav-bg`, `--oav-fg`, `--oav-accent`, `--oav-line`, `--oav-font`, and `--oav-ratio` (width ÷ height). Parts: `::part(toolbar)`, `::part(body)`, `::part(readout)`.
description.zh: 它的寬度填滿容器，高度則跟著面板走（手機上會用比較高的直排），除非你自己設高度。CSS 變數：`--oav-bg`、`--oav-fg`、`--oav-accent`、`--oav-line`、`--oav-font`，以及 `--oav-ratio`（寬除以高）。可用的 part：`::part(toolbar)`、`::part(body)`、`::part(readout)`。

needs.en: Wait for the controller to exist: `await el.ready` (a promise that resolves with the element), or listen for the `ready` event. Before that, `set()`, `press()`, `release()` and `ingest()` return `null` and print one console warning, and `get()` also returns `null`. It never asks for MIDI permission unless `hardware`, `midi-out` or Learn is used.
needs.zh: 要等控制器建好：`await el.ready`（會以元素本身完成的 promise），或是監聽 `ready` 事件。在那之前，`set()`、`press()`、`release()`、`ingest()` 會回傳 `null` 並在主控台印出一次警告，`get()` 也回傳 `null`。除非用了 `hardware`、`midi-out` 或學習，否則它不會要 MIDI 權限。

notes.en: For a place that only takes an iframe, the same element is served at `/embed/controller/` (query parameters mirror the attributes). Hardware and MIDI out inside the frame need `allow="midi"` on the `<iframe>`. See [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) and [`toParent()`](#toParent).
notes.zh: 只能放 iframe 的地方，同一個元素也放在 `/embed/controller/`（查詢參數對應到屬性）。要在 frame 裡用硬體和 MIDI 輸出，`<iframe>` 要加上 `allow="midi"`。見 [`parseEmbedOptions()`](#parseEmbedOptions) 和 [`toParent()`](#toParent)。

notes.en: If a page imports both `@openav/midi` and `@openav/midi/element`, the browser loads `index.js` twice, because the element imports its own copy under a `?v=` stamp. Checks across the two copies fail: `el.core instanceof ControllerHost` is `false`. Talk to the element through its methods and events instead.
notes.zh: 如果頁面同時匯入 `@openav/midi` 和 `@openav/midi/element`，瀏覽器會把 `index.js` 載入兩次，因為元素匯入的是自己那份、網址帶著 `?v=` 版本戳記。跨這兩份的檢查會失敗：`el.core instanceof ControllerHost` 是 `false`。請改用元素的方法和事件跟它溝通。

notes.en: Like [`createController()`](#createController), it sends one anonymous hit per page load, never from localhost or the LAN. `telemetry="off"` stops it.
notes.zh: 跟 [`createController()`](#createController) 一樣，每次載入頁面會送一筆匿名資料，從 localhost 或區域網路則不送。`telemetry="off"` 可以關掉。

caption.en: An LPD8 appears with a message line under it. The console prints `midi/lpd8/k1 0.50 ui`, then `midi/lpd8/k2 1.00 hardware`. Drag the knobs or tap the pads.
caption.zh: 出現一台 LPD8，下面有一行訊息列。主控台印出 `midi/lpd8/k1 0.50 ui`，接著是 `midi/lpd8/k2 1.00 hardware`。可以拖曳旋鈕或敲打擊墊。

caption.en: The toolbar has a device picker. Setting `el.profile` switches the faceplate to the Korg nanoKONTROL2 and the console prints its name, then `off null`.
caption.zh: 工具列上有機器選單。設定 `el.profile` 會把面板換成 KORG nanoKONTROL2，主控台印出它的名稱，再印出 `off null`。

examples.code:
<script type="module" src="https://openaudiovisual.com/packages/midi/element.js"></script>

<!-- plays on its own; the real device and MIDI out stay off until you ask -->
<oav-controller profile="akai-lpd8" readout></oav-controller>

<!-- a button asks for the real device on click; a MIDI output named like IAC receives what you play -->
<oav-controller profile="arturia-minilab3" hardware="ask" midi-out="IAC" picker learn></oav-controller>

caption.en: The two lines you paste into any page. The first plays with the mouse; the second shows a Connect button and a Learn button.
caption.zh: 貼進任何頁面的就是這幾行。第一台用滑鼠就能彈，第二台會顯示連接按鈕和學習按鈕。

tbd.en: Not tried for this page: `hardware` and `midi-out` inside an iframe in each browser, and a real MIDI device behind the element. The `allow="midi"` requirement is as the package README states it.
tbd.zh: 這一頁沒有實測：各個瀏覽器的 iframe 裡的 `hardware` 和 `midi-out`，以及元素背後接真實的 MIDI 機器。`allow="midi"` 的要求是照套件 README 的說法寫的。

members.name: set
members.doc: Move a control like a hand (pads / buttons: > 0 presses, 0 releases; keys: set('keys', vel, {note})).

members.name: ingest
members.doc: MIDI in from anywhere (a WebSocket, another tab): the faceplate follows, `control` fires with source 'hardware'.

members.name: send
members.doc: Raw bytes to the MIDI output port (when midi-out is open).

members.name: on
members.doc: Subscribe to an event by name; the callback gets the payload.

members.name: core
members.doc: The headless controller (same API as createController()).

members.name: controller
members.doc: The live model of the device on screen (MidiController).

members.name: controllers
members.doc: Every device this element can show (MidiControllers).

members.name: view
members.doc: The faceplate (ControllerView).

members.name: midi
members.doc: The Web MIDI engine, once hardware or MIDI out is on.

members.name: status
members.doc: { hardware, input, output, outputState, profile }

members.name: profileData
members.doc: The normalized profile on screen.

entries.name: PANEL_CSS
entries.signature: PANEL_CSS = "\n.mcp { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; …"

summary.en: The stylesheet text of the controller panel (`mountMidiPanel`), as a string.
summary.zh: 控制器面板（`mountMidiPanel`）的樣式表文字，是一個字串。

description.en: Advanced: it is exported for pages that want to read or override the rules. You never need it to mount a panel.
description.zh: 進階用途：匯出給想讀或覆寫規則的頁面。掛上面板時完全用不到它。

value.en: CSS for the `.mcp…` classes. `mountMidiPanel()` injects it by itself, once per document (a `<style id="openav-midi-panel-css">` in the head).
value.zh: `.mcp…` 那些 class 的 CSS。`mountMidiPanel()` 會自己注入，每個文件一次（放在 head 的 `<style id="openav-midi-panel-css">`）。

examples.code:
import { PANEL_CSS } from '@openav/midi';

console.log(PANEL_CSS.includes('.mcp.dock'));   // the drawer rules

caption.en: Prints `true`: the panel's rules are readable CSS text.
caption.zh: 印出 `true`：面板的規則是看得懂的 CSS 文字。

summary.en: Reads the options of one embed from an element, a query string, an object or a getter function, and returns them cleaned up with defaults.
summary.zh: 從元素、查詢字串、物件或取值函式讀出一個嵌入的選項，整理過並補上預設值後回傳。

description.en: It is the one place that decides what the attributes and the iframe's query string mean, so the element and the iframe always agree. Defaults: `profile` is `arturia-minilab3`, `layout` `auto`, `theme` `dark`, `hardware` and `midiOut` off (so embedding never asks for MIDI permission), the booleans false, `telemetry` true, and `channel`, `bg`, `frame`, `origin`, `lang` are `null`.
description.zh: 元素和 iframe 的查詢字串各代表什麼意思，都由它一個地方決定，所以兩邊一定一致。預設值：`profile` 是 `arturia-minilab3`，`layout` 是 `auto`，`theme` 是 `dark`，`hardware` 和 `midiOut` 是關閉（所以嵌入不會要 MIDI 權限），布林值都是 false，`telemetry` 是 true，`channel`、`bg`、`frame`、`origin`、`lang` 是 `null`。

description.en: Rules worth knowing: an unknown `layout` becomes `auto`; `theme` is `light` or `dark`; `midi-out` may also be written `midiout` or `midiOut`, and alone it means `ask`; `frame` may also be written `id` and is cut to 64 characters; `origin` is kept only as `https://host` or `http://host` with no path (anything else, such as `javascript:`, becomes `null`), `lang` is cut to 16 characters, and `bg` goes through [`embedColor()`](#embedColor).
description.zh: 值得知道的規則：不認得的 `layout` 變成 `auto`。`theme` 只有 `light` 或 `dark`。`midi-out` 也可以寫成 `midiout` 或 `midiOut`，單獨寫表示 `ask`。`frame` 也可以寫成 `id`，並且截成 64 個字元。`origin` 只接受沒有路徑的 `https://host` 或 `http://host`（其他的，像 `javascript:`，會變成 `null`）。`lang` 截成 16 個字元。`bg` 會經過 [`embedColor()`](#embedColor)。

params.name: src
params.en: Where the options live: an element (read with `getAttribute`), a `URLSearchParams` (the iframe page passes its own), a plain object `{ profile: 'lpd8' }`, or a function `(name) => value | null`.
params.zh: 選項放在哪裡：元素（用 `getAttribute` 讀）、`URLSearchParams`（iframe 頁面傳自己的）、普通物件 `{ profile: 'lpd8' }`，或是函式 `(name) => value | null`。

returns.en: `{ profile, layout, hardware, midiOut, channel, learn, picker, readout, follow, telemetry, theme, bg, frame, origin, lang }`. `hardware` and `midiOut` are `{ mode, port }` as in [`embedMode()`](#embedMode).
returns.zh: `{ profile, layout, hardware, midiOut, channel, learn, picker, readout, follow, telemetry, theme, bg, frame, origin, lang }`。`hardware` 和 `midiOut` 的格式是 [`embedMode()`](#embedMode) 那樣的 `{ mode, port }`。

caption.en: Prints `lpd8 stack`, `hardware` as `{ mode: 'on', port: null }`, `midiOut` as `{ mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }`, then `true transparent https://example.com null`.
caption.zh: 印出 `lpd8 stack`、`hardware` 的 `{ mode: 'on', port: null }`、`midiOut` 的 `{ mode: 'on', port: 'IAC' }`，再印出 `true transparent https://example.com null`。

caption.en: Prints every default as JSON, then `midiOut` as `{"mode":"ask","port":null}` next to `hardware` as off, then `null`.
caption.zh: 以 JSON 印出所有預設值，再印出 `{"mode":"ask","port":null}` 的 `midiOut`（旁邊是關閉的 `hardware`），最後是 `null`。

summary.en: The word that marks a message as an open-audiovisual embed message: `'openav'`, sent as `source` by the iframe and as `target` by the page.
summary.zh: 標記一則訊息屬於 open-audiovisual 嵌入的字：`'openav'`，iframe 送出時放在 `source`，外層頁面送進去時放在 `target`。

description.en: [`toParent()`](#toParent) and [`toFrame()`](#toFrame) write it for you, and [`fromFrame()`](#fromFrame) and [`fromParent()`](#fromParent) check it.
description.zh: [`toParent()`](#toParent) 和 [`toFrame()`](#toFrame) 會替你寫入，[`fromFrame()`](#fromFrame) 和 [`fromParent()`](#fromParent) 負責檢查。

value.en: A constant. A message from the iframe has `source: 'openav'`, and a command to the iframe has `target: 'openav'`. Anything else is ignored on both sides.
value.zh: 常數。iframe 送出的訊息有 `source: 'openav'`，送進 iframe 的指令有 `target: 'openav'`。兩邊都會忽略其他任何訊息。

caption.en: Prints `openav`, then `openav openav`.
caption.zh: 印出 `openav`，再印出 `openav openav`。

summary.en: The version of the iframe message format, `1`, written as `v` in every message.
summary.zh: iframe 訊息格式的版本，`1`，會寫成每則訊息裡的 `v`。

description.en: Messages from [`toParent()`](#toParent) and [`toFrame()`](#toFrame) carry it as `v: 1`.
description.zh: [`toParent()`](#toParent) 和 [`toFrame()`](#toFrame) 的訊息都會帶著 `v: 1`。

value.en: A constant, so a page can tell when the format changes. [`fromFrame()`](#fromFrame) gives `v` back (1 when a message lacks it).
value.zh: 常數，讓頁面在格式改變時能分辨。[`fromFrame()`](#fromFrame) 會把 `v` 還給你（訊息沒有時是 1）。

examples.code:
import { POST_VERSION, toParent } from '@openav/midi/embed';

console.log(POST_VERSION, toParent('ready').v);   // 1 1

caption.en: Prints `1 1`.

summary.en: Works out the width ÷ height a controller wants in a box of a given width: its faceplate when every control stays finger-sized, a taller stack otherwise.
summary.zh: 算出控制器在某個寬度的盒子裡想要的寬高比：每個控制項都夠手指按的話用面板本身的比例，否則用比較高的直排。

description.en: `<oav-controller>` uses it to set its height, so a controller sizes itself from its width. In `auto`, the faceplate's own proportions are used while the smallest control stays at least `minTouch` pixels at that width; otherwise it becomes a stack, about 0.8 to 1.5 times as tall as it is wide depending on how many bands the profile's `portrait` has. Square grid devices (the Launchpad, `stack: false`) always keep their face.
description.zh: `<oav-controller>` 用它來決定自己的高度，所以控制器會依寬度自己決定大小。在 `auto` 下，只要在那個寬度時最小的控制項仍有至少 `minTouch` 像素，就用面板本身的比例，否則改成直排，高度大約是寬度的 0.8 到 1.5 倍，視設定檔 `portrait` 有幾條而定。方形格子的機器（Launchpad，`stack: false`）永遠維持 `face`。

params.name: profile
params.en: A normalized profile (`face`, `sections`, `portrait`, `stack`).
params.zh: 整理過的設定檔（`face`、`sections`、`portrait`、`stack`）。

params.name: width
params.en: The box width in pixels.
params.zh: 盒子的寬度（像素）。

params.name: layout
params.en: `'auto'`, `'face'` or `'stack'`.
params.zh: `'auto'`、`'face'` 或 `'stack'`。

params.name: minTouch
params.en: The smallest control size in pixels that still counts as finger-sized.
params.zh: 還算夠手指按的最小控制項尺寸（像素）。

returns.en: `mode` is `'face'` or `'stack'`, and `aspect` is the width ÷ height to give the box.
returns.zh: `mode` 是 `'face'` 或 `'stack'`，`aspect` 是要給盒子的寬高比。

caption.en: Prints four results: a wide face, a tall stack for a narrow box, the face when forced, and the square Launchpad.
caption.zh: 印出四個結果：寬的面板、窄盒子用的高直排、強制指定時的面板，以及方形的 Launchpad。

summary.en: Says where a control rests: knobs and faders at their default (0), bipolar wheels at the centre, pads, buttons and keys at 0.
summary.zh: 說明控制項休息時在哪裡：旋鈕和推桿在預設值（0），雙向彎音輪在中心，打擊墊、按鈕和琴鍵在 0。

description.en: `reset()` on [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) uses it to bring every control home. An endless encoder has no real position, so only its drawn position goes to the middle and no MIDI is sent for it.
description.zh: [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) 的 `reset()` 用它讓每個控制項回到原位。無限旋鈕沒有真正的位置，所以只有畫面上的位置會回到中間，而且不會送出 MIDI。

params.name: c
params.en: A control definition from a normalized profile.
params.zh: 整理過的設定檔中的控制項定義。

returns.en: 0 for keys, pads, buttons and bipolar controls; otherwise the control's `def`, else 0.5 for an endless encoder and 0 for the rest.
returns.zh: 琴鍵、打擊墊、按鈕和雙向控制項是 0。其他用控制項的 `def`，沒有的話無限旋鈕是 0.5，其餘是 0。

caption.en: Prints 0 for the knob, the pitch strip (centre), the pad and the keys, and 0.5 for the endless encoder.
caption.zh: 旋鈕、音高觸控條（中心）、打擊墊和琴鍵印出 0，無限旋鈕印出 0.5。

entries.name: setControl
entries.signature: setControl(mc, id, value, { note = null, source = 'ui' } = {})

summary.en: Moves one control the way a hand would, whatever its type, and returns the MIDI bytes it sent: `setControl(mc, 'k1', 0.5)`.
summary.zh: 像一隻手一樣去動某個控制項，不論它是什麼類型，並回傳它送出的 MIDI 位元組：`setControl(mc, 'k1', 0.5)`。

description.en: What `value` means depends on the type. Knob, fader, wheel, strip and encoder: 0..1 (−1..1 for a bipolar one). Pad and momentary button: above 0 presses (with that velocity, held to 1) and 0 releases. Toggle button: 0.5 or more is on. Keys: `value` is the velocity, above 0 presses that `note` and 0 releases it. This is what `set()` on [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) and `<oav-controller>` call.
description.zh: `value` 的意思依類型而定。旋鈕、推桿、彎音輪、觸控條、編碼器：0..1（雙向的是 −1..1）。打擊墊和瞬間按鈕：大於 0 是按下（用那個力度，上限 1），0 是放開。切換按鈕：0.5 以上是開。琴鍵：`value` 是力度，大於 0 按下那個 `note`，0 放開它。`ControllerHost` 和 `<oav-controller>` 的 `set()` 呼叫的就是它。

params.name: mc
params.en: The controller.
params.zh: 控制器。

params.name: id
params.en: The control id. An unknown id throws `<profile> has no control "x" (controls: …)`.
params.zh: 控制項 id。不存在的 id 會丟出 `<profile> has no control "x" (controls: …)`。

params.name: value
params.en: The value (below). Anything that is not a finite number throws `set("id"): value must be a number`.
params.zh: 數值（見下）。不是有限數字的值會丟出 `set("id"): value must be a number`。

params.name: note
params.en: For a keys control: which note. The default is the first key of its range.
params.zh: 琴鍵控制項要給：哪個音。預設是音域的第一個鍵。

params.name: source
params.en: `'ui'` (default) publishes and reaches MIDI out. `'mirror'` moves only the faceplate (two-way binding).
params.zh: `'ui'`（預設）會發佈並送到 MIDI 輸出。`'mirror'` 只動面板（雙向綁定用）。

returns.en: The bytes sent, or `null` when nothing changed (for example releasing a pad that is not held).
returns.zh: 送出的位元組，沒有變化時（例如放開一個沒按著的打擊墊）回傳 `null`。

caption.en: Prints the three messages the control types send, then `null`.
caption.zh: 印出幾種控制項送出的三則訊息，最後是 `null`。

summary.en: Page side: builds a command to post into an embed iframe: `{ target: 'openav', v: 1, type, ...args }`.
summary.zh: 外層頁面這一側：組出要送進嵌入 iframe 的指令：`{ target: 'openav', v: 1, type, ...args }`。

description.en: It does not check the command: the iframe does, with [`fromParent()`](#fromParent), and ignores what it does not understand. Post to the frame's real origin, not `*`, when you can.
description.zh: 它不檢查指令內容：iframe 會用 [`fromParent()`](#fromParent) 檢查，不懂的就忽略。可以的話請送給 frame 真正的來源，不要用 `*`。

params.name: type
params.en: The command: one of [`FRAME_COMMANDS`](#FRAME_COMMANDS).
params.zh: 指令：[`FRAME_COMMANDS`](#FRAME_COMMANDS) 其中之一。

params.name: args
params.en: The command's fields (`{ id, value }` for `set`). Copied through JSON.
params.zh: 指令的欄位（`set` 是 `{ id, value }`）。會經過 JSON 複製。

returns.en: A message ready for `iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, origin)`.
returns.zh: 可以直接給 `iframe.contentWindow.postMessage(msg, origin)` 的訊息。

caption.en: Prints three command messages; the last line (commented out) is how you would send one.
caption.zh: 印出三則指令訊息，最後一行（被註解掉的）是實際送出一則的做法。

summary.en: Frame side: builds the message the iframe posts to its page for an event: `{ source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }`.
summary.zh: iframe 這一側：為一個事件組出 iframe 要送給外層頁面的訊息：`{ source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }`。

description.en: The iframe page calls `parent.postMessage(toParent(name, detail, { frame }), target)` for every event, where `target` is the `?origin=` parameter or `*`. With `?origin=https://your.site` the frame posts only to that origin and accepts commands only from it.
description.zh: iframe 頁面對每個事件都呼叫 `parent.postMessage(toParent(name, detail, { frame }), target)`，`target` 是 `?origin=` 參數，沒有就是 `*`。加上 `?origin=https://your.site` 之後，frame 只會送給那個來源，也只接受從它來的指令。

params.name: type
params.en: The event name (see [`EMBED_EVENTS`](#EMBED_EVENTS)), or `values`.
params.zh: 事件名稱（見 [`EMBED_EVENTS`](#EMBED_EVENTS)），或 `values`。

params.name: detail
params.en: The event payload. It is copied through JSON, so the message is always `postMessage`-safe (`undefined` becomes `null`).
params.zh: 事件內容。會經過 JSON 複製，所以訊息一定能安全地 `postMessage`（`undefined` 變成 `null`）。

params.name: frame
params.en: A name for this iframe (the `?frame=` parameter), echoed in every message so a page with several frames can tell them apart.
params.zh: 這個 iframe 的名字（`?frame=` 參數），每則訊息都會帶著，這樣頁面上有好幾個 frame 時才分得出來。

returns.en: The message `{ source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }`.
returns.zh: 訊息物件 `{ source: 'openav', v: 1, type, frame, detail }`。

caption.en: Prints the full message for a `control` event, then a bare `ready` message with `frame` and `detail` as `null`.
caption.zh: 印出 `control` 事件的完整訊息，再印出沒有 `frame` 和 `detail` 的單純 `ready` 訊息（兩者都是 `null`）。

summary.en: Writes what a device's screen says about a touch: `Knob 1 · 87`, `C4 · 100`, `Pad 3 · 96`, `Pitch +0.42`.
summary.zh: 寫出機器的螢幕會怎麼描述一次觸碰：`Knob 1 · 87`、`C4 · 100`、`Pad 3 · 96`、`Pitch +0.42`。

description.en: [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) draws this text on the device's screen (MiniLab 3, KeyStep) so a video shows what the hardware's own screen would. It is pure, so it is easy to reuse for a caption or a log.
description.zh: [`ControllerCanvas`](#ControllerCanvas) 把這段文字畫在機器的螢幕上（MiniLab 3、KeyStep），讓影片裡看得到實機螢幕會顯示的內容。它是純函式，拿去當字幕或記錄也很方便。

params.name: c
params.en: The control's definition (from the normalized profile). `null` gives an empty string.
params.zh: 控制項的定義（來自整理過的設定檔）。給 `null` 會回傳空字串。

params.name: st
params.en: Its state: `{ raw, value, held, pos }`.
params.zh: 它的狀態：`{ raw, value, held, pos }`。

params.name: note
params.en: For a keys control, the note that was touched.
params.zh: 琴鍵控制項要給：被碰到的音符。

returns.en: The line. A control whose label is only a number is named after its type (`Knob 1`). A pad shows its velocity only while held, a button shows `on` or `off`, a relative encoder shows its position as a percentage, and a bipolar wheel shows a signed value.
returns.zh: 那一行文字。標籤只是數字的控制項，會用類型來命名（`Knob 1`）。打擊墊只有按著時才顯示力度，按鈕顯示 `on` 或 `off`，相對旋鈕以百分比顯示位置，雙向彎音輪則顯示有正負號的值。

caption.en: Prints the four lines shown in the comments.
caption.zh: 印出註解裡的那四行。

summary.en: Reads every control's current value from a controller as `{ id: number }`; for keys it is 1 while any key is held.
summary.zh: 從控制器讀出每個控制項目前的值，格式是 `{ id: number }`，琴鍵控制項在有任何一個鍵按著時是 1。

description.en: This is what `values()` returns on [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) and `<oav-controller>`, and what the iframe answers to the `get` command.
description.zh: [`ControllerHost`](#ControllerHost) 和 `<oav-controller>` 的 `values()` 回傳的就是它，iframe 對 `get` 指令的回答也是它。

params.name: mc
params.en: The controller.
params.zh: 控制器。

returns.en: One number per control id, in the profile's order.
returns.zh: 每個控制項 id 一個數字，順序跟設定檔一致。

caption.en: Prints `16 controls`, then `k1 = 1 | pad2 = 0.50 | pad1 = 0`: one number for every control of the LPD8.
caption.zh: 印出 `16 controls`，再印出 `k1 = 1 | pad2 = 0.50 | pad1 = 0`：LPD8 的每個控制項各有一個數字。

entries.name: VIEW_CSS
entries.signature: VIEW_CSS = "\n.mcv { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; touc…"

summary.en: The stylesheet text of the on-screen controller (`ControllerView`), as a string.
summary.zh: 螢幕控制器（`ControllerView`）的樣式表文字，是一個字串。

description.en: Advanced. You never need it to show a controller. It is exported for pages that build their own shadow DOM, a server-rendered preview or a theme that wants to read the rules. Colours use the CSS variables `--oav-focus`, `--body`, `--c` and `--cap` that the view sets per control.
description.zh: 進階用途。要顯示控制器的話完全用不到它。它是匯出給「自己建 shadow DOM 的頁面、伺服器端渲染的預覽、想讀規則的佈景」用的。顏色用的 CSS 變數有 `--oav-focus`、`--body`、`--c` 和 `--cap`，其中後三個由畫面針對每個控制項設定。

value.en: CSS for the `.mcv…` classes. The view injects it by itself, once per document, or once per shadow root when it lives inside one (a `<style id="openav-midi-view-css">`).
value.zh: `.mcv…` 那些 class 的 CSS。畫面會自己注入，每個文件注入一次，放在 shadow root 裡時則是每個 root 一次（一個 `<style id="openav-midi-view-css">`）。

caption.en: Prints `string true`, then `true`: it is plain CSS text you can read or inject yourself.
caption.zh: 印出 `string true`，再印出 `true`：它就是純 CSS 文字，可以自己讀或自己注入。

summary.en: An on-screen piano you can play with the mouse, a finger or the computer keyboard, that calls a function for every note.
summary.zh: 一架螢幕上的鋼琴，可以用滑鼠、手指或電腦鍵盤彈，每彈一個音就呼叫你的函式。

description.en: `new KeysPiano(el, { onNote })` builds the keys inside `el`. Whatever plays a key (a click or a touch on it, sweeping across the keys with the button held, the computer keyboard, or your own call to `press()`) ends up in `onNote(note, vel01, on)`: `on` is `true` for a key going down and `false` for one coming up, and `vel01` is 0..1 (0 on the way up). The black and white pattern follows the real pitch, so a piano can start on any note. A key that is already down ignores a second `press()`.
description.zh: `new KeysPiano(el, { onNote })` 在 `el` 裡蓋出琴鍵。不管是誰彈了一個鍵（在上面點一下或觸碰、按著按鈕滑過琴鍵、電腦鍵盤，或你自己呼叫 `press()`），最後都會進到 `onNote(note, vel01, on)`：`on` 是 `true` 表示鍵按下去，`false` 表示放開，`vel01` 是 0..1（放開時是 0）。黑白鍵的排法照真正的音高走，所以鋼琴可以從任何一個音開始。已經按著的鍵再 `press()` 會被忽略。

description.en: The computer keyboard is off until you set `piano.captureEnabled = true`, and it is up to you to pass the page's `keydown` and `keyup` events to [`handleKeyDown(e)`](#KeysPiano) and `handleKeyUp(e)` (see [`PIANO_KEYMAP`](#PIANO_KEYMAP) for which letter is which note). [`mountKeys()`](#mountKeys) does all of that for you.
description.zh: 電腦鍵盤一開始是關的，要自己設 `piano.captureEnabled = true`，並且由你把頁面的 `keydown` 和 `keyup` 事件交給 `handleKeyDown(e)` 和 `handleKeyUp(e)`（哪個字母是哪個音見 [`PIANO_KEYMAP`](#PIANO_KEYMAP)）。[`mountKeys()`](#mountKeys) 把這些全部替你做了。

params.name: container
params.en: The element the keys are built in. It gets the class `oav-keys` and is emptied first.
params.zh: 要把琴鍵蓋在裡面的元素。它會得到 `oav-keys` 這個 class，並且先被清空。

params.name: opts
params.en: Options: `base` (lowest key, default 48), `octaves` (default 2), `semitones` (the number of keys, default `octaves × 12 + 1`), `velocity` (0..127 for the mouse and the computer keyboard, default 100), `onNote(note, vel01, on)`, `onOctave(base)`, `fill` (size the keys in percent of the container, so it can be any width), `keyWidth` (px per white key when not filling, default 27), `minBase` (24) and `maxBase` (84), the range the octave keys can move `base` in.
params.zh: 選項：`base`（最低的鍵，預設 48）、`octaves`（預設 2）、`semitones`（鍵的數量，預設 `octaves × 12 + 1`）、`velocity`（滑鼠和電腦鍵盤的力道，0..127，預設 100）、`onNote(note, vel01, on)`、`onOctave(base)`、`fill`（琴鍵用容器的百分比算大小，所以可以是任何寬度）、`keyWidth`（不 fill 的時候每個白鍵幾像素，預設 27）、`minBase`（24）和 `maxBase`（84），也就是八度鍵能移動 `base` 的範圍。

notes.en: `handleKeyDown(e)` returns `true` when the piano used the event, and then you should call `e.preventDefault()`. While capturing, every letter `a`–`z` counts as used, even those that play no note, so a stray letter cannot trigger a hotkey; digits, space and the arrows pass through. Held keys with `Ctrl`, `Cmd` or `Alt` are never used.
notes.zh: 鋼琴用掉這個事件的時候，`handleKeyDown(e)` 會回傳 `true`，那時你要呼叫 `e.preventDefault()`。在擷取鍵盤的時候，每個字母 `a`–`z` 都算被用掉，連不發音的也是，這樣打錯的字母不會觸發快捷鍵。數字、空白鍵、方向鍵會放行。有按著 `Ctrl`、`Cmd`、`Alt` 的組合鍵永遠不算。

caption.en: A one-octave piano from middle C appears on the page. Click its keys and the console logs each note by name.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現一架從中央 C 開始、一個八度的鋼琴。點它的琴鍵，console 就用音名印出每個音。

caption.en: Click the page, then press A, S, D, F… to play from C3, Z and X to change octave. The letter keys no longer reach the rest of the page.
caption.zh: 點一下頁面，然後按 A、S、D、F…從 C3 開始彈，用 Z 和 X 換八度。字母鍵不會再傳到頁面的其他地方。

members.name: handleKeyDown
members.doc: Returns true when the piano consumed the event (caller: preventDefault + return).

entries.name: mountKeys
entries.signature: mountKeys(container, { signals, chord = null, base = 48, octaves = 2, sim = true, capture = true } = {})

summary.en: Puts a playable piano on the page in one call, with a keyboard switch and a self-playing performer, and publishes every note as `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off`.
summary.zh: 一個呼叫就在頁面上放一架可以彈的鋼琴，附電腦鍵盤開關和會自己演奏的演奏者，並把每個音發布成 `midi/note/on` 和 `midi/note/off`。

description.en: `mountKeys()` is the whole keyboard department in one line: a [`KeysPiano`](#KeysPiano) you can play with the mouse, a finger or the computer keyboard, and a [`SimPlayer`](#SimPlayer) that plays by itself. Above the piano are two checkboxes, both off to begin with: **keyboard** (the QWERTY keys play, `Z` and `X` move an octave, `Shift` plays harder) and **simulate performance**.
description.zh: `mountKeys()` 一行就把整個鍵盤部門裝好：一架可以用滑鼠、手指或電腦鍵盤彈的 [`KeysPiano`](#KeysPiano)，加上一個會自己彈的 [`SimPlayer`](#SimPlayer)。鋼琴上面有兩個勾選框，一開始都沒勾：**keyboard**（QWERTY 鍵能彈，`Z` 和 `X` 換八度，`Shift` 彈得比較重）和 **simulate performance**。

description.en: Everything is published as the standard `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off`, the same names a real MIDI keyboard uses, so a world, a sound engine or a chord detector cannot tell a QWERTY performance from hardware. Call `keys.update(dt)` once per frame, or the simulated performer does not move.
description.zh: 所有東西都發布成標準的 `midi/note/on` 和 `midi/note/off`，跟真的 MIDI 鍵盤用同樣的名字，所以世界、聲音引擎或和弦偵測器分不出 QWERTY 演奏和硬體的差別。每個畫面要呼叫一次 `keys.update(dt)`，不然模擬演奏者不會動。

params.name: container
params.en: The element to put the piano in. It gets a small bar of checkboxes and the piano under it. `dispose()` empties it again.
params.zh: 要放鋼琴的元素。裡面會有一條小小的勾選列，和它底下的鋼琴。`dispose()` 會再把它清空。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) bus to publish into. Every key down is `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 0 }` (`vel` 0..1) and every key up `midi/note/off` `{ note, ch: 0 }`. Without a bus the piano still works and calls `chord`.
params.zh: 要發布訊號的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 匯流排。每個按下去的鍵是 `midi/note/on` `{ note, vel, ch: 0 }`（`vel` 是 0..1），每個放開的鍵是 `midi/note/off` `{ note, ch: 0 }`。沒給匯流排的話鋼琴照樣能彈，也會呼叫 `chord`。

params.name: chord
params.en: Anything with `noteOn(note, vel01)` and `noteOff(note)`, usually a chord detector from `@openav/chord`, to be fed every note directly.
params.zh: 任何有 `noteOn(note, vel01)` 和 `noteOff(note)` 的東西，通常是 `@openav/chord` 的和弦偵測器，每個音都會直接餵給它。

params.name: base
params.en: The MIDI note of the lowest key (48 is C3). The simulated performer plays an octave above it.
params.zh: 最低那個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼（48 是 C3）。模擬演奏者彈的是它高一個八度的地方。

params.name: octaves
params.en: How many octaves the piano shows. It has `octaves × 12 + 1` keys, so two octaves end on a C.
params.zh: 鋼琴有幾個八度。鍵數是 `octaves × 12 + 1`，所以兩個八度會結束在一個 C。

params.name: sim
params.en: Show the "simulate performance" checkbox. The performer exists either way: `keys.sim.toggle(true)` starts it from code.
params.zh: 要不要顯示「simulate performance」勾選框。不管有沒有顯示，演奏者都在：用程式 `keys.sim.toggle(true)` 就能開始。

params.name: capture
params.en: Show the "keyboard" checkbox that lets the computer keyboard play the piano. With `false` there is no checkbox and `captureBox` is `null`; you can still set `keys.piano.captureEnabled = true`.
params.zh: 要不要顯示「keyboard」勾選框，讓電腦鍵盤能彈這架鋼琴。給 `false` 就沒有勾選框，`captureBox` 是 `null`。你還是可以自己設 `keys.piano.captureEnabled = true`。

returns.en: `{ piano, sim, update(dt), dispose(), captureBox }`: the [`KeysPiano`](#KeysPiano), the [`SimPlayer`](#SimPlayer), a function to call every frame with the seconds since the last one (it drives the performer), a function that takes everything down again, and the "keyboard" checkbox (or `null`).
returns.zh: `{ piano, sim, update(dt), dispose(), captureBox }`：[`KeysPiano`](#KeysPiano)、[`SimPlayer`](#SimPlayer)、每個畫面要呼叫的函式（參數是距離上一次過了幾秒，它帶動演奏者）、把一切拆掉的函式，以及「keyboard」勾選框（或 `null`）。

needs.en: A page with a DOM. The keyboard checkbox must be ticked before the computer keyboard plays, on purpose: while it is on, every letter key is taken by the piano, so hotkeys on letters stop working. A key listener goes on `window` until `dispose()`.
needs.zh: 需要有 DOM 的頁面。要先勾「keyboard」電腦鍵盤才會彈，這是故意的：勾著的時候所有字母鍵都被鋼琴吃掉，字母的快捷鍵就不能用。`window` 上的按鍵監聽會一直在，直到 `dispose()`。

notes.en: In a p5 sketch you do not need this: the 🎹 panel of oav-p5 is a piano like this one, and [`notePressed()`](#notePressed) hears it. `mountKeys()` is for a page that has no oav-p5.
notes.zh: 在 p5 草圖裡用不到這個：oav-p5 的 🎹 面板就是一架這樣的鋼琴，[`notePressed()`](#notePressed) 聽得到它。`mountKeys()` 是給沒有 oav-p5 的頁面用的。

caption.en: A two-octave piano appears on the page with its two checkboxes; click a key and the console logs the same events the code below sends.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現兩個八度的鋼琴和它的兩個勾選框。點一個鍵，console 就印出跟下面程式送出的同樣的事件。

caption.en: A three-octave piano plays itself for three seconds, its keys lighting up, and then it is taken down. `capture: false` leaves out the keyboard checkbox.
caption.zh: 一架三個八度的鋼琴自己彈三秒，琴鍵一個個亮起來，然後被拆掉。`capture: false` 讓「keyboard」勾選框不出現。

summary.en: Which computer-keyboard letter plays which note: `a` is the base note, `w` a semitone higher, `s` two.
summary.zh: 電腦鍵盤的哪個字母彈哪個音：`a` 是最低音，`w` 高一個半音，`s` 高兩個半音。

description.en: The layout the music software calls the DAW standard: the `A S D F G H J K L ;` row is the white keys and the `W E T Y U O P` row above it is the black keys, placed where they sit on a piano. With a piano that starts on C (`base` 48, 60…) it reads C, C♯, D, D♯, E, F, F♯, G, G♯, A, A♯, B, C, C♯, D, D♯, E. The keys are lowercase letters; [`KeysPiano.handleKeyDown(e)`](#KeysPiano) lowercases the key first. `Z` and `X` are not in the map: they move the octave.
description.zh: 這是音樂軟體稱為 DAW 標準的排法：`A S D F G H J K L ;` 這一排是白鍵，上面一排 `W E T Y U O P` 是黑鍵，位置就跟鋼琴上一樣。鋼琴從 C 開始（`base` 是 48、60…）的話，從左到右是 C、C♯、D、D♯、E、F、F♯、G、G♯、A、A♯、B、C、C♯、D、D♯、E。鍵是小寫字母。[`KeysPiano.handleKeyDown(e)`](#KeysPiano) 會先把鍵轉成小寫。`Z` 和 `X` 不在這張表裡：它們是換八度。

value.en: `{ a: 0, w: 1, s: 2, e: 3, d: 4, f: 5, t: 6, g: 7, y: 8, h: 9, u: 10, j: 11, k: 12, o: 13, l: 14, p: 15, ';': 16 }`: key to semitones above the piano's `base`.

caption.en: Looks up the note of a few letters on a piano that starts on middle C: `k` is the C an octave up, and `q` plays nothing.
caption.zh: 在從中央 C 開始的鋼琴上查幾個字母的音：`k` 是高八度的 C，`q` 不發音。

entries.name: SimPlayer
entries.signature: new SimPlayer({ press, release, base = 60, scale = [0, 2, 4, 7, 9], density = 1 } = {})

summary.en: A hands-free performer: it presses and releases notes on its own, in a scale, so a demo can play itself.
summary.zh: 一個不用手的演奏者：它自己在音階裡按下和放開音符，讓示範可以自己演奏。

description.en: It plays like someone noodling. Every gesture it picks at random: mostly a step up or down the scale, sometimes a leap, now and then a triad stacked in the scale, and real rests. Notes last 0.18 to 0.68 seconds (a triad twice as long), the next gesture comes 0.22 to 0.77 seconds later (a rest lasts 0.6 to 2 seconds), all at the default `density` of 1, and the notes are kept between 36 and 96. Because it presses and releases through your own two functions, whatever listens downstream cannot tell it from a person.
description.zh: 它彈起來像有人隨手彈。每個動作都是隨機挑的：大多是在音階上往上或往下一步，有時跳一個音程，偶爾彈一個疊在音階上的三和弦，也有真正的休止。每個音持續 0.18 到 0.68 秒（三和弦長兩倍），下一個動作在 0.22 到 0.77 秒之後（休止 0.6 到 2 秒），這些都是 `density` 為預設的 1 時的數字，音符被限制在 36 到 96。因為它是透過你的兩個函式按下和放開，下游的東西分不出它跟真人的差別。

description.en: It starts off. Call `toggle(true)` and then `update(dt)` once per frame with the seconds since the last frame; it does nothing while it is off. `toggle(false)` releases every note it is holding, so none sticks. The notes are random (it uses `Math.random`, there is no seed).
description.zh: 它一開始是關的。呼叫 `toggle(true)`，然後每個畫面用距離上一個畫面過了幾秒呼叫 `update(dt)`。關著的時候它什麼都不做。`toggle(false)` 會放開它按著的所有音，不會有音卡住。音是隨機的（用的是 `Math.random`，沒有 seed）。

params.name: press
params.en: `press(note, vel01)`: called when a note starts, with its MIDI number and a velocity between 0.45 and 0.85. Usually the `press` of a [`KeysPiano`](#KeysPiano), so the keys light up.
params.zh: `press(note, vel01)`：一個音開始時呼叫，帶著 MIDI 號碼和 0.45 到 0.85 之間的力道。通常是 [`KeysPiano`](#KeysPiano) 的 `press`，這樣琴鍵會亮。

params.name: release
params.en: `release(note)`: called when the note ends.
params.zh: `release(note)`：這個音結束時呼叫。

params.name: base
params.en: The MIDI note the scale starts on.
params.zh: 音階從哪個 MIDI 音符開始。

params.name: scale
params.en: The notes it may play, as semitones above `base`. The default is a pentatonic scale, which sounds fine whatever happens.
params.zh: 它可以彈的音，用比 `base` 高幾個半音來表示。預設是五聲音階，怎麼彈都不會難聽。

params.name: density
params.en: How busy it is. The gaps between notes are divided by it, so 2 plays about twice as often.
params.zh: 多忙。音和音之間的間隔會除以它，所以 2 大約是兩倍密。

caption.en: Runs the performer for ten simulated seconds without any sound or screen and logs that it played a good number of notes, all inside 36 to 96.
caption.zh: 不用聲音也不用畫面，讓演奏者跑十秒的模擬時間，印出它彈了不少音，而且全都在 36 到 96 之間。

caption.en: A piano plays itself in a minor scale for four seconds: the keys light up as the notes go down and up.
caption.zh: 一架鋼琴在小調音階裡自己彈四秒：音符按下和放開的時候，琴鍵跟著亮和暗。

summary.en: An advanced helper: the orthonormal basis `[x, y, z]` of a bone, rebuilt from two joints and the palm normal the way LeapJS expects.
summary.zh: 進階用的輔助函式：用兩個關節和掌心法線重建一根骨頭的正交基底 `[x, y, z]`，做法符合 LeapJS 的期待。

description.en: The sensor gives joints, not rotations, but LeapJS sketches read a rotation basis for every bone, so [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter) uses this to fill in `bases`. You only need it if you write your own converter.
description.zh: 感測器給的是關節，不是旋轉，但 LeapJS 的草圖會對每根骨頭讀一個旋轉基底，所以 [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter) 用它來填 `bases`。只有自己寫轉換器的時候才會需要它。

params.name: prev
params.en: The joint at the base of the bone, `[x, y, z]` in millimetres.
params.zh: 骨頭根部的關節 `[x, y, z]`，單位是公釐。

params.name: next
params.en: The joint at the tip end of the bone.
params.zh: 骨頭前端的關節。

params.name: palmNormal
params.en: The palm normal; `-palmNormal` becomes the "back of the hand" axis (y).
params.zh: 掌心法線，`-palmNormal` 會成為「手背」那一軸（y）。

params.name: left
params.en: `true` for a left hand: the x axis is negated, so the determinant is negative, which is how LeapJS tells left from right.
params.zh: 左手就傳 `true`：x 軸會反向，行列式變成負的，LeapJS 就是靠這個分辨左右手。

returns.en: Three rows `[x, y, z]`, each a unit vector rounded to 3 decimals. z runs from the tip back to the base (LeapJS's `Bone.direction()` is `-z`).
returns.zh: 三列 `[x, y, z]`，各是四捨五入到小數三位的單位向量。z 從前端指回根部（LeapJS 的 `Bone.direction()` 是 `-z`）。

caption.en: The console prints the identity `[ [ 1, 0, 0 ], [ 0, 1, 0 ], [ 0, 0, 1 ] ]`, then `[ -1, 0, 0 ]` for the left hand.

summary.en: The Leap bridge's default port: 6437, the port the original Leap service used, so old `leap.js` sketches find it unchanged.
summary.zh: Leap 橋接程式預設的連接埠：6437，是原本的 Leap 服務用的連接埠，舊的 `leap.js` 草圖不用改就找得到。

description.en: The default of `startBridge({ port })` and of `--port`. The environment variable `LEAP_BRIDGE_PORT` changes it for the command line. This is the port of the **Leap** bridge; the out-bridge has its own ([`DEFAULT_PORT` of `@openav/out`](#out-DEFAULT_PORT), 6450).
description.zh: `startBridge({ port })` 和 `--port` 的預設值。環境變數 `LEAP_BRIDGE_PORT` 可以改命令列用的值。這是 **Leap** 橋接程式的連接埠。輸出橋接有自己的（[`@openav/out` 的 `DEFAULT_PORT`](#out-DEFAULT_PORT)，6450）。

summary.en: The default address `LeapInput` connects to: `ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json`, the bridge on this machine speaking the LeapJS protocol.
summary.zh: `LeapInput` 預設連的位址：`ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json`，也就是這台機器上、講 LeapJS 通訊協定的橋接程式。

description.en: Port 6437 is the port the original Leap service used, so old `leap.js` sketches find the bridge without changing anything. `…/raw` on the same port serves the raw lines instead. In a show, `?leap=ws://host:port/v6.json` in the page address points a page at another bridge, and `?leap=sim` starts the simulator.
description.zh: 6437 是原本的 Leap 服務用的連接埠，所以舊的 `leap.js` 草圖不用改任何東西就找得到橋接程式。同一個連接埠的 `…/raw` 提供的是原始行格式。在演出裡，網址加上 `?leap=ws://host:port/v6.json` 可以讓頁面改連別的橋接程式，`?leap=sim` 則會啟動模擬器。

summary.en: A LeapJS device event telling the client whether a device is attached and streaming, plus our own `service` flag.
summary.zh: 一則 LeapJS 裝置事件，告訴用戶端裝置有沒有接上、有沒有在串流，另外附上我們自己加的 `service` 旗標。

description.en: LeapJS (protocol 5 and up) turns it into `deviceAttached`, `deviceStreaming` and `streamingStarted`. The bridge sends one on connect and on every status change. `LeapInput` maps it to its status: no service is `'no-service'`, a service without a device is `'no-device'`, and a streaming device is `'tracking'`.
description.zh: LeapJS（通訊協定 5 以上）會把它轉成 `deviceAttached`、`deviceStreaming` 和 `streamingStarted`。橋接程式在連線時，以及每次狀態改變時都會送一則。`LeapInput` 把它對應成自己的狀態：沒有服務是 `'no-service'`，有服務沒裝置是 `'no-device'`，裝置在串流就是 `'tracking'`。

params.name: device
params.en: The device id, or `null` for no device.
params.zh: 裝置 id，沒有裝置就是 `null`。

params.name: service
params.en: Whether the tracking service is running. LeapJS ignores this; [`LeapInput`](#LeapInput) uses it to tell "no tracking service" from "no device".
params.zh: 追蹤服務有沒有在跑。LeapJS 會忽略它。[`LeapInput`](#LeapInput) 用它區分「沒有追蹤服務」和「沒有裝置」。

returns.en: `{ event: { type: 'deviceEvent', state: { attached, streaming, id, type: 'Peripheral', service } } }`; `id` is `'none'` without a device.
returns.zh: `{ event: { type: 'deviceEvent', state: { attached, streaming, id, type: 'Peripheral', service } } }`，沒有裝置時 `id` 是 `'none'`。

caption.en: Feeding three device events through a `LeapInput`: the console prints `no-service 1`, `no-device 2`, `tracking 3`.
caption.zh: 把三則裝置事件餵給 `LeapInput`：主控台印出 `no-service 1`、`no-device 2`、`tracking 3`。

summary.en: The five finger names in order, `thumb index middle ring pinky`: the order of `hand.fingers` and the names in the fingertip signals.
summary.zh: 依序排好的五個手指名稱 `thumb index middle ring pinky`：`hand.fingers` 的順序，也是指尖訊號用的名字。

description.en: `hand.fingers[0]` is the thumb and `hand.fingers[4]` the pinky, so `FINGERS[i]` names `hand.fingers[i]`. The fingertip signals are `leap/hand/<side>/<finger>/x|y|z` with these names, for example `leap/hand/right/index/y`.
description.zh: `hand.fingers[0]` 是拇指，`hand.fingers[4]` 是小指，所以 `FINGERS[i]` 就是 `hand.fingers[i]` 的名字。指尖訊號是 `leap/hand/<side>/<finger>/x|y|z`，用的就是這些名字，例如 `leap/hand/right/index/y`。

summary.en: Turns a hand's direction and palm normal into `{ pitch, yaw, roll }` in radians, with the LeapJS conventions.
summary.zh: 把手的方向和掌心法線轉成以弧度計的 `{ pitch, yaw, roll }`，沿用 LeapJS 的慣例。

description.en: A flat hand, palm down, fingers away from you, is `{ pitch: 0, yaw: 0, roll: 0 }`. The three angles are the `leap/hand/<side>/pitch|yaw|roll` signals, which `LeapInput` computes with this function from each hand.
description.zh: 手平放、掌心朝下、手指朝向遠離你的方向，就是 `{ pitch: 0, yaw: 0, roll: 0 }`。這三個角度就是 `leap/hand/<side>/pitch|yaw|roll` 這幾個訊號，`LeapInput` 對每隻手都是用這個函式算出來的。

params.name: direction
params.en: The direction the fingers point, `[x, y, z]` (a unit vector).
params.zh: 手指指的方向 `[x, y, z]`（單位向量）。

params.name: normal
params.en: The palm normal `[x, y, z]`, pointing out of the palm (down when the palm faces the sensor).
params.zh: 掌心法線 `[x, y, z]`，從手掌往外指（掌心朝向感測器時是向下）。

returns.en: `{ pitch, yaw, roll }`, each −π..π: `pitch` is the fingers tipping up, `yaw` turning toward +x (the right), `roll` the palm turning over.
returns.zh: `{ pitch, yaw, roll }`，各自在 −π..π：`pitch` 是手指往上翹，`yaw` 是轉向 +x（右邊），`roll` 是手掌翻轉。

notes.en: When the fingers point straight up there is no yaw or roll to measure, and the function answers π (3.14) for them. Expect that at the top of a gesture, and do not map those two signals when the hand is vertical.
notes.zh: 手指正對著天花板的時候，沒有 yaw 或 roll 可量，函式會回答 π（3.14）。手勢做到最高的時候會遇到，手垂直時請不要去映射那兩個訊號。

caption.en: The console prints the angles for four hands: all zeros, then `pitch: 0.52`, `yaw: 0.79` and `roll: 0.52`, one angle changing each time.
caption.zh: 主控台印出四隻手的角度：全是 0，然後是 `pitch: 0.52`、`yaw: 0.79` 和 `roll: 0.52`，每次只有一個角度在變。

summary.en: The bones to draw for a hand, as pairs of points: each finger's joints in turn, the line across the knuckles, and the forearm.
summary.zh: 一隻手要畫的骨頭，用成對的點表示：每根手指的關節依序相連、橫過指節的那條線，以及前臂。

description.en: It only lists the pairs; you choose how to draw them. [`LeapInput.skeleton()`](#LeapInput) calls it for you. Use it directly when you draw with p5, three.js or your own projection.
description.zh: 它只列出成對的點，怎麼畫由你決定。[`LeapInput.skeleton()`](#LeapInput) 會替你呼叫它。用 p5、three.js 或自己的投影來畫的時候，就直接用它。

params.name: hand
params.en: A hand from [`handsOf()`](#handsOf) or `leap.hands`.
params.zh: 來自 [`handsOf()`](#handsOf) 或 `leap.hands` 的一隻手。

returns.en: An array of `[pointA, pointB]` pairs, each point `[x, y, z]` in millimetres. A hand with five 5-joint fingers, a wrist and an elbow gives 25.
returns.zh: `[pointA, pointB]` 成對的陣列，每個點是 `[x, y, z]`，單位是公釐。一隻有五根各 5 個關節的手指、手腕和手肘的手，會得到 25 條。

caption.en: Both mock hands are drawn on the canvas in a front view, bone by bone.
caption.zh: 兩隻假手用正視圖畫在畫布上，一根骨頭一根骨頭地畫。

summary.en: Turns pinch and grab strengths into clean start and end events, per hand plus a both-hands pinch, using hysteresis so a wobbling value fires once.
summary.zh: 把捏合和握拳的力度變成乾淨的開始與結束事件，每隻手各一組，另外還有雙手捏合，用遲滯處理，所以抖動的值只會觸發一次。

description.en: A pinch strength hovers around any single threshold while the fingers are "almost touching", and one threshold then fires start, end, start, end sixty times a second. So every gesture is a trigger with two thresholds: it **starts** above `on` and only **ends** below `off`. The defaults are a pinch starting above 0.86 and ending below 0.5, a both-hands pinch entering when both hands are above 0.8 and leaving when either drops below 0.5, and a grab (fist) above 0.8 and below 0.5. A hand that disappears ends all of its gestures.
description.zh: 手指「快要碰到」的時候，捏合力度會在任何單一門檻附近晃來晃去，只有一個門檻的話，就會每秒六十次地開始、結束、開始、結束。所以每個手勢都有兩個門檻：高過 `on` 才**開始**，低於 `off` 才**結束**。預設值是：捏合高於 0.86 開始、低於 0.5 結束。雙手捏合在兩隻手都高於 0.8 時進入，任何一隻低於 0.5 就離開。握拳高於 0.8 開始、低於 0.5 結束。手消失的時候，它所有的手勢都會結束。

description.en: `LeapInput` already runs one (`leap.gestures`) and turns its events into the `leap/…/pinch-start` pulses. Use `HandGestures` on its own when you have hands from somewhere else.
description.zh: `LeapInput` 已經內建一個（`leap.gestures`），並把它的事件變成 `leap/…/pinch-start` 這些脈衝。你的手資料如果是從別的地方來，才需要單獨使用 `HandGestures`。

params.name: thresholds
params.en: Overrides for the defaults in [`THRESHOLDS`](#THRESHOLDS): `{ pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }`. Keys you leave out keep their defaults.
params.zh: 覆寫 [`THRESHOLDS`](#THRESHOLDS) 的預設值：`{ pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }`。沒寫的鍵維持預設。

caption.en: The console prints `[]`, `[ 'pinch-start' ]`, `[]`, `[ 'pinch-end' ]`: the pinch starts above 0.86 and holds until it drops under 0.5.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `[]`、`[ 'pinch-start' ]`、`[]`、`[ 'pinch-end' ]`：捏合高於 0.86 才開始，一直撐到低於 0.5。

caption.en: The console prints `[ 'pinch-start:left', 'pinch-start:right' ]`, then `[ 'both-pinch-start:both' ]`, then the three ends when the hands leave.
caption.zh: 主控台先印出 `[ 'pinch-start:left', 'pinch-start:right' ]`，接著是 `[ 'both-pinch-start:both' ]`，兩隻手離開時則印出三個結束事件。

members.name: state
members.doc: What is held right now: { left: {pinch, grab}, right: {…}, both }

summary.en: Reads either wire format (raw line or LeapJS v6 frame) into the one hand shape the rest of the package uses; anything else gives `[]`.
summary.zh: 把兩種傳輸格式（原始行或 LeapJS v6 影格）都讀成套件其他部分共用的同一種手的形狀，其他任何東西都回傳 `[]`。

description.en: This is the hand shape worlds draw from (`leap.hands`). A raw frame carries the fingers inline; a v6 frame carries them as `pointables` joined to their hand by `handId`, and `handsOf()` does that join. Both give the same hand, so code written against `leap.hands` does not care which URL the bridge was reached on.
description.zh: 這就是世界用來畫手的形狀（`leap.hands`）。原始影格把手指放在手的裡面。v6 影格把手指放成 `pointables`，用 `handId` 接到它們的手，`handsOf()` 負責做這個合併。兩者給出同一隻手，所以針對 `leap.hands` 寫的程式不在乎橋接程式是從哪個網址連的。

params.name: msg
params.en: A parsed message: a raw frame (`t: 'f'`) or a v6 frame (with `hands` and `pointables`).
params.zh: 一則解析好的訊息：原始影格（`t: 'f'`）或 v6 影格（有 `hands` 和 `pointables`）。

returns.en: The hands, each `{ id, side: 'left' | 'right', confidence, pinch, grab, palm, velocity, normal, direction, width, fingers, extended, elbow, wrist, timeVisible }`. Positions are in millimetres; `fingers` is 5 arrays of joints (the last is the tip), `extended` 5 booleans.
returns.zh: 手的陣列，每隻是 `{ id, side: 'left' | 'right', confidence, pinch, grab, palm, velocity, normal, direction, width, fingers, extended, elbow, wrist, timeVisible }`。位置單位是公釐。`fingers` 是 5 個關節陣列（最後一個是指尖），`extended` 是 5 個布林值。

caption.en: Both formats give the same hand: the console prints `right [ 43.6, 233.2, 53.6 ] 1` twice, then `[] []`.
caption.zh: 兩種格式給出同一隻手：主控台兩次印出 `right [ 43.6, 233.2, 53.6 ] 1`，然後是 `[] []`。

summary.en: One Schmitt trigger: `update(v)` says `'start'` when the value rises above `on`, and `'end'` only when it falls below `off`.
summary.zh: 一個施密特觸發器：數值升到 `on` 以上，`update(v)` 回報 `'start'`，要降到 `off` 以下才會回報 `'end'`。

description.en: The gap between `on` and `off` is what stops a value that hovers near one threshold from flickering. Each call to `update()` returns `'start'` (it just became active), `'end'` (it just stopped) or `null` (nothing changed). A missing or `NaN` value while active counts as an end, so a lost sensor lets go. `active` tells you whether it is on now.
description.zh: `on` 和 `off` 之間的空隙，就是讓在某個門檻附近徘徊的數值不會閃爍的原因。每次呼叫 `update()` 會回傳 `'start'`（剛變成啟動）、`'end'`（剛停止）或 `null`（沒有變化）。啟動中遇到缺值或 `NaN` 會當作結束，所以感測器掉了就會放開。`active` 告訴你它現在是不是開著。

params.name: on
params.en: The level the value must rise **above** to start.
params.zh: 數值要**高過**它才會開始。

params.name: off
params.en: The level the value must fall **below** to end. It must be lower than `on`, or the constructor throws "Hysteresis: off must be below on".
params.zh: 數值要**低於**它才會結束。必須比 `on` 低，否則建構函式會丟出 "Hysteresis: off must be below on"。

caption.en: The console prints `[ null, 'start', null, 'end', null ]`: 0.6 is below 0.8 but above 0.4, so it is still held.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `[ null, 'start', null, 'end', null ]`：0.6 低於 0.8，但高於 0.4，所以還是按住的狀態。

members.name: release
members.doc: Force the end (hand lost).

summary.en: The classic Leap interaction box, `{ center: [0, 200, 0], size: [235.247, 235.247, 147.751] }` in millimetres, that positions are normalised against.
summary.zh: 經典的 Leap 互動範圍盒，`{ center: [0, 200, 0], size: [235.247, 235.247, 147.751] }`，單位是公釐，位置就是對它做正規化。

description.en: A frozen object: the centre sits 200 mm above the sensor, and the box measures 235.247 mm along x, 235.247 mm along y and 147.751 mm along z (the sensor's own axes: x across, y up, z toward the player). [`normalizePoint()`](#normalizePoint) maps it to 0..1, and the console panel draws it as an outline so you can see when a hand leaves it. Pass your own box to `new LeapInput({ box })` to change where 0 and 1 are.
description.zh: 一個凍結的物件：中心在感測器上方 200 公釐，三個軸的尺寸是感測器自己的座標軸：x 是 235 公釐、y 是 235 公釐、z 是 148 公釐。[`normalizePoint()`](#normalizePoint) 把它對應到 0..1，主控台面板把它畫成外框，這樣你就看得到手什麼時候離開。要改 0 和 1 在哪裡，就傳自己的盒子給 `new LeapInput({ box })`。

entries.name: LeapInput
entries.signature: new LeapInput({ signals = null, url = DEFAULT_URL, reconnect = true, fingers = true, box = INTERACTION_BOX, thresholds = THRESHOLDS, WebSocket: WS = null } = {})

summary.en: Reads Leap Motion hands from the local bridge and publishes them as `leap/*` signals, plus the joints (`leap.hands`) for drawing the hand itself.
summary.zh: 從本機的橋接程式讀取 Leap Motion 的手，發布成 `leap/*` 訊號，並在 `leap.hands` 提供關節資料，讓你把手本身畫出來。

description.en: Browsers cannot talk to the Leap Motion sensor directly, so a small program on the same machine, the **bridge** ([`startBridge()`](#leap-startBridge), `ws://127.0.0.1:6437`), reads it and serves the hands over a WebSocket. `LeapInput` connects to that bridge and does one job: it turns hands into **normalised signals** and never touches params or worlds. In a show, `createShow({ modules: { leap: true } })` builds one and returns it as `show.leap`; the console's L1 panel shows which link is missing.
description.zh: 瀏覽器沒辦法直接跟 Leap Motion 感測器溝通，所以同一台機器上有個小程式，也就是**橋接程式**（[`startBridge()`](#leap-startBridge)，`ws://127.0.0.1:6437`），負責讀取它，再用 WebSocket 把手送出來。`LeapInput` 連到那個橋接程式，只做一件事：把手變成**正規化的訊號**，絕不碰參數或世界。在演出裡，`createShow({ modules: { leap: true } })` 會建好一個，用 `show.leap` 回傳。主控台的 L1 面板會告訴你哪一段連線不通。

description.en: It publishes, for each side (`left`, `right`): `leap/hand/<side>/present` (0 or 1), `x`, `y`, `z` (the palm in the interaction box, 0..1, y up, z toward the player), `pinch` and `grab` (0..1), `roll`, `pitch`, `yaw` (−π..π radians), `speed` (0..1, 1 = 1 m/s), and `<finger>/x|y|z` for the five fingertips. Shared: `leap/status` (0 no bridge, 1 bridge but no tracking service, 2 service but no device, 3 tracking), `leap/hands` (0..2) and `leap/both/distance` (palm to palm, 1 = 40 cm). The full list with its ranges is what [`leapSignals()`](#leapSignals) returns.
description.zh: 每一邊（`left`、`right`）它會發布：`leap/hand/<side>/present`（0 或 1）、`x`、`y`、`z`（掌心在互動範圍盒裡的位置，0..1，y 向上，z 朝向玩家）、`pinch` 和 `grab`（0..1）、`roll`、`pitch`、`yaw`（−π..π 弧度）、`speed`（0..1，1 = 每秒 1 公尺），還有五個指尖的 `<finger>/x|y|z`。共用的有：`leap/status`（0 沒有橋接、1 有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、2 服務在但沒有裝置、3 追蹤中）、`leap/hands`（0..2）和 `leap/both/distance`（兩掌之間的距離，1 = 40 公分）。完整的清單和範圍就是 [`leapSignals()`](#leapSignals) 的回傳值。

description.en: Gestures are pulses with a payload `{ side, x, y, z, strength }`: `leap/hand/<side>/pinch-start|pinch-end` and `grab-start|grab-end`, and `leap/both/pinch-start|pinch-end` (payload `{ x, y, z, distance }` at the midpoint). They use hysteresis, so a pinch hovering near the threshold fires once and not sixty times a second (see [`HandGestures`](#HandGestures)). A hand that leaves the view lets go: its `present`, `pinch`, `grab` and `speed` go to 0 and its gestures end.
description.zh: 手勢是帶有 `{ side, x, y, z, strength }` 的脈衝：`leap/hand/<side>/pinch-start|pinch-end` 和 `grab-start|grab-end`，以及 `leap/both/pinch-start|pinch-end`（內容是中點的 `{ x, y, z, distance }`）。它們有遲滯，所以在門檻附近徘徊的捏合只會觸發一次，不會一秒鐘觸發六十次（見 [`HandGestures`](#HandGestures)）。手離開畫面就會放開：它的 `present`、`pinch`、`grab` 和 `speed` 歸零，手勢也跟著結束。

description.en: For continuous control, map a signal to a param (`{ source: 'leap/hand/right/y', target: 'energy' }`) so the timeline, a knob and a hand are interchangeable. Use `leap.hands` (joints in millimetres) only to draw the hand itself.
description.zh: 連續控制請把訊號映射到參數（`{ source: 'leap/hand/right/y', target: 'energy' }`），這樣時間軸、旋鈕和手就可以互換。`leap.hands`（以公釐計的關節）只用來把手本身畫出來。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) registry to publish into. Without one the input still works (`hands`, `onFrame`) but publishes nothing.
params.zh: 要發布進去的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表。沒有的話，這個輸入仍然能用（`hands`、`onFrame`），只是不發布任何訊號。

params.name: url
params.en: The bridge address: the LeapJS protocol (the default, [`DEFAULT_URL`](#DEFAULT_URL)) or `…/raw` for the raw line format. Any service that still speaks the LeapJS v6 protocol works too.
params.zh: 橋接程式的位址：LeapJS 通訊協定（預設，[`DEFAULT_URL`](#DEFAULT_URL)），或 `…/raw` 的原始行格式。任何還在講 LeapJS v6 通訊協定的服務也行。

params.name: reconnect
params.en: Whether to try again after the connection drops, waiting 0.5 s, then 1 s, 2 s … up to 5 s between tries.
params.zh: 連線中斷之後要不要重試：每次等待 0.5 秒、1 秒、2 秒……最長 5 秒。

params.name: fingers
params.en: Publish the fingertip signals (3 per finger, 30 across two hands). `false` leaves them out and keeps the signal list short.
params.zh: 要不要發布指尖訊號（每根手指 3 個，兩隻手共 30 個）。`false` 會省略它們，訊號清單比較短。

params.name: box
params.en: The interaction box `{ center, size }` in millimetres that positions are normalised against. The default is [`INTERACTION_BOX`](#INTERACTION_BOX).
params.zh: 位置據以正規化的互動範圍盒 `{ center, size }`，單位是公釐。預設是 [`INTERACTION_BOX`](#INTERACTION_BOX)。

params.name: thresholds
params.en: Overrides for the gesture hysteresis, such as `{ pinch: { on: 0.9, off: 0.6 } }` (see [`THRESHOLDS`](#THRESHOLDS)). Keys you leave out keep their defaults.
params.zh: 手勢遲滯值的覆寫，例如 `{ pinch: { on: 0.9, off: 0.6 } }`（見 [`THRESHOLDS`](#THRESHOLDS)）。沒寫的鍵維持預設。

params.name: WebSocket
params.en: The WebSocket constructor to use. Pass your own to test without a network.
params.zh: 要用的 WebSocket 建構函式。傳你自己的，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。

needs.en: For real hands: the bridge must be running (`node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs`, or `--mock` for animated made-up hands) and you must call `connect()`. Nothing is published until the first frame arrives. No sensor and no bridge: feed it hands with `ingest()`, or call `simulate()` to turn the mouse into hands.
needs.zh: 要接真的手：橋接程式必須在跑（`node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs`，或加 `--mock` 得到會動的假手），而且你要呼叫 `connect()`。第一個影格到達之前不會發布任何東西。沒有感測器也沒有橋接程式：用 `ingest()` 餵手給它，或呼叫 `simulate()` 把滑鼠變成手。

notes.en: Fields to read: `status` (`'idle'`, `'connecting'`, `'bridge'`, `'no-service'`, `'no-device'`, `'tracking'`, `'simulated'`, `'closed'`), `hands` (an array; each hand has `id`, `side`, `palm`, `fingers` (5 × 5 joints), `pinch`, `grab`, `velocity`, `normal`, `direction` … in millimetres), `frame` (the latest message as it came), `frames`, `fps`, `device`, `serviceVersion`, `gestures` and `box`.
notes.zh: 可以讀的欄位：`status`（`'idle'`、`'connecting'`、`'bridge'`、`'no-service'`、`'no-device'`、`'tracking'`、`'simulated'`、`'closed'`）、`hands`（陣列，每隻手有 `id`、`side`、`palm`、`fingers`（5 × 5 個關節）、`pinch`、`grab`、`velocity`、`normal`、`direction` ……，單位是公釐）、`frame`（最近收到的原始訊息）、`frames`、`fps`、`device`、`serviceVersion`、`gestures` 和 `box`。

notes.en: While the simulator runs it owns the hands: real frames from the bridge are ignored, and what the bridge says is remembered and restored when the simulator stops.
notes.zh: 模擬器在跑的時候，手由它掌管：橋接程式來的真實影格會被忽略，橋接程式的狀態會被記住，等模擬器停止再恢復。

notes.en: The signals are normalised (y = 1 is up). `leap.hands` and the LeapJS frames keep the sensor's own millimetre units, with +z toward the player.
notes.zh: 訊號是正規化的（y = 1 代表向上）。`leap.hands` 和 LeapJS 的影格則保留感測器自己的公釐單位，+z 朝向玩家。

notes.en: How the bridge talks, the formats and the troubleshooting table are in the [package README](https://github.com/frank890417/open-audiovisual/blob/main/packages/leap/README.md).
notes.zh: 橋接程式怎麼溝通、各種格式和疑難排解表，都在[套件的 README](https://github.com/frank890417/open-audiovisual/blob/main/packages/leap/README.md)。

caption.en: The console prints `tracking 2` and `1` (the mock right hand is pinching at second 2), and both hands are drawn on the canvas.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `tracking 2` 和 `1`（假的右手在第 2 秒正在捏合），兩隻手也畫在畫布上。

caption.en: Six seconds of mock hands, with the pulses listed as they fire: the right hand pinches twice (`leap/hand/right/pinch-start 0.86`, then `pinch-end 0.50`, again) and the left fist closes once (`leap/hand/left/grab-start 0.80`). It ends with `2 3` (two hands, status 3 = tracking).
caption.zh: 六秒鐘的假手，脈衝在觸發時一一列出：右手捏合兩次（`leap/hand/right/pinch-start 0.86`，然後 `pinch-end 0.50`，再來一次），左手握拳一次（`leap/hand/left/grab-start 0.80`）。最後印出 `2 3`（兩隻手，狀態 3 = 追蹤中）。

caption.en: Move the mouse over the page: a right hand follows it, and the text shows its height (`y`). Press the button to pinch, right-click to make a fist.
caption.zh: 在頁面上移動滑鼠：右手會跟著動，文字顯示它的高度（`y`）。按下按鍵是捏合，按右鍵是握拳。

caption.en: With the bridge running and a hand over the sensor, the console follows the link (`leap connecting`, `leap bridge`, `leap tracking`) and prints a line for every pinch.
caption.zh: 橋接程式開著、手放在感測器上方，主控台會跟著連線的進展（`leap connecting`、`leap bridge`、`leap tracking`），每次捏合印出一行。

tbd.en: Not tried with a real Leap Motion sensor here: the examples feed made-up hands (`mockFrame`) through the same `ingest()` path.
tbd.zh: 這裡沒有用真正的 Leap Motion 感測器試過：範例是把假手（`mockFrame`）餵進同一條 `ingest()` 路徑。

tbd.en: On a public https page, whether Chrome asks for permission before the page may reach `127.0.0.1` (the package README says it needs the "loopback-network" permission) was not tried here.
tbd.zh: 在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 是否會在頁面連到 `127.0.0.1` 之前詢問權限（套件 README 說需要「loopback-network」權限），這裡沒有實測。
