members.name: mountPanel
members.doc: A small status + skeleton panel (the console's L1 section uses it; so does the lab).

summary.en: The list of every signal `LeapInput` publishes, with its range, as `[[name, meta], …]`, ready to hand to `signals.define()`.
summary.zh: `LeapInput` 發布的所有訊號清單，連同範圍，格式是 `[[name, meta], …]`，可以直接交給 `signals.define()`。

description.en: `new LeapInput({ signals })` already declares all of these, so you rarely call this yourself. It is useful when you want the list: to build a signal picker, to check that a route's source exists, or to declare the signals before the sensor is connected. The names it returns are the vocabulary of the [Signals reference](https://openaudiovisual.com/docs/#signals) for Leap.
description.zh: `new LeapInput({ signals })` 已經把這些全部宣告好了，所以很少需要自己呼叫。想要這份清單的時候它就很有用：做訊號選單、檢查某條路由的來源存不存在、或在感測器還沒接上之前先宣告訊號。它回傳的名稱就是[訊號參考](https://openaudiovisual.com/zh/docs/#signals)裡 Leap 的那一批詞彙。

params.name: fingers
params.en: Include the fingertip signals. `false` leaves out the 30 of them.
params.zh: 要不要包含指尖訊號。`false` 會少掉那 30 個。

returns.en: The pairs `[name, meta]`: 63 with fingers, 33 without. Each `meta` has `source: 'leap'`, and `min` and `max` (the roll, pitch and yaw ones in radians, −π..π) or `kind: 'pulse'`.
returns.zh: `[name, meta]` 的成對清單：有指尖是 63 個，沒有是 33 個。每個 `meta` 都有 `source: 'leap'`，以及 `min` 和 `max`（roll、pitch、yaw 是弧度，−π..π），脈衝則是 `kind: 'pulse'`。

caption.en: The console prints `63 33`, then the roll range's lower end (−π) and `pulse`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `63 33`，然後是 roll 範圍的下限（−π）和 `pulse`。

summary.en: One frame of made-up, animated hands at time `t`: a right hand circling and pinching every 3 seconds, a left hand rising, falling and slowly making a fist.
summary.zh: 時間 `t` 的一個影格的假手，會動：右手繞圈、每 3 秒捏合一次，左手升降，並且慢慢握拳。

description.en: This is the bridge's `--mock` stream and the way to try Leap code without a sensor. The right hand pinches for about a second out of every 3, the left hand pinches once every 12 seconds, and at those moments (for example second 8) both are pinched, so the both-hands pinch fires too. The left fist comes and goes slowly. The output goes through exactly the same conversion and publishing as a real Leap Motion Controller.
description.zh: 這就是橋接程式 `--mock` 模式送出的串流，也是沒有感測器時試 Leap 程式的辦法。右手每 3 秒有大約 1 秒在捏合，左手每 12 秒捏合一次，兩者重疊的時刻（例如第 8 秒），兩隻手同時捏合，所以雙手捏合也會觸發。左手的拳頭則慢慢地出現又消失。輸出走的轉換與發布路徑，跟真正的 Leap Motion Controller 完全一樣。

params.name: t
params.en: Time in seconds. The result depends only on `t`, so it is the same every time.
params.zh: 時間，單位是秒。結果只跟 `t` 有關，所以每次都一樣。

params.name: id
params.en: The frame number written into the frame.
params.zh: 寫進影格裡的影格編號。

params.name: hands
params.en: How many hands: 2 (right and left), 1 (the right only) or 0.
params.zh: 手的數量：2（右手和左手）、1（只有右手）或 0。

returns.en: A frame in the raw line format: `{ t: 'f', id, fps: 60, hands: [hand, …] }`, the right hand (`side: 'R'`) first. Feed it to [`LeapInput.ingest()`](#LeapInput) or [`handsOf()`](#handsOf).
returns.zh: 原始行格式的影格：`{ t: 'f', id, fps: 60, hands: [hand, …] }`，右手（`side: 'R'`）在前面。可以餵給 [`LeapInput.ingest()`](#LeapInput) 或 [`handsOf()`](#handsOf)。

caption.en: The console prints `0.5 R pinch 0 · L pinch 0`, `2 R pinch 1 · L pinch 0` and `8 R pinch 1 · L pinch 1` (the both-hands pinch).
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `0.5 R pinch 0 · L pinch 0`、`2 R pinch 1 · L pinch 0` 和 `8 R pinch 1 · L pinch 1`（雙手捏合）。

entries.name: mockHand
entries.signature: mockHand({ id = 1, side = 'R', palm = [0, 200, 0], pinch = 0, grab = 0, roll = 0, yaw = 0, pitch = 0, vel = [0, 0, 0], conf = 1, width = 85 } = {})

summary.en: Builds one made-up hand, with all five fingers and the arm, from a palm position plus pinch, grab, roll, yaw and pitch.
summary.zh: 用掌心位置加上捏合、握拳、roll、yaw、pitch，做出一隻假手，五根手指和手臂都有。

description.en: It places a plausible hand in space: palm, knuckles, fingers curled by `grab`, thumb and index meeting as `pinch` goes to 1, wrist and elbow. [`LeapInput.simulate()`](#LeapInput) builds its hands from the mouse with it, and [`mockFrame()`](#mockFrame) with the animated ones. Use it to put a hand exactly where a test needs it.
description.zh: 它在空間裡放一隻合理的手：掌心、指節、隨 `grab` 彎起來的手指、`pinch` 到 1 時碰在一起的拇指和食指、手腕和手肘。[`LeapInput.simulate()`](#LeapInput) 用它把滑鼠變成手，[`mockFrame()`](#mockFrame) 用它做出會動的手。需要把手剛好放在某個位置來測試時，就用它。

params.name: id
params.en: The hand's id.
params.zh: 這隻手的 id。

params.name: side
params.en: `'R'` for a right hand, `'L'` for a left.
params.zh: 右手用 `'R'`，左手用 `'L'`。

params.name: palm
params.en: The palm position `[x, y, z]` in millimetres (+x right, +y up, +z toward the player).
params.zh: 掌心位置 `[x, y, z]`，單位是公釐（+x 向右、+y 向上、+z 朝向玩家）。

params.name: pinch
params.en: Thumb to index, 0..1. At 1 the two fingertips meet.
params.zh: 拇指到食指，0..1。到 1 的時候兩個指尖碰在一起。

params.name: grab
params.en: How closed the fist is, 0..1.
params.zh: 拳頭握得多緊，0..1。

params.name: roll
params.en: Radians; positive rolls toward the thumb side.
params.zh: 弧度，正值是往拇指那一側翻。

params.name: yaw
params.en: Radians; positive turns the fingers toward +x.
params.zh: 弧度，正值是讓手指轉向 +x。

params.name: pitch
params.en: Radians; positive tips the fingers up.
params.zh: 弧度，正值是讓手指往上翹。

params.name: vel
params.en: Palm velocity in millimetres per second.
params.zh: 掌心速度，單位是公釐每秒。

params.name: conf
params.en: Tracking confidence, 0..1.
params.zh: 追蹤的信心程度，0..1。

params.name: width
params.en: Palm width in millimetres.
params.zh: 手掌寬度，單位是公釐。

returns.en: A hand in the raw line format: `{ id, side, conf, pinch, grab, palm, vel, n, dir, w, f, ext, arm }`, where `f` is 5 fingers × 5 joints (thumb to pinky; the last joint of each is the tip). Wrap hands in `{ t: 'f', id, fps, hands: [...] }` to make a frame.
returns.zh: 原始行格式的手：`{ id, side, conf, pinch, grab, palm, vel, n, dir, w, f, ext, arm }`，其中 `f` 是 5 根手指 × 5 個關節（從拇指到小指，每根的最後一個關節是指尖）。把手包進 `{ t: 'f', id, fps, hands: [...] }` 就成了一個影格。

caption.en: The console measures the distance between the thumb tip and the index tip: `100 mm` for the open hand and `0 mm` when pinched.
caption.zh: 主控台量出拇指指尖和食指指尖的距離：手張開時是 `100 mm`，捏合時是 `0 mm`。

entries.name: mountLeapPanel
entries.signature: mountLeapPanel(el, leap, { width = 300, simulate = true, simTarget } = {})

summary.en: Mounts a small panel that shows whether the Leap is alive (bridge, service, device, hands) and draws what it sees, with a button to simulate hands.
summary.zh: 掛上一個小面板，顯示 Leap 有沒有活著（橋接、服務、裝置、手）並畫出它看到的東西，還有一個模擬手的按鈕。

description.en: One status line says which link is the broken one, in order: no bridge, bridge but no tracking service, service but no device, tracking (with the number of hands and the frame rate). Under it, a small front view draws the interaction box (a hand outside it is visibly outside, its signals sitting clamped at the edge) and the hand skeletons. It redraws only on frames and status changes, so nothing runs while the sensor is idle.
description.zh: 一行狀態列會告訴你是哪一段連線壞了，依序是：沒有橋接、有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、有服務但沒有裝置、追蹤中（附上手的數量和影格率）。下面是個小小的正視圖，畫出互動範圍盒（手在盒子外面一眼就看得出來，它的訊號會被夾在邊緣）和手的骨架。它只在有影格或狀態改變時重畫，感測器閒置時什麼都不會跑。

description.en: In a show you do not call it: the console's **L1 · Input** panel mounts it when you declare `modules: { leap: true }`.
description.zh: 在演出裡不用自己呼叫：宣告 `modules: { leap: true }` 之後，主控台的 **L1 · Input** 面板會掛上它。

params.name: el
params.en: Where to put the panel.
params.zh: 面板要放在哪個元素裡。

params.name: leap
params.en: The [`LeapInput`](#LeapInput) to show.
params.zh: 要顯示的 [`LeapInput`](#LeapInput)。

params.name: width
params.en: The width of the drawing in CSS pixels; the height follows (about 0.62 of the width).
params.zh: 繪圖區的寬度（CSS 像素），高度跟著決定（約為寬度的 0.62 倍）。

params.name: simulate
params.en: Show the "simulate" button (mouse and touch become hands).
params.zh: 要不要顯示「simulate」按鈕（滑鼠和觸控變成手）。

params.name: simTarget
params.en: What the simulator listens on. Defaults to `leap.simTarget`, then the window.
params.zh: 模擬器監聽哪個目標。預設是 `leap.simTarget`，再不然是 window。

returns.en: `{ el, render(), destroy() }`: the panel's root element, a function that redraws it, and one that removes it and unsubscribes.
returns.zh: `{ el, render(), destroy() }`：面板的根元素、重畫它的函式，以及移除它並取消訂閱的函式。

caption.en: A panel appears in the page: a green dot, the status line `tracking · 2 hands · 60 fps · R:pinch` (the right hand is pinching), a "simulate" button, and the two mock hands drawn in a small box.
caption.zh: 頁面上出現一個面板：綠色圓點、狀態列 `tracking · 2 hands · 60 fps · R:pinch`（右手正在捏合）、一個「simulate」按鈕，以及畫在小方框裡的兩隻假手。

summary.en: Maps a point in millimetres to 0..1 inside the interaction box, clamped by default: the same normalisation the `leap/*` signals use.
summary.zh: 把一個以公釐計的點，換算成互動範圍盒裡的 0..1，預設會夾住：`leap/*` 訊號用的就是這個正規化。

description.en: The classic box is centred 200 mm above the sensor and about 235 × 235 × 148 mm ([`INTERACTION_BOX`](#INTERACTION_BOX)). A palm at the centre reads `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5]`; a palm far outside it reads 0 or 1 on that axis, which is why the signals "sit clamped at the edge" when a hand leaves the box. Pass `clamp = false` when you want to know how far outside it is.
description.zh: 經典的盒子中心在感測器上方 200 公釐，大小約 235 × 235 × 148 公釐（[`INTERACTION_BOX`](#INTERACTION_BOX)）。掌心在中心讀到 `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5]`，掌心遠在盒子外面，那個軸就讀到 0 或 1，這就是手離開盒子時訊號會「夾在邊緣」的原因。想知道超出多遠，就傳 `clamp = false`。

params.name: p
params.en: The point `[x, y, z]` in millimetres.
params.zh: 點 `[x, y, z]`，單位是公釐。

params.name: box
params.en: The box `{ center, size }` in millimetres.
params.zh: 範圍盒 `{ center, size }`，單位是公釐。

params.name: clamp
params.en: Hold each value to 0..1. `false` lets a point outside the box go beyond.
params.zh: 把每個值限制在 0..1。`false` 的話，盒子外面的點可以超出範圍。

returns.en: `[x, y, z]`, each `(p − center) / size + 0.5`: 0.5 is the centre of the box, x grows to the right, y upward, z toward the player.
returns.zh: `[x, y, z]`，每個都是 `(p − center) / size + 0.5`：0.5 是盒子的中心，x 往右增加、y 往上增加、z 朝向玩家。

examples.code:
import { normalizePoint } from '@openav/leap';

console.log(normalizePoint([0, 200, 0]));                          // [ 0.5, 0.5, 0.5 ]: the centre
console.log(normalizePoint([500, 0, -500]));                       // [ 1, 0, 0 ]: far outside, clamped
console.log(normalizePoint([100, 320, 0]).map((v) => +v.toFixed(2)));   // [ 0.93, 1, 0.5 ]

summary.en: An advanced helper: the orthonormal basis `[x, y, z]` of the palm, from its direction and normal, in the rows LeapJS reads as `hand.r`.
summary.zh: 進階用的輔助函式：由手的方向和法線算出掌心的正交基底 `[x, y, z]`，列的排法就是 LeapJS 當作 `hand.r` 來讀的那種。

description.en: Like [`boneBasis()`](#boneBasis), it exists so that the LeapJS frames [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter) writes have a `r` that `hand.rotationAngle()` can use. Worlds that draw hands read `leap.hands` and [`handAngles()`](#handAngles) instead.
description.zh: 和 [`boneBasis()`](#boneBasis) 一樣，它的存在是為了讓 [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter) 寫出的 LeapJS 影格有 `hand.rotationAngle()` 能用的 `r`。要畫手的世界讀的是 `leap.hands` 和 [`handAngles()`](#handAngles)。

params.name: direction
params.en: The direction the fingers point.
params.zh: 手指指的方向。

params.name: normal
params.en: The palm normal.
params.zh: 掌心法線。

params.name: left
params.en: `true` for a left hand: x is negated.
params.zh: 左手傳 `true`：x 會反向。

returns.en: Three rows `[x, y, z]` (x sideways, y the back of the hand, z toward the wrist), rounded to 3 decimals.
returns.zh: 三列 `[x, y, z]`（x 是橫向、y 是手背、z 朝向手腕），四捨五入到小數三位。

examples.code:
import { palmBasis } from '@openav/leap';

console.log(palmBasis([0, 0, -1], [0, -1, 0], false));   // flat hand, palm down, fingers forward: the identity

caption.en: The console prints the identity `[ [ 1, 0, 0 ], [ 0, 1, 0 ], [ 0, 0, 1 ] ]`.

summary.en: The highest LeapJS protocol version we speak: 6. LeapJS 1.1.1 and earlier throw "unrecognized version" above that.
summary.zh: 我們支援的 LeapJS 通訊協定最高版本：6。LeapJS 1.1.1 和更早的版本遇到更高的版本會丟出 "unrecognized version"。

description.en: [`v6Header()`](#v6Header) never reports more than this, and the bridge answers `/v7.json` as version 6. It is the default of the `version` argument there.
description.zh: [`v6Header()`](#v6Header) 不會回報比這更高的版本，橋接程式也把 `/v7.json` 當成版本 6 回應。它是那裡 `version` 參數的預設值。

summary.en: Which protocol version a `/vN.json` path asks for, as a number, or `null` when the path is not one.
summary.zh: `/vN.json` 這種路徑要求的是哪個通訊協定版本，回傳數字，路徑不是這種格式就回傳 `null`。

description.en: The bridge uses it to decide whether a WebSocket upgrade is a LeapJS client at all: `/v6.json` yes, `/raw` is handled separately, anything else is refused with a 404.
description.zh: 橋接程式用它判斷一個 WebSocket 升級請求是不是 LeapJS 的用戶端：`/v6.json` 是，`/raw` 另外處理，其他的一律回 404 拒絕。

params.name: pathname
params.en: The URL path, such as `'/v6.json'`.
params.zh: 網址的路徑，例如 `'/v6.json'`。

returns.en: The number in `/v<number>.json`, or `null`. It does not clip to 6: `/v7.json` gives 7 (the bridge then answers it as version 6).
returns.zh: `/v<數字>.json` 裡的數字，或 `null`。它不會截到 6：`/v7.json` 得到 7（橋接程式再以版本 6 回應）。

caption.en: The console prints `6 3 7`, then `null null null`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `6 3 7`，然後是 `null null null`。

summary.en: One-off conversion of a raw frame to a LeapJS v6 frame, with a fresh converter each time (no history, so no velocities).
summary.zh: 把一個原始影格一次轉成 LeapJS v6 影格，每次都用全新的轉換器（沒有歷史，所以沒有速度）。

description.en: Handy for tests and for looking at what a legacy sketch would receive. For a stream, keep one [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter) instead, so that `timeVisible` and `tipVelocity` can accumulate.
description.zh: 用在測試，以及查看舊版草圖會收到什麼的時候很方便。處理一條串流的話，請改為保留一個 [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter)，`timeVisible` 和 `tipVelocity` 才能累積。

params.name: raw
params.en: A raw frame `{ t: 'f', id, fps, hands }`.
params.zh: 原始影格 `{ t: 'f', id, fps, hands }`。

params.name: tUs
params.en: The time in microseconds. Defaults to now.
params.zh: 時間，單位是微秒。預設是現在。

params.name: opts
params.en: Options for the [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter): `{ box, smoothing }`.
params.zh: 給 [`V6Converter`](#V6Converter) 的選項：`{ box, smoothing }`。

returns.en: The v6 frame. Every field the LeapJS `Frame`, `Hand`, `Pointable`, `Finger` and `Bone` constructors read is there.
returns.zh: v6 影格。LeapJS 的 `Frame`、`Hand`、`Pointable`、`Finger` 和 `Bone` 建構函式會讀的每個欄位都有。

caption.en: The console prints the frame's keys (`id timestamp currentFrameRate hands pointables interactionBox gestures r s t`), then `2 10 right 1`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出影格的欄位（`id timestamp currentFrameRate hands pointables interactionBox gestures r s t`），然後是 `2 10 right 1`。

summary.en: The ports the Leap bridge refuses to use: `[7457]`, which belongs to The Last Input and the backstage monitor.
summary.zh: Leap 橋接程式拒絕使用的連接埠：`[7457]`，那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的。

description.en: `startBridge({ port: 7457 })` throws "port 7457 belongs to The Last Input" immediately, so the bridge can never take the port the monitor listens on (`node packages/monitor/server.js`). The out-bridge refuses the same one.
description.zh: `startBridge({ port: 7457 })` 會立刻丟出 "port 7457 belongs to The Last Input"，所以橋接程式絕不會占走後台監看監聽的連接埠（`node packages/monitor/server.js`）。輸出橋接也一樣拒絕這一個。

entries.name: startBridge
entries.signature: startBridge({ port = DEFAULT_PORT, host = '127.0.0.1', mock = false, hz = 60, bin = null, log = () => {} } = {})

summary.en: Starts the Leap bridge on this machine: a loopback WebSocket and HTTP server that serves the sensor's hands to every page (Node only).
summary.zh: 在這台機器上啟動 Leap 橋接程式：一個只綁 loopback 的 WebSocket 與 HTTP 伺服器，把感測器的手送給每一個頁面（只能在 Node 執行）。

description.en: This is what `node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs` runs (add `--mock` for made-up hands, `--port`, `--hz`, `--bin`, `--quiet`). It serves `ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json` (the LeapJS protocol, which every 2014 to 2021 browser sketch speaks), `ws://…/raw` (the raw lines), the same lines as server-sent events on `GET /raw` and `/hands`, and `GET /health` (source, service, device, fps, hands, clients). Any page origin may read it, as the original Leap service allowed.
description.zh: `node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs` 執行的就是它（加 `--mock` 得到假手，另有 `--port`、`--hz`、`--bin`、`--quiet`）。它提供 `ws://127.0.0.1:6437/v6.json`（LeapJS 通訊協定，2014 到 2021 年所有的瀏覽器草圖講的都是它）、`ws://…/raw`（原始行）、`GET /raw` 和 `/hands` 上以 server-sent events 送的同樣內容，以及 `GET /health`（來源、服務、裝置、fps、手、用戶端）。任何頁面來源都可以讀取，跟原本的 Leap 服務一樣。

description.en: Call it from your own Node program when you want the bridge inside it, for example in a test. `startBridge()` throws at once for port 7457 (it belongs to The Last Input and the monitor) and for a non-loopback `host`; a port already in use rejects the returned promise with a message that suggests `curl http://127.0.0.1:6437/health`.
description.zh: 想把橋接程式放進你自己的 Node 程式裡（例如測試）時，就自己呼叫它。連接埠是 7457（那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的）或 `host` 不是 loopback，`startBridge()` 會立刻丟出錯誤。連接埠已被占用，回傳的 promise 會被拒絕，訊息會建議你執行 `curl http://127.0.0.1:6437/health`。

params.name: port
params.en: The port to listen on, [`DEFAULT_PORT`](#leap-DEFAULT_PORT) unless you say otherwise. 0 picks any free one. The ports in [`RESERVED_PORTS`](#leap-RESERVED_PORTS) (7457) are refused.
params.zh: 要監聽的連接埠，沒特別指定就是 [`DEFAULT_PORT`](#leap-DEFAULT_PORT)。0 表示隨便挑一個空的。[`RESERVED_PORTS`](#leap-RESERVED_PORTS) 裡的連接埠（7457）會被拒絕。

params.name: host
params.en: The address to bind. Only loopback (`127.0.0.1`, `::1`, `localhost`) is allowed: hand data never leaves the machine.
params.zh: 要綁定的位址。只允許 loopback（`127.0.0.1`、`::1`、`localhost`）：手的資料絕不會離開這台機器。

params.name: mock
params.en: `true` serves two animated made-up hands ([`mockFrame()`](#mockFrame)) instead of reading a sensor.
params.zh: `true` 的話，送出兩隻會動的假手（[`mockFrame()`](#mockFrame)），不讀感測器。

params.name: hz
params.en: The most frames per second sent to each client (held to 1..120). A slow client skips frames; it never queues them.
params.zh: 每個用戶端每秒最多收到幾個影格（限制在 1..120）。慢的用戶端會跳過影格，不會排隊。

params.name: bin
params.en: The path to the `leap-stream` reader program. By default the bridge compiles its C reader on first start (needs the Xcode command line tools) and caches it.
params.zh: `leap-stream` 讀取程式的路徑。預設是橋接程式第一次啟動時編譯它的 C 讀取程式（需要 Xcode 命令列工具）並快取起來。

params.name: log
params.en: Called with a line of text for each event worth knowing (clients coming and going, status changes).
params.zh: 每一件值得知道的事（用戶端進出、狀態改變）都會以一行文字呼叫它。

returns.en: Resolves once listening, with `{ port, state, health(), close() }`: the real port (useful with `port: 0`), the live state, a function returning the `/health` object, and a function that stops everything and returns a Promise.
returns.zh: 開始監聽之後才完成，結果是 `{ port, state, health(), close() }`：實際的連接埠（`port: 0` 時有用）、即時狀態、回傳 `/health` 物件的函式，以及停止一切並回傳 Promise 的函式。

needs.en: Node 22 or later, and for real hands the Ultraleap Hand Tracking service plus Xcode's `clang` to build the reader on first start. With `mock: true` neither is needed.
needs.zh: Node 22 以上，要接真的手，還需要 Ultraleap Hand Tracking 服務，以及第一次啟動時用來編譯讀取程式的 Xcode `clang`。`mock: true` 的話兩者都不需要。

caption.en: In Node: the first message is the handshake, `handshake: { serviceVersion: 'mock', version: 6, bridge: 'open-audiovisual' }`, then a frame arrives and the program prints `hands in the frame: 2` and stops the bridge.
caption.zh: 在 Node 裡：第一則訊息是交握 `handshake: { serviceVersion: 'mock', version: 6, bridge: 'open-audiovisual' }`，接著收到一個影格，程式印出 `hands in the frame: 2`，並把橋接程式停掉。

summary.en: The four levels of the `leap/status` signal by name: `off` 0, `bridge` 1, `service` 2, `tracking` 3.
summary.zh: `leap/status` 訊號的四個等級，用名字表示：`off` 0、`bridge` 1、`service` 2、`tracking` 3。

description.en: A frozen object `{ off: 0, bridge: 1, service: 2, tracking: 3 }`: 0 no bridge, 1 the bridge is there but the tracking service is not, 2 the service is there but no device, 3 tracking. Use it to read the signal without magic numbers: `signals.get('leap/status') === STATUS.tracking`. Note it is the **number** published as `leap/status`; `leap.status` is a different thing, a string (`'tracking'`, `'no-device'` …), and the simulator counts as 3.
description.zh: 一個凍結的物件 `{ off: 0, bridge: 1, service: 2, tracking: 3 }`：0 沒有橋接、1 有橋接但追蹤服務沒開、2 有服務但沒有裝置、3 追蹤中。讀訊號時可以不用神祕數字：`signals.get('leap/status') === STATUS.tracking`。注意，發布成 `leap/status` 的是這個**數字**。`leap.status` 是另一回事，它是字串（`'tracking'`、`'no-device'` ……），而模擬器算 3。

notes.en: The code in `LeapInput` writes the numbers itself and does not read this object, so `STATUS` is a convenience for your own code. The strings map as: `tracking` and `simulated` to 3, `no-device` to 2, `bridge` and `no-service` to 1, the rest to 0.
notes.zh: `LeapInput` 裡的程式是自己寫入數字，並不讀這個物件，所以 `STATUS` 只是方便你自己的程式用。字串的對應是：`tracking` 和 `simulated` 是 3，`no-device` 是 2，`bridge` 和 `no-service` 是 1，其餘是 0。

summary.en: The default hysteresis levels for the gestures: pinch 0.86 / 0.5, both-hands pinch 0.8 / 0.5, grab 0.8 / 0.5 (start above `on`, end below `off`).
summary.zh: 手勢預設的遲滯門檻：捏合 0.86 / 0.5、雙手捏合 0.8 / 0.5、握拳 0.8 / 0.5（高於 `on` 開始，低於 `off` 結束）。

description.en: A frozen object `{ pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }`. The numbers come from The Last Input, tuned on a Leap Motion Controller 2, so one bridge means one feel. Change them per input with `new LeapInput({ thresholds: { pinch: { on: 0.9, off: 0.6 } } })` or `new HandGestures(...)`; you cannot change this object itself.
description.zh: 一個凍結的物件 `{ pinch: { on, off }, bothPinch: { on, off }, grab: { on, off } }`。數字來自 The Last Input，在 Leap Motion Controller 2 上調過，這樣一個橋接程式就是一種手感。要改的話，在每個輸入上設定：`new LeapInput({ thresholds: { pinch: { on: 0.9, off: 0.6 } } })` 或 `new HandGestures(...)`，這個物件本身改不了。

summary.en: Converts raw hand lines into LeapJS v6 frames, keeping the little state the protocol needs: time visible, smoothed positions and fingertip velocities.
summary.zh: 把原始的手資料行轉成 LeapJS v6 影格，並保存通訊協定需要的少量狀態：可見時間、平滑過的位置和指尖速度。

description.en: Every browser sketch written for the old Leap service (LeapJS, 2014 to 2021) speaks the v6 protocol, so the bridge serves it on `/v6.json`. This class does the conversion: one converter per stream. It is stateful where the protocol is: a hand's `timeVisible` grows while it stays in view and starts over when it leaves, `stabilized…` positions are a light low-pass, and `tipVelocity` is a finite difference between two frames.
description.zh: 所有為舊版 Leap 服務寫的瀏覽器草圖（LeapJS，2014 到 2021 年）講的都是 v6 通訊協定，所以橋接程式在 `/v6.json` 提供這個格式。這個類別負責轉換：一條串流用一個轉換器。它在通訊協定要求有狀態的地方才有狀態：手在畫面裡時 `timeVisible` 會增加，離開再回來就重新開始，`stabilized…` 位置是輕微的低通濾波，`tipVelocity` 是兩個影格之間的差分。

description.en: LeapC gives joints, not bone rotations, so the bone bases are rebuilt from the joints and the palm normal ([`boneBasis()`](#boneBasis)). Gestures are not synthesised: `gestures` is always `[]`.
description.zh: LeapC 給的是關節，不是骨頭的旋轉，所以骨頭的基底是從關節和掌心法線重建的（[`boneBasis()`](#boneBasis)）。手勢不會被合成：`gestures` 永遠是 `[]`。

params.name: box
params.en: The interaction box written into every frame's `interactionBox`.
params.zh: 寫進每個影格 `interactionBox` 的互動範圍盒。

params.name: smoothing
params.en: 0..1: how strongly `stabilizedPalmPosition` and `stabilizedTipPosition` lag behind (0 follows exactly, close to 1 barely moves).
params.zh: 0..1：`stabilizedPalmPosition` 和 `stabilizedTipPosition` 落後的程度（0 完全跟隨，接近 1 幾乎不動）。

caption.en: The console prints `0.1`, then `10` pointables and the index fingertip's velocity `[ -21, 17, 28 ]` (millimetres per second between the two frames).
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `0.1`，接著是 `10` 個 pointable，以及食指指尖的速度 `[ -21, 17, 28 ]`（兩個影格之間，每秒幾公釐）。

summary.en: The first message of a LeapJS v6 connection: `{ serviceVersion, version }`, with `version` held to 1..6 because LeapJS throws above 6.
summary.zh: LeapJS v6 連線的第一則訊息：`{ serviceVersion, version }`，`version` 被限制在 1..6，因為 LeapJS 超過 6 會丟出錯誤。

description.en: The bridge sends this (plus `bridge: 'open-audiovisual'`) as soon as a client connects to `/v6.json`, and [`LeapInput`](#LeapInput) turns it into the status `'bridge'`. Ask for 7 and you get 6.
description.zh: 用戶端一連到 `/v6.json`，橋接程式就會送出這則訊息（外加 `bridge: 'open-audiovisual'`），[`LeapInput`](#LeapInput) 收到後會把狀態變成 `'bridge'`。要求 7 會得到 6。

params.name: serviceVersion
params.en: The tracking service version to report, such as `'5.20.0'`.
params.zh: 要回報的追蹤服務版本，例如 `'5.20.0'`。

params.name: version
params.en: The protocol version the client asked for. Held to 1..6.
params.zh: 用戶端要求的通訊協定版本。限制在 1..6。

returns.en: `{ serviceVersion: String, version: Number }`.
returns.zh: 物件 `{ serviceVersion: String, version: Number }`。

caption.en: The console prints the header for version 6, version 3, and `6` for a request of 9.
caption.zh: 主控台印出版本 6 的標頭、版本 3 的標頭，以及要求 9 時得到的 `6`。

entries.name: HandTracker
entries.signature: new HandTracker({ signals = null, mirror = true } = {})

summary.en: Tracks up to two hands from the camera with 21 landmarks each and publishes palm position and thumb-to-finger pinch distances as `hand/*` signals.
summary.zh: 用鏡頭追蹤最多兩隻手，每隻 21 個關節點，把掌心位置和拇指到手指的捏合距離發布成 `hand/*` 訊號。

description.en: The **fine-control** tracker: each hand gives two precise continuous controllers, thumb to index and thumb to middle finger, so two hands are four controllers you can pinch. The distances are normalised by the size of your palm (wrist to the base of the middle finger), so moving toward or away from the camera does not change a pinch: stage-robust. It runs on the device with MediaPipe Tasks Vision and downloads nothing until `enable()`. In a show, `createShow({ modules: { hands: true } })` builds one (`show.hands`) and the L1 panel gets a 🖐 hands button.
description.zh: **精細控制**的追蹤器：每隻手提供兩個精確的連續控制，拇指到食指、拇指到中指，所以兩隻手就是四個可以捏的控制。距離會依你的手掌大小（手腕到中指根部）正規化，所以靠近或遠離鏡頭不會改變捏合的值，在舞台上很穩。它在裝置上用 MediaPipe Tasks Vision 執行，在 `enable()` 之前不會下載任何東西。在演出裡，`createShow({ modules: { hands: true } })` 會建好一個（`show.hands`），L1 面板會多出一個 🖐 hands 按鈕。

description.en: For each of `left` and `right` it publishes `hand/<side>/present` (0 or 1), `hand/<side>/x` and `/y` (the palm, 0..1; y flipped so 1 is raised), `hand/<side>/pinch/index` and `hand/<side>/pinch/middle` (0..1, **0 = touching**, 1 = wide open) and `hand/<side>/spread` (index fingertip to little fingertip, 0..1). A side with no hand in view gets `present` 0 and keeps its other values. Note that these names do not start with `pose/`, and are different from the body tracker's.
description.zh: `left` 和 `right` 各自會發布 `hand/<side>/present`（0 或 1）、`hand/<side>/x` 和 `/y`（掌心，0..1，y 翻轉過，所以 1 是舉高）、`hand/<side>/pinch/index` 和 `hand/<side>/pinch/middle`（0..1，**0 = 碰在一起**，1 = 張得最開），以及 `hand/<side>/spread`（食指指尖到小指指尖，0..1）。畫面裡沒有手的那一邊，`present` 會是 0，其他的值維持不變。請注意，這些名稱不是 `pose/` 開頭，跟身體追蹤器的不一樣。

description.en: A pinch is a distance, so for "pinch closes" use a route with `invert`: `{ source: 'hand/right/pinch/index', target: 'tightness', invert: true, smooth: 0.1 }`. If you want pinch start and end as events, [`LeapInput`](#LeapInput)'s gestures do that; `HandTracker` only gives the continuous distances.
description.zh: 捏合是一個距離，所以想要「捏緊的時候變大」，就在路由裡用 `invert`：`{ source: 'hand/right/pinch/index', target: 'tightness', invert: true, smooth: 0.1 }`。如果你要把捏合的開始和結束當成事件，[`LeapInput`](#LeapInput) 的手勢就是做這個的。`HandTracker` 只提供連續的距離。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) registry to publish into. Without one the tracker still runs and keeps `hands`, but publishes nothing.
params.zh: 要發布進去的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表。沒有的話，追蹤器照樣會跑、也會更新 `hands`，只是不發布任何訊號。

params.name: mirror
params.en: Treat the camera as a mirror: x is flipped, and the left and right labels MediaPipe gives are swapped so the signals match the body.
params.zh: 把鏡頭當成鏡子：x 會左右翻轉，MediaPipe 給的左手、右手標籤也會對調，讓訊號跟身體對得上。

needs.en: Call `await hands.enable()`: it loads the MediaPipe library from jsDelivr and the hand model from Google's model storage (so it needs the network), asks for the camera (`https` or `localhost`, and the user must allow it) and starts the loop. Until then the signals sit at their starting values.
needs.zh: 要呼叫 `await hands.enable()`：它會從 jsDelivr 載入 MediaPipe 函式庫、從 Google 的模型儲存空間載入手的模型（所以需要網路）、向瀏覽器要鏡頭（`https` 或 `localhost`，使用者也要允許），然後啟動迴圈。在那之前，訊號都停在起始值。

notes.en: Fields to read: `hands` (`[{ handed: 'left' | 'right', lm }]`, `lm` the 21 landmarks `{ x, y, z }` in the camera image, y downward and not mirrored), `running`, `mirror`, `video`.
notes.zh: 可以讀的欄位：`hands`（`[{ handed: 'left' | 'right', lm }]`，`lm` 是 21 個關節點 `{ x, y, z }`，在鏡頭影像裡，y 向下、沒有左右翻轉）、`running`、`mirror`、`video`。

notes.en: Landmark indexes used: wrist 0, thumb tip 4, index tip 8, middle tip 12, little finger tip 20, base of the middle finger 9 (the palm position and the size reference).
notes.zh: 用到的關節點編號：手腕 0、拇指指尖 4、食指指尖 8、中指指尖 12、小指指尖 20、中指根部 9（掌心位置，也是計算大小的參考）。

caption.en: Click the page and allow the camera; hold a hand up and pinch thumb to index finger: the console prints `right hand pinches thumb and index` while they touch.
caption.zh: 點一下頁面並允許鏡頭，舉起一隻手、拇指碰食指：兩指相碰的時候，主控台印出 `right hand pinches thumb and index`。

caption.en: An open right hand is drawn in yellow on the canvas from made-up landmarks, with bigger dots at the thumb, index and middle fingertips: the overlay `skeleton()` gives you over the camera picture.
caption.zh: 用編造的關節點在畫布上用黃色畫出一隻張開的右手，拇指、食指、中指的指尖是比較大的圓點：這就是 `skeleton()` 疊在鏡頭畫面上的骨架。

tbd.en: Not tried here with a live camera, so the real range of the pinch values (for example how close to 0 a firm pinch gets) is not measured.
tbd.zh: 這裡沒有用真正的鏡頭試過，所以捏合值實際的範圍（例如用力捏的時候能多接近 0）沒有量過。

members.name: skeleton
members.signature: ctx, w, h, { colorLeft = 'rgba(55,201,120,0.9)', colorRight = 'rgba(255,209,102,0.9)', lineWidth = 2 } = {}
members.doc: Draw hand skeletons onto a 2D context (overlay).

entries.name: PoseTracker
entries.signature: new PoseTracker({ signals = null, mirror = true } = {})

summary.en: Tracks one body from the camera and publishes wrist positions, wrist speed, hand spread, height and lean as `pose/*` signals.
summary.zh: 用鏡頭追蹤一個人的身體，把手腕的位置、手腕速度、雙手距離、身高位置和傾斜，發布成 `pose/*` 訊號。

description.en: This is the **body** tracker: one person, 33 landmarks (the BlazePose set), run by MediaPipe Tasks Vision on the device. No video leaves the machine, and nothing is downloaded until you call `enable()`. For fine finger control use [`HandTracker`](#HandTracker) instead. In a show, `createShow({ modules: { pose: true } })` builds one and the console's L1 panel gets a 🕺 body button that calls `enable()`; it is `show.pose`.
description.zh: 這是**身體**追蹤器：一個人、33 個關節點（BlazePose 那一套），在裝置上由 MediaPipe Tasks Vision 執行。影像不會離開這台機器，在你呼叫 `enable()` 之前也不會下載任何東西。要精細控制手指的話，改用 [`HandTracker`](#HandTracker)。在演出裡，`createShow({ modules: { pose: true } })` 會建好一個，主控台的 L1 面板會多出一個 🕺 body 按鈕來呼叫 `enable()`，它就是 `show.pose`。

description.en: Signals, all normalised, with y **flipped** so that 1 means raised and 0 means the bottom of the frame (performance meaning beats pixel meaning): `pose/present` (0 or 1: someone is visible), `pose/hand/left/x` and `/y`, `pose/hand/right/x` and `/y` (wrist positions, 0..1), `pose/hand/left/v` and `pose/hand/right/v` (wrist speed, 0..1, clamped), `pose/hands/spread` (distance between the wrists, 0..1), `pose/height` (nose height, 0..1: crouching to standing) and `pose/lean` (shoulder-line tilt, −1..1). When nobody is in view only `pose/present` goes to 0; the others keep their last values.
description.zh: 訊號全都是正規化的，y **翻轉**過，所以 1 是舉高、0 是畫面底部（演出的意義比像素的意義重要）：`pose/present`（0 或 1：看得到人）、`pose/hand/left/x` 和 `/y`、`pose/hand/right/x` 和 `/y`（手腕位置，0..1）、`pose/hand/left/v` 和 `pose/hand/right/v`（手腕速度，0..1，超過會被夾住）、`pose/hands/spread`（兩個手腕的距離，0..1）、`pose/height`（鼻子的高度，0..1：蹲下到站直）和 `pose/lean`（肩線的傾斜，−1..1）。畫面裡沒人的時候，只有 `pose/present` 會變成 0，其他的維持最後的值。

description.en: Map these to params (`{ source: 'pose/hand/right/y', target: 'energy', smooth: 0.1 }`) so a raised hand does what a knob would. The detection runs on every animation frame while `running`.
description.zh: 把它們映射到參數（`{ source: 'pose/hand/right/y', target: 'energy', smooth: 0.1 }`），舉起的手就能做旋鈕做的事。偵測在 `running` 期間每個動畫畫面都會跑。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) registry to publish into. Without one the tracker still runs and keeps `landmarks`, but publishes nothing.
params.zh: 要發布進去的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表。沒有的話，追蹤器照樣會跑、也會更新 `landmarks`，只是不發布任何訊號。

params.name: mirror
params.en: Treat the camera as a mirror: x is flipped, so moving toward the viewer's right makes x grow. Natural for performers. `false` keeps the camera's own left and right.
params.zh: 把鏡頭當成鏡子：x 會左右翻轉，所以往觀看者的右邊移動，x 就變大。對表演者很自然。`false` 則保留鏡頭本身的左右。

needs.en: Call `await pose.enable()`: it loads the MediaPipe library from jsDelivr and the model from Google's model storage (so it needs the network), asks the browser for the camera (the page needs `https` or `localhost`, and the user must allow it), and starts the loop. Until then every signal sits at its starting value.
needs.zh: 要呼叫 `await pose.enable()`：它會從 jsDelivr 載入 MediaPipe 函式庫、從 Google 的模型儲存空間載入模型（所以需要網路）、向瀏覽器要鏡頭（網頁要在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下，使用者也要允許），然後啟動迴圈。在那之前，所有訊號都停在起始值。

notes.en: Fields to read: `landmarks` (the latest 33 raw points `{ x, y, z, visibility }`, x and y 0..1 in the camera image, y downward and not mirrored; `null` when nobody is seen), `running`, `mirror`, `video`.
notes.zh: 可以讀的欄位：`landmarks`（最新的 33 個原始點 `{ x, y, z, visibility }`，x、y 是鏡頭影像裡的 0..1，y 向下、沒有左右翻轉，看不到人就是 `null`）、`running`、`mirror`、`video`。

notes.en: Landmark indexes (BlazePose): nose 0, shoulders 11 and 12, wrists 15 and 16, hips 23 and 24.
notes.zh: 關節點編號（BlazePose）：鼻子 0、肩膀 11 和 12、手腕 15 和 16、髖部 23 和 24。

notes.en: The model is MediaPipe's "lite" pose landmarker on the GPU, one pose at a time. If two people are in view, only one is tracked.
notes.zh: 模型是 MediaPipe 的「lite」姿態偵測器，跑在 GPU 上，一次只追蹤一個姿態。畫面裡有兩個人的話，只會追蹤其中一個。

caption.en: Click the page and allow the camera: the console prints `tracking`, then every half second the height of the right wrist (1 = raised) and whether someone is in view.
caption.zh: 點一下頁面並允許鏡頭：主控台印出 `tracking`，然後每半秒印出右手腕的高度（1 = 舉高），以及畫面裡有沒有人。

caption.en: A stick figure with one arm raised is drawn on the canvas from made-up landmarks: the overlay `skeleton()` draws over the camera picture, without needing a camera.
caption.zh: 用編造的關節點在畫布上畫出一個舉著一隻手的火柴人：這就是 `skeleton()` 疊在鏡頭畫面上的骨架，不需要鏡頭。

caption.en: Click to start the camera, then raise your right hand: the bar at the bottom of the canvas grows with it, because the pose signal is mapped to a param.
caption.zh: 點一下啟動鏡頭，然後舉起右手：畫布底下的長條會跟著變長，因為姿態訊號被映射到一個參數。

tbd.en: Not tried here with a live camera. In particular, which person's hand `pose/hand/left/*` follows in practice was not checked: the code takes landmark 16 for `left` and landmark 15 for `right` when `mirror` is true (the other way round when false), and the package docs say `left` is the viewer's left.
tbd.zh: 這裡沒有用真正的鏡頭試過。尤其是 `pose/hand/left/*` 實際上跟著誰的手，沒有查證：`mirror` 為 true 的時候，程式用關節點 16 當 `left`、15 當 `right`（false 時相反），套件文件則說 `left` 是觀看者的左邊。

tbd.en: Whether the camera permission prompt needs a click first was not tested; the package README calls `enable()` from a button.
tbd.zh: 鏡頭權限的詢問是否一定要先點一下，沒有測試過。套件的 README 是從按鈕呼叫 `enable()`。

entries.name: ChordDetector
entries.signature: new ChordDetector({ window = 80, onChord = null, signals = null } = {})

summary.en: Groups notes struck close together into one gesture and analyses it: chord type, consonance, triad and cluster flags, published as `chord/*` signals.
summary.zh: 把幾乎同時按下的音歸成一個手勢並分析它：和弦類型、協和度、三和弦與音叢的旗標，發布成 `chord/*` 訊號。

description.en: This is not a music-theory library. It is a **performance semantics** layer: raw notes in, one analysed event per gesture out, with features that are made to drive a work. A single note is a seed, a chord a colony, a consonant chord a flourish, a dissonant one decay; rename them for your own piece. In a show, `createShow({ modules: { chord: true } })` builds one (`{ chord: { window: 120 } }` tunes it) and connects it to `midi/note/on` and `midi/note/off`, so a MIDI keyboard, the on-screen piano and phones all feed it.
description.zh: 它管的是**演出語意**，不是樂理：原始的音進去，每個手勢出來一個分析過的事件，特徵都是為了驅動作品而設計的。單一個音是種子，和弦是一群生物，協和的和弦是繁盛，不協和的和弦是衰敗。你可以替自己的作品換掉這些名字。在演出裡，`createShow({ modules: { chord: true } })` 會建好一個（`{ chord: { window: 120 } }` 可以調整）並接上 `midi/note/on` 和 `midi/note/off`，所以 MIDI 鍵盤、螢幕上的鋼琴和手機都能餵它。

description.en: Each closed gesture publishes `chord/consonance` (−1..1), `chord/count` (0..10), `chord/root` (the lowest note) and the pulse `chord/event`, whose payload is the whole analysis: `{ notes, count, root, vel, pcs, consonance, isConsonant, isDissonant, isTriad, thirdsFraction, dissonanceLevel, chordType }`. `chordType` is one of `single`, `major`, `minor`, `sus2`, `sus4`, `dim`, `aug`, `maj7`, `min7`, `dom7`, `halfdim7`, `maj9`, `min9`, `dom9`, `six`, `min6`, `cluster` (a very dissonant pile) or `chord` (anything else). Inversions resolve to the root-position name.
description.zh: 每個收尾的手勢會發布 `chord/consonance`（−1..1）、`chord/count`（0..10）、`chord/root`（最低音）和脈衝 `chord/event`，脈衝的內容就是整份分析：`{ notes, count, root, vel, pcs, consonance, isConsonant, isDissonant, isTriad, thirdsFraction, dissonanceLevel, chordType }`。`chordType` 是 `single`、`major`、`minor`、`sus2`、`sus4`、`dim`、`aug`、`maj7`、`min7`、`dom7`、`halfdim7`、`maj9`、`min9`、`dom9`、`six`、`min6`、`cluster`（非常不協和的一堆音）或 `chord`（其他任何和弦）之一。轉位會被還原成原位和弦的名稱。

description.en: `consonance` is the average of an interval weight for every pair of notes (an octave or fifth is high, a semitone or tritone is negative). `isConsonant` is `consonance > 0.25` and `isDissonant` is `consonance < −0.15`, both only for two notes or more. `dissonanceLevel` is 0 for none, 1 for **mild** (a storm warning: foreshadow it) and 2 for **severe** (three or more notes that are a true cluster: commit to the decay). `isTriad` is true for `major`, `minor`, `sus2`, `sus4`, `dim` and `aug`, and `thirdsFraction` is the share of neighbouring notes exactly 3 or 4 semitones apart, so "genuinely stacked thirds" can be told from "some consonant notes".
description.zh: `consonance` 是每一對音的音程權重的平均（八度或五度很高，半音或三全音是負的）。`isConsonant` 是 `consonance > 0.25`，`isDissonant` 是 `consonance < −0.15`，都只在兩個音以上才成立。`dissonanceLevel` 0 是沒有，1 是**輕微**（風暴警報：預告它），2 是**嚴重**（三個音以上的真正音叢：直接進入衰敗）。`isTriad` 在 `major`、`minor`、`sus2`、`sus4`、`dim`、`aug` 時為真，`thirdsFraction` 是相鄰兩個音剛好相差 3 或 4 個半音的比例，這樣就分得出「真正疊起來的三度」和「幾個協和的音」。

params.name: window
params.en: How many milliseconds after the **last** `noteOn` the gesture is closed and analysed. Notes struck within this time of each other are one chord.
params.zh: **最後一個** `noteOn` 之後等幾毫秒，就把這個手勢收尾並分析。彼此相隔不到這個時間按下的音，算同一個和弦。

params.name: onChord
params.en: Called with the analysis object each time a gesture is closed.
params.zh: 每次一個手勢收尾，就以分析結果物件呼叫一次。

params.name: signals
params.en: A [`Signals`](#Signals) registry to publish `chord/*` into. The signals are declared when the detector is built.
params.zh: 要把 `chord/*` 發布進去的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表。訊號在建立偵測器時就宣告好了。

needs.en: Feed it with `noteOn(note, vel)` (and `noteOff(note)`), or let `createShow` do it from `midi/note/on|off`. Nothing is published until `window` milliseconds after the last `noteOn`, so the result is asynchronous. `analyze()` is the exception: it is instant and needs no setup.
needs.zh: 用 `noteOn(note, vel)`（和 `noteOff(note)`）餵它，或讓 `createShow` 從 `midi/note/on|off` 餵。要等到最後一個 `noteOn` 之後 `window` 毫秒才會發布，所以結果是非同步的。`analyze()` 是例外：它立刻回傳，也不需要任何前置動作。

notes.en: Pass notes to `analyze()` lowest first: `root` is the first note, and the detector sorts for you but a direct call does not.
notes.zh: 呼叫 `analyze()` 時音要由低到高：`root` 就是第一個音，偵測器會替你排序，但直接呼叫就不會。

notes.en: A major second like `[60, 62]` is typed `cluster` (no template fits and its consonance is below −0.3) even though its `dissonanceLevel` is only 1. Level 2 needs three or more notes.
notes.zh: 像 `[60, 62]` 這樣的大二度，類型會是 `cluster`（沒有範本符合，而且協和度低於 −0.3），不過它的 `dissonanceLevel` 只有 1。要到 2 至少得有三個音。

notes.en: The gesture window does not know about held notes: a note already down when you play two more does not join them.
notes.zh: 手勢窗口不知道還按著的音：已經按著的一個音，不會跟你後來彈的兩個音湊成一個和弦。

caption.en: The console prints `major true 0.75 1` for C-E-G, then `cluster 2 true` for four neighbouring semitones.
caption.zh: 主控台對 C-E-G 印出 `major true 0.75 1`，對四個相鄰半音印出 `cluster 2 true`。

caption.en: Three notes struck together become one event: the console prints `chord/event: major 3 notes`, then `0.75 60` (consonance and root).
caption.zh: 同時按下的三個音變成一個事件：主控台印出 `chord/event: major 3 notes`，然後是 `0.75 60`（協和度和根音）。

caption.en: Inversions resolve to the root-position name: the console prints `major`, `major` (E-G-C is C major again), `dom7`, `dim`, `sus4`, and `chord` for the bare fifth, which matches no template.
caption.zh: 轉位會還原成原位和弦的名稱：主控台印出 `major`、`major`（E-G-C 還是 C 大三和弦）、`dom7`、`dim`、`sus4`，以及空心五度的 `chord`，它不符合任何範本。

members.doc: Feed from MIDI or an on-screen keyboard.
