members.doc: Pure function: MIDI note numbers → analysis.

summary.en: Sends OSC messages from the browser to TouchDesigner, Max, Reaper or a spatialiser, batched once per frame, through a small local bridge.
summary.zh: 把 OSC 訊息從瀏覽器送到 TouchDesigner、Max、Reaper 或空間化軟體，每個畫面打包一批，透過一個本機的小橋接程式。

description.en: A browser cannot send UDP, so `OscOut` posts batches of messages to a ~100-line Node program, `packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js`, which sends them on as OSC packets. Start it with `node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js 7456 192.168.1.50 3456` (HTTP port, target host, UDP port; the defaults are `7456 127.0.0.1 3456`). Then `send(address, args)` as often as you like and `flush()` once per frame: only the **latest message per address** survives a frame, because a position stream does not need its in-between values.
description.zh: 瀏覽器沒辦法送 UDP，所以 `OscOut` 把一批一批的訊息用 POST 送給一支大約一百行的 Node 程式 `packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js`，由它再當成 OSC 封包送出去。用 `node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js 7456 192.168.1.50 3456` 啟動它（HTTP 連接埠、目標主機、UDP 連接埠，預設是 `7456 127.0.0.1 3456`）。然後想送多少次都可以 `send(address, args)`，每個畫面 `flush()` 一次：每個畫面裡，每個位址只有**最後一則訊息**會送出去，因為位置的串流不需要中間的值。

description.en: Numbers go out as OSC floats (what Spat, Reaper and TouchDesigner expect), and anything else as a string. `createShow()` does not create an `OscOut`: make one, call `enable()`, flush it from `onFrame`, and if you like hand it to the worlds as `show.stage.io.osc` and to the Layers panel as `show.app.osc` (which then shows the OSC rate).
description.zh: 數字會當成 OSC 浮點數送出（Spat、Reaper 和 TouchDesigner 期待的格式），其他東西一律當成字串。`createShow()` 不會建立 `OscOut`：你自己建一個、呼叫 `enable()`，在 `onFrame` 裡 flush，想要的話再用 `show.stage.io.osc` 交給世界，用 `show.app.osc` 交給 Layers 面板（面板就會顯示 OSC 的訊息率）。

params.name: url
params.en: The address of the OSC bridge (its HTTP port, not the UDP target).
params.zh: OSC 橋接程式的位址（它的 HTTP 連接埠，不是 UDP 的目的地）。

needs.en: The bridge must be running, and you must `await osc.enable()` first: it probes `GET /health` and answers `false` if nobody is there. Until it succeeds `flush()` just throws the queue away. On a public https page, Chrome asks permission before the page may reach `127.0.0.1`.
needs.zh: 橋接程式必須在跑，而且你要先 `await osc.enable()`：它會探測 `GET /health`，沒有人在就回答 `false`。在成功之前，`flush()` 只會把佇列丟掉。在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 會在頁面連到 `127.0.0.1` 之前先詢問權限。

notes.en: Fields and hooks: `enabled`, `udp` (the target the bridge reported), `onStatus = (ok, info) => {}` and `onMsg = (address, args) => {}` (high frequency: use sparingly).
notes.zh: 欄位與掛鉤：`enabled`、`udp`（橋接程式回報的目的地）、`onStatus = (ok, info) => {}` 和 `onMsg = (address, args) => {}`（頻率很高，請節制使用）。

notes.en: If the bridge disappears, the first failed flush calls `onStatus(false, 'bridge lost')`, and after more than 30 failed flushes in a row `enabled` turns false by itself, with no further message. Call `enable()` again to resume. The messages of a failed flush are lost.
notes.zh: 橋接程式消失的話，第一次失敗的 flush 會呼叫 `onStatus(false, 'bridge lost')`，連續失敗超過 30 次之後，`enabled` 會自己變成 false，不再有任何訊息。想恢復就再呼叫一次 `enable()`。失敗那次 flush 的訊息會遺失。

notes.en: Every number goes out as a 32-bit float, whole numbers included (the bridge's own header comment mentions integers, but its code only writes floats). If the receiver needs integers, convert there.
notes.zh: 每個數字都會當成 32 位元浮點數送出，整數也一樣（橋接程式檔案開頭的註解提到整數，但它的程式碼只會寫浮點數）。接收端如果需要整數，請在那邊轉換。

caption.en: With `node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js` running, the console prints `true` and the bridge forwards `/source/3/xyz` as an OSC packet with three floats.
caption.zh: `node packages/osc/bridges/osc-bridge.js` 在跑的時候，主控台印出 `true`，橋接程式把 `/source/3/xyz` 當成帶三個浮點數的 OSC 封包轉送出去。

caption.en: Three `send()` calls become two messages: the console prints `status true 127.0.0.1:3456`, then the one `POST` with `/source/1/xyz` carrying `[0.4,0.5,0.6]` and `/gain` carrying `[0.8]`, then `rate 2`.
caption.zh: 三次 `send()` 變成兩則訊息：主控台印出 `status true 127.0.0.1:3456`，然後是那一個 `POST`，裡面 `/source/1/xyz` 帶著 `[0.4,0.5,0.6]`、`/gain` 帶著 `[0.8]`，最後是 `rate 2`。

caption.en: With no bridge, `enable()` does not throw: the console prints `status false bridge not running (node bridges/osc-bridge.js)`, then `false`. (The browser may also log one failed request.)
caption.zh: 沒有橋接程式的時候，`enable()` 不會丟出錯誤：主控台印出 `status false bridge not running (node bridges/osc-bridge.js)`，然後是 `false`。（瀏覽器可能另外記下一次失敗的請求。）

tbd.en: Not tried here against TouchDesigner, Max or Reaper: the examples use a stand-in for the bridge, and what the bridge does with the packets is read from its code (floats for numbers, strings for the rest).
tbd.zh: 這裡沒有對 TouchDesigner、Max 或 Reaper 實測：範例是用一個代替橋接程式的函式，橋接程式如何處理封包是從它的程式碼讀出來的（數字用浮點數，其餘用字串）。

members.name: rate
members.doc: msgs per second (resets on read) — monitor food.

summary.en: The out-bridge's default port: 6450.
summary.zh: 輸出橋接程式預設的連接埠：6450。

description.en: The default of `startBridge({ port })` and of `--port`; the environment variable `OUT_BRIDGE_PORT` changes it for the command line. It is the **out**-bridge's port: the Leap bridge has its own ([`DEFAULT_PORT` of `@openav/leap`](#leap-DEFAULT_PORT), 6437).
description.zh: `startBridge({ port })` 和 `--port` 的預設值。環境變數 `OUT_BRIDGE_PORT` 可以改命令列用的值。這是**輸出**橋接程式的連接埠：Leap 橋接程式有自己的（[`@openav/leap` 的 `DEFAULT_PORT`](#leap-DEFAULT_PORT)，6437）。

summary.en: The watchdog time when the config does not say: 500 milliseconds without a value, and a channel is put on its safe value.
summary.zh: 設定檔沒寫的時候，看門狗的時間：500 毫秒沒有收到值，頻道就會被放到它的安全值。

description.en: It is the default of `timeoutMs` in the bridge config (the minimum allowed is 20). [`OutClient`](#OutClient) re-sends held values every third of whatever the bridge reports, so a still slider is not mistaken for a dead page. Lower it for hardware that must stop quickly, but keep it above the slowest frame your page may have.
description.zh: 這是橋接設定裡 `timeoutMs` 的預設值（允許的最小值是 20）。[`OutClient`](#OutClient) 每隔橋接程式回報的時間的三分之一就重送目前的值，所以停著不動的滑桿不會被誤認為當掉的頁面。需要硬體很快停下來的話可以調低它，但要比你的頁面可能出現的最慢畫面更長。

summary.en: Turns a channel glob like `light/*` into the regular expression the bridge matches channel names with: only `*` is special, and it crosses slashes.
summary.zh: 把像 `light/*` 這樣的頻道萬用字元，轉成橋接程式用來比對頻道名稱的正規表示式：只有 `*` 有特殊意義，而且它可以跨過斜線。

description.en: The `match` of a channel rule and the keys of `safe` in the bridge config are globs, and this is how both are read. Remember that `*` also crosses slashes: `light/*` fits `light/0/r`, and `*` alone fits every channel.
description.zh: 橋接設定裡，頻道規則的 `match` 和 `safe` 的鍵都是萬用字元，兩者都是用它來解讀。請記得 `*` 也能跨過斜線：`light/*` 符合 `light/0/r`，只寫 `*` 就符合每一個頻道。

params.name: glob
params.en: The pattern. `*` matches any run of characters, slashes included. Everything else, including `.`, `?` and `+`, matches itself.
params.zh: 樣式。`*` 符合任何一串字元，包含斜線。其他一切，包括 `.`、`?` 和 `+`，都只符合它自己。

returns.en: An anchored expression: `globToRegExp('light/*')` is `/^light\/.*$/`.
returns.zh: 一個固定頭尾的正規表示式：`globToRegExp('light/*')` 是 `/^light\/.*$/`。

caption.en: In Node: the console prints `true false`, then `true`, then `false`.
caption.zh: 在 Node 裡：主控台印出 `true false`，然後是 `true`，再來是 `false`。

summary.en: Reads the out-bridge config from a JSON file and returns it as an object (Node only); throws when the file cannot be read.
summary.zh: 從 JSON 檔讀取輸出橋接程式的設定並回傳成物件（只能在 Node 執行），讀不到檔案就丟出錯誤。

description.en: A thin helper around `fs.readFileSync` and `JSON.parse`. A missing file or invalid JSON throws one error that names the file (its text is written in Chinese in the code). The command line uses it for `--config out.json`; in your own program you may just as well pass an object to `startBridge({ config })`.
description.zh: 包著 `fs.readFileSync` 和 `JSON.parse` 的薄薄一層。找不到檔案或 JSON 不合法，會丟出一個指出檔名的錯誤（訊息在程式碼裡是用中文寫的）。命令列的 `--config out.json` 就是用它。在你自己的程式裡，直接把物件傳給 `startBridge({ config })` 也一樣。

params.name: file
params.en: The path of the JSON file, such as `out.json` (copy `packages/out/bridge/out.example.json` to start).
params.zh: JSON 檔的路徑，例如 `out.json`（可以從複製 `packages/out/bridge/out.example.json` 開始）。

returns.en: The parsed config, unchecked: [`startBridge()`](#out-startBridge) is what validates it.
returns.zh: 解析後的設定，沒有檢查：驗證它的是 [`startBridge()`](#out-startBridge)。

caption.en: In Node: the console prints `1 { 'light/*': 0 }`, then `cannot load: true`: the error names the missing file.
caption.zh: 在 Node 裡：主控台印出 `1 { 'light/*': 0 }`，然後是 `cannot load: true`：錯誤訊息裡有那個找不到的檔名。

summary.en: The address `OutClient` connects to by default: `ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out`, the out-bridge on this machine.
summary.zh: `OutClient` 預設連的位址：`ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out`，也就是這台機器上的輸出橋接程式。

description.en: Port 6450 is the bridge's [`DEFAULT_PORT`](#out-DEFAULT_PORT) and `/out` is the only WebSocket path it serves. In the lab, `?out=ws://host:port/out` points a page at another bridge, `?out=sim` records values without one and `?out=0` turns it off.
description.zh: 6450 是橋接程式的 [`DEFAULT_PORT`](#out-DEFAULT_PORT)，`/out` 是它唯一提供的 WebSocket 路徑。在實驗室裡，`?out=ws://host:port/out` 可以讓頁面改連別的橋接程式，`?out=sim` 只記錄不連線，`?out=0` 則是關掉。

entries.name: OutClient
entries.signature: new OutClient({ url = OUT_DEFAULT_URL, id = null, WebSocket: WS, schedule, maxBackoffMs = 5000, minBackoffMs = 250 } = {})

summary.en: The page side of the out-bridge: `set(channel, value)` sends a number to a named hardware channel, at most once per frame, and keeps the connection alive.
summary.zh: 輸出橋接程式在頁面這一側的部分：`set(channel, value)` 把一個數字送到有名字的硬體頻道，每個畫面最多送一次，並且維持連線。

description.en: Hardware needs a number, and a page has a number: `out.set('light/0/r', 0.8)`. The channel name is yours (`a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /`, up to 128 characters) and the **bridge** ([`startBridge()`](#out-startBridge)) decides from its config where that channel goes: a WLED strip, a serial motor board, an OSC address. Values are plain numbers; the convention is 0..1. Several `set()` calls on one channel inside one frame leave as one value, the last. In a lab work `lab.out` is this class.
description.zh: 硬體需要的是數字，而頁面有數字：`out.set('light/0/r', 0.8)`。頻道名稱由你決定（`a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /`，最長 128 個字元），這個頻道要送去哪裡，由**橋接程式**（[`startBridge()`](#out-startBridge)）依它的設定決定：WLED 燈條、序列埠馬達板、OSC 位址。值就是普通的數字，慣例是 0..1。同一個畫面裡對同一個頻道呼叫好幾次 `set()`，只會送出最後一個值。在實驗室的作品裡，`lab.out` 就是這個類別。

description.en: It keeps the connection alive on its own: it reconnects with a growing delay (250 ms doubling up to 5 s), resends everything it knows after a reconnect (a restarted bridge has forgotten it all), and while the socket is open it re-sends the held values every `timeoutMs / 3` of the bridge's watchdog, so a slider that stands still is not mistaken for a frozen page. If the page really freezes, that heartbeat stops and the bridge puts the hardware on its safe values.
description.zh: 它自己會維持連線：用愈來愈長的間隔重連（250 毫秒起，加倍到 5 秒），重連之後把它知道的值全部重送一遍（重新啟動的橋接程式什麼都忘了），而且在 socket 開著的時候，每隔橋接程式的看門狗時間的三分之一就重送一次目前的值，所以停著不動的滑桿不會被誤認為當掉的頁面。如果頁面真的凍結，這個心跳就會停，橋接程式就讓硬體回到安全值。

params.name: url
params.en: The bridge's WebSocket address. The default is [`OUT_DEFAULT_URL`](#OUT_DEFAULT_URL), `ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out`.
params.zh: 橋接程式的 WebSocket 位址。預設是 [`OUT_DEFAULT_URL`](#OUT_DEFAULT_URL)，也就是 `ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out`。

params.name: id
params.en: A name for this page (the work's id), sent to the bridge in its "hello" and shown in its log.
params.zh: 這個頁面的名字（作品的 id），會在 "hello" 訊息裡送給橋接程式，並顯示在它的紀錄裡。

params.name: WebSocket
params.en: The WebSocket constructor to use. Defaults to the global one (also in Node 22). Pass your own to test without a network.
params.zh: 要用的 WebSocket 建構函式。預設是全域的那個（Node 22 也有）。傳你自己的，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。

params.name: schedule
params.en: A function that runs a callback once, on the next frame. The default is `requestAnimationFrame` (or a 16 ms timer when the tab is hidden or there is no `requestAnimationFrame`).
params.zh: 一個在下一個畫面執行一次回呼的函式。預設是 `requestAnimationFrame`（分頁被藏起來或沒有 `requestAnimationFrame` 時，改用 16 毫秒的計時器）。

params.name: maxBackoffMs
params.en: The longest wait between reconnection attempts, in milliseconds.
params.zh: 重新連線之間最長的等待時間，單位是毫秒。

params.name: minBackoffMs
params.en: The first wait between reconnection attempts. It doubles each time up to `maxBackoffMs`.
params.zh: 重新連線之間第一次的等待時間。每次加倍，直到 `maxBackoffMs`。

needs.en: Call `connect()` (the bridge must be running: `node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json`), or `simulate()` for no hardware at all. `set()` before the socket is open is not lost: it waits in `last` and goes out on open.
needs.zh: 要呼叫 `connect()`（橋接程式必須在跑：`node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json`），或呼叫 `simulate()` 完全不接硬體。在 socket 開啟之前呼叫 `set()` 不會遺失：它會先放在 `last`，等開啟之後送出。

notes.en: Fields to read: `status` (`'closed'`, `'connecting'`, `'open'`, `'sim'`), `last` (`{ channel: last value given to set() }`, also in simulate mode), `sent` (values actually put on the wire: less than the number of `set()` calls because of coalescing) and `bridge` (the bridge's last status message).
notes.zh: 可以讀的欄位：`status`（`'closed'`、`'connecting'`、`'open'`、`'sim'`）、`last`（`{ 頻道: 最後給 set() 的值 }`，模擬模式下也有）、`sent`（真正送上線路的值：因為合併，會比 `set()` 呼叫次數少），以及 `bridge`（橋接程式最近的狀態訊息）。

notes.en: On the wire a single value is `{ "type": "set", "ch", "v" }` and several are `{ "type": "batch", "items": [{ "ch", "v" }, …] }`, after a `{ "type": "hello", "id" }`.
notes.zh: 在線路上，單一個值是 `{ "type": "set", "ch", "v" }`，多個值是 `{ "type": "batch", "items": [{ "ch", "v" }, …] }`，前面先有一則 `{ "type": "hello", "id" }`。

notes.en: On a public https page, Chrome asks permission before the page may reach `127.0.0.1`; if it is refused, the status stays `'connecting'`.
notes.zh: 在公開的 https 頁面上，Chrome 會在頁面連到 `127.0.0.1` 之前詢問權限，被拒絕的話，狀態會一直停在 `'connecting'`。

caption.en: With the out-bridge running, the console prints `out connecting`, then `out open`, and the green channel breathes between 0 and 1.
caption.zh: 輸出橋接程式開著的時候，主控台印出 `out connecting`，然後是 `out open`，綠色那個頻道在 0 和 1 之間起伏。

caption.en: The console prints the `hello`, then one `batch` of three values (`light/0/r` is 0.9, not 0.8), then `sent 3 open`.
caption.zh: 主控台先印出 `hello`，然後是一個含三個值的 `batch`（`light/0/r` 是 0.9，不是 0.8），最後是 `sent 3 open`。

caption.en: Simulate mode records instead of sending: the console prints `sim { 'light/0/r': 0.25 }`; the bad value was ignored.
caption.zh: 模擬模式只記錄不送出：主控台印出 `sim { 'light/0/r': 0.25 }`，壞的值被忽略了。

tbd.en: Not tried here with real hardware (a WLED strip, a motor board): the examples use a stand-in socket and the bridge's `log` sink.
tbd.zh: 這裡沒有用真正的硬體（WLED 燈條、馬達板）試過：範例用的是代替的 socket 和橋接程式的 `log` 輸出。

members.name: connect
members.doc: Open the socket (and keep it open: reconnects with exponential backoff, capped).

members.name: simulate
members.doc: No socket: values are only recorded in .last (for sketches without hardware, ?out=sim).

summary.en: The ports the out-bridge refuses to use: `[7457]`, which belongs to The Last Input and the backstage monitor.
summary.zh: 輸出橋接程式拒絕使用的連接埠：`[7457]`，那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的。

description.en: `startBridge({ port: 7457 })` throws at once, so the bridge can never take the port the monitor listens on. The Leap bridge refuses the same one ([`RESERVED_PORTS` of `@openav/leap`](#leap-RESERVED_PORTS)).
description.zh: `startBridge({ port: 7457 })` 會立刻丟出錯誤，所以橋接程式絕不會占走後台監看監聽的連接埠。Leap 橋接程式也拒絕同一個（[`@openav/leap` 的 `RESERVED_PORTS`](#leap-RESERVED_PORTS)）。

entries.name: startBridge
entries.signature: startBridge({ port = DEFAULT_PORT, host = '127.0.0.1', config = null, watchdog = true, log = () => {}, print = (s) => console.log(s) } = {})

summary.en: Starts the out-bridge: a loopback WebSocket server that routes channel values from the page to hardware sinks, with a watchdog that falls back to safe values (Node only).
summary.zh: 啟動輸出橋接程式：一個只綁 loopback 的 WebSocket 伺服器，把頁面傳來的頻道值導向硬體輸出，並有看門狗在頁面沒聲音時退回安全值（只能在 Node 執行）。

description.en: This is what `node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json` runs (also `--port`, `--no-watchdog`, `--quiet`; the environment variable `OUT_BRIDGE_PORT`). It serves `ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out`, which understands `{ type: 'hello', id }`, `{ type: 'set', ch, v }`, `{ type: 'batch', items }` and `{ type: 'status' }`, and answers with `{ type: 'status', … }`; `GET /health` reports the sinks, the channel count, the clients and the time since the last value. Channel names are `a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /` up to 128 characters, values must be finite numbers, and there is room for 4096 channels.
description.zh: `node packages/out/bridge/out-bridge.mjs --config out.json` 執行的就是它（另有 `--port`、`--no-watchdog`、`--quiet`，以及環境變數 `OUT_BRIDGE_PORT`）。它提供 `ws://127.0.0.1:6450/out`，聽得懂 `{ type: 'hello', id }`、`{ type: 'set', ch, v }`、`{ type: 'batch', items }` 和 `{ type: 'status' }`，並以 `{ type: 'status', … }` 回應。`GET /health` 回報輸出、頻道數、用戶端和距離上一個值的時間。頻道名稱是 `a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - . /`，最長 128 個字元，值必須是有限數，最多容納 4096 個頻道。

description.en: The config routes channels: `channels` is a list of `{ match, sink, … }` and the **first** rule whose `match` glob fits the channel name takes it (`*` means anything, slashes included); a channel no rule fits is counted and dropped. The sinks are `log` (stdout), `udp-json` (UDP, `{"ch","v"}`), `osc` (UDP, address `"/" + channel`, one float32), `ddp` (WLED over UDP 4048: `light/<i>/r|g|b`, 0..1, pixel index from 0, up to 10000 pixels) and `serial` (a device path, `ch value` lines or JSON, latest value only). `safe` maps a channel glob to its safe value, `timeoutMs` (default 500, at least 20) is the watchdog time, and `allowOrigins` lists the page origins that may connect (without it any page on this machine can).
description.zh: 設定檔負責把頻道導向各處：`channels` 是 `{ match, sink, … }` 的清單，**第一條** `match` 萬用字元符合頻道名稱的規則就接手它（`*` 代表任何東西，包含斜線）。沒有規則符合的頻道會被計數然後丟掉。輸出（sink）有 `log`（標準輸出）、`udp-json`（UDP，`{"ch","v"}`）、`osc`（UDP，位址是 `"/" + 頻道`，一個 float32）、`ddp`（用 UDP 4048 控制 WLED：`light/<i>/r|g|b`，0..1，像素索引從 0 開始，最多 10000 個像素）和 `serial`（裝置路徑，`ch value` 的行或 JSON，只送最新的值）。`safe` 把頻道萬用字元對應到它的安全值，`timeoutMs`（預設 500，至少 20）是看門狗的時間，`allowOrigins` 列出允許連線的頁面來源（沒寫的話，這台機器上的任何頁面都能連）。

description.en: The **watchdog**: a channel that has a safe value and gets no new value for `timeoutMs` is sent its safe value once (a new value re-arms it). When the last client disconnects, every channel the bridge has seen that has a safe value gets it at once, and so does a clean shutdown. It does not cover channels the bridge has never heard of, nor a bridge killed with SIGKILL.
description.zh: **看門狗**：有安全值的頻道，如果 `timeoutMs` 內沒有收到新的值，就會被送出一次安全值（新的值進來會重新啟動它）。最後一個用戶端斷線的時候，橋接程式見過的每個有安全值的頻道會立刻得到它的安全值，正常關閉時也一樣。它不涵蓋橋接程式從沒聽過的頻道，也不涵蓋被 SIGKILL 殺掉的橋接程式。

description.en: It throws at once for port 7457 (it belongs to The Last Input and the monitor), for a `host` that is not loopback, and for a bad config (no `channels`, an unknown sink, a `safe` value that is not a number, a `timeoutMs` under 20). A port already in use rejects the returned promise.
description.zh: 連接埠是 7457（那是 The Last Input 和後台監看用的）、`host` 不是 loopback、設定有問題（沒有 `channels`、不認得的 sink、`safe` 的值不是數字、`timeoutMs` 小於 20），它都會立刻丟出錯誤。連接埠已被占用，回傳的 promise 會被拒絕。

params.name: port
params.en: The port to listen on, [`DEFAULT_PORT`](#out-DEFAULT_PORT) unless you say otherwise. 0 picks any free one. The ports in [`RESERVED_PORTS`](#out-RESERVED_PORTS) (7457) are refused.
params.zh: 要監聽的連接埠，沒特別指定就是 [`DEFAULT_PORT`](#out-DEFAULT_PORT)。0 表示隨便挑一個空的。[`RESERVED_PORTS`](#out-RESERVED_PORTS) 裡的連接埠（7457）會被拒絕。

params.name: host
params.en: The address to bind. Only loopback is allowed.
params.zh: 要綁定的位址。只允許 loopback。

params.name: config
params.en: The routing: `{ channels: [{ match, sink, … }], safe: { glob: value }, timeoutMs, allowOrigins }` (see the description). `null` sends every channel to the `log` sink. [`loadConfig(file)`](#loadConfig) reads it from a JSON file.
params.zh: 路由設定：`{ channels: [{ match, sink, … }], safe: { glob: value }, timeoutMs, allowOrigins }`（見說明）。`null` 的話，所有頻道都送到 `log` 輸出。[`loadConfig(file)`](#loadConfig) 可以從 JSON 檔讀取。

params.name: watchdog
params.en: `false` switches the watchdog off: no safe values are ever sent (the tests use it to prove the watchdog is what does the work).
params.zh: `false` 會關掉看門狗：永遠不送安全值（測試用它來證明做事的是看門狗）。

params.name: log
params.en: Called with a line of text for diagnostics: clients coming and going, safe values sent.
params.zh: 以一行文字呼叫，給診斷用：用戶端進出、送出了安全值。

params.name: print
params.en: What the `log` sink prints each value with (`"channel value"`). The default is stdout.
params.zh: `log` 輸出用來印每個值的函式（`"channel value"`）。預設是標準輸出。

returns.en: Resolves once listening, with `{ port, state, health(), close() }`: the real port, the counters (`received`, `rejected`, `unrouted`, `safeSent` …), a function returning the `/health` object, and a function that puts every known channel on its safe value, stops the server and returns a Promise.
returns.zh: 開始監聽之後才完成，結果是 `{ port, state, health(), close() }`：實際的連接埠、計數器（`received`、`rejected`、`unrouted`、`safeSent` ……）、回傳 `/health` 物件的函式，以及會讓每個已知頻道回到安全值、停掉伺服器並回傳 Promise 的函式。

needs.en: Node 22 or later. The sinks need what they talk to: a WLED device for `ddp`, the device file for `serial`, a listener for `osc`.
needs.zh: Node 22 以上。各個輸出需要它要連的對象：`ddp` 要有 WLED 裝置，`serial` 要有裝置檔，`osc` 要有人在聽。

notes.en: The error messages the bridge throws and sends back to a page are written in Chinese in the code, so a page may show them in Chinese whatever its language.
notes.zh: 橋接程式丟出的、以及回傳給頁面的錯誤訊息，在程式碼裡是用中文寫的，所以不管頁面是什麼語言，頁面上看到的可能是中文。

caption.en: In Node: the console prints `sink: light/0/r 0.8`, then `sink: light/0/r 0`: when the page goes away the bridge puts the light channel on its safe value.
caption.zh: 在 Node 裡：主控台印出 `sink: light/0/r 0.8`，然後是 `sink: light/0/r 0`：頁面一離開，橋接程式就讓燈的頻道回到安全值。

tbd.en: The `ddp` (WLED) and `serial` sinks were not tried here with real hardware; what the description says about them comes from the package README and the code. The `log` sink and the watchdog were run.
tbd.zh: `ddp`（WLED）和 `serial` 輸出沒有用真正的硬體試過。說明裡講到它們的部分來自套件的 README 和程式碼。`log` 輸出和看門狗是實際跑過的。

entries.name: LearnWizard
entries.signature: new LearnWizard({ mapper, keys, onChange = null })

summary.en: Binds a list of params one after another: it arms learn for the first, you turn a knob, it binds it and arms the next. Skip, back and stop steer it.
summary.zh: 依序綁定一整串參數：先替第一個備好 learn，你轉一個旋鈕，它就綁上去，再備好下一個。skip、back、stop 可以操控它。

description.en: Binding twelve params one by one with the learn chip means twelve clicks and twelve guesses about what to touch next. The wizard walks the list for you: `start()` arms learn for `keys[0]`, `wizard.current` says which param it is waiting for ('Turn a knob for: hue (1/12)'), you move a control, it is bound and the next one is armed. At the end learn is disarmed. The console's **🎛 map knobs in order** button is this class.
description.zh: 用 learn 標籤一個一個綁十二個參數，就是點十二次，還要猜十二次下一個該碰哪裡。精靈替你走完整份清單：`start()` 替 `keys[0]` 備好 learn，`wizard.current` 告訴你它在等哪個參數（「Turn a knob for: hue (1/12)」），你動一個控制項，它就綁上去，然後備好下一個。全部結束後，learn 會解除。主控台的 **🎛 map knobs in order** 按鈕就是這個類別。

description.en: It is pure logic on top of the mapper, with no screen of its own. Learn only ever adds routes, so running the wizard twice puts a second control on a param instead of losing the first. While it runs, it owns learn mode: call `sync()` every frame so that a click on some other learn chip cannot leave it waiting for nothing.
description.zh: 它是建在映射上面的純邏輯，沒有自己的畫面。learn 只會新增路由，所以跑兩次精靈，是替參數多加一個控制項，不會弄丟第一個。它在跑的時候擁有 learn 模式：請每個畫面呼叫 `sync()`，這樣有人點了別的 learn 標籤，也不會讓它空等。

params.name: mapper
params.en: The [`Mapper`](#Mapper) to bind through.
params.zh: 要透過它綁定的 [`Mapper`](#Mapper)。

params.name: keys
params.en: The param keys to bind, in order, or a function that returns them (it is called when `start()` runs).
params.zh: 要綁定的參數 key，依序排列。也可以是回傳它們的函式（在 `start()` 執行時呼叫）。

params.name: onChange
params.en: Called with the wizard whenever what a banner would show changes: the current param, the position, finished or not.
params.zh: 只要橫幅會顯示的內容改變（目前的參數、位置、有沒有結束），就以這個精靈本身呼叫。

notes.en: Fields to read: `active`, `done` (the run reached the end), `index`, `total`, `order`, and `added` (`[{ key, source }]`, what was bound in this run).
notes.zh: 可以讀的欄位：`active`、`done`（這一輪走到了最後）、`index`、`total`、`order`，以及 `added`（`[{ key, source }]`，這一輪綁了什麼）。

notes.en: While it runs the wizard wraps the mapper's `onLearn` and puts yours back when it ends, so your own `onLearn` keeps being called.
notes.zh: 精靈在跑的時候會包住映射的 `onLearn`，結束時再還給你，所以你自己的 `onLearn` 照樣會被呼叫。

caption.en: The console prints `waiting for hue`, `waiting for size`, then `true` and the two bindings `[ { key: 'hue', source: 'knob/1' }, { key: 'size', source: 'knob/2' } ]`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `waiting for hue`、`waiting for size`，然後是 `true` 和兩個綁定 `[ { key: 'hue', source: 'knob/1' }, { key: 'size', source: 'knob/2' } ]`。

members.name: current
members.doc: The param being waited for, or null.

members.name: skip
members.doc: Leave the current param unbound and wait for the next one.

members.name: back
members.doc: Back to the previous param (it keeps what it already has; a turned knob adds one more).

members.name: stop
members.doc: End the run now.

members.name: sync
members.doc: Call every frame: while the wizard runs it owns learn mode, so a click on some other learn chip cannot leave it waiting for nothing.

entries.name: loadMapUrl
entries.signature: async loadMapUrl(mapper, value, { base = (typeof location !== 'undefined' ? location.href : undefined), fetchImpl = (typeof fetch !== 'undefined' ? fetch : null), timeoutMs = 8000 } = {})

summary.en: Fetches a map file from an address (what `?map=` calls) and puts it on the mapper; it never throws and never blocks the show.
summary.zh: 從一個網址抓映射檔（`?map=` 呼叫的就是它）並放到映射上，絕不丟出例外，也不會卡住演出。

description.en: Fetches the address with `credentials: 'omit'`, and `importMap()`s the text. Any failure (refused address, no `fetch`, the server answered 404, offline, a site that blocks cross-origin reads, a timeout, a file that is not a map) lands in the report and in `mapper.report`, where the console shows it, and the routes stay as they were. It is async, so `createShow()` does not wait for it and the show starts regardless.
description.zh: 用 `credentials: 'omit'` 去抓這個網址，再把文字交給 `importMap()`。任何失敗（網址被拒絕、沒有 `fetch`、伺服器回 404、離線、擋住跨來源讀取的網站、逾時、檔案不是映射檔）都會寫進報告和 `mapper.report`，主控台會顯示出來，路由維持原樣。它是非同步的，所以 `createShow()` 不會等它，演出照常開始。

description.en: A map on another site must be served with CORS (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`); raw GitHub files and gists are. In a show you rarely call it: open the page with `?map=<url>`, or pass `map: 'maps/a.json'` to `createShow()`.
description.zh: 別的網站上的映射檔必須用 CORS 提供（`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`），raw GitHub 檔案和 gist 都可以。做演出的時候很少直接呼叫它：開頁面時加上 `?map=<url>`，或在 `createShow()` 傳 `map: 'maps/a.json'` 就行了。

params.name: mapper
params.en: The [`Mapper`](#Mapper) to import into.
params.zh: 要匯入的 [`Mapper`](#Mapper)。

params.name: value
params.en: The address of the map file, checked by [`parseMapUrl()`](#parseMapUrl) first.
params.zh: 映射檔的網址，會先經過 [`parseMapUrl()`](#parseMapUrl) 檢查。

params.name: base
params.en: The page address that relative addresses resolve against.
params.zh: 相對網址據以解析的頁面網址。

params.name: fetchImpl
params.en: The function that does the request. Replace it to test without a network.
params.zh: 真正發出請求的函式。換掉它，就能在沒有網路的情況下測試。

params.name: timeoutMs
params.en: Give up after this many milliseconds.
params.zh: 超過這麼多毫秒就放棄。

returns.en: The report: what `mapper.importMap()` returned (`source: 'url'`, `address`, `added`, `skipped` …), or `{ ok: false, source: 'url', address, error }`. The same report is kept in `mapper.report`.
returns.zh: 報告：`mapper.importMap()` 的回傳值（`source: 'url'`、`address`、`added`、`skipped` ……），或 `{ ok: false, source: 'url', address, error }`。同一份報告也存在 `mapper.report`。

caption.en: With a stand-in for the network, the console prints `true https://openaudiovisual.com/x/maps/stage-left.json 1`: the route came in.
caption.zh: 用一個代替網路的函式，主控台印出 `true https://openaudiovisual.com/x/maps/stage-left.json 1`：路由進來了。

caption.en: A refused address is a report, not an exception: the console prints `false a map from another site must be served over https`, then `true`.
caption.zh: 被拒絕的網址是一份報告，不是例外：主控台印出 `false a map from another site must be served over https`，然後是 `true`。

summary.en: The text `"openav.map"`: the value of `format` in every map file. A file with another format is refused.
summary.zh: 文字 `"openav.map"`：每個映射檔裡 `format` 的值。格式不同的檔案會被拒絕。

description.en: A map file is JSON with `"format": "openav.map"`, a `version`, a `world` name and a list of `routes`. [`parseMap()`](#parseMap) refuses anything whose `format` is not this string, so you cannot import some other tool's JSON by accident. The one exception is a bare array (what `mapper.toJSON()` returns), which is read as version 0.
description.zh: 映射檔是 JSON，裡面有 `"format": "openav.map"`、`version`、`world` 名稱和一份 `routes` 清單。[`parseMap()`](#parseMap) 會拒絕 `format` 不是這個字串的東西，所以不會誤把別的工具的 JSON 匯進來。唯一的例外是單純的陣列（`mapper.toJSON()` 回傳的那種），會被當成版本 0 來讀。

summary.en: The longest map text `parseMap()` will read: 262144, which is 256 KB. Longer text is refused without being parsed.
summary.zh: `parseMap()` 願意讀的映射文字長度上限：262144，也就是 256 KB。更長的文字不會解析，直接拒絕。

description.en: The limit is compared with the length of the text (characters), before any parsing, so a huge file cannot freeze the page. A map with more than 500 routes is refused as well, whatever its size.
description.zh: 這個上限是拿文字的長度（字元數）來比，在任何解析之前就比，所以很大的檔案不會讓頁面卡住。路由超過 500 條的映射檔也會被拒絕，不管大小。

summary.en: The newest map file version this build reads and writes: 1. A file with a higher version is refused with a message.
summary.zh: 這個版本能讀也能寫的映射檔最新版本：1。版本更高的檔案會被拒絕並給出訊息。

description.en: [`serializeMap()`](#serializeMap) writes this number and [`parseMap()`](#parseMap) accepts any version from 1 up to it. A newer file gets the message "this build of OAV reads up to version 1. Update OAV or re-export it." A file with no valid `version` is refused too. Only a bare array of routes counts as version 0.
description.zh: [`serializeMap()`](#serializeMap) 寫入這個數字，[`parseMap()`](#parseMap) 接受從 1 到它之間的任何版本。更新的檔案會得到這句訊息：`this build of OAV reads up to version 1. Update OAV or re-export it.` 沒有合法 `version` 的檔案也會被拒絕。只有單純的路由陣列會被當成版本 0。

entries.name: Mapper
entries.signature: new Mapper({ signals, params, profile = 'default', onChange = null, onLearn = null })

summary.en: Connects signals to params: it holds a list of routes (a window, a curve, smoothing) and writes the matching param whenever a signal arrives.
summary.zh: 把訊號接到參數：它手上有一份路由清單（輸入窗、曲線、平滑），每當訊號到來，就寫入對應的參數。

description.en: The mapper is the only component that connects signals to params, and everything it knows is a list of **routes**, plain objects. `mapper.addRoute({ source: 'midi/cc/74', target: 'bloom' })` makes the param `bloom` follow the signal `midi/cc/74`. One signal may drive several params, one param may listen to several signals (the last writer wins), and learn adds routes, it never replaces them. In a show, [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds one, loads the saved routes (or adds the ones you declared in `routes`) and returns it as `show.mapper`.
description.zh: 映射是唯一把訊號接到參數的元件，它知道的一切就是一份**路由**清單，每條路由是個普通物件。`mapper.addRoute({ source: 'midi/cc/74', target: 'bloom' })` 讓參數 `bloom` 跟著訊號 `midi/cc/74` 走。一個訊號可以驅動好幾個參數，一個參數也可以聽好幾個訊號（最後寫入的算數），learn 只會新增路由，不會取代。在演出裡，[`createShow()`](#createShow) 會建好一個，載入存起來的路由（或加入你在 `routes` 宣告的），用 `show.mapper` 回傳。

description.en:
A route needs only `source` and `target`; `addRoute()` fills in the rest and returns the stored route:

```text
source, target      the signal name and the param key (required)
inMin, inMax        0, 1   the part of the signal that counts; outside it is clamped
outMin, outMax      the param's min and max AT THE MOMENT THE ROUTE IS ADDED (0 and 1 if the param does not exist yet)
curve               'linear' | 'exp' (x squared) | 'log' (square root) | 'smooth' (smoothstep); an unknown name is linear
invert              false   flip the value (1 - x) before the curve
smooth              0       glide time in seconds; 0 = instant
enabled             absent = on; false mutes the route
id                  assigned; used by removeRoute()
```
description.zh:
一條路由只需要 `source` 和 `target`，其餘由 `addRoute()` 補上，並回傳存下來的路由：

```text
source, target      the signal name and the param key (required)
inMin, inMax        0, 1   the part of the signal that counts; outside it is clamped
outMin, outMax      the param's min and max AT THE MOMENT THE ROUTE IS ADDED (0 and 1 if the param does not exist yet)
curve               'linear' | 'exp' (x squared) | 'log' (square root) | 'smooth' (smoothstep); an unknown name is linear
invert              false   flip the value (1 - x) before the curve
smooth              0       glide time in seconds; 0 = instant
enabled             absent = on; false mutes the route
id                  assigned; used by removeRoute()
```

description.en: When a signal arrives, each enabled route with that `source` does five things in order: take the **window** (`(value - inMin) / (inMax - inMin)`, clamped to 0..1), **invert** if asked, apply the **curve**, **scale** into `outMin`..`outMax`, and **write**. With `smooth: 0` the param is overridden at once. With `smooth > 0` the result becomes a target that `update(dt)` glides toward: after `smooth` seconds the param has covered about 63% of the way. If the target param is a pulse param, the route fires it instead: on every event of a pulse signal, or when a continuous source rises past 0.5.
description.zh: 訊號到來的時候，每一條啟用中、`source` 相符的路由會依序做五件事：取**輸入窗**（`(value - inMin) / (inMax - inMin)`，限制在 0..1）、需要的話**反轉**、套用**曲線**、**縮放**到 `outMin`..`outMax`、然後**寫入**。`smooth: 0` 時參數立刻被覆寫。`smooth > 0` 時，結果變成一個目標值，由 `update(dt)` 慢慢滑過去：經過 `smooth` 秒，參數走完大約 63% 的距離。如果目標是脈衝參數，路由改成觸發它：脈衝訊號每來一次就觸發，連續訊號則是往上越過 0.5 的那一刻觸發。

description.en: **Learn** is generalised MIDI-learn: `mapper.learn('bloom')`, then move something. The first signal that moves by at least 5% of its declared range (a knob, a hand, a phone tilt), or the first pulse that fires (a key, a pad), becomes the source of a new route with the default settings. Calling `learn('bloom')` again cancels it. Because any pulse binds at once, stop the drum machine before you learn.
description.zh: **Learn** 是通用版的 MIDI-learn：呼叫 `mapper.learn('bloom')`，然後動一個東西。第一個移動超過其宣告範圍 5% 的訊號（旋鈕、手、手機傾斜），或第一個觸發的脈衝（按鍵、打擊墊），就會成為一條使用預設值的新路由的來源。再呼叫一次 `learn('bloom')` 就取消。因為任何脈衝都會立刻被綁定，learn 之前請先把鼓機停掉。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) registry to listen to. The mapper subscribes to every signal at once, so a route works the moment it is added.
params.zh: 要監聽的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表。映射一建立就訂閱所有訊號，所以路由一加進去就生效。

params.name: params
params.en: The [`Params`](#Params) to write into. A route writes its target as an override.
params.zh: 要寫入的 [`Params`](#Params)。路由會把目標參數寫成覆寫值。

params.name: profile
params.en: The name this mapper saves its routes under in `localStorage` (`openav.map.<profile>`), and the `world` name in an exported map file. `createShow()` uses the world's name.
params.zh: 這個映射在 `localStorage` 儲存路由時用的名字（`openav.map.<profile>`），也是匯出的映射檔裡的 `world` 名稱。`createShow()` 用的是世界的名字。

params.name: onChange
params.en: Called with no arguments whenever the routes change or the import report changes (for a UI to redraw).
params.zh: 路由改變或匯入報告改變的時候呼叫，不帶參數（讓介面重畫用）。

params.name: onLearn
params.en: Called as `onLearn(route, signalName)` when learn mode binds a signal.
params.zh: learn 模式綁定了一個訊號的時候，以 `onLearn(route, signalName)` 呼叫。

needs.en: Create the signals and the params first, then the mapper. A smoothed route (`smooth > 0`) writes its param only inside `update(dt)`, so call `mapper.update(dt)` every frame (`createShow()` does).
needs.zh: 先建好訊號和參數，再建映射。平滑的路由（`smooth > 0`）只會在 `update(dt)` 裡寫入參數，所以每個畫面都要呼叫 `mapper.update(dt)`（`createShow()` 會做）。

notes.en: A route writes its param as an **override**, and overrides are sticky: as soon as a mapped signal moves, the timeline stops driving that param until `params.clearOverride(key)`.
notes.zh: 路由把參數寫成**覆寫值**，而覆寫是黏住的：映射的訊號一動，時間軸就不再驅動那個參數，直到你呼叫 `params.clearOverride(key)`。

notes.en: A smoothed route keeps writing its last target every frame once its signal has arrived, so its param stays overridden even after `clearOverride` and even when the route is muted with `enabled = false`. Remove the route to give the param back to the timeline.
notes.zh: 平滑的路由只要訊號來過一次，之後每個畫面都會繼續寫入它最後的目標值，所以就算 `clearOverride`、甚至用 `enabled = false` 靜音，參數仍然是被覆寫的。要把參數還給時間軸，請移除那條路由。

notes.en: With `createShow()`, routes are added before the sound engine registers its `sound/*` params, so a route to `sound/cutoff` needs an explicit `outMin: 100, outMax: 8000`.
notes.zh: 在 `createShow()` 裡，路由加進去的時間比聲音引擎登記 `sound/*` 參數還早，所以接到 `sound/cutoff` 的路由要明確寫上 `outMin: 100, outMax: 8000`。

notes.en: More, with the saved-profile rules: [Mapping](https://openaudiovisual.com/docs/#mapping).
notes.zh: 更多內容與存檔規則：[映射](https://openaudiovisual.com/zh/docs/#mapping)。

caption.en: The console prints `25`: the knob is halfway, the `exp` curve squares it to 0.25, and that is a quarter of the way along 0..100.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `25`：旋鈕在一半，`exp` 曲線把它平方成 0.25，也就是 0..100 的四分之一。

caption.en: A smoothed route only moves inside `update(dt)`: the console prints `0`, then `227.6` after half a second (63% of the way to 360).
caption.zh: 平滑的路由只會在 `update(dt)` 裡動：主控台先印出 `0`，半秒之後印出 `227.6`（走了 360 的 63%）。

caption.en: Learn waits for a real movement: the console prints `bound knob/a`, then `[ 'knob/a' ] null` (learn disarms itself once it has bound a signal).
caption.zh: learn 會等到真正的移動：主控台印出 `bound knob/a`，然後是 `[ 'knob/a' ] null`（綁定一個訊號之後，learn 會自己解除）。

caption.en: A wiring travels as a file: the console prints `openav.map 1 true 1 []`.
caption.zh: 一份接線可以變成檔案帶著走：主控台印出 `openav.map 1 true 1 []`。

members.name: learn
members.doc: Toggle learn mode for a param.

members.name: update
members.doc: Call per frame — advances smoothed routes.

members.name: exportMap
members.doc: The portable file for the current routes ({ format, version, world, routes }).

members.name: importMap
members.doc: Put a map file on this mapper.

members.name: clear
members.doc: Remove every route (and forget it: the saved profile is emptied too).

members.name: setReport
members.doc: Remember what the last import said and tell the UI (a failure shows up here, never as an exception).

summary.en: Reads and cleans a map file (JSON text or a parsed value) without touching any mapper; it never throws.
summary.zh: 讀取並整理一份映射檔（JSON 文字或已解析的值），不會動到任何映射，也絕不丟出例外。

description.en: Use it to validate a file before you import it, or to show what is inside one. It refuses, with a plain-language `error`, text that is not JSON, text longer than [`MAP_MAX_BYTES`](#MAP_MAX_BYTES), an object whose `format` is not [`MAP_FORMAT`](#MAP_FORMAT), a missing or newer `version`, no `routes` list, and more than 500 routes.
description.zh: 用它在匯入之前檢查檔案，或看看檔案裡有什麼。下列情形它會用白話的 `error` 拒絕：文字不是 JSON、文字比 [`MAP_MAX_BYTES`](#MAP_MAX_BYTES) 長、物件的 `format` 不是 [`MAP_FORMAT`](#MAP_FORMAT)、`version` 缺少或比較新、沒有 `routes` 清單，以及超過 500 條路由。

description.en: What it accepts is cleaned: a route without a string `signal` and `param` is dropped (and counted in `dropped`), unknown keys disappear, numbers must be finite, an unknown `curve` becomes `'linear'`, `smooth` is held to 0..60 seconds, and only `invert: true` inverts. A route is on unless it says `enabled: false`.
description.zh: 接受的內容都會被整理過：沒有字串 `signal` 和 `param` 的路由會被丟掉（並算進 `dropped`），不認得的欄位會消失，數字必須有限，不認得的 `curve` 變成 `'linear'`，`smooth` 限制在 0 到 60 秒，只有 `invert: true` 才會反轉。路由除非寫了 `enabled: false`，否則是開著的。

params.name: input
params.en: The JSON text of a map file, an already parsed map object, or a bare array of routes (version 0).
params.zh: 映射檔的 JSON 文字、已經解析好的映射物件，或單純的路由陣列（版本 0）。

returns.en: `{ ok: true, version, world, routes, dropped }` or `{ ok: false, error }`. Each route is `{ signal, param, curve, inMin, inMax, outMin?, outMax?, smooth, invert, enabled }`; `dropped` counts the entries that were not routes.
returns.zh: `{ ok: true, version, world, routes, dropped }` 或 `{ ok: false, error }`。每條路由是 `{ signal, param, curve, inMin, inMax, outMin?, outMax?, smooth, invert, enabled }`。`dropped` 是不算路由而被丟掉的項目數。

caption.en: The console prints `true linear 1` (the unknown curve became linear, the broken route was dropped), then the two refusals with their reasons.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `true linear 1`（不認得的曲線變成 linear，壞掉的路由被丟掉），然後是兩個被拒絕的情形與原因。

summary.en: Decides whether a `?map=` address may be fetched: same origin, or an absolute https URL, and nothing else.
summary.zh: 判斷一個 `?map=` 的網址能不能去抓：同源的，或絕對的 https 網址，其他一律不行。

description.en: A map file named in the page address is somebody else's data, so the rules are strict. Accepted: an address on the same origin as `base` (any scheme, so plain `http://localhost` works for a page served from there), or an absolute `https:` address. Refused: an empty address, one longer than 2048 characters, one that is not a URL, one carrying a user name or password, `http:` to another host, and `data:`, `javascript:`, `file:`, `blob:` and every other scheme. [`loadMapUrl()`](#loadMapUrl) runs this check before it fetches anything.
description.zh: 網址列上指定的映射檔是別人的資料，所以規則很嚴。接受：跟 `base` 同源的網址（任何通訊協定，所以從 `http://localhost` 提供的頁面用 `http://localhost` 也行），或絕對的 `https:` 網址。拒絕：空網址、超過 2048 個字元、不是網址、帶有帳號或密碼、指向別的主機的 `http:`，以及 `data:`、`javascript:`、`file:`、`blob:` 和其他所有通訊協定。[`loadMapUrl()`](#loadMapUrl) 在抓任何東西之前都會先跑這個檢查。

params.name: value
params.en: The address as typed: absolute, or relative to `base`.
params.zh: 輸入的網址：絕對網址，或相對於 `base` 的網址。

params.name: base
params.en: The page address that relative addresses resolve against, and that "same origin" is judged by. Usually `location.href`.
params.zh: 相對網址據以解析、「同源」據以判斷的頁面網址。通常是 `location.href`。

returns.en: `{ ok: true, url }` with the resolved address, or `{ ok: false, error }`.
returns.zh: `{ ok: true, url }`（解析後的網址），或 `{ ok: false, error }`。

caption.en: The console prints two accepted results (the first with the full resolved address `https://openaudiovisual.com/examples/01-hello-particles/maps/stage-left.json`) and two refusals with their reasons.
caption.zh: 主控台印出兩個接受的結果（第一個是完整解析後的網址 `https://openaudiovisual.com/examples/01-hello-particles/maps/stage-left.json`）和兩個被拒絕的情形與原因。

summary.en: Builds the portable map file object from a list of routes: `{ format, version, world, exported, routes }`.
summary.zh: 把一份路由清單做成可攜的映射檔物件：`{ format, version, world, exported, routes }`。

description.en: Routes in a map file are named by **signal** and **param**, never by id, so the file can travel between worlds. `mapper.exportMap()` calls this for you; use `serializeMap()` directly when you build routes by hand or want a fixed date. Missing `inMin`/`inMax` become 0 and 1, missing `curve` is `'linear'`, and the output range is 0..1 unless the route has `outMin`/`outMax`.
description.zh: 映射檔裡的路由是用**訊號**和**參數**的名字來指，不用 id，所以檔案可以在不同世界之間搬運。`mapper.exportMap()` 會替你呼叫它。自己手寫路由、或想要固定日期時，才需要直接用 `serializeMap()`。沒寫的 `inMin`/`inMax` 會變成 0 和 1，沒寫的 `curve` 是 `'linear'`，沒有 `outMin`/`outMax` 的話輸出範圍是 0..1。

params.name: routes
params.en: Routes in the mapper's own shape (what `mapper.toJSON()` returns: `source`, `target`, `inMin`, `outMax` …).
params.zh: 映射本身格式的路由（`mapper.toJSON()` 回傳的那種：`source`、`target`、`inMin`、`outMax` ……）。

params.name: world
params.en: The world name written into the file. Importing into another world drops the output ranges.
params.zh: 寫進檔案的世界名稱。匯入到別的世界時，輸出範圍會被丟掉。

params.name: now
params.en: The time written as `exported` (an ISO string). Pass a fixed date to get the same file twice.
params.zh: 寫成 `exported` 的時間（ISO 字串）。傳一個固定的日期，就能得到兩次相同的檔案。

returns.en: `{ format: 'openav.map', version: 1, world, exported, routes: [{ signal, param, curve, range: { in: [inMin, inMax], out: [outMin, outMax] }, smooth, invert }] }`. A muted route also carries `enabled: false`.
returns.zh: `{ format: 'openav.map', version: 1, world, exported, routes: [{ signal, param, curve, range: { in: [inMin, inMax], out: [outMin, outMax] }, smooth, invert }] }`。被靜音的路由會多一個 `enabled: false`。

caption.en: The console prints the whole file as one line of JSON, starting `{"format":"openav.map","version":1,"world":"garden","exported":"2026-10-19T00:00:00.000Z","routes":[{"signal":"midi/cc/74","param":"bloom","curve":"exp","range":{"in":[0,1],"out":[0,100]} …`.
caption.zh: 主控台把整個檔案印成一行 JSON，開頭是 `{"format":"openav.map","version":1,"world":"garden","exported":"2026-10-19T00:00:00.000Z","routes":[{"signal":"midi/cc/74","param":"bloom","curve":"exp","range":{"in":[0,1],"out":[0,100]} …`。

summary.en: A minimal event emitter: `on(event, cb)`, `emit(event, payload)`, `off(event, cb)`. No wildcards, no async.
summary.zh: 最陽春的事件發射器：`on(event, cb)`、`emit(event, payload)`、`off(event, cb)`。沒有萬用字元，也不是非同步。

description.en: `new Bus()` is a tiny publish and subscribe helper for your own code: subscribe to an event name with `on()`, fire it with `emit()`, and every callback gets the one payload you pass. Callbacks run in the order they subscribed, synchronously, inside `emit()`.
description.zh: `new Bus()` 是給你自己的程式用的小型發布與訂閱工具：用 `on()` 訂閱一個事件名稱，用 `emit()` 觸發，每個函式都會收到你傳的那一個內容。函式依訂閱順序同步執行，都在 `emit()` 裡面跑完。

description.en: It is not the thing shows talk through. Inputs and worlds talk through [`Signals`](#Signals) (named values with a range) and [`Params`](#Params); nothing else in the framework uses a `Bus`, and `createShow()` does not create one.
description.zh: 演出裡各部分溝通靠的不是它。輸入和世界是透過 [`Signals`](#Signals)（有範圍的具名值）和 [`Params`](#Params) 溝通，框架裡沒有別的東西用到 `Bus`，`createShow()` 也不會建立一個。

caption.en: The console prints `hit 0.8` once; after unsubscribing, the second `emit` is silent.
caption.zh: 主控台只印出一次 `hit 0.8`，取消訂閱之後，第二次 `emit` 沒有任何反應。

members.name: on
members.doc: Subscribe.

summary.en: The frame clock: calls your function every animation frame with the seconds since the last one, and keeps ticking when the tab is hidden.
summary.zh: 畫面的時鐘：每個動畫畫面呼叫你的函式一次，並告訴你距離上一次過了幾秒，分頁被藏起來時它也繼續跳。

description.en: `new Loop((dt) => { … }).start()` runs your function once per `requestAnimationFrame`, with `dt` in seconds. It is the one clock a show has: the timeline advances, mapped signals settle, the world draws and the backstage feed is sent from inside it, in the order [the architecture page](https://openaudiovisual.com/docs/#architecture-the-frame-loop) lists. [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds and starts one for you and returns it as `show.loop`.
description.zh: `new Loop((dt) => { … }).start()` 每個 `requestAnimationFrame` 呼叫你的函式一次，`dt` 的單位是秒。這是一場演出唯一的時鐘：時間軸往前走、映射的訊號安頓下來、世界繪圖、後台資料送出，都在它裡面做，順序見[架構頁](https://openaudiovisual.com/zh/docs/#architecture-the-frame-loop)。[`createShow()`](#createShow) 會替你建好並啟動一個，用 `show.loop` 回傳。

description.en: Browsers freeze `requestAnimationFrame` in a hidden tab, but a performance must not stop because someone switched windows. So while the loop runs, a Web Worker beats every 33 ms; whenever no animation frame has arrived for 50 ms, the loop steps itself. A hidden tab therefore ticks at roughly 15 frames a second with a normal-sized `dt`, and show time stays real time. Where the page forbids workers (a strict content security policy) that fallback is simply absent.
description.zh: 瀏覽器會在分頁被藏起來的時候凍結 `requestAnimationFrame`，但演出不能因為有人切換視窗就停下來。所以迴圈在跑的時候，會有一個 Web Worker 每 33 毫秒跳一下。只要 50 毫秒內沒有收到動畫畫面，迴圈就自己往前走一步。被藏起來的分頁因此大約每秒 15 個畫面，`dt` 大小正常，演出時間仍是真實時間。如果頁面禁止 Worker（嚴格的內容安全政策），這個備援就不存在。

description.en: `loop.fps` is the frame rate, rounded, refreshed about every half second (the very first value comes from the first frame alone); it is 0 before the first frame. `loop.running` says whether it is going.
description.zh: `loop.fps` 是四捨五入後的影格率，大約每半秒更新一次（第一個值只由第一個畫面算出來），在第一個畫面之前是 0。`loop.running` 告訴你它有沒有在跑。

params.name: onFrame
params.en: Called as `onFrame(dt, now)`: `dt` is the seconds since the previous frame (never more than `maxDt`), `now` the time in milliseconds. An error thrown inside is caught and logged as `[loop]`; the clock keeps going.
params.zh: 以 `onFrame(dt, now)` 呼叫：`dt` 是距離上一個畫面的秒數（不會超過 `maxDt`），`now` 是以毫秒計的時間。裡面丟出的錯誤會被接住、記成 `[loop]`，時鐘繼續跑。

params.name: maxDt
params.en: The longest `dt` you will ever be handed, in seconds. A stall (a long garbage collection, a dragged window) is cut to this, so a world never has to cope with a one-second jump.
params.zh: 你拿到的 `dt` 最大值，單位是秒。卡頓（長時間的記憶體回收、被拖動的視窗）會被截成這個值，世界不用處理一秒鐘的跳動。

needs.en: Call `start()`: nothing ticks until you do. It needs a browser (`requestAnimationFrame`, `performance`); in Node there is no clock to run it.
needs.zh: 要呼叫 `start()`，在那之前什麼都不會跳。它需要瀏覽器（`requestAnimationFrame`、`performance`），在 Node 裡沒有時鐘可以讓它跑。

notes.en: Do not read the real clock inside a world: take time from `dt` (or from the timeline), so a show at 30 fps and one at 144 fps do the same thing.
notes.zh: 不要在世界裡讀真實時間，時間請從 `dt`（或時間軸）來，這樣 30 fps 和 144 fps 的演出才會做一樣的事。

caption.en: A clock counts up in the page and stops itself after three seconds.
caption.zh: 頁面上有一個時鐘一直往上數，三秒後自己停下來。

caption.en: A square crosses the canvas at 120 pixels a second, the same speed at any frame rate because it moves by `dt`.
caption.zh: 一個方塊以每秒 120 像素的速度橫過畫布，它是按 `dt` 移動的，所以不管畫面更新率多少，速度都一樣。

summary.en: The values a world listens to: a list of declared params, each resolved every frame from the timeline, unless a hand, a knob or a route has overridden it.
summary.zh: 世界所聽的那些值：一份宣告好的參數清單，每個參數每個畫面都解析成一個數字，除非有手、旋鈕或路由把它蓋掉。

description.en: A param is the way a world takes continuous control: `{ key: 'bloom', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }`. The world never asks who set it. Every frame each param resolves to one number: the **override** if there is one, otherwise the **base** value (usually the [`Timeline`](#Timeline)'s automation at the current time), otherwise `def`. `resolve()` does exactly that and hands the world a `{ key: value }` object.
description.zh: 參數是世界取得連續控制的方式：`{ key: 'bloom', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }`。世界從來不問是誰設定的。每個畫面，每個參數都會解析成一個數字：有**覆寫值**（override）就用覆寫值，否則用**基準值**（通常是 [`Timeline`](#Timeline) 在目前時間的自動化曲線），再不然就用 `def`。`resolve()` 做的就是這件事，把 `{ key: value }` 物件交給世界。

description.en: An override is sticky. After `params.override('bloom', 0.8)` (what a slider, a MIDI knob or a mapped route does) the timeline stops moving `bloom` until `clearOverride('bloom')`. That matches the stage: when a person grabs a control, the score gives way. Overrides are clamped into `min`..`max` and snapped to `step` when they are written.
description.zh: 覆寫是黏住的。`params.override('bloom', 0.8)` 之後（滑桿、MIDI 旋鈕或映射的路由做的就是這個），時間軸就不再動 `bloom`，直到你呼叫 `clearOverride('bloom')`。這跟舞台上的情形一樣：有人抓住控制的時候，樂譜讓路。覆寫值在寫入的時候就會被夾進 `min`..`max`，並對齊 `step`。

description.en: A param with `pulse: true` is a trigger, not a level: nobody reads a value from it. Fire it with `firePulse(key)` (a pad, a route from a pulse signal, a console button) and listen with `onPulse(key, cb)`.
description.zh: `pulse: true` 的參數是觸發器，不是水準值：沒有人從它讀值。用 `firePulse(key)` 觸發它（打擊墊、脈衝訊號的路由、主控台的按鈕），用 `onPulse(key, cb)` 聽它。

description.en: In a show, [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds one `Params` and registers every world's schema into it with `add()`, then returns it as `show.params`.
description.zh: 在演出裡，[`createShow()`](#createShow) 會建好一個 `Params`，用 `add()` 把每個世界的 schema 登記進去，再用 `show.params` 回傳。

params.name: schema
params.en: The param declarations: `{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group? }`. `key` is required; `min`, `max` and `def` give the range and the value when nothing else sets it. The array is kept, not copied.
params.zh: 參數的宣告：`{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group? }`。`key` 一定要有。`min`、`max`、`def` 給出範圍，以及沒人設定時的值。這個陣列是直接拿來用，不會複製。

notes.en: `step` snaps with ordinary floating-point arithmetic: with `step: 0.1`, an override of 0.3 reads back as `0.30000000000000004`. On a timeline a stepped param also holds each keyframe instead of interpolating.
notes.zh: `step` 用一般的浮點數運算對齊：`step: 0.1` 時，覆寫值 0.3 讀回來是 `0.30000000000000004`。在時間軸上，有 `step` 的參數還會停在每個關鍵影格，而不是做內插。

notes.en: `resolve()` does not clamp the base value, only overrides are clamped when written. Keep your automation inside `min`..`max`.
notes.zh: `resolve()` 不會夾基準值，只有覆寫值在寫入時會被夾住。自動化曲線請自己保持在 `min`..`max` 之內。

notes.en: The fields a world may declare (`label`, `options`, `surface`, `group` …) are listed in [Writing a world](https://openaudiovisual.com/docs/#writing-a-world-params).
notes.zh: 世界可以宣告的欄位（`label`、`options`、`surface`、`group` ……）列在[寫一個世界](https://openaudiovisual.com/zh/docs/#writing-a-world-params)。

caption.en: The console prints `0.5`, `0.8`, `0.1`: def, then an override that beats the timeline, then the timeline again.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `0.5`、`0.8`、`0.1`：先是 def，接著是蓋過時間軸的覆寫值，最後時間軸回來了。

caption.en: A stepped param snaps (the console shows `2`) and a pulse param fires its listener (`fired burst`).
caption.zh: 有 `step` 的參數會對齊（主控台顯示 `2`），脈衝參數會觸發它的監聽函式（`fired burst`）。

caption.en: The gotchas: `get()` returns the declaration `{ key, min, max, def }`, an override is clamped to the range (`1`), and an unknown key is silently ignored (`false`).
caption.zh: 幾個陷阱：`get()` 回傳的是宣告 `{ key, min, max, def }`，覆寫值會被夾進範圍（`1`），不認識的 key 會被默默忽略（`false`）。

summary.en: The registry every input writes into and everything else reads from: named values that are either a level (continuous) or an event (pulse).
summary.zh: 所有輸入都寫進去、其他東西都從這裡讀的登錄表：一個個有名字的值，不是持續的數值（continuous），就是一次性的事件（pulse）。

description.en: `new Signals()` makes an empty registry. In a show you rarely build it yourself: [`createShow()`](#createShow) creates one and returns it as `show.signals`. A signal is a name plus a value. Input packages publish with `set()` and `pulse()`; everything else reads with `get()` and `norm()`, or subscribes with `on()` and `onAny()`.
description.zh: `new Signals()` 會做出一個空的登錄表。做演出的時候通常不用自己建：[`createShow()`](#createShow) 會建好一個，用 `show.signals` 回傳給你。一個訊號就是一個名字加一個值。輸入套件用 `set()` 和 `pulse()` 發布。其他東西用 `get()` 和 `norm()` 讀，或用 `on()` 和 `onAny()` 訂閱。

description.en: There are two kinds. A **continuous** signal (the default) always holds a current value, usually between 0 and 1: a knob, the loudness of the room, the height of a wrist. A **pulse** signal (`kind: 'pulse'`) is an event: its value is the payload of the last firing and it is `null` until the first one: a key struck, a kick heard, a pinch started. Read a level whenever you like; subscribe to an event with `on()`.
description.zh: 訊號分兩種。**連續**（continuous，預設）的訊號隨時都有一個目前的值，通常在 0 到 1 之間：旋鈕的位置、房間的音量、手腕的高度。**脈衝**（pulse，寫成 `kind: 'pulse'`）是事件：它的值是最近一次觸發帶的內容，在第一次觸發之前是 `null`：按下一個鍵、聽到一下大鼓、開始一次捏合。水準值想讀就讀。事件用 `on()` 訂閱。

description.en: Names are paths with the source first: `midi/cc/74`, `audio/rms`, `pose/hand/right/y`, `breath/pressure`. Declare a signal with its range before you publish it: `signals.define('breath/pressure', { min: 0, max: 1 })`. `set()` on a name nobody declared defines it on the spot as a continuous signal from 0 to 1, so declare first whenever your numbers are in degrees, MIDI notes or any other range.
description.zh: 名字是「來源在前」的路徑：`midi/cc/74`、`audio/rms`、`pose/hand/right/y`、`breath/pressure`。發布之前先用範圍宣告它：`signals.define('breath/pressure', { min: 0, max: 1 })`。對一個沒人宣告過的名字呼叫 `set()`，會當場把它宣告成 0 到 1 的連續訊號，所以你的數字如果是角度、MIDI 音符號碼或別的範圍，請先宣告。

description.en: A knob, a raised hand and a chord are equal citizens here. Whoever reads a signal (the [`Mapper`](#Mapper), a world that listens for events, the monitor) does not know and does not care what produced it.
description.zh: 旋鈕、舉起的手、一個和弦，在這裡地位相同。讀訊號的一方（[`Mapper`](#Mapper)、聽事件的世界、後台監看）不知道也不在乎是什麼產生它。

notes.en: `signals.meta` is a `Map` of name → declaration and `signals.values` a `Map` of name → last value. Read them if you must; write through `define()` and `set()` so subscribers hear about it.
notes.zh: `signals.meta` 是「名字 → 宣告」的 `Map`，`signals.values` 是「名字 → 最近的值」的 `Map`。需要的話可以讀，要寫請透過 `define()` 和 `set()`，訂閱者才聽得到。

notes.en: A subscriber that throws is caught and logged as `[signals] <name>`; the other subscribers still run and `set()` does not throw.
notes.zh: 訂閱者丟出錯誤會被接住、記成 `[signals] <名字>`，其他訂閱者照常執行，`set()` 也不會丟錯。

notes.en: The names every built-in package publishes are listed in [the signals reference](https://openaudiovisual.com/docs/#signals).
notes.zh: 每個內建套件發布的訊號名稱，都列在[訊號參考](https://openaudiovisual.com/zh/docs/#signals)。

caption.en: Open the console: it prints `pressure 0.4`, because the subscriber ran as soon as the value was set.
caption.zh: 打開主控台：會印出 `pressure 0.4`，因為值一設定，訂閱者就跟著執行。

caption.en: A level and an event side by side: the console shows `25 0.75`, then `sigh { depth: 0.8 }`.
caption.zh: 一個水準值和一個事件並排：主控台先印出 `25 0.75`，再印出 `sigh { depth: 0.8 }`。

caption.en: The gotcha: an undeclared signal is 0..1, so 12 reads as 1. Declare the range and the same value reads 0.6 (the console shows `1`, then `0.6`).
caption.zh: 陷阱：沒宣告的訊號範圍是 0..1，所以 12 會讀成 1。把範圍宣告好，同一個值就讀成 0.6（主控台先印 `1`，再印 `0.6`）。

entries.name: createShow
entries.signature: async createShow({ world = null, worlds = [], timeline: timelineCfg = { total: 120 }, routes = [], modules = {}, artwork = null, hint = '', profile = null, map = null, onFrame = null, mount = null, telemetry = true, score: scoreCfg = null, } = {})

summary.en: Builds a whole show around a world in one call: signals, params, stage, timeline, mapper, the modules you switch on, the console, the backstage feed and the frame loop.
summary.zh: 一個呼叫就替世界組好整場演出：訊號、參數、舞台、時間軸、映射、你開啟的模組、控台、後台資料和影格迴圈。

description.en: Every example is a world plus one `createShow()` call. It builds the [`Signals`](#Signals) registry, the [`Params`](#Params), the [`Stage`](#Stage) with your world, the [`Timeline`](#Timeline), the [`Mapper`](#Mapper) (with your `routes`), the inputs and outputs you declare in `modules`, the director's desk ([`mountConsole()`](#mountConsole)), the backstage feed ([`MonitorFeed`](#MonitorFeed)) and the frame [`Loop`](#Loop), starts the loop, and hands you every part. Nothing is hidden: `show.signals`, `show.params`, `show.timeline`, `show.mapper`, `show.stage` and the rest are the very objects the frame loop runs. When the framework grows a module, every show can have it just by declaring it.
description.zh: 每個範例都是一個世界加上一次 `createShow()` 呼叫。它建好 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表、[`Params`](#Params)、放著你的世界的 [`Stage`](#Stage)、[`Timeline`](#Timeline)、[`Mapper`](#Mapper)（帶著你的 `routes`）、你在 `modules` 宣告的輸入與輸出、導演控台（[`mountConsole()`](#mountConsole)）、後台資料（[`MonitorFeed`](#MonitorFeed)）和影格 [`Loop`](#Loop)，啟動迴圈，再把每個部分交給你。什麼都沒有藏起來：`show.signals`、`show.params`、`show.timeline`、`show.mapper`、`show.stage` 這些，就是影格迴圈實際在跑的那些物件。框架多了一個模組的時候，每場演出只要宣告就能用上。

description.en: The `modules` keys: `midi` (on by default, `false` turns it off, `{ controllers: true }` or `{ controllers: { profile, profiles, open } }` docks an on-screen MIDI controller), `keys` (the on-screen piano, QWERTY and the simulated performer: on by default, `false` turns them off, `{ base, octaves, sim, capture }` tunes them), `drums` (`true` or `{ engine, autoEnableEngine }`), `audio` (any truthy value: the microphone analyser, started from the 🎤 button), `chord` (`true` or `{ window }`: a [`ChordDetector`](#ChordDetector) wired to every played note), `hands` (`true`: [`HandTracker`](#HandTracker)), `pose` (`true`: [`PoseTracker`](#PoseTracker)), `leap` (`true` or `{ url, simulate, fingers, box }`: [`LeapInput`](#LeapInput); `?leap=sim` or `?leap=ws://…` in the address overrides), `remote` (`true` or `{ room, … }`: phones as controllers) and `sound` (`true`, an instrument id such as `'piano'`, or `{ instrument, remember, picker, engine }`: instruments in the page, loaded only when declared). Parts that fetch things load lazily, so a show that does not declare them pays nothing.
description.zh: `modules` 的鍵：`midi`（預設開啟，`false` 關掉，`{ controllers: true }` 或 `{ controllers: { profile, profiles, open } }` 會在舞台上停靠一個螢幕上的 MIDI 控制器）、`keys`（螢幕鋼琴、電腦鍵盤和模擬演奏者：預設開啟，`false` 關掉，`{ base, octaves, sim, capture }` 可調整）、`drums`（`true` 或 `{ engine, autoEnableEngine }`）、`audio`（任何真值：麥克風分析器，從 🎤 按鈕啟動）、`chord`（`true` 或 `{ window }`：接上每個被彈奏的音的 [`ChordDetector`](#ChordDetector)）、`hands`（`true`：[`HandTracker`](#HandTracker)）、`pose`（`true`：[`PoseTracker`](#PoseTracker)）、`leap`（`true` 或 `{ url, simulate, fingers, box }`：[`LeapInput`](#LeapInput)，網址上的 `?leap=sim` 或 `?leap=ws://…` 可以覆寫）、`remote`（`true` 或 `{ room, … }`：把手機當控制器）和 `sound`（`true`、像 `'piano'` 這樣的樂器 id，或 `{ instrument, remember, picker, engine }`：頁面內的樂器，宣告了才會載入）。需要下載東西的部分都是延遲載入，所以沒宣告的演出不會付出任何代價。

description.en:
The page shell is fixed once so every show is the same. Without `mount`, the page body becomes a two-column grid: the stage, and a 340 px side panel holding the piano and the console (an upright phone gets the stage on top and the panel below: see [`isStacked()`](#isStacked)). Every frame, in this order:

```text
keys, drums, audio update   on-screen performers and the microphone
onFrame(dt, show)           your hook
timeline.advance(dt)        time moves
director.update(...)        with a score: segment modules enter, update, exit
mapper.update(dt)           smoothed routes settle
stage.frame(dt, state)      params resolve, world updates and renders
sound, remote               sound params reach the synth, values echo to phones
console.render(state)       the desk reflects reality
monitor.frame(snapshot)     the backstage hears about it
```
description.zh:
頁面外殼只固定一次，所以每場演出都一樣。沒有 `mount` 的話，頁面的 body 會變成兩欄的格線：舞台，以及放著鋼琴和控台的 340 像素側邊面板（直立的手機則是舞台在上、面板在下：見 [`isStacked()`](#isStacked)）。每個畫面依這個順序做事：

```text
keys, drums, audio update   on-screen performers and the microphone
onFrame(dt, show)           your hook
timeline.advance(dt)        time moves
director.update(...)        with a score: segment modules enter, update, exit
mapper.update(dt)           smoothed routes settle
stage.frame(dt, state)      params resolve, world updates and renders
sound, remote               sound params reach the synth, values echo to phones
console.render(state)       the desk reflects reality
monitor.frame(snapshot)     the backstage hears about it
```

params.name: world
params.en: The world to perform: `{ name, params, init, update, render, dispose }` (see [`Stage`](#Stage)). It is activated first, and `createShow` waits for its `init()`.
params.zh: 要表演的世界：`{ name, params, init, update, render, dispose }`（見 [`Stage`](#Stage)）。它會最先被啟用，`createShow` 會等它的 `init()` 完成。

params.name: worlds
params.en: More worlds to register, after `world`. All of their params are registered up front; switch with `show.stage.activate(name)`.
params.zh: `world` 之外要登記的更多世界。它們的參數會全部先登記好。用 `show.stage.activate(name)` 切換。

params.name: timeline
params.en: The options of the [`Timeline`](#Timeline): `{ total, automation, scenes, start, loop, onCue }`. With a `score`, its scenes and total win.
params.zh: [`Timeline`](#Timeline) 的選項：`{ total, automation, scenes, start, loop, onCue }`。有 `score` 的時候，以它的場景和總長為準。

params.name: routes
params.en: Routes for the [`Mapper`](#Mapper). If a saved profile exists it is loaded, and any declared route whose `source → target` pair is missing from it is still added.
params.zh: 給 [`Mapper`](#Mapper) 的路由。如果有存起來的 profile 就會載入，其中沒有的 `source → target` 組合，仍然會把你宣告的路由補進去。

params.name: modules
params.en: The inputs and outputs to switch on, by key (see the description): `midi`, `keys`, `drums`, `audio`, `chord`, `hands`, `pose`, `leap`, `remote`, `sound`.
params.zh: 要開啟的輸入與輸出，用鍵名指定（見說明）：`midi`、`keys`、`drums`、`audio`、`chord`、`hands`、`pose`、`leap`、`remote`、`sound`。

params.name: artwork
params.en: `{ title, artist, year, note }`: a credit line at the bottom right of the stage and a `<meta name="artwork">` tag in the head.
params.zh: `{ title, artist, year, note }`：舞台右下角的一行作品署名，以及 `<head>` 裡的 `<meta name="artwork">` 標籤。

params.name: hint
params.en: A line of **HTML** at the bottom left of the stage, for example `'play the piano · Space plays the timeline'`. It is inserted as HTML, so never put untrusted text in it.
params.zh: 舞台左下角的一行 **HTML**，例如 `'play the piano · Space plays the timeline'`。它是當成 HTML 插入的，所以千萬別放來路不明的文字。

params.name: profile
params.en: The name the mapper saves its routes under in `localStorage` (default: the first world's name, else `'show'`). `false` ignores the saved routes when the show starts, so the routes come from your code on every load.
params.zh: 映射在 `localStorage` 儲存路由時用的名字（預設是第一個世界的名字，再不然是 `'show'`）。`false` 會在演出開始時忽略存起來的路由，所以每次載入路由都來自你的程式。

params.name: map
params.en: A map file to load on start: a same-origin or https address (see [`loadMapUrl()`](#loadMapUrl)). Left out, `?map=<url>` in the page address is used; `false` ignores `?map=`.
params.zh: 開始時要載入的映射檔：同源或 https 的網址（見 [`loadMapUrl()`](#loadMapUrl)）。沒寫的話，使用頁面網址上的 `?map=<url>`。`false` 會忽略 `?map=`。

params.name: onFrame
params.en: Called as `onFrame(dt, show)` every frame, after the on-screen performers and the microphone update and **before** the timeline advances. The place for assembly-level logic such as envelopes, or `osc.flush()`.
params.zh: 每個畫面以 `onFrame(dt, show)` 呼叫，在螢幕上的演奏者和麥克風更新之後、時間軸前進**之前**。適合放組裝層級的邏輯，例如包絡，或 `osc.flush()`。

params.name: mount
params.en: `{ stage, side }`: elements or selectors to render into instead of the generated full-page layout.
params.zh: `{ stage, side }`：要渲染進去的元素或選擇器，取代自動產生的全頁面版面。

params.name: telemetry
params.en: Allow one anonymous `oav_show_start` hit per page load. `false` sends nothing.
params.zh: 是否允許每次載入頁面送出一次匿名的 `oav_show_start`。`false` 什麼都不送。

params.name: score
params.en: `{ cuts, cut, modules, api, onStatus, onCue, maxStep, midi }`: the show's structure as segment lengths, performed by segment modules (see [`Score`](#Score) and [`Director`](#Director)). `?cut=<id>` in the page address picks the version.
params.zh: `{ cuts, cut, modules, api, onStatus, onCue, maxStep, midi }`：以段落長度寫成的演出結構，由段落模組表演（見 [`Score`](#Score) 和 [`Director`](#Director)）。頁面網址上的 `?cut=<id>` 可以選版本。

returns.en: The show: `{ signals, params, stage, timeline, mapper, midi, controllers, midiPanel, keys, drums, sound, audio, hands, pose, leap, chord, remote, score, director, scoreMidi, console, app, loop }`. A part you did not ask for is `null`. With a `score` there is also `show.show`, the rehearsal controls. The same object is `window.openav`.
returns.zh: 演出物件：`{ signals, params, stage, timeline, mapper, midi, controllers, midiPanel, keys, drums, sound, audio, hands, pose, leap, chord, remote, score, director, scoreMidi, console, app, loop }`。沒有要求的部分是 `null`。有 `score` 的時候還有 `show.show`，也就是排練用的控制。同一個物件也是 `window.openav`。

needs.en: `await` it: it is async because it waits for the world's `init()` (and for lazily loaded modules). It needs a page (`document`, `location`, `localStorage`), and an import map or bundler that resolves every `@openav/*` package it imports (copy the one from `examples/01-hello-particles/index.html`). Browsers start audio only after a click, so sound and the microphone start from the console's buttons.
needs.zh: 要 `await` 它：它是非同步的，因為要等世界的 `init()`（和延遲載入的模組）完成。它需要一個頁面（`document`、`location`、`localStorage`），還要有能解析它所匯入的每個 `@openav/*` 套件的 import map 或打包工具（可以複製 `examples/01-hello-particles/index.html` 裡的那份）。瀏覽器要等點擊之後才會啟動聲音，所以聲音和麥克風要從控台的按鈕啟動。

notes.en: The mapper saves its routes under the profile name every 3 seconds, so a learned or edited route survives a reload and **wins over a changed declaration in your code** (the same `source → target` pair keeps its saved curve and smoothing). `profile: false` makes the routes come from code on every load, but the mapper still saves under the world's name from then on. To start clean, `localStorage.removeItem('openav.map.<world name>')`.
notes.zh: 映射每 3 秒把路由存在 profile 名稱底下，所以學來的或改過的路由，重新載入之後還在，而且**會贏過你在程式裡改過的宣告**（同一個 `source → target` 組合會保留存起來的曲線和平滑）。`profile: false` 讓路由每次載入都來自程式，但映射之後仍然會用世界的名字存檔。要從頭開始，執行 `localStorage.removeItem('openav.map.<世界名稱>')`。

notes.en: Routes are added before the sound engine registers its `sound/*` params, so a declared route to `sound/cutoff` needs an explicit `outMin: 100, outMax: 8000`.
notes.zh: 路由加進去的時間比聲音引擎登記 `sound/*` 參數還早，所以宣告接到 `sound/cutoff` 的路由要明確寫上 `outMin: 100, outMax: 8000`。

notes.en: `show.params.resolve()` without an argument gives the `def` of every param. To read what the world sees this frame, pass the timeline's base state: `show.params.resolve(show.timeline.state())`.
notes.zh: `show.params.resolve()` 不給參數的話，回傳的是每個參數的 `def`。想讀世界這個畫面看到的值，要傳入時間軸的基準狀態：`show.params.resolve(show.timeline.state())`。

notes.en: Unless `telemetry: false`, one anonymous `oav_show_start` hit goes to Google Analytics per page load. Per the code it is silent on localhost, LAN addresses, `file://` and openaudiovisual.com itself, and it honours Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control. Nothing played, no path, no cookie and no stable id is sent.
notes.zh: 除非 `telemetry: false`，每次載入頁面會有一次匿名的 `oav_show_start` 送到 Google Analytics。依程式碼，在 localhost、區域網路位址、`file://` 和 openaudiovisual.com 本身都不會送，也尊重 Do Not Track 和 Global Privacy Control。彈了什麼、頁面路徑、cookie 和固定的識別碼都不會送。

notes.en: With a `score`, `window.openav.show` has `table()`, `goto('dusk')`, `goto('dusk.glow')`, `goto(2)`, `seek(T)`, `cue(name)`, `status()`, `next()`, `prev()` and `cuts`, for rehearsal from the devtools console.
notes.zh: 有 `score` 的時候，`window.openav.show` 有 `table()`、`goto('dusk')`、`goto('dusk.glow')`、`goto(2)`、`seek(T)`、`cue(name)`、`status()`、`next()`、`prev()` 和 `cuts`，可以在開發者工具的主控台排練。

caption.en: A blue dot on the stage grows slowly while the timeline plays, with the desk (transport, layers, the `size` slider) on the right. The console prints `23 true`: twenty-three parts, and the timeline is playing.
caption.zh: 舞台上的藍色圓點隨時間軸播放慢慢變大，右邊是控台（播放控制、圖層、`size` 推桿）。主控台印出 `23 true`：二十三個部分，時間軸正在播放。

caption.en: A signal drives a param through a route: the console prints `true 0.9`, then `burst!` as the pad crosses 0.5, then `the world heard 0.9`.
caption.zh: 一個訊號透過路由驅動一個參數：主控台印出 `true 0.9`，接著是墊子越過 0.5 時的 `burst!`，最後是 `the world heard 0.9`。

caption.en: With a score the timeline takes its length from it: the console prints `20 20`, then `dusk enters` after the jump, and `dusk 10`.
caption.zh: 有總譜的時候，時間軸的長度由它決定：主控台印出 `20 20`，跳轉之後印出 `dusk enters`，最後是 `dusk 10`。

caption.en: The whole set: an on-screen piano, chord analysis, the microphone and a grand piano that sounds after a click on the console's sound button. Play a chord and the console prints its type (`major`).
caption.zh: 完整的一套：螢幕鋼琴、和弦分析、麥克風，以及在控台上按一下聲音按鈕之後就會發聲的平台鋼琴。彈一個和弦，主控台就印出它的類型（`major`）。

tbd.en: The modules that need hardware, a permission or a download (microphone, camera, Leap, phones, the Tone.js sound engine, a MIDI device) were not run here; they are described from the code and the package docs. The examples switch `midi` and `keys` off so that they run anywhere.
tbd.zh: 需要硬體、權限或下載的模組（麥克風、鏡頭、Leap、手機、Tone.js 聲音引擎、MIDI 裝置）沒有在這裡跑過，說明是根據程式碼和套件文件寫的。範例把 `midi` 和 `keys` 關掉，這樣在哪裡都能跑。

summary.en: Whether a window of this size gets the stacked layout (stage on top, panel below): upright and no wider than 820 pixels.
summary.zh: 這個大小的視窗會不會用堆疊版面（舞台在上、面板在下）：直立的、而且寬度不超過 820 像素。

description.en: The shell of [`createShow()`](#createShow) has one layout rule: wide windows get the stage and a 340 px side panel next to each other, and an upright phone or small tablet gets the stage on top and the panel below it, scrolling. The rule is the media query [`STACK_QUERY`](#STACK_QUERY), and `isStacked()` is the very same decision as a plain function, so a test (or your own layout code) can use it without a browser. A phone on its side is never taller than wide, so it stays in the wide layout.
description.zh: [`createShow()`](#createShow) 的外殼只有一條版面規則：寬的視窗是舞台和 340 像素的側邊面板並排，直立的手機或小平板則是舞台在上、面板在下並可以捲動。規則就是媒體查詢 [`STACK_QUERY`](#STACK_QUERY)，而 `isStacked()` 是同一個判斷的純函式版本，所以測試（或你自己的版面程式）不用瀏覽器也能用。橫放的手機高度不會比寬度大，所以仍然是寬版面。

params.name: width
params.en: The window width in pixels.
params.zh: 視窗寬度，單位是像素。

params.name: height
params.en: The window height in pixels.
params.zh: 視窗高度，單位是像素。

returns.en: `true` when `width <= 820` and `height > width`.
returns.zh: `width <= 820` 而且 `height > width` 的時候是 `true`。

examples.code:
import { isStacked, stageHeight } from '@openav/show/layout';

console.log(isStacked(390, 844));     // true: a phone held upright
console.log(isStacked(844, 390));     // false: the same phone on its side
console.log(isStacked(820, 1180));    // true: a small tablet held upright
console.log(isStacked(1024, 1366));   // false: wider than 820, even though it is upright
console.log(stageHeight(844));        // 490: the stage keeps 58% of the window height

caption.en: The console prints `true`, `false`, `true`, `false`, then `490`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `true`、`false`、`true`、`false`，然後是 `490`。

entries.name: SHELL_CSS
entries.signature: SHELL_CSS = "\n  body { margin: 0; background: #000; height: 100vh; display: grid;\n    grid…"

summary.en: The CSS text `createShow()` puts in the page: the two-column grid, the 340 px side panel, the hint and credit styles, and the stacked layout.
summary.zh: `createShow()` 放進頁面的 CSS 文字：兩欄格線、340 像素的側邊面板、提示與署名的樣式，以及堆疊版面。

description.en: A string. `createShow()` adds it once as `<style id="openav-shell-css">` (unless one with that id is already there). It sets the page body to a grid of the stage and a 340 px side panel, with the classes `.oav-stage`, `.oav-side`, `.oav-keys-slot`, `.oav-desk`, `.oav-hint` and `.oav-credit`, and the stacked layout from [`STACK_QUERY`](#STACK_QUERY). Read it to see what the shell does to your page, or add a `<style id="openav-shell-css">` of your own before calling `createShow()` to replace it entirely.
description.zh: 一個字串。`createShow()` 會把它用 `<style id="openav-shell-css">` 加進頁面一次（除非已經有同 id 的）。它把頁面 body 設成舞台加上 340 像素側邊面板的格線，用到 `.oav-stage`、`.oav-side`、`.oav-keys-slot`、`.oav-desk`、`.oav-hint` 和 `.oav-credit` 這些 class，以及來自 [`STACK_QUERY`](#STACK_QUERY) 的堆疊版面。想知道外殼對你的頁面做了什麼就讀它。或在呼叫 `createShow()` 之前，自己先放一個 `<style id="openav-shell-css">`，就能整個取代它。

caption.en: The console prints `true true true`, then the first lines of the stylesheet (the body grid).
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `true true true`，接著是樣式表最前面的幾行（body 的格線）。

summary.en: The widest window that can get the stacked layout: 820 pixels (a small tablet held upright).
summary.zh: 能用堆疊版面的最寬視窗：820 像素（直立的小平板）。

description.en: Used inside [`STACK_QUERY`](#STACK_QUERY) and [`isStacked()`](#isStacked), so the CSS rule and the function cannot drift apart. Above 820 pixels the stage and the 340 px panel always sit side by side.
description.zh: 用在 [`STACK_QUERY`](#STACK_QUERY) 和 [`isStacked()`](#isStacked) 裡面，所以 CSS 規則和函式不會彼此走樣。超過 820 像素，舞台和 340 像素的面板一律是並排的。

summary.en: The media query behind the stacked layout: `(max-width: 820px) and (orientation: portrait)`.
summary.zh: 堆疊版面背後的媒體查詢：`(max-width: 820px) and (orientation: portrait)`。

description.en: It is a string you can hand to `matchMedia()` to ask the browser the same question the shell's CSS asks: `matchMedia(STACK_QUERY).matches`. [`isStacked(width, height)`](#isStacked) is the same decision from numbers.
description.zh: 這是一個字串，可以交給 `matchMedia()`，問瀏覽器跟外殼的 CSS 同一個問題：`matchMedia(STACK_QUERY).matches`。[`isStacked(width, height)`](#isStacked) 是用數字做的同一個判斷。

caption.en: The console prints the query and whether this window matches it (usually `false` on a desktop); the last line logs again whenever the window is resized across the rule.
caption.zh: 主控台印出這個查詢，以及目前的視窗符不符合（在桌機上通常是 `false`）。最後一行在視窗大小跨過這條規則的時候會再印一次。

summary.en: How much of the window height the stage keeps when the layout is stacked: 58 (percent).
summary.zh: 版面堆疊的時候，舞台保有視窗高度的多少：58（百分比）。

description.en: The stage must stay the main thing on a phone, so it keeps 58% of the height and the console below it scrolls. [`stageHeight()`](#stageHeight) turns this number into pixels.
description.zh: 在手機上，舞台必須仍然是主角，所以它保有 58% 的高度，下方的控台可以捲動。[`stageHeight()`](#stageHeight) 把這個數字換算成像素。

summary.en: The stage height in pixels for a window of this height when the layout is stacked: 58% of it, rounded.
summary.zh: 版面堆疊的時候，這個高度的視窗裡舞台的高度（像素）：它的 58%，四捨五入。

description.en: When the shell stacks, the stage must stay the main thing, so it takes [`STAGE_SHARE`](#STAGE_SHARE) percent of the window height (the CSS uses `58vh`, and `58dvh` where the browser has it) and the panel gets the rest. This is the same number as a function, for tests and your own layout code.
description.zh: 外殼堆疊的時候，舞台必須仍然是主角，所以它佔視窗高度的 [`STAGE_SHARE`](#STAGE_SHARE) 百分比（CSS 用 `58vh`，瀏覽器支援的話用 `58dvh`），面板拿剩下的。這是同一個數字的函式版本，給測試和你自己的版面程式用。

params.name: height
params.en: The window height in pixels.
params.zh: 視窗高度，單位是像素。

returns.en: A number: `Math.round(height * 58 / 100)`.
returns.zh: 一個數字：`Math.round(height * 58 / 100)`。

examples.code:
import { stageHeight } from '@openav/show/layout';

for (const height of [667, 844, 1180]) console.log(height, stageHeight(height));   // 667 387, 844 490, 1180 684

caption.en: The console prints `667 387`, `844 490` and `1180 684`.

summary.en: Makes a 2D canvas that fills its container and keeps its size in step with it, at up to 2 times the device pixel ratio.
summary.zh: 做出一個填滿容器、並隨容器大小調整的 2D 畫布，解析度最高到裝置像素比的 2 倍。

description.en: A convenience for worlds that draw with the 2D canvas API; a world may use it or ignore it. The canvas is `display: block` and as big as the container. `fit()` sets its pixel size to the container size times the device pixel ratio (never more than 2) and scales the context so you keep drawing in CSS pixels. Call `fit()` at the top of `render()`: it only does work when the size changed, and it returns `{ w, h }` to draw with. A `ResizeObserver` also calls it when the container is resized.
description.zh: 給用 2D 畫布 API 繪圖的世界的小幫手。世界可以用，也可以不用。畫布是 `display: block`，跟容器一樣大。`fit()` 把它的像素大小設成容器大小乘以裝置像素比（最多 2），並縮放 context，讓你繼續用 CSS 像素繪圖。在 `render()` 開頭呼叫 `fit()`：只有大小改變時它才會做事，而且會回傳畫圖要用的 `{ w, h }`。容器改變大小時，`ResizeObserver` 也會呼叫它。

description.en: Call `dispose()` in the world's `dispose()`: it stops the observer and removes the canvas.
description.zh: 在世界的 `dispose()` 裡呼叫 `dispose()`：它會停掉觀察器並移除畫布。

params.name: container
params.en: The element to put the canvas in (a world's `container`, usually).
params.zh: 要放畫布的元素（通常是世界的 `container`）。

params.name: alpha
params.en: Whether the canvas may be transparent. The default `false` is faster and gives an opaque canvas.
params.zh: 畫布可不可以是透明的。預設 `false` 比較快，畫布是不透明的。

returns.en: `{ canvas, ctx, fit, dispose }`: the `<canvas>`, its 2D context, `fit()` and `dispose()`. `fit()` returns `{ w, h }`, the container size in CSS pixels.
returns.zh: `{ canvas, ctx, fit, dispose }`：`<canvas>`、它的 2D context、`fit()` 和 `dispose()`。`fit()` 回傳 `{ w, h }`，也就是容器以 CSS 像素計的大小。

notes.en: If the container has no height (an empty `<div>` in normal flow is 0 pixels tall), the canvas is 0 × 0 and nothing shows. Give the container a size, or use it inside a [`Stage`](#Stage), whose layer fills the stage.
notes.zh: 如果容器沒有高度（一般排版流程裡的空 `<div>` 高度是 0 像素），畫布就是 0 × 0，什麼都看不到。請給容器一個大小，或是用在 [`Stage`](#Stage) 裡，它的圖層會填滿舞台。

caption.en: A blue square slides left and right across a canvas that fills a 200-pixel-high strip of the page, and stays sharp when the window is resized.
caption.zh: 一個藍色方塊在填滿頁面 200 像素高橫條的畫布上左右滑動，視窗大小改變時依然清晰。

entries.name: Stage
entries.signature: new Stage({ container, params, signals, io = {} })

summary.en: Runs one world at a time: registers worlds and their params, switches between them, and each frame resolves the params and calls the world's `update` and `render`.
summary.zh: 一次執行一個世界：登記世界和它們的參數、在世界之間切換，並在每個畫面解析參數、呼叫世界的 `update` 和 `render`。

description.en:
A **world** is any system with this shape, and every method is optional:

```js
{
  name: 'garden',                                   // unique: the stage registers worlds by name
  params: [{ key: 'growth', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }],   // what it can be performed with
  init({ container, signals, params }) {},           // when it becomes active (may be async)
  update(dt, state, io) {},                          // every frame: state = the resolved params
```
