```js
  render() {},                                       // every frame, right after update
  dispose() {},                                      // when another world is activated
}
```

The stage owns the lifecycle and the param aggregation and deliberately **not** a renderer: draw with a 2D canvas, p5, three.js, SVG, the DOM, whatever you like. The shell never knows the work: switching works means swapping the world and its data, and the shell stays.
description.zh:
**世界**就是任何符合這個形狀的系統，每個方法都是選填的：

```js
{
  name: 'garden',                                   // unique: the stage registers worlds by name
  params: [{ key: 'growth', min: 0, max: 1, def: 0.5 }],   // what it can be performed with
  init({ container, signals, params }) {},           // when it becomes active (may be async)
  update(dt, state, io) {},                          // every frame: state = the resolved params
  render() {},                                       // every frame, right after update
  dispose() {},                                      // when another world is activated
}
```

舞台負責生命週期和參數的彙整，而刻意**不**負責繪圖：用 2D 畫布、p5、three.js、SVG、DOM，隨你高興。外殼永遠不知道作品是什麼：換作品就是換掉世界和它的資料，外殼不動。

description.en: A world takes continuous control from `state` (the params) and may subscribe to `signals` for discrete events (a note struck, a chord resolved). If it reads `signals.get('midi/cc/74')` inside `update()`, it works with your controller today, but the timeline, a hand or another controller can no longer drive it. In a show, [`createShow()`](#createShow) builds the stage from its `world` and `worlds` options and returns it as `show.stage`.
description.zh: 世界從 `state`（參數）取得連續控制，可以訂閱 `signals` 來接離散事件（按下一個音、一個和弦解決）。如果它在 `update()` 裡讀 `signals.get('midi/cc/74')`，今天用你的控制器是行的，但時間軸、手或別的控制器就再也驅動不了它。在演出裡，[`createShow()`](#createShow) 依 `world` 和 `worlds` 選項建好舞台，用 `show.stage` 回傳。

params.name: container
params.en: The element the worlds draw into. It becomes `position: relative` if it was static. The stage adds its own layer inside it, so overlays you put in the container (hints, start buttons) are not wiped when a world is switched.
params.zh: 世界要畫進去的元素。如果它原本是 static，會被改成 `position: relative`。舞台會在裡面加一個自己的圖層，所以你放在容器裡的覆蓋物（提示、開始按鈕）在切換世界的時候不會被清掉。

params.name: params
params.en: The [`Params`](#Params) the worlds' schemas are absorbed into, and that `frame()` resolves.
params.zh: 世界的 schema 要併進去、也是 `frame()` 要解析的 [`Params`](#Params)。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals) registry handed to every world, so it can subscribe to events.
params.zh: 交給每個世界的 [`Signals`](#Signals) 登錄表，讓世界可以訂閱事件。

params.name: io
params.en: Extra output handles for the worlds' `update(dt, state, io)`, such as `{ midi, osc }`. `signals` is always there.
params.zh: 給世界的 `update(dt, state, io)` 用的額外輸出把手，例如 `{ midi, osc }`。`signals` 一定在裡面。

needs.en: Register your worlds, then `await stage.activate(name)` once; until a world is active, `frame()` returns `null` and does nothing. Then call `stage.frame(dt, baseState)` every frame (a show's loop does).
needs.zh: 先登記你的世界，再 `await stage.activate(name)` 一次。在有世界啟用之前，`frame()` 會回傳 `null`，什麼都不做。之後每個畫面呼叫 `stage.frame(dt, baseState)`（演出的迴圈會做）。

notes.en: Check the name before you activate: `activate('nope')` disposes the current world **first** and only then rejects, and the stage keeps pointing at the disposed world (`active` and `activeName` do not change), so the next `frame()` still calls its `update()` and `render()`.
notes.zh: 啟用之前請先確認名字：`activate('nope')` 會**先**讓目前的世界 dispose，之後才被拒絕，而舞台仍然指著那個已經 dispose 的世界（`active` 和 `activeName` 沒有改變），所以下一次 `frame()` 還是會呼叫它的 `update()` 和 `render()`。

notes.en: Fields to read: `active` (the active world object), `activeName`, `worlds` (a `Map` of name → world), `container`, `layer` (the element worlds are placed in) and `io` (`{ signals, ...io }`, what `update` receives; add handles later with `stage.io.osc = osc`).
notes.zh: 可以讀的欄位：`active`（目前啟用的世界物件）、`activeName`、`worlds`（名字對應世界的 `Map`）、`container`、`layer`（世界被放進去的元素），以及 `io`（`{ signals, ...io }`，也就是 `update` 收到的東西，之後可以用 `stage.io.osc = osc` 補上把手）。

notes.en: An exception in `init()` is not caught: `activate()` rejects. Exceptions in `update()` and `render()` are caught. A world must release what it takes (GPU objects, DOM, subscriptions) in `dispose()`, because worlds get switched live.
notes.zh: `init()` 裡的例外不會被接住：`activate()` 會被拒絕。`update()` 和 `render()` 裡的例外會被接住。世界必須在 `dispose()` 裡釋放它拿走的東西（GPU 物件、DOM、訂閱），因為世界是可以現場切換的。

caption.en: The console prints `{ size: 40 }`, then `{ size: 20 }`, and the page shows the text `size 20` in blue: the world drew itself from the resolved params.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `{ size: 40 }`，然後是 `{ size: 20 }`，頁面上用藍色顯示文字 `size 20`：世界依解析後的參數畫出了自己。

caption.en: The console prints `calm init`, `calm dispose`, `storm init`, then `storm 1` (the shared param is registered once), then `storm dispose` and the error message for an unknown world: the failed switch has already disposed the world that was playing.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `calm init`、`calm dispose`、`storm init`，然後是 `storm 1`（共用的參數只登記一次），接著是 `storm dispose` 和未知世界的錯誤訊息：失敗的切換已經先讓正在跑的世界 dispose 了。

members.name: register
members.doc: Register a world and absorb its param schema.

members.name: activate
members.doc: Switch active world (disposes the previous one).

members.name: frame
members.doc: Per-frame: resolve params → world.update → world.render.

entries.name: webtoeWorld
entries.signature: webtoeWorld({ name = 'webtoe', app = 'https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/', project = null, params = [], extra = null, } = {})

summary.en: Turns a WebToe node patch into a world: the patch runs in an iframe and every changed param is posted into it.
summary.zh: 把一份 WebToe 節點圖變成世界：節點圖在 iframe 裡執行，每個改變的參數都會被送進去。

description.en: [WebToe](https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/) is the sister project: a web-native, node-based dataflow engine that speaks TouchDesigner. `webtoeWorld()` embeds its app in an iframe that fills the stage (with `allow="camera; microphone"`), and each frame it posts the resolved params into the iframe as `{ type: 'webtoe:ext', values }`. Inside the patch, any parameter written as `ext('name', fallback)` follows the value called `name`, and uses `fallback` until one arrives.
description.zh: [WebToe](https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/) 是姊妹專案：一個網頁原生、以節點為基礎的資料流引擎，講的是 TouchDesigner 的語言。`webtoeWorld()` 把它的應用程式嵌進一個填滿舞台的 iframe（帶著 `allow="camera; microphone"`），每個畫面把解析後的參數用 `{ type: 'webtoe:ext', values }` 送進 iframe。節點圖裡，任何寫成 `ext('name', fallback)` 的參數，都會跟著名為 `name` 的值走，在值抵達之前用 `fallback`。

description.en: The contract stays pure: the world reads params and never inputs. Which knob, hand or timeline drives `speed` is the mapper's business, as for any world. To send less, the world posts only when at least one value differs from the last post.
description.zh: 約定維持純粹：世界讀的是參數，從不讀輸入。是哪個旋鈕、手或時間軸在驅動 `speed`，是映射的事，跟任何世界一樣。為了少送一點，世界只在至少有一個值跟上一次送出的不同時才會送。

params.name: name
params.en: The world's name: what [`Stage`](#Stage) registers it under and what you pass to `stage.activate()`. Give each patch its own.
params.zh: 世界的名字：[`Stage`](#Stage) 用它來登記，`stage.activate()` 也是傳它。每份節點圖請取自己的名字。

params.name: app
params.en: The WebToe app to embed in the iframe. Change it to run your own copy of the app.
params.zh: 要嵌進 iframe 的 WebToe 應用程式。改它就能跑你自己那一份。

params.name: project
params.en: The address of a `.webtoe.json` patch file. It is handed to the app as `?project=<address>`, and the app fetches it, so the file's server must allow the app's origin (CORS). Make the address absolute, for example `new URL('./garden.webtoe.json', location.href).href`.
params.zh: `.webtoe.json` 節點圖檔案的網址。它會用 `?project=<網址>` 交給應用程式，由應用程式去抓，所以檔案所在的伺服器必須允許應用程式的來源（CORS）。請寫成絕對網址，例如 `new URL('./garden.webtoe.json', location.href).href`。

params.name: params
params.en: The param schema of the world: `[{ key, min, max, def }, …]`. The keys are the names the patch reads with `ext('name', fallback)`.
params.zh: 世界的參數 schema：`[{ key, min, max, def }, …]`。這些 key 就是節點圖用 `ext('name', fallback)` 讀取的名稱。

params.name: extra
params.en: `extra(state, out)`, called every frame: add derived values to `out` (a copy of the state) that the patch can read too, such as `out.hueRad = state.hue * Math.PI / 180`.
params.zh: `extra(state, out)`，每個畫面呼叫：把衍生的值加進 `out`（狀態的複本），節點圖也讀得到，例如 `out.hueRad = state.hue * Math.PI / 180`。

returns.en: A world `{ name, params, init, update, render, dispose }` to pass to `createShow({ world })` or `stage.register()`.
returns.zh: 一個世界 `{ name, params, init, update, render, dispose }`，可以交給 `createShow({ world })` 或 `stage.register()`。

needs.en: The page must be able to load the WebToe app in an iframe (the network, by default `https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/`), and the patch file must be reachable by the app. The world does its work when it is activated, so use it with `createShow({ world })`, or `stage.register()` and `stage.activate()`.
needs.zh: 頁面必須能把 WebToe 應用程式載進 iframe（要有網路，預設是 `https://webtoe.openaudiovisual.com/`），節點圖檔案也要讓應用程式抓得到。世界在被啟用的時候才開始做事，所以請搭配 `createShow({ world })`，或 `stage.register()` 加 `stage.activate()` 使用。

notes.en: The message goes to the iframe with the target origin `*`, so any page the iframe happens to be showing receives the values. If you point `app` at a site you do not trust, it can read your params.
notes.zh: 訊息是用目標來源 `*` 送給 iframe，所以 iframe 當時顯示的任何頁面都收得到這些值。如果你把 `app` 指向你不信任的網站，它就能讀到你的參數。

caption.en: An iframe fills the container and, once it has loaded, shows the message the world posted: `{"type":"webtoe:ext","values":{"speed":0.8,"hue":180,"hueRad":3.14}}`.
caption.zh: iframe 填滿容器，載入完成之後顯示世界送出的訊息：`{"type":"webtoe:ext","values":{"speed":0.8,"hue":180,"hueRad":3.14}}`。

caption.en: The patch from `garden.webtoe.json` fills the stage, and turning MIDI knob 1 changes its `speed` through the mapper. Every `ext('speed', …)` in the patch follows.
caption.zh: `garden.webtoe.json` 的節點圖填滿舞台，轉動 MIDI 旋鈕 1 會透過映射改變它的 `speed`。節點圖裡每個 `ext('speed', …)` 都會跟著動。

tbd.en: Not run against the real WebToe app here (the examples use a stand-in page, with no network). Because a value is only posted when it changed, a patch that finishes loading after the first frame may not receive values that never move again until one of them changes; whether that happens with the live app was not checked.
tbd.zh: 這裡沒有對真正的 WebToe 應用程式跑過（範例用的是一個代替的頁面，不需要網路）。因為值只有在改變時才會送出，在第一個畫面之後才載入完成的節點圖，對於之後再也不動的值，可能要等到其中一個值改變才會收到。真正的應用程式會不會發生這種情況，沒有查證。

summary.en: The "latest phone" name of a phone signal: `aliasOf('phone/ab12/tilt/x')` is `'phone/any/tilt/x'`. `null` for anything else.
summary.zh: 手機訊號的「最新那支手機」名稱：`aliasOf('phone/ab12/tilt/x')` 是 `'phone/any/tilt/x'`。其他的名稱回傳 `null`。

description.en: A route written in a World file cannot know the id of a stranger's phone. The alias fixes that: every phone signal is also filed under `phone/any/…`, which always holds the value from whichever phone sent last, so `{ source: 'phone/any/tilt/x', target: 'hue' }` can be written before anyone has joined. [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) and [`localSensors()`](#localSensors) both file the alias for you.
description.zh: 寫在世界檔案裡的路由，不可能知道陌生人手機的 id。別名就是用來解決這件事：每個手機訊號也會歸一份到 `phone/any/…`，它永遠是最後送出數值的那支手機的值，所以 `{ source: 'phone/any/tilt/x', target: 'hue' }` 在還沒有人加入之前就能寫好。[`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) 和 [`localSensors()`](#localSensors) 都會替你歸這份別名。

params.name: name
params.en: A signal name. Only `phone/<id>/…` has an alias.
params.zh: 訊號名稱。只有 `phone/<id>/…` 有別名。

params.name: alias
params.en: The word that replaces the id. Leave it out for `any`.
params.zh: 用來取代 id 的字。不給就是 `any`。

returns.en: The alias name, or `null` when `name` is not a phone signal or already uses the alias.
returns.zh: 別名。`name` 不是手機訊號、或本來就用別名的時候是 `null`。

caption.en: Prints phone/any/tilt/x, then null twice (already an alias; not a phone signal), then phone/latest/knock.
caption.zh: 印出 phone/any/tilt/x，然後兩個 null（已經是別名、不是手機訊號），最後是 phone/latest/knock。

summary.en: Attaches the room relay to a Node `http.Server`: WebSocket clients that connect to `path` are put in rooms and routed by role. Returns `{ hub, close() }`.
summary.zh: 把房間中繼掛到 Node 的 `http.Server` 上：連到 `path` 的 WebSocket 用戶端會被放進房間，並依身分轉送訊息。回傳 `{ hub, close() }`。

description.en: This is the server half, in Node, with no dependencies (the WebSocket codec is in the package). `node serve.js` already does it for you at `/relay`. To use it in your own server: `attachRelay(server)` before or after `server.listen()`. Clients connect to `ws://host/relay?role=controller|runner|monitor&room=<name>&id=<device>`: a bad role becomes `controller`, a bad room name becomes `default`, and the id is cut to 64 characters.
description.zh: 這是伺服器那一半，跑在 Node 裡，沒有任何相依套件（WebSocket 編解碼器就在套件裡）。`node serve.js` 已經在 `/relay` 替你做好了。要用在你自己的伺服器上：在 `server.listen()` 之前或之後呼叫 `attachRelay(server)` 都行。用戶端連到 `ws://host/relay?role=controller|runner|monitor&room=<name>&id=<device>`：身分不合格會變成 `controller`，房間名不合格會變成 `default`，id 會被截成 64 個字元。

description.en: Who may talk to whom: a controller's `signal` and `batch` go to the runner and the monitors; a runner's go to the monitors only; a runner's `feedback` and `config` go to the controllers and monitors; a monitor says nothing. A `config` is kept per key and replayed to controllers that join later, and the room forgets it when its runner leaves. Rooms never hear each other. A message over 256 KB is ignored and a frame over 1 MB closes the connection.
description.zh: 誰能對誰說話：控制端的 `signal` 和 `batch` 送給演出端和監看端。演出端的只送給監看端。演出端的 `feedback` 和 `config` 送給控制端和監看端。監看端什麼都不能說。`config` 依 key 留著，重播給之後才加入的控制端，演出端離開時房間就忘掉它。房間之間互相聽不到。超過 256 KB 的訊息會被忽略，超過 1 MB 的 frame 會讓連線關閉。

description.en: There is no authentication: anyone who can reach the server and knows a room name can join as a controller. Use a closed network, or a room name nobody will guess.
description.zh: 沒有任何身分驗證：任何連得到伺服器、又知道房間名稱的人，都能以控制端身分加入。請用封閉的網路，或一個沒人猜得到的房間名稱。

params.name: server
params.en: A Node `http.Server` (or anything with the same `upgrade` event, such as an https server). The relay listens for its `upgrade` events.
params.zh: Node 的 `http.Server`（或任何有同樣 `upgrade` 事件的東西，例如 https 伺服器）。中繼會聽它的 `upgrade` 事件。

params.name: path
params.en: The URL path clients connect to. Any other path is refused.
params.zh: 用戶端要連的網址路徑。其他路徑一律拒絕。

params.name: log
params.en: `(line) => {}`, called with a line such as `+ controller ab12 @main` when a client joins and `- controller ab12 @main` when it leaves. The default says nothing.
params.zh: `(line) => {}`，用戶端加入時以 `+ controller ab12 @main` 這樣的一行呼叫，離開時是 `- controller ab12 @main`。預設什麼都不說。

params.name: heartbeatMs
params.en: How often to ping every client, in milliseconds. A client that has not answered by the next ping is dropped, so a dead phone goes within one to two periods.
params.zh: 多久對每個用戶端 ping 一次，單位毫秒。到下一次 ping 還沒回應的用戶端會被移除，所以斷線的手機會在一到兩個週期內消失。

returns.en: `hub` is the `RoomHub` (`hub.rooms` is a `Map` of the rooms; `hub.counts(room)` gives `{ controllers, runners, monitors }`). `close()` drops every connected client; it does not close your server.
returns.zh: `hub` 是 `RoomHub`（`hub.rooms` 是房間的 `Map`，`hub.counts(room)` 回傳 `{ controllers, runners, monitors }`）。`close()` 把所有連線中的用戶端斷開，不會關掉你的伺服器。

needs.en: A Node program, imported from `@openav/relay/server` (a different entry point from `@openav/relay`, which is the browser side). Standalone: `node packages/relay/server.js [port]` (default 7458; `/health` answers with the room names; `RELAY_HOST=127.0.0.1` binds to localhost behind a reverse proxy).
needs.zh: 一支 Node 程式，從 `@openav/relay/server` 匯入（它跟 `@openav/relay` 是不同的進入點，後者是瀏覽器端）。單獨執行：`node packages/relay/server.js [port]`（預設 7458，`/health` 會回傳房間名稱，用 `RELAY_HOST=127.0.0.1` 可以綁在 localhost，後面接反向代理）。

caption.en: A relay on port 7458 in about five lines. Open a show page with `?relay=ws://localhost:7458/relay` and the terminal logs a line such as `[relay] + runner show-k3x9 @default` when it connects.
caption.zh: 五行左右就有一個跑在 7458 埠的中繼。打開演出頁面時加上 `?relay=ws://localhost:7458/relay`，頁面連上去的時候，終端機會印出像 `[relay] + runner show-k3x9 @default` 這樣的一行。

summary.en: Connects a runner's `RelayClient` to a `Signals` registry: every signal a phone sends is filed there, plus a `phone/any/…` copy. Returns an undo function.
summary.zh: 把演出端的 `RelayClient` 接到 `Signals`：手機送來的每個訊號都歸進去，並多一份 `phone/any/…` 的複本。回傳一個復原函式。

description.en: Call it once on the show page, after making the runner's client: `bindSignals(show, signals)`. It sets `client.onSignal` so that each signal that arrives goes through [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal), and a phone signal is filed twice, under its own name (`phone/ab12/tilt/x`) and under the alias (`phone/any/tilt/x`). Routes written at author time use the alias.
description.zh: 在演出頁面上，做好演出端的用戶端之後呼叫一次：`bindSignals(show, signals)`。它會設定 `client.onSignal`，讓每個收到的訊號都經過 [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal)，手機訊號會歸兩份：自己的名稱（`phone/ab12/tilt/x`）和別名（`phone/any/tilt/x`）。寫作品時寫的路由用的是別名。

description.en: A callback that was already in `client.onSignal` keeps running after the filing, so you can still watch the raw messages.
description.zh: `client.onSignal` 裡原本就有的回呼，會在歸檔之後繼續執行，所以你還是看得到原始訊息。

params.name: client
params.en: The runner's client (any object with an `onSignal` field works).
params.zh: 演出端的用戶端（任何有 `onSignal` 欄位的物件都行）。

params.name: signals
params.en: The registry to fill (from `@openav/core`).
params.zh: 要填的註冊表（來自 `@openav/core`）。

params.name: alias
params.en: The word used in the copy, `phone/<alias>/…`. `null` or an empty string turns the copy off.
params.zh: 複本用的字，`phone/<alias>/…`。`null` 或空字串表示不做複本。

params.name: meta
params.en: Replace [`signalMeta`](#signalMeta) with your own declarations, as in [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal).
params.zh: 像 [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal) 一樣，用你自己的宣告取代 [`signalMeta`](#signalMeta)。

returns.en: Call it to unbind: `client.onSignal` goes back to what it was before.
returns.zh: 呼叫它就解除綁定：`client.onSignal` 回到綁定之前的樣子。

caption.en: Prints the tilt under the alias (0.4), the knock declared as a pulse, and "true" once `unbind()` has put `onSignal` back.
caption.zh: 印出別名底下的傾斜值（0.4）、被宣告成脈衝的 knock，以及 `unbind()` 把 `onSignal` 放回去之後的「true」。

caption.en: A listener that was there before `bindSignals()` still hears every message: prints "phone/ab12/tilt/y | 0.2".
caption.zh: `bindSignals()` 之前就有的監聽函式，照樣聽得到每一則訊息：印出「phone/ab12/tilt/y | 0.2」。

summary.en: The short random id of this browser, kept in `localStorage`, that names this phone in its signals, as in `phone/ab12/tilt/x`.
summary.zh: 這個瀏覽器的隨機短 id，存在 `localStorage` 裡，用來在訊號名稱裡稱呼這支手機，例如 `phone/ab12/tilt/x`。

description.en: The first call makes an id and stores it under `key`; later calls read it back. [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) uses it as its default `id`, so a phone keeps the same name across reloads and its signals stay `phone/<same id>/…`.
description.zh: 第一次呼叫會做一個 id 並存在 `key` 底下，之後的呼叫就把它讀回來。[`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) 把它當作預設的 `id`，所以手機重新載入之後名字不變，訊號也一直是 `phone/<同一個 id>/…`。

description.en: If `localStorage` is blocked (some private windows), nothing can be stored and every call makes a new id.
description.zh: 如果 `localStorage` 被擋掉（有些無痕視窗），就存不下來，每次呼叫都會做一個新的 id。

params.name: key
params.en: The `localStorage` key. The default is the one the lab uses, so `/control` and `/remote` on one phone count as one device.
params.zh: `localStorage` 的 key。預設是實驗室用的那一個，所以同一支手機上的 `/control` 和 `/remote` 算是同一個裝置。

returns.en: A short id of about five letters and digits, such as `k3x9a`. The same one on every call, in the same browser.
returns.zh: 大約五個字母和數字的短 id，例如 `k3x9a`。同一個瀏覽器裡，每次呼叫都一樣。

caption.en: Prints a short id and "true": the second call reads back what the first one stored.
caption.zh: 印出一個短 id 和「true」：第二次呼叫讀回第一次存下的值。

entries.name: fileSignal
entries.signature: fileSignal(signals, name, value, { pulse = false, meta = signalMeta, source = '' } = {})

summary.en: Files one incoming signal into a `Signals` registry: declares the name the first time, fills in the velocity, then sets it or pulses it.
summary.zh: 把一個收到的訊號歸進 `Signals`：第一次聽到名稱就先宣告，補上力度，再設值或觸發脈衝。

description.en: This is the receiving half of the wire format, and every receiver files a message the same way through it: [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) for a show that has a relay, [`localSensors()`](#localSensors) for a show on a phone, and a host that runs its own socket. In order: if the registry has never heard the name, declare it with what [`signalMeta()`](#signalMeta) says (a pulse is never mistaken for a knob, and meters get their range); fill in the missing velocity spelling with [`normalizeValue()`](#normalizeValue); then `signals.pulse(name, value)` for a pulse or `signals.set(name, value)` for the rest.
description.zh: 這是傳輸格式的接收那一半，每個接收端都靠它用同樣的方式歸檔訊息：有中繼的演出用 [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals)，跑在手機上的演出用 [`localSensors()`](#localSensors)，自己開 socket 的主機也一樣。順序是：註冊表沒聽過這個名稱的話，就照 [`signalMeta()`](#signalMeta) 的說法宣告（脈衝不會被當成旋鈕，音量表也拿得到範圍），用 [`normalizeValue()`](#normalizeValue) 補上缺的力度寫法，然後脈衝就 `signals.pulse(name, value)`，其他就 `signals.set(name, value)`。

params.name: signals
params.en: The registry to file it in (from `@openav/core`).
params.zh: 要歸進去的註冊表（來自 `@openav/core`）。

params.name: name
params.en: The signal name. It must be a non-empty string of at most 128 characters, or nothing is filed.
params.zh: 訊號名稱。必須是非空字串，最長 128 個字元，否則什麼都不歸。

params.name: value
params.en: The payload.
params.zh: 訊號的內容。

params.name: pulse
params.en: True when the message was sent as an event. A name that [`signalMeta()`](#signalMeta) knows to be a pulse (or was declared as one) is a pulse either way.
params.zh: 訊息是當作事件送來的話為 true。名稱若是 [`signalMeta()`](#signalMeta) 認得的脈衝（或之前就宣告成脈衝），不管這一項是什麼，都當作脈衝。

params.name: meta
params.en: Replace [`signalMeta`](#signalMeta) with your own `(name, { pulse }) => metadata | null`, to declare names the relay does not know.
params.zh: 用你自己的 `(name, { pulse }) => 資料 | null` 取代 [`signalMeta`](#signalMeta)，用來宣告中繼不認得的名稱。

params.name: source
params.en: A label stored in the declared metadata (`signals.meta.get(name).source`), such as `'relay'` or `'local'`.
params.zh: 存進宣告資料裡的標籤（`signals.meta.get(name).source`），例如 `'relay'` 或 `'local'`。

returns.en: `true` when it was filed, `false` for a bad name.
returns.zh: 歸好了是 `true`，名稱不合格是 `false`。

caption.en: Prints a velocity of 0.79 (100 / 127) that the sender never wrote, the kind "pulse", the range -1..1 for tilt, and "false" for the empty name.
caption.zh: 印出送訊號的人沒寫過的力度 0.79（100 / 127）、種類「pulse」、傾斜的範圍 -1..1，以及空名稱的「false」。

summary.en: Fills in the missing velocity spelling of a note message: `vel` (0..1) or `velocity` (1..127). Every other message passes through unchanged.
summary.zh: 補上音符訊息缺的那一種力度寫法：`vel`（0..1）或 `velocity`（1..127）。其他訊息原樣通過。

description.en: `@openav/midi` publishes `vel` as 0..1, a hardware keyboard talks in `velocity` 1..127, and senders (an old phone page, a TouchOSC bridge, a sequencer) give one or the other. A sketch is written against one spelling, so the receiving end fills in the other: `velocity` becomes `vel = velocity / 127`, and `vel` becomes `velocity = Math.round(vel * 127)`.
description.zh: `@openav/midi` 發布的 `vel` 是 0..1，硬體鍵盤說的是 1..127 的 `velocity`，而送訊號的人（舊的手機頁面、TouchOSC 橋接、編曲軟體）只會給其中一種。草圖通常只照一種寫法寫，所以接收端把另一種補上：`velocity` 會變成 `vel = velocity / 127`，`vel` 會變成 `velocity = Math.round(vel * 127)`。

description.en: You rarely call it yourself: [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal) does it for every message it files.
description.zh: 通常不用自己呼叫：[`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal) 歸檔每一則訊息時都會做這件事。

params.name: name
params.en: The signal name. Only `midi/note/on`, `midi/note/off` and the same with a device in the middle (`midi/<device>/note/on`) are touched.
params.zh: 訊號名稱。只有 `midi/note/on`、`midi/note/off`，以及中間多一個裝置名的寫法（`midi/<device>/note/on`）會被處理。

params.name: value
params.en: The payload. Only an object with `vel` or `velocity` is changed (a copy, never the original).
params.zh: 訊號的內容。只有帶 `vel` 或 `velocity` 的物件會被改（改的是複本，不動原件）。

returns.en: The payload with both `vel` and `velocity`. If both were there already, the same object comes back untouched.
returns.zh: 同時帶 `vel` 和 `velocity` 的內容。兩個本來就都有的話，原物件原樣傳回。

caption.en: The first two gain the spelling they lacked (`vel` 1 and `velocity` 64); the third works with a device in the name; the fourth is not a note and stays as it is.
caption.zh: 前兩個補上缺的寫法（`vel` 是 1、`velocity` 是 64）。第三個名稱中間有裝置名也照樣處理。第四個不是音符，保持原樣。

entries.name: RelayClient
entries.signature: new RelayClient({ role = 'controller', room = 'default', id = deviceId(), url = null, batchHz = 30, resendMs = 1000, onStatus, onSignal, onFeedback, onConfig } = {})

summary.en: The browser end of the room relay: sends signals to the other pages in a room and receives theirs, as a phone (controller), the show (runner) or a backstage monitor.
summary.zh: 房間中繼的瀏覽器端：把訊號送給同一個房間裡的其他頁面，也接收它們的訊號，身分可以是手機（controller）、演出本身（runner）或後台監看（monitor）。

description.en: Make one client per page, give it a role and a room, and call `connect()`. A phone calls `phone.set('phone/me/tilt/x', 0.3)` for values that change continuously and `phone.send('midi/note/on', { note: 60 }, true)` for events. The show passes its client to [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals), and every phone signal lands in its `Signals`. The relay itself is [`attachRelay()`](#attachRelay) on a Node server.
description.zh: 每個頁面做一個用戶端，給它身分和房間，然後呼叫 `connect()`。手機用 `phone.set('phone/me/tilt/x', 0.3)` 送連續變化的數值，用 `phone.send('midi/note/on', { note: 60 }, true)` 送事件。演出端把自己的用戶端交給 [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals)，每個手機訊號就會進到它的 `Signals`。中繼本身是 Node 伺服器上的 [`attachRelay()`](#attachRelay)。

description.en: Continuous values are cheap on purpose: `set()` only stores the value (and does nothing if it is the same as the last), then every `1 / batchHz` seconds the changed ones leave in one `batch`, and every `resendMs` all of them leave again. Events are the opposite: `send()` leaves at once and is never batched or repeated, because a note-on delivered twice is a bug.
description.zh: 連續的數值刻意做得很省：`set()` 只是把值存起來（跟上一次一樣就什麼都不做），之後每 `1 / batchHz` 秒，有變動的值打包成一則 `batch` 送出，每 `resendMs` 毫秒，全部的值再送一遍。事件則相反：`send()` 馬上送出，不打包也不重送，因為一個 note-on 收到兩次就是錯。

description.en: It looks after the connection itself. When the socket closes it reconnects after 0.5 s, then 1 s, 2 s, 4 s and every 5 s, until you call `close()`. A ping goes out every 2 s and the answer becomes `latency` in milliseconds. `status` is `'connecting'`, `'open'` or `'closed'`, and `peers` is how many `controllers`, `runners` and `monitors` the room has.
description.zh: 連線它自己照顧。socket 關掉之後，它會在 0.5 秒、1 秒、2 秒、4 秒，之後每 5 秒重連一次，直到你呼叫 `close()`。每 2 秒送一個 ping，回應的時間差就是 `latency`（毫秒）。`status` 是 `'connecting'`、`'open'` 或 `'closed'`，`peers` 是房間裡有幾個 `controllers`、`runners`、`monitors`。

params.name: role
params.en: Who this page is. A controller (a phone) sends signals to the runner and the monitors. A runner (the show) hears the controllers, and can send feedback and config back. A monitor only listens. The server treats any other word as `controller`.
params.zh: 這個頁面的身分。控制端（controller，也就是手機）把訊號送給演出端和監看端。演出端（runner，也就是演出本身）聽得到控制端，也能把 feedback 和 config 送回去。監看端（monitor）只聽不說。伺服器遇到其他字一律當成 `controller`。

params.name: room
params.en: The room name. Pages in different rooms never hear each other. 1 to 32 characters of `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -`; the server turns anything else into `default`.
params.zh: 房間名稱。不同房間的頁面彼此聽不到。1 到 32 個字元，只能用 `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -`，其他的伺服器會換成 `default`。

params.name: id
params.en: This device's id, the `<id>` in `phone/<id>/…`. The default is [`deviceId()`](#deviceId), which is kept in `localStorage`. The server keeps its first 64 characters.
params.zh: 這個裝置的 id，也就是 `phone/<id>/…` 裡的 `<id>`。預設是 [`deviceId()`](#deviceId)，存在 `localStorage` 裡。伺服器只留前 64 個字元。

params.name: url
params.en: The full WebSocket address, with the query already on it: `wss://host/relay?role=controller&room=main&id=ab12`. Nothing is added to it. Leave it out and the client uses `?relay=ws://…` from the page's address, or else the page's own `/relay` (`wss:` on an https page), and adds `role`, `room` and `id` itself.
params.zh: 完整的 WebSocket 位址，查詢字串要自己帶好：`wss://host/relay?role=controller&room=main&id=ab12`。它不會再補任何東西。不給的話，用頁面網址裡的 `?relay=ws://…`，再沒有就用頁面自己的 `/relay`（https 頁面用 `wss:`），並自動補上 `role`、`room`、`id`。

params.name: batchHz
params.en: How many times a second the values you `set()` are flushed to the relay, as one `batch` message.
params.zh: 每秒把你 `set()` 的數值送出幾次，打包成一則 `batch` 訊息。

params.name: resendMs
params.en: Every this many milliseconds, send every stored value again, not only the changed ones. This is what lets a phone that joins late, or a show page that reloads, catch up.
params.zh: 每隔這麼多毫秒，把存起來的每一個值再送一次，不只是有變動的。晚進來的手機、重新載入的演出頁面，就靠這個趕上現況。

params.name: onStatus
params.en: `(client) => {}`, called when the connection opens or closes, when a `pong` gives a new `latency`, and when the peer counts change. Read `client.status`, `client.latency` and `client.peers` inside it.
params.zh: `(client) => {}`，連線打開或關閉、`pong` 帶來新的 `latency`、連線數改變的時候呼叫。在裡面讀 `client.status`、`client.latency`、`client.peers`。

params.name: onSignal
params.en: `(name, value, msg) => {}`, for every signal that arrives (a runner or monitor hears the controllers; a monitor also hears the runner). A `batch` calls it once per item. `msg.pulse` is true for a pulse. [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) fills this in for you.
params.zh: `(name, value, msg) => {}`，每收到一個訊號就呼叫（演出端和監看端聽得到控制端，監看端也聽得到演出端）。一則 `batch` 會每個項目各呼叫一次。脈衝訊號的 `msg.pulse` 是 true。[`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) 會替你填這一項。

params.name: onFeedback
params.en: `(name, value) => {}`, on a controller: a value the runner sent with `feedback()`, to show in a meter or to move a fader.
params.zh: `(name, value) => {}`，在控制端：演出端用 `feedback()` 送來的數值，拿去顯示在音量表或移動推桿。

params.name: onConfig
params.en: `(key, data) => {}`, on a controller: a standing config the runner sent with `config()`, such as the surface layout. A phone that joins late gets the stored ones right away.
params.zh: `(key, data) => {}`，在控制端：演出端用 `config()` 送來的常駐設定，例如控制面板的版面。晚進來的手機會立刻收到已儲存的那些。

needs.en: A relay server for it to reach, such as `node serve.js` (it hosts one at `/relay`) or `node packages/relay/server.js`. Until the socket is open, `set()` keeps the latest values and sends them when it opens, but `send()`, `feedback()` and `config()` messages are dropped, not queued.
needs.zh: 要有一台中繼伺服器可以連，例如 `node serve.js`（它在 `/relay` 架了一個）或 `node packages/relay/server.js`。socket 還沒打開之前，`set()` 會記住最新的值，打開時送出，但 `send()`、`feedback()`、`config()` 的訊息會直接丟掉，不會排隊。

notes.en: Public fields: `role`, `room`, `id`, `url`, `batchHz`, `resendMs`, the callbacks, `status`, `latency` (milliseconds, `null` until the first pong), `peers` and `sent` (how many messages have gone out).
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `role`、`room`、`id`、`url`、`batchHz`、`resendMs`、各個回呼、`status`、`latency`（毫秒，第一個 pong 回來之前是 `null`）、`peers` 和 `sent`（已經送出幾則訊息）。

notes.en: After a reconnect the runner has to send its `config()` again: the client does not remember it. `mountRemoteHost()` does that for you.
notes.zh: 重連之後，演出端要再送一次 `config()`：用戶端不會記得它。`mountRemoteHost()` 會替你做這件事。

caption.en: The two ends of one room, as they would sit on two pages (the show and a phone): once the socket is open, the show's signals hold `phone/me/tilt/x` and, as an alias, `phone/any/tilt/x`.
caption.zh: 一個房間的兩端，實際上會放在兩個頁面（演出和手機）：socket 打開之後，演出端的 signals 裡就有 `phone/me/tilt/x`，以及別名 `phone/any/tilt/x`。

caption.en: Prints the config and the feedback the phone got back from the show, then the phone's tilt as the show hears it (under its alias `phone/any/tilt/x`). Same calls as against a real relay.
caption.zh: 印出手機從演出端收到的 config 和 feedback，再印出演出端聽到的手機傾斜（在別名 `phone/any/tilt/x` 底下）。呼叫的方式跟連真正的中繼完全一樣。

tbd.en: The reconnect delays (0.5 s, 1 s, 2 s, 4 s, then 5 s) are read from the code, not measured against a relay that goes down and comes back. The second example runs the client against a stand-in socket, not a real WebSocket server.
tbd.zh: 重連的間隔（0.5 秒、1 秒、2 秒、4 秒，之後 5 秒）是從程式碼讀來的，沒有拿一個斷線又恢復的中繼去實測。第二個範例是拿替身 socket 跑用戶端，不是真正的 WebSocket 伺服器。

members.name: send
members.doc: Immediate, un-coalesced.

members.name: set
members.doc: Continuous value: only the latest per name survives a flush.

members.name: feedback
members.doc: Runner → controllers: a value to display (meter) or echo (fader follows the timeline).

members.name: config
members.doc: Runner → controllers: standing config (e.g.

summary.en: What the relay knows about a signal name: its range and unit, or that it is a pulse. Returns `null` for names it does not know.
summary.zh: 中繼對一個訊號名稱知道什麼：它的範圍和單位，或者它是脈衝。不認得的名稱回傳 `null`。

description.en: A `Signals` registry needs to know a name's range before a meter can scale it or a mapping can tell a knob from an event. [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal) calls this the first time it hears a name. What it knows: `phone/<id>/tilt/*` is −1..1, `accel/*` is −20..20 m/s², `rot/*` is −360..360 °/s, `orient/*` is 0..360 °, `touch/count` is 0..10, `knock` is a pulse, and every other `phone/…` name (touch, light) is 0..1. `surface/…` names are 0..1 (`…/raw` and `…/delta` are unscaled, `{}`). `midi/note/on`, `midi/note/off`, `midi/virtual` and the `hit`, `on`, `off`, `last` names of a controller are pulses, and `midi/cc/*` is 0..1.
description.zh: `Signals` 要先知道一個名稱的範圍，音量表才能縮放、映射才分得出旋鈕和事件。[`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal) 第一次聽到一個名稱就會呼叫它。它認得的有：`phone/<id>/tilt/*` 是 −1..1，`accel/*` 是 −20..20 m/s²，`rot/*` 是 −360..360 °/s，`orient/*` 是 0..360 °，`touch/count` 是 0..10，`knock` 是脈衝，其他的 `phone/…` 名稱（觸控、光線）是 0..1。`surface/…` 的名稱是 0..1（`…/raw` 和 `…/delta` 沒有縮放，回傳 `{}`）。`midi/note/on`、`midi/note/off`、`midi/virtual`，以及控制器的 `hit`、`on`、`off`、`last` 名稱是脈衝，`midi/cc/*` 是 0..1。

params.name: name
params.en: A signal name such as `phone/ab12/tilt/x`, `surface/main/hue` or `midi/note/on`.
params.zh: 訊號名稱，例如 `phone/ab12/tilt/x`、`surface/main/hue` 或 `midi/note/on`。

params.name: pulse
params.en: Pass `{ pulse: true }` when the message was sent as an event: the answer is then always `{ kind: 'pulse' }`.
params.zh: 訊息是當作事件送來的話，傳 `{ pulse: true }`：答案一律是 `{ kind: 'pulse' }`。

returns.en: Metadata for `signals.define()`: `{ min, max, unit? }`, `{ kind: 'pulse' }`, or `{}` for raw values. `null` when the name is not one it knows.
returns.zh: 給 `signals.define()` 用的資料：`{ min, max, unit? }`、`{ kind: 'pulse' }`，原始值則是 `{}`。名稱不在它認得的範圍內時是 `null`。

caption.en: Prints what the relay knows about seven names, from `{"min":-1,"max":1}` for tilt to `null` for a name it has never heard of.
caption.zh: 印出中繼對七個名稱的認識，從傾斜的 `{"min":-1,"max":1}`，到完全不認得的名稱的 `null`。

summary.en: Makes an element a multi-touch pad: each finger publishes `touch/x`, `touch/y` and `touch/down` (0..1 inside the element), and `touch/count` says how many are down.
summary.zh: 把一個元素變成多點觸控板：每根手指發布 `touch/x`、`touch/y` 和 `touch/down`（在元素裡的 0..1），`touch/count` 是現在按著幾根。

description.en: The first finger down is slot 0 and publishes `touch/x`, `touch/y`, `touch/down`; the second is slot 1 and publishes `touch/1/x`, `touch/1/y`, `touch/1/down`, and so on. A slot is given back when its finger lifts, so the lowest free number is used next. `x` runs 0 at the left edge to 1 at the right, `y` runs 0 at the top to 1 at the bottom, both held inside the element and rounded to 4 decimals. `touch/down` is 1 or 0, and `touch/count` is the number of fingers down.
description.zh: 第一根按下去的手指是 slot 0，發布 `touch/x`、`touch/y`、`touch/down`。第二根是 slot 1，發布 `touch/1/x`、`touch/1/y`、`touch/1/down`，以此類推。手指離開就把 slot 還回去，下一根會用最小的空號。`x` 從左邊緣的 0 到右邊緣的 1，`y` 從上緣的 0 到下緣的 1，都限制在元素裡面，並四捨五入到小數點後 4 位。`touch/down` 是 1 或 0，`touch/count` 是按著的手指數。

description.en: It publishes `touch/down` 0 and `touch/count` 0 at once, so a receiver knows the pad is there before anyone touches it. It uses pointer events, so a mouse works too (one finger).
description.zh: 它一接上去就先發布 `touch/down` 0 和 `touch/count` 0，所以接收端在還沒有人碰之前就知道觸控板存在。它用的是 pointer 事件，所以滑鼠也能用（算一根手指）。

params.name: pad
params.en: The element to listen on. Give it `touch-action: none` in CSS, or the browser may take a drag for a scroll and cancel the touch.
params.zh: 要監聽的元素。在 CSS 裡給它 `touch-action: none`，不然瀏覽器可能把拖曳當成捲動，把觸碰取消掉。

params.name: io
params.en: Where the values go, as for [`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors): only `set` is used, and the names have no `phone/<id>/` in front.
params.zh: 數值要送去哪裡，跟 [`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors) 一樣：只用到 `set`，名稱前面沒有 `phone/<id>/`。

params.name: onMove
params.en: `(slot, x, y, down) => {}`, when a finger touches and each time it moves. `x` and `y` are 0..1 and `down` is true. Use it to draw the finger.
params.zh: `(slot, x, y, down) => {}`，手指按下去和每次移動的時候呼叫。`x`、`y` 是 0..1，`down` 是 true。拿來畫手指的位置。

params.name: onEnd
params.en: `(slot) => {}`, when a finger lifts or the touch is cancelled.
params.zh: `(slot) => {}`，手指離開或觸碰被取消的時候呼叫。

notes.en: The sense tab uses this on its touch pad, with `io` writing to a [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) under `phone/<id>/`.
notes.zh: 感測 分頁的觸控板用的就是它，`io` 寫進 [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient)，名稱加上 `phone/<id>/`。

caption.en: A 200 px square appears, and under it the values a finger would publish: touch/down=0, touch/count=0 at the start, then x, y, down and count as it lands, moves and lifts.
caption.zh: 畫面上出現一個 200 像素的方塊，下面列出一根手指會發布的數值：一開始的 touch/down=0、touch/count=0，然後是它落下、移動、離開時的 x、y、down 和 count。

caption.en: Two fingers get slots 0 and 1; after the first lifts, the next finger takes slot 0 again. The list shows the callbacks and the count.
caption.zh: 兩根手指拿到 slot 0 和 1，第一根離開之後，下一根又拿回 slot 0。清單裡是各個回呼和手指數。

summary.en: For a show page that runs on the phone itself: the phone's own sensors go straight into a `Signals` as `phone/local/…`, with a `phone/any/…` copy.
summary.zh: 給跑在手機本身上的演出頁面用：手機自己的感測器直接進到 `Signals`，名稱是 `phone/local/…`，另外多一份 `phone/any/…` 的複本。回傳 `PhoneSensors`。

description.en: A remote phone reaches the show through a relay. When the show page is open on the phone itself, there is no one to relay to, so this reads the sensors in place. The names and thresholds are the same as a remote phone's (`phone/local/tilt/x` is −1..1, `phone/local/knock` is a pulse), declared the same way by [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal), and mirrored to `phone/any/…`, so a route written for "the latest phone", `phone/any/tilt/x`, works whether the phone is in your hand as a controller or is the show.
description.zh: 遠端的手機要透過中繼才找得到演出。演出頁面就開在手機上的時候，沒有人需要轉送，所以直接在原地讀感測器。名稱和門檻跟遠端手機一樣（`phone/local/tilt/x` 是 −1..1，`phone/local/knock` 是脈衝），用 [`fileSignal()`](#fileSignal) 一樣的方式宣告，並複製一份到 `phone/any/…`，所以替「最新的那支手機」寫的路由 `phone/any/tilt/x`，不論手機是拿在手上當控制端、還是它本身就是演出，都能用。

params.name: signals
params.en: The registry to fill (from `@openav/core`).
params.zh: 要填的註冊表（來自 `@openav/core`）。

params.name: prefix
params.en: What goes in front of each sensor name.
params.zh: 放在每個感測器名稱前面的字。

params.name: alias
params.en: The word for the copy, `phone/<alias>/…`. `null` turns the copy off.
params.zh: 複本用的字，`phone/<alias>/…`。`null` 表示不做複本。

params.name: source
params.en: Stored as the signals' `source` in `signals.meta`.
params.zh: 存成 `signals.meta` 裡這些訊號的 `source`。

params.name: hooks
params.en: The `hooks` of [`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors): `onKnock`, `onSample`, `notify`.
params.zh: [`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors) 的 `hooks`：`onKnock`、`onSample`、`notify`。

returns.en: Nothing is listening yet: call `.start()` from a tap.
returns.zh: 還沒有開始聽：要在點擊時呼叫 `.start()`。

needs.en: Call `.start()` on the result from a tap (iOS asks for permission only inside a gesture, and only on https pages). Until then nothing is published. See [`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors).
needs.zh: 拿到結果之後，要在點擊時呼叫 `.start()`（iOS 只在手勢裡才會問權限，而且只限 https 頁面）。在那之前什麼都不會發布。見 [`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors)。

caption.en: Prints the tilt under both names (-1 and 0.5) and the source "local". On a phone the events come from the sensors instead of from this made-up one.
caption.zh: 印出兩個名稱底下的傾斜值（-1 和 0.5）和來源「local」。在手機上，事件是從感測器來的，而不是這個編出來的。

caption.en: A different prefix and no alias: prints "phone/me/tilt/x = 0.2, copy exists: false".
caption.zh: 換一個前綴、不做別名：印出「phone/me/tilt/x = 0.2, copy exists: false」。

summary.en: Puts a small card on the show page with a QR code and the URL a phone should open, and a line that says whether the relay is reachable and how many phones are in.
summary.zh: 在演出頁面上放一張小卡片，有 QR code 和手機該打開的網址，還有一行字說明中繼連不連得上、有幾支手機進來。

description.en: The URL is the phone page (`packages/remote/` next to this file) with `?room=<room>` on it, and with `?relay=…` as well when the show uses the public relay or a relay of your own, so the phone ends up in the same room on the same relay. On `localhost` it asks `node serve.js` for this machine's LAN address at `/__info` and puts that in the URL, because a phone cannot open `localhost`. The QR code is drawn from the URL; if the URL is too long for the encoder, the code is left out and the URL stays.
description.zh: 網址是手機頁面（這個檔案旁邊的 `packages/remote/`），後面接 `?room=<room>`，演出用公開中繼或你自己的中繼的話還會接上 `?relay=…`，這樣手機會進到同一個中繼的同一個房間。在 `localhost` 的時候，它會向 `node serve.js` 的 `/__info` 詢問這台電腦的區域網路位址並填進網址，因為手機打不開 `localhost`。QR code 是依網址畫出來的，網址太長、編碼器放不下時，就只留網址、不畫 QR code。

description.en: The status line reads `relay ok · 2 phones · room demo` when the connection is open (and adds `· public relay` on the public one), `relay offline — is it `node serve.js`?` when a local relay cannot be reached, and `can't reach the relay (…) — retrying` for a shared one. On a phone held upright the card starts folded, because the stage is small; tap it to open or fold it.
description.zh: 連線打開的時候，狀態那行寫 `relay ok · 2 phones · room demo`（用公開中繼的話後面加 `· public relay`），本機的中繼連不上時寫 `relay offline — is it `node serve.js`?`，共用的中繼連不上則寫 `can't reach the relay (…) — retrying`。直拿的手機上，卡片一開始是收起來的，因為舞台很小，點一下可以展開或收起。

params.name: parent
params.en: The element to add the card to. The card is `position: absolute` at its top left, so the parent should be positioned (`position: relative`) and big enough to show it.
params.zh: 要把卡片加進去的元素。卡片是 `position: absolute`，貼在左上角，所以父元素最好有定位（`position: relative`），而且夠大，放得下它。

params.name: host
params.en: The host from [`mountRemoteHost()`](#mountRemoteHost). The card reads `host.room`, `host.relayMode` and `host.relayUrl`, and takes over `host.onStatus` to write the status line.
params.zh: [`mountRemoteHost()`](#mountRemoteHost) 回傳的 host。卡片會讀 `host.room`、`host.relayMode`、`host.relayUrl`，並接管 `host.onStatus` 來寫狀態那行字。

returns.en: The card's element, already in `parent`. Remove it with `.remove()`.
returns.zh: 卡片的元素，已經放進 `parent` 裡了。要移除就呼叫 `.remove()`。

notes.en: The words on the card are in English.
notes.zh: 卡片上的字是英文。

caption.en: A card appears at the top left with a QR code, the phone URL ending in ?room=demo, and the line "relay ok · 2 phones · room demo".
caption.zh: 左上角出現一張卡片，有 QR code、結尾是 ?room=demo 的手機網址，以及「relay ok · 2 phones · room demo」這行字。

summary.en: The whole phone app in one call: a status bar and the tabs sense, keys, control and MIDI, talking to the relay as a controller. `/packages/remote/` is exactly this.
summary.zh: 一次呼叫就是整個手機 app：狀態列加上 感測、琴鍵、控制台、MIDI 這幾個分頁，以控制端身分跟中繼溝通。`/packages/remote/` 做的就是這件事。

description.en: It is what a phone opens: `lockViewport()` so nothing scrolls or zooms, `keepAwake()` so the screen stays on, one [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) as a controller that every tab shares, and the tabs. Sense is a tilt ball, readouts, a multi-touch pad ([`attachTouchPad()`](#attachTouchPad)) and the sensors ([`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors)) behind a start button. Keys is a piano that is one row in landscape and two stacked rows in portrait. Control is a [`Surface`](#Surface). MIDI is a virtual controller.
description.zh: 它就是手機打開的那個東西：`lockViewport()` 讓畫面不能捲動也不能縮放，`keepAwake()` 讓螢幕不暗掉，一個所有分頁共用的、身分是控制端的 [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient)，再加上幾個分頁。感測（sense）有一顆傾斜球、讀數、一塊多點觸控板（[`attachTouchPad()`](#attachTouchPad)），以及藏在開始按鈕後面的感測器（[`PhoneSensors`](#PhoneSensors)）。琴鍵（keys）是一台鋼琴，橫拿時一排，直拿時上下兩排。控制台（control）是一個 [`Surface`](#Surface)。MIDI 是一台虛擬控制器。

description.en: The control tab's layout comes from, in order: `surfaceUrl` or `?surface=`, `metaUrl` or `?meta=`, whatever layout the show publishes over the relay (the config `surface`), and finally a small generic panel so the page is never blank. The signals are `phone/<id>/…` (sense), `midi/note/on|off` and `midi/cc/64` (keys), and `surface/<page>/<id>` (control). The app opens on `?tab=`, else the tab used last in this browser, else sense.
description.zh: 控制台分頁的版面依序從這些地方找：`surfaceUrl` 或 `?surface=`、`metaUrl` 或 `?meta=`、演出透過中繼發布的版面（設定 `surface`），最後是一個小小的通用面板，頁面永遠不會空白。訊號是 `phone/<id>/…`（感測）、`midi/note/on|off` 和 `midi/cc/64`（琴鍵）、`surface/<page>/<id>`（控制台）。app 一開始打開 `?tab=` 指定的分頁，沒有就是這個瀏覽器上次用的分頁，再沒有就是感測。

params.name: root
params.en: Where to put the app. It fills the whole page (`position: fixed`), so pass `document.body`.
params.zh: 要把 app 放在哪裡。它會填滿整個頁面（`position: fixed`），所以傳 `document.body`。

params.name: opts
params.en: `{ room, relayUrl, surfaceUrl, metaUrl }`, each optional. `room` is the relay room (else `?room=` in the address, else `window.__REMOTE__.room`, else `default`). `relayUrl` is a `ws://` or `wss://` relay (else `?relay=`; only those two schemes are accepted, so a link cannot point the phone anywhere else). `surfaceUrl` is a layout JSON for the control tab and `metaUrl` a JSON with a `params` array, which the control tab turns into [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface). The address can also say `?tab=sense|keys|control|midi`.
params.zh: `{ room, relayUrl, surfaceUrl, metaUrl }`，每一項都可省略。`room` 是中繼房間（沒給就用網址的 `?room=`，再沒有就用 `window.__REMOTE__.room`，再沒有就是 `default`）。`relayUrl` 是 `ws://` 或 `wss://` 的中繼（沒給就用 `?relay=`。只收這兩種，所以一個連結不能把手機指到別的地方）。`surfaceUrl` 是控制台分頁用的版面 JSON，`metaUrl` 是帶 `params` 陣列的 JSON，控制台分頁會把它變成 [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface)。網址上也可以寫 `?tab=sense|keys|control|midi`。

returns.en: `{ relay, show(tab), surface, dispose() }`: the [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient), a function that switches tab, the control tab's [`Surface`](#Surface) (a getter, `null` until that tab has been opened), and `dispose()`, which closes the relay, unlocks the viewport, lets go of the wake lock and removes the app.
returns.zh: `{ relay, show(tab), surface, dispose() }`：[`RelayClient`](#RelayClient)、切換分頁的函式、控制台分頁的 [`Surface`](#Surface)（getter，那個分頁還沒打開過就是 `null`），以及 `dispose()`：關掉中繼、解除視窗鎖定、放掉螢幕喚醒鎖、移除整個 app。

needs.en: A page of its own (it takes over the whole screen) and a relay to reach: the same origin's `/relay` unless `relayUrl` or `?relay=` says otherwise. Without a show in the room the header says it is waiting for the work to open.
needs.zh: 一個專屬的頁面（它會佔滿整個螢幕），以及一個連得到的中繼：沒有 `relayUrl` 或 `?relay=` 的話就是同源的 `/relay`。房間裡沒有演出的時候，狀態列會寫在等作品開啟。

notes.en: The words on the app's tabs and header are in Chinese.
notes.zh: app 的分頁和狀態列上的字是中文。

caption.en: On a phone: the status bar with the connection and latency, and the four tabs (sense, keys, control and MIDI, labelled in Chinese) along the bottom.
caption.zh: 在手機上：有連線和延遲的狀態列，以及下方的 感測、琴鍵、控制台、MIDI 分頁。

tbd.en: Not opened on a real phone for this entry: how the tabs behave is read from `packages/remote/app.js` and docs/remote.md.
tbd.zh: 這一條沒有在真正的手機上打開過：分頁怎麼運作，是從 `packages/remote/app.js` 和 docs/remote.md 讀來的。

entries.name: mountRemoteHost
entries.signature: mountRemoteHost({ signals, params, mapper, world = null, room = 'default', auto = {}, surface = null, feedbackHz = 10, url = null, mode = null, controllers = null } = {})

summary.en: The show side of the phone remote: joins the relay as the runner, files phone signals, builds the control panel from the params and echoes values back.
summary.zh: 手機遙控在演出這一邊：以演出端（runner）身分加入中繼，歸檔手機訊號，依世界的參數建立控制面板，並把數值回送。回傳 host。

description.en: `createShow({ modules: { remote: true } })` calls this for you, so the world never has to know about phones. Calling it yourself does five things: it makes a [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) as the room's runner; files every phone signal into `signals` with [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) (so `phone/any/…` always holds the latest phone); builds the layout from `surface`, `world.surface` or [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) of the params; adds the `surface/… → param` routes to the mapper; and, when you call `host.frame(dt, state)` every frame, sends the resolved param values back about `feedbackHz` times a second so the phones' faders follow the timeline.
description.zh: `createShow({ modules: { remote: true } })` 會替你呼叫它，所以世界完全不必知道手機的存在。自己呼叫的話，它做五件事：先做一個 [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) 當房間的演出端，再用 [`bindSignals()`](#bindSignals) 把每個手機訊號歸進 `signals`（所以 `phone/any/…` 永遠是最新那支手機的值），然後用 `surface`、`world.surface` 或參數的 [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 建立版面，接著把 `surface/… → param` 路由加進映射器，最後，你每個畫面呼叫 `host.frame(dt, state)` 的話，它大約每秒 `feedbackHz` 次把算好的參數值送回去，讓手機上的推桿跟著時間軸動。

description.en: Making the host does not connect it: call `host.connect()` when you want the socket. On every (re)connection it publishes the layout as relay config `surface`, so a phone that joins later gets the right panel. `host.layout`, `host.routes` and `host.bindings` are there to look at straight away, and `host.dispose()` closes the socket.
description.zh: 做出 host 並不會連線：要連的時候呼叫 `host.connect()`。每次（重新）連上時，它會把版面當成中繼設定 `surface` 發布出去，所以之後才加入的手機也拿得到正確的面板。`host.layout`、`host.routes`、`host.bindings` 一做出來就能看，`host.dispose()` 會把 socket 關掉。

params.name: signals
params.en: The registry that phone signals are filed in.
params.zh: 手機訊號要歸進去的註冊表。

params.name: params
params.en: The world's params. Its `schema` is what the control surface is built from.
params.zh: 世界的參數。控制面板就是依它的 `schema` 建立的。

params.name: mapper
params.en: The mapper that gets the `surface/… → param` routes (a route it already has is not added twice).
params.zh: 會收到 `surface/… → param` 路由的映射器（它已經有的路由不會重複加）。

params.name: world
params.en: The world: its `params` are used when `params.schema` is empty, its `name` becomes the layout's title, and its `surface` (a hand-written layout) is used instead of a generated one.
params.zh: 世界物件：`params.schema` 是空的時候用它的 `params`，它的 `name` 會變成版面的標題，它的 `surface`（手寫的版面）會取代自動產生的。

params.name: room
params.en: The relay room to join.
params.zh: 要加入的中繼房間。

params.name: auto
params.en: Options for [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface): `pairs`, `meters`, `style`, `perPage`, `smooth`, `title`.
params.zh: 傳給 [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 的選項：`pairs`、`meters`、`style`、`perPage`、`smooth`、`title`。

params.name: surface
params.en: An explicit layout. It wins over `world.surface`.
params.zh: 指定的版面。它比 `world.surface` 優先。

params.name: feedbackHz
params.en: How many times a second `host.frame()` sends the param values back to the phones.
params.zh: `host.frame()` 每秒把參數值送回手機幾次。

params.name: url
params.en: A relay to use instead of this page's own `/relay`, such as `wss://host/relay`. `role`, `room` and `id` are added to it for you. The runner id is then `show-` plus four random characters, so two tabs of one show do not collide; without `url` it is `show`.
params.zh: 不用這個頁面自己的 `/relay`，改用的中繼，例如 `wss://host/relay`。`role`、`room`、`id` 會替你補上去。這時演出端的 id 是 `show-` 加四個隨機字元，所以同一個演出開兩個分頁也不會打架。沒給 `url` 的話就是 `show`。

params.name: mode
params.en: What `pickRelay()` decided. Only the words of the join card depend on it; the host reports it as `host.relayMode`.
params.zh: `pickRelay()` 的決定。只有加入卡片上的字會依它而變，host 會把它報成 `host.relayMode`。

params.name: controllers
params.en: The on-screen MIDI controllers of `@openav/midi`: the phone's MIDI tab then shows the same device, and what is played on either screen shows on the other.
params.zh: `@openav/midi` 的螢幕 MIDI 控制器：這樣手機的 MIDI 分頁會顯示同一台裝置，兩邊畫面上彈的音也會互相顯示。

returns.en: `{ relay, layout, routes, bindings, publish, room, relayUrl, relayMode, onStatus, frame(dt, state), connect(), dispose() }`. `connect()` returns the host again.
returns.zh: `{ relay, layout, routes, bindings, publish, room, relayUrl, relayMode, onStatus, frame(dt, state), connect(), dispose() }`。`connect()` 會再回傳 host 本身。

needs.en: A relay for `connect()` to reach: `node serve.js` hosts one at `/relay`, a static site uses the public relay (see `pickRelay()`), or pass `url`. Building the host needs none of that.
needs.zh: 要有中繼讓 `connect()` 連：`node serve.js` 在 `/relay` 架了一個，靜態網站用公開中繼（見 `pickRelay()`），或傳 `url`。單單做出 host 不需要這些。

caption.en: Prints what the host built from two params: a layout titled Bloom with a fader and a button, the two routes, and that the mapper now has them.
caption.zh: 印出 host 用兩個參數建出來的東西：標題是 Bloom、有一支推桿和一顆按鈕的版面、兩條路由，以及映射器現在已經有這兩條。

caption.en: The usual wiring on a show page: connect, show the join card, and call `host.frame()` from the frame loop. A phone that scans the card moves the faders.
caption.zh: 演出頁面上的一般接法：連線、顯示加入卡片、在畫面迴圈裡呼叫 `host.frame()`。手機掃了卡片上的 QR code，就能推動推桿。

summary.en: Turns a phone's tilt, acceleration, rotation, knocks and front-camera light into named signals, in screen axes, and hands them to the `io` you give it.
summary.zh: 把手機的傾斜、加速度、旋轉、敲擊和前鏡頭的光線，換成有名字的訊號（用螢幕座標軸），交給你給它的 `io`。

description.en: This is the phone half of the sense tab, with no page in it: make one with an `io`, call `start()` from a tap, and signals flow. From the phone's own events it produces `tilt/x` and `tilt/y` (−1..1, which is ±45° from the resting pose, x to the right and y toward you, in screen axes, so a phone turned sideways still reports "tilt right is +x"), `orient/alpha|beta|gamma` (degrees), `accel/x|y|z` (m/s², gravity included), `rot/alpha|beta|gamma` (degrees per second), `knock` (a pulse `{ strength, delta, t }`) and, if you turn the camera on, `light` (0..1).
description.zh: 這是 感測 分頁在手機這一半的邏輯，裡面不含頁面：給它一個 `io`，在使用者點一下時呼叫 `start()`，訊號就開始流動。它用手機自己的事件產生 `tilt/x` 和 `tilt/y`（−1..1，也就是離靜止姿勢 ±45°，x 向右、y 朝向你，用的是螢幕座標軸，所以手機橫著拿也還是「往右傾是 +x」）、`orient/alpha|beta|gamma`（度）、`accel/x|y|z`（m/s²，含重力）、`rot/alpha|beta|gamma`（每秒幾度）、`knock`（脈衝 `{ strength, delta, t }`），打開鏡頭的話還有 `light`（0..1）。

description.en: A knock is a jolt: when the acceleration vector changes by more than `threshold` (10 m/s² by default) between two motion samples, and at least 130 ms after the last knock, `io.send('knock', { strength, delta, t }, true)` fires. `delta` is the size of the change, and `strength` runs from 0.15 just over the threshold up to 1. The phone also vibrates for 10 ms where it can. Hold the phone how you want to play it and call `calibrate()` to make that pose the zero of the tilt.
description.zh: 敲擊就是猛地一震：兩筆動作樣本之間，加速度向量的變化超過 `threshold`（預設 10 m/s²），而且距離上次敲擊至少 130 毫秒，就會觸發 `io.send('knock', { strength, delta, t }, true)`。`delta` 是變化的大小，`strength` 從剛過門檻的 0.15 到 1。手機能震動的話也會震 10 毫秒。把手機拿成你想演奏的姿勢，呼叫 `calibrate()`，就把那個姿勢當成傾斜的零點。

description.en: For the show page itself running on a phone, [`localSensors()`](#localSensors) wraps this class and files straight into a `Signals`.
description.zh: 演出頁面本身就跑在手機上的話，用 [`localSensors()`](#localSensors)，它包住這個類別，直接把訊號歸進 `Signals`。

params.name: io
params.en: Where the signals go. `set` gets the continuous ones, `send` the knocks (with `pulse` true). The names have no `phone/<id>/` in front: `tilt/x`, `accel/z`. A [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient) with a prefix, or a `Signals` registry, can sit behind it.
params.zh: 訊號要送去哪裡。`set` 收連續的訊號，`send` 收敲擊（`pulse` 為 true）。名稱前面沒有 `phone/<id>/`，是 `tilt/x`、`accel/z` 這樣。後面可以接加了前綴的 [`RelayClient`](#RelayClient)，或是 `Signals`。

params.name: hooks
params.en: Optional callbacks. `onKnock(strength)` after each knock, `onSample(name, value)` for every continuous sample (to draw a readout), `notify(message)` with a one-line problem report such as a refused permission. The messages are written in Chinese.
params.zh: 選用的回呼。`onKnock(strength)` 在每次敲擊之後呼叫，`onSample(name, value)` 每個連續樣本都呼叫（拿來畫讀數），`notify(message)` 收一行問題說明，例如權限被拒絕。訊息是中文寫的。

needs.en: Call `start()` from a tap or click, not on page load. iOS asks for motion permission only inside a user gesture, and it only gives motion sensors to pages on `https://`; touch and keys work over plain `http://`. `start()` always resolves `true`: look at `denied` for a refusal. If no sensor data arrives within 2.5 s, `hooks.notify` says so (a desktop, or an iPhone page on http). `setCamera(true)` also needs a gesture and HTTPS on iOS.
needs.zh: 要在點擊或觸碰時才呼叫 `start()`，不是載入頁面時。iOS 只在使用者手勢裡才會問動作權限，而且只把動作感測器開放給 `https://` 的頁面，觸控和琴鍵在一般的 `http://` 就能用。`start()` 一律回傳 `true`，被拒絕要看 `denied`。2.5 秒內沒有任何感測資料進來的話，`hooks.notify` 會說明（桌機，或 http 的 iPhone 頁面）。`setCamera(true)` 在 iOS 上同樣要手勢和 HTTPS。

notes.en: Public fields: `io`, `hooks`, `started`, `gotSensor` (true once any sensor data has arrived), `denied` (iOS said no; it stays no until the Settings app is changed), `rest` and `deg` (tilt in degrees), `threshold` (the knock threshold, 10) and `COOLDOWN` (130 ms).
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `io`、`hooks`、`started`、`gotSensor`（收過任何感測資料就是 true）、`denied`（iOS 說不行，要到「設定」裡改才會變）、`rest` 和 `deg`（傾斜，單位度）、`threshold`（敲擊門檻，10）和 `COOLDOWN`（130 毫秒）。

caption.en: Prints tilt/x = -1 (45° left is the end of the range), tilt/y = 0.5, then the three raw orient angles.
caption.zh: 印出 tilt/x = -1（向左 45° 就是範圍的盡頭）、tilt/y = 0.5，然後是三個原始的 orient 角度。

caption.en: Prints one knock with strength 0.35 and delta 15 (and the onKnock call), then the new threshold 12 after cycleThreshold().
caption.zh: 印出一次敲擊，strength 是 0.35、delta 是 15（還有 onKnock 的呼叫），然後是 cycleThreshold() 之後的新門檻 12。

caption.en: Prints x and y for the four screen angles: (20, 10), (10, -20), (-20, -10), (-10, 20).

tbd.en: Not tried on a real iPhone or Android phone for this entry: the iOS permission flow, the HTTPS requirement and the 2.5 s "no data" message are read from the code and from docs/remote.md. The examples feed the class real `DeviceOrientationEvent` and `DeviceMotionEvent` objects in a desktop browser instead.
tbd.zh: 這一條沒有用真正的 iPhone 或 Android 手機試過：iOS 的權限流程、HTTPS 的要求、2.5 秒的「沒有資料」訊息，都是從程式碼和 docs/remote.md 讀來的。範例是在桌面瀏覽器裡，把真正的 `DeviceOrientationEvent` 和 `DeviceMotionEvent` 餵給這個類別。

members.name: start
members.doc: MUST be called inside a user gesture (iOS permission rules).

members.name: setCamera
members.doc: 光照：front-camera mean luma, 32×24 samples

members.name: screenTilt
members.doc: Rotate (gamma, beta) into screen axes using the current screen angle.

summary.en: Packs widgets into a grid first-fit, row by row, and never overlaps; `fixed` placements are kept and block their cells. Returns the placements and the rows used.
summary.zh: 把元件依序排進格線，一列一列找第一個放得下的位置，絕不重疊，`fixed` 的位置會保留，並擋住它們的格子。回傳各元件的位置和用掉的列數。

description.en: Each item takes the first free spot found by scanning left to right, then top to bottom: what a person does laying out a controller. The grid grows downward as far as it must, so `rows` is a result, not a limit. [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) uses it for widgets without a position and for the automatic reflow.
description.zh: 每個項目都從左到右、再從上到下找第一個空位放進去：就是人在排控制器時的做法。格線需要多長就往下長多長，所以 `rows` 是結果，不是上限。[`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) 用它來排沒有位置的元件，也用在自動重排。

params.name: items
params.en: What to place, in order. Every item needs a numeric `w` and `h` in cells, at least 1. A `w` wider than the grid is cut to `cols`.
params.zh: 要擺的東西，依序排。每一項都要有數字的 `w` 和 `h`（單位是格，至少 1）。`w` 比格線寬的話會被截成 `cols`。

params.name: cols
params.en: How many columns the grid has.
params.zh: 格線有幾欄。

params.name: fixed
params.en: Placements that are already decided. They come first in the result and the other items go around them.
params.zh: 已經決定的位置。它們會排在結果的最前面，其他項目繞著它們擺。

returns.en: `placements` is a list of `{ id, x, y, w, h }` (the fixed ones first), `rows` is how many rows they fill.
returns.zh: `placements` 是 `{ id, x, y, w, h }` 的清單（固定的排前面），`rows` 是它們佔了幾列。

notes.en: An item with no `w` (or a `w` that is not a number) never finds a spot and the function never returns. Give every item a `w` and an `h`; [`DEFAULT_SIZE`](#DEFAULT_SIZE) has the natural size of each widget type.
notes.zh: 沒有 `w`（或 `w` 不是數字）的項目永遠找不到位置，函式也就永遠不會結束。每個項目都要給 `w` 和 `h`。[`DEFAULT_SIZE`](#DEFAULT_SIZE) 有每種元件類型的預設大小。

caption.en: a and b share the first row, c takes a full row, d goes below: rows is 5.
caption.zh: a 和 b 共用第一列，c 佔滿一整列，d 排在下面：rows 是 5。

caption.en: Prints "go at 0,0   knob at 2,0": the fixed placement comes first and the knob takes the first free cells.
caption.zh: 印出「go at 0,0   knob at 2,0」：固定的位置排在最前面，旋鈕拿第一組空的格子。

entries.name: autoSurface
entries.signature: autoSurface(params = [], { perPage = 8, style = 'auto', pairs = [], meters = [], smooth = 0.04, title = '' } = {})

summary.en: Turns a world's params into a control panel: a layout, the routes that drive the params, and the bindings for echoing values back.
summary.zh: 把世界的參數變成控制面板：一份版面、驅動參數的路由，以及把數值回送用的綁定。

description.en: This is how a world that declares what it can be performed with gets a phone panel for free: `const { layout, routes, bindings } = autoSurface(world.params)`, then `routes.forEach((r) => mapper.addRoute(r))` and `new Surface(el, { layout, sink })`. Each param becomes the widget [`widgetTypeFor()`](#widgetTypeFor) picks. Each `group` of params gets its own page (a param without a group goes on `main`), long groups continue on `main2`, `main3` …, and a pair from `pairs` becomes one XY pad with two routes, `…/x` and `…/y`.
description.zh: 一個宣告了「可以拿什麼來演奏」的世界，就這樣免費得到手機面板：`const { layout, routes, bindings } = autoSurface(world.params)`，再 `routes.forEach((r) => mapper.addRoute(r))` 和 `new Surface(el, { layout, sink })`。每個參數變成 [`widgetTypeFor()`](#widgetTypeFor) 挑的元件。每個 `group` 各有一頁（沒有 group 的參數放在 `main`），太長的群組接著放到 `main2`、`main3` …，`pairs` 裡的一對會變成一塊有兩條路由（`…/x` 和 `…/y`）的 XY 板。

description.en: Widget ids are the param keys (anything outside `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -` becomes `_`), colours go round cyan, amber, magenta, lime, violet, coral, and a radio's `options` come from the param or are the numbers. A pulse param gets no binding, since there is no value to show. The routes already scale the normalized signal to the param's `min` and `max`. A world that comes with its own layout uses [`routesFromLayout()`](#routesFromLayout) instead.
description.zh: 元件的 id 就是參數鍵（`A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -` 以外的字元會變成 `_`），顏色依序輪流用 cyan、amber、magenta、lime、violet、coral，radio 的 `options` 來自參數，沒有就用數字。脈衝參數沒有 binding，因為沒有值可以顯示。路由已經把正規化的訊號換算成參數的 `min` 和 `max`。自己帶版面的世界，改用 [`routesFromLayout()`](#routesFromLayout)。

params.name: params
params.en: The param declarations: `{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group?, options?, surface? }`. `surface: { type, color, label }` on a param overrides the choice.
params.zh: 參數宣告：`{ key, label?, min, max, def, step?, pulse?, group?, options?, surface? }`。參數上的 `surface: { type, color, label }` 可以蓋過自動的選擇。

params.name: perPage
params.en: How much fits on a page, counted in weights: a fader or a meter weighs 1, an XY pad 4, anything else 2. The default 8 is eight faders, four knobs or two XY pads. A page that scrolls is a page that fails, so a full page starts the next.
params.zh: 一頁放得下多少，以權重計算：推桿或音量表算 1，XY 板算 4，其他都算 2。預設的 8 就是八支推桿、四個旋鈕或兩塊 XY 板。要捲動的頁面就是失敗的頁面，所以滿了就開下一頁。

params.name: style
params.en: Faders or knobs for the continuous params. `'auto'` picks faders up to six, knobs beyond.
params.zh: 連續參數用推桿還是旋鈕。`'auto'` 六個以內用推桿，超過就用旋鈕。

params.name: pairs
params.en: Pairs of param keys to drive with one XY pad: `[['cx', 'cy']]`. The first key is x and the second is y.
params.zh: 要用同一塊 XY 板驅動的參數鍵配對：`[['cx', 'cy']]`。第一個鍵是 x，第二個是 y。

params.name: meters
params.en: Param keys to also show as read-only meters, on a page called Meters.
params.zh: 另外要顯示成唯讀音量表的參數鍵，放在一頁叫 Meters 的頁面。

params.name: smooth
params.en: Seconds of smoothing on the continuous routes, to hide the steps of a 30 Hz network (zipper noise). Pulses, toggles and radios are never smoothed.
params.zh: 連續路由的平滑秒數，用來遮住 30 Hz 網路造成的階梯感（拉鍊雜訊）。脈衝、開關和單選不會被平滑。

params.name: title
params.en: The layout's title.
params.zh: 版面的標題。

returns.en: `layout` is a layout JSON for [`Surface`](#Surface). `routes` is a list of mapper routes `{ source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }`, from `surface/<page>/<id>` to each param. `bindings` is `{ param, name, page, widget, min, max, readonly? }` for [`feedbackFor()`](#feedbackFor).
returns.zh: `layout` 是給 [`Surface`](#Surface) 用的版面 JSON。`routes` 是映射器路由的清單 `{ source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }`，從 `surface/<page>/<id>` 到各個參數。`bindings` 是給 [`feedbackFor()`](#feedbackFor) 用的 `{ param, name, page, widget, min, max, readonly? }`。

caption.en: Prints the one page main with a fader for hue and size, a radio for mode and a button for burst, then the four routes, smoothed by 0.04 s except the radio and the button.
caption.zh: 印出一頁 main，有 hue 和 size 的推桿、mode 的單選、burst 的按鈕，然後是四條路由，除了單選和按鈕之外都平滑 0.04 秒。

caption.en: cx and cy share one XY pad, density is a fader and also a read-only meter on its own page, and glow, in group look, gets a page of its own.
caption.zh: cx 和 cy 共用一塊 XY 板，density 是推桿、同時也是自己那一頁上的唯讀音量表，group 是 look 的 glow 另外有一頁。

caption.en: Prints "main1: 4 knobs   main2: 4 knobs …" up to main5: the page limit counts a knob as 2, so four fit in the default 8.
caption.zh: 印出「main1: 4 knobs   main2: 4 knobs …」一直到 main5：頁面上限把旋鈕算成 2，所以預設的 8 放得下四個。

summary.en: True when the page can ask for fullscreen: the browser has `requestFullscreen` (or the WebKit one). The code treats iPhone Safari as not having it.
summary.zh: 頁面可以要求全螢幕的時候是 true：瀏覽器有 `requestFullscreen`（或 WebKit 版的）。程式碼把 iPhone 的 Safari 當成沒有。

description.en: Use it to decide whether to show a fullscreen button: `if (canFullscreen()) button.hidden = false`. It only checks that the function exists; whether a request succeeds is up to the browser, which wants it to come from a tap ([`toggleFullscreen()`](#toggleFullscreen)).
description.zh: 用來決定要不要顯示全螢幕按鈕：`if (canFullscreen()) button.hidden = false`。它只檢查那個函式存不存在。要求會不會成功由瀏覽器決定，瀏覽器要求它必須來自一次點擊（[`toggleFullscreen()`](#toggleFullscreen)）。

returns.en: `true` or `false`. `false` without a `document`.
returns.zh: `true` 或 `false`。沒有 `document` 的話是 `false`。

examples.code:
import { canFullscreen } from '@openav/surface';

document.getElementById('app').textContent = 'this browser can ask for fullscreen: ' + canFullscreen();

caption.en: Prints "true" in desktop Chrome, Firefox and Safari, and in Android Chrome.
caption.zh: 在桌面的 Chrome、Firefox、Safari 和 Android 的 Chrome 上印出「true」。

tbd.en: Not checked on an iPhone or iPad: that iPhone Safari has no fullscreen function is what the code's own comment says, not something measured here.
tbd.zh: 沒有在 iPhone 或 iPad 上檢查過：iPhone 的 Safari 沒有全螢幕函式，這是程式碼自己的註解說的，不是在這裡量到的。

summary.en: The seven colour names a widget's `color` may be: cyan, amber, magenta, lime, violet, coral, white.
summary.zh: 元件的 `color` 可以用的七個顏色名稱：cyan、amber、magenta、lime、violet、coral、white。

description.en: `{ id: 'hue', type: 'knob', color: 'amber' }` makes the widget's fill, its value readout and its pressed outline amber. A widget without a colour uses `--oav-accent` of [`THEME_VARS`](#THEME_VARS). [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) hands out the first six in turn (white is left for you). A name that is not in the list gets no colour of its own and falls back to the accent; [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) does not check it.
description.zh: `{ id: 'hue', type: 'knob', color: 'amber' }` 會讓元件的填色、數值讀數和按下時的描邊都變成琥珀色。沒有顏色的元件用 [`THEME_VARS`](#THEME_VARS) 的 `--oav-accent`。[`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 會輪流發前六個（white 留給你用）。不在清單裡的名稱沒有自己的顏色，會退回強調色。[`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) 不檢查它。

value.en: `['cyan', 'amber', 'magenta', 'lime', 'violet', 'coral', 'white']`.
value.zh: 七個字串：`['cyan', 'amber', 'magenta', 'lime', 'violet', 'coral', 'white']`。

examples.code:
import { COLOR_NAMES } from '@openav/surface';

document.getElementById('app').textContent = COLOR_NAMES.join(', ');

caption.en: Prints cyan, amber, magenta, lime, violet, coral, white.
caption.zh: 印出 cyan、amber、magenta、lime、violet、coral、white。

summary.en: The natural size of each widget type, in grid cells, as `{ w, h }`: a layout only has to give `x`, `y`, `w`, `h` when it cares.
summary.zh: 每種元件類型在格線上的預設大小，格式是 `{ w, h }`（以格為單位）：版面只有在在意的時候才需要寫 `x`、`y`、`w`、`h`。

description.en: A widget without a `w` or `h` takes the size of its type, held to the number of columns of the grid. [`autoArrange()`](#autoArrange) and [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) use it, and so does [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) when it counts how many widgets fit on a page. A type it does not know counts as 2×2.
description.zh: 沒寫 `w` 或 `h` 的元件，會用它的類型的大小，並限制在格線的欄數以內。[`autoArrange()`](#autoArrange) 和 [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) 會用到它，[`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 計算一頁放得下幾個元件的時候也是。不認得的類型當作 2×2。

value.en: Fourteen keys, one per type: fader 1×4, knob 2×2, encoder 2×2, button 2×1, toggle 2×1, xy 4×4, bank 4×4, radio 4×1, pads 4×4, keyboard 8×4, number 2×1, text 4×1, label 2×1, meter 1×4 (width × height).
value.zh: 十四個鍵，每種類型一個：fader 1×4、knob 2×2、encoder 2×2、button 2×1、toggle 2×1、xy 4×4、bank 4×4、radio 4×1、pads 4×4、keyboard 8×4、number 2×1、text 4×1、label 2×1、meter 1×4（寬 × 高）。

caption.en: Prints "a knob is 2 cells wide and 2 tall; a fader is 1 by 4".
caption.zh: 印出「a knob is 2 cells wide and 2 tall; a fader is 1 by 4」。

summary.en: Turns the resolved param state into the normalized values the phone's widgets should show right now: `[{ name, value }]`.
summary.zh: 把算好的參數狀態，換成手機上的元件現在該顯示的正規化數值：`[{ name, value }]`。

description.en: It is pure and cheap, so the show calls it about ten times a second and sends each result to the phones with `relay.feedback(name, value)`; `host.frame()` of [`mountRemoteHost()`](#mountRemoteHost) does exactly that. On the phone, [`Surface`](#Surface)'s `feedback()` moves the widget, so a fader follows the timeline and other controllers.
description.zh: 它是純函式、成本很低，所以演出端大約每秒呼叫十次，並用 `relay.feedback(name, value)` 把每一項送給手機，[`mountRemoteHost()`](#mountRemoteHost) 的 `host.frame()` 做的就是這件事。在手機上，[`Surface`](#Surface) 的 `feedback()` 會移動元件，所以推桿會跟著時間軸和其他控制器動。

params.name: state
params.en: The resolved param values, such as `params.resolve(…)`: `{ hue: 90, size: 5.5 }`.
params.zh: 算好的參數值，例如 `params.resolve(…)` 的結果：`{ hue: 90, size: 5.5 }`。

params.name: bindings
params.en: The `bindings` that [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) returned.
params.zh: [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 回傳的 `bindings`。

returns.en: One entry per binding that has a number in `state`: `name` is the widget's signal, `value` is the param scaled to 0..1 and held in range. A param that is missing, not a number, or with `min` equal to `max` is skipped.
returns.zh: `state` 裡有數字的每個 binding 各一項：`name` 是元件的訊號，`value` 是縮放到 0..1 並限制在範圍內的參數值。缺少、不是數字、或 `min` 等於 `max` 的參數會跳過。

caption.en: Prints surface/main/hue = 0.25 (90 of 0 to 360) and surface/main/size = 0.5 (5.5 of 1 to 10).
caption.zh: 印出 surface/main/hue = 0.25（0 到 360 裡的 90）和 surface/main/size = 0.5（1 到 10 裡的 5.5）。

summary.en: Says whether a grid `{ cols, rows }` is `'landscape'` (at least as many columns as rows) or `'portrait'`.
summary.zh: 判斷格線 `{ cols, rows }` 是 `'landscape'`（欄數不少於列數）還是 `'portrait'`。

description.en: [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) compares it with the orientation of the screen: a base grid of 8 by 4 is used as it is on a landscape screen and reflowed on a portrait one.
description.zh: [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) 會拿它跟螢幕的方向比：8 乘 4 的基本格線在橫向螢幕上直接用，在直向螢幕上就重排。

params.name: g
params.en: The grid.
params.zh: 格線。

returns.en: `'landscape'` when `g.cols >= g.rows`, else `'portrait'`.
returns.zh: `g.cols >= g.rows` 是 `'landscape'`，否則是 `'portrait'`。

caption.en: Prints landscape for 8 x 4, portrait for 4 x 8, and landscape for 4 x 4.
caption.zh: 印出 8 x 4 是 landscape、4 x 8 是 portrait、4 x 4 是 landscape。

summary.en: Vibrates the phone for `ms` milliseconds where the browser can (Android Chrome); silent everywhere else, and `enabled` false turns it off.
summary.zh: 瀏覽器做得到的地方（Android 的 Chrome）讓手機震動 `ms` 毫秒，其他地方什麼都不會發生，`enabled` 為 false 就關掉。

description.en: It calls `navigator.vibrate(ms)` when that exists and swallows any error. Browsers without it, such as Safari on iPhone, simply do nothing, and Chrome only vibrates after the person has touched the page. [`Surface`](#Surface) calls it for buttons, toggles and radios, and its `haptics: false` option turns that off.
description.zh: 它在 `navigator.vibrate(ms)` 存在的時候呼叫它，並吞掉任何錯誤。沒有它的瀏覽器，例如 iPhone 上的 Safari，就單純什麼都不做，而 Chrome 要等使用者碰過頁面之後才會震動。[`Surface`](#Surface) 會在按鈕、開關和單選時呼叫它，它的 `haptics: false` 選項可以把這個關掉。

params.name: ms
params.en: How long to vibrate, in milliseconds. A button press in the surface uses 10 to 14.
params.zh: 震動多久，單位毫秒。面板裡按一下按鈕用的是 10 到 14。

params.name: enabled
params.en: Pass `false` to do nothing: a page can offer a "haptics" switch and hand it here.
params.zh: 傳 `false` 就什麼都不做：頁面可以提供一個「觸覺回饋」開關，把它的值交給這裡。

examples.code:
import { haptic } from '@openav/surface';

document.querySelector('button').addEventListener('pointerdown', () => haptic(20));   // a short buzz on every press

caption.en: On an Android phone the button buzzes for 20 ms each time it is pressed; elsewhere nothing happens.
caption.zh: 在 Android 手機上，按一下按鈕就震 20 毫秒，其他地方什麼都不會發生。

caption.en: Prints "vibrate 20 ms" and "vibrate 30 ms": the call with enabled false made no vibration.
caption.zh: 印出「vibrate 20 ms」和「vibrate 30 ms」：enabled 為 false 的那一次沒有震動。

tbd.en: Not felt on a real Android phone for this entry. The example uses a stand-in for `navigator.vibrate` to show when it is called.
tbd.zh: 這一條沒有在真正的 Android 手機上感受過。範例用了一個代替 `navigator.vibrate` 的替身，來示範什麼時候會被呼叫。

summary.en: Writes the surface's stylesheet into the page, once: the 15 theme variables on `:root` and the rules for every widget. Safe to call again.
summary.zh: 把面板的樣式表寫進頁面，只寫一次：`:root` 上的 15 個主題變數，以及每個元件的樣式規則。重複呼叫也沒問題。

description.en: [`Surface`](#Surface) and `mountRemote()` call it for you, so you need it only when you build a [widget](#WIDGET_CLASSES) by yourself, or when you want the variables (`var(--oav-accent)`) for your own elements. It adds one `<style id="openav-surface-css">` to the head, and does nothing if that already exists, or if there is no `document`. To change the look, set a variable after that: `document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--oav-accent', '#ff5fb3')`.
description.zh: [`Surface`](#Surface) 和 `mountRemote()` 會替你呼叫它，所以只有自己建立 [元件](#WIDGET_CLASSES) 的時候，或想在自己的元素上用這些變數（`var(--oav-accent)`）的時候才需要它。它會在 head 裡加一個 `<style id="openav-surface-css">`，這個已經存在、或根本沒有 `document` 的話，就什麼都不做。要改外觀，在那之後設變數：`document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--oav-accent', '#ff5fb3')`。

caption.en: Prints "(not set)" before, #7ea6ff after, and exactly one style tag even though it was called twice.
caption.zh: 印出之前是「(not set)」、之後是 #7ea6ff，而且就算呼叫了兩次，style 標籤也只有一個。

caption.en: A fader and a knob drawn in pink: they have no colour of their own, so they take the accent that was overridden.
caption.zh: 一支推桿和一個旋鈕畫成粉紅色：它們沒有自己的顏色，所以用了被覆寫過的強調色。

summary.en: Asks the browser to keep the screen on (a screen wake lock) and asks again when the tab comes back. Returns `{ release() }`.
summary.zh: 請瀏覽器讓螢幕保持亮著（螢幕喚醒鎖），分頁回來時再要求一次。回傳 `{ release() }`。

description.en: A phone that is a controller dims and locks within a minute unless something holds the screen on. `keepAwake()` requests `navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')` right away if the page is visible. The operating system drops the lock whenever the page is hidden, so it asks again each time the page becomes visible. It is best effort and silent: a browser with no wake lock, or one that says no, just means the screen may still dim, and it never throws.
description.zh: 當控制器用的手機，一分鐘內就會暗掉、鎖定，除非有東西讓螢幕保持亮著。如果頁面看得到，`keepAwake()` 馬上要求 `navigator.wakeLock.request('screen')`。頁面一被藏起來，作業系統就會放掉這把鎖，所以每次頁面再變成可見，它都會再要求一次。它是盡力而為、而且不出聲：瀏覽器沒有喚醒鎖、或回答不行的話，就只是螢幕可能還是會暗掉，它絕不會丟出錯誤。

returns.en: `release()` stops asking and lets go of the lock.
returns.zh: `release()` 停止再要求，並放掉喚醒鎖。

needs.en: A page that is visible, on `https` or `localhost` (the wake lock only exists on secure pages). `mountRemote()` calls it for you.
needs.zh: 頁面要看得到，而且在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下（喚醒鎖只存在於安全的頁面）。`mountRemote()` 會替你呼叫它。

caption.en: On a phone or a laptop the screen stops dimming while the page is open and visible.
caption.zh: 在手機或筆電上，頁面開著而且看得到的時候，螢幕不會再暗掉。

caption.en: Prints "request screen", then "lock released" and "release() called": one request when the page is visible, and release() lets the lock go.
caption.zh: 印出「request screen」，然後是「lock released」和「release() called」：頁面看得到時要求一次，release() 把鎖放掉。

tbd.en: Not tried on a real iPhone or iPad: Safari may refuse a wake-lock request that is not made inside a tap, in which case the screen can still dim. The second example only shows the calls, with a stand-in for `navigator.wakeLock`.
tbd.zh: 沒有在真正的 iPhone 或 iPad 上試過：Safari 可能會拒絕不在點擊裡發出的喚醒鎖要求，這時螢幕還是會暗掉。第二個範例只示範呼叫的順序，用了一個代替 `navigator.wakeLock` 的替身。

summary.en: Makes a page behave like an instrument panel instead of a web page: no scrolling, no pinch zoom, no rubber-banding. Returns a function that undoes most of it.
summary.zh: 讓頁面像儀器面板，而不是網頁：不能捲動、不能雙指縮放、不會有橡皮筋回彈。回傳一個函式，可以復原其中大部分。

description.en: It sets `<meta name="viewport">` to `width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover` (making the tag if there is none) and adds a style that gives `html` and `body` no margin, the full height, `overflow: hidden`, `overscroll-behavior: none` and `touch-action: none`. iOS ignores `user-scalable=no`, so it also cancels `gesturestart` and `gesturechange` (pinch zoom) and the default of every `touchmove`, except one that starts in an `input` or `textarea`, so a text box still works.
description.zh: 它把 `<meta name="viewport">` 設成 `width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover`（沒有這個標籤就先做一個），並加一段樣式，讓 `html` 和 `body` 沒有邊界、高度填滿、`overflow: hidden`、`overscroll-behavior: none`、`touch-action: none`。iOS 會忽略 `user-scalable=no`，所以它也取消 `gesturestart` 和 `gesturechange`（雙指縮放），以及每個 `touchmove` 的預設行為，只有從 `input` 或 `textarea` 開始的例外，所以文字框還是能用。

description.en: This is for a page that is a control panel, such as `mountRemote()`, which calls it. Do not call it on a page that has to scroll. Without a `document` (in Node) it returns a function that does nothing.
description.zh: 這是給整個頁面就是控制面板的情況用的，例如 `mountRemote()` 就會呼叫它。要捲動的頁面不要呼叫它。沒有 `document`（在 Node 裡）的話，它回傳一個什麼都不做的函式。

returns.en: Call it to remove the stylesheet and the listeners. The viewport `<meta>` stays as it was set.
returns.zh: 呼叫它會移除樣式表和監聽。viewport 的 `<meta>` 維持設好的樣子，不會還原。

caption.en: Prints the viewport string, "hidden" while locked, and "visible" after unlock(): the stylesheet goes away, the meta tag stays.
caption.zh: 印出 viewport 字串、鎖定時的「hidden」、unlock() 之後的「visible」：樣式表消失了，meta 標籤還在。

summary.en: Returns a copy of a layout with the defaults filled in: ids, titles, grids and the version. The input is not changed.
summary.zh: 回傳一份補上預設值的版面複本：id、標題、格線和版本。原本的輸入不會被改動。

description.en: A page without an `id` becomes `page1`, `page2` …; without a `title` it gets its id (or `Page 1`); without a `grid` it gets `{ cols: 8, rows: 6 }`. A widget without an `id` becomes its type and its position in the list, `fader1`; an id already used on the page gets `_` added until it is unique. Every other field is kept as it is. [`Surface`](#Surface) normalizes the layout it is given, and so do [`signalNames()`](#signalNames) and the show side of the remote.
description.zh: 沒有 `id` 的頁面會變成 `page1`、`page2` …，沒有 `title` 就用它的 id（或 `Page 1`），沒有 `grid` 就是 `{ cols: 8, rows: 6 }`。沒有 `id` 的元件會變成「類型加在清單中的位置」，像 `fader1`。在同一頁已經用過的 id 會一直加上 `_` 直到不重複。其他欄位原樣保留。[`Surface`](#Surface) 會把拿到的版面正規化，[`signalNames()`](#signalNames) 和遙控的演出端也一樣。

params.name: raw
params.en: The layout JSON. `undefined` or an object without pages gives a layout with no pages.
params.zh: 版面 JSON。`undefined` 或沒有 pages 的物件，會得到沒有任何頁面的版面。

returns.en: `{ version: 1, title, pages }` with every page and widget complete.
returns.zh: `{ version: 1, title, pages }`，每個頁面和元件的欄位都補齊了。

notes.en: The default grid has 6 rows. [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) writes its own grids of 8 by 4, so this default only matters for layouts that leave the grid out.
notes.zh: 預設格線是 6 列。[`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 自己寫的格線是 8 乘 4，所以這個預設值只對沒寫格線的版面有意義。

caption.en: Prints "page: page1 "Page 1", grid 8x6" and the widget ids fader1, fader1_ (the second fader1 was already taken), knob3.
caption.zh: 印出「page: page1 "Page 1", grid 8x6」和元件 id：fader1、fader1_（第二個 fader1 已經被用了）、knob3。
