summary.en: Says whether a box is `'landscape'` or `'portrait'` from its width and height; a square counts as landscape.
summary.zh: 從寬和高判斷一個框是 `'landscape'`（橫向）還是 `'portrait'`（直向），正方形算橫向。

description.en: [`Surface`](#Surface) calls it with the size of its container, not the size of the screen, so a panel in a half-width pane can be portrait while the phone is landscape. Use [`gridOrientation()`](#gridOrientation) for the shape of a grid.
description.zh: [`Surface`](#Surface) 傳給它的是容器的大小，不是螢幕的大小，所以放在半寬窗格裡的面板可以是直向，而手機本身是橫向。要判斷格線的形狀，用 [`gridOrientation()`](#gridOrientation)。

params.name: w
params.en: The width, in any unit.
params.zh: 寬，什麼單位都可以。

params.name: h
params.en: The height, in the same unit.
params.zh: 高，單位跟寬一樣。

returns.en: `'landscape'` when `w >= h`, else `'portrait'`.
returns.zh: `w >= h` 是 `'landscape'`，否則是 `'portrait'`。

caption.en: Prints landscape for 844 x 390, portrait for 390 x 844, and landscape for the square.
caption.zh: 印出 844 x 390 是 landscape、390 x 844 是 portrait，正方形是 landscape。

entries.name: planKeyboard
entries.signature: planKeyboard({ width, height, base = 48, minKeyPx = 38, maxWhites = 22, stackBelow = 2.2, forceRows = 0 })

summary.en: Decides how many piano keys, in how many rows, fit a box: one wide row, or two stacked rows when the box is tall, so keys stay a playable size.
summary.zh: 決定一個框裡放得下多少琴鍵、排成幾列：框很寬就一排，框很高就上下兩排，讓琴鍵維持好彈的大小。

description.en: A piano is two and a half metres wide and a phone held upright is six centimetres, so shrinking the keys makes a toy. Instead the keyboard changes shape with its box. A wide box gets one row with as many octaves as fit at `minKeyPx` or wider. A tall box gets two rows, the upper one continuing the pitch range where the lower stops, within reach of a thumb. The rows end on E or B and the next one starts on the next white key, so no black key is left alone at the seam. Notes stop at 127. The `keyboard` widget of [`Surface`](#Surface) calls this every time its box changes size.
description.zh: 一台鋼琴有兩公尺半寬，直拿的手機只有六公分，把琴鍵縮小只會變成玩具。所以改成讓鍵盤隨著框的形狀變形。很寬的框得到一排，放得下幾個八度就放幾個（白鍵不窄於 `minKeyPx`）。很高的框得到兩排，上排接著下排停下來的地方往高音延伸，拇指搆得到。每一排都結束在 E 或 B，下一排從下一個白鍵開始，所以接縫處不會留下孤單的黑鍵。音符最高到 127。[`Surface`](#Surface) 的 `keyboard` 元件在框的大小改變時，每次都會呼叫它。

params.name: width
params.en: The width of the box, in pixels.
params.zh: 框的寬，單位像素。

params.name: height
params.en: The height of the box, in pixels.
params.zh: 框的高，單位像素。

params.name: base
params.en: The MIDI note of the lowest key. 48 is C3 (C4 is 60).
params.zh: 最低音那個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼。48 是 C3（C4 是 60）。

params.name: minKeyPx
params.en: The narrowest a white key may be, in pixels. At least 3 white keys are kept.
params.zh: 白鍵最窄可以多寬，單位像素。至少會保留 3 個白鍵。

params.name: maxWhites
params.en: The most white keys in a row. Two stacked rows are limited to 14 each.
params.zh: 一排最多幾個白鍵。上下兩排的話，每排最多 14 個。

params.name: stackBelow
params.en: Stack into two rows when width ÷ height is below this.
params.zh: 寬 ÷ 高低於這個值就改成上下兩排。

params.name: forceRows
params.en: `1` or `2` to decide yourself; `0` lets the shape of the box decide.
params.zh: `1` 或 `2` 自己決定，`0` 由框的形狀決定。

returns.en: `stacked` is true for two rows, `whites` the white keys in a row, `keyPx` the width of a white key. `rows` is a list of `{ base, semitones, whites }`, **the top row first** (the higher notes), the way two keyboards are read: `base` is the MIDI note of the first key and `semitones` how many notes the row spans.
returns.zh: `stacked` 為 true 就是兩排，`whites` 是每排的白鍵數，`keyPx` 是白鍵的寬度。`rows` 是 `{ base, semitones, whites }` 的清單，**上面那一排在最前面**（音比較高），就像兩層鍵盤的讀法：`base` 是第一個鍵的 MIDI 音符號碼，`semitones` 是那一排涵蓋幾個半音。

caption.en: Prints one row of 21 white keys (notes 48 to 83) for the wide box, and two rows of 10 (notes 65 to 81 on top, 48 to 64 below) for the tall one.
caption.zh: 寬的框印出一排 21 個白鍵（音符 48 到 83），高的框印出兩排各 10 個（上排 65 到 81、下排 48 到 64）。

summary.en: Works out where every widget of one page goes for one orientation: the grid and a cell for each widget, and which rule produced it.
summary.zh: 算出某一頁在某個方向下每個元件要放哪裡：格線，以及每個元件的格子，還有是哪一條規則排出來的。

description.en: A phone gets turned, so a layout has to survive it. The rules, in order: 1. If the page has a `portrait` or `landscape` entry for this orientation, use its `grid` and its `place` (`{ widgetId: { x, y, w, h } }`); widgets it does not mention keep their own position, or are packed into free cells (`source` is `'explicit'`). 2. Else, if the base grid has the right shape (more columns than rows is landscape) and every widget has an `x` and a `y`, use the base (`'base'`). 3. Else reflow: the same widgets in reading order, packed again into half the columns (portrait, at least 2) or twice as many (landscape, up to 16), with a lone last row stretched to the edge by [`stretchRows()`](#stretchRows) (`'reflow'`).
description.zh: 手機會被轉來轉去，所以版面一定要撐得住。規則依序是：1. 頁面針對這個方向有 `portrait` 或 `landscape` 的項目，就用它的 `grid` 和 `place`（`{ 元件 id: { x, y, w, h } }`）。它沒提到的元件保留自己的位置，或被打包進空的格子（`source` 是 `'explicit'`）。2. 否則，基本格線的形狀對（欄數多於列數是橫向）、而且每個元件都有 `x` 和 `y`，就用基本格線（`'base'`）。3. 否則重排：同樣的元件依閱讀順序，重新打包進一半的欄數（直向，至少 2 欄）或兩倍的欄數（橫向，最多 16 欄），最後孤零零的一列由 [`stretchRows()`](#stretchRows) 拉到邊緣（`'reflow'`）。

description.en: Rows are a count, not pixels, so the result always fills the screen and nothing scrolls. A widget without `w` and `h` takes the size of its type from [`DEFAULT_SIZE`](#DEFAULT_SIZE). [`Surface`](#Surface) calls this for every page each time the orientation changes.
description.zh: 列數是個數，不是像素，所以結果永遠填滿螢幕，不會捲動。沒有 `w` 和 `h` 的元件，會用 [`DEFAULT_SIZE`](#DEFAULT_SIZE) 裡它的類型的大小。每次方向改變，[`Surface`](#Surface) 都會對每一頁呼叫它。

params.name: page
params.en: One page of a layout: `{ grid, widgets, portrait?, landscape? }`.
params.zh: 版面中的一頁：`{ grid, widgets, portrait?, landscape? }`。

params.name: orientation
params.en: Which way the screen is held.
params.zh: 螢幕怎麼拿。

returns.en: `grid` is `{ cols, rows }`, `placements` a list of `{ id, x, y, w, h }`, `source` is `'explicit'`, `'base'` or `'reflow'`.
returns.zh: `grid` 是 `{ cols, rows }`，`placements` 是 `{ id, x, y, w, h }` 的清單，`source` 是 `'explicit'`、`'base'` 或 `'reflow'`。

caption.en: Prints "landscape: base, 8 columns x 4 rows" and "portrait: reflow, 4 columns x 8 rows": turned upright, the eight faders become two rows of four.
caption.zh: 印出「landscape: base, 8 columns x 4 rows」和「portrait: reflow, 4 columns x 8 rows」：轉成直的之後，八支推桿變成兩列、每列四支。

caption.en: Prints "explicit": a goes where the portrait entry says, the knob and the button (which have no place) fill the free cells.
caption.zh: 印出「explicit」：a 照 portrait 項目寫的位置放，旋鈕和按鈕（沒有位置）填進空的格子。

summary.en: Writes the mapper routes for a hand-written layout: every widget that names a param in `target` gets a route from its signal to that param.
summary.zh: 替手寫的版面產生映射器路由：每個用 `target` 指定參數的元件，都會得到一條從它的訊號到那個參數的路由。

description.en: Give a widget a `target` and the layout file is enough to perform a world. `target` is a param key, or an array for the widgets with several signals: an `xy` sends x to the first and y to the second, a `bank` sends channel *i* to the *i*-th. Every other widget uses its first (or only) target. The routes already scale the 0..1 signal to the param's `min` and `max`. [`mountRemoteHost()`](#mountRemoteHost) uses this for a layout from `world.surface` or from its `surface` option.
description.zh: 給元件一個 `target`，光靠版面檔案就能演奏一個世界。`target` 是參數鍵，訊號不只一個的元件可以給陣列：`xy` 把 x 送給第一個、y 送給第二個，`bank` 把第 *i* 個頻道送給第 *i* 個。其他元件都用第一個（或唯一的）target。路由已經把 0..1 的訊號換算成參數的 `min` 和 `max`。[`mountRemoteHost()`](#mountRemoteHost) 遇到來自 `world.surface` 或 `surface` 選項的版面，就是用它。

params.name: layout
params.en: The layout JSON, whose widgets may have a `target`.
params.zh: 版面 JSON，裡面的元件可以有 `target`。

params.name: params
params.en: The param declarations. A `target` that is not among them is skipped without a warning.
params.zh: 參數宣告。`target` 不在裡面的話，會不吭一聲地跳過。

params.name: smooth
params.en: Seconds of smoothing on continuous routes. A widget's own `smooth` wins. Pulse params and button, toggle and radio widgets are never smoothed.
params.zh: 連續路由的平滑秒數。元件自己的 `smooth` 優先。脈衝參數，以及 button、toggle、radio 元件不會被平滑。

returns.en: Routes in the same shape [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) makes: `{ source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }`, with `curve` taken from the widget (`linear` if it has none).
returns.zh: 格式跟 [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 做出來的一樣的路由：`{ source, target, inMin, inMax, curve, smooth, outMin, outMax }`，`curve` 取自元件（沒有就是 `linear`）。

caption.en: Prints surface/p/size → size, surface/p/pos/x → cx, surface/p/pos/y → cy, surface/p/go → burst: the label has no target, so no route.
caption.zh: 印出 surface/p/size → size、surface/p/pos/x → cx、surface/p/pos/y → cy、surface/p/go → burst：label 沒有 target，所以沒有路由。

summary.en: Lists every signal name a layout can publish, so a mapping screen, a doc or a test can show them without touching the panel.
summary.zh: 列出一份版面能發布的每一個訊號名稱，讓映射畫面、文件或測試不用碰面板就能列出它們。

description.en: It follows the table in [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES): an XY pad gives `/x`, `/y`, `/down`; a bank gives `/1` to `/count`; pads give `/hit` and `/0` to `/<rows × cols − 1>`; an encoder gives its name and `/delta`; a keyboard gives `midi/note/on`, `midi/note/off`, `midi/cc/64` and `midi/virtual`; a label or a meter gives nothing. The `…/raw` names that a widget with a range also sends are not in the list.
description.zh: 它依照 [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES) 裡的表：XY 板給 `/x`、`/y`、`/down`，bank 給 `/1` 到 `/count`，pads 給 `/hit` 和 `/0` 到 `/<列數 × 欄數 − 1>`，encoder 給它自己的名稱和 `/delta`，keyboard 給 `midi/note/on`、`midi/note/off`、`midi/cc/64` 和 `midi/virtual`，label 和 meter 什麼都不給。有範圍的元件另外送的 `…/raw` 名稱不在清單裡。

params.name: layout
params.en: The layout JSON (it is normalized first).
params.zh: 版面 JSON（會先正規化）。

returns.en: Unique names such as `surface/main/hue`, `surface/main/pad/x`, `midi/note/on`, in page and widget order.
returns.zh: 不重複的名稱，像 `surface/main/hue`、`surface/main/pad/x`、`midi/note/on`，依頁面和元件的順序。

caption.en: Prints surface/main/hue, then pos/x, pos/y, pos/down, then mix/1 and mix/2: the label gives nothing.
caption.zh: 印出 surface/main/hue，然後是 pos/x、pos/y、pos/down，再來是 mix/1 和 mix/2：label 什麼都不給。

summary.en: Makes a `sink` for a `Surface` that writes straight into a `Signals` registry: for a panel on the same page as the show, with no phone and no relay.
summary.zh: 做一個給 `Surface` 用的 `sink`，直接寫進 `Signals`：給跟演出在同一頁上的面板用，不需要手機，也不需要中繼。

description.en: A name it has not met is declared first: `{ kind: 'pulse' }` when `info.pulse` is set, otherwise `{ min: 0, max: 1 }`. Then a pulse fires with `signals.pulse()` and anything else is `signals.set()`. So a route in the mapper, `{ source: 'surface/main/hue', target: 'hue' }`, works whether the finger is on this page or on a phone.
description.zh: 還沒見過的名稱會先宣告：`info.pulse` 有設的話是 `{ kind: 'pulse' }`，不然是 `{ min: 0, max: 1 }`。然後脈衝用 `signals.pulse()` 觸發，其他都是 `signals.set()`。所以映射器裡的路由 `{ source: 'surface/main/hue', target: 'hue' }`，不論手指在這個頁面上還是在手機上，都能運作。

description.en: It does no scaling: the `…/raw` signal that a widget with a range sends is filed like any other name, with the range 0..1 it was declared with, so ignore those or give them their own declaration.
description.zh: 它不做任何縮放：有範圍的元件送出的 `…/raw` 訊號，會跟其他名稱一樣歸檔，宣告的範圍是 0..1，所以請忽略它們，或自己另外宣告。

params.name: signals
params.en: The registry to write into (from `@openav/core`).
params.zh: 要寫進去的註冊表（來自 `@openav/core`）。

returns.en: A `(name, value, info) => {}` to pass as `Surface`'s `sink`.
returns.zh: 一個 `(name, value, info) => {}`，傳給 `Surface` 的 `sink`。

caption.en: Prints "level = 0.4, kind continuous" and "go = 1, kind pulse": the sink declared each name the first time it saw it.
caption.zh: 印出「level = 0.4, kind continuous」和「go = 1, kind pulse」：sink 第一次看到每個名稱時就替它宣告了。

summary.en: Stretches a last row that stops short to the edge of the grid: five faders in four columns leave one lonely fader, and this makes it four columns wide.
summary.zh: 把停在半途的最後一列拉到格線邊緣：四欄裡放五支推桿會剩下一支孤零零的，這個函式把它拉成四欄寬。

description.en: A row is stretched only when it is safe: its widgets are all the same height, side by side with no gaps from the left edge, and nothing else sits to their right. The extra columns are dealt out one at a time from left to right, so a short row of three in four columns gives the first widget two columns. A row that does not qualify is left alone, and nothing ever overlaps. [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) calls it at the end of a reflow.
description.zh: 只有安全的時候才會拉長一列：它的元件高度都一樣、從左邊緣開始一個接一個沒有空隙、右邊也沒有別的東西。多出來的欄數從左到右一欄一欄分下去，所以四欄裡只有三個元件的短列，第一個元件會拿到兩欄。不符合條件的列就不動，也絕不會重疊。[`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) 在重排的最後會呼叫它。

params.name: placements
params.en: Placements, for example from [`autoArrange()`](#autoArrange). Not changed: copies come back.
params.zh: 位置清單，例如來自 [`autoArrange()`](#autoArrange)。不會被改動，回傳的是複本。

params.name: cols
params.en: How many columns the grid has.
params.zh: 格線有幾欄。

returns.en: The placements, with the short rows widened.
returns.zh: 位置清單，短的列已經加寬。

notes.en: Advanced. You rarely call it yourself.
notes.zh: 進階用法。通常不用自己呼叫。

caption.en: Prints f0 to f3 at width 1 both times, and f4 going from width 1 to width 4.
caption.zh: 印出 f0 到 f3 的寬度前後都是 1，而 f4 的寬度從 1 變成 4。

entries.name: Surface
entries.signature: new Surface(container, { layout, sink, haptics = true, tabs = true, orientation = null, onPage = null } = {})

summary.en: A TouchOSC-style control panel: draws the pages and widgets of a layout in a container, and sends each touch out as a named signal.
summary.zh: 像 TouchOSC 的控制面板：把版面裡的頁面和元件畫在容器裡，每一次觸碰都變成一個有名字的訊號送出去。

description.en: Pass `new Surface(container, { layout, sink })` and a panel appears: faders, knobs, an XY pad, pads, a keyboard, whatever the layout names, each with its live number. Widgets are dumb on purpose. Fingers go in, named normalized signals come out of `sink`, and the surface never knows what the work is. Run it on the show page with [`signalSink()`](#signalSink), or on a phone with a sink that sends to the relay: the same layout works for both. A world's params can grow the whole layout by themselves with [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface).
description.zh: 呼叫 `new Surface(container, { layout, sink })`，面板就出現了：推桿、旋鈕、XY 板、打擊墊、琴鍵，版面裡寫什麼就有什麼，每個都顯示即時的數字。元件刻意做得很笨：手指進去，有名字的正規化訊號從 `sink` 出來，面板完全不知道作品是什麼。在演出頁面上搭配 [`signalSink()`](#signalSink) 用，或在手機上搭配送去中繼的 sink 用：同一份版面兩邊都行。世界的參數也能用 [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 自己長出整份版面。

description.en: The grid always fills the container and nothing scrolls. When the container is turned, the page is laid out again for the new orientation by [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage): a `portrait` or `landscape` variant in the layout if there is one, else the base grid, else the same widgets packed again into half or double the columns. Touching a widget outlines it in its colour, and a double-tap on a fader or knob returns it to its default.
description.zh: 格線一定填滿容器，不會有任何捲動。容器轉向的時候，頁面會由 [`resolvePage()`](#resolvePage) 依新的方向重新排：版面裡有 `portrait` 或 `landscape` 的版本就用它，沒有就用基本格線，再不行就把同樣的元件重新擺進一半或兩倍的欄數。碰到元件時，它會用自己的顏色描邊，在推桿或旋鈕上連點兩下就回到預設值。

description.en: Runner to widget goes the other way: [`feedback(name, value)`](#Surface) moves a fader to follow the timeline, or fills a meter. A widget under a finger ignores feedback while it is touched and for about half a second after, so it does not fight the hand (a button only while it is held).
description.zh: 從演出端到元件是另一條路：`feedback(name, value)` 讓推桿跟著時間軸動，或把音量表填起來。手指碰著的元件，在被碰著的時候和放開後大約半秒內，會忽略 feedback，不跟手搶（按鈕則只有按住的時候）。

params.name: container
params.en: Where the panel goes. The panel is `position: absolute` and fills it, so the container needs a position (`position: relative`) and a size, or the panel has none.
params.zh: 面板要放的地方。面板是 `position: absolute`，會填滿它，所以容器要有定位（`position: relative`）和大小，不然面板就沒有大小。

params.name: layout
params.en: The layout JSON (see [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout)): pages, a grid, widgets. A bad layout throws an error that lists every problem.
params.zh: 版面 JSON（見 [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout)）：頁面、格線、元件。版面有問題會丟出錯誤，列出每一個問題。

params.name: sink
params.en: `(name, value, info) => {}`, called for every signal a touch makes. `name` is like `surface/main/hue`, `value` is normalized 0..1 (an event is `info.pulse`, a string for a text box). When a widget's range is not 0..1, `info.raw` holds the unscaled value, and a second call follows with the name `…/raw`. [`signalSink()`](#signalSink) writes into a `Signals`; a phone passes one that calls `relay.set`.
params.zh: `(name, value, info) => {}`，每一次觸碰產生訊號都會呼叫。`name` 像 `surface/main/hue`，`value` 是正規化的 0..1（事件是 `info.pulse`，文字框則是字串）。元件的範圍不是 0..1 的時候，`info.raw` 帶著沒縮放的值，接著還會再呼叫一次，名稱是 `…/raw`。[`signalSink()`](#signalSink) 會寫進 `Signals`，手機上則傳一個呼叫 `relay.set` 的函式。

params.name: haptics
params.en: Buzz the phone briefly on a button, a toggle, a radio choice or a double-tap reset, where the browser can (Android Chrome). `false` turns it off.
params.zh: 在按下按鈕、切換開關、選了單選項目、雙擊重設的時候讓手機震一下，瀏覽器做得到的話（Android Chrome）。`false` 就關掉。

params.name: tabs
params.en: Show a tab strip when the layout has more than one page. `false` hides it, and you switch with `setPage()`.
params.zh: 版面有一頁以上的時候，顯示分頁列。`false` 就隱藏，改用 `setPage()` 切換。

params.name: orientation
params.en: Force the orientation. Left out, it follows the container's shape (wider than tall is landscape) and changes when the container does.
params.zh: 強制指定方向。不給的話，它跟著容器的形狀走（寬大於高是橫向），容器改變它也會跟著改。

params.name: onPage
params.en: `(pageId) => {}`, when the page changes, and once at the start with the first page.
params.zh: `(pageId) => {}`，換頁的時候呼叫，一開始也會用第一頁呼叫一次。

needs.en: A browser page (it builds DOM) and a container with a size. The panel injects its look once with [`injectTheme()`](#injectTheme). Nothing else to start: it works on the first touch. On a phone page, [`lockViewport()`](#lockViewport) stops the page from scrolling and zooming under the fingers.
needs.zh: 要有瀏覽器頁面（它會建立 DOM），而且容器要有大小。面板會用 [`injectTheme()`](#injectTheme) 把它的外觀注入一次。不用另外啟動：第一次觸碰就能用。在手機頁面上，用 [`lockViewport()`](#lockViewport) 讓頁面不會在手指底下捲動或縮放。

notes.en: Public fields: `layout` (the normalized layout), `root` (the panel's element), `orientation`, `pageId`, `widgets` (a `Map` of `"page/id"` to widget), `sink`, `haptics`.
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `layout`（正規化之後的版面）、`root`（面板的元素）、`orientation`、`pageId`、`widgets`（`"page/id"` 對應元件的 `Map`）、`sink`、`haptics`。

notes.en: The constructor appends the panel to the container before it checks the layout, so a layout that throws there leaves an empty panel behind. Run [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) first if the layout comes from a file or a person.
notes.zh: 建構函式在檢查版面之前就把面板加進容器了，所以版面在那裡丟出錯誤的話，會留下一個空的面板。版面來自檔案或使用者的話，請先跑 [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout)。

caption.en: A dark panel with a fader, an XY pad and a button. Touch one and the line under it shows the signal it sent, for example surface/main/size = 0.75 (raw 7.75).
caption.zh: 一個深色面板，有一支推桿、一塊 XY 板和一顆按鈕。碰其中一個，下面那行就顯示它送出的訊號，例如 surface/main/size = 0.75 (raw 7.75)。

caption.en: The meter rises and falls with a sine wave and the fader moves the opposite way: the show sending values back to the phone with feedback().
caption.zh: 音量表隨著正弦波起落，推桿朝相反方向動：這是演出端用 feedback() 把數值送回手機。

caption.en: A bad layout throws and lists every problem (an unknown type "dial", a duplicate id "x"); the panel that was already there stays as it was.
caption.zh: 有問題的版面會丟出錯誤，並列出每個問題（不認得的類型「dial」、重複的 id「x」），原本的面板維持不變。

members.name: setLayout
members.doc: (Re)build from layout JSON.

members.name: feedback
members.doc: Runner → widget.

summary.en: The look of every control as 15 CSS custom properties on `:root` (`--oav-bg`, `--oav-accent` …): override them to re-skin the whole surface.
summary.zh: 每個控制元件的外觀，收成 `:root` 上的 15 個 CSS 自訂屬性（`--oav-bg`、`--oav-accent` …）：覆寫它們就能替整個面板換皮膚。

description.en: The design is a set of rules rather than decoration, because a controller is used in the dark, fast and half-looking: dark cards on near-black, the only saturated thing on screen is a value, every touch target at least 44 px (`--oav-touch-min`), the number you are changing always visible, and a pressed widget outlines itself in its colour. Everything is a CSS variable, so a work re-skins the surface by overriding a few of them, never by editing widget code.
description.zh: 設計是一組規則，不是裝飾，因為控制器是在黑暗中、很快、只用眼角餘光看的：近黑底上的深色卡片、畫面上唯一飽和的東西是數值、每個觸碰目標至少 44 像素（`--oav-touch-min`）、正在調的數字一定看得到、被按住的元件用自己的顏色描邊。所有東西都是 CSS 變數，所以作品只要覆寫其中幾個就能換皮膚，不必改元件的程式碼。

description.en: [`injectTheme()`](#injectTheme) writes these values into the page once. Override after that, on `document.documentElement` or in your own stylesheet, with a rule that comes later on `:root`.
description.zh: [`injectTheme()`](#injectTheme) 會把這些值寫進頁面一次。要覆寫的話，在那之後，對 `document.documentElement` 設，或在你自己的樣式表裡用排在後面的 `:root` 規則。

value.en: Property name to its default value: `--oav-bg` #0a0c11, `--oav-surface` #141922, `--oav-surface-2` #1b2230, `--oav-line` #283044, `--oav-text` #e8ecf5, `--oav-dim` #8691a8, `--oav-accent` #7ea6ff, `--oav-ok` #3ddc84, `--oav-warn` #f5a524, `--oav-bad` #e5484d, `--oav-radius` 14px, `--oav-gap` 8px, `--oav-touch-min` 44px, `--oav-font` (the system font) and `--oav-mono` (a monospace font).
value.zh: 屬性名稱對應它的預設值：`--oav-bg` #0a0c11、`--oav-surface` #141922、`--oav-surface-2` #1b2230、`--oav-line` #283044、`--oav-text` #e8ecf5、`--oav-dim` #8691a8、`--oav-accent` #7ea6ff、`--oav-ok` #3ddc84、`--oav-warn` #f5a524、`--oav-bad` #e5484d、`--oav-radius` 14px、`--oav-gap` 8px、`--oav-touch-min` 44px、`--oav-font`（系統字型）和 `--oav-mono`（等寬字型）。

caption.en: Prints the background #0a0c11, the accent #7ea6ff, the corner radius 14px and the 44px minimum touch size.
caption.zh: 印出背景 #0a0c11、強調色 #7ea6ff、圓角 14px 和最小觸碰尺寸 44px。

summary.en: Enters fullscreen if the page is not in it, and leaves it if it is. Call it from a tap, because browsers refuse otherwise.
summary.zh: 頁面不在全螢幕就進入，已經在就離開。要在點擊裡呼叫，不然瀏覽器會拒絕。

description.en: It asks for the whole page (`document.documentElement`) with the browser's navigation bar hidden, and quietly does nothing on a browser without fullscreen (see [`canFullscreen()`](#canFullscreen)). The phone app puts it on a ⛶ button in the status bar.
description.zh: 它要求整個頁面（`document.documentElement`）進入全螢幕，並把瀏覽器的導覽列藏起來，瀏覽器沒有全螢幕功能（見 [`canFullscreen()`](#canFullscreen)）的話就安靜地什麼都不做。手機 app 把它放在狀態列的 ⛶ 按鈕上。

needs.en: A user gesture: call it from a `click` or `pointerdown` handler. Called on page load it is refused by the browser.
needs.zh: 需要使用者手勢：在 `click` 或 `pointerdown` 的處理函式裡呼叫。在頁面載入時呼叫，瀏覽器會拒絕。

caption.en: A button that puts the page into fullscreen and out again, and is hidden where the browser has no fullscreen.
caption.zh: 一顆讓頁面進入、再離開全螢幕的按鈕，瀏覽器沒有全螢幕的地方就隱藏。

summary.en: Checks a layout and returns a list of readable problems; an empty list means it is fine.
summary.zh: 檢查一份版面，回傳一串看得懂的問題清單，清單是空的就表示沒問題。

description.en: It looks for: no object, or no non-empty `pages` array (it stops there); a page without an `id`, with a duplicate id or an id outside `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -`; a widget whose `type` is not in [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES), without an `id`, with a duplicate id on its page or an id outside those characters (the id becomes part of a signal name); and a `min` equal to its `max`. It reports every problem it finds, not only the first.
description.zh: 它會檢查：不是物件、或沒有非空的 `pages` 陣列（到這裡就停），頁面沒有 `id`、id 重複、或 id 用了 `A–Z a–z 0–9 _ -` 以外的字元，元件的 `type` 不在 [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES) 裡、沒有 `id`、在同一頁 id 重複、或 id 用了那些以外的字元（id 會變成訊號名稱的一部分），還有 `min` 等於 `max`。它會報告找得到的每一個問題，不只是第一個。

description.en: It does not look at positions, grids or `target`s: a widget that overlaps another, or a `target` that is not a param, is not a problem here. [`Surface`](#Surface)'s `setLayout()` runs it and throws with the list when it is not empty.
description.zh: 它不看位置、格線或 `target`：元件互相重疊、或 `target` 不是任何參數，在這裡都不算問題。[`Surface`](#Surface) 的 `setLayout()` 會跑它，清單不是空的就丟出錯誤。

params.name: layout
params.en: The raw layout JSON.
params.zh: 原始的版面 JSON。

returns.en: One sentence per problem, with where it is (`pages[0].widgets[2]: unknown type "dial"`). `[]` when the layout is fine.
returns.zh: 每個問題一句話，附上位置（`pages[0].widgets[2]: unknown type "dial"`）。版面沒問題就是 `[]`。

caption.en: Prints "good: []", then five problems for the bad layout: the page id, the unknown type, the duplicate id, the missing id and min equal to max.
caption.zh: 印出「good: []」，然後是有問題的版面的五個問題：頁面 id、不認得的類型、重複的 id、缺少的 id、以及 min 等於 max。

summary.en: The widget classes, one per type, that `Surface` builds from a layout: `WIDGET_CLASSES.fader`, `.knob`, `.xy` and so on (advanced).
summary.zh: `Surface` 依版面建立的元件類別，每種類型一個：`WIDGET_CLASSES.fader`、`.knob`、`.xy` 等等（進階）。

description.en: Most pages never touch it: [`Surface`](#Surface) looks each `spec.type` up here. It is exported for code that wants a single widget without a whole panel. `spec` is the widget's entry of the layout (`{ id, type, label, min, max, … }`) and `ctx` is `{ page, out(name, value, info), haptic(ms) }`, where `out` is where the widget's signals go and `page` is the page id used in their names. A widget's element is `.el`; put it in the page yourself.
description.zh: 大部分頁面用不到它：[`Surface`](#Surface) 會在這裡查每個 `spec.type`。把它匯出來，是給只想要單一元件、不要整個面板的程式用的。`spec` 是元件在版面裡的那一項（`{ id, type, label, min, max, … }`），`ctx` 是 `{ page, out(name, value, info), haptic(ms) }`，`out` 就是元件的訊號送去的地方，`page` 是用在訊號名稱裡的頁面 id。元件的元素是 `.el`，要自己把它放進頁面。

description.en: Adding your own key here does not make a new layout type: [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) only accepts the names in [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES).
description.zh: 在這裡加你自己的鍵，並不會多出一種新的版面類型：[`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) 只接受 [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES) 裡的名稱。

value.en: An object with the same 14 keys as [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES), each a class: `new WIDGET_CLASSES[type](spec, ctx)`.
value.zh: 一個物件，鍵跟 [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES) 一樣有 14 個，每個值是一個類別：`new WIDGET_CLASSES[type](spec, ctx)`。

notes.en: Advanced. The `keyboard` widget wraps `KeysPiano` from `@openav/keys`.
notes.zh: 進階用法。`keyboard` 元件包著 `@openav/keys` 的 `KeysPiano`。

caption.en: A lone toggle on the page, and under it what it sent when it was switched on and off: surface/solo/mute = 1, then 0.
caption.zh: 頁面上有一個單獨的開關，下面是它被打開、關掉時送出的訊號：surface/solo/mute = 1，然後是 0。

summary.en: The names of the 14 widget types a layout may use: fader, knob, encoder, button, toggle, xy, bank, radio, pads, keyboard, number, text, label, meter.
summary.zh: 版面可以用的 14 種元件類型名稱：fader、knob、encoder、button、toggle、xy、bank、radio、pads、keyboard、number、text、label、meter。

description.en: Each widget publishes under `surface/<page>/<id>`, normalized 0..1; when its range is not 0..1 the unscaled value also goes out as `…/raw`. What each type sends:
description.zh: 每個元件都發布在 `surface/<page>/<id>` 底下，正規化成 0..1。範圍不是 0..1 的話，沒縮放的值也會以 `…/raw` 送出。各類型送出的東西：

description.en:
```text
fader, knob, number   <id>
button                 <id>  1 while held, 0 on release
toggle                 <id>  1 or 0
encoder                <id> (phase 0..1, wraps) and <id>/delta (turns)
xy                     <id>/x  <id>/y  <id>/down
bank                   <id>/1 … <id>/N        (count, default 8)
radio                  <id> = index / (n - 1), raw = index
pads                   <id>/hit {pad,row,col,vel}  and  <id>/<n> while held
keyboard               midi/note/on  midi/note/off  midi/cc/64
text                   <id>  a string, as a pulse
label, meter           nothing: they only receive feedback
```
description.zh:
```text
fader, knob, number   <id>
button                 <id>  1 while held, 0 on release
toggle                 <id>  1 or 0
encoder                <id> (phase 0..1, wraps) and <id>/delta (turns)
xy                     <id>/x  <id>/y  <id>/down
bank                   <id>/1 … <id>/N        (count, default 8)
radio                  <id> = index / (n - 1), raw = index
pads                   <id>/hit {pad,row,col,vel}  and  <id>/<n> while held
keyboard               midi/note/on  midi/note/off  midi/cc/64
text                   <id>  a string, as a pulse
label, meter           nothing: they only receive feedback
```

[`signalNames()`](#signalNames) 可以替你的版面列出這些名稱。

description.en: Fields every widget accepts: `id`, `type`, `label`, `min`, `max`, `def`, `step`, `unit`, `color` (one of [`COLOR_NAMES`](#COLOR_NAMES)) and, for hand-written layouts, `target`, the param key that [`routesFromLayout()`](#routesFromLayout) turns into a route. Others by type: `orient` (`v`, `h` or `auto`) on a fader, `spring: true` on an XY pad, `count` and `labels` on a bank, `options` on a radio, `rows`, `cols` and `labels` on pads, `pulse` on a button.
description.zh: 每個元件都接受的欄位：`id`、`type`、`label`、`min`、`max`、`def`、`step`、`unit`、`color`（[`COLOR_NAMES`](#COLOR_NAMES) 其中之一），手寫版面還可以加 `target`，也就是 [`routesFromLayout()`](#routesFromLayout) 要變成路由的參數鍵。各類型另有：推桿的 `orient`（`v`、`h` 或 `auto`）、XY 板的 `spring: true`、bank 的 `count` 和 `labels`、radio 的 `options`、pads 的 `rows`、`cols` 和 `labels`。

value.en: The keys of [`DEFAULT_SIZE`](#DEFAULT_SIZE), in that order. [`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) rejects any `type` that is not in it.
value.zh: [`DEFAULT_SIZE`](#DEFAULT_SIZE) 的鍵，順序也一樣。[`validateLayout()`](#validateLayout) 會拒絕不在裡面的 `type`。

caption.en: Lists the 14 types with their natural size in grid cells, from fader 1×4 to meter 1×4.
caption.zh: 列出 14 種類型和它們在格線上的預設大小，從 fader 1×4 到 meter 1×4。

summary.en: Picks the widget type for one param declaration: a button for a pulse, a toggle, a radio, a fader or a knob.
summary.zh: 替一個參數宣告挑元件類型：脈衝是按鈕，其他是開關、單選、推桿或旋鈕。

description.en: The rules, first match wins: a `surface: { type }` hint on the param; `pulse` is a `button`; `step: 1` over a range of 1 (two values) is a `toggle`; `step: 1` over a range of 2 to 6 (three to seven values) is a `radio`; `style` `'knob'` or `'fader'` as asked; otherwise a `fader`, or a `knob` when `continuousCount` is above 6. A missing `min` is 0 and a missing `max` is 1. [`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) calls it for every param.
description.zh: 規則依序比對，第一個符合的就用：參數上有 `surface: { type }` 提示就照它，`pulse` 是 `button`，`step: 1` 而範圍是 1（兩個值）是 `toggle`，`step: 1` 而範圍是 2 到 6（三到七個值）是 `radio`，`style` 要求 `'knob'` 或 `'fader'` 就照辦，其他是 `fader`，`continuousCount` 超過 6 時是 `knob`。沒寫 `min` 當 0，沒寫 `max` 當 1。[`autoSurface()`](#autoSurface) 會對每個參數呼叫它。

params.name: p
params.en: A param: `{ key, min?, max?, step?, pulse?, surface? }`.
params.zh: 一個參數：`{ key, min?, max?, step?, pulse?, surface? }`。

params.name: continuousCount
params.en: How many continuous params the panel has in all. More than 6 turns faders into knobs.
params.zh: 整個面板一共有幾個連續參數。超過 6 個，推桿就改成旋鈕。

params.name: style
params.en: Force faders or knobs for the continuous params.
params.zh: 連續參數強制用推桿或旋鈕。

returns.en: One of the names in [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES).
returns.zh: [`WIDGET_TYPES`](#WIDGET_TYPES) 裡的其中一個名稱。

caption.en: Prints hue → fader, mode → radio, mirror → toggle, burst → button, and a knob for hue once the panel has nine continuous params.
caption.zh: 印出 hue → fader、mode → radio、mirror → toggle、burst → button，以及面板有九個連續參數時，hue 變成旋鈕。

summary.en: Mounts the director's desk into an element: transport and scrubber, layers overview, inputs, mapping, param sliders, signal meters and a fullscreen performance mode.
summary.zh: 把導演控台掛進一個元素：播放控制與 scrubber、圖層總覽、輸入、映射、參數推桿、訊號音量表，以及全螢幕的演出模式。

description.en: The desk reads the same objects the loop runs and owns nothing. From top to bottom it has the transport (play, previous and next scene, reset, the clock) and a scrubber with a block for every scene (with a tick for every cue, and a dashed end for a hold, when the scenes have them); with a score, the Director panel; the **Layers** overview (L1 input, L2 mapping, L3 world, L4 output); **L1 · Input** (MIDI devices, 🎤 mic, 🖐 hands, 🕺 body, leap); **L2 · Mapping** (the routes with a mute box and ✕, **🎛 map knobs in order**, ⬇ export, ⬆ import, clear); **L3 · Params** (a slider per param with ✕ to clear the override and a *learn* chip; a yellow label means overridden); **L4 · sound** when there is a sound engine; and the **Signals** meters with the MIDI log. Every panel header collapses its section.
description.zh: 控台讀的是迴圈實際在跑的那些物件，自己什麼都不擁有。由上到下依序是：播放控制（播放、上一個與下一個場景、重設、時鐘）和一條 scrubber（每個場景一個區塊，場景有 cue 的話每個 cue 一個刻度、有 hold 的話尾端是虛線）。有總譜的話，Director 面板。**Layers** 總覽（L1 輸入、L2 映射、L3 世界、L4 輸出）。**L1 · Input**（MIDI 裝置、🎤 mic、🖐 hands、🕺 body、leap）。**L2 · Mapping**（路由清單，附靜音框與 ✕，還有 **🎛 map knobs in order**、⬇ export、⬆ import、clear）。**L3 · Params**（每個參數一支推桿，附清除覆寫的 ✕ 和 *learn* 標籤，黃色標籤代表被覆寫）。有聲音引擎的話是 **L4 · sound**。最後是 **Signals** 音量表和 MIDI 紀錄。每個面板的標題都可以收合它的區塊。

description.en: Keyboard, on the whole window: <kbd>Space</kbd> play and pause (at a hold: release it), <kbd>→</kbd> and <kbd>←</kbd> next and previous scene (→ at a hold releases it), <kbd>R</kbd> back to the start, <kbd>T</kbd> performance mode (a fullscreen teleprompter for the performer: scene title, note and acts, the clock, the next scene, a HOLD banner), <kbd>F</kbd> fullscreen, <kbd>Esc</kbd> stops the mapping wizard or leaves keyboard-piano capture. Typing in an input field, a held key and any combination with ⌘, Ctrl or Alt are ignored. While the on-screen piano captures the keyboard the **letters** (R, T, F) belong to the piano; Space, the arrows and Esc always work.
description.zh: 鍵盤，作用在整個視窗：<kbd>Space</kbd> 播放與暫停（在 hold 上則是放行）、<kbd>→</kbd> 和 <kbd>←</kbd> 下一個與上一個場景（在 hold 上，→ 是放行）、<kbd>R</kbd> 回到起點、<kbd>T</kbd> 演出模式（給表演者看的全螢幕提詞器：場景標題、備註與 acts、時鐘、下一個場景、HOLD 橫幅）、<kbd>F</kbd> 全螢幕、<kbd>Esc</kbd> 停止映射精靈，或離開鍵盤鋼琴的捕捉。在輸入欄位裡打字、按住不放的鍵，以及任何帶 ⌘、Ctrl 或 Alt 的組合都會被忽略。螢幕鋼琴捕捉鍵盤的時候，**字母鍵**（R、T、F）屬於鋼琴，Space、方向鍵和 Esc 則永遠有效。

params.name: root
params.en: The element to build the desk in. It gets the class `oav-console`, and the desk's styles are added once to the head.
params.zh: 要在裡面建出控台的元素。它會得到 `oav-console` 這個 class，控台的樣式也會一次加進 `<head>`。

params.name: app
params.en: The objects the desk reads: `{ timeline, params, mapper, signals, stage }` are needed, and `midi`, `controllers`, `keys`, `sound`, `audio`, `hands`, `pose`, `leap`, `chord`, `remote`, `drums`, `loop`, `osc`, `score`, `director` are optional. A missing part hides its section. [`createShow()`](#createShow) passes `show.app`.
params.zh: 控台要讀取的物件：`{ timeline, params, mapper, signals, stage }` 一定要有，`midi`、`controllers`、`keys`、`sound`、`audio`、`hands`、`pose`、`leap`、`chord`、`remote`、`drums`、`loop`、`osc`、`score`、`director` 是選填的。缺少的部分，它的區塊就會隱藏。[`createShow()`](#createShow) 傳的是 `show.app`。

params.name: opts
params.en: `{ layers: false }` and `{ signals: false }` leave out the Layers and Signals panels; `{ learnOrder: ['hue', 'size'] }` sets the order of the **🎛 map knobs in order** wizard (default: the params as declared, skipping hidden ones and any with `wizard: false`).
params.zh: `{ layers: false }` 和 `{ signals: false }` 會省略 Layers 和 Signals 面板。`{ learnOrder: ['hue', 'size'] }` 設定 **🎛 map knobs in order** 精靈的順序（預設是依宣告順序的參數，略過 hidden 的和 `wizard: false` 的）。

returns.en: `{ render(state), perf, director, wizard, dispose() }`: `render` redraws the desk, `perf` is the performance mode (`toggle()`, `active`, `render()`), `director` the Director panel (or `null`), `wizard` the knob-mapping wizard, and `dispose()` removes the keyboard handler and empties the element.
returns.zh: `{ render(state), perf, director, wizard, dispose() }`：`render` 重畫控台，`perf` 是演出模式（`toggle()`、`active`、`render()`），`director` 是 Director 面板（或 `null`），`wizard` 是旋鈕映射精靈，`dispose()` 會移除鍵盤處理並清空這個元素。

needs.en: Call `desk.render(state)` every frame after `stage.frame()` (a show's loop does): the desk only redraws when you tell it to. `state` is the resolved params, `params.resolve(timeline.state())`.
needs.zh: 每個畫面在 `stage.frame()` 之後呼叫 `desk.render(state)`（演出的迴圈會做）：控台只在你叫它的時候才重畫。`state` 是解析後的參數，也就是 `params.resolve(timeline.state())`。

notes.en: The keyboard handler is on `window`, so two desks on one page both answer the keys. `dispose()` removes it. The performance mode's teleprompter is appended to `document.body`, not to `root`.
notes.zh: 鍵盤處理是掛在 `window` 上的，所以同一頁有兩個控台的話，兩個都會回應按鍵。`dispose()` 會移除它。演出模式的提詞器是加在 `document.body` 底下，不是 `root`。

notes.en: Touch a slider (or a mapped control) and that param leaves the timeline's hands until you press its ✕: the score gives way when a person grabs a control.
notes.zh: 碰一下推桿（或被映射的控制），那個參數就離開時間軸的掌控，直到你按下它的 ✕：有人抓住控制項的時候，樂譜讓路。

caption.en: The desk appears in the page: a transport with a clock running, a scrubber with two scene blocks (Dawn, Noon), the layers overview and a slider each for Hue and Size. The Hue slider follows the timeline until you drag it.
caption.zh: 控台出現在頁面上：一個時鐘在走的播放控制、一條有兩個場景區塊（Dawn、Noon）的 scrubber、圖層總覽，以及 Hue 和 Size 各一支推桿。Hue 推桿會跟著時間軸走，直到你去拖它。

caption.en: A desk without the Layers and Signals panels: the console prints `false true true` as performance mode is switched on from code, then `0` after `dispose()` has emptied the element.
caption.zh: 一個沒有 Layers 和 Signals 面板的控台：用程式打開演出模式，主控台印出 `false true true`，`dispose()` 把元素清空之後印出 `0`。

summary.en: Where the backstage relay is unless told otherwise: the page's own host on port 7457 as a `ws://` address, and `null` on an https page or where there is no page.
summary.zh: 沒有指定的時候後台中繼站在哪裡：頁面自己的主機加上 7457 連接埠，寫成 `ws://` 位址，在 https 頁面或沒有頁面的地方是 `null`。

description.en: It is the default `url` of [`MonitorFeed`](#MonitorFeed). Not on an https page: the browser blocks `ws://` there (mixed content, logged as an error), and a page published over https (openaudiovisual.com, a tunnel) has no relay beside it. A show that runs one behind TLS passes `{ url: 'wss://…' }` explicitly.
description.zh: 它是 [`MonitorFeed`](#MonitorFeed) 預設的 `url`。https 頁面上不用：瀏覽器在那裡會擋住 `ws://`（混合內容，會被記成錯誤），而且用 https 發布的頁面（openaudiovisual.com、通道）旁邊沒有中繼站。在 TLS 後面跑了一個中繼站的演出，要明確傳 `{ url: 'wss://…' }`。

params.name: loc
params.en: Anything with `protocol` and `hostname`, like `location`. Pass a fake one to test.
params.zh: 任何有 `protocol` 和 `hostname` 的東西，像 `location`。測試的時候可以傳一個假的。

returns.en: `'ws://<hostname>:7457'`, or `null` when `loc` is missing or its protocol is `https:`.
returns.zh: `'ws://<hostname>:7457'`，`loc` 不存在、或它的 protocol 是 `https:` 的時候是 `null`。

examples.code:
import { defaultMonitorUrl } from '@openav/monitor';

console.log(defaultMonitorUrl({ protocol: 'http:', hostname: '192.168.1.20' }));        // ws://192.168.1.20:7457
console.log(defaultMonitorUrl({ protocol: 'https:', hostname: 'openaudiovisual.com' })); // null
console.log(defaultMonitorUrl(null));                                                    // null: no page

caption.en: The console prints `ws://192.168.1.20:7457`, then `null` twice.

summary.en: Streams snapshots of the running show to the backstage relay over a WebSocket, at most `hz` times a second, and quietly keeps trying when there is no relay.
summary.zh: 把正在進行的演出的快照透過 WebSocket 串流到後台中繼站，每秒最多 `hz` 次，沒有中繼站的時候安靜地持續嘗試。

description.en: A show without a backstage is a rehearsal. Run the relay on the machine that serves the show (`node packages/monitor/server.js`, port 7457, which also serves the backstage page at `/` and `GET /health`), and a stage manager's phone or laptop on the same network opens `http://<that machine>:7457/` to see the clock, the scene, the world, the frame rate, the overrides and every signal and param live, with a red "stage feed lost" banner when the stage stops sending for 4 seconds. The show page joins as `?role=stage`; every other socket is a monitor. [`createShow()`](#createShow) already creates and connects one, so you only build a `MonitorFeed` for a show you assembled by hand.
description.zh: 沒有後台的演出只是排練。在提供演出頁面的那台機器上跑中繼站（`node packages/monitor/server.js`，連接埠 7457，它同時在 `/` 提供後台頁面，並有 `GET /health`），同一個網路上舞台監督的手機或筆電打開 `http://<那台機器>:7457/`，就能即時看到時鐘、場景、世界、影格率、覆寫，以及每個訊號和參數。舞台超過 4 秒沒有送資料，就會出現紅色的「stage feed lost」橫幅。演出頁面是以 `?role=stage` 加入的，其他所有 socket 都是監看端。[`createShow()`](#createShow) 已經會建好並連上一個，所以只有手工組裝的演出才需要自己建 `MonitorFeed`。

description.en: It is made to cost nothing when left on: with no relay it reconnects with a growing delay (about 5 seconds, growing by 1.6 each time up to 30), though the browser logs each refused connection, and that message is expected. `frame()` throttles itself, so call it every frame with a snapshot (see [`snapshotOf()`](#snapshotOf)).
description.zh: 它的設計是一直開著也不花什麼成本：沒有中繼站的時候，它用愈來愈長的間隔重連（大約 5 秒，每次乘以 1.6，最長 30 秒），不過瀏覽器會把每次被拒絕的連線記下來，那個訊息是預期中的。`frame()` 自己會節流，所以每個畫面都可以用一份快照呼叫它（見 [`snapshotOf()`](#snapshotOf)）。

params.name: url
params.en: The relay address, such as `'ws://192.168.1.20:7457'` (`?role=stage` is added for you). The default comes from [`defaultMonitorUrl()`](#defaultMonitorUrl): the page's own host on port 7457, and `null` on an https page. With `null`, `connect()` does nothing.
params.zh: 中繼站的位址，例如 `'ws://192.168.1.20:7457'`（`?role=stage` 會替你加上去）。預設值來自 [`defaultMonitorUrl()`](#defaultMonitorUrl)：頁面自己的主機加上 7457 連接埠，https 頁面則是 `null`。是 `null` 的時候，`connect()` 什麼都不做。

params.name: hz
params.en: The most snapshots sent per second.
params.zh: 每秒最多送出幾個快照。

needs.en: Call `connect()` once (a show does), then `frame(snapshot)` every frame. `frame()` does nothing while `connected` is false. The relay must be reachable from the page: on an https page the browser blocks `ws://` (mixed content), so give a `wss://` address explicitly.
needs.zh: 呼叫一次 `connect()`（演出會做），之後每個畫面呼叫 `frame(snapshot)`。`connected` 是 false 的時候，`frame()` 什麼都不做。頁面必須連得到中繼站：在 https 頁面上，瀏覽器會擋住 `ws://`（混合內容），所以請明確給一個 `wss://` 位址。

notes.en: Fields to read and set: `url` (with `?role=stage` appended, or `null`), `hz`, `connected`, `ws`, and the hook `onStatus = (ok) => {}`.
notes.zh: 可以讀、可以設的欄位：`url`（附上 `?role=stage`，或是 `null`）、`hz`、`connected`、`ws`，以及掛鉤 `onStatus = (ok) => {}`。

notes.en: On a public https page a hand-assembled show that connects to `ws://127.0.0.1:7457` meets Chrome's Local Network Access prompt (from Chrome 147 for WebSockets, per the package README): press Allow, or open the page from `http://localhost`.
notes.zh: 在公開的 https 頁面上，手工組裝的演出如果連 `ws://127.0.0.1:7457`，會遇到 Chrome 的區域網路存取詢問（依套件 README，WebSocket 從 Chrome 147 開始）：按允許，或從 `http://localhost` 開啟頁面。

caption.en: The console prints `connecting ws://192.168.1.20:7457?role=stage`, `connected true`, and then only one `sent at t scene`: the other four calls came inside one throttle interval and were dropped.
caption.zh: 主控台印出 `connecting ws://192.168.1.20:7457?role=stage`、`connected true`，然後只有一行 `sent at t scene`：其他四次呼叫都落在同一個節流間隔裡，被丟掉了。

caption.en: With the relay running (`node packages/monitor/server.js`), a phone on the same network that opens `http://<this machine>:7457/` sees the clock, the scene, the frame rate and every signal and param move.
caption.zh: 中繼站開著的時候（`node packages/monitor/server.js`），同一個網路上的手機打開 `http://<這台機器>:7457/`，就會看到時鐘、場景、影格率，以及每個訊號和參數在動。

tbd.en: The relay itself (`packages/monitor/server.js`) and the backstage page were not run here; the examples use a stand-in socket.
tbd.zh: 中繼站本身（`packages/monitor/server.js`）和後台頁面沒有在這裡跑過。範例用的是代替的 socket。

members.name: frame
members.doc: Call per frame; throttles itself.

entries.name: snapshotOf
entries.signature: snapshotOf({ timeline, params, signals, stage, loop }, state)

summary.en: Builds the usual snapshot of a show from its parts: clock, scene, world, frame rate, resolved params, overrides and every signal.
summary.zh: 從演出的各部分建出一般的快照：時鐘、場景、世界、影格率、解析後的參數、覆寫，以及每個訊號。

description.en: The data that [`MonitorFeed.frame()`](#MonitorFeed) sends and the backstage page draws. Each part is optional and read with a safe fallback, so a hand-assembled show can pass only what it has. The snapshot is plain JSON, so you can also log it, store it for a rehearsal recording or show it in your own page.
description.zh: 這是 [`MonitorFeed.frame()`](#MonitorFeed) 送出、後台頁面用來畫畫面的資料。每個部分都是選填的、讀取時有安全的預設值，所以手工組裝的演出只要傳它有的部分就行。快照是單純的 JSON，所以你也可以把它記下來、存成排練的錄影，或顯示在自己的頁面上。

params.name: timeline
params.en: The [`Timeline`](#Timeline): gives `t`, `playing`, `holding`, `total`, `sceneIndex` and `scene`.
params.zh: [`Timeline`](#Timeline)：提供 `t`、`playing`、`holding`、`total`、`sceneIndex` 和 `scene`。

params.name: params
params.en: The [`Params`](#Params): gives the list of keys that are overridden.
params.zh: [`Params`](#Params)：提供被覆寫的參數 key 清單。

params.name: signals
params.en: The [`Signals`](#Signals): every signal as `{ n, v, k }` (name, value, kind).
params.zh: [`Signals`](#Signals)：每個訊號整理成 `{ n, v, k }`（名字、值、類型）。

params.name: stage
params.en: The [`Stage`](#Stage): gives the active world's name.
params.zh: [`Stage`](#Stage)：提供目前世界的名字。

params.name: loop
params.en: The [`Loop`](#Loop): gives the frame rate.
params.zh: [`Loop`](#Loop)：提供影格率。

params.name: state
params.en: The resolved param values of this frame (what `stage.frame()` returns). `{}` when you pass nothing.
params.zh: 這個畫面解析後的參數值（`stage.frame()` 的回傳值）。什麼都不傳的話是 `{}`。

returns.en: `{ t, playing, holding, total, sceneIndex, scene, world, fps, state, overrides, signals }`. `scene` is the current scene's title (or its id); `holding` is true while the show waits at a hold; `signals` is `[{ n, v, k }]` with numbers rounded to 3 decimals. A part you leave out gives zeros, empty strings and empty lists.
returns.zh: `{ t, playing, holding, total, sceneIndex, scene, world, fps, state, overrides, signals }`。`scene` 是目前場景的標題（沒有標題就用 id）。`holding` 在演出停在 hold 上等待的時候為 true。`signals` 是 `[{ n, v, k }]`，數字會四捨五入到小數三位。沒有給的部分，結果是 0、空字串和空清單。

caption.en: The console prints the snapshot: `t: 35`, `scene: 'noon'` (a scene without a title shows its id), `world: 'garden'`, `fps: 60`, `state: { hue: 90 }`, `overrides: [ 'hue' ]` and `signals: [ { n: 'midi/cc/74', v: 0.457, k: 'continuous' } ]`.
caption.zh: 主控台印出快照：`t: 35`、`scene: 'noon'`（沒有標題的場景會顯示它的 id）、`world: 'garden'`、`fps: 60`、`state: { hue: 90 }`、`overrides: [ 'hue' ]`，以及 `signals: [ { n: 'midi/cc/74', v: 0.457, k: 'continuous' } ]`。

summary.en: The list of URLs [`loadKernel()`](#loadKernel) tries for a kernel, in order: your `urls`, then `window.__LAB__.vendor`, then the unpkg default.
summary.zh: [`loadKernel()`](#loadKernel) 載入核心時依序嘗試的網址清單：你給的 `urls`、`window.__LAB__.vendor`、最後是 unpkg 預設的。

description.en: The order lets a page choose where its kernels come from without touching the code that uses them: pass `urls` for one page, set `window.__LAB__.vendor` for a whole host (the lab does, to serve the kernels itself), and the unpkg default is the last resort. Calling it yourself is useful to see where a page would look.
description.zh: 這個順序讓頁面可以決定核心從哪裡來，而不用動到使用它們的程式：單一頁面傳 `urls`，整個主機就設 `window.__LAB__.vendor`（實驗室就是這樣做，自己提供核心），unpkg 預設是最後的辦法。自己呼叫它，可以看出一個頁面會去哪些地方找。

params.name: kind
params.en: Which kernel.
params.zh: 哪一個核心。

params.name: opts
params.en: `urls`: `{ smlib, manifold }`, each a URL or a list of URLs.
params.zh: `urls`：`{ smlib, manifold }`，每一項是一個網址或一串網址。

returns.en: The URLs, first to try first, without repeats.
returns.zh: 網址清單，最先要試的排最前面，沒有重複。

caption.en: Prints three smlib URLs in order (yours, the host's, unpkg) and only the unpkg URL for manifold, which nobody configured.
caption.zh: 依序印出 smlib 的三個網址（你的、主機的、unpkg），以及 manifold 只有 unpkg 的網址，因為沒有人設定它。

summary.en: Measures a triangle mesh for 3D printing: closed or not, volume, mass, overhang, thinnest wall, fit on the bed, with a plain warning for each problem.
summary.zh: 替三角形網格量 3D 列印要看的數字：封不封閉、體積、重量、懸空、最薄的壁、放不放得進列印床，每個問題有一句白話警告。

description.en: Pure and synchronous, with no DOM. Duplicate vertices are merged first (within 1e-6 of the bounding-box diagonal), because without that every un-indexed mesh (three.js `toNonIndexed()`, an STL, any triangle soup) reads as open. In the report: `triangles` (after merging; a face that collapses is dropped), `bbox` as `{ min, max, size }` in mm, `volume` in mm³ (always positive; a mesh wound inside out is measured the right way round), `watertight` (every edge used by exactly two faces, in opposite directions) with the counts `openEdges`, `nonManifoldEdges` and `inconsistentEdges` behind it, and `grams`: `{ PETG, PLA }`, the weight of the volume as solid plastic (1.27 and 1.24 g/cm³).
description.zh: 純函式、同步，不碰 DOM。重複的頂點會先合併（距離在包圍盒對角線的 1e-6 以內），因為不這樣做，每個沒有索引的網格（three.js 的 `toNonIndexed()`、STL、任何三角形湯）都會被看成有開口。報告裡有：`triangles`（合併之後的數量，塌掉的面會被丟掉）、`bbox`（`{ min, max, size }`，單位毫米）、`volume`（單位 mm³，一定是正的，繞法反了的網格也會用正確的方向去量）、`watertight`（每條邊剛好被兩個面用到、而且方向相反），背後是 `openEdges`、`nonManifoldEdges`、`inconsistentEdges` 三個計數，還有 `grams`：`{ PETG, PLA }`，把體積當成實心塑膠算出的重量（1.27 和 1.24 g/cm³）。

description.en: `overhang` is `{ angle, area, ratio }`: the area (mm²) of faces that look down steeper than `angle` allows, and its share of the whole surface. Faces that rest on the lowest 0.2 mm (the bed) do not count. `minWall` is `{ value, min, median, samples }` or `null`: rays are shot into the part from sampled faces, and `value` is the 5th percentile of the thicknesses found, which is how thin most of the wall is. `min` is the single thinnest sample, which on a part with holes drilled at an angle is a knife edge and says little about the wall, so it has its own milder note.
description.zh: `overhang` 是 `{ angle, area, ratio }`：朝下的程度超過 `angle` 容許範圍的面的面積（mm²），以及它佔整個表面的比例。貼在最低 0.2 毫米內（也就是貼在床上）的面不算。`minWall` 是 `{ value, min, median, samples }` 或 `null`：從取樣的面朝零件裡面射線，`value` 是量到的厚度的第 5 百分位，也就是大部分壁有多薄。`min` 是單一最薄的樣本，在有斜著鑽孔的零件上，它會是刀口，對壁厚說不了什麼，所以另外有比較溫和的提示。

description.en: `warnings` is a list of one sentence each, in Chinese: not watertight (with the three counts), overhang above `overhangWarn`, a wall thinner than `minWall`, a knife edge thinner than half of it, and a size beyond `bed`. An empty list means nothing to report. `fab.check(x)` is `checkMesh(meshOf(x), opts)`.
description.zh: `warnings` 是一串警告，每項一句話：網格不水密（附三個計數）、懸空超過 `overhangWarn`、壁比 `minWall` 薄、刀口比它的一半還薄、尺寸超出 `bed`。清單是空的就表示沒有要回報的事。`fab.check(x)` 就是 `checkMesh(meshOf(x), opts)`。

params.name: input
params.en: A mesh `{ vertices, triangles, units? }`: `vertices` a `Float32Array` or `Float64Array` of x, y, z, x, y, z …, `triangles` a `Uint32Array` with three vertex numbers per face, counter-clockwise seen from outside, Z up, in millimetres. Use [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) to get one from something else.
params.zh: 網格 `{ vertices, triangles, units? }`：`vertices` 是 x, y, z, x, y, z … 的 `Float32Array` 或 `Float64Array`，`triangles` 是每個面三個頂點編號的 `Uint32Array`，從外面看逆時針，Z 向上，單位毫米。要從別的東西得到網格，用 [`meshOf()`](#meshOf)。

params.name: opts
params.en: `angle` (45): the overhang angle in degrees. `minWall` (1.2): the thinnest wall allowed, in mm. `bed` (`[320, 320, 325]`): the size of the print bed in mm. `wallSamples` (2000): how many faces to measure the wall from; fewer is faster. `overhangWarn` (0.15): the share of overhanging area that earns a warning. `weld` (`true`): merge duplicate vertices first; `false` skips it.
params.zh: `angle`（45）：懸空角度，單位度。`minWall`（1.2）：允許的最薄壁，單位毫米。`bed`（`[320, 320, 325]`）：列印床的大小，單位毫米。`wallSamples`（2000）：量壁厚時取樣的面數，少一點比較快。`overhangWarn`（0.15）：懸空面積佔多少比例才警告。`weld`（`true`）：先把重複的頂點合併，`false` 就跳過。

returns.en: `{ units, triangles, bbox, volume, watertight, openEdges, nonManifoldEdges, inconsistentEdges, overhang, minWall, grams, warnings }`. See the description.
returns.zh: `{ units, triangles, bbox, volume, watertight, openEdges, nonManifoldEdges, inconsistentEdges, overhang, minWall, grams, warnings }`。見說明。

notes.en: `grams` is the weight of a solid part: it does not know about infill or wall count, so a sliced print weighs less.
notes.zh: `grams` 是實心零件的重量：它不知道填充率或外殼層數，所以切片列印出來的會比較輕。

caption.en: Prints closed: true, size 10 x 10 x 10 mm, volume 166.67 mm³, PLA 0.207 g and a wall of 3.33 mm.
caption.zh: 印出 closed: true、尺寸 10 x 10 x 10 mm、體積 166.67 mm³、PLA 0.207 公克，壁厚 3.33 mm。

caption.en: Prints watertight: false with 3 open edges, and 2 warnings: the open mesh and the 10 mm part that does not fit a 5 mm bed.
caption.zh: 印出 watertight: false、3 條開放邊，以及 2 個警告：網格有開口，以及 10 毫米的零件放不進 5 毫米的床。

caption.en: Prints true with the default merge and false with weld: false: a soup of loose triangles looks open until its vertices are merged.
caption.zh: 預設會合併，印出 true，用 weld: false 印出 false：一堆散的三角形，在頂點合併之前看起來是開的。

summary.en: Where the CAD kernels are loaded from when nothing else says so: smlibwasm 0.3.0 and manifold-3d 3.5.4, both from unpkg.
summary.zh: 沒有別的指定時，CAD 核心從哪裡載入：smlibwasm 0.3.0 和 manifold-3d 3.5.4，都是從 unpkg。

description.en: The last entry of [`candidateUrls()`](#candidateUrls). Versions are pinned, so the kernels a page gets do not change under it. To use another copy, pass `urls` to [`Fab`](#Fab) or [`loadKernel()`](#loadKernel) rather than changing this object.
description.zh: [`candidateUrls()`](#candidateUrls) 的最後一項。版本是釘死的，所以頁面拿到的核心不會在它底下悄悄改變。要用別的副本，請把 `urls` 傳給 [`Fab`](#Fab) 或 [`loadKernel()`](#loadKernel)，不要去改這個物件。

value.en: `{ smlib: 'https://unpkg.com/@classcad/smlibwasm@0.3.0/dist/index.js', manifold: 'https://unpkg.com/manifold-3d@3.5.4/manifold.js' }`.
value.zh: 兩個網址：`{ smlib: 'https://unpkg.com/@classcad/smlibwasm@0.3.0/dist/index.js', manifold: 'https://unpkg.com/manifold-3d@3.5.4/manifold.js' }`。

examples.code:
import { DEFAULT_URLS } from '@openav/fab'; document.getElementById('app').innerHTML = Object.entries(DEFAULT_URLS).map(([kind, url]) => kind + ': ' + url).join('
');

caption.en: Prints the two unpkg addresses, with the versions in them.
caption.zh: 印出兩個 unpkg 位址，位址裡有版本號。

entries.name: exportAs
entries.signature: async exportAs(x, fmt, opts = {}, kernel = null)

summary.en: Exports a shape as STL, OBJ, GLB, STEP or DXF and resolves to `{ bytes, mime, ext, report }`: the same as `fab.export()`, without the `Fab` class.
summary.zh: 把形狀輸出成 STL、OBJ、GLB、STEP 或 DXF，結果是 `{ bytes, mime, ext, report }`：跟 `fab.export()` 一樣，只是不用 `Fab` 類別。

description.en: `stl`, `obj` and `glb` come from the mesh: [`toStlBytes()`](#toStlBytes), [`toObjText()`](#toObjText), [`toGlbBytes()`](#toGlbBytes). `step` and `dxf` come straight from the smlibwasm kernel (`toStep`, `toDxf`) and are refused for anything that is not a kernel shape, because a mesh has no curved surfaces to write; an error says so. A kernel solid's `glb` uses the kernel's `toGlb` when it has one. The report is made on the way, so a file and its check always agree.
description.zh: `stl`、`obj`、`glb` 由網格產生：[`toStlBytes()`](#toStlBytes)、[`toObjText()`](#toObjText)、[`toGlbBytes()`](#toGlbBytes)。`step` 和 `dxf` 直接來自 smlibwasm 核心（`toStep`、`toDxf`），不是核心形狀的東西會被拒絕，因為網格沒有曲面可以寫，錯誤訊息會這樣說。核心實體的 `glb` 在核心有 `toGlb` 的時候會用它。報告是順便做出來的，所以檔案和它的檢查結果一定一致。

params.name: x
params.en: The shape: anything [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) accepts, and for `step` a smlibwasm `Part`, for `dxf` a smlibwasm `Shape` or `Sketch`.
params.zh: 形狀：[`meshOf()`](#meshOf) 接受的任何東西。`step` 要用 smlibwasm 的 `Part`，`dxf` 要用 smlibwasm 的 `Shape` 或 `Sketch`。

params.name: fmt
params.en: `'stl'`, `'obj'`, `'step'`, `'dxf'` or `'glb'`, in any case. `'stp'` means step and `'gltf'` means glb. Another word throws an `Error` that lists the formats.
params.zh: `'stl'`、`'obj'`、`'step'`、`'dxf'` 或 `'glb'`，大小寫都可以。`'stp'` 等於 step，`'gltf'` 等於 glb。其他的字會丟出列出可用格式的 `Error`。

params.name: opts
params.en: The options of [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) (`scale`, `tessellator`) and of [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) (`angle`, `minWall`, `bed` …), and `name`, the object name of an OBJ file.
params.zh: [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) 的選項（`scale`、`tessellator`）、[`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) 的選項（`angle`、`minWall`、`bed` …），以及 `name`，也就是 OBJ 檔裡的物件名稱。

params.name: kernel
params.en: `{ smlib: () => Promise<module> }`, where to get the smlibwasm module for `step`, `dxf`, and the `glb` of a `Part`. `fab.export()` passes its own.
params.zh: `{ smlib: () => Promise<module> }`，`step`、`dxf` 和 `Part` 的 `glb` 要從哪裡拿 smlibwasm 模組。`fab.export()` 會傳它自己的。

returns.en: `bytes` is a `Uint8Array`, `mime` is from [`MIME`](#MIME), `ext` is the extension without the dot (`'step'` even if you asked for `'stp'`), and `report` is the [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) report of the mesh (for `step` and `dxf` it can be `null` when the shape cannot be meshed, such as a 2D sketch).
returns.zh: `bytes` 是 `Uint8Array`，`mime` 來自 [`MIME`](#MIME)，`ext` 是不含點的副檔名（就算你要的是 `'stp'` 也是 `'step'`），`report` 是這個網格的 [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) 報告（`step` 和 `dxf` 在形狀切不成網格，例如 2D 草圖時，可能是 `null`）。

caption.en: Prints three exports: STL as stl (284 bytes), obj, and the alias gltf as glb, each with the report's verdict.
caption.zh: 印出三個輸出：STL 變成 stl（284 位元組）、obj，以及別名 gltf 變成 glb，每個都附上報告的結論。

caption.en: Two refusals, each with a message in Chinese: a mesh cannot become STEP (it has no curved surfaces), and "xyz" is not a format.
caption.zh: 兩個拒絕，各有一則中文訊息：網格不能變成 STEP（它沒有曲面），「xyz」也不是格式。

caption.en: Prints "step (model/step): ISO-10303-21;": the alias stp was understood and the bytes came from the kernel's toStep.
caption.zh: 印出 `step (model/step): ISO-10303-21;`，表示別名 stp 被認得了，位元組來自核心的 toStep。

summary.en: Checks a shape for 3D printing and exports it as STL, OBJ, GLB, STEP or DXF; takes a mesh, a three.js object or a smlibwasm solid.
summary.zh: 檢查一個形狀能不能 3D 列印，並輸出成 STL、OBJ、GLB、STEP 或 DXF，吃網格、three.js 物件或 smlibwasm 的實體。

description.en: Make one `Fab` and hand it whatever you made: `fab.check(x)` returns a manufacturability report (is it closed, how much material, how much overhang, how thin is the thinnest wall, how many grams), and `await fab.export(x, 'stl')` returns the file as bytes. `x` can be a plain triangle mesh `{ vertices, triangles }`, a three.js `Mesh`, `Object3D` or `BufferGeometry` (recognised by its shape, three.js is never imported), or a smlibwasm `Part` or `Shape`. [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) says exactly what is accepted.
description.zh: 做一個 `Fab`，把你做出來的東西交給它：`fab.check(x)` 回傳製造性報告（封不封閉、用了多少材料、有多少懸空、最薄的壁多薄、幾公克），`await fab.export(x, 'stl')` 以位元組回傳檔案。`x` 可以是單純的三角形網格 `{ vertices, triangles }`、three.js 的 `Mesh`、`Object3D` 或 `BufferGeometry`（靠形狀辨認，從不 import three.js），或 smlibwasm 的 `Part` 或 `Shape`。[`meshOf()`](#meshOf) 說明了到底接受什麼。

description.en: Formats: `stl`, `obj` and `glb` work for any input; `step` only for a smlibwasm `Part`, and `dxf` only for a smlibwasm `Shape` or `Sketch`, because a mesh has no curved-surface information. The CAD kernels are not bundled: the first time one is needed, `fab.smlib()` or `fab.manifold()` imports it from a URL (unpkg by default) and remembers it.
description.zh: 格式：`stl`、`obj`、`glb` 任何輸入都行。`step` 只能從 smlibwasm 的 `Part` 輸出，`dxf` 只能從 smlibwasm 的 `Shape` 或 `Sketch` 輸出，因為網格沒有曲面資訊。CAD 核心沒有打包在裡面：第一次需要時，`fab.smlib()` 或 `fab.manifold()` 才從網址（預設是 unpkg）import 進來，並且記住。

description.en: `fab.save()` writes the file through `fab.saver` if you set one (the lab's dev server does), and otherwise as a browser download. Zero runtime dependencies: nothing is fetched until you ask for a kernel.
description.zh: `fab.save()` 如果你設了 `fab.saver`（實驗室的開發伺服器就會設）就透過它寫檔，沒有的話就當成瀏覽器下載。沒有任何執行期相依套件：在你要求核心之前，不會抓任何東西。

params.name: opts
params.en: `{ scale, urls, importer, download, context }`, all optional. `scale` is millimetres per unit for a three.js object (`10` means one three.js unit is 10 mm). `urls` is `{ smlib, manifold }`, a URL or a list of them, to load the CAD kernels from. `importer(url)` replaces the dynamic `import()` that loads a kernel. `download(bytes, info)` replaces the browser download that `save()` falls back to. `context()` returns `{ id, params }` for `save()` to put in `info`.
params.zh: `{ scale, urls, importer, download, context }`，每一項都可省略。`scale` 是 three.js 物件每個單位多少毫米（`10` 表示 three.js 的一個單位是 10 毫米）。`urls` 是 `{ smlib, manifold }`，一個網址或一串網址，用來載入 CAD 核心。`importer(url)` 取代載入核心用的動態 `import()`。`download(bytes, info)` 取代 `save()` 退而求其次用的瀏覽器下載。`context()` 回傳 `{ id, params }`，讓 `save()` 放進 `info`。

needs.en: Nothing for meshes and three.js objects. A smlibwasm `Part` has to be tessellated by the kernel: call `await fab.smlib()` once before the synchronous `check()`, or use `checkAsync()`, `meshOfAsync()` and `export()`, which load it for you. Loading needs a network, or `urls` / `window.__LAB__.vendor` pointing somewhere that has the kernel.
needs.zh: 網格和 three.js 物件不需要任何前置動作。smlibwasm 的 `Part` 要由核心來切成網格：在同步的 `check()` 之前先 `await fab.smlib()` 一次，或改用會自動載入的 `checkAsync()`、`meshOfAsync()` 和 `export()`。載入需要網路，或是 `urls`、`window.__LAB__.vendor` 指向有這個核心的地方。

notes.en: Public fields: `opts` and `saver` (set it to `async (bytes, info) => ({ file, … })`; it starts as `null`). The file name for `save()` is `name`, else the `id` from `context()`, else `fab`.
notes.zh: 公開的欄位有 `opts` 和 `saver`（設成 `async (bytes, info) => ({ file, … })`，一開始是 `null`）。`save()` 的檔名是 `name`，沒有的話是 `context()` 給的 `id`，再沒有就是 `fab`。

caption.en: Prints watertight: true, volume 166.7 mm³ (10 × 10 × 10 ÷ 6), 0.212 g of PETG, no overhang and no warnings.
caption.zh: 印出 watertight: true、體積 166.7 mm³（10 × 10 × 10 ÷ 6）、PETG 0.212 公克、沒有懸空、沒有警告。

caption.en: Prints the STL as 284 bytes (84 + 50 × 4) and the first lines of the OBJ: a comment, "o tetra" and the first two vertices.
caption.zh: 印出 STL 是 284 位元組（84 + 50 × 4），以及 OBJ 的前幾行：註解、「o tetra」和前兩個頂點。

caption.en: Prints the download of tetra.stl (the stand-in `download` replaces the browser's), then the saver's answer for tetra.obj.
caption.zh: 印出 tetra.stl 的下載（替身 `download` 取代了瀏覽器的下載），然後是 saver 對 tetra.obj 的回答。

tbd.en: The STEP and DXF export, and the tessellation of a real smlibwasm `Part`, were not run for this entry: they need the real kernel from unpkg. The examples use a stand-in kernel to show the routing.
tbd.zh: 這一條沒有實際跑過 STEP 和 DXF 輸出，以及真正的 smlibwasm `Part` 切網格：它們需要 unpkg 上的真正核心。範例用一個替身核心來示範流程。

summary.en: Turns a mesh-like object (positions and indices under any of the usual names) into a triangle mesh, multiplying the positions by `scale`.
summary.zh: 把像網格的物件（位置和索引用常見的任何名稱）變成三角形網格，位置會乘上 `scale`。

description.en: This is what [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) uses for a kernel's tessellation result, whichever way the kernel spells it. It throws an `Error` (in Chinese) when `m` is empty or has no positions. It does not check that the faces point outward or that the mesh is closed: that is [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh).
description.zh: [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) 處理核心的切網格結果時用的就是它，不管核心怎麼拼那些名稱。`m` 是空的、或沒有位置的話，會丟出 `Error`（中文訊息）。它不檢查面是不是朝外、網格有沒有封閉：那是 [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) 的工作。

params.name: m
params.en: An object with the points under `positions`, `vertices`, `points` or `position`, and the faces under `indices`, `triangles`, `faces`, `index` or `triVerts`. Points may be flat numbers, nested arrays (`[[x, y, z], …]`) or objects (`{ x, y, z }`). Without faces, every three points are one triangle. `m.units` is kept (default `'mm'`).
params.zh: 一個物件，點放在 `positions`、`vertices`、`points` 或 `position` 底下，面放在 `indices`、`triangles`、`faces`、`index` 或 `triVerts` 底下。點可以是攤平的數字、巢狀陣列（`[[x, y, z], …]`）或物件（`{ x, y, z }`）。沒有面的話，每三個點是一個三角形。`m.units` 會保留（預設 `'mm'`）。

params.name: scale
params.en: Multiplies every position, for example millimetres per unit.
params.zh: 乘在每個位置上，例如每個單位多少毫米。

returns.en: `{ vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }`.
returns.zh: 回傳 `{ vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }`。

caption.en: Prints "vertices: 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 10, 0 | triangles: 0, 1, 2 | mm".
caption.zh: 印出「vertices: 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 10, 0 | triangles: 0, 1, 2 | mm」。

summary.en: Reads a binary STL file back into a triangle mesh: every face has its own three vertices, in 32-bit floats.
summary.zh: 把二進位 STL 檔讀回三角形網格：每個面有自己的三個頂點，32 位元浮點數。

description.en: It reads what [`toStlBytes()`](#toStlBytes) writes, or any binary STL: the normals and the two attribute bytes are skipped, and the result is a triangle soup. Give it to [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh), which merges the vertices itself, or to [`weldMesh()`](#weldMesh). The text (ASCII) form of STL, which starts with `solid`, is not supported and would read as garbage.
description.zh: 它讀的是 [`toStlBytes()`](#toStlBytes) 寫出的東西，或任何二進位 STL：法線和兩個屬性位元組會跳過，結果是一堆三角形湯。把它交給會自己合併頂點的 [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh)，或交給 [`weldMesh()`](#weldMesh)。以 `solid` 開頭的文字（ASCII）格式 STL 不支援，讀進來會是亂碼。

params.name: bytes
params.en: The contents of a binary STL file. The face count is read from the header; the file's length is not checked against it.
params.zh: 二進位 STL 檔的內容。面數從檔頭讀，不會拿檔案長度去對照。

returns.en: `{ vertices: Float32Array (9 per face), triangles: Uint32Array (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 …), units: 'mm' }`.
returns.zh: `{ vertices: Float32Array（每個面 9 個）, triangles: Uint32Array（0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 …）, units: 'mm' }`。

caption.en: Prints 4 faces and 12 vertices (no sharing), and "true": the check welds them and finds the shape closed.
caption.zh: 印出 4 個面和 12 個頂點（沒有共用），以及「true」：檢查時把它們合併後，發現形狀是封閉的。

summary.en: Imports a CAD kernel (smlibwasm or manifold-3d) from the first URL that works, and resolves to the ready module.
summary.zh: 從第一個能用的網址 import CAD 核心（smlibwasm 或 manifold-3d），結果是可以直接用的模組。

description.en: The kernels are not bundled, because open-audiovisual has no dependencies and no build step: the first time a page needs one, it is imported from a URL. The order is [`candidateUrls()`](#candidateUrls): `opts.urls[kind]`, then `window.__LAB__.vendor[kind]`, then unpkg ([`DEFAULT_URLS`](#DEFAULT_URLS)). If every URL fails it rejects with an `Error` (in Chinese) that names each URL and why it failed. It does not remember anything: `fab.smlib()` and `fab.manifold()` keep the promise for you, so call those unless you want to manage it yourself.
description.zh: 核心沒有打包，因為 open-audiovisual 沒有相依套件、也沒有建置步驟：頁面第一次需要的時候，才從網址 import 進來。順序是 [`candidateUrls()`](#candidateUrls)：`opts.urls[kind]`，然後 `window.__LAB__.vendor[kind]`，最後是 unpkg（[`DEFAULT_URLS`](#DEFAULT_URLS)）。每個網址都失敗的話，它會用 `Error`（中文）reject，訊息列出每個網址和失敗原因。它自己什麼都不記：`fab.smlib()` 和 `fab.manifold()` 會替你留著 promise，除非你想自己管理，不然呼叫那兩個。

params.name: kind
params.en: Which kernel: `'smlib'` for smlibwasm (solid modelling, STEP and DXF) or `'manifold'` for manifold-3d (fast mesh booleans).
params.zh: 哪一個核心：`'smlib'` 是 smlibwasm（實體建模、STEP 和 DXF），`'manifold'` 是 manifold-3d（快速的網格布林運算）。

params.name: opts
params.en: `urls`: `{ smlib, manifold }`, a URL or a list of URLs for each kernel. `importer`: `async (url) => module`, to use instead of the dynamic `import()`.
params.zh: `urls`：`{ smlib, manifold }`，每個核心一個網址或一串網址。`importer`：`async (url) => module`，用來取代動態的 `import()`。

returns.en: The smlibwasm module as it came, or the manifold-3d module with its WebAssembly started (`setup()` called).
returns.zh: smlibwasm 模組原樣，或已經把 WebAssembly 啟動（呼叫過 `setup()`）的 manifold-3d 模組。

needs.en: A network, or `urls` pointing at a place that serves the kernel (the lab uses `window.__LAB__.vendor`), or an `importer` that returns one.
needs.zh: 要有網路，或是 `urls` 指向有提供核心的地方（實驗室用的是 `window.__LAB__.vendor`），或是一個會回傳核心的 `importer`。

caption.en: Prints the two URLs in the order they were tried, then "setup() called": manifold's WebAssembly is started for you.
caption.zh: 依嘗試的順序印出兩個網址，然後是「setup() called」：manifold 的 WebAssembly 會替你啟動。

caption.en: When every URL fails the error names each one, yours first and then the unpkg default, with the reason (in a Chinese sentence).
caption.zh: 每個網址都失敗的時候，錯誤訊息會一個一個列出來，你的在前、unpkg 預設的在後，並附上原因（用中文寫的句子）。

summary.en: Turns whatever you made into a triangle mesh `{ vertices, triangles, units }`: a mesh, a three.js object, a mesh-like object or a smlibwasm shape.
summary.zh: 把你做的東西變成三角形網格 `{ vertices, triangles, units }`：網格、three.js 物件、像網格的物件，或 smlibwasm 的形狀。

description.en: Everything is recognised by its shape and nothing is imported, so three.js and smlibwasm are never loaded for you. A three.js object has its `matrixWorld` applied (a mirrored object keeps its faces facing outward), indexed or not, and Y up is turned into Z up as `(x, y, z) → (x, −z, y)`, then everything is multiplied by `scale`. A missing input, or something it cannot read, throws an `Error` whose message (in Chinese) says what to do.
description.zh: 每種東西都靠形狀辨認，什麼都不 import，所以 three.js 和 smlibwasm 絕對不會被替你載入。three.js 物件會套用它的 `matrixWorld`（鏡射的物件仍會讓面朝外），有沒有索引都行，Y 向上會換成 Z 向上，換法是 `(x, y, z) → (x, −z, y)`，然後全部乘上 `scale`。沒有給輸入、或它讀不懂的東西，會丟出 `Error`，訊息（中文）會說明該怎麼辦。

description.en: It is synchronous, so it cannot wait for a kernel: a smlibwasm solid without `opts.tessellator` throws a message that tells you to load the kernel first, and a `tessellate()` that returns a promise throws too. Use [`meshOfAsync()`](#meshOfAsync) for those.
description.zh: 它是同步的，所以不能等核心：沒有 `opts.tessellator` 的 smlibwasm 實體會丟出一則叫你先載入核心的訊息，`tessellate()` 回傳 promise 也會丟出錯誤。這些情況請用 [`meshOfAsync()`](#meshOfAsync)。

params.name: x
params.en: The thing to convert. Accepted, tried in this order: a mesh `{ vertices, triangles }` (returned as it is); a three.js `Mesh`, `Object3D` (every visible mesh below it) or `BufferGeometry`; anything with a `tessellate()` method; an object with `positions` / `vertices` / `points` and, optionally, `indices` / `triangles` / `faces` / `index`; a smlibwasm solid or shape (given `opts.tessellator`).
params.zh: 要轉換的東西。接受的類型，依這個順序比對：網格 `{ vertices, triangles }`（原樣傳回），three.js 的 `Mesh`、`Object3D`（底下每個看得見的網格）或 `BufferGeometry`，任何有 `tessellate()` 方法的東西，有 `positions`／`vertices`／`points`，以及可有可無的 `indices`／`triangles`／`faces`／`index` 的物件，smlibwasm 的實體或形狀（要給 `opts.tessellator`）。

params.name: opts
params.en: `scale`: millimetres per unit for a three.js or mesh-like input (default 1). A mesh `{ vertices, triangles }` is never scaled. `tessellator(shape)`: a function that turns a smlibwasm shape into a mesh (the `Fab` class passes the kernel's once it is loaded). `tessellate`: an argument passed on to the shape's own `tessellate()`.
params.zh: `scale`：three.js 或像網格的輸入，每個單位多少毫米（預設 1）。`{ vertices, triangles }` 的網格不會被縮放。`tessellator(shape)`：把 smlibwasm 形狀變成網格的函式（`Fab` 類別在核心載入後會傳入核心的那個）。`tessellate`：傳給形狀自己的 `tessellate()` 的參數。

returns.en: `{ vertices, triangles, units }`: counter-clockwise faces seen from outside, Z up, millimetres.
returns.zh: `{ vertices, triangles, units }`：從外面看逆時針的面，Z 向上，單位毫米。

caption.en: Prints "vertices: 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 10 (mm)": scaled by 10, and three.js's up (y = 1) became fab's up (z = 10).
caption.zh: 印出「vertices: 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 10 (mm)」：乘上 10，three.js 的向上（y = 1）變成 fab 的向上（z = 10）。

caption.en: Prints the nine numbers of the three corners and the face "0 1 2": nested arrays are flattened.
caption.zh: 印出三個角的九個數字，以及面「0 1 2」：巢狀陣列會被攤平。

zh: y 向上 z 向上

summary.en: Like `meshOf()`, but it waits for a `tessellate()` that returns a promise, and can load the smlibwasm kernel to tessellate a solid.
summary.zh: 跟 `meshOf()` 一樣，但它會等回傳 promise 的 `tessellate()`，也能載入 smlibwasm 核心來切實體。

description.en: Use it where the conversion may have to wait: a shape whose `tessellate()` is asynchronous, or a smlibwasm `Part` when the kernel is not loaded yet. With `opts.kernel.smlib` it awaits the module and uses its `tessellate(part)`; an error says so if the module has none. Everything else is passed on to [`meshOf()`](#meshOf). `fab.meshOfAsync()` fills in `kernel` for you.
description.zh: 轉換可能得等的時候用它：`tessellate()` 是非同步的形狀，或核心還沒載入的 smlibwasm `Part`。有給 `opts.kernel.smlib` 的話，它會等模組載好，用它的 `tessellate(part)`。模組沒有這個函式的話會丟出說明的錯誤。其他東西都交給 [`meshOf()`](#meshOf)。`fab.meshOfAsync()` 會替你填好 `kernel`。

params.name: x
params.en: The thing to convert; see [`meshOf()`](#meshOf).
params.zh: 要轉換的東西，見 [`meshOf()`](#meshOf)。

params.name: opts
params.en: The options of [`meshOf()`](#meshOf), and `kernel`: `{ smlib: () => Promise<module> }`, where to get the smlibwasm module from when a solid has to be tessellated and no `tessellator` was given.
params.zh: [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) 的選項，另外有 `kernel`：`{ smlib: () => Promise<module> }`，遇到實體要切、又沒給 `tessellator` 時，從哪裡拿 smlibwasm 模組。

returns.en: The same mesh [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) would give.
returns.zh: 跟 [`meshOf()`](#meshOf) 會給的一樣的網格。

caption.en: Prints "3 vertices, 1 face": the promise was awaited and the result turned into a mesh.
caption.zh: 印出「3 vertices, 1 face」：promise 被等到了，結果也轉成了網格。

caption.en: Prints "tessellated by the kernel: 1 face": the module was fetched through `kernel.smlib()` and its `tessellate` did the work.
caption.zh: 印出「tessellated by the kernel: 1 face」：透過 `kernel.smlib()` 取得模組，由它的 `tessellate` 完成。

summary.en: The media type of each export format: `MIME.stl` is `'model/stl'`, and `obj`, `step`, `dxf` and `glb` the same way.
summary.zh: 每種輸出格式的媒體類型：`MIME.stl` 是 `'model/stl'`，`obj`、`step`、`dxf`、`glb` 也一樣。

description.en: For the `type` of a `Blob` or the `Content-Type` of an upload when you handle the bytes yourself: `new Blob([bytes], { type: MIME.stl })`. [`exportAs()`](#exportAs) already puts the right one in its result.
description.zh: 自己處理位元組的時候，拿來當 `Blob` 的 `type` 或上傳的 `Content-Type`：`new Blob([bytes], { type: MIME.stl })`。[`exportAs()`](#exportAs) 的結果裡已經附上正確的那一個。

value.en: `{ stl: 'model/stl', obj: 'model/obj', step: 'model/step', dxf: 'image/vnd.dxf', glb: 'model/gltf-binary' }`. Its keys are the formats [`exportAs()`](#exportAs) accepts.
value.zh: `{ stl: 'model/stl', obj: 'model/obj', step: 'model/step', dxf: 'image/vnd.dxf', glb: 'model/gltf-binary' }`。它的鍵就是 [`exportAs()`](#exportAs) 接受的格式。

caption.en: Prints the five formats and a blob of type model/stl, 284 bytes.
caption.zh: 印出五種格式，以及一個類型是 model/stl、284 位元組的 blob。

summary.en: Writes a triangle mesh as a minimal binary glTF (`.glb`): one mesh with welded positions and indices, in millimetres.
summary.zh: 把三角形網格寫成最精簡的二進位 glTF（`.glb`）：一個網格，位置已合併並帶索引，單位毫米。

description.en: Vertices are welded first with [`weldMesh()`](#weldMesh). The file has `POSITION` and indices only: no normals, no materials, no colours, so a viewer shades it flat or works the normals out itself. The positions stay in millimetres and Z up, and `asset.extras` says `{ units: 'mm', up: 'Z' }`. glTF itself assumes Y up, so a viewer that does not read the extras shows the part lying on its side.
description.zh: 頂點會先用 [`weldMesh()`](#weldMesh) 合併。檔案裡只有 `POSITION` 和索引：沒有法線、材質、顏色，所以檢視器會用平面著色，或自己算法線。位置維持毫米、Z 向上，`asset.extras` 寫著 `{ units: 'mm', up: 'Z' }`。glTF 本身假設 Y 向上，所以不讀 extras 的檢視器會把零件顯示成躺在側面。

description.en: `await fab.export(part, 'glb')` of a smlibwasm `Part` uses the kernel's own `toGlb` when it has one, and this function otherwise.
description.zh: smlibwasm 的 `Part` 用 `await fab.export(part, 'glb')` 的話，核心有自己的 `toGlb` 就用它，沒有才用這個函式。

params.name: mesh
params.en: A mesh `{ vertices, triangles }`, in millimetres.
params.zh: 網格 `{ vertices, triangles }`，單位毫米。

returns.en: A glTF 2.0 binary: the `glTF` header, one JSON chunk, one binary chunk with 32-bit float positions and 32-bit indices. The length is a multiple of 4.
returns.zh: glTF 2.0 二進位檔：`glTF` 檔頭、一個 JSON 區塊、一個放 32 位元浮點數位置和 32 位元索引的二進位區塊。長度是 4 的倍數。

caption.en: Prints the magic "glTF" and the size, 4 vertices with 12 indices, and the bounds 10 x 10 x 10.
caption.zh: 印出魔術字串「glTF」和大小、4 個頂點配 12 個索引，以及範圍 10 x 10 x 10。

summary.en: Writes a triangle mesh as OBJ text: welded vertices (`v x y z`), then faces (`f a b c`), one object, in millimetres.
summary.zh: 把三角形網格寫成 OBJ 文字：先合併頂點（`v x y z`），再寫面（`f a b c`），一個物件，單位毫米。

description.en: Vertices are welded first with [`weldMesh()`](#weldMesh), so a triangle soup comes out with shared vertices and a small file. There are no normals, no texture coordinates and no materials. `await fab.export(x, 'obj', { name })` is the same thing with the conversions done for you.
description.zh: 頂點會先用 [`weldMesh()`](#weldMesh) 合併，所以三角形湯寫出來有共用的頂點，檔案也小。沒有法線、沒有貼圖座標、沒有材質。`await fab.export(x, 'obj', { name })` 是同一件事，並且替你做了轉換。

params.name: mesh
params.en: A mesh `{ vertices, triangles }`, in millimetres.
params.zh: 網格 `{ vertices, triangles }`，單位毫米。

params.name: name
params.en: The object name on the `o` line. Spaces become underscores.
params.zh: `o` 那一行的物件名稱。空格會變成底線。

returns.en: The text: a comment line, `o <name>`, one `v` line per welded vertex (6 decimals at most) and one `f` line per face, vertex numbers counting from 1.
returns.zh: 文字內容：一行註解、`o <name>`、每個合併後的頂點一行 `v`（最多 6 位小數）、每個面一行 `f`，頂點編號從 1 開始。

caption.en: Prints the comment, "o my_part", four v lines and four f lines: "f 1 3 2" is the first face.
caption.zh: 印出註解、「o my_part」、四行 v 和四行 f：「f 1 3 2」是第一個面。

summary.en: Writes a triangle mesh as a binary STL file: 84 + 50 bytes per face, with a normal worked out for every face.
summary.zh: 把三角形網格寫成二進位 STL 檔：84 位元組加上每個面 50 位元組，每個面的法線都會算出來。

description.en: Every face becomes its own 50 bytes: STL has no shared vertices. The normal comes from the order of the corners (right-hand rule), so counter-clockwise faces seen from outside give outward normals. Positions are written as they are, as float32: nothing is converted to millimetres, so give it a mesh that is already in mm. `await fab.export(x, 'stl')` is the same thing with the conversions and the check done for you.
description.zh: 每個面各自佔 50 位元組：STL 沒有共用頂點。法線是從角的順序（右手定則）算出來的，所以從外面看逆時針的面，法線就朝外。位置原樣寫成 float32，不會換算成毫米，所以請給它已經是毫米的網格。`await fab.export(x, 'stl')` 是同一件事，並且替你做了轉換和檢查。

params.name: mesh
params.en: A mesh `{ vertices, triangles }`, in millimetres.
params.zh: 網格 `{ vertices, triangles }`，單位毫米。

returns.en: The file: an 80-byte header (the text `open-audiovisual fab STL (mm)`), the face count as a little-endian 32-bit integer, then per face the normal and three corners as 32-bit floats and two zero bytes.
returns.zh: 檔案內容：80 位元組的檔頭（文字 `open-audiovisual fab STL (mm)`）、面數（小端序的 32 位元整數），然後每個面是法線和三個角（32 位元浮點數）加上兩個零位元組。

caption.en: Prints 284 bytes = 84 + 50 × 4 faces, and the header text.
caption.zh: 印出 284 位元組 = 84 + 50 × 4 個面，以及檔頭文字。

caption.en: A link that downloads the file: open it in a slicer or a 3D viewer to see a small pyramid with a right-angle corner.
caption.zh: 一個下載檔案的連結：用切片軟體或 3D 檢視器打開，會看到一個有直角的小金字塔。

summary.en: Merges vertices that sit closer together than a tolerance and drops the faces that collapse; returns a new mesh with shared vertices.
summary.zh: 把靠得比容差還近的頂點合併，並丟掉塌掉的面，回傳一個頂點有共用的新網格。

description.en: A triangle soup, where every face has three vertices of its own (what an STL file or three.js `toNonIndexed()` gives), has no neighbours as far as topology goes: every edge looks open. Welding gives the faces shared vertices, so [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) can see that they join. [`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh), [`toObjText()`](#toObjText) and [`toGlbBytes()`](#toGlbBytes) call it themselves; [`toStlBytes()`](#toStlBytes) does not need it.
description.zh: 三角形湯，也就是每個面都有自己的三個頂點（STL 檔或 three.js 的 `toNonIndexed()` 給的就是這樣），在拓撲上沒有鄰居：每條邊都看起來是開的。合併頂點讓面共用頂點，[`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh) 才看得出它們是接在一起的。[`checkMesh()`](#checkMesh)、[`toObjText()`](#toObjText) 和 [`toGlbBytes()`](#toGlbBytes) 會自己呼叫它，[`toStlBytes()`](#toStlBytes) 用不到。

params.name: mesh
params.en: A mesh `{ vertices, triangles }`. It is not changed.
params.zh: 網格 `{ vertices, triangles }`。不會被改動。

params.name: tolerance
params.en: Vertices closer than this (in each of x, y and z) become one, in the mesh's units. Left out: 1e-6 times the diagonal of the bounding box.
params.zh: 距離（x、y、z 各自）小於這個值的頂點會變成一個，單位跟網格一樣。不給的話是包圍盒對角線的 1e-6 倍。

returns.en: `{ vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }` with each position once, and no face that has two corners on the same vertex.
returns.zh: `{ vertices: Float64Array, triangles: Uint32Array, units }`，每個位置只出現一次，也沒有任何一個面有兩個角落在同一個頂點上。

caption.en: Prints "soup: 12 vertices, welded: 4 vertices, 4 faces".
caption.zh: 印出「soup: 12 vertices, welded: 4 vertices, 4 faces」。

summary.en: Lists every MIDI controller profile that ships with the framework: id, name, maker, kind, control mix, how many controls are unverified, and its page URL.
summary.zh: 列出框架內建的每一份 MIDI 控制器設定檔：id、名稱、廠牌、種類、控制元件的組成、還有幾個沒驗證、以及它的頁面網址。

description.en: No input: send `"arguments": {}`. It reads the profiles in `packages/midi/profiles/`, the same ones the controller pages and `<oav-controller>` use. Use it to find the `id` for [`read_profile`](#read_profile), or to check that a controller is already covered before writing a new profile with [`scaffold_profile`](#scaffold_profile).
description.zh: 不需要輸入：送 `"arguments": {}`。它讀的是 `packages/midi/profiles/` 裡的設定檔，跟控制器頁面和 `<oav-controller>` 用的是同一批。用它找 [`read_profile`](#read_profile) 要的 `id`，或在用 [`scaffold_profile`](#scaffold_profile) 寫新設定檔之前，先確認這台控制器是不是已經有了。

returns.en: `{ count, controllers }` as JSON text.
